UMNDENI kasomatekisi waseMbulwana, eGreytown, usola amaphoyisa ngokushona kwelungu lawo, okuthiwa lipitshizwe imoto yamaphoyisa lashona, liyokhomba lapho lifihle khona isibhamu.Umndeni kaMnuz Mdumiseni Mkhize (32) onamatekisi asuka eMbulwane aye eGreytown, usola ukuthi umufi ushone efakwe ishubhu, amaphoyisa afihla ukuthi useshonile amathatha ngeveni athi ubulawe yingozi yemoto.UMnuz Zwelihle Mkhize umfowabo kamufi, uthe amaphoyisa angena kubo phakathi nobusuku ngoLwesihlanu efuna yena, umufi nomunye umfowabo. Uthe umufi wavula kuqala. Uthe ngokuzwa kwakhe amaphoyisa ayezobaphenya ngezinsolo zokuthinteka ekubulaweni kwabashayeli bamatekisi abangu-12, abadutshulwa eColenso, bephuma emngcwabeni owawukule ndawo, emasontweni edlule.“Alinganiselwa ku-30 amaphoyisa abezungeze umuzi wakithi. Mina bengizwa umfowethu elokhu ekhala ngaphakathi endlini ebivaliwe, ngaphakathi kukhona amaphoyisa naye kuphela, unkosikazi nezingane kuthiwe abaphume ngoba amaphoyisa afuna ukukhuluma naye kuphela. Sithe sizwa kwabe kuthuleka. Asazi bekwenzekani ngaphakathi,” echazaNgemuva kwalokho uthe kuphume amaphoyisa ayolanda imoto abeyifihlile ngoba abefike ehamba ngezinyawo. Uthe ingene ihlehla yaze yama eduze komnyango wendlu ebinomufi.“Amalunga omndeni athe ayobheka ukuthi sekwenzenjani, amaphoyisa awaxosha athi awahambe ayolala kwezinye izindlu, amthatha amfaka emotweni. Asimbonanga ukuthi ubekusiphi isimo kodwa endlini abeshaywa ekuyo sifice kumanzi umbhede, izingubo naphansi, kusho ukuthi abecabanga ukuthi uqulekile ezama ukumphaphamisa,” kusho umfowabo.Uthe amaphoyisa aseKranskop athi umshayeli wale moto imphunyukile yaphaphalaza yashayisa izinsimbi ezisemgwaqweni, kwavuleka isicabha, umufi wawa, yamphitshiza, washona.“Okusixakayo ukuthi kulesi siteshi sikhonjiswa imoto encane okuthiwa ubekuyo. Kuthiwa bekunamaphoyisa amabili kuyo kodwa asizwa ukuthi wona alimele yini. Siwumndeni wakwaMkhize sihleli kabi endaweni ngoba kuthiwa siyasoleka ekushoneni kwabamatekisi abadutshulwa. Angazi ukuthi thina singena kanjani odabeni lwamatekisi asebenza eGoli. Umfowethi unamatekisi ahambela eGreytown, akanatekisi eGoli,” kusho uMkhize.UCol Thembeka Mbele okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uthe amaphoyisa abehamba nomsolwa obeyokhomba ukuthi usifihle kuphi isibhamu esingekho ethethweni.“Umshayeli uphunyukwe imoto besemgwaqweni uSambana, yagingqika, amaphoyisa abesemotweni alimele kanzima, umsolwa ushone esendaweni yesehlakalo. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso esiteshini samaphoyisa eKranskop,” kusho uCol Mbele.UMnuz Moses Dlamini wophiko oluphenya amacala athinta amaphoyisa, i-Ipid, uthe leli cala lidluliselwe kubo.

KUSAMILE ukufunda ekolishi eliqeqesha ngamakhono eGroutville emuva kokuba sekuphele izinsuku izitshudeni zilala emakilasini ngoba zingakhokhelwe imali yokuqasha izindawo zokuhlala. Izitshudeni zize zakhishwa ngamaphoyisa ekolishi ngoLwesihlanu.Izitshudeni zaseMfolozi TVET College zicasulwe wukuthi sezibekezele isikhathi eside zingayitholi imali yokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala ekhishwa yisikhwama iNational Students Financial Aid Scheme (Nsfas). Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngoMsombuluko odlule bafike emakilasini nezimpahla nezingubo zokulala ngoba abanye sebexoshiwe emiqashweni abebehlala kuyo ngenxa yokungakhokhi. Ukulala kwabo emakilasini kuphazamise nokufunda njengoba kuthiwa othisha bagcine bengasafiki yavalwa ikolishi.Okhulumela isigungu sezitshudeni, uMbali Nxumalo, uthe bagcina ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule.“Izitshudeni bezilokhu zibekezele kodwa inkinga iqale sezixoshwa ezindaweni zokuhlala ebeziqashe kuzona. Inselelo enkulu wukuthi zihlala ezindaweni ezikude futhi zizidinga ngempela izindawo zokuhlala. Kumanje ezinye zimpintshiswe abanezindawo zokuhlala, ezinye zaphindela emakhaya,” kusho yena.Uthe izitshudeni azihlangene nokuphazamiseka kokufunda ngoba ukulala kwazo bekungaphazamisi. Uveze ukuthi bamangele uma othisha nabahlanza amakilasi bengasafiki. Bagcina ukulala ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokukhishwa ngamaphoyisa. Kuthiwa le nkinga isiphazamise nezitshudeni ezifunda ngasese njengoba othisha bengasafundisi. Zilinganiselwa ku-80 izitshudeni okuthiwa zithintekile kulolu daba.UMnuz Sam Zungu, ophethe wonke amakhempasi eMfolozi, uthe kuzocaca ngoLwesithathu ukuthi sizovulwa nini isikhungo. Uphikile ukuthi izitshudeni ziqale ukulala emakilasini ngoMsombuluko wathi ziqale ngoLwesithathu.“Okumele sikucacise wukuthi asikwazi ukulawula uhlelo lokukhipha imali yezitshudeni kwaNsfas. Izitshudeni zizifakela izicelo ngqo kwaNsfas thina sithole uhla lwabazoxhaswa emuva kwesikhathi. Inkinga iqale ngokuthi kufike uhla lwamagama abazoxhaswa uNsfas ngesikhathi izitshudeni zisemaholidini ePhasika ngo-Ephreli 4. Bekumele ziqale ukufunda ngoMsombuluko odlule, ngenxa yokuhluleka ukubekezela zacasuka. Besisalindele ukuhlaziya uhla bese siluphindisela kwaNsfas ukuqinisekisa abazoxhaswa,” kusho uZungu.Ekhuluma nephephandaba uMnuz Kagisho Mamabolo okhulumela abakwaNsfas uthe ziyaqhubeka izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izitshudeni ezizoxhaswa bacela zibekezele.

IMIZAMO yokuthi kube khona uBabes Wodumo emcimbini wokuqala, iGqom in Concert ozoba senxanxatheleni yezitolo iPavillion, eThekwini, ngo-Ephreli 21, seyifana nokuthela amanzi emhlane wedada.Ngemuva kokukhishwa kwesikhangiso somcimbi, abantu abaningi bakhala ekhasini likaDJ Tira ongumhleli womcimbi befuna afake uBabes Wodumo njengoba engomunye wabagqamisa kakhulu lolu hlobo lomculo. UTira usamile ekutheni lo mculi ubiza imali abangeke bakwazi ukuyikhokha njengabahleli.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uTira izolo uthe, kuze kube yimanje beyingakalungi indaba yokuthi uBabes abe semcimbini.“Uma kuphela leli sonto ingalungile kusho ukuthi ngeke isalunga. Okwamanje inkulumo ayihlangani,” kusho uTira.Okhulumela uBabes, uHlengiwe Mbambo, uthe bebethanda ukuthi uBabes aye emcimbini.“UBabes nethimba lakhe ngebhadi bazobe bematasa ngaleyo mpelasonto. Saqinisekisa kwabanye abahleli bemicimbi ngesikhathi besiqasha ukuthi sizoba khona emcimbini yabo, abukho ubutha,” kusho uHlengiwe.Uthe ithimba laseWest Ink lifisela uTira impumelelo futhi liyathemba ukuthi bazoba khona emcimbini wangonyaka ozayo. UTira akazange ayiphathe eyokuthi akazange amthole ngoba uqashwe kwenye indawo uBabes. UHlengiwe uthe ugxile kwezokuxhumana kuphela kwiWest Ink. Ebuzwa ukuthi uBabes ubiza malini uma umqasha, uthe kuncika ohlotsheni lomcimbi omqashela lona. “Ayifani ngokwamazinga, kukhona emikhulu nemincane, nenani lakhe lihambisana nalokho,” kuchaza uHlengiwe.Kulo mcimbi kuzobe kunandisa iDistruction Boyz, Busiswa, Kwesta, Tipcee, DJ Sox, Okmalumkoolkat, Dladla Mshunqisi, Black Motion nabanye.Amathikithi omcimbi atholakala eComputicket ngoR200 kanti iVIP nguR450.“Siyakholwa wukuthi ithimba esinalo lizowenza umsebenzi futhi yingakho siqhubekile sawethula umcimbi (ngaphandle kukaBabes). Umcimbi futhi uzoshisa,” kusho uTira.Khonamanjalo, ngoLwesithathu nangoLwesine ngesonto elizayo kuzoba nengqungquthela yokucobelelana ngolwazi kwezomculo, iGqom Music Conference. Ingqungquthela ihlelwe yiDurban’s Finest, uTira noDJ Sox.Ingqungquthela izobe iseMoses Mabhida Stadium ngo-8 ekuseni kuze kube wu-4 ntambama. Kungenwa mahhala.Esitatimendeni kuvele ukuthi kuzobe kukhulunywa ngokudidiyela, ukusabalalisa umculo, ukunandisa nokunye.Izikhulumi zihlanganisa iDurban’s Finest, Rude Boyz, Distruction Boyz, DJ Lag, Zakes Bantwini nabanye.

BAYAVEVA abenhlangano elwela abathandana nobulili obufanayo ngezinsolo zokuthi amaphoyisa ashaye abesilisa ababili, bavalelwa esiteshini ngoba becwaswa ngobulili.UMnuz Vincent Nkosi (24) waseChesterville ongumfundi eRegent Business School eThekwini, uthi usahlukumezekile ngenxa yalesi sigameko esenzeke ngoLwesine olwedlule ngasebhishi eThekwini. Wayehamba nomngani wakhe wasePitoli uKgotatso obevakashile ngamaholidi eThekwini. Elandisa ngokwenzeka, uNkosi uthe babezihambela ngasebhishi ngesikhathi kuqhamuka amadoda amabili eza kubona sekukhona akukhipha emaphaketheni.“Indawo esasihamba kuyo ayiphephile, yingakho sacabanga ukuthi yizigebengu ezizosibamba inkunzi. Sabaleka ngokuhlukana nomngani wami, omunye wesilisa weza kimina wazibiza ngephoyisa. Wakhipha isibhamu wabuza ukuthi ngibalekelani engibiza ngesitabane, wangidonsa ngebhande lebhulukwe wangishaya. Wangilalisa phansi emgwaqweni esaqhubeka nokungithuka.”Uthe wabona lona omunye wesilisa esebuya nomngani wakhe embambe ngesidlozana, bobabili bafakwa evenini yamaphoyisa. Uthe bahanjiswe esiteshini samaphoyisa esingumahambanendlwana esisebhishi.“Safica kukhona owesifazane osekhulile kuleli gumbi, bamtshela ukuthi akaphume ukuze basiqondise kahle. Umngani wami unezwi elincane njengowesifazane, bekuthi uma ekhuluma bamthethise bathi akakhulume njengendoda. Umngani wami ucele nokushayela unina ucingo, banqaba bathi nguyena omvumele ukuthi abe yisitabane. Bebelokhu bengishaya ngezimpama, bangibuza nangeselula asesikhwameni sami bethi ngiyintshontshile,” kuchaza uNkosi othe lawa maphoyisa abuza ukuthi ngesikabani isithombe sowesilisa esikwiselula yakhe, wabatshela ukuthi ngesomuntu athandana naye.“Bathi bazongibophela kwakona lokho ukuthi indoda yami ngiyibhangqile ngoba ngihamba nenye indoda. Kwale noma ngibatshela ukuthi uphathina wami uyazi ukuthi ngihamba nomngani wami,” kusho uNkosi.Uthe umngani wakhe udedelwe kuqala esiteshini, yena babuye bamdedela kamumva. Bavule icala lokushaywa nelokucwaswa esiteshini samaphoyisa ePhoyinti.Okhulumela iDurban Lesbian and Gay Community and Health Care uMnuz Sbo Khumalo uthe: “Kuyasidumaza ukuthi sigubha inyanga yenkululeko kodwa kusekhona abantu abangawahloniphi amalungelo abanye. Okusithusa kakhulu ukuthi kuthinteka abantu abazi umthetho. Sizolulandela lolu daba futhi sizocela izeluleko kwikhomishini yamalungelo abantu nakwikhomishini yezokulingana ngobulili ngoba sifuna ubulungiswa,” kushouKhumalo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane uthe kuphenywa icala lokushaya emuva kokuba abesilisa ababili behlaselwa abasolwa ababafaka evenini yamaphoyisa kodwa ababengawugqokile umfaniswano womsebenzi.

KUZOCACA kuleli sonto ukuthi mungakanani umonakalo odalwe abalandeli abavuke umbhejazane bacekela phansi inkundla yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini ngemuva kokuthi iKaizer Chiefs ikhishwe yiFree State Stars kuma-semi final eNedbank Cup ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.IChiefs ihlulwe ngo 2-0 kulo mdlalo okusho ukuqhubeka kosizi kubalandeli bayo bengayazi injabulo yezicoco ngaphansi kukaSteve Komphela ogcine esulile ngawo uMgqibelo.Izolo imenenja yeMoses Mabhida, uMnuz Vusi Mazibuko, ibisemhlanganweni nonjiniyela benkundla bebheka ukuthi mungakanani umonakalo futhi kuzodla malini ukuwulungisa.“Mukhulu umonakalo owenzeke enkundleni kodwa lapho kufikela khona izivakashi ngaphandle akubanga nankinga. Sinonjiniyela ozohlola ukuthi mungakanani umonakalo futhi uzodla malini. Izindawo ezithinteke kakhulu yizihlalo, imipheme evimbela abalandeli ukuthi bangangeni ebaleni nodoti abawusaphazile. Okwamanje angifuni ukuqagela kodwa ngemuva kwamahora angu-48 sizobe sesazi,” kusho uMazibuko.Bekuwumdlalo wesithupha iChiefs isebenzisa iMoses Mabhida njengekhaya layo. Phambilini abalandeli bake bazama ukushisa inkundla ngemuva kokuhlulwa yiBaroka FC emdlalweni weligi.Owangempelasonto ufike besathuthumela ngemuva kokushaywa yiChippa United eFNB Stadium, eGoli koweligi nakhona abadala umonakalo.Njengoba bese belimaza iMabhida nonogada abaphuthunyiswe esibhedlela, iChiefs ibisanda kuhlawuliswa yiPremier Soccer League (PSL) * -R250 000 ngomonakalo waseFNB Stadium. Isigwebo besilengiselwe * -R200 000 ngokuthi ingatholakali inecala elifanayo.UMazibuko uthe yize besigxeka isenzo sabeChiefs kodwa lokho ngeke kuphazamise ubudlelwano neqembu.“Izinto ezifuze lezi zenzeka kuzona zonke izinkundla nakho angicabangi ukuthi kungabaphazamisa ubudlelwano. Noma ngubani olandela ibhola ubelindele ukuthi uma iChiefs ihlulwa kungasuka uthuthuva . Ngicabanga ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abalandeli bebhola bashintshe indlela abacabanga ngayo ngoba noma ungafaka onogada namaphoyisa abangakanani ngeke ubavimbe abantu abasuke sebezitshelile ukuthi bazodlova,” kusho uMazibuko.Imenenja yeChiefs, uBobby Motaung, ithe bayakuqonda ukudinwa kwabalandeli kodwa abahambisani nodlame.“Akwamukelekile, wonke umuntu uyakwazi lokho. Akusikhona okwami ukuthi ngithi bayizidlova wukuthi nje abalandeli bacasukile kodwa indlela yokuziphatha ayamukelekile. Isinqumo esisithathile (sokusula kukaSteve Komphela) sisenzele bona.”Okhulumela iPSL, uLuxolo September uthe bazolandela imigudu efanele ngaphambi kokuthi baphawule ngokugcwele.Isitatimende esikhishwe yiPSL sithe bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho abathintekayo ngomonakalo owenzekile.

KUVUKE umunyu kwamanzi amaduku yizinyembezi kubazali ngesikhathi kwethulwa ubufakazi babafundi abakhuliswe abazali abangabazali, izolo abebeklonyeliswa wuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal.Laba bafundi abebefunda * -matric nyakenye, bangaphansi kohlelo lomnyango lokufunela izingane eziyizintandane abazozikhulisa, zihole nemali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni. Abafundi abathathu abethule ubufakazi bagcizelele ukuthi basizwe wukuhlonipha bonke abantu abadala ngisho bazi ukuthi abanabazali.Laba bafundi baklonyeliswe ngama-laptop nezikhwama.USakhile Njoko (18) waseSandlwana eNquthu obefunda eSiyanda High wathola o-A abayisikhombisa uthe wakhuliswa umzala wakhe, yena nabafowabo abathathu nodadewabo oyedwa. Washonelwa abazali esamncane. Uyise washona eneminyaka emithathu unina washona enemihlanu.Umzala kaSakhile umkhulisile wamfundisa waze waqeda isikole benodadewabo osenguthisha nabafowabo abesezigabeni ezahlukene zokufundela izifundo zobudokotela enyuvesi, omunye wabo useCuba. USakhile uthe: “Into engikholelwa kuyo yinhlonipho. Iyona ebalulekile kakhulu kangangokuthi noma ngabe kuthiwa ushonelwe abazali, lokho akusho ukuthi ungahloniphi emphakathini. Wonke umuntu okhona mthathe njengomzali wakho.”USakhile owenza unyaka wokuqala ezifundweni ze-Acturial Science enyuvesi yaseWits, eGoli, uthe ayikho imfihlo etheni eyenze waphumelela. Uthe uma ufuna ukuphumelela kumele uzilungiselele, nokuzibekela izinto ofisa ukuphumelela kuzo.Omunye wabafundi ophumelele kahle uNoxolo Manyoni (18) waseMbazwana obefunda esikoleni iNkosi Moses Zikhali High owathola o-A abayisithupha uthe washonelwa yibo bobabili abazali bakhe esemncane. Uthe wakhuliswa uninalume benodadewabo nezinye izingane eziningi eziyizihlobo. UNoxolo uthe: “Bengifuna ukuba yinto enkulu, ngikwazi nokuzimela”. Echaza ngendawo aphuma kuyo uthe amantombazane angangaye ajwayele ukuqeda * -matric bese eyakipita kodwa yena ufuna ukuhluka. Ukhethe ukwenza izifundo zeChemical Engineering ngoba ebona isimo sesomiso izwe elibhekene naso, ufisa ukuba ngomunye wabantu abazosixazulula.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, uthe bajwayela ukuba nalo mcimbi kodwa bekungokokuqala ukuthi ube kuleli zinga. Ubonge abazali abakhulise laba bafundi abebeklonyeliswa ngokwenza okufanele ngoba abanye abazali bayayidla imali ekhishwa wumnyango wakhe ukuthi bafundise ngayo izingane.Uthe uNkk Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ubezozigqaja ngalaba bafundi ikakhulukazi abesifazane ngoba bekuyisifiso sakhe ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zifunde.

USASHAQEKILE umndeni womfundi (17) waseNtshisekelo High, eNanda okuthiwa ugwazwe, wabulawa omunye umfundi ngoLwesibili eya esikoleni emuva kokuthi kubangwe iphepha elalibhalwe abangawenzile umsebenzi wesikole.Kusenzima emndenini kaSikhumbuzo Gumede waseWolawola eMatikwe obenza uGrade 10 eNtshisekelo High, eNanda ukwamukela ukuthi akasekho emhlabeni. Kuthiwa ugwazwe eduze kwasesikoleni wawela ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, washonela emtholampilo.Umfowabo, uSiyanda Gumede owenza uGrade 12 kulesi sikole uthe akazi ukuthi uzoqhubeka kanjani aphile impilo ejwayelekile emuva kokwenzeke kumfowabo abebesondelene kakhulu naye.Uthe ubesesikoleni ngesikhathi ebizwa ngomunye wothisha emtshela ukuthi akeze esangweni lapho umfowabo ebeselele khona engakhombisi mpilo.Uthe lesi sigameko senzeke emuva kokuthi umfowabo exabene nalo mfundi afunda naye ekilasini ngoLwesihlanu oludlule. Ngokusho kwakhe umfowabo wacelwa uthisha ukuthi ayobiza abantu ababengawenzanga umsebenzi wesikole ababebhalwe epheshaneni okwakufanele lifundwe ekilasini. Uthe wanika umfundi okunguye oyi-prefect ukuthi enze lokhu. Kuthe uma lo mfundi ememeza amagama kwakhona umfundi omphuca iphepha walidabula. Uthe abanye abafundi babiza umfowabo bembikela lokhu. Ngesikhathi ebuza lona omunye umfundi ukuthi wenzani kuthiwa lo mfundi ubhoke ngolaka embuza ukuthi uzomenzani base belwa. Lona omunye umfundi kuthiwa uhluliwe wase esongela uSikhumbuzo.Kukholakala ukuthi lo mfundi ulalele uSikhumbuzo unyendle ngesikhathi eya esikoleni ngoLwesibili wamgwaza esifubeni ngommese.Uyise kaSikhumbuzo, uMnuz Jabulani Dludla (57) obesashaqekile ngesigameko sokubulawa kwendodana yakhe uthe umoya wakhe uphukile ngokwenzekile. Uthe indodana yakhe beyigubha usuku lwayo kokuzalwa ngoLwesine oludlule. Uveze nokuthi unina kaSikhumbuzo washona ngale nyanga, emuva kosuku embelethile. Konke lokhu kubavusela iminjunju njengomndeni. Ukhale nangokuthi baye emndenini womfana osolwa kulesi sigameko kodwa kwangabonakala sengathi bayazwelana nabo ngokwenzekile. Uthe bazoyekela umthetho usebenze.Elinye lamalungu omphakathi elithe linengane efunda uGrade 10 kulesiya sikole lithe selicabanga nokukhipha ingane yalo ngenxa yezigameko ezenzeka khona elithe likholwa ukuthi zidalwa ukungahloniphi kwezingane ezifunda khona.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa uthe sibaphathe kabi lesi sigameko. Uthe bathumele abeluleki bengqondo bomnyango ukuthi bayoluleka izingane ebezikhona kushona lo mfundi.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, okhulumela amaphoyisa eKZN uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala, akukaboshwa muntu.

UHLELI lubhojozi umphakathi waseNgodini, eDududu, ngenxa yezingulube zehlathi okuthiwa ziyacanasa kule ndawo ziqeda ukudla emasimini zibhincisele nxanye nabantu bale ndawo.Leli phephandaba linikele kule ndawo ngenhloso yokuzwa usizi lwabantu bakhona asebehlala ngokwethuka izanya ngenxa yalezi zilwane eziyingozi. Izakhamizi zale ndawo zithi azisakwazi ukudla okulinywa emakhaya njengoba lezi zingulube zishaya ziqothule emasimini. Kuthiwa ziphuma zibe wumhlambi ebusuku ikakhulukazi uma imvula ina zicanase naphakathi kwezindlu zifuna ukudla.UMnuz Joseph “Ngculaza” Gumede uthe yena ulima udedangendlale wensimu athembele kuyo ukuze aphile kodwa useze wayeka ngenxa yokulimela izingulube."Mina bengivuka ebusuku ngo-2 ngilime insimu yami enkulu ngoba yiyona engondlayo. Zivele zifike zimbe ngaphansi kocingo zingene zishaye zivale zishiye kube ngathi kade kushanelwa ensimini," kusho uGumede ngokukhathazeka.Esinye isakhamuzi uMnuz Leonard Nzimande uthe naye usesimeni esifanayo wathi kukhona nekhehla lendawo elihola impesheni eselihamba lixhuga emuva kokuhlaselwa yingulube yamlimaza emlenzeni.UMnuz Pius Lukhozi naye oyisakhamuzi kule ndawo uthe yena seyake yamgagazisa ingulube eya ekhweni lakhe ewela umfula yathushuka khona.Okhulumela iKZN Wildlife KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Musa Mtambo uthe bake bathintwa ngenkinga yezingulube endaweni esogwini olusenhla nesifundazwe bazama ukuyisukumela."Sike saya ngomunye unyaka sazidubula izingulube kodwa kwakusewuhlelo nje lokuhlola ukuthi luyasebenza yini, sathi sizwa futhi zabe sezibuyile. Ngeke sikwazi ukuyozidubula kodwa singathumela umuntu ayofundisa umphakathi kabanzi ngazo," kusho uMtambo.INduna yesinye sezigodi kule ndawo uMnuz Thulisani Madiba uthe indodana yakhe isike yanqwamana mahlanze nenye yezingulube yamkhombisa naye, ukhale ngokuthi zinkulu kakhulu futhi ziyalwa kunzima ukuyibulala."Sidinga usizo lwabantu abanamathuluzi afanele okubulala lezi zilwane ngoba ziyingozi ngeke sizame thina ukuzibulala. Ziningi zihamba ziyinqwaba zibe yishumi nangaphezulu ziyaqhubeka ziyazalana futhi. Sesabela nempilo yethu asisakwazi nokulima sisaphumi ebusuku emagcekeni kunzima," kubalisa uMnuz Madiba.

text: ODLALELA abaculi abadumile bokholo base-Eastern Cape i-keyboard, okubalwa kubo uBetusile Mcinga noDumi Mkokstad, kusolakala ukuthi uzifake obishini ngokulimaza kabuhlungu obeyintombi yakhe.UNksz Phakamile Mthalane (33) waseWembezi, e-Estcourt, ufuna lo saziwayo abhadle ejele ngokumsakaza ngezimpama, amklinye, amgingqe ngequpha, amgxobe futhi aze amgence ngembazo encane ngesikhathi emvakashele endlini aqashe kuyo eChris Hani Park, eMthatha, e-Eastern Cape, ngoMashi 4.Umgilwa uthi umsolwa wamshaya wacishe wamkhipha umphefumulo beqhathwa yizimpahla zomunye umuntu wesifazane azifica endlini yomsolwa.“Namanje angazi wangishayelani ngoba angimlwisanga. Ngambuza nje ukuthi kwenzakalani ngempahla yowesifazane engayifica endlini yakhe ngoba kimina wathi akathandani namuntu. Ngagcina sengixolisa, ngingazi ukuthi ngixoliselani.“Ngazithulela ngemuva kwalokho walibele ekhuluma, ngingamphenduli esefuna silale ngenkani, nganqaba.”Uthe umsolwa wabe esemshaya ngempama ethi akamphenduli ngani. “Wabe esengikhahlela futhi engigxoba sengilele phansi, engibuza ukuthi angimphenduli ngani uma ekhuluma nami. Wangiklinya ethi angimshaye nami, ngaze ngaphelelwa ngamandla, ngaquleka.”UNksz Mthalane uthi umsolwa wayemshaya sengathi ulwa nomuntu wesilisa obezama ukumbulala.“Ngaphaphama cishe ngemuva kwemizuzu eyishumi, wayesami phezu kwami nembazo ethi ungihlahlela ngayo ngayivika ngaze ngagoqana. Ngaphumelela ukuphulukundlela ngibaleke, ngacishe ngashayiswa imoto engingayazi, ngiyimisa emgwaqweni, ngicela usizo lwasesiteshini samaphoyisa.”Uthe wavula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMgungundlovu kodwa ladluliselwa kwesaseMthatha esiqinisekisile ukuthi likhona icala esiliphenyayo elimayelana nokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza elivulwe wuNksz Mthalane.UBetusile uvumile ukuthi uyamazi umsolwa, futhi uyamdlalela i-keyboard nabanye abaculi abaningi abadumile base-Eastern Cape.“Nodaba ngiyalwazi kodwa ngamtshela lo sisi ukuthi akaxhumane naye lo bhuti noma avule icala ngoba mina angifuni ukufakwa entweni engingahlangene nayo. Akasalungu lebhendi yami kodwa ngiyamqasha uma kukhona lapho ngiyocula khona.”Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukamsolwa ayiphumelelanga ngenxa yokuthi izingcingo zakhe bezingabanjwa kanti nemiyalezo abethunyelelwa yona kuWhatsApp beyifundwa kodwa ingaphendulwa.Umsolwa ugcine eseyibhlokha inamba abethunyelelwa ngayo imiyalezo.

Njengophiko olunakekelayo lukahulumeni, iRoad Accident Fund (RAF) inezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi indlela okudingidwa ngayo izicelo zesinxephezelo azichemile - noma ngabe zifakwe ngummeli noma zifakwe kwaRAF ngqo - nokuthi bonke abafakizicelo bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula esikhungweni. Nokho, njengesikhungo sibone ukuthi kukhona okungaqondwa ngabasuke behlangabezane nezingozi zomgwaqo. Lokho kubandakanya okungezansi:Abafakizicelo abanabameli abangathokozileAbameli, ngokwemigomo yokusebenza elawula umkhakha wezomthetho, kumele bahlale bewazisa amakhasimende abo ngokwenzekayo ezicelweni zesinxephezelo zawo, nokuthi baphendule izincwadi nezingcingo zamaklayenti.Ngeshwa, iRAF ayivumelekile ukugxambukela ebudlelwaneni bommeli nekhasimende ngakho ayinakubeluleka abafakizicelo ngezicelo zabo. Nokho, iRAF ikhuthaza abathinteka ezingozini ukuthi kube yibo abazixhumanela neRAF ngqo ukuze zilandeleke izicelo zezinxephezelo zabo, noma ngabe umfakisicelo enommeli noma ezifakele isicelo ngqo eRAF.Abanxenximakhasimende Kuvamile ukuthi abagileke ezingozini banxenxwe abazenza abasebenzi bakwaRAF. Bagcwalise, bathumele imibhalo yokufaka izicelo zesinxephezelo kulaba banxenximaklayenti. Abafakizicelo bakhuthazwa ukuthi baxhumane neRAF ngqo ukuze bagweme ukugilwa abanxenximaklayenti.Isitifiketi esiyisibopho sokunakekelaI-RAF isiza ukuhlumelelisa abafakizicelo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuthi isikhungo sikhiphele umfakisicelo isitifiketi esiyisibopho sokunakekela, esiyisivumelwano esiphakathi kukamfakisicelo neRAF sokuhlinzeka izidingo zokwelashwa zamanje nezakusasa, umfakisicelo angase abe nazo ngenxa yokulimala engozini yomgwaqo, ngesikhathi ingxenye esele yesicelo sesinxephezelo sisasetshenzwa.Abafakizicelo bangathumela ama-invoice, kwaRAF emuva kokubonana nodokotela, noma udokotela angaxhumana nebeRAF ukuze imgunyaze ngaphambi kokwelapha umfakisicelo, bese ethumela i-invoice. Umfakisicelo kumele azise udokotela ukuthi unesitifiketi esiyisibopho sokunakekela.Izicelo zesinxephezelo nezindleko zomngcwaboI-RAF ikhokhela okulandelayo kuphela:Ukuthuthwa kwesidumbu, ukuhlinzeka ngebhokisi lomngcwabo noma uhlaka lokungcwaba, ukulungisa isidumbu, ukugcinwa kwesidumbu, ukuhlelela ukukhishwa kwesitifiketi sokushona, ukungcwatshwa noma ukulothiswa kwesidumbu, ukuqashwa kwempahla yokwehlisela ibhokisi lomngcwabo elibeni nezindleko zasemathuneni.Izikhathi zokufakwa kwesicelo sesinxephezeloLapho umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto odale ingozi aziwa, isikhathi sokufaka isicelo sesinxephezelo siphela eminyakeni emithathu emuva kosuku okwehle ngalo ingozi ngaphandle kwalapho kufakwe isicelo esihlukile sesinxephezelo esisemthethweni kwaRAF.Lapho umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto engaziwa (okubizwa “ngokwenza ingozi ubaleke”), isikhathi sokufaka isicelo sesinxephezelo sizophela eminyakeni emibili kusukela ngosuku okwehle ngalo ingozi yomgwaqo, ngaphandle kwalapho kufakwe isicelo esihlukile esisemthethweni kwaRAF.Lapho umfakisicelo engumntwana, noma umuntu ogcinwe njengongaphilile ngokomqondo noma umuntu onommeli oqokelwe ukumthathela izinqumo ngoba engenakuma phambi komthetho, futhi umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto onecala aziwa, isicelo sesinxephezelo esisemthethweni singafakwa eRAF eminyakeni emithathu kusukela ngosuku okunqunywa ngalo ukuthi lo muntu obengenamandla usengazimela ngokomthetho.Lapho umshayeli noma umnikazi wemoto onecala engaziwa futhi umfakisicelo ebhekene nesithiyo sokuthi akanamandla okuzimela ngokomthetho, kumele kufakwe isicelo sesinxephezelo eRAF ungakapheli unyaka kusuka kunqunywe ukuthi lowo muntu obengenamandla usengazimela.Ukucazwa kwesinxephezeloUma umfakisicelo wemoto ebe sephutheni ngokuphelele kwenzeka ingozi, ngeke aphumelele uma efaka isicelo sesinxephezelo kwiRAF. Uma kunenye imoto kuleyo ngozi, umshayeli angakwazi ukufakaza ukuthi omunye umshayeli ube nephutha eliholele engozini.Uma umshayeli naye ebe nephutha ekudalekeni kwengozi, isicelo sesinxephezelo sakhe singase sincishiswe. Lokhu kuncishiswa kususelwa ephesentini lokuba nephutha abe nalo ngokubambisana nomunye umshayeli othintekayo engozini.UNtsoaki Kunene, oyiRegional General Manager yeRAF KwaZulu-Natal.* UNtsoaki Kunene, uyiRegional General Manager yeRAF KwaZulu-Natal

UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhumana uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane nowezeMidlalo uNkk Tokozile Xasa bafinyelele esivumelwaneni nePSL sokuthi ivumele iSABC ukuba isakaze yonke imidlalo yebhola kuzo zonke iziteshi zomsakazo izolo, kusukela namhlanje.Lesi sivumelwano senziwe izolo ebusuku emuva kokuthi abalandeli bebhola besihlabile isinqumo seSABC sokungayisakazi imidlalo yebhola eziteshini zomsakazo.“Siyaxolisa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubanyusela umoya ngesinqumo esimenyezelwe yiSABC. Siyathembisa ukuthi kusukela kusasa (namhlanje) yonke imidlalo yebhola izosakazwa njengokujwayelekile eziteshini zomsakazo zeSABC,” kusho uMokonyane.Ngesikhathi kusayinwa isivumelwano bekukhona noSihlalo wePSL uDkt Irvin Khoza, uSihlalo weBhodi lakwaSABC uDkt Bongumusa Makhathini nabanye.Khonamanjalo, izolo iSouth African Football Association (Safa) idalule ukuthi ayisezukuyisakaza kuthevishini imidlalo yeBafana Bafana neBanyana Banyana.Ngokusho kwesikhulu esiphezulu kwiSafa, uDennis Mumble, iSABC ikweleta le nhlangano eyengamele unobhutshuzwayo kuleli imali engaphezulu kukaR50 million esivumelwaneni abebenaso esiphele ngo-Ephreli nonyaka.Phambilini iSABC ibinqume ukuthi ngeke isakaze imidlalo yebhola ngenxa yokungavumelani ngenkontileka entsha nePSL.Isivumelwano sokusakaza imidlalo yebhola sizosiza ngoba besekuzophazamiseka ezokukhangisa njengoba ezemidlalo zithola isikhathi esiningi ngezimpelasonto.UNkk Mokonyane uthe bekungeke kulunge ukuthi iSABC ingayisakazi imidlalo ngoba kwenziwa izinhlelo ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale isizini. Izinhlelo ezenziwayo ngezezikhangiso, ezokuhlala emahhotela ahlukene kwabasakaza ibhola nokunye.

UBHOBOKA ngezinkinga zomrepha uZakwe, uphrojusa ophinde abe nguDJ we-hip hop, uNgane Sikobi othi ucasulwa wukuthi uZakwe akalikhulumi iqiniso ngoba efuna ukudatshukelwa ngenxa yokwehla kwezinga lakhe emculweni.Lokhu kuqhamuka ngemuva kokuba Isolezwe ngeSonto libhale ngoZakwe ophumele obala ngokuthi utshwala bucishe baqeda ikusasa lakhe emculweni ngenxa yezinkinga abebhekene nazo ngenxa yokuboshwa yinkampani abekuyona.UNgane uthe kungamanga aluhlaza ukuthi uZakwe uke waba nezinkinga emculweni waze wazinikela otshwaleni abebuthola ngokuphuziswa abangani.“Inkinga kaZakwe ukuthi usegxekwa ngabantu abathi izinga lakhe lomculo selehlile njengoba ashiya iNative Rhythms ayefakwe yimina kuyona ngoba ngazana nomphathi wayo uSipho Sithole. Ngenxa yalokhu kugxekwa usefuna ukudatshukelwa kube sengathi ubehlukumezekile enkampanini kaSithole kube kungenjalo. Lezinto azishoyo ukuthi inkampani yambopha yindlela yokuzama ukungcolisa igama lami nelikaSithole okuyithina esimakhile emculweni. Ngisho ekhuluma kwabezindaba akawabali amagama ethu njengabantu abamsizile emculweni ngoba ulwa nathi,” kusho uNgane.Uthe nokuthi ubesephila ngokuphuza utshwala abebuthengelwa ngabantu kungamanga aluhlaza.“Kubangani bakhe uZakwe akekho obenemali ngaphandle kwakhe. Uyena obethengela abantu utshwala. Kukhona abanye engike ngixoxe nabo abangitshela ukuthi wabafaka nasezidakamizweni ngoba kunguyena obethenga yonke into uma enabo,” kuqhuba uNgane.Ethintwa uZakwe ushaye ungqimphothwe ngokuthi ubenenkinga yokuboshwa yinkampani abekuyona.“Engangizama ukukuchaza ukuthi ngibe nengcindezi sengiphumile enkampanini ngingazi ukuthi ikusasa lingiphatheleni emculweni. Okokuthi yimina obethengela abantu utshwala ngicabanga ukuthi naye uNgane akanalo iqiniso lalokho ngoba ubejwayele ukungifica nginezinsizwa ebesihlala nazo siphuza. Okusho ukuthi yena ubezitshela ukuthi yimina othenge utshwala,” kusho uZakwe.Uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uNgane usenesilonda sokuthi washiya enkampanini usafisa abuye.Ngezinsolo zezidakamizwa, uthe ubengazi ukuthi isimo sesibi kangaka phakathi kwakhe noNgane ukuthi angaze athi ubethengela abantu izidakamizwa, athi akulona iqiniso.Odabeni olwedlule uZakwe uveze ukuthi izinkinga enkampanini iNative Rhythms zenze waze washiya nenkampani ayisungula noNgane, iSphethu Entertainment.UNgane uthe uZakwe wayengasayinile njengomculi kwiSphethu kodwa wayengumphathi. Uthe ngesikhathi ehamba wabhala incwadi esho ukuthi uyayiyeka inkampani ngoba uyabambezeleka emculweni okuyinto engahlangene nezinkinga athi ubenazo. Isolezwe ngeSonto linayo ikhophi yale ncwadi uNgane athi yabhalwa wuZakwe.UZakwe uvumile ukuthi washiya kungekho nkinga kwiSphethu Entertainment. Manje usengaphansi kweMabala Noise engaphansi kwe-Universal Music njengoba esanda kukhipha iCebisa ngaphansi kwayo.

text: UVALE amasango kamasipala, izolo umphakathi waseMooi River othi awusayifuni imeya yawo othi ayizi uma uyibizela emihlanganweni kodwa iphendula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Lo mphakathi obukhala ngokuthi iMeya kaMasipala iMpofana, uMnuz Xolani Duma iqasha abangani bayo ezikhaleni zemisebenzi ezikhangisiwe, uthi kunomyalezo osabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okuthiwa ubhalwe ngothile obebonga umsebenzi ekubeni umphakathi usaqhubeka nokuletha ama-CV awo ezikhaleni ezingu-13 zamaGeneral Worker ezikhangisiwe kodwa kube usuku lokuvalwa kokufakwa kwezicelo kungoLwesithathu.Umphakathi okuthiwa ubuholwa yintsha kuthiwa ugasele kwamasipala ngoLwesibili wavala amasango uthi ufuna ukuthi imeya izophendula ngalokhu okubone kuFacebook, iphinde ichaze ukuthi yini eyenze ukuthi lezi zikhala zincishiswe ngoba phambilini bezingu-50. Abantu bathi kwasha amahhovisi akwandabazabantu kulo masipala abantu sebezifakile izicelo zomsebenzi, kwase kuthiwa zizobuye zivulwe kabusha kodwa sezibuya sezingaphansi kwesibalo esasikhishwe.Abasolwa ngokuthi bahola lo mkhankaso wokuvala umasipala baboshiwe ngalo uLwesibili ntambama besolwa ngokulimaza impahla kamasipala, badedelwa ngesexwayiso izoloUMYALEZO okuthiwa ubuthunyelelwe imeya kaMasipala waseMpofana osatshalaliswe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, oholele ekutheni umphakathi uvale umasipalaAbangaboshwanga babuyele kuwo lo masipala ekuseni, izolo baphinde bavala umasipala.Elinye ilunga lomphakathi elingathandanga ukudalulwa lithe: “Zishonephi izikhala ezingu-37, njengoba sekukhangiswe ezingu-13? Uneminyaka emithathu ehleli esihlalweni sobumeya kodwa akezi emhlanganweni uma simbiza, ugijima ayobhala kuFacebook.”UDuma akatholakalanga ocingweni lwakhe kodwa kwi-akhawunti kaFacebook okuthiwa eyakhe uphendule wathi: “Izindaba ezingamampunge ziholele ebugebengwini. Umasipala uvulele amacala izigebengu ezingu-17, ezidabule ama-CV abantu emahhovisi alo mkhandlu.”Uqhuba athi uyazi ukuthi lo mkhankaso uqhutshwa ngabantu ababehola imashi eyayithi akaphume esikhundleni nyakenye. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ungadidiswa ngabantu abanezinhloso zezepolitiki.Umthombo waleli phephandaba uthe umphakathi awuzange ungene kwamasipala, ubume ngaphandle futhi ubungenalo udlame, kodwa kubonakale imeya isifaka izithombe zama-CV kuFacebook, agcwele phansi ethi kwenziwe ngabebevale umasipala.UNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uthe abakukhuthazi ukuthi kuqashwe ngobungani. “Ukuvala amasango kamasipala ngento esabalele kuFacebook nakho kuyiphutha. Siyakuphenya ukuthi ngabe kukhona yini asebeqashiwe ekubeni lungakafiki usuku oluwumnqamulajuqu kodwa sithi umphakathi awungathathi izinqumo ngezinto ezisatshalaliswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.”

WETHUSE abaningi umfundisi webandla labasindisiwe evuma emsakazweni Ukhozi FM ukuthi unoxhaxha lwezintombi ngaphakathi ebandleni.Unamakhosikazi amabili futhi kulezi zintombi ezikhona, uhlela ukukhetha ezintathu azozishada ngo-Okthoba kulo nyaka.Lo mfundisi odume ngelika King Prophet Sazi Ndwandwe webandla iHealing Hour Emmanuel Global Ministries, ingxoxo yakhe nomsakazi walo msakazo, uNomfundo Mkhize, isisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kanti abantu abawuvali umlomo, ngisho abangabazalwane baleli bandla.Leli bandla linamagatsha amaningi KwaZulu-Natal okubalwa kuwo KwaNongoma, eThekwini, Mtubatuba, oLundi, Ophongolo naseMnambithi.Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo, uNdwandwe uzwakale emangala ngabanenkinga ngendlela aziphatha ngayo. Uthi akuyona imfihlo ukuthi unenqwaba yezintombi ebandleni, nangaphandle kwasebandleni uthi unazo.“Mina uma ngibone intombi ngayithanda, ngiyayitshela bese kuya ngokuthi siphathana kanjani nayo.“Uma sengibona sesithandana ukuthi ayiziphethe kahle, siyahlukana.“Nginazo zona izintombi futhi ngilungiselela ukuthatha ezintathu, zibe ngamakhosikazi ami ungakashayi u-Okthoba kulo nyaka.”Uthe kulezi zintombi zikhona ezisagcwele mpu nezinye ezingasaphelele. “Abangakathintwa, nami angibenzi lutho.“Ngibagcinela umshado kanti asebethintiwe, nami ngiyaqhubeka nokubathinta ngoba sebeyayazi indoda. Uma ngibagcina bazoqhubeka nokuthintwa ngabanye abafana ngasese.”Echaza ukuthi kungani enesithembu futhi ehlobonga nabanye abantu besifazane ekubeni engumfundisi osindisiwe, uNdwandwe uthe yena akafuni ukuphila impilo yamanga njengabanye abefundisi.“Mina ngiyindoda yomZulu. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu okupha umfazi, mina ngineso lokubona umfazi wami.“Izishimane ezithi ziyaboniswa. Yizo lezi ezijola emakhoneni, zilalane bese kukhishwa nezisu. Mina ngiyinsizwa yomZulu esakhuzela uma ibona intombi eyithandayo.”Uthe nasemandulo kunamadoda kaNkulunkulu ayenenqwaba yezancinza.“Mina angiholwa yizwi kodwa ngilandela umgomo wakwaNdwandwe. Mina nganikezwa izwe kwathiwa angibuse kulo.”UNdwandwe uthe iningi labazalwane liyamjabulela ngoba wenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabo.Kodwa ngesikhathi leli phephandaba likhuluma namanye amalungu aleli bandla, asho okwehlukile.“Abanye bethu abaneme neze ngoba sikhonza namadodakazi ethu.Njengoba siyibandla labasindisiwe nje, akuzwakali kahle ukuthi umfundisi wethu unesithembu futhi aphinde abe noxhaxha lwezintombi.”Ukuthola ukuphawula kwamakhosikazi kaNdwandwe kugcine kungaphumelelanga.

USIHLALO weMKMVA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Themba Mavundla, unxuse uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi onke amasosha oMkhonto Wesizwe ahlanganiswe namasosha akuleli ukuze ahole nemindeni yawo idle.UMavundla uphakamise lokhu emcimbini wokubuyiswa kwamathambo abanye ozakwabo ababengamalungu oMkhonto Wesizwe ngezikhathi zobandlululo obuseCity Hall, eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo. Uthe kade kwasa bezicelela ukuba uhulumeni asukumele usizi lwamasosha okuthiwa awanakiwe kodwa ayelwela inkululeko yezwe. Uthe kufanele amasosha anakwe ngoba izwe lilapho likhona ngenxa yeqhaza alibamba emzabalazweni.“Bonke kufanele bathole izinombolo zasembuthweni bafakwe ohlwini lwamasosha kube khona abakutholayo nemindeni yabo. Ngake ngakucela lokhu, ngiyaphinda futhi ngiyakucela nanamuhla ngiyethemba kuzwakele. Nginalo ithemba lokuthi kuzofika nasesigungwini esiphezulu sikaKhongolose, kusho uMavundla. Ubonge kakhulu kuDkt Zweli Mkhize onguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zomdabu kuzwelonke ngeqhaza lakhe ekutheni kusukunyelwe indaba yamasosha aduka ngezikhathi zempi.Uvumelane noNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, othe maningi amasosha akhalayo anganelisekile. Ubekhuluma kanjena nje sekunomkhuba odlangile KwaZulu-Natal wokuthi amasosha oMkhonto Wesizwe aphazamise ukusebenza komasipala ekhala ngokuthi avalelwa ngaphandle abulawa yindlala. UDhlomo uwanxusele amasosha wathi akufanele alahlwe.“Amanye amasosha engike ngixoxe nawo asuke ekhala izinyembezi ngempela. Kufanele kube khona okwenziwayo naye uSihlalo uMavundla ngimphathisa umphako wokuthi ahlanganise amasosha abumbane esifundazweni kungabibikho amaqembuqembu amasosha,’’ kusho uDhlomo.Uthe ukubuyiswa kwamathambo kudala isidingo sokuthi kuqhutshekwe kuthungathwe nabanye abaningi abaduka ngezikhathi zomzabalazo babuyiselwe emindenini yabo.Okhulumela iMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mthunzi Gumede, utshele abezindaba ukuthi uMasipala weTheku uvele uphezu kwezinhlelo zokuthi kwakhiwe indawo ezogcina amagugu omlando wamasosha.“Le ndawo izoba njengendawo yokuvakasha lapho sizobe sibhale khona amagama azo zonke izishoshovu ukuze kugcineke umlando.’’

Sekujwayelekile ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi emuva kokubhala kule ngosi ngokusebenza nokwenziwa wumzimba uma kuyiwa ocansini, bese kuvela izicelo ezithi sikhulume sigcizelele umunxa othile. Kulokhu izicelo bezilokhu zilekanyana ezifisa sizimelele ontwentwesaneni oluyisicutshana esisekungeneni komgudu wesifazane. Lokhu bekuhambisana nesifiso sokuthi sikhulume nangokuya ocansini kusetshenziswa umgudu ongemuva. Nizongivumela ukuthi la mathafa womabili - untwentwesana esilubiza ngokuthi yiso nalolu hlobo lokuya ocansini - ngakunye yingosi ezimele. Iso liyatholakala ezilwaneni ezifana nezindlovu namahhashi. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi umsebenzi wami njengodokotela kule ngosi, wukunikeza umumomzimba nokusebenza komzimba, hhayi ukunikeza umbono okanye umcabango othile othinta isiko, inkolo okanye umcabango othile ngengosi noma ngami nomndeni wami.Izibalo zithi sikhula ngesivinini isibalo sabantu abasha nasebekhulile abaya ocansini lomgudu ongemuva. Izizathu zalokhu ziningi, zihlanganisa:Ukulangazelela kwabesifazane abasebancane ukugcina umgudu wezocansi ongaphambili ungabanga yingxenye yokuzithokozisaUbumnandi obukhethekile obunanelekayo kule nhlobo yocansiUkulangezelela ukuklama indima engesiye undabuzekwayoUkuvuleleka ekuphileni ubulili oyibona.Ayiyinye indlela yokuya ocansini kodwa ziningi. Okuhluphayo wukuthi kuyaye kukhulumeke sengathi uluntu luya ocansini emgudwini ongaphambili kuphela kumuntu wesifazane, bese wonke amehlo athi njo ekuziphatheni okuthinta lo mgudu bese kukhohlakala ukuthi kuyayiwa ocansini kusetshenziswa ezinye izindawo zomzimba, kubengathi kwezinye izindawo kuvumelekile. Lokhu kwenza kuyadukisa futhi kuletha ingcindezi enkulu kwezocansi. Kunenkolelo engelona iqiniso eliphelele yokuthi owesifazane osemncane ohlezi ngentombi ubonakala ngokuthi iso lihlale likhona futhi lingakaze ligcobhozwe. Ake sibuke ngqo okuthile ngeso:Akusiyena wonke umuntu wesifazane ozalwa enalo. Ngiyaphinda, uyakwazi ukuzalwa unalo futhi bakhona abazalwa bengenalo nhlobo, ngokwendalo. Abezibalo bathi abazalwa bengenalo balinganiselwa ku-10 kwabangu-100.Kwabesifazane abazalwa benalo, lwakheka lungawuvali ngokugcwele umgudu. Iso lakheka ngokwehlukana; kusukela ekubeni yingqintsanyana kuya ophephesaneni oluncanyana oluthi ne odongeni lomgudu. Zibalelwa esishiyagalolunyeni izinhlobo ezehlukene zokwakheka kweso.Zibalelwa ngaphezu kwamashumi ayisithupha ekhulwini izintokazi ezineso eliba wuphephesana futhi kuzo akubikhona ukuconsaconsa kwegazana uma ziya ocansini okokuqala zisebenzisa lo mgudu ongaphambili kowesifazane. Iso eliwuphephesana liyazishabalalela uma owesifazane ekhula eya eminyakeni engu-25. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iningi lezintombi ezikule minyaka azisenalo iso, hhayi ngoba zingaziphethe kahle kodwa ngoba zizalwe liwuphephesana lwaze lwazinciphela lwaphela okanye lwaba encane intsalelela odongeni lomgudu.Ngabesifazane abazalwe beneso eliwungqintsanyana abaconsisa okusagazana uma beya ocansini okokuqala futhi nabo bayingcosana.Enye inselelo ekhona ngeso wukuthi iningi lezintokazi, nabesifazane nje, abakaze balibone ngamehlo. Abesifazane noma izintokazi kazazi ukuthi zizalwe zinalo iso noma qha. Lokhu kwenziwa wukuthi ubulili besifazane bucashile, abufani nobesilisa. Bambalwa abesifazane abathatha isibuko bazibuke ubulili babo ngokubuqonda okunzulwanyana, angikhulumi eyokububuka ubuphenyaphenye ngalesiya sikhathi useyitshitshi nasebuntombini.Eminye yemibuzo engicabanga seyakhekile eyokuthi, pho sikuqinisekisa kanjani ukuthi intokazi iyintombi nto noma cha? Sithi:Ucansi luyenziwa emlonyeni, emgudwini ongemuva nasemgudwini ongaphambili.Zikhona izintombi ezidalwe zazalwa zingenalo nhlobo leli soEzintokazini ezizalwe zinalo, eziningi zifika eminyakeni engu-25 selinyamalele.Kunezimo zempilo ezingadabula noma zisheshise ukunyamalala kweso njengokudansa, ukuzilolonga, izimo ozenza uvule imilenze nezinye.Izintokazi eziningi azazi noma zizalwa zinalo iso noma cha ngoba azikaze zilibone ngamehlo.Iso kwabanalo lakhekhe layizinhlobonhlobo, akusiyona inhlobo eyodwa. Enye nje inhlobo yeso ibambobombobo, enye ingaba yimicwi.Akekho umuntu ongama aqiniseke ngobuntombi bomunye ngaphandle kwayo intombi uqobo noMdali wayo. Ngisho sengithanda njengodokotela, ngigcina ngokucabangela kuphela. Ngeke ngime ngithi yebo noma cha.Pho udokotela uthini ngamasiko ezizwe anhlobonhlobo athinta ubulili neso? Amasiko avundisa, anisele, akhulisa adlondlobalise okuthile ngaleso sikhathi ezinganeni zethu nasebantwini. Umsebenzi wami nawe wukuthi uma echumisa okuhle siweseke ngezandla zombili.Mpilonde!

IZOZE ibe ngemuva kokhetho lonyaka ozayo ingqungquthela ye-ANC esifundeni iTheku obekulindeleke ukuthi ibe ngoDisemba kulo nyaka.Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uNobhala omusha we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, uthe yize isinqumo sobuholi obuphezulu kwi-ANC sithi zonke izingqungquthela zezifunda kumele zibe ngaphambi kokuthi kuphele * -Agasti kodwa eyaseThekwini izoze isingathwe ngonyaka ozayo.UNtuli uthe kodwa izingqungquthela ezintathu eyaseMoses Mabhida, Lower South Coast naseHarry Gwala zona zizoba ngaphambi kokuthi kuphele * -Agasti. “Ubuholi besifundazwe buyaxoxisana nalezi zifunda ezintathu ngenhloso yokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kufika isikhathi sengqunggquthela kukhona umoya wobumbano.”Uphinde waveza ukuthi ubuholi obusha abunazo izinhlelo zokwenza izinguquko kwiKhabhinethi yaKwaZulu-Natal, echitha imibiko eke yasabalala nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana ethi bahlela ukwenza izinguquko. “Noma ngabe kuthiwa umuntu uwenza kanjani emsebenzini ajutshwe kuwona kodwa akuselula ukuthi singenza izinguquko ikakhulukazi njengoba sibheke okhethweni lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo.”UNtuli uphawula kanje, sekuphinde kwavuka izindaba ezithi uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo kumele akhonjwe indlela ngenxa yesimo esingagculisi somnyango wakhe.I-ANCYL eKZN ifuna uDhlomo athathelwe izinyathelo ngodaba lwemishini yokwelapha umdlavuza. “Ngokwazi kwethu umnyango uyazama ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona emnyangweni,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe ukungalibambi iqhaza kobuholi be-ANC emibuthanweni esuke inobengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma uma evela enkantolo kunikeza osomathuba indawo yokukhankasa besebenzisa igama likaZuma.“Ngenxa yesinqumo sobuholi obuphezulu kuzwelonke, i-ANC iyakwazi ukulawula kule mibuthano, uma engekho umholi noma ngubani uvele asukume azenze umholi,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe bonke osomathuba basebenzisa le mibuthano esuke inoZuma ukuziveza emphakathini.EMgungundlovu uZuma unxuse abantu ukuthi beseke ngevoti uKhongolose okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, waphinde wathi abavoti bangamkhohlwa nomholi weLand First Black First (BLF) uMnuz Andile Mgxitama.Ebuzwa uNtuli ukuthi ukuphawula kukaZuma lapho ethi akuvotelwe uMgxitama akusikho yini ukuphula umgomo we-ANC, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babuke izinto ngeso elibanzi futhi elijulile, hhayi ukubuka ngokuphuma iqhubu nento ethile.“Obengumengameli ukhulume kabanzi ngokuthi abantu abavotele i-ANC phezu kwalokho wathi kuyilungelo labo abantu ukuthi bangavotela noma ngubani uma bethanda,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe uZuma ungumholi ohlonishwayo we-ANC futhi bazosebenza naye kakhulu nangesikhathi semikhankaso.Izolo i-ANC iphinde yethula ngokusemthethweni uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu njengomkhulumeli wayo omusha. Iphinde yamemezela nosihlalo abasha bamakomiti ehlukene ebuholini bayo besifundazwe.

KUSUKE umsindo phakathi kwamakhansela e-ANC neDA emhlanganweni we-Exco eThekwini izolo mayelana nohambo lukaR2 million oluya emadolobheni amabili aseSouth America, lwezikhulu ophikweni lwezokuthutha kumasipala, osomatekisi nabanikazi bamabhasi.Ithimba labantu abangu-54, elisuka eThekwini, lizoya eSao Paulo eBrazil naseBogota eColombia liyofunda kabanzi ngohlelo lokuphucula ezokuthutha olwaziwa ngeGo Durban. Usuku lohambo lusazohlelwa.Amakhansela eDA ashaya amakhala athi inkulu le mali ezokhishwa wumkhandlu ngalolu hambo.Usihlalo wekhokhasi yeDA eThekwini, uNkk Nicole Graham, uthe bona abahambisani nalolu hambo ngoba luzomosha imali.UNkk Graham uthe uphiko lwezokuthutha eMkhandlwini weTheku ludume kabi ngokuqhuba izinhlelo ezingaphumeleli.“Lolu phiko ayikho futhi into olwake lwayiqala lwayiqeda,” kusho uNkk Graham.Elinye ikhansela leDA, uMnuz Heinz de Boer, lithe noma ngabe kuthiwa le mali ivela kuphi kodwa ngeyabakhokhi bentela.“Kumele kube khona indlela okuzokwenziwa ngayo ukuze kuncishiswe le mali. Abantu abangu-54 baningi kakhulu kungakuhle isibalo sabantu abahambayo sincishiswe,” kusho uDe Boer.Uthe uhulumeni we-ANC uhlala ukhuluma ngokuthi usezinhlelweni zokonga imali kodwa eThekwini iyaxhashazwa.Nomholi wekhokhasi ye-IFP, uMnuz Mdu Nkosi, uhambe emazwini kaDe Boer wathi kumele sincishiswe isibalo sabahambayo.USotswebhu wamakhansela e-ANC eThekwini, uNkk Nelly Nyaniso, uthe bayalweseka lolu hambo ngoba lubalulekile.“Imboni yamatekisi yilona lodwa ibhizinisi labamnyama abazibambele kulona mathupha futhi abaziqalela lona. Leli bhizinisi libambe iqhaza elikhulu emnothweni wezwe. Ngalezo zizathu-ke asisoze sayeka ukuleseka,” kusho uNkk Nyaniso.USomlomo eMkhandlwini weTheku, uMnuz William Mapena, uthe imali ezosetshenziswa iphuma esikhwameni esifanele.UMgcinimafa eThekwini, uMnuz Krish Kumar, uthe uphiko lwabo lwezokuthutha kumele luze kwi-Exco luzocacisa kabanzi ngohlelo lwalo.Uthe uhambo lubalulekile ngoba amazwe avakashelwayo analo uhlelo olufana nolweGo Durban abafuna ukuluqala.

USENKINGENI umfelokazi wasesigodini saKwaNgubo esizweni sabaThembu eMsinga ngaphansi kwenkosi uSiphamandla Mthembu ohlawuliswe inkomo ngecala lokukhumula inzilo ehlobo.UNkk Thandiwe Ndlovu-Makhunga (46) namhlanje ubuyele enkantolo yesizwe ngemuva kokulahlwa yicala ngoJulayi 31, nonyaka, lapho anikwa khona umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku ezingu-14, ukuthi zingapheli angayikhiphile inhlawulo kodwa kuze kube yimanje akakahlawuli.Lo wesifazane uzile izinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ngoSepthemba nyakenye kushone umyeni wakhe kwaze kwaba nguFebhuwari.Isigungu senkantolo yesizwe kuhlelwe ukuthi namhlanje siphinde sihlangane lapho kulindeleke ukuthi sibhunge ngodaba lukaNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga.UNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga unqabile ukuphawula ngalolu daba izolo.Abantu abasondelene naye abakhulume neSolezwe kodwa bacela ukuthi bangadalulwa ngoba besaba ukuthi bazojeziswa bathi abaneme ngesinqumo senkantolo yesizwe ngoba indaba yenzilo yinto ethinta umndeni.“Asazi ukuthi isizwe nenkosi bangenaphi endabeni yokuthi abantu bazila kanjani ngoba leyo yinto yomndeni,” kusho leli ilungu lomphakathi.Lithe kuyaqala ukuthi kuphume isinqumo esifana nalesi enkantolo yesizwe.“Njengoba isizwe sabaThembu sisikhulu kangaka, manje inkosi isizohamba ibheka ukuthi abantu emindenini yabo bazila kanjani?” kubuza eli lungu lomphakathi.Lithe uNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga wabatshela ukuthi umyeni wakhe esaphila wathi kumele angamzileli isikhathi eside.Ithintwa izolo, inkosi Mthembu ithe iyalwazi udaba lukaNkk Ndlovu-Makhunga, yathi ibona abamlahla ngecala.“Lowo wesifazane simhlawulise inkomo ngoba wenze into engenziwa esizweni sabaThembu, ayilokothwa inzilo ehlobo ebaThenjini ikhunyulwa ebusika kuphela,” kusho uMthembu.Uthe njengoba sekuze kwafika izinsuku ezingu-14 ezazibekiwe, ingakhishiwe inhlawulo, bazophoqoleka ukuthi bathathe ezinye izinyathelo.Isazi samasiko, uSolwazi uJabulani Maphalala, sithe udaba lwenzilo udaba oluthinda umndeni.“Ngokwesiko lakwaZulu kwakuthiwa umfelokazi usuke ezile kahle uma ezile kwaze kwaphela unyaka kodwa asikho isikhathi esibekelwe ukuzila. Kuya ngokuthi inkomo yokumkhumula inzilo ikhona yini,” kusho uMaphalala.Uthe kudala amakhosikazi ayezila ngokuthi akhumule isicholo, asale ngezinwele.“Izingubo ezimnyama lezi ezigqokwayo into yamanje. Kudala amakhosikazi ayekhumula isicholo,” kusho uMaphalala.Uthe uyadideka ukuthi le nto eyenzeka ebaThenjini yenzeka kanjani ngoba abaThembu basebenzisa isiko lakwaZulu.“La baThembu okhuluma ngabo abaNgoza lona owabalekela iLembe uShaka babuya sebenikwa le ndawo abahleli kuyona manje kwathiwa abagadwe uSojiyisa wakwaZulu,” kusho uMaphalala.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Lennox Mabaso, uthe lolu daba bayaqala ukuzwa ngalo, wathembisa ukuthi bazoluphenya. “Sesijube ihhovisi lethu eMzinyathi ukuba lizilandele lezi zinsolo ukuze sithole umbiko ogcwele,” kusho uMabaso.

UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa uqoke uDkt Silas Ramaite ukuthi abambe esikhundleni sokuba nguMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi emuva kokuthi iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo inqume ukuthi ukuqokwa kuka-Advocate Shaun Abrahams kwakungekho emthethweni.UNkk Khusela Diko okhulumela ihhovisi likaRamaphosa uthe uMengameli uqoke uRamaite ukuthi abambe ngesikhathi esafunda ngokugcwele isinqumo senkantolo ebheka nomuntu ozongena esikhaleni sika-Abrahams.“UMengameli uzocubungula isinqumo senkantolo futhi uzolandela umgomo wokuthi aqoke uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi kungakapheli izinsuku eziwu-90. Okwamanje uDkt Ramaite nguye ozobheka ezokushushiswa komphakathi,” kusho uNkk Diko esitatimendeni.Uthe uRamaite uyiPhini loMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, okuwumsebenzi asehlale kuwo iminyaka ewu-15.Ubegxile ophikweni lokuvikelwa kofakazi bombuso.URamaite uneziqu zeB.Proc azithola eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, ezeLL.B; ezeLL.M, ezigxile kwiCriminal Law, Constitutional Law, Administrative Law nePublic International Law.Uphinde abe neziqu zeLL.D, ezigxile kwiConstitutional Law azithola eNyuvesi yaseSouth Africa.Uqokwe ukuba abe ngummeli wasemaJajini (Supreme Court) ngo-1988 wathola isitifiketi sokuba ngummeli omkhulu (Senior Counsel (SC) ngo-2001.URamaphosa ufisele uRamaite okuhle emsebenzini azowenza okwesikhashana wathi uyamthemba ukuthi uzophatha kahle abuyise nokuthenjwa kophiko lwezokushushisa.Khonamanjalo, uNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa nezokuHlunyeleliswa kwezimilo, uMnuz Michael Masutha, uthe akazange abambe iqhaza ezingxoxweni zokukhokhela owayenguMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi * -Adv Mxolisi Nxasana uR17 million.Igama likaMasutha belifakwa kwawabantu abasiza uNxasana ukuba athole uR17 million.

KUSIZE abezimo eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi indoda yaseChina isenkingeni kubhajwe isandla sayo emshinini okuthengwa kuwona ngesikhathi izama ukukhipha ithoyizi locansi ebilikhokhele kulo mshini.Lo mlisa uthi ufike wakhokha wabe eselinda ukuthi liphume ithoyizi lakhe kodwa lutho ukuphuma, wagcina efaka isandla sakhe emshinini ezama ukuliqhwanda. Kuvele ukuthi ubekhathazeke ngokuthi uma eshiya kanjalo kuzocwila nemali yakhe nempahla yakhe ibe ingaphumanga. Ube esenza umzamo wokuyikhipha.Kuthiwa kuphele imizuzu engamashumi amabili ebhajiwe efuna usizo kwaze kwafika abezicishamlilo. Ukhale ngokuthi uzamile ukushaya ucingo kubanikazi bomshini kodwa abamsizanga yingakho egcine ezama ukuzikhiphela yena impahla yakhe kanti uzokwehlelwa yishwa.Kuthiwa usifakile kahle isandla sangena ebona imbotshana kulo mshini , konakale uma esezama ukusikhipha sabhajwa. Kuthiwa kuphoqeleke ukuthi uze usikwe umshini ukuze kuphume isandla salo mlisa obedabukisa ngenxa yokubhadla kulo mshini engakwazi ukuhamba aziqhubekele nempilo yakhe.Akachazanga kabanzi ngokuthi uze athenge ithoyizi locansi nje bekwenzenjani. Ubonge abophiko lwezicishamlilo abafike bamxazulula kule ndawo esediniwe emuva kokuthi abanikazi bomshini kuthiwa abalubhadanga kule ndawo. - The Daily Mail

OSOMATEKISI bakhala ngokugqoza kokukhishwa kwamaphemithi okusebenza abathi abanye babo bafaka izicelo zawo ngo-Ephreli kodwa kuze kube manje abakaze bawathole.UMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza, okhulumela iNational Taxi Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, uthe iProvincial Regulatory Entity Board (PRE-Board), idlala ngabo ngoba yavula iwindi lokuthi kufakwe izicelo zamaphemithi kodwa awabuyi.“Sahambisa yonke imininingwane eyayidingeka kodwa amaphemithi amatekisi awaphumi. Okusiphatha kabi wukuthi izimoto ziyaboshwa, uShanela awuyingeni indaba yokuthi sisalinde amaphemithi. Siyacela iPRE isinike amaphemithi ethu.”UMnuz Bafana Mhlongo, uNobhala weSouth African Taxi & Transport Alliance, uthe ngoLwesibili iPRE ibihlangene nosomatekisi besifunda iGreater North okukhona kubo iNanda, KwaMashu nezinye izindawo ukuchaza ngezinhlelo zayo.“Sixakekile uma sesimenywa emhlanganweni ekubeni iPRE ingazikhiphi izimvume zethu zokusebenza. Eziphumayo ziyagqoza. Kuthiwa ezinye ziyadayiswa ngoR20 000. Akekho osichazelayo ukuthi izicelo zihamba kanjani. Asihambisani nale mihlangano ngoba ayizi nezixazululo ezinkingeni zemboni yamatekisi. Sinenkinga yamaphemithi, eyokungabikho koxhaso lwabagibeli nokubulawa kwabanikazi bomsebeni. Zonke lezi zinto zidinga ukuxazululwa,” kusho uMhlongo.UMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa obhekelele ezokuXhumana eMnyangweni wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uthe iPRE iqale ukuvakashela izifunda ezehlukene zamatekisi ngoJulayi ukuze ixoxe nabasembonini.Uthe kuyenzeka kuthathe isikhathi eside ukukhishwa kwezimvume zokusebenza kodwa lokhu kuya ngokuthi umnikazi wetekisi uyithumele yonke yini imininingwane edingekayo.“Kuningi okulandelwayo ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe imvume yokusebenza, njengokuthi kufanele umnikazi wetekisi alethe wonke amaphepha adingwa yiPRE, kufanele sithole ukuphawula kumasipala okusebenza kuwo itekisi, kufanele sithole isitifiketi sentela somnikazi wetekesi. Ngenxa yobuningi bezicelo zezimvume ezitholwe yiPRE kuvulwe amahhovisi azokhipha izimvume ePort Shepstone, Mbazwana, Ladysmith naseMpangeni. Lokhu kuzosiza abanikazi bamatekisi ukuthi bafake izicelo eduze kwalapho besebenzela khona bangayi eMgungundlovu bonke.”Uthe kunezinhlelo zokuvula ihhovisi lePRE eThekwini maduzane.UMntungwa uthe izimvume zokusebenza zinikwa abanikazi bamatekisi hhayi ososeshini babo ngoba kufanele bagcwalise amafomu okucela imvume, kucutshungulwe isicelo sabo, isicelo sibe sesishicilelwa kwiGovernment Gazette okuwuhlelo oluthatha izinsuku eziwu-21.Emuva kwalokhu kuhlalwa phansi kulalelwe isicelo somuntu ofuna imvume yokusebenza. Ithimba elilalela isicelo libe selinquma ukuthi isicelo siyaphumelela noma siyachithwa bese kukhishwa imvume yokusebenza uma isicelo siphumelele.Ugqugquzele osomatekisi abanobufakazi bokuthi amaphemithi ayadayiswa ukuba bathinte uMqondisi Jikelele wePRE, uMnuz SJ Langa, noma uMqondisi, uNkk N Majola, noma uMnuz S Ntuli ku-033 341 9500.Uthe bangathinta nehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha ku-031 360 6576 noma ku-033 355 8760 nasemaphoyiseni.“Akudingeki ukuthi abantu bazidalule amagama abo kodwa bangacela ukufihlwa uma bevula icala emaphoyiseni noma bebika ehhovisi likaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nelikaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha.”Kulabo abathi amaphemithi ayadayiswa benganabo ubufakazi uthe kuyicala ukusola abantu ngenkohlakalo ungenabo ubufakazi.

text: MHLELI: Ngithi ake ngikhuze abaholi abasho noma yini okuthi mabayisho ezweni lethu.Abaholi abafana noMnuz Julius Malema we-EFF bayingozi enhlalweni nasemnothweni nakukho konke okuhle osekwenziwe selokhu izwe lethu lathola inkululeko. Uma umlalela kahle uMalema uma ekhuluma usho into efana nse neshiwo abaholi basezwenikazi i-Afrika ababulala amazwe abo ekubeni babethenjiwe ukuthi bazokwenza into engcono.Le nto eshiwo yi-EFF yokuthi akuthathwe umhlaba ngenkani ngeke ilunge bakwethu. Lokho kuzomosha yonke into esetshenzelwe kanzima. Kuyiqiniso elimsulwa ukuthi siyabadinga abasentshonalanga ukuze basichushise ezintwenieziningi.FUNDA:UMalema ubize i-ANC ngesipokiBuka nje iZimbabwe yawuthatha umhlaba ngenkani kwabamhlophe yabulala abanye abantu ababekwazi ukuwusebenza umhlaba emva kwalokho amapulazi ayenza imikhiqizo efukula umnotho agcwala ocadolo. Ngabe sifuna ukuya lapho?Mina ngithi ake kugxilwe entweni enhle vele eyenzekayo okungukusiza intsha ehlwempu emazingeni emfundo ephakeme ngesikhwama iNSFAS. Uma senzenjalo sizowubona umehluko ezweni.Mzwandile SitholeEmtshezi

IMBOKODO ebiyingxenye yemashi ebizwa nge#Totalshutdown izolo ithi ifuna kubuyekezwe izigwebo zabantu besifazane ababoshelwa ukubulala abantu ababethandana nabo ababebahlukumeza.Laba besifazane abebemasha eThekwini, begqoke imifaniswano ebomvu neminyama, bebemasha nezinhlangano ezihlukene zabantu besifazane okubalwa kuzo i-Agenda Feminist Media, iKZN Network on Violence Against Women, bebezwakalisa ilaka labo ngezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabantu besifazane.Le mashi ibibanjelwe emadolobheni ehlukene kuleli.Imashi yaseThekwini iqale eCurries Fountain yaphela eCity Hall lapho abesifazne bethule khona incwadi yezikhalo zabo. Bekulindeleke ukuthi incwadi yezikhalo bayethule kwiMeya uNkk Zandile Gumede kodwa bagcina beyethule kuMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane ongungqongqoshe wezemfundo eKZN ngoba umphathi wohlelo ethe kumele yamukelwe umuntu wesilisa ngoba ibona abahlukumezayo.UNksz Beverly Mpho Motlabani, onguSihlalo wekomidi ebelihlela imashi yaseThekwini, ethula incwadi yezikhalo uthe bafuna kube noshintsho ezimpilweni zabantu besifazane.“Sifuna uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, wakhe izindlu eziphephile ukuze abantu besifazane nezingane bahlale ezindlini eziphephile. UMnyango wezeMfundo kumele unake izingane, ubone ukuthi azihlukemezekile, futhi azishayani ezikoleni.”Uveze nokuthi uphiko lwezokuphepha alubavikeli abantu besifazane emacaleni okudlwengula.“Kubalulekile ukuthi uma umuntu wesifazane eya esiteshini samaphoyisa ukuthi amaphoyisa amkholwe ummangali emacaleni okudlwengulwa, akufanele ukuthi abesilisa abadlwengulayo bathole ibheyili uma besolwa ngakho.”Uphethe ngokuthi kumele kube nezigwebo ezithe xaxa kubantu abadlwengulawayo, waphinde wathi kumele kubuyekezwe izigwebo zabantu besifazane ababoshelwe ukubulala abantu ababethandana nabo “ababebahlukumeza” ngoba uma babengababulalanga kwakuzofa bona (abesimame).Uthe laba besifazane kumele banikwe ithuba lokuthi bafake isicelo sikashwele ngoba babesuke bezivikela.Lo muntuza naye ubeyingxenye yabesifazane abebemasha eThekwini bezwakalisa ilaka labo ngesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa nokubulawa kwabesifazane nezingane izoloUNkk Lindiwe Thanjekwayo-Mzimela weSouth African Lawyers Association uthe, “Sekwanele ngokubulawa kwabantu besifazane, bafuna nokubona ubulungiswa.”Uthe abantu besifazane kumele bafundiswe ngamalungelo abo ukuze bakwazi ukuzivikela.Uqhube wathi kumele bagqugquzelwe ukuthi basebenze baphinde banikwe amathuba emisebenzi.“Abantu abaningi besifazane abakwazi ukushiya imishado enodlame ngoba sebehlalele ukuthi abasebenzi. Basuke besaba ukuthi uma beshiya abayeni babo ababahlukumezayo abazi ukuthi bazozondla ngani izingane zabo. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi abantu besifazane banikwe amakhono okuzithuthukisa ukuze bengeke bahlale emshadweni enodlame ngenxa yokuthi bahlalele imali.”Umbhali wezincwadi obuye abe ngumlingisi, uGcina Mhlophe, ekhuluma neSolezwe ugqugquzele ukuhlonishwa kwembokodo nabantu abadala kuleli.“Ukuze izwe liphephe kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahloniphane. Kumele abantu bazwelane nabantu abasebunzimeni.”Le mashi ibikhona eTshwane, eGoli, eKapa nakwezinye izindawo kanti abesifazane bebephume ngobuningi bethi, Sekwanele ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo!

LISHONE elayizolo isematheni indaba yokuzibulala kwesitshudeni ebesiyisishoshovu, okusolwa ukuthi sizibulele.UKhensani Maseko (23), obeyisitshudeni emkhakheni wezomthetho eRhodes University, kusolwa ukuthi uzibulele ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokuphathwa ukhwantalala. Ngokwemiyalezo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusolwa ukuthi uKhensani ubenokhwantalala ngenxa yokuthi wadlwengulwa yisoka lakhe elikuyona le nyuvesi. Abamaziyo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bathe bezivele zibonakala izimpawu zokuthi uzozibulala. Abaningi bakhale ngokuthi bekumele athole usizo ngoba bekukhombisa ukuthi unengcindezi.Ekhasini lakhe likaTwitter, uKhensani ubesanda kubhala ukuthi ngelinye ilanga uyokhuluma inkulumo eyonyakazisa abaningi. Ubuye wabhala ku-Instagram ukuthi “Kulungile uma kuyintando yakho.”Konke lokhu kuhumushwe ngokuthi ubengekho esimeni esihle emqondweni.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abanye bamchaze njengesishoshovu ebesiwakhathalele amalungelo ezitshudeni futhi ehlakaniphile. Kuvele nokuthi ubengomunye wabaholi bohlaka lwezitshudeni olumele i-EFF kule nyuvesi.Kuthintwa uNksz Sixolise Gcilisha, osehhovisini lezokuxhumana kwi-EFF, uvumile ukuthi uKhensani ubephambili emzabalazweni wezitshudeni kuleli qembu. Uthe abangaphawula kahle ngaye yilabo abebesebenza naye ophikweni lwezitshudeni enyuvesi, izolo abangatholakalanga ukuphawula.UKhensani ubephinde abe nguSihlalo weRhodes Independent Electoral Board. Ubephinde abe semkhakheni wezokumodela njengoba ebenguMiss Varsity Shield ophethe isicoco sakulo nyaka. Ngesikhathi sokuloba ibingakaveli eminye imininingwane ngalesi sitshudeni. Kwenzeka lokhu nje ngempelasonto bekungcwatshwa ingcithabuchopho yakuleli, uSolwazi Bongani Mayosi (51).UMayosi obeyiDean yeFaculty of Health Sciences e-University of Cape Town, kuvele ukuthi uzibulele ngenxa yokhwantalala. Umndeni wakhe emngcwabeni uveze ukuthi ukhwantalala lwaqala ngesikhathi kunemibhikisho yeFees Must Fall emanyuvesi. Kuthiwa ubenozwelo, ezikhathalele izitshudeni ezihlwempu. Ukuzibulala kwakhe kuvule amehlo abaningi abathe kumele kuqwashiswe ngendaba yokhwantalala ngoba baningi abanalo kodwa abangasizakali. Sekusungulwe nophenyo ekutholeni ukuthi yini eholele ekutheni azibulale lo solwazi obengungoti emkhakheni wezokuhlinzwa kwezinhliziyo.

KUPHENYWA isihlabani somculi kamaskandi, uKhuzani Mpungose, ngokunyamalala kwenkosikazi yomuntu, uNkk Lungi MaBiyela Hadebe nezingane zakhe ezimbili, okungeyentombazane neyomfana. Lesi sigameko senzeke endaweni yaseNkonise, eNkandla, ngaphansi kwenkosi uMbhele ngoLwesine olwedlule.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uNkk Hadebe, obeyilungu leqembu lesigekle, unyamalale nezimpahla zokugqoka, isamba semali elinganiselwa kuR70 000. UKhuzani uvumile ukuthi usethintwe kaningi ngabaseshi, bemphenya ngalolu daba.“Wudaba oseludumile impela lapha eNkandla,” kusho uKhuzani. Yize uKhuzani ephika elala ngomhlane ukuthi uyazana nalo mkhonyovu kodwa uthe kunomuntu wakwaHadebe okugcizelelayo ukuthi nguye oqole umndeni. “Sebebaningi abantu asebeqolwe ngegama lami. Angisazi ukuthi ngenzenjani,” kusho lo mculi.Isolezwe lithole emithonjeni emithathu ukuthi uNkk Hadebe unyamalala nje wayexhumane ku-facebook nalo muntu ozibiza ngoKhuzani ngemuva kokuba ethole ukuthi kunomcimbi ozokuba kubo kalo maskanda.Kuthiwa lo “Khuzani” wathi uzobasiza labo mama uma bezoshintsha isigqi sibe esikamaskandi futhi wabe esebafuna imali, okuyinto eyabathusa abanye omama kodwa uMaBiyela noHadebe baqhubeka nokuxhumana no“Khuzani’ futhi babaxosha abanye omama ababefuna ukumbona ngamehlo lo “Khuzani.” UHadebe wagcina esekhokhela labantu uR7 000 futhi wabanikeza neveni eyiLong Base, athi lo “Khuzani” izofakwa isithombe nombhalo kaMaBiyela. Kuthiwa “uKhuzani” wenzela uMaBiyela iCD engumbombayi ngoba yayinesithombe sakhe kodwa kucula abanye abaculi besilisa ngaphambi kokuthi athi abalethe le veni. Ngemuva kwalokho, lo “Khuzani” wabe esethumela abantu ababelethe kwakhe uR70 000 maqede bathi akeze eGoli ezolanda ikhumbi enguSiyaya. UHadebe uthe eseya eGoli ngoLwesithathu olwedlule, lo “Khuzani” wangabe esazibamba izingcingo zakhe kanti uzothi ebuyela kwakhe, wafika uMaBiyela nezingane zabo ezimbili bengasekho.Ethintwa uHadebe uthe amaphoyisa amdonse ngendlebe ukuthi angaphawuli ngalolu daba ngoba selusemaphoyiseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbhele ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aseNkandla aphenya icala ngokunyamalala kwabantu abathathu.
