text: USOLA isiteshi uMzansi Magic nenkampani ekhiqiza uhlelo iOur Perfect Wedding, iConnect TV, owesifazane waseManguzi, ochashwe ngenhlamba ngemuva kokuvela kulolu hlelo enxusa umkhwenyana ukuthi athengele umakoti isiqholo esizomenza anuke kahle.Lona wesifazane ogama lakhe uMavuyi Vuyi kuFacebook kodwa kulolu hlelo ubizwe ngoPromise Sithole, ukusho lokhu ngemuva kokuchashwa ngenhlamba abesifazane ekhasini elaziwa ngokuthi iLadies House enkundleni yokuxhumana uFacebook.Ubekhuluma emshadweni kaNonkululeko noNjabulo Mkhumbuzi obekukhonjiswa umshado ngeSonto.Kusuka ngeSonto ngemuva kwalolu hlelo inkulumo kaMavuyi idine abaningi njengoba athi kuyashisa ngakho kudingeka umakoti anuke kamnandi.NgoLwesibili ngemuva kokuthola igama lalona wesifazane iningi limthelekele limbuza ukuthi kungani athunaza isithunzi somunye umuntu wesifazane.Eziphendulela khona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uthe, ababesemshadweni bayazi ukuthi wayethini.“Babehleka umakoti nomkhwenyana ngesikhathi ngisho le nto kodwa kulolu hlelo babaveza sengathi badiniwe ukuze kudonseke amehlo abaningi futhi kube nokukhuluma. Kule nkulumo yami basusa okuningi bagqamisa lokhu okuvelile,” kubhala lona wesifazane.Uthe izinhlelo zethelevishini ziyathanda ukunonga izinto ukuze zihehe zisuse nomsindo.AbeMzansi Magic abayiphendulanga imiyalezo abathunyelelwe yona nge e-mail nemiqhafazo yileli phephandaba.

IPHINI likaMengameli we-NFP, uNkk Sindi Maphumulo-Mashinini, seliphakamise ukuba ibhekisiswe indaba yokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane basemakhaya ngoba besolwa ngokuthakatha.“Sekufike isikhathi sokuba iNingizimu Afrika isukume manje ivikele abesifazane basemakhaya abahlale besolwa ngokuthakatha ngoba bahlukumezeka ngokomphefumulo nangokwenyama. Sibonile kuleli sonto esifundazweni eMpumalanga kuxoshwa owesifazane nezingane zakhe endaweni kuthiwa akahambe ngoba uyathakatha. Okubuhlungu wukuthi noma esekhoseliswa abamsizayo kodwa kukhona abangasamethembi ngenxa yokubhixwa ngegama lokuthi uyathakatha. Le nto siyafisa ukuba uhulumeni wethu ayisukumele ukuze kuvikelwe abesifazane,” kusho uNkk Maphumulo-Mashinini.Uqhube wathi naKwaZulu-Natal lezi zigameko zichithiwe ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisenyakatho koMhlabuyalingana lapho kuba nezigameko zokushiswa kwemizi ngoba kusolwa ugogo walowo muzi ngokuthi uyathakatha.“Sekumele uhulumeni aqale imikhankaso yokuqwashisa abantu ngezifo zabantu abadala ezihambisana nokukhohlwa, nezigcina zibenza sengathi umqondo uyalahleka,” kusho uNkk Maphumulo-Mashinini.Uthe lolu hlobo lwezifo lwenza umuntu omdala azibone esezulazula emzini womuntu engazazi ukuthi uyaphi noma akhohlwe nawukuthi ikhaya lingakuphi ngenxa yazo.“Akukwazi ukuthi singaphila ezweni lapho kusanezinkolelo ezicindezela abesifazane baze babulawe ngesihluku. Empeleni ngisho emalokishini akuvamile ukuzwa kunukwa owesilisa ngokuthakatha kodwa kuhlale kunukwa abesifazane. Abanye ibenza le nto yokusolwa bagcine sebezikhipha inyumbazane bengasahlangani nabantu nokugcina sekuphenduka ubufakazi kulabo abamsolayo bokuthi uyathakatha kanti akunjalo yingoba usuke umntanomuntu esehlukumezeke kakhulu emoyeni. Okubi kakhulu nokudabukisayo abesifazane abahluphekayo yibo abathwele lo mthwalo wokuhlukunyezwa ngokusolwa ngokuthi bayathakatha,” kuqhuba uMaphumulo-Mashinini.Uthe okubuhlungu wukuthi akekho owake waba nobufakazi obubambekayo bokuthi umuntu uthakatha ngempela.

source: kume nse ukufunda enyuvesi izitshudeni zikhala ngensfas
text: KUME ukufunda eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal ophikweni lwaseWestville izolo kwaboshwa nezitshudeni ezingu-17 ngesikhathi kuqubuka umbhikisho izitshudeni zikhala ngokungazitholi izimfanelo zazo esikhwameni sezimali iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme, izindawo zokuhlala kanjalo nokuhamba kancane kwe-wifi.Ngokwamaphoyisa, izitshudeni ezingu-300 izolo ekuseni zihlangane kulolu phiko zajikijela amaphoyisa ngamatshe. Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe kulimale izimoto zamaphoyisa kulesi sehlakalo.“Kuboshwe izitshudeni ezingu-17 ngecala lokudala udlame emphakathini. Zizovela maduze enkantolo. Amaphoyisa ayaqhubeka nokuqapha isimo.”USihlalo weSasco esifundazweni, uMnuz Mqondisi Duma, uthe njengoba iNSFAS ibhekene nezinkinga izitshudeni azikazitholi izimfanelo.UDuma uthe indaba yezindawo zokuhlala ngenye yezinto abakhala ngazo.“Sizoqhubeka silwe udaba lwezinkinga zezitshudeni zize zixazululeke. Indaba ye-wifi nayo ngezinye zezikhalo zezitshudeni,” kusho uDuma.Izitshudeni zikhala ngokuthi ezindaweni ezihlala kuzona ngaphandle kwalesi sikhungo i-wifi ihamba kancane.Okhulumela le nyuvesi, uNksz Normah Zondo, uthe kumiswe izivivinyo nokufunda izolo kulolu phiko kuphela.Uthe lokhu kuzonika ithuba lokuthi abaphathi bahlangane nabaholi bezitshudeni ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga.Uqhube wathi namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi kufundwe kulolu phiko.

USHAQEKILE umphakathi waseThornwood eMariannhill, eduze kwasePinetown emuva kokutholwa kwamalungu amane omndeni ebulewe.Izolo umphakathi ubumi izixongololo ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ephenya kwaDube eThornwood lapho kusolakala ukuthi indodana yakhona uMnuz Khulekani Dube (21) inqume unina, yagwaza unina wezingane zayo ezimbili, yagwaza indodana enezinyanga ezintathu, kwasinda ingane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili nayo yazigwaza yase izikhunga.UMnuz Themba Joseph Makhathini ongumfowabo kaNkk Thembi Dube, uthe bashaqekile ngoba abazi ukuthi dimoni lini elingene umshana wakhe.“Ezinyangeni ezedlule udadewethu wathi indodana yakhe iyamsabisa uma iphuzile ithi izombulala. Ngamcela ukuthi abikele amaphoyisa kodwa wanganaka ngoba umshana ubesho uma ephuzile. Ubephuza ugologo omhlophe ebhema nosikilidi. Angikaze ngizwe ukuthi ubhema izidakamizwa. Kungiphethe kabi ukuthi ubulale udadewethu ngesihluku emnqumisa okwembuzi, isithusile le nto,” kusho uMakhathini.Uthe bathole izolo ekuseni ukuthi udadewabo akasekho emuva kokuthi umfundisi obeyolanda umndeni ukuba uye esontweni ekhale ngokuthi akukho muntu ophendulayo uma engqongqoza futhi kunuka iphunga elibi.“Sithumele uMfanafuthi (omunye umshana) ukuthi ayobheka ngoba sihlala ngaphesheya. Uze wathatha i-crowbar ukuze avule ngayo ngoba akekho obephendula. Uthole izidumbu esisola ukuthi bese zihlale isonto zidindilizile zonakele futhi zinamanxeba okugwazwa,” kusho uMakhathini.UNksz Zodwa Makhathini obiza uNkk Dube ngonina omncane uthe: “Asazi sizothi bekwenzenjani, asimazi ebhema izidakamizwa, siphatheke kabi”.Ukhungathekile umphakathi waseThornwood lapho umfana ehlahlele unina izingane zakhe ezimbili wase ezikhunga.Video: Mcebo Mpungosepic.twitter.com/io1vgSQkfC— Isolezwe Newspaper (@IsolezweNews)August 19, 2018Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Bheki Mfeka, lithe liyaqala ukubona into enjena ngoba abakaze bezwe kuthiwa ilungu lomndeni liwuqothe wonke.“Uma kuthiwa umndeni ubulewe usuke ubulawe yizigebengu, siyakuqala ukuthi kube yilungu lawo eliwuqothayo. Sizowulekelela ngalo lonke usizo eliwudingayo umndeni wakwaDube ngoba sishiye yonke into sazobona lo monakalo osuwenzekile,” kusho uMfeka.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe amaphoyisa aseMariannhill aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala kwavulwa nedokodo (ngecala lozibulele).“Kutholwe izidumbu ezintathu emzini oseThornwood zinamanxeba okugwazwa. Kutholwe nesendoda eneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-20 silenga, zonke izidumbu bese zonakele. Kutholwe nentombazanyana eneminyaka emibili ebiphila ihleli nalezi zidumbu. Iphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuze iyothola usizo,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.Uthe isaphenywa imbangela yokubulawa kwabantu.

source: angase alahlekelwe yisithabathaba somuzi owakhe esizeni somuntu
text: USENGCUPHENI yokulahlekelwa isithabathaba somuzi umndeni waseSikhaleni, eMpangeni, osuthole ukuthi wadayiselwa ngokungemthetho isiza sawo.Ukhala ezimathonsi uNkk Nqobile Mkhwanazi, osecabanga ukuvele awudilize umuzi awakha ngemali yesinxephezelo somyeni wakhe owalimala engozini yemoto. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi wathenga isiza ngo-2013 esasibiza uR120 000, wakha nomuzi. Uveze ukuthi walandela konke okwenziwa uma uthenga isiza, wathola nencwadi yetayitela. Ngo-2014 kwafika abazibize ngabanikazi balesi siza, abathe abakaze basidayise. UNkk Mkhwanazi uthe athenga kuyena isiza naye wayesidayiselwe ngomunye okusolakala ukuthi nguyena owakokotela omazisi babanikazi baso.“Angisazi yini engizoyenza yingakho sengibona kungcono ngiwudilize umuzi. Icala selibuya ngisho enkantolo ngo-2015 ngatshelwa ukuthi isiza kumele sibuyele kubanikazi baso. Ngesonto eledlule ngithole ucingo kuthiwa angizosayina ukuthi ngiyavuma ukuthi isiza sibuyele kubanikazi,” kubalisa uNkk Mkhwanazi.Umuzi ongase umlahlekele wambiza uR400 000 ukuwakha, unamakamelo amane okulala, ikamelo lokuphumula, elokudlela, ikhishi, amagaraji amabili nezindlu zokugeza ezimbili ezinamathoyilethi. Ingozi alimala kuyo umyeni wakhe yamshiya engakwazi ukuhamba njengoba esebenzisa isihlalo esinamasondo.UNkk Mkhwanazi uthe uyile kobika udaba kuMasipala waseMhlathuze ngoba isiza siselokishini, bathembisa ukululandela.Okhulumela uMasipala, uMnuz Mdu Ncalane uvumile ukuthi lwafika kubona udaba kodwa akukho abangasiza ngakho.Uthe abakutholile wukuthi indawo okwakhiwe kuyo umuzi ayikho ngaphansi kukamasipala.“Ukungenela kwethu kwakuwukubheka ukuthi isiza esikabani. Ngeke sikwazi ukungenela ngoba lena yindawo ezimele engekho ngaphansi kukaMasipala. Sameluleka uNkk Mkhwanazi ukuthi azame abameli ukuxazulula lolu daba,” kusho uNcalane.Isolezwe lizamile ukuthola umnikazi wesiza, oshayelwe emahhovisi akhe okusebenza ngoMsombuluko kwathiwa usaphumile. Intatheli ishiye umyalezo nenombolo yocingo. Izolo kuthiwe uxinwe umsebenzi futhi ngeke abe khona ehhovisi usuku lonke. Omunye owesilisa osebenza enkampanini yakhe, uthe uyalwazi udaba kodwa kumele kuthintwe ngqo umnikazi walo. Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela engatholakali.

UKUBONA isifo esixakile esahlasela unina, kwenze ukuthi asungule inhlangano aqwashisa ngayo owesifazane waseLamontville, eThekwini, osezinze e-England.UNksz Zethu Makhathini (56), unenhlangano ebizwa ngeBessie Makhathini Foundation efundisa kabanzi ngeDementia. Lesi yisifo esijwayele ukuhlasela asebekhulile, esenza balahlekelwe umqondo. UNksz Makhathini uthe wayengazi ukuthi unina unalesi sifo kodwa nasemndenini babecabanga ukuthi ukuguga. Ukusungula le nhlangano kuyingxenye yokuthi apholise amanxeba njengoba ethi ukushona kukanina kwashiya isilonda.Uchaze unina owayengunesi njengowesifazane obenesibindi, ebakhathalele nabantu. UNksz Makhathini washiya elakuleli waya ekudingisweni ngo-1981 ngenxa yezepolitiki. Uthe kwathatha isikhathi ukuthi unina amazi ukuthi ukuliphi izwe kodwa wamfuna waze wamthola, wamvakashela.“Ngaqala ngaya eTanzania ngesikhathi ngisuka eNingizimu Afrika, ngagcina sengiseSoviet Union. Yilapho engafike ngafundela iPsychology, namanje okuyiyona engisiza ukulekelela abaneDementia,” kusho yena.Yize uNksz Makhathini abuyela kuleli emuva kokhetho lwenkululeko ngo-1994, wanquma ukuyozinza e-England. Inhlangano ayisungulile iwaxhumanisa womabili lawa mazwe njengoba enehhovisi eLamontiville nelinye elise-England. Naye uyabuya ukuzobheka umsebenzi kuleli kodwa uxhumana nehhovisi nsuku zonke ngeSkype. Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2015 emuva kokushona kukanina ngo-2012. Uveze ukuthi unina watholakala ukuthi unalesi sifo ngo-2009 kodwa ngalesi sikhathi lwalungekho usizo.“Baningi abaphethwe yilesi sifo kodwa kungaziwa. Umphakathi awufundisekile ngaso ngoba uma ugogo ebonakala ehamba ebusuku usolwa ngokuthakatha. Umama watholakala nalesi sifo sesidlondlobele kakhulu yingakho ngisiza abantu ukuze basheshe bathole usizo,” kusho yena.Echaza ezinye izimpawu zaso uthe abanye bayakhohlwa noma bakhulume into engekho.“Kwakuthi uma ngihamba nomama ngemoto ngifuna angiyalele ngoba angilazi iTheku, acishe angiphonse ezimotweni engihambisa ngendlela okungeyona. Omunye kuyenzeka agcine ebiza ngisho amaphoyisa esola umndeni ngokuntshontshelwa imali ngoba esekhohliwe ukuthi uyifihlephi. Omunye ukhohlwa ngisho ukudla noma aphume imoto ihamba,” echaza.UNksz Makhathini osebenzisana nesibhedlela iKing Dinuzulu eThekwini ukusiza abanalesi sifo, uneSupport Group kanti ubuye asebenze ngocingo ukuhlolela iDementia.Ngaphandle kwalo msebenzi, usebenza nesikhungo iNational Health Service emkhakheni wePsycho Education e-England.

LUGCINE lugobile uphondo eziphathimandleni zikaMasipala waKwaNongoma, KwaZulu-Natal, mayelana nokuhoxisa esikhundleni ikhansela obekuthiwa lihola imali yabakhokhibentela libe lidonsa iminyaka eyisithupha ejele ngecala lokweba imfuyo esifundazweni iMpumalanga.IMeya yaKwaNongoma, uMnuz Albert Mncwango, ithe sebegcine bemsulile emabhukwini amakhansela omkhandlu wabo uZamani Sibiya ngoba icala ligcine limlahlile ngemuva kokulidlulisela phambili.Uthe lokhu kusho ukuthi sekuzoba nokhetho lokuchibiyela ewadini ebiphethwe uSibiya.“Sitholile njengomkhandlu ukuthi inkantolo isichithihile isicelo sikaSibiya sokuba kubuyekezwe isinqumo saphambilini sokutholwa enecala lokweba imfuyo eVolkrust. Ngenxa yalokho sinqume ukuba simsule ohlwini lwamakhansela ethu. Ngaphandle kwalokho besingeke sikwazi ukufinyelela kulesi sinqumo singakezwa isiphetho semizamo yakhe, okuyilungelo lomthethosisekelo elimgunyazayo ukuba icala alidlulise kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo esingujuqu. Ukube besenzenjalo besizoba senkingeni uma icala elinqoba ngoba bekofanele sibuyisele emuva zonke izinqumo ebesizobe zithathwe ngaphandle kwakhe nebezizobe zithinta yena,” kusho uMncwango.USibiya ubeyikhansela le-IFP ku-ward 20 kanti ubephinde ahlale emkhandlwini kaMasipala waseZululand.Ugwetshwe iminyaka emithathu ngoMeyi 25 yiNkantolo yaseVolkrust kodwa icala walidlulisa. Inkantolo ibe isimengezela ngeminye iminyaka emithathu yabe isiba yisithupha isiyonke.UMncwango ukuphikile ukuthi uSibiya ubeqhubeka nokuhola yize edonsa ejele. Uthe wagcina ukuhola ngoMeyi 25 ngoba wayesebenzile.USihlalo weKhomishini yezoKhetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mawethu Mosery, uthe bebengakaziswa ngodaba lukaSibiya ngakho abanazo izinhlelo zokhetho lokuchibiyela ezithinta uNongoma.UMncwango uthe basalungisa imigudu ethile yangaphakathi ukuze bazise ikhomishini ezimele ebhekele ukhetho KwaZulu-Natal ukuze ikwazi ukuhlela usuku lokhetho lokuchibiyela.

UKUBONA isasasa kubalandeli abathanda ukujima ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kwenze izintokazi zaseThekwini zavula inkampani ekhuthaza ukuzivocavoca.UYolanda Sokhela oyiPersonal Trainer noSbahle Mpisane odume ngeleFitness Bunnie, sebesebenza ndawonye ukukhuthaza ukujima ngaphansi kwenkampani yabo, iDual Aerodance. Baqale ngo-Ephreli nonyaka umkhankaso wokuvakashela amalokishi, abakhuthaza kakhulu abesifazane ukuthi bazivocavoce. Echaza uYolanda uthe ubebona indlela abantu abaphawula ngayo ngomsebenzi wakhe noSbahle ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Uthe uhlabeke umxhwele nangendlela abantu basemalokishini asebekukhuthalele ngayo ukujima.“Abaningi uSbahle bebemazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuphela. Bebekhala ngokuthi bayafisa ukumbona bajime naye ngoba bathanda indlela umzimba wakhe obukeka ngayo. Ngakubona kuyinselelo lokhu, ngakhuluma noSbahle wavuma ukuthi sisebenze ndawonye,” echaza.#SibungazaImbokodo| Amazwi kaMama uMiriam Makebahttps://t.co/eqF6fZoKpF#IntandokaziYesizwe#TotalShutDown#WomensMonthpic.twitter.com/ejoXJRW9Rk— Isolezwe Newspaper (@IsolezweNews)August 2, 2018Uthe kulo mkhankaso banxenxa abantu abanamaqembu okujima ukuthi babameme ukuzojima nabo emalokishini. Baqale ukuvakashela eMlaza lapho uYolanda athi kunamaqembu amaningi okujima. Ezinye izindawo abazivakashele kubalwa iMontclair naKwaMashu.“Isikhathi esiningi ngabesifazane abakhuluphala kakhulu, bahlaselwe nayizifo ezihlobene nakho. Siheha kakhulu nentsha ngoba uSbahle ulandelwa yiyona kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana,” kusho uYolanda.USBAHLE Mpisane osesebenzisana noYolanda Sokhela ukukhuthaza ukuzivocavoca emalokishini, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane Isithombe:FACEBOOKNgo-Agasti 11 bazoba nomcimbi wokuqala omkhulu e-Amphitheatre eThekwini ogxile kwabesifazane.UYolanda useqeqeshe abaningi asebengoPersonal Trainer, wavula nendawo yokujima ePort Shepstone. Uyinxusa lezimpahla zokujima aphinde asebenzisane nelinye lamaphephabhuku. USbahle naye uyinxusa lemikhiziqo yezemidlalo nemikhankaso eminingi yokunakekela umzimba aphinde abe yiFitness Trainer. Eminye imininingwane ngomcimbi wabo itholakala emakhasini abo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Umyalezo woMhleli: Kule nyanga sizobungaza abesifazane ngokuba nezindaba ezibathinta ngqo ezibathuthukisayo, ezibakhayo, ezibafundisayo, ezibahlomisayo nezibagqugquzelayo. Nsukuzonke kule nyanga sizogqamisa nabesifazane asebephumelele ngehloso yokugqugquzela siphinde sikuvuselele sikukhuthaze ngamazwi obuhlakani akhulunywa yimbokodo engamaqhawe.

KUDUTSHULWE kwashona umshayeli wetekisi emayini KwaSomkhele, KwaMsane, zolo.UMnuz Sthembiso Khumalo (27) obeshayela itekisi ebigcwele abasebenzi bakule mayini ufike kuyo ekuseni ngo-5.30 njengokujwayelekile. Ngesikhathi onogada bematasa becindezela ilayisensi yakhe emshinini othatha imininingwane, omunye emfuthisa emshinini ohlola ukuthi abukho yini utshwala egazini, kuthushuke owesilisa ongaziwa wakhomba umshayeli ngesibhamu.Kuthiwa udubule kwaze kwaba kasithupha ebhekise kumshayeli. Umufi udubuleke ekhanda, esifubeni, engalweni, izinhlamvu ezintathu zangena ohlangothini lwangakwesokudla washonela khona lapho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCol Thembeka Mbele, uthe ngokuthola kwamaphoyisa umsolwa udubule maqede wabaleka wayongena emotweni iBMW empunga eyi-sedan.Uthe ngesikhathi umsolwa evulela ngenhlamvu etekisini kudubuleke nomgibeli enqulwini waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela KwaHlabisa.“Kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMsane. Okwamanje akukaboshwa muntu,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa acela noma ngubani ongawasiza ngolwazi olungaholela ekuboshweni kosolwa ngaleli cala athinte umphenyi wecala uCaptain Nkosinathi Themba Hilton Buthelezi ku-035 551 9008.

source: ubengafuni ukubuyela ekhaya obulawe yisoka ethornwood
text: UNINA wowesifazane (24) obulawe yisoka lakhe eThornwood, eMariannhill eduze kwasePinetown uthe kudala ayeyincenga indodakazi yakhe ethi ayibuyele ekhaya kodwa inqaba ithi iyohlukaniswa wukufa nesoka layo.UNkk Sindi MaGumede Njakazi (48) uthe uphatheke kabi ngokubulawa kwendodakazi yakhe ngoba indlela ebulawe ngayo iyakhombisa ukuthi bekukhona okonakele othandweni lwayo.UNkk Njakazi uthe indodakazi yakhe, uNksz Philile Gracia Gumede, ibulawe yisoka layo uMnuz Khulekani Dube (21), obulale unina uNkk Thembi Dube (57), waphinde wabulala nendodana yakhe enezinyanga ezintathu uNhlakanipho Dube, wagwaza nendodakazi yakhe uNonkululeko Dube (2) otholwe encela ibele likanina obeseshonile. UNonkululeko usesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela.UNKSZ Philile Gumede kuthiwa kade ayecelwa ukuthi abuyele ekhaya kodwa ethi uzohlukaniswa wukufa nesoka lakhe“Indodakazi yami ibingashadile noKhulekani kodwa bebezalisene futhi abakwaDube bebegcina ngokuthembisa ukuthi bazolobola kodwa bebengakaze bafike. Ngiphatheke kabi ngokuthi indodakazi yami ibulawe wuKhulekani ngoba bengiyincenga ngithi ayibuye ekhaya ingitshele ukuthi uKhulekani wumuntu onolaka okuthi uma esethukuthele kube iyona kuphela ekwazi ukumehlisa. Ibithi uma ingivakashele ayifonele uKhulekani ayibuze ukuthi ibuya nini ibe iqeda kufika,” kusho uNkk Njakazi.FUNDA:Bashaqekile ngoqothe umndeniUthe kwala ngisho eseyisabisa ngokuthi uzoyilanda namaphoyisa kwaDube kodwa ayizange ifune ukubuya.UMNUZ Khulekani Dube obulele umndeni wakhe maqede wazikhunga.“UPhilile wangitshela ukuthi yena noKhulekani bayohlukaniswa wukufa, ngiphatheke kabi ngoba sekwenzekile lokhu ayekushilo. Ngiyacela ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zikhulume uma zinezinkinga othandweni lwazo zingafeli ngaphakathi. Ngiyasola ukuthi bekunezinkinga othandweni lwendodakazi yami kodwa ibifela ngaphakathi,” kusho uNkk Njakazi.Uveze ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ibisihlale kwaDube iminyaka eyisithupha kanti kwaNjakazi abasebenzi njengoba beziphilisa ngokudayisa amashidi ombhede.Mayelana nengane yendodakazi yakhe esindile uthe usazoya esibhedlela aphinde akhulume nosonhlalakahle ngoba izodinga ukwelulekwa ngokwengqondo.IMEYA yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi umasipala uzolekela ukuze kufihlwe umndeni wakwaDube oqothwe yindodana yakhona egcine ngokuzihilela. Video: BONISWA MOHALEIMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, ibizifikele mathupha kwaDube yathi siyishaqisile isigameko sokuqothwa kwalo mndeni.“Baningi la bantu besifazane abadlule emhlabeni ngesandla somuntu wesilisa osemncane kakhulu, sithinteke kakhulu ezinhliziyweni. Njengomkhandlu onakekelayo sizoqinisekisa ukuthi umndeni ufihlwa ngesizotha. Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi ingane esele, esesibhedlela njengamanje, ithola ukuhlunyeleliswa kwezengqondo ngoba ihlukumezeke kakhulu, ihlale isonto lonke nabantu abashonile incela ebeleni likanina. Kuyinto ebuhlungu kakhulu. Sizoqinisekisa umndeni ozobe uhleli nayo ukuthi sizoyinakekela ngoba uhulumeni wethu unezinhlelo zonke zokunakekela abantwana abangenabo abazali,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Ugqugquzele amadoda ukuthi avikele abesifazane ayeke izidakamizwa ngoba uKhulekani uchazwe njengomuntu obephuza futhi kutholwe namaphilisi eduze kwakhe.UNKK Thembi Dube obulewe yindodana yakhe uKhulekani Dube emgwazile yaphinde yamnquma.Khonamanjalo uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Weziwe Thusi, uthe uzothumela osonhlalakahle bayosiza umndeni wakwaDube.Uphinde wacela imindeni ukuthi isheshe icele usizo uma inezinkinga kungaze kube nezigameko ezifuze esakwaDube.

AMANYE amakhosi awafuni nakuyizwa indaba yeNgonyama Trust njengoba ethi afuna ukuziphathela wona umhlaba wawo, azilawulele nemali eyenziwa ngawo.Inkosi Mzabane Makhoba yaseKokstad eNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal ithe yize yabekwa yiSilo uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu futhi iyawuncoma umsebenzi owenziwa Ingonyama Trust evikela umhlaba wamakhosi ukuthi uthathwe wuhulumeni kodwa amakhosi kufanele aziphathele umhlaba wawo.“INgonyama Trust kufanele inike amakhosi ilungelo lokuthi aziphathele imali ekhokhwa abatshalizimali abasuke besebenzisa umhlaba. Njengamanje yonke imali eyenziwa emhlabeni wamakhosi iya kwiNgonyama Trust. Amakhosi nezizwe zawo awahlomuli ngalutho,” kusho uMakhoba.Uthe amakhosi kufanele aziphathele wona umhlaba wawo nemali eyenziwa kuwona ukuze kuzohlomula izizwe zawo.KwaZulu-Natal angu-303 amakhosi ahambisana nokuthi umhlaba wawo uphathwe iNgonyama Trust futhi awafuni ukuthi uhulumeni asondele kulo mhlaba.INgonyama Trust iphethwe yiSilo, inomhlaba ongu-2.8 million hectares okungumhlaba wasemakhaya omningi kanti ngonyaka iqoqa uR90 million kosomabhizinisi abasebenzisa lo mhlaba.Inkosi Bhungane Hadebe ithe isizwe sayo esise-Estcourt asiyazi iNgonyama Trust ngoba asikaze sithintwe ngesikhathi isungulwa.“Sihambisana neSilo ekutheni umhlaba ngowamakhosi akusiwo okahulumeni kodwa asihambisana neNgonyama Trust ngoba yasungulwa ngaphandle kokwazisa amakhosi,” kusho uHadebe.Umkhankaso wokuvikela iNgonyama Trust uqalwe emuva kokuthi owayenguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe ededele umbiko owawuphakamisa ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele ahlakaze Ingonyama Trust ngoba ayihambisani nomthetho sisekelo.Umholi we-IFP, Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ngokubambisana nohulumeni kaMengameli owayephethe ngaleso sikhathi uMnuz FW de Klerk, yasungula Ingonyama Trust ngo-1994.Ngesonto eledlule uButhelezi uthe wasungula iNgonyama Trust ukuvikela umhlaba wabantu basemakhaya.Enye inkosi ecele ukungadalulwa ithe iSilo asinawo umhlaba ngoba ngowokhokho bamakhosi abawudlulisela kwizizukulwane zabo.Asihambisani nokuthi umhlaba wethu uphathwe Ingonyama sifuna ukuziphathela wona njengoba sasiwuphethe kudala,” kusho le nkosi.Enye inkosi ikhale ngokuthi kudala ibizithathela izinqumo ngomhlaba wayo kodwa manje sekufanele ibhalele Ingonyama ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umhlaba wayo.Inkosi Nhlakanipho Maphumulo enguNobhala weCongress of Traditional Leaders of South Africa (Contralesa) ithe wonke amakhosi anelungelo lokuphatha umhlaba wawo kodwa abatshalizimali okufanele basayine isivumelwano sokusebenzisa umhlaba neNgonyama Trust.“Osomabhizinisi bakhokha irenti yokusebenzisa umhlaba kwiNgonyama Trust. Kunama-akhawunti aveza ukuthi umhlaba wenkosi ethile wenza malini ,” kusho uMaphumulo.UMntwana uThulani Zulu okhulumela Isilo walile ukuphawula.UJaji Jerome Ngwenya onguSihlalo weNgonyama Trust Board akawaphendulanga ama-sms nama-emails athunyelelwe wona ngesonto eledlule.Iphephandaba iMail&Guradian libike ukuthi iNgonyama Trust iyiswe enkantolo ngabantu abafuna iyeke ukukhokhisa amasonto, osomabhizinisi nabanye abantu abasebenzisa umhlaba wamakhosi.KwaZulu-Natal ibandla lamaLuthela libalwa nezinhlangano ezihambise Ingonyama Trust enkantolo ngoba likhala ngokuthi abantu bazolahlekelwa wumhlaba uma behluleka wukukhokhela umhlaba.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula koMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu ayiphumelelanga.

text: MHLELI: Ake ngikhulume ngedolobha engihlala kulo uMgungundlovu. Leli dolobha lincane kodwa ngesikhathi salo belihlanzekile ngale ndlela ongayazi.Angazi ukuthi imeya neziphathimandla zedolobha zihamba kuyiphi imigwaqo. Indawo obonayo ukuthi kuseyidolobha isemgwaqweni uVictoria nakoGreyling uma ubheka nakhona hhayi yonke indawo. Kukhona umgwaqo ongaka-Asmalls ohlezi unamanzi amnyama. Nomunye omncane owehlayo, wudoti woqobo-ke wona, mhlawumbe usungawubiza ngomgwaqo wamaphara. Naserenki yaseSweetwaters emathoyilethi laphaya kudliwa iwunga ungalimala uma ungangena unganakile.Kanti imeya yayibhidlizelani indawo okuthiwa isematsheni? Uyixazulula kanjani inkinga ngenye inkinga? Uma ukhipha amabhubesi esiqiwini ulindeleni ngempela? Uma uhamba kweminye imigwaqo imila utshani. Umasipala uhlulwa wukuthenga umuthi nje wokhula ufuthe.Uzobona into ezokwenzeka ehlobo. Utshani eduze nomgwaqo babuye bashanele bafake emapayipini bese amanzi angabe esahamba kube nenkinga nezikhukhula zihamba namaphepha yonke imfucuza igcwala emgwaqweni. Uhamba ezitaladini kwezinye indawo ungangena nasemigodini basusa izinsimbi ezivale izitamkoko. Izinga lenhlanzeko nokunakekela ingqalasizinda kuphansi. Bayamba bangabuyiseli ngendlela.Impela kuyoshaya u-2030 ingekho indaba yaleli dolobha uma besaqhuba ngale ndlela. Akwenziweni umsebenzi ningasiqhosheli ngokuthi umuntu wavota ebe engavotelanga ukuthi akenze noma yini ayithandayo.D M MtoloEMGUNGUNDLOVU

text: UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uyihlabe wayihlikiza inkulumo kamengameli wase-United States, uMnuz Donald Trump, othe uzolufakela izibuko udaba lokudliwa komhlaba kuleli.UMalema uphawule ngalolu daba esithangameni nabezindaba ngoLwesine lapho eveze khona ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isazobhekana nobunzima odabeni lomhlaba. Uthe inkulumo kaTrump ayimethusi nakancane ngoba ubeyilindele kumuntu ofana naye.“Uma kuwukuthi abantu bakuleli abakazimiseli ukudla umhlaba ngoba besaba unswinyo nokugxekwa, akumele bavotele i-EFF. Uma besivotela thina sizowudla umhlaba futhi uDonald Trump, iBritain ne-European Union bazosihlasela ngalokho. Ngihlezi ngisho ukuthi ngaphambi kokuzuza okuhle, kuqala izinhlungu. Uma abantu bakuleli bengazimesele ngokudlula ezinhlungwini, abakhohlwe umhlaba. Okwesibili esizimisele ngakho ukuhlupheka ngoba siyazi bazovala ompompi (bomnotho). Kumele silungiselele yonke into, ngisho impi. Kumele sizilungiselele uDonald Trump nabo bonke, asibesaba. Usivuselele ugqozi kakhulu ngemuva kombhalo wakhe kuTwitter,” kusho uMalema.I have asked Secretary of State@SecPompeoto closely study the South Africa land and farm seizures and expropriations and the large scale killing of farmers. “South African Government is now seizing land from white farmers.”@TuckerCarlson@FoxNews— Donald J.
