UNQGONGQOSHE wezeMfundo ePhakeme kuleli bekumele abeke umnqamulajuqu ocacisa ngokuthi isikhwama esiboleka izitshudeni imali yokufunda, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) kumele sithathe isikhathi esingakanani ukulungisa izinkinga eziholela ekutheni izicelo zezitshudeni zingaphothulwa.Lokhu kushiwo yizitshudeni zezikhungo zezemfundo ephakeme KwaZulu-Natal, ngemuva kokuputshuka kwencwadi kaNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo kuleli uNkk Naledi Pandor, abeyibhalele usihlalo webhodi lwakwaNSFAS, uMnuz Sizwe Nxasana.Zithi yize sisihle lesi sinyathelo sokuthi iNSFAS ikumisile ukuthatha izicelo zika-2019, obekumele kuqale namhlanje kodwa bekumele kuhambisane nomnqamulajuqu wokuthi lezi zinkinga bazilungise ngesikhathi esingakanani.UMengameli womkhandlu wezitshudeni eMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), uMnuz Sandile Dlamini yize bewujabulela lo myalelo kaNkk Pandor ngoba uzobeka ezinye izitshudeni ethubeni elingcono lokuthi kuhlaziywe izicelo zazo esezinesikhathi eside zingaphothulwa kodwa bakhathazekile ngokuthi akushiwo ukuthi lesi sikhwama sinikezwa isikhathi esingakanani sokuthi silungise izinkinga zaso.“Sekunesikhathi eside sisho ukuthi lesi sikhwama asisebenzi kahle. E-MUT kunezitshudeni zika-2017 izicelo zazo ezingakaphothulwa, kube nezitshudeni zika-2018 nazo ezisalinde ukuthi lesi sikhwama sithathe isinqumo sokuthi zizohlomula yini kuso. Ngempela uma kuphinde kuvulwa ukuthi kufakwe ezinye izicelo ngabe kuthiwa nazo kumele ziduve kwaNSFAS? Nginethemba lokuthi emhlanganweni esizoba nawo nomnyango neNSFAS ngeSonto uzocacisa kabanzi ngale mibuzo esisenayo.”FUNDA:Umyalelo kaPandor kwabeNSFASUMengameli womkhandlu wezitshudeni eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, (UKZN), uMnuz Sandile Zondi, uthe uNkk Pandor kumele agade ukuthi akalungisi inkinga ngokudala enye inkinga.“Ungqongqoshe ukhiphe lo myalelo ngenyanga yesishiyagalombili yonyaka ekubeni kade siwubikela umnyango ngezinkinga zalesi sikhwama.“Uma ukulungiswa kwezinkinga ezikhona kudonsa kuze kushaya uNovemba, kuzodaleka inkinga efanayo kwizitshudeni zonyaka ozayo. Ngabe kuyacaca ukuthi uthi okungenani lesi sikhungo asiphothule zonke izicelo ezingaphothuliwe ngo-Agasti, ngoSepthemba kuvulwe ukufakwa kwezicelo.”

CISHE yisifiso sabesifazane abaningi ukubona indoda ihlaba phansi ngedolo icela umshado. Yize lokhu bekujwayeleke emidlalweni yethelevishini, bayanda abamnyama abakholelwa ekuthembisaneni umshado esidlangalaleni. Isikhathi esiningi owesifazane usuke engazi nhlobo ukuthi uzocelwa umshado. Lokhu kujwayeleke ukwenzeka ezindaweni zomphakathi, kuhlelwe owesifazane engazi.Ngesonto eledlule uMnuz Scelo Shelembe waseClermont umangaze isithandwa sakhe uNksz Thobile Ntombela esicela umshado endaweni yobumnandi iViews At Twenty5 eThekwini. Bekugujwa unyaka kwavulwa le ndawo yobumnandi. UShelembe osethandane iminyaka emithathu noNksz Ntombela, uthe usezinhlelweni zokuthi bashade. Uveze ukuthi ubone kungcono amthembise umshado kule ndawo ngoba bayithanda kakhulu.Ngo-Ephreli nonyaka waphenduka isilomo uMnuz Thobile Cawana osebenza kwaSA Navy ezothembisa umshado uDkt Vonani Mpangela obeyisitshudeni e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN). UCawana wasuka emsebenzini ephelezelwa uzakwabo obemphathele izimbali, okuthe sekubizwa uDkt Mpangela esiteji ukuzothweswa umyezane, wamlinda nendandatho.Ngo-2016 kusona lesi sikhungo wenza okufanayo uMnuz Sanele Mhlungu waseMgungundlovu owacela umshado kuNksz Nosipho Nguse ezothweswa iziqu. Lezi zithandani zazihlangane khona e-UKZN futhi uMhlungu wayeselobolile ngesikhathi ecela umshado.Yize lo mkhuba usujwayelekile nakwabamnyama, ihlukene imibono ngawo. Abanye bagxeka laba abathembisana umshado kuthweswa iziqu bathi bafuna ukubukwa. Abanye bakubona kuwukuzifakela ingcindezi emphakathini.UMfundisi Thandi Ngonelo ongumeluleki wezemishado, uthe abesifazane akumele basheshe bajatshuliswe ukucelwa umshado.Uthe kumele umuntu ahluze umqondo ngaphambi kokuthi avume.“Baningi abasanganayo uma umfana eseguqe wakhipha indandatho. Kumele uqale umbuze ukuthi usekhule ngokwanele yini nokuthi unayo yini imali.“Abanye bakwenza lokhu ukujabulisa omunye nje kodwa bengahlelanga,” kusho yena.Ngokombiko weWedding Trends Mag, kuningi okumele ukucabange ngaphambi kokucela umuntu umshado.* Mawube nesiqiniseko sokuthi uzovuma ukuze ungaphoxeki.* Kungenzeka avume ngoba esesaba ukukuphoxa phambi kwabantu.* Uma kungumuntu onamahloni kungcono ukwenze ninobabili.* Makube sendaweni ayithandayo ukuze angalukhohlwa lolu suku.* Zama ukuqala ngokwenza ucwaningo ukuthi angakujabulela yini ukucelwa umshado kugcwele abantu.

MHLELI: Ngibeka umbono ngodaba lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Umvusi wenyamazane akuvamisile ukuthi kube wuye oyishayayo ngoba iye ithi uma ivuka iqala ukubaleka ibaleke iye le kanti iyoziphonsa kwabanye abantu.Ngalo mzekelo ngiqonde ukuthi umvusi wenyamazane ewudaba lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo nguJulius Malema neqembu lakhe le-EFF kodwa le nyamazane sibona isitshathwe yi-ANC.Nginemibuzo eminingi engidinga ukuphendulwa kuyo mayelana nalolu daba olusematheni lokuthathwa komhlaba.Lo mhlaba uma usuthathwa ubuyiselwa kubantu bebala, laba abangabanikazi bawo okwamanje iningi labo okungabamhlophe, bayoshoniswaphi?Thina bantu bebala ngabe sesihlome ngokwanele yini ngolwazi nangamakhono ukuthi uma sinikwa umhlaba siyazi ukuthi sizowenzani?Bazohlonzwa kanjani abantu okumele bahlomule kulolu hlelo lokubuyiswa komhlaba?Nginomuzwa wokuthi noma unganikwa abantu bebala umhlaba kodwa lo oseduze namadolobha uzogcwala imijondolo.Uhulumeni ophethe ngimbona esethole iphuzu lokucasha ngesithupha odabeni lokuthi anikeze abantu izindlu waphinde wathola iphuzu lezepolitiki ngalolu daba lomhlaba nasezokhankasa ngalo.Nginomuzwa wokuthi kuyimanje ayikho indlela ebekiwe yokuthi uzokwabiwa kanjani wona lo mhlaba usunikwa thina bebala. Ngike ngezwa uMalema ethi umuntu wesifazane ngamunye uzothola i-hectare elilodwa. Lokhu akuwenzanga sidalo umqondo kimi kuze kube yinamhlanje.Iqiniso limile lithi nje uhulumeni akakhele abantu izindlu bese kuqhubeka udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba okuhamba nesinxephezelo ukuze kube nozinzo nasemnothweni wezwe. Uma le mpi yobuhlanga iqhubeka sizofana neZimbabwe. Lokho kufakazelwa wukuthi ukuphawula kukamengameli uDonald Trump ngalolu daba kwenze irandi ladunguzela.Le ndaba yokuthathwa komhlaba ngale ndlela izosibuyisela emumva ngoba kimina ivela iwubandlululo ngokwebala.Umfundi weSolezwe

ABEVALWE ngezingidi amasango amasonto amabandla amabili aKwaMashu izolo, bekhala ngabefundisi.Izolo amaLuthela akhonza egatsheni laKwaMashu, eSangweni,elikwa-F, elidume ngokuthi yisonto loZalo ngenxa yokuthi umdlalo we-tv, Uzalo lusebenzisa leli sonto uma ludlala indawo yesonto, agcine ebamba umhlangano lapho kupakwa khona izimoto, isango lesonto likhiywe ngezingidi, ezintsha.Esangweni bekunanyathiselwe amaphepha athi umfundisi (KB Maseko) onezinyanga ezintathu engalubhadi kuleli gatsha, uyalixova, futhi unabantu abathandayo nangabathandi.Kuthiwa izinkinga ziqale kuleli gatsha ngesikhathi umfundisi nowakwakhe bekhombisa ukungaseseki isigungu esisha sokuphathwa kwesonto esikhethwe ngoMashi, ngoba kuphume abantu abefuna babuyele kulo mkhandlu behlulwa okhethweni.Kuthiwa isigungu esisha sokuphathwa kwaleli gatsha esiholwa uNkk Nonhlanhla Khanyile asizange sinikwe ngokusemthethweni izintambo obekumele kwenziwe ngoMeyi.Kuthiwa umkhandlu omdala bekumele ubikele ibandla ukuthi ushiye kukhona imali engakanani esikhwameni sebandla, uchaze wenzeni kule minyaka eyisithupha uphethe, uchaze nangezinkontileka zaleli bandla nabathile okubalwa neyoZalo, kodwa alizange likwenze lokho. UNkk Khanyile uvumile ukuthi leli gatsha linezinkinga, wathi umkhandlu awuholayo uhambise uhla lwezikhalo enhlokohhovisi, kodwa kwathiwa abayilandelanga imigomo yokufaka izikhalo.“Namhlanje bekumele sibikele ibandla ukuthi sesihambe sagcina kuphi, sesifika kuvalwe amasango,” kusho yena.USihlalo womkhandlu waseNtuzuma, igatsha laKwaMashu elingaphansi kwaso, uMnuz Thabani Mazibuko, uthe abanalo igunya lokungena bagxile edabeni oselwedluliselwe ezingeni elingaphezulu kwabo, njengoba selubikwe kumphathi wesifunda saseThekwini. Uthe udaba lokungeneliseki kwamanye amalungu ebandla lwadingidwa umkhandlu omusha ngoMeyi asibanga khona isisombululo base bethumela amaminithi alowo mhlangano kwisekethe (eThekwini).Uthe bezwile ukuthi kube nokuphazamiseka kwenkonzo ekuseni, okuyinto ebashaqisile nabo.E-Apostolic Faith Mission, KwaC, KwaMashu ebuye yaziwe ngeMaranatha nakhona amalungu aleli bandla abegcwele ngaphandle, amasango ekhiywe yingxenye yamakholwa aleli bandla abebhikisha ethi umfundisi wawo akayindawo.Abesho kanjena nje ngoba isifunda saleli bandla saseThekwini besizobikela amakholwa ukuthi umfundisi waleli gatsha uzogcina ezinyangeni ezimbili ngoba utholakale enamacala okwephula imithetho yebandla.Abahambisana noPastor Simon Mdletshe bebethi uboshelwe amanqina enyathi wethweswa amacala osekuthiwa utholakale enecala kuwo.Ngaphandle kwesango amakholwa abehlukene kabili amanye ethi akahambe, amanye ethi akayindawo.UPastor Tyrone Goliath wesifunda saseThekwini uthe uMdletshe ubephenywa ngamacala yinhlokohhovisi, okukhona kuwo awokusebenzisa budlabha imali, ukuhlanganisa igatsha laKwaMashu nelaseNanda wakha igatsha elilodwa elaziwa ngeMaranatha engayitholanga imvume kwabamphethe.Uqhube wathi uMdletshe wawavuma amacala ayebekwe wona. Kusukela izolo uthe leli gatsha lizolawulwa yisifunda, uma esehambile kuzolethwa umfundisi omusha. Lezi zindaba zimenyezelwe ngombhobho khona ngaphandle kwesonto.

USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waseLovu emuva kokuboshwa komthandazi ophinde abe yinyanga (42) osolwa ngokudlwengula indodakazi yakhe (19) nokusolakala ukuthi uyikhulelisile.Lo mlisa obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNsimbini izolo kuthiwa uboshwe ngeSonto ebusuku emuva kokuthi evulelwe icala yindodakazi yakhe okuthiwa ubeyidlwengula ephindelela. Indodakazi yakhe eyenza uGrade 11 kukholakala ukuthi seyinezinyanga ezintathu ikhulelwe, akukaziwa ukuthi ubani oyikhulelisile phakathi kwakhe nesoka layo abeyiphoqa ukuthi iyolala nalo njalo uma eseyidlwengulile.Unina wale ngane (38) esalaliswe esibhedlela esingadalulwanga njengoba iselashwa nobengahlali nayo njengoba ahlukana noyise isencane uthe uthole ngeSonto ngokudlwengulwa kwayo.“Ngithole * -call back obuvela kwindodakazi yami ngeSonto ekuseni ngayifonela yase idlulisela ucingo komunye umuntu ongitshele ukuthi ngize ngizoyilanda esiteshini samaphoyisa ngokushesha. Ngize ngakwazi ukufika ebusuku ngoba bengisuka kude. Kuthe uma sengisendleleni ngaphinde ngashaya ucingo ngazama ukuthola ukuthi ikuphi yangitshela ukuthi isesibhedlela. Ngishaywe uvalo ngathi ayingitshele ukuthi kwenzekeni ngoba bebelokhu bengasho ngesikhathi beqala ukungifonela. Ibe seyingitshela ukuthi uyise ubeyidlwengula,” kusho unina wale ngane.Uthe ngesikhathi bebonana nendodakazi yakhe imbikele ukuthi uyise ubeyidlwengula bese eyisabisa ngokuthi uzoyithumelela ngezulu.Ubethi uma eseyidlwengulile bese ethi ayiyolala nesoka layo ngenkani ukuze kuthi noma ikhulelwa kube sengathi yilona.Uthe ingane yakhe itshele umngani wayo ukuthi uyise uyayidlwengula base beya kovula icala ngeSonto ekuseni emuva kokuthi egcine ukuyidlwengula ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.“Namanje ikhanda lami lisaphithene ngoba bengingazitsheli ukuthi kunento efana nalena eyenzekayo. Uyise wafika wazomthatha ekhaya ngo-2016. Bekungathi bahleli kahle kodwa kwathi uma ivakasha ngoJuni kulo nyaka ngabona sengathi kukhona okungamphethe kahle. Ngesikhathi ngimbuza uthe ukhathele ngoba ufunda kakhulu. Uthe uqale ukumdlwengula ngoMashi wathi wayesaba ukusho ngoba ubemsabisa,” kusho unina wale ngane.Uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi ugogo wengane ozala uyise uyamfonela amthuke njengoba eboshiwe. Unina wengane uthe ingane ithe ifisa sengathi uyise angayitholi ibheyili ngoba izibona ingaphephile uma engaphumela ngaphandle.Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uthe umphakathi wakule ndawo usashaqekile mayelana nokuvela kwezinsolo zokudlwengula ezibekwe lo mthandazi okuthiwa ubehlonishwa endaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo mlisa uboshiwe nokuthi uvele enkantolo ngoLwesibili.Kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa aphindele enkantolo ngoLwesithathu oluzayo ukuze afake isicelo sebheyili.

INYUKE ngokusemthethweni imali yokugibela amatekisi izolo emuva kokuthi iSouth African National Taxi Council (Santaco) imemezele ngokusemthethweni ukuthi izindleko zokusebenza nokukhuphuka umlibe kukaphethroli, kuphoqe abanikazi bamatekisi ukuthi bayinyuse.UMengameli weSantaco uMnuz Phillip Taaibosch, uthe amatekisi azonyuka ngoR1 emabangeni aseduze bese kuthi lawo ahambela ezindaweni ezikude anyuke ngoR10 noR20.“Izindleko zokusebenza yizona ezenza sinyuse imali yokugibela. Kusukela ngoJanuwari wonyaka odlule kuze kube yimanje uphethroli usunyuke ngo-130%. Uma kunyuka ilitha kusho ukuthi nentela kaphethroli iyanyuka.Sinqume ukunyusa imali kaphethroli kusukela manje (Agasti 1) kuze kube wuJuni wonyaka ozayo,” kusho uTaaibosch.Ucele uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi eze nezindlela zokwehlisa umthwalo emahlombe osomatekisi nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.Uyichithile imibiko ethi osomatekisi abangaphansi kweSantaco bebesemashini yokuthi kwehle uphethroli ngoLwesibili.Uthe bazomemezela uma sebemasha kwazise kuma yonke into uma kuteleke iSantaco.UMnuz Bhekisisa Nzuza okhulumela iNational Taxi Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, uvumile ukuthi imali yokugibela amatekisi izonyuka ngenxa yezindleko zomsebenzi.“Siyazwelana kakhulu nabagibeli ngoba iningi labo alisebenzi futhi uma lisebenza linezindleko eziningi kodwa-ke izindleko zomsebenzi wamatekisi nokunyuka kukaphethroli yikona okwenza kunyuke imali yokugibela.Sikhokha imali enkulu uma sithenga izinsimbi zezimoto njengoba intela inyuswe yasuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%.Siphinde sikhokhe intela uma sithenga amathayi, izindleko zingaphezu kwamandla ethu yingakho imali yokugibela inyuka,” kusho uNzuza.

UHLA LELWE wumsebenzi onzima uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa njengoba yonke iminyakazo yakhe yokuqoka uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi izoqashwa ngeso lokhozi.Izazi zomthetho zisho lokhu emuva kokuthi iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga linqume ukuthi ukuqokwa kuka-Adv Shaun Abrahams akukho emthethweni ngoba wangena esikhundleni sika-Adv Mxolisi Oliver Nxasana owaxoshwa ngaphandle kokulandela uMthethosisekelo.IJaji Madlanga lithe u-Abrahams kufanele akhokhe izindleko zecala zabameli bakhe ababili bese uhulumeni ekhokha zonke izindleko zecala.Uyalele uNxasana ukuthi akhokhe uR10.3 million (R10 240 767.47) kuR17.3 million akhokhelwa wona ngesikhathi exoshwa. Uphinde wayalela uRamaphosa ukuthi aqoke uMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-90.Uthe zonke izinqumo ezithathwe ngu-Abrahams zisemthethweni.USolwazi Pierre De Vos oyisazi soMthethosisekelo esifundisa ezomthetho eNyuvesi yaseCape Town, uthe Ramaphosa kufanele aqoke umuntu ozophatha ezokushushiswa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi esabheka umuntu ofanelwe yilesi sikhundla.“Wonke amehlo azothi njo kuRamaphosa njengoba kufanele aqoke umuntu onesibindi, onesimilo futhi ongahambisani nenhlangano ethile yepolitiki futhi ongahambisana nosomabhizinisi abathile.“Kufanele kube wumuntu ozobeka izidingo zezwe ngoba uma ehambisana nepolitiki uzocabangela inhlangano yakhe futhi uma ehambisana nosomabhizinisi uzocabangela bona angabheki izidingo zesizwe,” kusho uDe Vos.Uthe njengoba ijaji lithe izinqumo zika-Abrahams ngeke zishintshe kusho ukuthi abanamacala ezinkantolo bazoqhubeka nawo kuze kuba yizona ezinquma ukuthi ayabalahla noma ayabathetha.UMnuz Lawson Naidoo weCouncil for Adavancement of the South African Constitution uthe bayasijabulela isinqumo senkantolo yize sifike sekwenzeke umonakalo omkhulu.“Isinqumo senkantolo sizobuyisa uzinzo kwezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika futhi siyasamukela. Sizoqapha ngeso lokhozi ukuthi zonke iziphakamiso zenkantolo ziyenzeka,” kusho uNaidoo.Phakathi kwezinye izinhlangano ebezifake udaba luka-Abrahams enkantolo kubalwa iCorruption Watch neFreedom Under Law.UMnuz David Lewis onguMqondisi weCorruption Watch, uthe inkantolo ithathe isinqumo esifanele ngoba umthetho ubusufile eNingizimu Afrika.“Silindele ukuthi kuqokwe umuntu onesibindi, ongeke asabe ukushushisa izephulamthetho noma ngabe zikuhulumeni. Asifuni umuntu ohambisana nepolitiki noma othanda imali,” kusho uLewis.UNxasana uthe akanankinga nokukhokha uR10.3 million futhi uzolandela okushiwo yinkantolo kodwa uyajabula ukuthi akalahlwanga yicala.

source: abahlaziyi babona i anc igaya amavoti ngolomhlaba
text: ABAHLAZIYI bepolitiki bathi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa uzama ukugaya amavoti njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, ngokusheshisa udaba lokuguqula isigatshana u25 soMthethosisekelo othinta udaba lo mhlaba.NgoLwesibili ebusuku uRamaphosa uvele kuSABC ememezela ukuthi i-ANC izovotela ukuthi kuchitshiyelwe lesi sigaba 25 soMthethosisekelo ukuze ithathe umhlaba wabantu abazimele ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo iwunike abawuswele.“Kuyasicacela sonke ukuthi abantu bakithi bafuna umthethosisekelo ucacise udaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Lokhu sikubone kwizithangami zodaba lomhlaba ezenzeka kuzwelonke,” kusho uRamaphosa.Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe kusobala ukuthi uRamaphosa useqala ukukhankasa ngoba udaba lo mhlaba yilona olunyakazisa abantu kuwo wonke amazinga.“I-ANC isiyaxhamazela, ithatha umkhankaso we-EFF ibe ingazi ukuthi izowenza kanjani. Ayilwenzanga ucwaningo ebantwini, emakhosini nakuzo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo. URamaphosa wenze isimemezelo yize izithangami zodaba lomhlaba zisaqhubeka, lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi akanazo izinhlelo ezicacile,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe okokuqala i-ANC yayinohlelo lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngesinxephezelo, engakaze yenze umbiko ngalo, isho nokuthi yimaphi amaphutha enzekile.Omunye umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Bukani Mngoma uthe kungenzeka ukuthi uRamaphosa ukhulume ngodaba lomhlaba ngoba efuna ukususa amehlo abantu kwi-EFF ebeyigubha iminyaka emihlanu yasungulwa futhi ikhuluma ngodaba lomhlaba.“Kungenzeka ukuthi ufuna ukukhombisa abanye kwi-ANC ukuthi ulusukumele phezulu udaba lo mhlaba ngoba beluvamise ukukhulunywa ngabantu akade beseka uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma. Asingakhohlwa nokuthi sekusondele ukhetho futhi udaba lomhlaba yilona oluhamba phambili naye useqalile ukugaya ivoti,” kusho uMngoma.Uthe inkulumo kaRamaphosa izodida abatshalizimali ngoba abasaqondi ukuthi uhulumeni umiphi odabeni lomhlaba nokuthi uma sewuwuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo imali yabo izophepha kangakanani.UKhumalo uthe abatshalizimali bazoba manqika ukuthi bafake imali yabo emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngoba abazi ukuthi iphephe kangakanani.UMnuz Omri van Zyl ongoMqondisi we-AgriSA uthe uRamaphosa nesigungu esiphezulu bekufanele balinde imibono yabantu ngaphambi kokwenza isimemezelo.“Ukuchitshiyelwa kwesigaba esithile somthethosisekelo kusho ukuthi usengcupheni wonke umthethosisekelo. Kuzoba nomthelela omubi emnothweni wethu lokhu,” kusho uVan Zyl.Umholi weDA uMnuz Mmusi Maimane usole uRamaphosa ngokungahleleki nokungakhathaleli izwe.“URamaphosa usitshela ukuthi imibono yabantu ngeke bayilalele ngoba sebezokwenza intando yabo beyi-ANC. Sizolwisana nale mizamo yabo yokuwisa umnotho wethu nokuthi umhlaba ube sezandleni zikahulumeni okhohlakele,” kusho uMaimane.USotshwebhu we-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Narend Singh uthe abahambisani nokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bazogcina sebehlala emijondolo ngoba uhulumeni ukhohlakele.

KUBULAWE umfowabo wombhali wengosi yocansi kwiSolezwe ngoMgqibelo, odutshulwe abantu abangaziwa washona nesihlobo sakhe entathakusa izolo eSigqumeni, KwaSwayimane.UMnuz Gceno Gumede (41) noMnuz Thobani Gumede (25), bahlaselwe abantu bavulela ngenhlamvu behamba nabafana bendawo ngemoto ngezithuba zabo-3 ekuseni izolo. Kuthiwa bebeyovula amamitha amanzi endaweni. Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa kulimale kanzima abanye abathathu abanye bathola imihuzuko.UGceno ungumfowabo omdala kaNksz Distance Gumede ongumbhali wengosi esihloko esithi Elawini likaMaGumede.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe kuvulwe amacala amabili okubulala namathathu okuzama ukubulala kodwa bekungakaboshwa muntu.Umfowabo kaMaGumede kuthiwa ubulawa nje bebezokwenza umcimbi wokuhlambuluka womfowabo omncane izolo, uBusani Gumede, oshone ngokugwazwa ngenyanga edlule.

MHLELI: Njalo ngoJulayi singamadoda aziphatha kahle siyabikelwa ngoba amadoda agxekwa ngapha nangapha. Amadoda angabadlwenguli, amadoda awondli, amadoda ahlukumeza abesifazane, kuze kube nemashi emashela ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.Mhleli kuliqiniso ukuthi kukhona amadoda ahlukumeza abesifazane nezingane. Kuliqiniso futhi ukuthi kukhona amadoda amahle akholwayo njengami nje. Kuliqiniso ukuthi bakhona nabesifazane abahlukumeza amadoda; isibonelo abesifazane abondlisa abesilisa izingane okungezona ezabo. Bakhona abesifazane abazala izingane bazilahle emgqonyeni kadoti. Bakhona abesifazane abathelela amadoda ngeHIV ngamabomu. Bakhona abesifazane ababhanqa amadoda bewakhwahle imali.Uma kuziwa emadodeni kuphakanyiswa okubi kanti uma kungabantu besimame kuphakanyiswa okuhle, “Wathint' abafazi wathint' imbokodo”. Ngenyanga yabantu abasha (uJuni) kunezinhlelo eziningi ezithuthukisa abasha. Uma kuyinyanga yabesimame kukhona izinhlelo ezithuthukisa abesimame, kube yinyanga yobaba siyagxekwa. Akumele kube njalo ummese awusike nhlangothi zombili kanti amadoda adlani kabani? Uma ufuna ukuthola amathenda kumele kube abasifazane nezingane nabaphila nokukhubazeka. Kanti senzeni singamadoda?Bhekisisa Khumalo.KwaMashu

OWAYEYIPHINI likaNgqongqoshe emnyangweni wezimali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, noNksz Vytjie Mentor, owayeyilungu lePhalamende emele i-ANC, bangabokuqala abazothula ubufakazi kwikhomishini eholwa yijaji uRaymond Zondo ephenya ngezinsolo zokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.Kulindeleke ukuthi bafakaze mayelana nezinsolo zokuthi umndeni wakwaGupta wawunezwi uma kuqokwa ongqongqoshe nabazophatha izinkampani zikahulumeni ngesikhathi uMnuz Jacob Zuma esengumengameli wezwe.Izolo iphephandaba lesiNgisi langeSonto libike ukuthi ikhomishini ibize uZuma ukuthi azofakaza uma kuqala izigcawu namhlanje.Phakathi kwabanye abantu okulindeleke ukuthi bafakaze kubalwa uMnuz Willie Mathebula, osebenza emnyangweni womgcinimafa, owayeyinhloko yezokuxhumana kuhulumeni, uMnuz Themba Maseko, nokhulumela uhulumeni uNksz Phumla Williams.Izolo iSACP ithe inethemba lokuthi kuningi okuzovela kwikhomishini yathi labo abathintekayo kumele baboshwe.“Labo abazojaha ukusula ukuze bangashushiswa kumele bangavunyelwa, bonke kumele baboshwe. Kumele kukhucululwe inkohlakalo.”I-SACP ithi iyabeseka labo abazofakaza abanye bebeka impilo yabo engcupheni.

UKUBOSHWA kukaMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu owayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nezokuVakasha KwaZulu-Natal, okube undabamlonyeni kuleli sonto kushiye abaningi bekhexile bezibuza imibuzo eminingi.UMabuyakhulu ungena kuleli hlazo nje ubesanda kuqokwa esikhundleni sokuba umgqugquzeli ohlakeni lwesikhashana lobuholi be-ANC esifundazweni. Ukuboshwa kwakhe kumayelana nomkhonyovu wemali enguR28 million okuthiwa yabhubhudlwa njengamanzi.Le mali kwakufanele yenze umcimbi iNorth Sea Jazz Festival phakathi kuka-2012 no-2013. UMabuyakhulu ukhishwe ngebheyili kaR50 000. Ubhekene namacala okukhwabanisa, inkohlakalo, ukweba nokushintshisana ngemali ngokungekho emthethweni.Ukugqama kukaMabuyakhulu kuleli cala sekwenze abaningi bakhohlwa ukuthi kunenqwaba yabantu aboshwe nabo nabanye okuthiwa bangase baboshwe maduze.Empeleni bangu-16 abasavela emaphepheni asenkantolo. Umbuzo osalayo uthi bangobani laba banye abasolwa njengoba uMabuyakhulu engummangalelwa weshumi nesithupha ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo.Ummangalelwa wokuqala uMnuz Desmond Golding owayeyiNhloko yoMnyango owawuphethwe uMabuyakhulu ngesikhathi somkhonyovu. UGolding isikhundla sakhe sasimnika amandla okukhipha izizumbulu zemali njengoba wayeyinhloko yomnyango.UGolding uke waba yisikhulu esiphezulu seRegional Tourism Organisation of Southern Africa (RETOSA). Ezinye izikhundla aziphathile ngesokuba nguMqondisi weCredit Policy and Risk Governance eStandard Bank nomeluleki kaNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo kuzwelonke. Ubephinde ahlale kwibhodi yaseSABC. UGolding useqhulwini kwabathweswe amacala.Ummangalelwa wesibili uMnuz Ceaser Walter ‘Maqhoboza’ Mkhize (39) oyisikhulu sezinkampani iSoft Skills Communication 100CC, Shaka Holdings neMaqhoboza Traders CC. UMkhize ubuye avele njengommangalelwa wesithathu, owesine nowesihlanu ngenxa yezinkampani eziningi. Ungumuntu owaziwayo ngomswenko izimoto eziphambili nemicimbi eThekwini. UZandile Nonjabulo Mbongwe uvela njengommangalelwa wesihlanu obesebenzisana noMkhize emabhizinisini akhe, bashadile.Ummangalelwa wesikhombisa ophinde avele njengowesi-9 uNothando ‘Mamgo’ Zungu oke waba umsakazi weGagasi FM. Lo msolwa wazakhela igama ethula uhlelo iKiss and Make Up olwalusiza izithandani nemindeni exabene ukuba bathelelane amanzi. Waphinda wayingxenye yohlelo i-Alex and The Crew noqweqwe lomsakazi u-Alex Mthiyane. Uphinde abe ngumethuli wezinkulumo ezakhayo nomphathi wohlelo emicimbini esezingeni eliphezulu.UMamgo yena ungene obishini ngenkampani yakhe iShashalazi Productions CC okuthiwa yawathola amantshontsho anonile ngesikhathi kuhlinzwa.Ummangalelwa wesishiyagalolunye uMnuz Mabheleni Ntuli ongusomabhizinisi odumile eThekwini, ubengomunye kwabavele enkantolo. UNtuli waduma kakhulu eminyakeni edlule ngokuba yimpunyela eba netende emcimbini iVodacom Durban July eba minyaka yonke eGreyville Race Course. Kulo mcimbi kuthiwa uNtuli wayeshiya abaningi bekhexile ngenxa yengqephu ayeyidla nangenxa yemali ayeyichitha ezintweni ezahlukene. UNtuli useke wanukwa yizangoma ehlazweni lokudliwa kwezimali ngomngcwabo kaDkt Nelson Mandela esifundazweni eMpumalanga. Kuthiwa uNtuli wathola uR18 million ngendlela engaqondakali kahle. Kuthiwa usondelene kakhulu noMengameli uJacob Zuma futhi ubenikela esikhwameni iJacob Zuma Foundation.Laba basolwa balindeleke ukuba babuye enkantolo yaseThekwini ngo-Ephreli 8.

OWESIFAZANE wasesigodini eNdluzeleni emaChunwini, eMsinga, uthi uxoshiswe okwenja enethile emzini wakhe, ngesikhathi ezozila njengoba eshonelwe wumyeni.UNkz Zandile Mchunu (42) oshadele kwaNgubane kodwa obiza isibongo sakubo, uthi uxoshwe ngesikhathi eyozilela umnyeni wakhe uMnuz Vusi Ngubane (44) oshone emuva kokuzidubula ngoMsumbuluko emzini wabo. Umkamufi uthi wahamba kwakhe ngoJanuwari nezingane zakhe ezimbili waya eGoli.Uthi wayeyophumuza ikhanda ngoba umufi ubemhlukumeza emshaya ngesibhamu.Uveze ukuthi wamazisa u-anti wakhe wasemzini ngokuhlukumezeka kwakhe kodwa waqhubeka nokumhlukumeza.NgokukaNksz Mchunu, ngesikhathi eyopholisa ikhanda eGoli, wayezitshela ukuthi uzoshintsha umyeni wakhe, azisole kodwa lutho.Eseshonile umyeni wakhe uthi ngoLwesibili yena nodadewabo baya kobona emzini, waxoshwa.Uthi isono sakhe esiholele ekutheni axoshwe, wukuthi uveze iqiniso ngomyeni wakhe ukuthi akazalwa kwaNgubane.“Umyeni wami esaphila wacela ukuthi uma eseshonile akothintwa abantu bakwaMbatha, okuyisibongo sakhe sangempela. Badinwe bagana unwabu abakwaNgubane ngibatshela lokhu, bangixosha.“Iningi labo angilazi, bengiqala ukulibona selokhu ngagana kulo muzi,” kusho uNksz Mchunu.Ukhale nangokuthi usephucwa nendodakazi yakhe endala eyahamba ngonyaka odlule iyofunda uGrade 8 ku-anti wayo.“Ayisangifuni nalapho ngihambe khona. Uma ngiqhamuka iyabaleka, ize yajahwa kodwa yangavuma ukuza kimina.“Asazi nokuthi sizoya kanjani emngcwabeni. Sizibona singaphephile uma siya,” esho ekhihla isililo. UMnuz Lucky Ngubane (68) othe unguyise kamufi, uthe basashaqekile ngalesi sigameko futhi akuvumi ngisho akhulume.Uthe umakoti abamxoshanga kodwa uzihambele ngoba bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi ubekuphi ngesikhathi indodana yakhe izibulala.Uthe yena ubazi ukuthiumufi uganiwe. Umngani kamufi ocele ukuthi angadalulwa, uthe umufi ubehlala ekhala ngokuthi umoya wakhe ukhubekile ngokuhamba kwenkosikazi yakhe.Uthi ubesesaba nokuphumela emphakathini, ebona sengathi abantu bayamhleka futhi nemfuyo yakhe izolahleka njengoba naye engahlali ekhaya ehlala emsebenzini.Uqhube wathi umufi wafika ngoLwesihlanu ecele izinsuku ezimbili emsebenzini.Uthi ngoMgqibelo wazivalela endlini belokhu bemduduza.Wagcina ukuxoxa naye ngeSonto, kwathi ngoMsombuluko ngezikhathi zamadina, wayombheka, wamemeza, wangasabela.Uveze ukuthi wazama ukuvula umnyango wamfica esebanda, enenxeba enhliziyweni negazi selomile, kukhona incwadi eceleni kwakhe, echazayo ukuthi kungani ezibulele.Umndeni wakwaMbatha uthe umufi ubeyindodana yawo, wahlatshelwa nembuzi engeniswa ngokusemthethweni kodwa akukho abangakwenza uma abakwaNgubane bethi bazomngcwaba.Bathe umakoti nguyena ozothatha isinqumo sokuthi uzoqhubeka nasiphi isibongo.

AKUJWAYELEKILE ukuthi abantu abamnyama bakhombise ukuthandana ngisho sebeguga ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi ngabezinye izinhlanga abenza kanjalo.Kuhlukile kuNkk Thandi Ngonelo (65) nomyeni wakhe uMfundisi Eddie Ngonelo (66), abangabeluleki kwezomshado abangofakazi bokuthi uthando alugugi. Bangabaholi be-Act of Obedience Ministries eThekwini kodwa bayaziwa nakwezinye izifundazwe ngomsebenzi wokweluleka.Sixoxe ngokuthandana kwabo emuva kweminyaka ewu-40 beshadile. Bafike behamba ndawonye emotweni kushayela uMfundisi Ngonelo. Wehle ku­qala uNkk Ngonelo nengubo ephuzi, izicathulo ezisagolilde, wabopha ngomchilo ophuzi igoda eliyi-afro.Babukana emehlweni uma bexoxa bencikene.“Akukona ukuthi konke bekuhamba kahle emshadweni wethu. Indlela ebesixabana ngayo, kukaningi sibona ukuthi idivosi isifanele. Akukho nento etheni esasiyibanga kodwa sasibanga ngisho izinto ezincane,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Uthe bahlangana bengakasindiswa kodwa uNkk Ngonelo yena wayevele esonta.UNgonelo uthe enye yezinto ezazibaxabanisa wukuthi wayengafuni umkakhe asonte futhi babehlukene ngokwesikompilo.“Bekuthi njalo uma umkami ezoya esontweni ngimnqabele, aye ngenkani. Bekungicika nokuthi ubenezihlobo eziningi kanti mina ngikhule emndenini omncane. Kuyena bekumnandi ukuvakashelwa yinqwaba yezihlobo ekubeni kanti mina ngifuna sibe naye nezingane kuphela,” kusho uNgonelo.Bathe basizwa wukumenywa kwenye inkonzo yabashadile lapho bafike babona wonke amaphutha abo. Leyo nkonzo yalandelwa enye lapho bazinikela khona basindiswa.“Kuleyo nkonzo kwaba manzi amaduku sikhala. Kwabashadile ababekhona, yithina okwachithwa nathi isikhathi esiningi ngoba kwakonakele,” kusho uNgonelo.Yize bethe izinselelo aziphelanga emshadweni, bafunda ukubekezelelana nokukhulisana. Yilokhu abathi kuhlula abaningi kulezi zinsuku.“Inkinga wukuthi umuntu uqale ahlanyiswe isiqu somuntu bese egijimela umshado engakalazi ingaphakathi lakhe. Ngeke umthole umuntu ongenasici kodwa kumele uqale uzilungise wena. Kunezinto okumele ungazinaki ngoba ngeke uzishintshe. Umshado ukuze uqine kumele ube nezinselelo, ngale kwalokho akuwona umshado. Inkinga wukuthi abantu bajaha ukuphuma emshadweni bengakawazi,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Mayelana nokufundana okwaziwa nge-dating, uNkk Ngonelo uthe akunankinga ngisho kubazalwane. Okubalulekile ukugwema ukuya ocansini. Bebuzwa ngokwenza uthando lwabo lungafi, bavele bahleka babukana.“Engangikwenza ngifika emshadweni namanje ngisakwenza. Ngiyezwana nokuhlanzeka futhi ngiyazibambela ekhishini. Ngino-65 kodwa ngizizwa ngimusha kunalokho,” kusho uNkk Ngonelo.Banezingane ezintathu nabazukulu abayisithupha.Ezinye izeluleko zabo:*Musa ukugxeka owakwakho njalo uma kunezinkinga.*Uma usubazi ubuthaka bakhe, zama ukumsiza.*Ngeke umshintshe umuntu kodwa funda ukumbekezelela.*Hlala umuhle njengoba wawunjalo ningakashadi.*Thoba ekhaya ukhohlwe isikhundla onaso emsebenzini nasemphakathini.*Khumbulani ukuthi kunabantu ababukela kinina abafunda umshado wenu.*Ningazami impilo eniyibona kuthelevishini.*Ungasatshiswa wukuphumelela kowakwakho kodwa yazi ukuthi uphakamisa nelakho igama.

ZISABISA ngokuphinda zivale umgwaqo kusasa izitshudeni zase-University of South Africa (UNISA), eThekwini uma zingayitholi incazelo ecacile mayelana nokuxhaswa kwazo yisikhwama sezimali iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme, iNSFAS.Lezi zitshudeni zikusho lokhu ngesikhathi zizokweseka ozakwabo oSamukelisiwe Ndlovu, Nompumelelo Nduli noMlekeleli Shandu abebevele enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini izolo ngecala lokususa udlame emphakathini.Izitshudeni ziphume ngebheyili kaR500 umuntu emunye.UXolo Magutshwe, uMengameli weSASCO kule nyuvesi uthe ukuboshwa kwalazi zitshudeni kungenye yezindlela zamaphoyisa zokubasabisa ukuthi zingaqhubeki nokulwela imfundo yamahhala ezithenjisiwe.Omunye wezitshudeni ongathandanga ukudalulwa, obeyingxenye yabebezokweseka ababoshiwe uthe: “Amaphoyisa ehluleka izigebengu zigwaze isitshudeni amanxeba awu-10. Lesi sitshudeni sisesimeni esibucayi esibhedlela. Azobopha abantu abalwela imfundo? Ngeke siyeke ukulwela ilungelo lethu lokufunda, uma izikhulu zakwaNSFAS zingacacisi ukuthi sizokhokhelwa nini. Sizovala umgwaqo omkhulu eThekwini uWest Street (Dkt Pixley kaSeme). Sifuna imfundo yamahhala esithenjiswe yona. Njengamanje asibhalisiwe silinde wona uNSFAS esingazi ukuthi kungani ungasikhokheli.Izitshudeni ziboshwe ngoLwesibili ngesikhathi zibhikishela ukuthi lesi sikhwama asikhokhile okwenza ukuthi zingabhaliswa.Lesi sikhungo sivaliwe, sizovulwa kusasa njengoba kuzoba nomhlangano nezikhulu zakwaNSFAS nezitshudeni, ozocacisa ngokukhokhelwa kwazo.IMantshi elingatholakalanga igama layo ithe akwamukelekile ukuthi uma izitshudeni zinezikhalo ngento ethile bese zivala imigwaqo.“Ukulwa nabantu bomthetho kuyicala elibi futhi izehlakalo ezinjengalesi sezivamisile. Ngenxa yalokhu ngizonishaya ngoswazi oluncane ngebheyili kaR500.”

UMHOLI weDA KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango uthi iqembu labo lizimisele ngokuheha intsha njengoba lisemkhankasweni wokwehlisa amandla kaKhongolose abe ngaphansi kuka-50%, okhethweni lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo.Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uMncwango uthe sebejube uNksz Mbali Ntuli ukuthi kube nguyena iNhloko yezemikhankaso eqenjini ngenhloso yokufeza iphupho labo lokudonsa ivoti labantu abasha.“Iqiniso lithi iningi lentsha lintula amathuba emisebenzi futhi abantu abasha abavoti ngokuthi obani ababesemzabalazweni, bavota ngokuthi ubathembisani,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe bayathemba ukuthi uNksz Ntuli uzowenza ngempumelelo umsebeni wakhe.“UNksz Ntuli ungumholi owaziwayo oseke waba yikhansela waphinde wahola intsha yeqembu, ukubeka yena kulesi sikhundla sokuhola imikhankaso kuzoyisiza kakhulu inhlangano,” kusho uMncwango.UNksz Ntuli obeyilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal wesulile khona njengoba esenikwe lo msebenzi omusha.Kumanje iqembu limatasa nohlelo lokuvala isikhala sakhe.UMncwango uthe basazobona ukuthi isikhala sikaNksz Ntuli basivala ngobani.UMncwango akazange afune ukuphumela obala ukuthi uzoya yini esiShayamthetho njengoba kulindelekile kulandela ukuthi uphinde wakhethwe kabusha njengomholi wenhlangano esifundazweni.“Uma unguSihlalo weqembu esifundazweni, lokho kukwenza ukuthi kube nguwena ophambili ohlwini lwamagama, kulele kumina ukuthi nginqume ukuthi ngiyaya yini esiShayamthetho noma ngiqhubeka nokuhlala eThekwini kodwa isinqumo engizosithatha sizobe sincike ekutheni ikuphi okuzosiza inhlangano,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe ngemuva kwengqungquthela ka-2015, unqume ukuthi angayi esiShayamthetho ngoba kade efuna ukulungisa isimo saseThekwini aphinde akhulise neqembu khona.“Ngicabanga ukuthi ngikwazile ukukhulisa iqembu eThekwini ngaphinde ngakwazi ukudala uzinzo enhlanganweni eThekwini nakwisifundazwe, uma kwenzeka ngihamba eThekwini anginalo uvalo ngabaholi engingabashiya khona,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni ngonyaka ozayo bazophinde bagxile nakubafundi basemanyuvesi ngenhloso yokunxenxa amavoti abo.“Sifuna ukunxenxa amavolontiya amaningi avela emphakathini ehlukene, emakhaya nasemadolobheni,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe sebesungule umkhankaso weVukuzakhe ngenhloso yokusiza intsha entula imisebenzi.“Siphezu komkhankaso iSakh’ingomso ozogxila ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ozobe ubhekelele ngqo ukusiza abafundi ezinkingeni zabo ozoba uholwa inhlangano yethu yabafundi iDemocratic Alliance Student Organisation (Daso),” kusho uMncwango.UNksz Ntuli uthe uzizwa ethobekile ngokuthenjwa iqembu ukuthi limnike umsebenzi obaluleke kangaka wokuhola imikhankaso yeqembu.“Ngizimisele ngokuthi lo msebenzi ngiwenze ngempumelelo ukuze ngingabaphoxi abaholi bami,” kusho uNksz Ntuli.

Sike sizibuze yini umbuzo othi; yini lena entshontsha abantu abaningi bakithi, futhi bashona ngendlela ecishe ifane? Abantu abaningi abashona kungazelele muntu. Kwabaningi esingike ngababona ukudlula kwabo emhlabeni kujikeleza ekuphundulukeni ukusebenza kwenhliziyo uqobo nasekuqhugeleni kwezinye izitho zomzimba ezishesha zizwele enhliziyweni ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwazo nenhliziyo, kuhlanganisa nomzimba wonke nje.Abantu bakithi bahamba emhlabeni beqale bakhale ngovalo olushaya kugubhuzele isifuba, kuphele amandla, iphika nokucinana kuthi ngilapha. Umuntu ahefuzele aze ashone. Lolu valo kwabaningi lusuke lukade lwaqala ukuhlupha kwesinye isikhathi kuze kuphele amandla.Impendulo abantu abayithandayo eyokuthi baye baphuza amanzi bese bethi kuye kwehla kwathi ‘gidi’ emuva kwalokhu.Namhlanje ngicela sikhulume ngalolu valo olungaqala kancane kancane okanye luqale lukusheshise luze lukugojele.Uvalo wumuzwa wokuzizwa ingathi inhliziyo ishaya ngokushesha nangamandla ngokungejwayelekile. Kwesinye isikhathi kuze kube ngathi isifuba lesi siyanyakaza ngenxa yesigqi esizwakala kusona. Lo muzwa wokushesha namandla enhliziyo kuhambisana nesiyezi, umzimba uphelelwe ngamandla, iphika, ukujuluka, umzimba oqhaqhazelayo, ukuqumbelana, ukungakwazi ukulala nekhanda elibuhlungu.Lezi zimpawu akuphoqelekile ukuthi zibe khona zonke ngesikhathi isisodwa. Isikhathi esiningi abantu abafika benalolu valo basitshela ukuthi kade babelubika emitholampilo, ezibhedlela nakodokotela babo kodwa benganakwa ngaphandle ngokutshelwa ukuthi banengcindezi emqondweni. Ziningi izinto ezingabangela umuzwa wovalo; okubalulekile ukwenza umehluko phakathi kovalo oluphelayo noyaziyo imbangela yalo nalolu valo olungafuni ukuphela nembangela ingalandeleki.Kulezi zinsuku zimbili izimbangela engizibonayo zovalo oluyingozi futhi okugcina kuhambe imiphefumulo yabaningi.Okokuqala wuvalo lapho kukhona ukucinana kubenzima ukuphefumula, kuphele amandla. Lapha siyaye sithole ukuthi inhliziyo ishaya kakhulu ngokwedlulele. Inhliziyo eshaya igcina ingakwazi ukukhipha igazi elanele elidingwa wumzimba. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni amandla aphele emzimbeni kube nzima ukuphefumula. Uma umuntu onjengalona umfaka kumshini wenhliziyo okuthiwa yi-ECG uyaye uthole ukuthi inhliziyo isishaya ngokungalawuleki futhi isiphumile esipolweni okumele ihambe kuso. Ezinye zezimbangela lapha kuba yi-Atrial fibrillation ne-Atrial flutter.Lezi yizimo lapho inhliziyo isiphunduleke kakhulu kule ndawo okumele iqale kuyo ukushaya. Ivele ijikeleze kuhle kwesikhwishikazane, ishaye uzungezane ogcina uletha uvalo namandla aphele emzimbeni. Akugcini lapho, abanye bavele baquleke, bacinane kakhulu. Uma usizo olufanele lungaveli, umuntu wakithi lowo uyasishiya emhlabeni. Lezi zifo esiqeda kuzibala ziba yizimo eziphuthuma kakhulu ukuthi zelashwe. Bakhona abantu abaphila behamba nazo kodwa isimo sabo sihlala sibucayi kakhulu. Ukuzelapha kudinga amaphilisi, imijovo nemishini ethile eyisipesheli ekwazi ukuguqula inhliziyo ebisinhlanhlatha ibuyele kundalashe ishaye ngendlela.Enye imbangela enkulu yovalo olungapheli kuba yindlala ehlala lapha emphinjeni eduze kwegilo okuthiwa yiThyroid. Le ndlala iyakwazi ukukhukhumala ibe nomkhuhlane wayo oyisipesheli okanye ivele igcwale izishizi shizi ezigcina zidale ukukhiqiza okukhulu kwamakhemikhali agcina ebange ukugula noma abe ngumdlavuza.Kulezi zinsuku ngibona abaningi abesifazane abanalesi sifo, bafika bekhala kakhulu ngokuncipha emzimbeni, inhliziyo ishaya kakhulu, beshaywa yuvalo, bevevezela, bengakuthandi ukudla. Kokunye umfutho wenhliziyo uba phezulu, ikhanda libe buhlungu baze baphelelwe ngamandla.Kwabanye kuba nokugcwalelana lapha emqaleni, kungagwinyeki kahle. Kuba sengathi kukhona okuthi ngqi lapha emphinjeni kwabanye kuze kuvuvukale nobuso. Abanalesi sifo uyaye uthole nokuthi abayi kahle esikhathini njengokwejwayelekile. Imbangela yaso enkulu kuba ngumzimba ovele ukhiqize amakhemikhali alwa nale ndlala kuwo umzimba. Kwesinye isikhathi igcina ivuvukele indlala ibe yisigaxa lapha entanyeni namehlo kube sengathi ayavuvukala aphumele ngaphandle.Lesi sifo sihlupha ngokudlulele uma vele lowo ogulayo enanesifo senhliziyo. Okubalulekile ukusibamba bese uselapha ngendlela eqondene naso.Kusukumele ukuba novalo olungapheli nolungalandaleki imvelaphi yalo. Udokotela wakho uyokwazi ukukuhlaziyela imbangela yalo ukuze welapheke ngendlela eshaya emhloleni neqondile.Mpilonhle mpilonde!

ILUNGU lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC uMnuz Bheki Cele, likhwele ladikila kuNobhala-jikelele kaKhongolose uMnuz Ace Magashule lathi ubulala umbutho ngalezi zinkulumo alokhu ezenza esidlangalaleni.Ekhuluma emgubhweni weminyaka engu-106, i-ANC yasungulwa enkundleni yezemidlalo eLakeside Sport Ground, eVryheid izolo, uCele uthe sebembonile ukuthi uMagashule usemkhankasweni wokucekela phansi uKhongolose.“Awukwazi ungumholi we-ANC uthi ubuholi obukhona nawe oyingxenye yabo uthi buzoba khona iminyaka emihlanu, ngemuva kwalokho inhlangano izobuyela ezandleni ezifanele,” kusho uCele.Uthe phezu kokuthi uMagashule ethi ubuholi bukaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa buzophela ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu, uyaqhubeka uyabhuqa uthi abantu abangathengi kwaMcDonalds ngoba bazokhuluphala.Emcimbini wokubungaza i-ANC obuseMgungundlovu, uMagashule wanxusa amalungu enhlangano ukuba aseke uMengameli Jacob Zuma, wathi ubuholi obukhona buzohlala iminyaka emihlanu bese buyaphuma.“Uthi akungathengwa kwaMcDonalds ngoba uyazi ukuthi uphethwe uRamaphosa. Uma ethi abantu bazokhuluphala abadle ukudla okunempilo, yena ukwaze kwanjani ukuntshontsha imali yabantu abampofu * -R30 million wayowunika umndeni wakwaGupta, washada ngayo?”Uthe bafuna ukwazi ukuthi iziphi lezi zandla ezifanele uMagashule akhuluma ngazo.“Isikhathi sabadayisi sesaphela, ngeke sithule abantu bekhuluma umathanda ngenhlangano, sifuna ukwazi ukuthi kazi uMagashule usebenzela bani njengoba kade sihlangene siyisigungu esiphezulu i-NEC kwathiwa wonke umuntu akazethule, yena wathi wethulwa yi-ANC emndenini wakwaGupta."Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi uMagashule ubika kubani ngoba sizolokhu sicabanga ukuthi izwe siliphethe kanti kade ladayiswa,” kusho uCele.UCele uthe uMagashule utshelwe ngubani yena ukuthi kuyophela iminyaka emihlanu esakhona kwi-ANC.UCele uphinde wakhwela wadilika kulabo abahlela imashi ephikisana nokukhishwa kukaZuma esikhundleni.Uthe akangabazi ukuthi labo abahlela le mashi, basebenzisa imali yombuso."Nathi sithi abasimele kancane bayiyeke phansi i-ANC ngoba laba bantu abahlela imashi asibazi, i-ANC kumele iyilungise indaba kamengameli kungaze kumosheke izinto eziningi,” kusho uCele.UCele uthe uzwile ukuthi abakwaGupta banyamelale kulezi zinsuku. Uthe kuzomele babuye bazophendula ngezenzo ezibhekiswe kubo.

SEKUPHELE unyaka engabuyeli emabhukwini abaphilayo owesilisa waseFolweni, owathola ukuthi kubhalwe ukuthi sewashona eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya emuva kokulala ezibhedlela izintathu.UMnuz Zamokwakhe Mthethwa (58), washayiswa yimoto ngo-24 Ephreli 2016 walaliswa esibhedlela, wadedelwa ngoJulayi. Echaza ngengozi eyamehlela uthe wayeshayela iloli, yasha ephakathi. Wayezama ukuphuma ngesikhathi ehlangana nemoto eyamshayisa waqulekela khona lapho. Waze waphaphama emuva kwezinsukwana esibhedlela.“Ngaphuma esibhedlela ngoJulayi kuwona * -2016 ngathi ngiyokhipha imali ebhange ngathola ukuthi i-akhawunti yami yavalwa. Kuthe uma ngilandela ngathola ukuthi yavalwa ngoba ngokwemininingwane yaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya angisekho emhlabeni,” echaza.Isitifiketi sokushona esibhalwe imininingwane kaMthethwa, sikhomba ukuthi washona ngenxa yokugula eMandeni ngoNovemba 29 ku-2016. Uthe uyamangala ukuthi ngabe lo mkhonyovu wenzeke kanjani ngoba wazi ukuthi umazisi wakhe washa neloli. Uveze ukuthi waya emahhovisi omnyango ngoJanuwari 12 wonyaka odlule, wagcwalisa ifomu okuthiwa izosiza ukuthi abuyiselwe emagameni abaphilayo. Usegqigqe kaningi emahhovisi ethola ukuthi namanje akukalungi.“Okungiphatha kabi ukuthi abangichazeli ukuthi ngizolungiselwa nini le nkinga. Banqaba nokuthi ngishaye umazisi omusha, bathi kusamele ngivuswe kwabafileyo kuqala. Ngabhalisa nemali yokulimala emsebenzini, yaze yaphindela emuva ngoba i-akhawunti yami ivaliwe ebhange. Kumanje angikwazi ukuhamba kahle kumele ngabe sengibhalisa impesheni kodwa ngeke ngikwazi ngenxa yale nkinga,” kusho uMthethwa.Akuqali ukuthi iphephandaba lithole imibiko ngabantu abazithola bebhalwe emagameni abangasekho bebe besadla anhlamvana. Isikhathi esiningi laba bantu basuke belahlekelwe ngomazisi. UMnuz Cyril Mncwabe oyiMenenja yoMnyango wezaseKhaya, KwaZulu-Natal uthe kunzima ukusho ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukulungisa udaba olufana nolukaMthethwa ngoba lusuke seludluliselwe ophikweni lwabaphenyi ehhovisi elikhulu“Kuya ngokuthi olunjani uphenyo olwenziwayo kodwa ngokwesifundazwe, udaba siludlulisela kwiCounter Corruption Unit ukubheka ukuthi akuthinteki yini abasebenzi bethu,” kusho uMncwabe. Uthe uma kukhona abanye abanale nkinga kumele baye emahhovisi omnyango aseduze ukuze kudluliselwe ophikweni lwabaphenyi.

ULULAMELA esibhedlela umpetha ka-5000m uThabang Mosiako ngemuva kokulimala ekhanda ekade ehlaselwa okusolakala ukuthi kungenxa yokucwaswa ngokwebala.Lokhu kuthiwa kwenzeke ePotchefstroom, eNorth West, ngesonto eledlule. Umbiko okhishwe yiPotchefstroom Herald ngempelasonto uveze ukuthi uMosiako ukhahlelwe kanzima ekhanda wagaklazwa phansi yiqeqebana labamhlophe elilinganeselwa ku-10 eNorth West University.UMosiako (22) waphaphama esesesibhedlela ngelanga kwenzeka lokhu (Febhuwari 4). Ngesikhathi kwenzeka wayenabangani bakhe uRantso Mokopane noSandy Londt nabo okuvela ukuthi bahlaselwa. UMokopane ungumpetha wakuleli we-3000m steeplechace kanti nguyena oveze lokhu ekhasini lakhe leFacebook.“Okwesine sihlaselwa endaweni esondelene neNWU lapho uzakwethu esiziqeqesha naye elinyazwe kanzima ekhanda okungenzeka kumenze aphathwe yikhanda impilo yakhe yonke. Ngihlezi ngigwema izinto eziphathelene nebala kodwa kuzona zonke izehlo ezine kuhlezi kungamadoda amhlophe alimaza abamnyama ngaphandle kokuthathelwa izinyathelo. Kungiphatha kabi ukuthi ngisho amaphoyisa nabezokuphepha bayahluleka ukusivikela uma sidinga usizo #Cry_Our_Beloved_Country,” kubhala uMokopane.Uthe indaba iqale eNews Cape ePotschefstroom ngesikhathi abafundi bethuka umsebenzi wasethilini. “Ngingenelile ngabacela ukuthi bayeke ukuthuka lowa sisi. Uma sengiya ngaphandle iqeqebana elilinganiselwa ku-10 elinemizimba eyizidlakela njengabantu be-rugby lisihlaselile. Amaphoyisa afikile ayimisa impi kodwa aqonde thina asishaya engathi yithina ebesisephutheni. Sizizwe sibukeleke phansi. Sibalekile. Endleleni sibone enye imoto yamaphoyisa sacela ukuthi asiphelezele siye ngaphakathi esikhungweni ngoba besazi ukuthi abahlaseli basazobuya. Anqabile amaphoyisa. Ngemuva kwemizuzwana baphinde basihlasela kade becashe efokizini elilapho,” kulandisa uMokopane kwiHerald.Uthe abahlaseli bese bebaningi. Ngesikhathi yena nomunye uzakwabo bebaleka babe sebengenele uMosiako.“Bebemkhahlela ekhanda nasemzimbeni ngesikhathi elele phansi. Babalekile sebebona amaphoyisa eza bamshiya ethule phansi okuyilapho ephuthunyiswe khona esibhedlela.”

UZIKHETHELE ukuba agqunywe ejele ngoba enovalo lokuthi uzohlaselwa wumphakathi owesilisa obhekene necala lokudlwengula nokubulala isalukazi esineminyaka ewu-107 eMagwababeni eMpophomeni ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu.UMnuz Sanele Mthethwa (36) izolo uvele enkantolo yaseHowick nalapho etshele khona inkantolo ukuthi ufuna ukuhlanza konke ngokwenzekile kodwa iMantshi uNkk Ntsoaki Khakane yamnqanda yathi kumele athole ummeli kuqala.UMthethwa ubhekene necala lokudlwengula nelokubulala uNkk Girley “Gail” Maphumulo, kwengezwa necala lokugqekeza njengoba kusolwa ukuthi wangena ngewindi ezogila lo mkhuba.UMPHAKATHI waseMpophomeni ububhodla umlilo ngaphandle kwasenkantolo yeMantshi eHowick uthi umfuna ngaphandle osolwa ngokudlwengula abulale isalukazi (107)Umsolwa ngesikhathi ebuzwa ukuthi ukhetha ukusebenzisa yiphi inhlobo yommeli uvele wathi uzozimela yena ngoba ufuna ukusho konke okwenzeka ngelanga lesehlakalo.IMantshi ibe isithetha ithi ayizile ukuzobuza ukuthi kwenzekalani ngelanga lesigameko kodwa ibuza ukuthi ukhetha yiphi inhlobo yommeli, ukuze ezokwazi ukukhuluma konke afuna ukukusho kummeli wakhe.Umsolwa ube eseqoka ukumelwa wummeli woMbuso.Ngesikhathi iMantshi ibuza ngesicelo sebheyili ukuthi uyafuna yini ukusifaka, uvele walandula wathi kungcono ejele kunangaphandle usaba ukwenzakaliswa wumphakathi. IMantshi ibe isilihlehlisela uFebhuwari 9 nonyaka icala.Enkantolo bekugcwele abaholi bomphakathi, abomndeni nomphakathi.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo umphakathi ubuphethe izingqwembe ezigxeka ababulali nabadlwenguli.Lo mphakathi ubukhala ngokusebenza kwesiteshi samaphoyisa saseMpophomeni njengoba kuthiwa umsolwa wake wafika emzini walesi salukazi ngaphambi kokuba sibulawe.Indodana yalesi salukazi, uMnuz Enock Maphumulo (68), ebisenkantolo ithe ukuba amaphoyisa aluphakamela lolu daba mhlawumbe unina ngabe usaphila. “Umsolwa ufike cishe izikhawu ezine ekhaya ebuza umama ukuthi unayo yini indoda nokuthi wake wadlwengulwa yini. Lokhu kwabikwa emaphoyiseni kodwa kwangenziwa lutho. Umama ubemdala engasakwazi ukuzenzela lutho, ubesesizwa njengengane encane. Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuba abulawe ngale ndlela,” kusho uMaphumulo.Lesi salukazi besihlala nabazukulu abafundayo abaneminyaka eko-20.Ngelanga lesigameko omunye umzukulu wayelele kwelinye ikamelo, yena waklinywa waquleka. Kuthiwa umsolwa wabe esedlwengula isalukazi, wasiklinya ngeSonto ebusuku.Ngesikhathi umndeni ungena enkantolo owesifazane ongumzukulu uze wabanjwa ekhihla isililo. Umndeni walo wesifazane uthe ukubulawa kwakhe ngale ndlela kubahlukumeze kakhulu.

ISISHOSHOVU kwezokuvocavoca umzimba esesizakhele igama KwaZulu-Natal namaphethelo siphonsela inselelo bonke abanesifiso sokuncipha kodwa abalokhu behlehlisa ngenxa yobuvila.UThalente Ngcobo, waKwaMashu, ongumnikazi weVipaji Fitness Gym useqalile ngohlelo alubiza ngeNational Transformation Boot Camp athembisa ngalo ukuthi angenza umuntu afinyelele emzimbeni ahlale ephupha ngawo ngezinyanga ezintathu. Nakuba lokhu kuzwakala kulula kodwa uNgcobo uthe lokhu ngeke kwenzeke uma umuntu ezodembesela ngoba ekhaliswa yizinhlungu azozizwa ngesikhathi kusetshenzwa.UNgcobo ukufundele wagogoda ukubheka nokuvocavoca imizimba yabantu ngokwehlukana kwayo. Ngakhoke uthe umuntu noma ngabe uzimuke kangakanani angaxhumana naye ukuze amsize. Uhlelo lwakhe athi uma eluteketisa athi: “lahla amafutha usondelane nomzimba oqoqekile” luqalile lapha eKZN nasePitoli.“Isifiso sethu wukulishumayela leli vangeli lokugada imizimba yethu kuze kube wonke umuntu esifinyelela kuyena wenza izinqumo ezikhaliphile ngomzimba wakhe. Okubalulekile ngezifiso zemizimba wukuthi lowo nalowo azibophezele ekutheni uzokwenza okufanele futhi ngeke abuvumele ubuvila bumbuse. Indaba yokwakha umzimba isekhishini kakhulu hhayi lapho sijimela khona,” usho kanje uNgcobo ngaphambi kokuqala kwale Boot Camp ngoFebhuwari 1.Njengoba kusaqalwa uNgcobo nabaqeqeshi bakhe emagatsheni ehlukene akhele iTheku nelilodwa elisePitoli, basashumayela ivangeli lokugada umuntu akufaka emlonyeni. Uma ubhalisa uthola izikibha ezimbili bese uthathwa isithombe (okuzoqhathaniswa ngaso ekupheleni kwezinyanga ezintathu). Uzohlolwa ukuthi ukulungele yini ukuzivocavoca ukuze kugwenywe ukuthi ulimala sekuphakathi. Uzonikwa indlela ezokulawula ukuthi udla kanjani. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuzivocavoca kuzoba nesidlo esiphelezelwa kakhulu yimikhiqizo yakwaHerbalife. Isikhathi sokuziqeqesha ihora ngosuku.Phakathi kwezindawo ongathola kuzo amagatsha okuziqeqesha singabala iKwaMashu, Newlands West, Bester, Inanda, City Centre (DSW), North Beach, Nhlungwane, KwaMakhutha naseNtuzuma.“Inyanga yesibili neyesithathu kulapho sizobe sesingena sigxila khona ekuziqeqesheni. Leli yithuba lawo wonke umuntu, isilisa noma isifazane, onenkinga yokuncipha nalabo abafuna ukugcina imizimba yabo isesimeni esibagculisayo,” kusonga uNgcobo.Ngemininingwane egcwele nangezimali kungathintwa yena uThalente Ngcobo kuselula ethi: 076 190 2501 noma ku-email ethi:[email protected]

UMNDENI kaMengameli Jacob Zuma ugcine ukhiphe isitatimende ufongqa isigqoko uxolisa emphakathi ngenkulumo kankosikazi wakhe, uNkk Thobeka Madiba-Zuma ebisematheni ku-Instagram nakuTwitter ngoLwesihlanu.Unkosikazi kamengameli ubefake imiyalezo ku-Instagram esonga ngokuthi labo abazama ukulwa nomyeni wakhe bazozisola. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kusabalele izinkulumo ezithi uZuma uhleli ngesinqe esisodwa njengoba enxenxwa ukuba ashenxe esikhundleni.Inkosana kamengameli uMnuz Edward Zuma esitatimendeni sokuxolisa igxeke unina omncane ngokukhuluma budedengu."Asazi singakuchaza kanjani ukudumala nokuphoxeka kwethu ngalolu daba. Yingakho sibone ukuthi masikhiphe isitatimende sishweleze ngenkulumo yalolu hlobo. Sesiqale uphenyo ngalesi senzo ukuze sithole kahle ukuthi kwenze njani," kusho uZuma esitatimendeni.Uthe bewumndeni bakholwa wukuthi ihhovisi likanina omncane kufanele libe seqhulwini ekudaleni ukuthula emphakathini."Sifisa ukugcizelela ukubethemba ubuholi obukhethwe yi-ANC. Sibona ukuthi yibona obuzothatha izwe lethu buliyise phambili. Sithole inqwaba yezingcingo abantu besibuza ngalolu daba olube undabamlonyeni," kuqhuba uZuma.Unina omncane ubefake isithombe sakhe nomengameli bezipholele, wasiphelezela ngombhalo othi ‘Kusazoshuba ungalwi nomuntu ongalwi nawe. Kusazoshipha ukotshi darling." Ugcizelele nokuthi uZuma wajoyina umzabalazo esemncane. Uze wathakazela umengameli wambiza nangamagama othando lapho ethi: "My everyday crush Nxamalala, Msholozi, Maphumephethe," emthopha.

source: ibhungu liklabhe abashana lababulala lona labulawa yiloli
text: USAPHITHENE amakhanda umndeni webhungu (21) okuthiwa liklabhe lalimaza unina, labulala abashana balo ababili libagenca ngobhushu, maqede lashayiswa yiloli lashona, eBhobhoyi.Umndeni kaMnuz Siphamandla Smith awuwuvali umlomo ngesigameko esihlasimulisa umzimba esidlule nemiphefumulo yabashana bakhe uSiyamthanda (3) noThobani (2) okuthiwa bahlaselwe nguye ngobhushu izolo ekuseni, emuva kwehora lesithupha. Kuthiwa unina, uNkk Marry Smith usindile kulesi sigameko kodwa usesimeni esibi esibhedlela.Ngesikhathi leli phephandaba lithinta lo mndeni izolo bewuzwakala ukuthi usakhungathekile futhi udidekile.UNkk Nana Ngcobo uthe basafisa ukuthola ongabachazela ngokwenze indodana kababekazi wakhe ivuke ihlasele unina nabashana bayo.Uthe uthole umbiko ophuthumayo kuthiwa akazobheka lesi sehlakalo. “Sisathukile futhi siphithene amakhanda ngale nto eyenzekile. Okubi wukuthi kwayena uSiphamandla ngeke size sikwazi ukumbuza ngoba ushayiswe yiloli washona emuva kwalesi sigameko. Ngeke ngithi uziphonse ezimotweni noma ushayiseke ethi uyawela kodwa naye ushonile,” kusho uNkk Ngcobo.Kuthiwa uSmith ubebaklabha emakhanda ngobhushu.Abashana bakhe kuthiwa bebeshayeke kabi eziphongweni kwaze kwaphuma ubuchopho.Unina yena kuthiwa umklabhe ekhanda nasengalweni.UNkk Ngcobo uchaze uSmith njengomuntu obethula kakhulu kodwa oqale ukuba nenkinga emuva kokudidekelwa wumqondo nyakenye. Ngokusho kwamalungu omndeni wakhe ukuphazamiseka kwakhe emqondweni bekumenza abuye abe nodlame kodwa akekho obelindele ukuthi angagcina enze lokhu akwenzile.UNksz Zamo Smith uthe ubabekazi wakhe ubehlala noSmith ekhaya nabashana bakhe nezinye izingane zakubo, okubalwa unina womunye wabashana bakhe abashonile ngesikhathi ebahlasela.UNksz Smith uthe unina wenye yezingane ezishonile nguyena ozithele phezu kwezidumbu zezingane nonina obelimele kakhulu kodwa esaphila.Uthe umndeni wonke uphatheke kabuhlungu ngenxa yalesi sigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt Col Thulani Zwane uthe kuvulwe amacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala ngenxa yokuhlaselwa kwalaba bobathathu.Uthe kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa ushayiswe yiloli ngesikhathi ebaleka.Uthe kuzovulwa icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso.UZwane uthe akuqondakali ukuthi umsolwa ubezama ukuzibulala yini.

BAKHATHAZEKILE abazali babafundi baseMlazi Com Tech High eMlaza, okuthiwa sebephuthwa ukufunda ngenxa yenkinga yokucishwa kukagesi. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi sekuphele isonto ugesi ungekho kulesi sikole esinabafundi abahlala ngaphakathi. Phezu kokucishwa kukagesi, kuphinde kwaphela namanzi, okwenza ukuthi izingane ezihlala emakubo zisheshe zigodukiswe. Kuthiwa isikole sikweleta uMasipala weTheku imali elinganiselwa kuR4 million. Okukhathaza abazali ukuthi abakaze batshelwe ngale nkinga yesikweletu.Umzali wengane efunda uGrade 9 kodwa engahlali ngaphakathi esikoleni, uthe isimo simanzonzo.Uthe bezwe ngesonto eledlule ukuthi ugesi uphelile.“Sithole ukuthi izingane ezihlala ngaphakathi sezikhanyisa amakhandlela ebusuku, zilale ngesinkwa ngoba akuphekwa. Bazamile abanye abazali ukuyohlola isimo, bavinjwa onogada esangweni.”Omunye umzali onengane ehlala ngaphakathi esikoleni uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu ukuthi abazi ngokwenzeka ezinganeni zabo.Uthe njengoba izingane zihlala ngaphakathi azivunyelwe ukuphatha amaselula futhi sikaliwe nesikhathi sokuzivakashela. “Ngiphathwa kabi ukuthi zidlani izingane zethu njengoba ugesi ungekho. Sizwe ukuthi ezinye azisayi emakilasini ngoba namanzi okugeza awekho. Kuqale unyaka sibhalisile sangatshelwa lutho ngenkinga. Inkinga ebesiyazi eyokuphuka kwezicabha okwenzeka ngesikhathi kuhlasele umoya ngonyaka odlule,” kusho umzali. Kuthiwa abazali bathunyelelwe uthishanhloko amaSMS ngoLwesithathu ebabikela ngenkinga kagesi, ebatshela nokuthi bayazama ukuyilungisa.Uxolise nangokungasheshi abatshele abazali ngale nkinga.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe asibaphethe kahle isimo saseComTech.Uthe kukhona abakuhlelayo ukuxazulula le nkinga.UMnuz Mthunzi Gumede, okhulumela ihhovisi leMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, uthe sekubizwe umhlangano ophuthumayo namuhla ukuxoxa ngalolu daba.Lo mhlangano uphakathi kwemeya nobuholi bomnyango wezemfundo nothishanhloko abathintekayo. Uthe akuyona inhloso yabo ukuthi izikole zicishelwe ugesi futhi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi izingane zingaphazamiseki.“Zingu-500 izikole ezikweleta umasipala imali elinganiselwa kuR80 million. Imeya isiyalele ukuthi izikole zingacishelwa ugesi singakatholakali isixaxululo sokukhokha isikweletu ngoba iyikhathalele imfundo. Sinxusa ukuthi izikole esezithikamezekile ukuthi zithintane nomasipala ngokushesha,” kusho uGumede.

LUTHATHE elinye igxathu udaba lwekusasa leNhloko yezokuShushisa kuleli u-Advocate Shaun Abrahams njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, enqume ukuhoxisa isicelo sokwedluliswa kwesinqumo senkantolo.NgoLwesihlanu abammeli behhovisi likamengameli, ngomyalelo kaRamaphosa bahoxise lesi sicelo sokwedluliswa kodaba olwalufakwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma obengumengameli wezwe. UZuma wadlulisa isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu iNorth Gauteng eyayithe ukuqokwa kuka-Abrahams kwakungekho emthethweni, yancoma ukuthi axoshwe.UZuma obehambisana no-Abrahams abakuzwanga kahle lokho, bathi udaba aluyobuyekezwa yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Lolu daba kulindeleke ukuthi lulalelwe kuleli sonto elizoqala kodwa ihhovisi likamengameli lizobe lingasayingeni leyo.U-Abrahams usanda kuqinisekisa ngoLwesibili ukuthi uzitholile izincomo ezivela kubashushisi ezihlahla indlela eya phambili mayelana nokuthi uZuma kufanele yini ashushiswe ngamacala enkohlakalo, asukela esivumelwaneni sokuthengwa kwezikhali.La macala ayehoxiswe owayephethe uphiko lwezokushushiswa u-Advocate Mokotedi Mpshe ekhala ngokuthi kwakunetulo elihambisana nezepolitiki.Inkantolo yabe isinquma ukuthi isinqumo sikaMpshe sasingaphusile, okwaholela ekutheni udaba lokushushiswa kukaZuma lubukwe kabusha.Amaqembu aphikisayo asincomile isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuhoxisa ukwedluliswa kodaba.UMnuz James Selfe weDA uthe sekusele ukuthi uRamaphosa aqoke omunye umuntu othembekile esikhundleni sika-Abrahams.

SIZWAKELE isikhalo somphakathi obufuna kufakwe uMnuz Bheki Cele abe wuNgqongqoshe wezamaPhoyisa njengoba uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ememezele ukuthi uzongena kulesi sikhundla ngesikhathi ememezela izinguquko kwiKhabhinethi yakhe izolo ebusuku.UDkt Zweli Mkhize, obengumgcinimafa we-ANC, ngomunye wabantu abamenyezelwe ukuthi uma esefungisiwe namhlanje njengamalungu ePhalamende uzothatha isikhundla sokuba nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu.UMnuz Nhlanhla Nene, owaxoshwa ngowayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma ubuyele kwesikaNgqongqoshe weziMali kwathi iphini lakhe nguMnuz Mondli Gungubele.Kuphelile nokuqagela ngesikhundla sephini likamengameli wezwe njengoba ememezele kuthi iphini lakhe kwi-ANC, uMnuz David Mabuza, uzoba yiphini likamengameli wezwe uma esefungisiwe namhlanje ePhalamende.Umemezele uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, owayegaqele esokuba umengameli we-ANC kwesikangqongqoshe ehhovisi likamengameli ebhekele ukuhlela. UNksz Bathabile Dlamini ususiwe emnyangweni wezeNhlalakahle wayiswa emnyangweni wabesifa-zane nabaphila nokukhubazeka ehhovisi likamengameli.UMnuz Malusi Gigaba umyise emnyangweni wezaseKhaya, ake wawuphatha.UMnuz Jeff Radebe yena umyise emnyangweni wezamandla emsusa ehhovisi likamengameli kwathi uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, naye owaxoshwa nguZuma, waya emnyangweni wezamabhizinisi kahulumeni.UNksz Ayanda Dlodlo usenguNgqongqoshe wezisebenzi zikahulumeni nokuphatha kwathi uNksz Lindiwe Sisulu, obengungqongqoshe wezokuhlaliswa kwabantu, wayiswa emnyangweni wezobudlelwano namazwe omhlaba.UMnuz Thulas Nxesi, ungungqongqoshe wezemisebenzi yomphakathi kwathi uMnuz Gugile Nkwiti waba ngungqongqoshe wezamanzi.UDkt Blade Nzimande, unobhala jikelele we-SACP, ungene emnyangweni wezokuThutha kwathi uNksz Thokozile Xasa wajutshelwa emnyangweni wezemidlalo.UNkk Nomvula Mokonyane, obengungqongqoshe wezamanzi ujutshelwe emnyangweni wezokuxhumana kwathi uNksz Susan Shabangu wajutshelwa emnyangweni wezenhlalakahle.USihlalo we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, ujutshelwe emnyangweni wezokumbiwa phansi.UNkk Naledi Pandor umjube emnyangweni wemfundo ephakeme, kwathi emnyangweni wezokuhlaliswa kwabantu wafaka uNkk Nomaindia Mfeketo. UNkk Maite Nkoana Mashabane umjubele kwezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kwathi kwezokuphepha kombuso wafaka uNksz Letsasti Duba. Kwezesayensi nobuchwepheshe wafaka uNkk Nkhensani Kubayi Ngubane kwathi kwezokuvakasha wafaka uMnuz Derek Hanekom.ONgqongqoshe abaxoshiwe ngoMnuz Fikile Mbalula kwezamaphoyisa, David Mahlobo obekwezamandla, uMnuz Des Van Rooyen, obephethe umnyango wezokubusa ngokubambisana, uMnuz Mosebenzi Zwane obekwezezimayini noNksz Lynne Brown noNksz Faith Muthambi. Uphinde wenza izinguquko kumaphini ongqongqoshe.Omunye wongqongqoshe oxoshiwe nguMnuz Bongani Bongo obengungqongqoshe wezokuphepha kwezwe. Omunye wabantu abazofungiswa namhlanje njengelungu lePhalamende nguNkk Peggy Nkonyeni,owayengungqongqoshe wezemfundo KwaZulu-Natal owaxoshwa.

UMENGAMELI Jacob Zuma akanabo abamelulekayo noma kungenzeka ukuthi akabalaleli ngoba ukudaza inkani angehli esikhundleni kuzomlahlekisela ngokuningi. Usho kanje umhlaziyi wepolitiki ozimele uMnuz Thabani Khumalo.Uthe ukudaza inkani kukaMengameli aze alibeke ngembaba elokuthi akesabi noma angashaywa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe nokubekwa icala lokuphula umthethosisekelo kuzokwenza angazitholi izimfanelo zakhe uma esephumile.Uveze ukuthi lusingethwe ngobunono udaba lukaMengameli Jacob Zuma alufani nolukaMengameli Thabo Mbeki owakhishwa kungalindele muntu.“Ukudaza inkani kukaMengameli kukhombisa ukuthi akabalaleli abamelulekayo. Kucacela noma ngubani ukuthi uzophuma esikhundleni kodwa asazi ukuthi uzokhishwa nini noma kanjani,” kusho uKhumalo.NgoLwesithathu ebusuku kusabalale inkulumo kaMgcinimafa we-ANC, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, otshele abatshalizimali kwiMining Indaba, eCape Town, ukuthi uMengameli ubatshele emehlweni ukuthi ngeke asuke futhi uzimisele ukuya ePhalamende ukuze kube nevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe noma kuvele ukuthi uphule umthethosisekelo.UKhumalo uthe uMashatile wehlise amaphaphu kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika nakubatshalizimali ngokuchaza ukuthi i-ANC isithathe isinqumo sokuthi uMengameli kufanele ehle esikhundleni.Uthe ukugxekwa kukaMashatile ngenkulumo yakhe kukhombisa ukuthi kusenamalungu e-ANC angazimisele ukuvuselela le nhlangano.“Uma i-ANC izimisele ngokulungisa isimo kufanele ibhekane nabantu abaphula umthetho bevika ngokuthi kufanele inhlangano ibumbane. Kufanele bakhuzwe abaphambana nehlombe futhi kushushiswe abaholi abanamacala,” kusho uKhumalo.UMashatile uthe beyi-ANC abazimisele ngokuthi uZuma ayoshaywa ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe futhi bamazisile ngalokho.“Umbono wethu wukuthi uma uMengameli engafuni ukusula ngenxa yezizathu ezithile kufanele simsuse esikhundleni. Sinezinkinga eziningi kabi ukuthi singavumela ukuthi kube nelungu lethu elivotelwa ePhalamende bese i-ANC iba nesithombe esibi,” kusho uMashatile.Uphinde waveza ukuthi uZuma ubezokhishwa esikhundleni emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC obuzoba ngoLwesithathu kodwa wahoxiswa.Uthe uZuma kufanele adedele ubuholi obusha buphathe angabatsheli ukuthi mabenzeni.Izolo uNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Ace Magashule, uthe bahlangene nekhokhasi ye-ANC ePhalamende bedingida izindaba ezibathintayo.Akathandanga ukuphendula imibuzo yokuthi uZuma uphuma nini esikhundleni.USotswebhu we-ANC ePhalamende, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, uthe ikhokhasi ayinawo amandla okuxosha uMengameli wase evalelisa ezintathelini.

source: ezothando kunzima nokujabula ekamelweni ngenxa yendoda engasebenzi
text: Umbuzo: Ngagana indoda engishiya ngeminyaka ewu-22 ubudala kanti mina manje ngineminyaka ewu-34. Sesineminyaka emihlanu sishadile kodwa asitholi bantwana. Noma yena esola ukuthi imina onenkinga, angizange ngimtshele ukuthi ngake ngakhulelwa ingane yenye indoda engangithandana nayo kudala kodwa ngasikhipha isisu. Angikaze ngimtshele ngempilo yami yaphambilini ngoba angifuni angahlulele. Sekunzima ukuphumela obala manje emva kweminyaka engaka sishadile. Ungidlisa amaphilisi azongisiza ngikhulelwe ngokushesha, futhi usefaka nengcindezi yenhlobo yokudla okufanele ngiyidle ukungisiza. Angazi impela ukuthi ngenzenjani, ngoba ngiyazi mina ukuthi anginankinga nhlobo nje.
