BAZITAPELE izimpahla negilosa emzini kamakhelwane wabo abantu baseChesterville abebemsola ngokubakhokhisa imali abethi eyokugwazela umsebenzi wakwaMasipala weTheku.Izolo, labo makhelwane abebegane unwabu bathe umakhelwane wabo uNkk Cabangile Cele-Zikhali, ubebathembise ukuthi bazoqala emsebenzini ngoMsombuluko. Kuthe sekumele baqale wathi abaye emahhovisi ophiko oluqoqa intela kuleli iSouth African Revenue Service (Sars) bayofuna izinombolo zokukhokha intela.UNksz Nomvula Nyathikazi uthe uNkk Cele-Zikhali oke wasebenza ohlelweni obelwaziwa ngeCato Manor Greening, ubethi uqashwe umasipala ophikweni lwamanzi ngemuva kokuphela kwalolu hlelo ngoDisemba.“Uthe ube nenhlanhla waqashwa wuphiko lwamanzi, nathi asisolanga lutho ngoba ubethi uqale ngoJanuwari. Uthe kulolu phiko kunowesifazane abembiza ngokuthi uLulu, okunguyena onikezwa le mali ayiqoqayo. Ubethi uma sebeqashiwe laba bantu nguyena ozoba yimenenja yabo kodwa uzobe esebenza ngaphansi kukaLulu,” kusho yena.Kuvele ukuthi bangu-36 abathi baluthwe nguNkk Cele-Zikhali kanti umuntu ngamunye ubegwaza ngoR2 000. Iningi labo le mali liyiboleke komashonisa ngoba lithembe ukuthi seliwuthole umsebenzi.UNksz Siziphiwe Mfeka uthe ubeyitoho lapho esebenza khona, wesule emsebenzini wakhe ngoLwesine ngoba etshelwe ukuthi uzohola uR9 000 kwamasipala.“Lo mama ungibulele, ngangihamba naye engiqhuba ethi angesule emsebenzini ngoba sizoqala ngoMsombuluko emsebenzini. NgoMsombuluko sivukele kwaSars njengoba kade eshilo, sihlale khona kwaze kwavalwa elokhu ethi asimlinde uyeza uyolanda imifaniswano yethu. Kulapho sibone khona ukuthi sengathi siqoliwe sabuya seza la emzini wakhe. Ingane yakhe isitshele ukuthi ubekhona ufike wathatha isikhwama wahamba. Simthumelele imiyalezo simtshela ukuthi sizothatha izimpahla emzini wakhe, sizozibuyisa uma eselethe imali yethu,” kusho yena.Kuthiwa uNkk Cele-Zikhali uthumele imiyalezo kubagilwa ethi abalande imali yabo ngo-9 ekuseni, izolo. Abanye ubebasabisa ngokuthi uzobathakatha uma bengayeki ukumthuka. Sebefikile uthe le mali ayikho kuye kodwa ikulo wesifazane okuthiwa uLulu. Ingxenye yaleli qulu ihambe naye yaya ophikweni lwamanzi kumasipala lapho kade ethi lo wesifazane usebenza khona, kwalandulwa kwathiwa akekho umuntu onalelo gama.Ngemuva kwaloku ushintshile wathi kunoR40 000 awubekile komunye umuzi eGlenmore. Kuthe kusalungiselelwa ukuya khona washintsha wathi ucela kubizwe amaphoyisa aboshwe.Ebuzwa yileli phephandaba mayelana nalezi zinsolo, uNkk Cele-Zikhali uthe: “Ngicela nike ningiyeke kancane.”Emva kwalokho uhambile wayongena ekamelweni. Kube khona abamlandelayo bamphuca amaphilisi okuthiwa uke wazama ukuwaphuza.Uthe abathathe izimpahla zakhe bazidayise ngoba ayikho imali. Kulamule ukufika kwamaphoyisa umphakathi usho ukumqeda.Umyeni wakhe uMnuz Sanele Zikhali uthe ubazi ukuthi unkosikazi wakhe usebenza kwadokotela.“Ebengikuqaphela ukuthi bese sidla ukudla esingajwayele ukukudla layikhaya. Ngithe uma ngimbuza ubebhoka ngolaka abukise ngami kubangani bakhe ebengihlale ngibafica la ekhaya bephuza. Ngigcine ngizitshela ukuthi kusho ukuthi uwinile e-casino ngoba ungumuntu okhonze ukugembula kodwa akafuni ukungitshela. Ngishayelwe ucingo sengitshelwa ukuthi umuzi wami usengcupheni yokusha. Namhlanje, asinakudla abantu bathathe ngisho igilosa, asinalutho. Uma ngimbuza ngalokhu, akangiphenduli,” kusho yena.ULt Colonel Thulani Zwane, okhulumela amaphoyisa, uthe alikho icala elivuliwe ngalesi sigameko.UNksz Tozi Mthethwa, okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe abathi baqoliwe kufanele bavule amacala emaphoyiseni noma bathinte uphiko lwakwamasipala oluphenya ngenkohlakalo iCity Investigation Unit.“Awukho umsebenzi okhokhelwa imali kwamasipala, uma kunomuntu othi udayisa imisebenzi, umphakathi awumbike kulolu phiko,” usho kanje.

IHLEKA yodwa imilutha yewunga ehlala edolobheni eThekwini njengoba sekuqalwe phansi ukubhaliswa kwabafundi, e-University of South Africa (Unisa), emuva kokumiswa kwesiteleka sabasebenzi.Kuthiwa le milutha idela ubuthongo ijoyine ulayini wabafundi abalala ngaphandle kwesikhungo sase-Unisa esisemgwaqweni uStalwart Simelane, eThekwini, ukuze idayisele abafundi abafika ekuseni izikhala kulayini.Amaphara alala kolayini, uma umfundi efika ekuseni akhokhele iphara uR50 bese ema lapho kade lime khona.UNksz Sizakele Msweli (25) uthe wethuka ngesikhathi efika kule nyuvesi ngehora lesihlanu ekuseni kodwa waba ngunombolo 391 kulayini.“Ngangizitshela ukuthi ngivuke ngempela uma ngishayelwa * -5 e-Unisa. Ngacela umfowethu ukuthi angihambise ngoba ngibona ukuthi uma ngihamba ngamatekisi ngizofika sekugcwele kakhulu. Ngathi ngisazimele kwaqhamuka iphara lathi liphambili kulayini, lingangidayisela isikhala ngoR200. Ngashaywa ukuthi imali ngangingenayo. Ukube yayikhona ngangizokhokha,” kusho uNksz Msweli.Uthe owayeseduze kwakhe, walikhokhela iphara waba phambili kulayini.Uqhube wathi waze wagoduka ngo-7 ebusuku ebe efike ekuseni ngovivi.Isolezwe ngeSonto lihambele kulesi sikhungo ngoLwesihlanu ukuthola kabanzi ngokushiwoyo.Abafundi abebemi kulayini bakuqinisekisile wukuthi wumkhuba ojwayelekile lo.Omunye wabadayisa ngaphandle kwase-Unisa, ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe kwesinye isikhathi yibo abafundi abasukela imilutha yewunga bayicele ukuthi ibabambele ulayini.“Abasuke benqena ukulala ngaphandle, bacela amaphara ukuthi ababambele olayini. Abanye baze bawaqashele nezihlalo kubhuti oqashisa ngazo ukuze ahlale phansi,” kusho lo mdayisi.Umlutha onqabile ukudalulwa, uthe kusebenzeka kangcono uma kusesekuseni kakhulu bengakafiki abasebenzi base-Unisa ngoba bafike babaxoshe.Uthe uma eme ngasekuqaleni kukalayini ubiza uR150 nangaphezulu kuya ngesivumelwano kodwa uma engasemuva ubiza uR50.UMnuz Zamokuhle Buthelezi (24) oqashisa ngezihlalo kubafundi abasuke bezobhalisa uthe uyazuza.“Ngiqale ngonyaka odlule ngemuva kokubona ukuthi abantu bama baze bakhathale kolayini. Ngibiza uR5 uma umuntu ezohlala ubusuku bonke kanti emini ngibiza uR2. Okwamanje nginezihlalo eziwu-300 ngisafuna ukuzandisa. Ngiphinde ngiqashisele abadayisayo,” kusho uButhelezi.

AQHUBEKILE nokucela ibheyili namhlanje amadoda ayisikhombisa asolwa ngokuba ngongqondongqondo ekubulaweni kwabantu ehostela laseMlaza, iGlebelands.USergeant Bhekukwazi Mdweshu (37), Mnuz Vukani Mcobothi (25), Mnuz Khayelihle Mbuthuma (32), Mnuz Wonderboy Mhlope (37), Mnuz Matlala Mdweshu Ntshangase (35), Mnuz Mahliphiza Mkhize (28) noMnuz Mondli Mthethwa (32) bavele enkantolo kaMantshi yaseThekwini izolo.Abekwe amacala awu-19, okubalwa kuwo awokubulala, itulo lokubulala, awokuzama ukubulala, elokutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.Amadoda amathathu athe afuna ukushintsha ummeli athathe okahulumeni. Amane okukhona kuwo iphoyisa, asamelwe ngummeli ozimele.Lokhu kuphoqe ukuthi iMantshi uFariedha Mohamed alimise kancane icala. Sekubuyelwa enkantolo umshushisi u-Advocate Dorian Pave uthe bavumelene bonke abameli ukuthi liqhubeke namhlanje. Imantshi ibe isilihlehlisa.Ukucelwa kwebheyili bekubekelwe izinsuku ezintathu kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuze kube uLwesithathu.Enkantolo bekugcwele phama abantu abebesuka ehostela nezihlobo zabamangalelwa. Abanye kuze kwaphoqeleka ukuthi bame ngaphandle ngenxa yobuncane benkantolo.Sebebuyiselwa ezitokisini abamangalelwa ubungafunga ukuthi bangosaziwayo ngenxa yokuphakamisa kwabo izandla bevayizela abantu abebehlezi enkantolo.

UYADLONDLOBALA umkhankaso wokulwa nokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana njengoba iPhini likaMengameli wezwe eliphinde libe nguMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, lithe mabashushiswe abathintekayo.Kuyimanje i-Asset Forfeiture Unit (AFU) isembhidlangweni wokubuyisa u-R50 billion owathathwa ezinkampanini zikahulumeni.NgoLwesine iNational Prosecuting Authority ibinomhlangano nabameli bakwaMcKinsey nabakwaTrillion okuyizinkampani okusolakala ukuthi zakhokhelwa u-R1.6 billion ngokungemthetho ngabakwa-Eskom.URamaphosa uthe i-Eskom yinkampani enkulu kahulumeni enezinkinga zokungaphathwa kahle kwemali, ayinazinzo ebuholini futhi ihlanganiswa nomndeni wakwaGupta.“Siyawamukela umnyakazo osuqalile futhi sifuna bashushiswe ngokushesha abathintekayo. Kubalulekile ukubamba impahla yabo kodwa sifuna ukubona kwenzeka nokunye,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe uhulumeni kufanele ayeke ukuza nemiyalezo edida abantu kodwa eze nezinhlelo zokuqeda inkohlakalo ezinkampanini zakhe.“Akwamukelekile ukuthi izinkampani zikahulumeni okufanele ukuthi zibhekele izidingo zikahulumeni kube yizona eziphethwe yizigebengu ezizenzelayo emalini.“Kuhle ukuthi yonke inkohlakalo ivelile futhi kunama-email asizile ngeminye imininingwane. INPA isiyashushisa futhi bazoboshwa abathintekayo,” kusho uRamaphosa.URamaphosa uzohola ithimba eliya kwiWorld Economic Forum, eDavos, eSwitzerland ngesonto elizayo.Ngaphambi kokuqokwa njengoMengameli we-ANC uRamaphosa wayezibophezele ngokuthi uzolwa nenkohlakalo. UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Ace Magashule, uthe ikusasa likaMengameli Jacob Zuma ngeke lidingidwe emhlanganweni wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC.“KunoMengameli wezwe okuhulumeni bese kuba noMengameli we-ANC, azikho izizinda ezimbili zombuso kodwa kune-ANC. Okumnandi wukuthi uMengameli we-ANC uyiPhini likaMengameli wezwe,” kusho uMagashule.

ZINGAPHEZU kuka-12 izikhulu eziqaphe izinto kuhulumeni nalabo ababheke ukugcinwa komthetho abazungeza izinkampani nosomabhizinisi abasebenzisana nomndeni wakwaGupta kufunwa uR50 billion owaluthwa ezinkampanini zikahulumeni.I-National Prosecuting Authority (NPA), Asset Forfeiture Unit (AFU), Specialised Commercial Crime Unit, aboMnyango weziMali, iFinancial Intelligence Centre, iCompanies and Intellectual Property Commission noKlebe bayasebenzisana kulo mzamo.Inhloko esabambile ye-AFU, u-Adv Knox Molelle, ithe basathumela amasamanisi kwabakwaGupta ophenyweni olusaqhubeka ngalabo abathinteka embikweni woMvikeli woMphakathi wokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.UMolelle uthe i-AFU ibheka amacala awu-17 kodwa ayisithupha asefakwe enkantolo.“Siyathemba sizothola incwadi yasenkantolo emasontweni ambalwa ezayo ezosigunyaza ukuthi sishaqe impahla. Kuseyisiqalo lesi,” kusho uMolelle.Uthe uyathemba ukuthi imali eningi izotholakala kungakapheli unyaka wezimali olandelayo.Sebethole incwadi ebagunyaza ukuthi bashaqe impahla ka-R1.6 billion ezinkampanini ezisebenzisana nomndeni wakwaGupta, iMcKinsey neTrillian.U-Adv Malini Govender oyiNhloko yeNPA Specialised Crime Unit (SCCU) uthe baqale ukucubungula ubufakazi ngonyaka odlule nethimba labantu abaningi abakwiNPA, SCCU, aboMnyango wezeziMali, AFU nabanye.Uthe baphenya izihloko eziyisikhombisa ezivela embikweni wokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana, olulodwa oluthinta i-Estina, inkampani ehlanganiswa nomdeni wakwaGupta eFree State.Umkhulumeli weMcKinsey ozinze e-United Kingdom, uMnuz Steve John, uthe bayayemukela yonke imizamo ezobasiza ukuthi bakhokhe imali ngoba kade bezama ukuyikhokha kusukelango-Okthoba.

Ukufika kwe-internet kule minyaka kuyishintshe kakhulu impilo. Kwafika neselula okwenza kwaba lula ukuxhumana. Yize ukufika kweselula kwathuthukisa indlela yokuphila, ushintsho lwangempela lubonakale lapho kufika lawa abizwa ngama-smart phone okwasho ukuthi amaselula asene-internet.Lokhu kwasho ukuthi sesikwazi ukuthola nokuthumela imiqulu (documents), imali, izithombe, umculo nokunye okuningi. Ngisho abantu abangenawo ama-akhawunti asebhange namhlanje bayakwazi ukuthola imali besebenzisa wona belu amaselula ane-internet.Kuningi okushintshile nasezimbonini ngenxa yobuchwepheshe be-internet namakhompyutha. Eqinisweni luningi ushintsho oluzayo njengoba kudlondlobala i-artificial intelligence efundisa amarobhothi ubuhlakani obusezingeni labantu nagaphezulu.Kasisho amarobhothi asemgaqweni lapha, kepha sisho la marobhothi asebenza ezimbonini enza imisebenzi efana nokupenda izimoto, ukuthutha izimpahla nokunye. Okujabhisayo wukuthi lobu buchwepheshe buzonciphisa imisebenzi. Yingakho kufanele sicabange ngamathuba amabhizinisi eza nabo. Kuyimanje baningi abantu abacabanga ukwakha amabhulokisi okwakha ngesikhathi sekwenzeka ukuthi wakhe udonga lwendlu ngosuku olulodwa usebenzisa i-3D printer. Kuningi-ke okwenziwa yila ma-3D printer, ayakwazi ukwenza amathuluzi, izimpahla, amathambo ngisho namalungu omzimba.Lobu buchwepheshe sebuyasebenza kwamanye amazwe nakwezinye izimboni lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Okufanele sikwenze wukuthi sizijube sifune lolu lwazi ngoba umnotho wakusasa uzodinga bona ubuchwepheshe lobu.Maduze nje i-virtual tourism izoba undabuzekwayo lapho abantu bezovakashela amanye amazwe ngaphandle kokushiya amakhaya abo. Lokhu sekuyenzeka ngenxa ye-virtual reality (VR) ekuthatha ikubeke ezindaweni ezikude yize ungakaze usuke ekhaya. Eminyakeni ezayo izimoto zizobe zizishayela zona, zisebenzisa ugesi, okuyosho ukuphela kwamagaraji kaphethroli. Obunye ubuchwepheshe obunzulu butholakala kwezolimo. Ukudla esikuthenga ezitolo kukhiqizwa ngobuchwepheshe obuqinisekisa ukuthi kwanele futhi kuphephile. Ukunisela izitshalo emasimini kuncike ekutheni angakanani amanzi adingekayo ngokutshelwa ngubuxhakaxhaka bemishiin efakwe emhlabathini. Ama-drones, okungamabhanoyi amancanyana azindizelayo, asetshenziswa ukwelusa imfuyo nokuchelela izitshalo ngemithi. Bonke lobu buchwepheshe buzoba yisisekelo somnotho wakusasa kanti ithuba lokuhlomula yilo leli iningi lisalibele.Amanye amazwe ahamba phambili ngobuchwepheshe kanti la ezweni ezinye izinhlanga zingaphambili kwethu ndlu emnyama. Cabanga nje kuthiwa sinikwa ithuba lokumba igolide noma insimbi ezimayini ezabelwe thina. Singakwazi nje ukusuka ekuqaleni kungekho lutho sakhe imayini eqhudelana nezinye emhlabeni? Sinalo ulwazi oluphelele lobuchwepheshe obudingekayo?Wonke umnotho uphethwe noma uzophathwa yilobu buchwepheshe. Nakho ukutshalwa kwemali akusele ngaphandle kulolu shintsho oluza nobuchwepheshe. Kunenqwaba yama-Apps umhlaba wonke okuhweba amasheya nokukhetha izinkampani ongatshala kuzona imali. Ngaphandle kobuhlakani be-internet namakhompyutha bekungaba nzima ukukhetha amasheya azodla umhlanganiso. Ngisho yona imali ye-internet efana ne-bitcoin isebenza ngabo ubuchwepheshe. Kusobala-ke ukuthi ukuze ube namathuba okwenza kahle ekutshaleni imali, kufanele wazi ngalobu bucwepheshe.Kungenjalo siyogcina ngokuthola imvuthu ngoba singenazo izikhali zokulwa lempi yomnotho.Yize obunye balobu buchwepheshe sebukhona empilweni yethu, ushintsho oluningi lulindeleke kule minayaka engu-20 kuya kwengu-30 ezayo. Akulula ukubona kude kangaka kodwa iyona indlela yokusungula amabhizinisi ayizikhondlakhondla. Uma kungenzeki kithina kufanele kwenzeke ebantwaneni bethu.Ngeke kusisize ngalutho ukubeka izaba, izingane zethu kufanele ziqhubeke nalokho esesikuqaleli. UKUSHODELWA yimali yokuthenga abaqwayizi kuholele ekutheni umfundisi osindisiwe adlwengule izingane zamantombazane ezingaphezu kuka-15, ezineminyaka esukela kwewu-3 kuya kwewu-12, emijondolo yaseLouisiana ePort Shepstone.Lezi zindaba zidalulwe wumndeni walo mfundisi, uThokozani Mvalelwa (34), ogwetshwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda yasePort Shepstone odilikajele abahlanu ngemuva kokuzivumela yena ukuthi ubedlwengula laba bantwana qede ababonge ngamaphakethe ama-chips noR2.Yize uMvalelwa, odabuka eLusikisiki, e-Eastern Cape, etshele inkantolo ukuthi zingaphezu kuka-15 izingane azidlwengula, kodwa kwafakaza ezinhlanu kuphela.Inkantolo ithole ukuthi lo mfundisi wadlwengula lezi zingane ezingomakhelwane phakathi kukaJuni no-Okthoba ka-2016.Imikhuba yalo mfundisi yavela ngesikhathi umzali wengane yentombazane eno-6, ethi uthuma indodakazi yakhe esitolo kanti izohlangana noMvalelwa, wayithatha wayiyisa endlini yakhe yomxhaso lapho ayidlwengulela khona maqede wayivala umlomo ngoR2.Ekhuluma neSolezwe ngoMgqibelo unina wale ntombazane, uthe wathi uma ezwa le mihlola wayobikela ikomiti.“Wafike wazivumela yena ukuthi wayidlwengula ingane yami futhi wathembisa ukuthi uzohlawula ngenkukhu. Waveza nokuthi ziningi izingane abezibiza bese elala nazo,” kusho lo mama elifihliwe igama lakhe ukuvikela ingane.Uthe izingane zonke zayiswa esibhedlela lapho odokotela bafike bakuqinisekisa ukuthi nebala zadlwengulwa.Ilungu leCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), uMnuz Simon Mthembu uthe babe sebebiza amaphoyisa ukuba ambophe uMvalelwa njengoba amanye amalungu omphakathi ayesefuna ukumudla amfele futhi efuna anqunyiswe okwembuzi.“Sathi uma simbuza ukuthi wayezidlwengulelani izingane ezincane kanje, wathi ubeswele imali yokuthenga abaqwayizi,” kusho uMthembu othi uMvalelwa ubaziwa njengekholwa ebelikhonze ukuzidumisela iNkosi kuphela.Le ndaba yaziwa ngisho nayizingane ezincane zaseLouisiana njengoba nasejoyintini lendawo isabhungwa.NoNksz Phumzile Khawula, oyisihlobo sikaMvalelwa, uthe naye wamtshela ukuthi usuke waphelelwa amatoho, wangabe esakwazi ukuthenga abaqwayizi.Eqhuba uNksz Khawula uthe uMvalelwa waqala wasonta eZayoni ngaphambi kokuyothwasa. “Indaba yonakala ngesikhathi esethi usindisiwe ngoba ubesenza nezinto ezingaqondakali. Wazivumela yena kimina ukuthi nonina wayemdlwengula njengoba egcine eshonile. Nezingane zezihlobo zakhe ubezidlwengula nje. Kukhona nje neyakithi ayidlwengula,” kusho uNksz Khawula.Umama (47) wengane eno-10 uthe wubulwane obenziwe nguMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo ngoba eziningi ziphazamisekile engqondweni futhi azisenzi kahle ezifundweni zazo esikoleni sendawo iLouisiana Primary.UMnuz Thozamile Zomba, obengumakhelwane kaMvalelwa, uthe naye waqala wangakholwa esezwa ukuthi uMvalelwa wenze la manyala. “Ngahluleka ngisho esezivumela yena kodwa ngangingakholwa. Uze wagwetshwa nje ngingakholwa ngoba ubewumntwana ohloniphayo obekhonze ukusonta. Ubungaze umfake nasekhukhwini. Ubehlale engungwe yizingane, kungasoli muntu,” kusho uZomba.Onina bezingane bathe nakuba benelesekile yisigwebo kodwa okwenziwa wuMvalelwa ezinganeni zabo kuyisihluku esingefaniswe.

UMHOLI weDA, uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, ufunge wagomela ukuthi uzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bayajeziswa bonke abantu abanukeka enkohlakalweni yokugixabeza umndeni wakwaGupta ngezigidi zemali yasepulazini laseFree State.Ethula inkulumo enkundleni yezemidlalo iPholani, eNtuzuma, izolo uMaimane uthe ngeke aphumule uNobhala-jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Ace Magashule noNgqongqoshe wezokuMbiwa Phansi uMnuz Mosebenzi Zwane bengaboshiwe mayelana nokuxhaphaza imali yabantu eFree State. UMagashule ubenguNdunankulu waseFree State kanti uZwane enguNgqongqoshe wezoLimo ngesikhathi okusolwa ukuthi kwaphuma ngaso izigidi zemali eyanikwa abakwaGupta.“UMagashule onguNobhala-jikelele we-ANC bantshontshe imali bayidla bayiqeda nya, baze banika nomndeni wakwaGupta, wathenga ibhanoyi kodwa abantu bethu basahlupheka. Ngiziyele mathupha eFree State ngiyokhuluma nabantu basepulazini ngababuza ukuthi bebethenjisweni, bathi uMagashule noZwane babathembisa amasheya. Uma ubheka yilona leli pulazi okuntshontshwe imali yalo,” kusho uMaimane.Uthe enye yemali eyanikwa lo mndeni iyona eyasetshenziswa ngesikhathi kushada ilungu lawo.“Iyihlazo le nto eyenziwa abaholi be-ANC ukuthi bathathe imali yabantu abamnyama bayinike umndeni ocwasayo owathi awubafuni oweta abamnyama emshadweni wawo,” kusho uMaimane.Ubuze ukuthi uKhongolose usho kanjani ukuthi umele abantu abamnyama ube ukwazi ukubantshontshela.Uthe abaholi abaningi be-ANC bakhohlakele bafanelwe yijele.“Noma uMengameli Jacob Zuma angakhishwa esikhundleni kodwa ngisazoya enkantolo ngiyommangalela ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ugcina ezikhindini,” kusho uMaimane.Uthe ufuna uZuma aboshwe nabo bonke abantu bakhe abekhohlakele nabo.“Kumele bawashintshe la masudi kanokusho abawagqokayo, bafake umfaniswano wasejele,” kusho uMaimane.Uthe alukho ushintsho oluzokuza noMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa njengoba sekunguye umholi ngoba ubevele ekhona kwenziwa inkohlakalo kodwa ethule.“Kumanje asazi ukuthi ngubani ozothula inkulumo yesizwe kwi-ANC njengoba isinamakhanda amabili,” kusho uMaimane.UMaimane ubezokhuluma nabantu baseNtuzuma efuna ukubezwa ukuthi bangamphathisani njengoba kuzoba nenkulumo yesizwe ezokwenziwa nguMengameli wezwe.

USAMUKELE isigwebo esinikwe iphoyisa elabulala indodakazi yakhe yize ekhale ngokuthi asenele, unina wentombazane eyayineminyaka engu-17 eyadutshulwa yabulawa kunombhikisho wezindlu eCator Manor ngo-2013.UNksz Bandile Ngidi ekhuluma nephephandaba elinguzakwabo waleli, iThe Mercury uthe lesi sigwebo seminyaka engu-10 esinikwe uPhumlani Ndlovu kasenele kodwa singcono kunokuthi angagwetshwa.Ngesikhathi ikhipha isigwebo eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoMsombuluko, imantshi u-Anand Maharaj ifunde umthetho olawula izinkantolo okhuluma ngokuthi izinkantolo zizimele futhi zinomsebenzi wokukhipha izigwebo ezinobulungiswa futhi ezifanele.UNdlovu watholwa enecala ngoJulayi nyakenye.Ubufakazi bochwepheshe bezibhamu baveza ukuthi yisibhamu sakhe esadubula uNqobile Nzuza (17).Yize kunjalo uMaharaj uthe umbuso uzibhekile izimo leli phoyisa elazithola lihlangabezana nazo ezenze ukuthi agudluke esigwebeni esibekiwe seminyaka engu-15. Uqhube wathi uNdlovu owayengajwayele ukusebenza ngezixuku zabantu wazithola ebhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nequlu labantu ababediniwe, wabe esedubula ebhekise kubabhikishi, kwadubuleka uNqobile owayebaleka.UMaharaj uthe leli cala lifaka inkantolo enkingeni okunzima ukuthi ibhekane nayo uma sekumele igwebe.“Umphakathi ubheke ukuthi amaphoyisa asebenze ngaphansi komthetho futhi aqaphele uma ebhekene nababhikishi abanodlame, futhi aqaphele ukuthi awasebenzisi indluzula uma ekulezi zimo.”Uthe imibhikisho ekhona kuleli muva nje ikhombisa ukuthi kukhona nenhlese yokwenza lungabi khona uzinzo.“Angeke kubekezelelwe lokhu futhi ngeke kugqugquzelwe kubantu.”Uthe kulindelekile ukuthi amaphoyisa uma ebhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nequlu lababhikishi abadiniwe, akwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi komthetho futhi aqaphele.“Kodwa indlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo empilweni ziyasifundisa ukuthi lokhu kulula ukukusho kunokwenza ikakhulukazi uma abantu bengasalawuleki,” kusho uMaharaj.Uthe ukuphela kwempilo kaNqobile kuyinto ebuhlungu.“Wayemncane futhi wadutshulwa emhlane. Abukho ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi wayeyingozi kuwe.”Imantshi ithe ayigculisekile ukuthi uNdlovu ubezisola ngoba ubeqhubeka nokuthi akadubulanga wabhekisa equlwini labantu kodwa wadubula wabhekisa phansi nokushayisanayo nobufakazi bochwepheshe.“Nginomuzwa wokuthi wazama ukusebenzisa ukuthi awubonwanga muntu ngesikhathi udubula. Angiboni ukuthi uyazisola ngokweqiniso ngokwenzeka,” kusho uMaharaj.Uthe uyathemba isigwebo sizonqanda amanye amaphoyisa ukuthi angenzi njengoNdlovu uma ebhekene nezimo ezifanayo.Okhulumela inhlangano yaBahlali baseMjondolo, uMnuz Thapelo Mohapi uthe bayasamukela isigwebo.“Leli cala seliqhubeke isikhathi eside kodwa sibona ukuthi bekufanele agwetshwe okungaphezulu kwalokhu. Impilo yentombazane esencane yathathwa yiphoyisa elibudedengu,” kusho yena.UNdlovu uvunyelwe ukuthi afake isicelo sokuphikisa isinqumo sokumlahla ngecala nesigwebo kodwa wanqatshelwa ukuthi abe ngaphandle ngebheyili esalinde kwenziwe lesi sicelo.

text: MHLELI: Kwelakho ngicela ukwedlulisa umbono wami ngodaba lwabadayisa amaDVD ukuthi basicabangele phela ukuthi sizele, bangasoneli izingane zethu.Uyabona la maDVD omkhuba agcwele idolobha asifakela amahloni uma sihamba nezingane zethu ngoba zibona ukuthi uba njani umuntu omdala uma engagqokile. Thina sikhula besitshelwa ukuthi wabona umuntu omdala enqunu uvaleka amehlo yingakho nje ngingeke ngaba wuBen 10 ngoba ngisahamba emazwini abazali bami okuthi abubukwa ubuntu bomuntu omdala ngoba uvaleka amehlo.Nabakamasipala ngiyabasola ngoba bakwazi ukuphuca abantu abazidayisela otamatisi amazambane nokunye okudliwayo bayeke la bantu abadayisa ama-dvd abantu abaya ocansini nabanqunu.Ingane yami sekumele ngihambe nayo ngiyibophe ngeduku emehlweni ukuze ingabuki imikhuba.
