source: i nehawu ihlabela phambili neziteleka emanyuvesi
text: INYUNYANA iNational Education, Health and Allied Workers’ Union (Nehawu), ithi zisaqhubeka iziteleka emanyuvesi ahlukene kuleli, ezinye eziqale ngeledlule.INehawu ithumele isitatimende kwabezindaba izolo icacisa ngokwenzeka e-Unisa, DUT, Wits nase-University of Pretoria. Esitatimende kuthiwa abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kwale nyunyana abasebenzi kuzo zonke izikhungo zenyuvesi kuleli. Lokhu kudalwe ukuthi abaphathi benyuvesi banqume ukuhoxa ezingxoxweni baya enkantolo yabasebenzi ngoba befuna ukuthi isiteleka esiqale ngeledlule sithathwe njengesingekho emthethweni kodwa bahluleka. Isitatimende siveza ukuthi izimfuno zisamile njengoba befuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-10% kuzo zonke izigaba. Bafuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi betoho abasemkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe okuthiwa sebebe yitoho iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-15. Le nyunyana ithi i-Unisa icabanga ukuthi ingaphezulu komthetho njengoba ingafuni ukuhlonipha iLabour Relations Act ngokuthi ibaqashe ngokugcwele yize benazo iziqu.Le nyunyana isicele iCCMA ukuthi izame ukulekelela izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthi zifinyelele esivumelwaneni ukuze kuqhubeke ukubhaliswa kwabafundi. Inyunyana inxuse amalungu ayo ukuthi angadidiseki, akaqhubeke nesiteleka kuze kube izimfuno zawo ziyabhekelwa.E-DUT nakhona le nyunyana ithe sisazoqhubeka isiteleka kuzo zonke izikhungo njengoba kungakafinyelelwa esivumelwaneni. Le nyunyana isikhabe ngazo zombili isiphakamiso somqashi sika-6%. Isamile ekutheni ifuna kunyuswe ngo-10%, kunyuswe nomhlomulo wezindlu ngoR400 nebhonasi kaR9 000.EWits le nyunyana iqale emasontweni amabili ukuthi njalo ngesikhathi sesidlo sasemini kube nombhikisho ngoba ifuna umqashi ukuthi abuyele etafuleni lezingxoxo. Le nyunyana ithe lesi siteleka sizoba sikhulu namuhla. Ifuna umqashi anyuse umholo ngo 8%, imali ye-medical aid ngo-1%, ukubuyiswa kwemihlomulo yemali kulabo asebesebenze isikhathi eside. Inyunyana ithi abasebenzi base-University of Pretoria bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-9.5% kanti umqashi uthi uno-6%.

UKUNGABONI ngaso linye phakathi kwabangcwabi abamnyama nabamhlophe sekuxazululekile.Lokhu kulandela umhlangano okade ukhona phakathi kukaNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nokuVakasha, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, nabangcwabi kanjalo nalabo abathintekayo kulolu daba, izolo. Laba bahlanganisa iNational Funeral Practitioners Association of South Africa (Nafupa SA) lapho kuvunyelwane khona ngokuthi kusungulwe ikomiti elizobhekana ngqo noguquko emkhakheni wazabangcwabi okuvezwe ngabeNafupa SA.“Ngingakuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkinga ebezenza kungabi nokuthula phakathi kwabangcwabi sezixazululiwe. Sihlangane nabo bonke abathintekayo savumelana ngokuthi kudingeka kuhlanganiswe leli komidi elizobhekana nalezi zinkinga, egqame kakhulu ileyo yoshintsho kule mboni yabangcwabi, nakho konke abakuvezile,” kusho uZikalala.AbeNafupa SA nabo sebeguqukile kulokhu abekade besabisa ngokukwenza, kokuvimba izinkampani zamaNdiya nabelungu ukuthi zingangeni emalokishini ukuzongcwaba, kusukela kule nyanga ezoqala.Leli komiti lihlanganisa izinhlangano ezahlukene okubalwa kuzo iSouth African Social Security Agency, uMnyango wezeMpilo, i-Road Accident Fund noMnyango wezaseKhaya.Leli komiti lizohlangana izikhathi eziningi libe selibikela uZikalala ngomgamo eseliwuhambile ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga eziveziwe.

source: bahlezi lubhojozi osomatekisi kubulawa esinye isikhulu
text: BAHLEZI lubhojozi osomatekisi bakasoseshini iDolphin Coast emuva kokubulawa kwePhini likaNobhala kasoseshini, uMnuz Dicky Govender, odutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu nenkosikazi yakhe ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.UGovender, omunye wabasunguli bakasoseshini iDolphin Coast, udutshulwe emuva kokudutshulwa kukaMnuz Nhlanhla Lephalo oyilungu lekomidi osinde ngokulambisa ngesikhathi edutshulwa esendleleni ebheke ekhaya ngabo -8 ekuseni ngamadoda abehamba nge-Audi emhlophe.UMnuz Sunshine Mthiyane, obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwiDolphin Coast, uthe badinga kungenelele uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ngoba ayaphela amalungu abo.“Asazi ukuthi adutshulelwani amalungu ethu kodwa esikuqaphelayo wukuthi kubulawa abantu abasekomidini likasoseshini. Kudutshulwe uSihlalo wethu ngonyaka odlule kanti ngesonto eledlule kudutshulwe uNhlanhla Lephalo naye oyilungu lekomidi njengoba sekubulawa uDicky. Siphatheke kabi ngoba asazi ukuthi kwenzekani, sicela uKaunda angenelele ngoba siyaphela.”ULieutenant Thulani Zwane, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe kuvulwe amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokudutshulwa kukaGovender obengusomatekisi nomkakhe ngoMgqibelo ngabo 7.45 ebusuku.“Indoda nomkayo bebehamba emgwaqweni * -R102 phakathi kweShakaskraal noThongathi ngesikhathi bephambana nezimoto ezidedele inhlamvu. Indoda ishonele khona lapho, umkayo ushonele esibhedlela. Amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okubulala, akekho oseboshiwe.”UMnuz Kwanele Ncalane obhekelele ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhumana koMphakathiKwaZulu-Natal, uthe ungqongqoshe (Kaunda) ukhathazekile ngokubulawa kwabaholi bemboni yamatekisi ngakho usejube ithimba elizophenya ngakho.

SINCAMELE ukulala emgwaqweni Siyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze eGoli, isitshudeni sase-University of South Africa (Unisa), osekuphele iminyaka emithathu singayitholi imali yokufunda.USthembele Ngejane (25) waseMount Moriah, uphenduke isilomo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana emuva kwesibindi sakhe asikhombise ngesonto eledlule. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubengeke aphuthwe yithuba lomfundaze akade ayewudinga. UNgejane ohlala nonina ongasebenzi nodadewabo ababili, waqeda * -matric ngo-2014 eShayamoya High eKokstad, nakhona awufunde esehlale iminyaka emibili ehleli ekhaya ngenxa yokulimala engozini yemoto. Uveze ukuthi sekukaningi impilo yakhe ibambezeleka kodwa akalilahli ithemba.“Ngaqeda esikoleni ngafaka izicelo emanyuvesi ngangazithola izikhala. Ngagcina ngibamba amatoho ezitolo kodwa ngingalilahlile ithemba lokubuyela esikoleni. Ngo-2016 ngamukelwa e-University of Johannesburg ukuyokwenza iHuman Resources Management, ngashoda ngemali yokubhalisa. Ngiphinde ngamukelwa e-Unisa nakhona kwaba nenkinga yemali. Bengifaka ngisho izicelo kuNsfas kodwa ngingaphendulwa,” echaza.Kubuye ithemba kuNgejane kulo nyaka amukelwa e-Unisa ukuyokwenza iNational Diploma in Accounting Sciences. Kuthe esabhalisa ngesonto eledlule wathola ucingo oluqhamuka kwaNYDA ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze abewucelile e-East Rand eGoli. Uthe kwale ngisho ecela ukuthi bamenzisele emahhovisi aseThekwini, bathi udingeka eGoli.“Ngishayele izihlobo ngizama imali, zonke zangichitha. Ngivele ngabhala ibhodi elithi ngiya eGoli ukuyokwenza inhlolokhono yomfundaze, ngama emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka ngoLwesine ebusuku. Bengingenalo ngisho isenti ephaketheni. Emuva kwesikhathi eside ngamelwa owesifazane, naye engangithembi ngoba esola ukuthi ngiyisigebengu. Ugcine engigibelisile wangishiya eGoli, endleleni wangithengela ukudla,” kusho yena.Esefike eGoli ubhale ekhasini likaFacebook lase-Unisa, abantu babheka inombolo yakhe kuFacebook wakhe, bamshayela bamfakela imali. Uthe imali ibingena ubuthaphuthaphu abanye bemfakela i-airtime neyokudla. Ugcine ethengelwe nethikithi lebhasi lokubuyela ekhaya ngoLwesihlanu njengoba ethi ubengazi ukuthi uzobuya kanjani.Kumanje uselinde impendulo yomfundaze kusukela ngenyanga ezayo. Nokho selikhona ithemba lokuthi lizofezeka iphupho lokuba yiChartered Accountant. Uveze ukuthi usebizwe komunye umhlangano ngesinye isikhulu kwezemfundo esimthembise uxhaso.

UKUNGENA ngo-6 ekuseni kuphunywe ngo-10 ebusuku nsuku zonke, ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo ngezimpelasonto ngezinye zezinto ezenza iBizimali High, eNhloshane eNkandla sikhiqize imiphumela emihle kwa-matric.Lesi sikole esigcwele ngokweqile njengoba sinabafundi abevile ku-2 000, amagumbi okufundela angu-21 nothisha ababalelwa ku-60 sesizakhele igama ngokwenza kahle minyaka yonke nakuba sisuke semukele abafundi abasuke sebehlule kwezinye izikole abalethwa kusona ukuze baphume beqondile.Nakuba minyaka yonke senza kahle kodwa sibhekene nengwadla yokushoda kwamanzi nogesi.Ukuze kusetshenziswe izinto ezidinga ugesi kunama-generator amathathu asebenzisa uphethroli obalelwa ku-R6 000 nyanga zonke.Abafundi kudingeka bagwedle ipitsi baziphathele amanzi ngoba kule ndawo okwakhiwe kuyona isikole iyashisa.Ayisithupha amakilasi ka-matric kanti nyakenye bangu-461 abafundi ababhale leli banga, kwaphasa abangu-406 izinga lokuphasa kwaba ngu-88.7%.Uthishanhloko oseneminyaka eyevile ku-20 ebambe izintambo, uMnuz Ntandoyakhe Ntuli (50), uthe ukuzikhandla kothisha nokubamba iqhaza komphakathi esikoleni kubenza benze kahle minyaka yonke.Uthe abanumzane bendawo abalali bahlala kuze kuphume isikole ngo-10 begade abafundi abasuke begoduka.“Iningi lothisha akubona abendawo bahlala emqashweni kubalwa nami. Nginomuzi eThekwini kodwa cishe ngiya kane ngonyaka, isikhathi esiningi sisichitha esikoleni. Siyisikole esithatha abafundi abasuke sebehlule, sibacije baphase ngamalengiso. Uma ubheka ezinye izikole ezenza kahle zihlunga abafundi ezibathathayo ukuze zilokhu zenza kahle,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe abafundi bahlala ngabathathu edeskini cishe kuwona wonke amakilasi ngoba kugcwele.“Besinabafundi abangu-2065, ngokomthetho kumele ngabe sime la ko-1 400 kodwa-ke asikwazi ukunqaba abafundi. Asikwazi nokukhala kakhulu ngoba umnyango uthi yithinta esamukela kakhulu kunokumele sikuthathe. Ngihleli nje nesitifiketi sezempilo esithi kunobungozi bezempilo kodwa ayikho into engingayenza ngoba abazali bayaziletha izingane zabo.”Uthe sekuyisiko nje ukuthi abafundi bakwa-matric baphuma ngo-10 ebusuku, uMgqibelo namaSonto kuyafana.“Kukhona abancintisanayo abaze baphume ngabo-2 ekuseni ngoba bethanda ukufunda. Kuyafundwa akudlalwa, ayikho imfihlo esinayo ngaphandle kwaleyo. Ngezimpelasonto sibhalisa izivivinyo ngakho akukho ukulova kwabafundi ngoba kusuke kubhalwa. Siyashesha ukuphothula isilabhasi bese sibuyekeza.”Uthe lesi sikole sakhiwe ngo-1983 asikaze sibe nogesi uma ama-generator efile basebenzisa amakhandlela.Uthi wafika kulesi sikole singenawo u-matric, sigcina kwaGrade 10 wathi no-100% bake bawuthola ngo-1999 kuya ku-2001.“Sinobudlelwano neWestvile Boys yaseThekwini lapho ngiyisa khona othisha bayothekela ulwazi bafunde nokusetha amaphepha. Ziningi nezinye izikole ezifikayo zizofunda kithina,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe ingxenye enkulu yemali abayithola emnyangweni bathenga ngayo uphethroli wathi ugesi ukhona kwezinye izingxenye kodwa awukho kubona ngoba isikole siphakathi nendawo.“Sibonga umphakathi ukuthi sisebenze kahle nawo. Akugcwelezwa izingane njengoba iningi lazo, nothisha behlala emqashweni. Uma siphuma ebusuku sikhanyisela abafundi amalambu ezimoto ukuze babone indlela uma sebegoduka,” kusho uNtuli.

AMAPHOYISA axwayisa umphakathi ukuthi uqaphele imisebenzi esolisayo ekhangiswa emaphephandabeni nakwi-internet, eminye yawo eyingxenye yomkhuba wokushushumbiswa kwabantu.UCaptain Khephu Ndlovu okhulumela amaphoyisa eThekwini, uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi kusukela ngoDisemba ibe miningi imisebenzi ekhangiswayo, abanye abazithola sebegilekile ngenxa yayo. Ugcizelele ukuthi abantu balandelele ukuthola kabanzi ngomsebenzi okhangiswayo, ngaphambi kokwenza izinhlelo zokufaka izicelo.“Esihlale sixwayisa ngakho abantu wukuthi awukwazi ukuvele uthole umsebenzi ungakaze usifake isicelo sawo. Ngokujwayelekile uma ufaka isicelo somsebenzi, ugcwalisa ifomu ubizelwe nakwinhlololwazi. Kubalulekile ukubheka yonke imininingwane ngalowo msebenzi nokuthi amahhovisi awo akuphi,” kuchaza uNdlovu.UNdlovu uxwayisa nangokuthi abantu babuze yonke imibuzo ukuze baneliseke ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somsebenzi.Ngisho kuwumsebenzi waphesheya uthe ikhona indlela yokuwucubungula.“Ungasheshi ujahe umsebenzi kodwa ungacaciselekile kahle ngawo. Akumele ngisho wenze izinhlelo zokuhlangana nomuntu ongamazi. Okunye abantu abakwenzayo ukuthi bafihlele ngisho imindeni yabo ngoba befuna ukubamangaza uma sebethole amadlelo aluhlaza. Ukwazisa othize kuyasiza uma usuzithola usenkingeni. Uma kuwumsebenzi waphesheya, wonke amazwe anamahhovisi amanxsusa awo, okuyiwona angasiza ukukucacisela ngomsebenzi okhangisiwe,” kusho uNdlovu.Kwenzeka lokhu nje lusematheni udaba lowesifazane oneminyaka engu-22 waseKings William Town e-Eastern Cape, otakulwe oKlebe esezoshushumbiswa.Lo wesifazane oyiBeauty Therapist, kuthiwa wabona kukhangiswa umsebenzi kwi-internet, wenziswa inhlololwazi ngeSkype.Ubeselungiselwe ngisho ithikithi lebhanoyi eliya e-Uganda ngoLwesine olwedlule. Unina usolile ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngalo msebenzi, waxhumana noKlebe abathole ukuthi ubeyosebenza kwenye indawo yokudla.OKlebe bamjikise esikhumulweni sezindiza e-OR Tambo eGoli, wabuyiselwa kubo ngeSonto.Okhulumela oKlebe e-Eastern Cape uCaptain Anelisa Femi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lo wesifazane usebuyiselwe ekhaya.“Uphenyo lusaqhubeka emuva kokuba lo wesifazane kutholakale ukuthi ubehlelelwe ukushushumbiswa. Akekho oseboshiwe kodwa sekutholakele ukuthi ubengaqashelwa umsebenzi obukhangisiwe kodwa ubeyosebenza kwenye indawo yokudla. Amaphoyisa aqale uphenyo ngoba umndeni wakhe ubusola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngalo msebenzi,” kusho uCaptain Femi.

IPHINI likaMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa lithembise ukuthi lizoletha abatshalizimali kuleli njengoba lizobacela ukuthi beze kuleli uma seluya emhlanganweni weWorld Economic Forum (WEF), eDavos, eSwitzerland ngesonto elizayo.URamaphosa uzohamba nongqongqoshe ababhekele ezomnotho nosomabhizinisi ngoJanuwari 23 kuya kuJanuwari 26 uma eseyohlangana nabaholi bomhlaba engqungqutheleni yeWEF.“Ngizozikhulumela mathupha nabatshalizimali ngisizwa wosomabhizinisi bakuleli. Angingabazi ukuthi ngizobuya nabantu abazofaka imali emnothweni wethu, badale amathuba omsebezi, kuthuthuke umnotho.Sizolaya labo abazitshela ukuthi izwe lethu ngeke liphumelele, ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi sakha isithombe esihle kubatshalizimali,” kusho uRamaphosa.Amazwi akhe enanelwe nguMnuz Bonang Mohale oyisikhulu esiphezulu kwaShell SA obuye abe yisikhulu seBusiness Leadership South Africa (BLSA) othe bazosebenzisana nohulumeni ukunxenxa abatshalizimali.“Besiphatheke kabi ngoba ukwehliswa kwezwe lethu kwezomnotho kwakhe isithombe esibi kubatshalizimali kodwa sizimisele ukusebenzisana nohulumeni uma eshaya imithetho noma enza izinguquko, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umnotho uyakhula,” kusho uMohale.Uthe umhlangano weWEF uyithuba lokuthi bahlangane nabanye abaholi bamabhizinisi babaqinisekise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ilindele abatshalizimali futhi umnotho wayo uzokhula.“Abatshalizimali sizobakhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yizwe elilwa nenkohlakalo, elinezinkantolo ezizimele kanjalo namabhange azimele. Wumyalezo esiyowusabalalisa loyo,” kusho uMohale.

IYASHUBA eyeziteleka emanyuvesi aKwaZulu-Natal njengoba izolo kuphazamiseke ukubhalisa eDurban University of Technology (DUT) nase-University of South Africa (Unisa) abasebenzi betelekela ukunyuselwa amaholo. Abasebenzi base-Unisa abangaphansi kweNational Education Health and Allied Workers Union (Nehawu) bafuna ukunyuselwa umholo ngo-12% kulo nyaka, umqashi uthi angabanika u-6%, abaseDUT bafuna u-10% umqashi uthi angabanika * -4%.Izinyunyana zabasebenzi baseDUT abangaphansi kweNehawu, iTertiary Education National Union SA (Tenusa) neNational Tertiary Education Union (NTEU) bangenele isiteleka ngoMsombuluko.Ngalolu suku bavule ngemashi ebiqondiswe koyiPhini likaShansela wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu.Izolo, abasebenzi abebethi babona sengathi umphathi uyabaziba babuyele ehhovisi lakhe befuna ukukhuluma naye.UMnuz Milton Estrice okhulumela lezi zinyunyana uthe kusukela bahambisa uhlu lwezikhalo ngalolu suku kuMthembu akukaze kube khona mpendulo noma umhlangano ohleliwe phakathi kwezinyunyana nomqashi.“Sibona sengathi iphini likaShansela lizishaya indiva izikhalo zethu kungakho namhlanje (izolo) sithe asibuye size ehhovisi lakhe ukuze asichazele ukuthi umi kuphi nodaba lwethu.“Sidinga isixazululo esisheshayo ngalolu daba ngoba sibona sengathi akazimisele ukululungisa,” kusho yena.Abasebenzi bazithele phezu konogada abebevimbile ehhovisi lomphathi, abasebenza kuleli hhovisi abathe akekho.ABASEBENZI baseDurban University of Technology (DUT) abatelekele ukwenyuselwa umholo izolo bemasha belibangise kumphathi wale nyuvesi, uSolwazi Thandwa Mthembu Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBOBathi uthe uzothumela umyalezo nge-email mayelana nomhlangano wokucacisango-4% no-6% umqashi azimisele ukunyusela ngayo abasebenzi.“Thina asiwazi u-6% ngoba sazi ukuthi abasebenzi abaqashwanga ngaphansi kohlelo olwaziwa nge-cost to company, yingakho sitshele abezindaba ukuthi umqashi ufuna ukubenyusela umholo ngo-4%. Sisamile ekutheni ngeke sibuyele emsebenzini lungalungisiwe lolu daba,” kusho yena.Lesi sikhungo siqashe abasebenzi besikhashana abebesebenzela kwenye ingxenye yenyuvesi abebebhalisa abafundi.UNksz Noxolo Memela oyimenenja yezokuxhumana kule nyuvesi, uthe inyuvesi izimisele ukulungisa lesi simo ngokushesha.Uthe abaphathi bazimisele ukuhlangana nezinyunyana kuleli sonto ukuze kuxazululwe udaba lwamaholo, olwaqala ukudingidwa ngoMeyi nyakenye.“Izitshudeni nabanye abantu abangena enyuvesi baphephile,” kusho yena.Khonamanjalo e-Unisa, abasebenzi abangaphansi kweNehawu bamise ukubhalisa befuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-12%.Okhulumela iNehawu, uMnuz Khaya Xaba, uthe umqashi ufuna ukunyusa amaholo ngo-6% wathi bakhathele ukuthathwa kancane ngabakule nyuvesi.“Sifuna kuqashwe ngokugcwele abasebenzi abayitoho kuyekwe ukuxhashazwa kwabo emnyangweni wezobuchwepheshe.“Siyazi inyuvesi ingakwazi ukunyusela abasebenzi umholo ngoba babalelwa ku-400 000 abafundi ababhaliswayo minyaka yonke kanti kunoR400 billion osezinqolobaneni. Sizoteleka baze bahlangabezane nezimfuno zethu.”Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela le nyuvesi uMnuz Matrin Ramotshela ayiphumelelanga, ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nemibuzo athunyelwe yona akayiphendulanga.

source: abaseka umncwango bathi ida ikhuliswe wukuholwa nguye
text: USEKWA nayiziMeya zomasipala abakhulu eGauteng umholi weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango (osesithombeni), iqembu lakhe elibheke engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe ezoba se-Olive Convention Centre, eThekwini, ngoFebhuwari 3.IMeya yaseJohannesburg, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, neMeya yaseTshwane, uMnuz Solly Msimanga, ngoLwesibili baphumele obala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana baseka uMncwango ekutheni abuyiselwe esikhundleni sakhe.UMashaba noMsimang bathi iDA ikhule kakhulu eKZN iholwa wuMncwango.UMncwango ubanga isikhundla sokuhola iqembu eKZN noMnuz Emmanuel Mhlongo oyikhansela laseThekwini.Oke waba yimbangi kaMncwango enkulu, uMnuz Sizwe Mchunu, akazange awungenele umbango.Esikhundleni sikaSihlalo wenhlangano esifundazweni kubanga uMnuz Francois Rodgers noMnuz Dean Mcpherson.UMncwango ukwamukele ukuphakanyiswa kwakhe.Ilungu leDA esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Hlanganani Gumbi, ngoLwesibili uthe lifisa uMncwango ukuthi aqhubeke nokuhola iqembu esifundazweni.UGumbi uthe iDA ikhulise ukwesekwa kwayo esifundazweni iholwa nguMncwango.“Okokuqala emlandweni iDA inamakhansela uMkhanyakude wonke, namakhansela KwaNongoma nakwezinye izindawo zasekhaya. Konke lokhu sikuzuze ngoMncwango,” kusho uGumbi.Uthe kumanje iDA ihola omasipala abaningi KwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana ne-IFP. “Uma kusenoMncwango iDA izosuka ekubuseni ngokubambisana ne-IFP igcine sekuyiyona yodwa ebusayo,” kusho uGumbi.

source: isoka libhokode intombi yafa iya esikoleni
text: KUSHAQEKE umndeni isoka leminyaka licuthela intombi ngovivi, iya esikoleni layigwaza liphindelela yashona khona lapho kulandela ingxabano, okusolwa ukuthi ibihlangene nokuthi isoka belingafuni umufi abuyele esikoleni.UNosiphiwo Ntombela (18) obefunda uGrade 11 eKlwana Combined School, eBabanango, kuvela ukuthi ubehleli ekhaya iminyaka emithathu ekhulisa ingane yabo, kulo nyaka wakhetha ukubuyela esikoleni ngoba eseyibona isikhulile.Kuzwakala ukuthi lezi zindaba azehlanga kahle esokeni njengoba liwumuntu obegajwa isikhwele ngobala futhi lihlala linolaka, obekwenza umufi ahlale engathokozile.Udadewabo omdala kamufi uthi leli soka belivele lihlala limchukuluza udadewabo kodwa ubengazitsheli ukuthi lingaze limbulale. UNksz Ntombela uthe naye belike limfonele limtshela ngezinsolo elinazo ngodadewabo.Uthe belihlale lisho izinto ezihambisana nokumsola ukuthi uyajola kodwa lingabuvezi ubufakazi balokho.Ngokusho kwesinye isihlobo salo mndeni esingathandanga ukudalulwa, leli soka bese libamba amatoho eGoli. Kuthe uma lizwa ukuthi unina wengane yalo usebuyele esikoleni, kwangalithokozisa lokho, lafuthelana njengoba lize lamcuthela eya esikoleni. Kuthiwa belijwayele ukumsola ngomjolo kodwa libuye lixolise.“Kubuhlungu lokhu asizwise khona ngoba kucacile wehlulwe ukwamukela ukuthi ubudlelwano babo bese buphelile. Akekho obemazi ukuthi ukhona ngoba sizwe sekufona omakhelwane ekuseni kade esanda kuhamba udadewethu.“Uphume la ekhaya ngo-6. 20 ngoba isikole sithanda ukuqhela. Kusho ukuthi ubemcuthele endleleni. Ngimfice enamanxeba amaningi okugwazwa.“Abemaningi ngendlela yokuthi ngihlulekile ngisho ukubona ukuthi abemangaki,” kusho uNksz Ntombela ovele wakhihla isililo ngenxa yomunyu.NoMnyango wezeMfundo izolo uzwakalise okukhulu ukushaqeka ngalesi sigameko.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa uthe ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe lizwelana kakhulu nomndeni nothisha nabafundi ngalesi sigameko.“Sidumele ngokwehlele lo mfundi. Sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini nesikole sakhe. Siyethemba umthetho uzokwenza okufanele. Sidinga ukubambisana nomphakathi ukulwa nodlame,” kusho uMlotshwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCaptain Nqobile Gwala usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko nokuthi umufi ugwazwe umuntu owaziwayo esendleleni. "Okwamanje akekho osaboshiwe,” kusho uCapt Gwala.

AMAWELE adume kuma-Idols abuye ahlala isikhathi eside emzini womfundisi waseNigeria obhekene namacala okudlwengulwa, akhulume okokuqala ngakubize ngokuhlukumezeka kwawo ebandleni lakhe.U-Aneliswa noNelisa Mxakaza (22) baseMayville, eThekwini, bakhiphe isitatimende kuFacebook bexolisa ngokuvikela uMfundisi Tim Omotoso ngesikhathi eboshwa emuva kokubekwa amacala ngonyaka odlule. Amawele ahlala unyaka emzini ka-Omotoso eMhlanga engamalungu ebandla lakhe iJesus Dominion International.Ngesikhathi u-Omotoso eboshwa esikhumulweni sezindiza ePort Elizabeth ngo-Ephreli, elinye lamawele lamvikela isidana. U-Omotoso ubhekene noxhaxha lwamacala okubalwa kuwo awokushushumbisa abantu nawokudlwengula.Esitatimendeni amawele athe abefana nabantu abalahlekelwe yingqondo ngenxa yempilo abeyiphila ebandleni.“Siyaxolisa kubo bonke abesifazane ngoba besibukeka sivuna u-Omotoso emacaleni okuya ocansini abhekene nawo. Sithanda ukuxolisa nakulabo abagiliwe ngoba siyabazi bonke bafana nodadewethu. Asizange sibaseke ngesikhathi bebhoboza ithumba ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabo ngoba sasiphoqekile ukuvikela u-Omotoso kwabezindaba,” kusho amawele.Isitatimende siveza ukuthi bebephoqwa ukuthi bangakhulumi okubi ngo-Omotoso.“Besihlala ngokusatshiswa ngoba akukho ebesizenzela kona ngoba sithanda. Izikhulu zebandla zasenza sabaleka emakhaya sayohlala no-Omotoso. Njengoba besiyizingane besitshelwa ukuthi nguyena osondelene noNkulunkulu, okumele sidlule kuyena kuqala. Siyazisola ngokudela abazali bethu salalela umfundisi esingamazi waseNigeria.”UMnuz Mando Makhubela, amawele amjube ukuthi awakhulumele, uthe kusenzima kuwona ukuzikhulumela ngendlela ahlulelwe ngayo ngodaba luka-Omotoso. Uthe basazama ukuthi alulekwe ngokomqondo ukuze impilo ibuyele esimeni ngokuphelele. Uziphikile izinsolo zokuthi amawele, athe aphunyuka engakaze athintwe.“Kuningi ukuhlukumezeka ngokomoya abadlule kuko u-Anele noNeliswa kodwa abazange badlwengulwe. Bebexoxelwa ngamantombazane ngokwenzeka kuwo aze anqume ukubaleka. Bekunzima ukuphumela obala ngoba bebesatshiswa. Bebegadwa usuku lonke bephuma kuphela uma beyothenga futhi bephelezelwa,” kusho uMakhubela.Uthe akuzange kube nokuthula ekhaya kusukela amawele aya kwa-Omotoso, okuyimanje asazama ukubuyisana nomndeni. Uveze nokuthi ngesikhathi eyohlala kwa-Omotoso ayesebhalisele ukuyofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal kodwa kulo nyaka abuyele ekolishi ukuyofunda.Okhulumela ibandla, uMfundisi Sanele Myeni, uthe bazwile ngesitatimende kodwa ngeke baphawule ngoba udaba lusenkantolo. U-Omotoso uvele enkantolo ngoMsombuluko icala lahlehliselwa uMashi 6.Kuvele ukuthi sekuboshwe nabesifazane ababili okusolwa ukuthi ubesebenzisana nabo ukushushumbisa abesifazane.

SEKUBHEKWE isigungu esiphezulu se-ANC ukuba sinqume ngekusasa lesigungu sesikhashana esihola inhlangano esifundazweni ngemuva kokuqubuka kwezikhalo. Kukhona abathi asihlakazwe.Izolo amalungu e-ANC aseka uMnuz Senzo Mchunu abebhikisha ngaphandle kwamahhovisi ale nhlangano eThekwini efuna kuhlakazwe isigungu sesikhashana esiholwa uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu noMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ekhala ngokuthi sicheme nohlangothi lukaZikalala.Awu-12, amalungu esigungu sikaZikalala asesigungwini sesikhashana ekubeni mane kuphela avela ohlangothini lukaMchunu, ohambisana noMabuyakhulu.Ngesikhathi abalandeli bakaMchunu bebhikisha, amaphoyisa abesiqaphe ngelokhozi isimo.Ababhikishi bebecula izingoma ezeseka uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa noMchunu.Bebecula izingoma ezizwakalisa ukungamfuni uNobhala-jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Ace Magashule, bemchapha nangenhlamba.Omunye wabebehola abebebhikisha, uMnuz Mthunzi Dlamini uthe bazokwethula izikhalo zabo ebuholini benhlangano.Uthe kukhona ukungeneliseki ngokubunjwa kwesigungu sesikhashana. “Ubuholi bukazwelonke buyazi ngezikhalo zethu. Siyathemba ukuthi buzozisukumela,” kusho uDlamini.UDlamini ube nomhlangano noMabuyakhulu noZikalala.Esithangamini nabezindaba izolo uMabuyakhulu uthe bayazi ngezikhalo, ubuholi obuphezulu buzozisebenza.UMabuyakhulu uxwayise amalungu ukuthi ayeke ukwenza izinto ezidala ukuthi kube noqhekeko enhlanganweni.“Umbutho usesikhathini lapho uzama ukuzivuselela khona, uzama nokudala ubumbano. Siyakukhuza ukuthi amalungu enze izinto ezingenza ukuthi iphupho lokubumba inhlangano ligcine lingafezekanga,” kusho uMabuyakhulu.Uthe uRamaphosa akayena umengameli wohlangothi oluthile kodwa ungumengameli we-ANC yonke.UZikalala uthe bahlanganile namaqabane abhikishayo, akuveza ukuthi umbhikisho wawo awuqondene ne-ANC esifundazweni kodwa ubhekiswe ebuholi benhlangano kuzwelonke.“La maqabane abhikishayo aphinde aveza nokuthi awakholwa ukuthi ingqungquthela yesifundazwe izokwazi ukuhlala ezinyangeni ezintathu njengoba kusho ubuholi bukazwelonke,” kusho uZikalala.Imizamo yokuthola okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uNkk Khusela Diko ayiphumelelanga. Ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa nomyalezo athunyelelwe wona kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela engakawuphenduli.UMagashule ekhuluma emgubhweni weminyaka engu-106 kwabunjwa i-ANC, eMgungundlovu ngeSonto, uthe ithimba lesikhashana balikhethe bangabheka ukuthi ngubani oweseka bani.Uthe inhloso yalo wukubumba amagatsha, kube nengqungquthela ngo-Ephreli nonyaka.Uqhube wathi akazange alikhethe eyedwa leli thimba lesifundazwe kodwa lakhethwa wubuholi obuphezulu be-ANC ngokuhlanganyela.UMagashule uthe ngeke asishiye isikhundla sakhe ngoba uyazi kukhona abamzamayo.

IVULELWE icala lokwesabisa iMeya kaMasipala waKwaNongoma uMnuz Albert Mncwango emuva komsindo oqubuke kulo masipala mayelana nethenda yonogada okuthiwa isinikwe enye inkampani. Kuthiwa kunqanyulwe inkontileka yeMighty B Security kwafakwa i-Eros Security.UMnuz Zwelethu Mbhele (49) oyinhloko yonogada abephucwe ithenda usola uMncwango ngokumesabisa nokwenze wagcina esemthathele izinyathelo zomthetho. UMbhele uthi emuva kokuba bephucwe ithenda kwabe sekukhangiswa kabusha naye wahamba ethi uyofaka isicelo senkampani yabo.“Ngafika kwathiwa ugesi awukho, ngeke bakwazi ukugaya amaphepha ngalinda khona emahhovisi kamasipala. Kwaqhamuka izimoto zikaMncwango, wehla waqonda kimi wangisongela wathi ngimthukile uzongikhombisa abantu. Wathi ngeke avume yena ukudlala mina, uzongifundisa isifundo ungowakwaMncwango yena," kusho uMbhele.Ethintwa uMncwango ngalolu daba uvele wafa yinsini, wathi ayikho yonke le nto eshiwo uMbhele.“Lo muntu waqala ngokwesabisa imenenja kamasipala, wangethuka ehamba ethi kubantu ufuna ukungibona. Ngesikhathi ngiya kuye ngangimnika ithuba lokungibona nokukhuza ukuthi ahlukane nokusabisa abasebenzi ngoba sekwake kwabulawa omunye umsebenzi lapha singazi kanjani," kusho uMncwango.Ukhale nangokuthi uMbhele wayefika ephethe isibhamu emahhovisi nokwakubonakala kuyingozi.“Akuvumelekile ukungena nesibhamu emahhovisi kamasipala kodwa yena ubegcaluza nesibhamu esabisa nabasebenzi benkampani entsha ethi uzoke abone ukuthi bazosebenza kanjani. Ngaze ngabikela abaphathi bakhe ngalolu daba," kuqhuba uMncwangoUthe uyabona ukuthi enye into ekhalisa uMbhele ukuphucwa ithenda.UMbhele umile kwelokuthi uMncwango wamesabisa futhi kufanele ashushiswengalokho.

source: umkhonto ugwaze ekhaya ngolwesabc nobathabile dlamini
text: INHLANGANO yezokusakaza kuleli, iSABC, ithi iphutha libe kuyona mayelana nesamba semali obekufanele isikhokhelwe wuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke, ngokusakazwa kwengxoxo noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uNksz Bathabile Dlamini kwiReal Talk with Anele kuSABC3.Ikomiti elibhekene nezindaba nokuhlelwa kwazo ngaphansi kwebhodi lakwaSABC, izolo likhiphe isitatimende livuma ukuthi yile nhlangano eyaphula imithetho yayo ngale ngxoxo kaNksz Dlamini esisuse umsindo, eyasakazwa ngoDisemba 7 no-8.Leli komiti beliziphendulela ngemuva kokugxekwa wumphakathi kulandela ukuputshuka kwezindaba zokuthi uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi wakhokhela iSABC imali engu-R149 000 ukuze kukhishelwe eshashalazini uNksz Dlamini kwiReal Talk with Anele.Umnyango wavuma ukukhokhela iSABC uR149 000 ngokuba nengxoxo, okuyisamba esingadalulwanga emphakathini.Okhulumela iSABC, uMnuz Kaizer Kganyago uthe akukho zinyathelo ezizothathelwa umuntu ngoba le nhlangano itholile ukuthi yiyona eyaba nephutha.“Ibhodi lenelisekile ukuthi leli phutha lalingahlosiwe. Sasuke sagxila ekutheni le ngxoxo yayiwudaba kodwa sakhohlwa ukulandela eminye imigomo yakwaSABC. Ngenxa yalokho akukho muntu ozojeziswa,” kuphendula uKganyago.Uthe umnyango wawungeke uthunyelelwe yi-SABC i-invoice ngale ngxoxo. Uthe lihlanganile ibhodi ladingida kabanzi ngale nkokhelo.I-SABC ithe ayilandelanga inqubomgomo yayo ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo sokusakaza lezi ziqephu.Lolu daba lususe umsindo nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kangangoba * -Anele ube manaphanapha yinhlamba esolwa ngokugwazelwa ngoR500 000 ukuze akhulume noNksz Dlamini kulolu hlelo. Eziphendulela * -Anele kwiTwitter, uthe yena umsulwa ngoba iSABC egunyaza ukuba kusakazwe uhlelo.“Yibo abanezwi eliphelele ohlelweni. Mina ngiholelwa yiSABC. Umnyango uxhumana neSABC. Ophrojusa bathatha izinqumo bese mina ngenza ucwaningo ngisakaze uhlelo. Ngiyacela ukhulume neSABC hhayi mina umuntu odumile odabeni,” kusho * -Anele. Kuthe kusenjalo nomrepha uKwesta wabhuqa * -Anele kwiTwitter ngokubhala ukuthi ‘Oh yingakho sivalelwa ngaphandle.” Ubuye esevutha bhe * -Anele esola uKwesta ngokuba namanga, wathi bese kuyihlandla lesine bemmema kulolu hlelo kodwa engalubhadi.Ugcine exolisile uKwesta ku-Anele nasethimbeni asebenzisana nalo.Lesi sitatimende seSABC sithe * -Anele nethimba lakhe babelandela imiyalelo.Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli phutha ngeke liphinde lenzeke, iSABC izibophezele ukuthi isizolandela inqubomgomo yayo futhi ishicilele nemisha ezoyibeka ukuze wonke umsebenzi wakwaSABC angazitholi eseyiphula engazi.“Iziphathimandla zizokwazisa iGCIS ukuthi iSABC ngeke iyithumele i-invoice yokukhokhelwa uR149, 000, okuyimali obekufanele kukhokhelwe ngayo le nkulumo ngxoxo”.Okhulumela uNksz Dlamini uNksz Lumka Oliphant phambilini uke wacashunwa ethi into eyenza bafune ukuyovela kulolu hlelo lwezingxoxo, wukuzama ukudlulisa umyalezo kubantu, babatshele ukuthi ungqongqoshe akabuphuzi utshwala. Wathi sebezame bahluleka.

BATHWALE kanzima izolo abasebenzi besitolo sezimpahla zesikole, iGem Schoolwear, ngenxa yesiminyaminya sabebezothenga umfaniswano wesikole ngosuku lokugcina ngaphambi kokuvulwa kwezikole namuhla.Uma uqhamuka eGem, esenkabeni yeTheku, ubukhangwa wulayini omude obheke emnyango waso. Bese kuvulwe intuba eyodwa yokungena, kwabiywa nangothango locingo ukugwema isiminyaminya. Ngasemnyango bekukhona unogada nephoyisa lesifazane, bengenisa kuphela abanokukhubazeka nabakhulelwe. Abanye bebekhonjwa kulayini obusuzungeze lonke ibhilidilesitolo.Abazali abaningi bebehamba nezingane ukuzolinganisa umfaniswano wesikole. Ngezikhathi zasemini ulayini ubungakanciphi, kunalokho abantu bese bethetha bekhala ngokuhamba kancane kwawo ngenxa yokuthi abasebenzi bebeshintshana ngokuyodla. Ngaphakathi abasebenzi bebetatazela bekhipha imifaniswano yezikole ezehlukene.UNkk Philile Ndlazi waseMlaza obehamba nendodakazi yakhe uthe kukhona ezinye izimpahla zesikole azithenga ngoDisemba kodwa zangaphelela ngoba enezingane ezintathu ezifundayo. Ubeselinde ukuthi ahole ekuqaleni kwaleli sonto nokuthi izingane zibuye emaholidini ukuze aqedele ukuthenga.Abanye abazali bebezoshintsha osayizi bezingane ezazingekho bezithengela.UMnuz Muhammed Salie, omunye wabaphethe kwaGem Schoolwear, uthe nabo bamangele ngoba akusajwayelekile ukuthi kugcwale kangaka sekusondele ukuthi kuvulwe izikole. Baqale ukuba matasa kakhulu ngoMsombuluko, okungenzeka ukuthi abanye abazali bebelinde ukuhola.“Indlela okugcwele ngayo ngeke sivale uma kusekhona abafuna ukuthenga. Olayini kabanciphi ngoba kusukela ekuseni bekugcwele. Besicabanga ukuthi bambalwa abazothenga sekuzovulwa izikole ngoba bathenga nangoDisemba,” kusho uSalie.Uthe bayazama ukusheshisela abathengi ngoba banabasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-100, abanye abaqashelwe itoho ukuze babhekane nomthamo wesikhathi sokuba matasa.“Sandise nonogada ukuze sigweme isiminyaminya. Sicele namaphoyisa ukuthi alekelele ukuqinisa ezokuphepha. Siyazi ukuthi uma kugcwele nezigebengu zithola ithuba lokubamba inkunzi,” kusho uSalie.USalie uthe namuhla bazovula ngaphambi kwesikhathi esijwayelekile ekuseni ukwenzela abazali abazobe bezoqedela ukuthenga njengoba kuvulwa izikole.

SEKUWUMKHUBA ojwayelekile ukuzwa ukuthi kunomzalwane noma umfundisi osolwa ngokudla umnikelo webandla elithile.Lokhu kugcina kuthela amabandla ngehlazo, ngoba imvamisa yalaba bantu abasolwa ngalokhu, basuke benezikhundla emabandleni abakhonza kuwo nokwenza kungabi lula ukuthi babone abazalwane uma sebexhaphazeka. Inhlangano ebhekele ukusebenza kwamabandla iKwaZulu-Natal Council of Churches nayo ike yakuveza phambilini ukuthi sekukaningi ithola ngalezi zigameko emabandleni ahlukene.UMengameli wale nhlangano uDkt Lucas Ngoetjana, uthi kunanoma yiliphi ibandla kumele kube nekomidi elinabantu ababhekela ukusebenza kwebandla kanjalo nomnikelo walo.UDkt Ngoetjana uthi lokhu kusiza ekutheni ibandla likwazi ukuhlala lihlangane licubungule amabhuku alo ukuthola imali eselinayo esikhwameni kanjalo nesisebenzile.“Kuyenzeka kula mabandla esimanje uthole umfundisi ebhekele zonke izinto ebandleni. Ngisho nomnikelo uthole uqoqwa nguyena kulezi zinkonzo esezigcwele manje. Kodwa ngokomthetho kusungulwa ikomidi ebandleni bese nemali ihlukaniswa ngokwezidingo zayo.“Kuyaye kubhalwe phansi nemali esele emva kokuba ibandla selikhokhele indawo elikhonzela kuyo lenza nezidingo zalo,” kusho uDkt Ngoetjana.Uqhube wathi abazalwane banelungelo lokwaziswa ngomnikelo wabo ukuthi usebenze kanjani.Uthe lokho akusho ukuthi banokholo oluncane kodwa kuyasiza ukugcina nomlando webandla umuhle.Ukuhlala isikhathi eside umuntu engalandelwa ngemali yomnikelo, nakho kungamenza angene esilingweni sokuyisebenzisela izinhloso zakhe.Okunye Okumele ibandlalikwenze ukuvikela umnikelo:-Uma kuyibandla elikhulu igatsha ngalinye alibe nomgcinimafa walo. Emabandleni amakhulu akumele kubekwe umuntu oyedwa ozogcina imali yebandla.-Ayibalwe imali yomnikelo bese kubhalwa phansi ngaphambi kokuthi ihlanganiswe nendala.-Uma ifakwa ebhange akube khona ubufakazi obuphathekayo nobuzogcinwa mayelana nokusebenza kwayo.-Kulaba abathengela abazalwane ukudla akube nobufakazi benani legilosa ethengwayo ukuze kwaziwe ukuthi imali yenzeni.-Ikota nekota yonyaka kufanele kube nomhlangano wokuchaza kabanzi ngemali esisebenzile nesalondoloziwe ebhange.-Imali ekhokhela indlu kwabarentayo, ugesi, amanzi, unogada nezinye izidingo eziqondene nebandla, nayo kumele ibe nobufakazi neziliphu eziwubufakazi bokuthi kuyakhokhelwa ngempela.

AMAPHAPHU aphezulu kosomatekisi abakwiMpumalanga Taxi Owners Association emuva kokubulawa kukaMnuz Mthethomusha “Mthetho” Ngubane (38), odutshulwe emgwaqweni uN3 eduze kwaseHammarsdale, izolo ekuseni nomunye odutshulwe ngabo-6.30 ntambama.Kushaye isikhathi sokushicilela lingakatholakali igama likasomatekisi wesibili obulewe kodwa izindaba zokudutshulwa kwakhe ziqinisekiswe nguSihlalo weSantaco eDurban West uMnuz Mathula Mkhize othe sebezwile ukuthi kulimale omunye kodwa basaqoqa imininingwane.Osomatekisi abangathandanga ukudalulwa amagama ngenxa yokusaba ukuthi bangase badutshulwe bathe isimo asisihle kusoseshini waseMpumalanga njengoba ungenabo ubuholi obuphezulu.Baveze ukuthi ngoJulayi nyakenye kudutshulwe iPhini likaSihlalo, uMnuz Dumisani Magwaza kwathi ngoKhisimusi kwabulawa uMnuz Mbhekeni Hlophe odutshulwe ngentululwane yezinhlamvu.UMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa, obhekelele ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha koMphakathi nokuXhumana KwaZulu-Natal, uthe uNgqongqoshe uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda ukhathazekile ngokubulawa kosomatekisiembonini.“Ungqongqoshe uhlela umhlangano namalungu kasoseshini waseMpumalanga nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukuthola ukuthi kwenzekani. Umhlangano uzoba maduze ngoba ungqongqoshe ufuna siphele isihlava sokubulawa kosomatekisi. Ugqugquzela namaphoyisa ukuthi akuphenyisisie ukubulawa kosomatekisi,” kusho uMntungwa.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kaNgubane ukuthi uphawule ayiphumelelanga njengoba zingatholakalanga izinombolo zawo.UMkhize, uthe baphatheke kabi ngokuqothana eMpumalanga futhi bazoba nomhlangano namalungu akhona lingakapheli isonto.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe ngabo-6.50 ekuseni amaphoyisa athole isidumbu sowesilisa (38) sinamanxeba okudutshulwa kwesingenhla.“Amaphoyisa aseHammarsdale aphenya icala lokubulala, ayikakatholakali imbangela yokubulawa kwalona wesilisa. Asikakabophi muntu futhi sicela noma ngubani onemininingwane ngalesi sigameko ukuthi athinte amaphoyisa aseduze naye noma iCrime Stop ku-08600 10111,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.

source: sekwanele uyala abesililsa odonsa esokubulala inkosikazi
text: INDODA eyabulala inkosikazi iyisola ngokuthi iqomile, iyala abesilisa ababhekene nesimo esifanayo ukuba bangababulali kodwa bebashiye ukugwema ukubhadla ejele njengaye odonsa iminyaka engu-14.UMnuz Thokozani Malloy (48) waKwaNzimakwe ngasePort Edward ugwetshwe ngoMeyi 2016, wanikezwa iminyaka engu-12 ngecala lokubulala uNkk Ntokozo Malloy neminyaka emibili ngelokusabisa indodana yakhe eyayingufakazi ecaleni lokubulala.UNkk Malloy wabulawa ngo-Disemba 2014.Lezi zithandani ezatholana zisafunda isikole ngo-1992 zase zishada ngo-2000, zaba nabantwana abathathu.UMalloy owayeyiphoyisa lomgwaqo ePort Shepstone esesebenze iminyaka engu-20, eseqedile ngempilo yenkosikazi yakhe naye wazama ukuzibulala ngokuzidubula ekhanda, inhlamvu yaphaphalaza yaphuma neso lakhe.Emuva kokwanda kwezigameko zabesifazane ababulawa abathandana nabo, Isolezwe libe nengxoxo ekhethelekile noMalloy ejele laseWestville lapho egwetshwe khona.“Ngifunde okukhulu ngesinqumo esingesihle engasenza sokubulala inkosikazi wami ngoba ngithola ukuthi uyajola. Engifisa ukukutshela abantu besilisa wukuthi uma bezithola kulesi simo, ukubulala umuntu othandana naye akusona isixazululo ngoba ubulala umuntu uphinde umoshe nempilo yakho neyomndeni wakho. Uma kunzima kungcono umshiye phansi ungaze wenze ozozisola ngakho,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe wayengakaze acabange ukuthi empilweni yakhe angathatha isibhamu abulale umuntu amthandayo.“Sihlalile sithandana nonkosikazi, saze sashada konke kuhamba kahle. Ngo-2010 izinto ziqalile ukungahambi kahle. Ngaphenya ngo-2013 ngigcine ngitholile ukuthi kunomuntu athandana naye. Ngabheka kwiselula yakhe emuva kokuba omunye umngani wakhe wesifazane engitshelile ukuthi impela unesoka. Ngabona izingqoxo nesoka lakhe kuWhatsApp, saxoxa kwaba sengathi kuyadlula,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe ukuba nolaka nenhliziyo encane ehambisana nokudinwa into ayevele enayo kodwa engazitsheli ukuthi kungaze kufike ekubulaleni umuntu.“Izinkinga phakathi kwami nonkosikazi zaqhubeka, ngo-2014 saze sahlala ngokuhlukana. Kwaze kwaba kufika lapho ngihluleka khona ngoDisemba ngaya kubo ngiyoxoxa naye ngendaba yomshado wethu. Saxabana ngavele ngakhipha isibhamu, wabaleka waya emzini kadadewabo lapho engafika ngamdubulela khona nami ngazidubula,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe akazi wasinda kanjani ngoba wayethi uyaqeda ngempilo yakhe.“Namanje kusangimangaza ukuthi ngaphila kanjani ngoba ngangizibulala. Ngaphaphama esibhedlela emuva kwesikhathi kwenzeke lokhu. Abantu abase bengitshela ukuthi kwenzekani endaweni yesigameko,” kusho uMalloy.Ngenxa yesimo sakhe sempilo uze wagwetshwa ngoMeyi 2016, ngemuva kokuphuma engena ezibhedlela.“Ukubulala kwami unkosikazi kwangilahlekisela ngomsebenzi, nomndeni wami njengoba ngingakwazi ukuhlala nezingane zethu ezineminyaka engu-22, 17 neneyisishiyagalombili. Ukuba nenhliziyo encane, nokudinwa akubuyiseli ngalutho. Abantu besilisa kumele bafunde ukulawula imizwa yabo, kungabi iyona ebalawulayo,” kusho uMalloy.Uthe ukungena ejele kuningi okumfundise khona njengoba efunde ngendlela yokulawula ukudinwa nendlela yokuziphatha nje.“Ngesikhathi sengenza lokhu angizange ngicabange ukuthi ngiwubaba ezinganeni zami, ziyangidinga. Angikucabanganga futhi nokuthi uma sengibulele unina, zizosala nobani uma sengiboshiwe njengoba ngisejele manje. Isinqumo osithatha ungacabanganga siyingozi,” kweluleka uMalloy.Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi amadoda angempela awabahlukumezi abesifazane.“Indoda yangempela ayimhlukumezi umuntu wesifazane. Ayimshayi umuntu wesifazane. Induku ayakhi, ngiyazi sikhule kuthiwa uyakhiwa ngenduku kodwa lokho akusilona iqiniso. Ukuxoxa nokubonisana yikhona okwakhayo uma uthi uyindoda,” kusho uMalloy.Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi sewaxolisa kubantwana bakhe yize kwakuyinto enzima kakhulu ngoba babengafuni nokumbona.

source: imibono sengathi lungaba yimpumelelo uhlelo lwemilutha ethekwini
text: MHLELI: KwiSolezwe langoMsombuluko Juni 25 ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: Uhlelo lokutakula imilutha eThekwini, ngithi ake ngibeke owami umbono ngalolu daba.Izwe lakithi liphansi kwenkulu ingcindezi yobugebengu obudlange iNingizimu Afrika yonkana. Manje ukugijimisa izigebengu kukhona umuntu olala phandle ongaziwa ukuthi uziphilisa ngani, ngibona sengathi ukunyanyalata lokho ekukhucululeni ubugebengu.Uhlelo lweMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, lokuthi lwenabele kuwona wonke ama-ward uhlelo lokuqoqa imilutha yezidakamizwa eyaziwa ngamaphara, inikwe amakhono kuze igcine iyeke izidakamizwa. Lokhu kuzokhulisa umnotho wezwe kunciphise ubugebengu.Sengathi lungaba yimpumelelo lolu hlelo nomphakathi ulekelele kusizwe laba bantu.Sphamandla MagwazaeShowe

INDODA okusolwa ukuthi ibidle izidakamizwa ivulele ngenhlamvu esidlangaleni kunabantu ebebezihambela emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza, maqede yabhekisa isibhamu kuyo yazidubula yafa izolo.Indoda, eyaziwa ngokuthi ingumakhi wezindlu odabuka kwelinye lamazwe ase-Afrika, kuthiwa inguMnuz Sdu Sithole. Imangaze abaningi ngesikhathi imisa imoto erobhothini kwaV, yaphuma yavulela inhlamvu esidlangaleni, kungaziwa ukuthi idubula bani.Kuthiwa kukhale ubumayemaye abantu bebaleka nxazonke. Kuthiwa ibonakale sengathi iyakujabulela lokhu ngesikhathi ikwenza ngoba ibigibele okhakhayini lwemoto. Ibidubula ibuye igxumele phansi idubule iyizungeze imoto. Kuthe kusenjalo kwaqhamuka amaphoyisa, athe engakafiki nakuyo yabhekisa isibhamu kuyo yazidubula yashonela khona lapho.Omunye ozibonele lokhu kwenzeka kodwa ongathandanga ukuthi igama lakhe lidalulwe, uthe uSithole ubengapheli kwaV futhi uyaziwa khona. Ubejwayele ukuhamba nabantu abakha izindlu emotweni yakhe.“Uyaziwa kule ndawo yize ngingamazi ukuthi uhlala kuphi. Ngiyacabanga ukuthi uhlala khona kwaV, siyazi nokuthi uyaphuza futhi ubuye asebenzise nezidakamizwa kodwa bekungakaze kwenzeke ukuthi akhiphe isibhamu. Bekungathi sibuka ifilimu, angazi noma kukhona yini abekusho ngoba sonke bese sicashile sesaba ukudubuleka. Ngiyasola ukuthi ubedle izidakamizwa, akekho umuntu obengenza le nto edakwe wutshwala kuphela. Ucishe walimaza abantu ngoba le ndawo iyaphithizela,” kusho yena.Kunenqwaba yezitolo, kuphinde kume namatekisi nabantu abanamatafula abadayisayo kuleli robhothi. Kuhlale kuphithizela kulo njengoba uma ungena noma uphuma eMlaza udlula kulona.Ngesikhathi ithimba leSolezwe lifika endaweni izihlobo zikamufi bezidangele, zime eduze kwesidumbu sakhe zisalinde ukuthi sithathwe yimoto ethatha izidumbu.Imoto yakhe iCiti Golf emhlophe ibimi erobhothini emgwaqweni oqhamuka eSiphingo obheke ngakwa E,F&G, isidumbu sakhe siseduze kwayo.Akekho obekhuluma nomunye kulamalungu omndeni bonke bebegobodisile bebheke isidumbu sakhe.Kulezi zihlobo akekho ovume ukukhuluma nabezindaba, zithe kuningi okushayisanayo abezwa kuthiwa kwenzekile, okwamanje kazikazi ukuthi kwenzekeni.Akekho kuzo obefuna ukuzisho ukuthi ungubani.“Sisenezinhliziyo ezibuhlungu, ngeke sikhulume okwamanje ,” esho ehamba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile okwenzeile wathi indoda yangaphandle kwaleli okuthiwa ibidakiwe, izidubule ngesibhamu sayo yafela emgaqweni.“Kuvulwe idokodo mayelana nokufa kwendoda esiteshini samaphoyisa eMlaza. Ngesikhathi edubula akekho olimele,” kusho uZwane.

LUSEYINDIDA udaba lowesilisa ongumakhi ozingqokloze ngesibhamu phambi komphakathi emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza ngeSonto, okusolwa ukuthi ubexabene nowesifazane okuthiwa ubesebenzisana naye obemkweleta imali eningi.UMnuz Sdu Sithole odabuka eMozambique kuvele ukuthi ngaphambi kokuzisakaza ngesibhamu ubhale kuWhatsApp wakhe exolisa kubangani ngokudubula abulale owesifazane othile. Komunye umbhalo wakhe ubethi isibhamu ubengasithengelanga ukubulala owesifazane kodwa ubenzela ukuzigada. Uqhuba athi akazi ukuthi ubengenwe yini kodwa uzozinikela emaphoyiseni. Akubhalile kusabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kodwa umndeni wakhe uthi awazi lutho ngomuntu abexabene naye nokuthi kukhona nomuntu ambulele.Umfowabo, uMnuz Carlos Sithole oficwe yiphephandaba emzini abebehlala kuwo oseMonkey Town, kwaV khona eMlaza, uthe akazi lutho ngalezi zinsolo futhi akazange azibone. Akakwazanga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isithombe esikuWhatsApp okubhalwe kuwo uke wazibona yini zifakwe umfowabo yize ethe iselula kamufi ikhona endlini futhi uke wayibheka efuna ukubona ukuthi ukhona yini abexabene naye.“Besijwayele ukusebenzisana uma enomsebenzi omkhulu, eminye besiyenza ngokwehlukana. Sijwayele ukuthi kube nabantu abasikweleta imali kodwa angazi ukuthi kunowesifazane obemkweleta imali eningi lo okuthiwa umbulele. Besingakezwa lutho nasemaphoyiseni olumhlanganisa nokubulala,” kusho yena.Ngakolunye uhlangothi uNksz Mbali Dlamini, unina wengane kamufi, uthe uyazi ukuthi kunowesifazane waseMgungundlovu obekweleta isoka lakhe imali elinganiselwa kuR60 000 futhi bese kunesikhathi beyibanga le mali.“Ngokwazi kwami owesifazane wambiza ngoMgqibelo emthembisa ukumkhokhela imali yakhe kodwa wamnika uR20 000 baxabana. Umufi ubengeyena umuntu wodlame futhi ubesho ukuthi uyazisola ngakwenzile. Okwamanje angikho esimeni sokuthi ngichaze izinto eziningi ngalolu daba,” esho evala ucingo.Ephinda eshayelwa ucingo uthe akakwazi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba ngoba akakakulungeli ukukhuluma ngalo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, Lt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe abanalwazi lokuthi kunezinsolo zokuthi umufi ubulele wathi kodwa uphenyo olwenziwa ngamaphoyisa aseMlaza yilona oluzocacisa yonke imininingwane.

UTHUKUTHELE uyaveva uyise wentombazane eyakhuleliswa ngobenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uNksz Nonkanyiso Chonco.UMnuz Fartescue Chonco uthe sekumume emphinjeni ukwedelelwa wuZuma ekubeni agqekeza futhi wakhulelisa indodakazi yakhe, awe evuka nayo isishiywe wunina. Izindaba zokuthandana kukaNonka Chonco (24), onomuzi endaweni yabadla izambane likapondo eBallito noZuma (76), zavela sekubelethwe ingane esibhedlela esizimele saseHillcrest, iBusamed, ngo-Ephreli 12, okuwusuku okwazalwa ngalo uZuma. UChonco (86) uthe baxhumana ngocingo noZuma bavumelana ngokuthi bazobonana kodwa kuze kube yimanje abakabonani.“Ngaleso sikhathi uNonka wayengakabelethi. Nokuthi usebelethile ngaze ngakubona emaphepheni. UNonka nonina baze bafika nengane kwami futhi bangiyalela ukuthi ngingakhulumi nabamaphepha ngoba ngizobhidliza umendo kaNonka kwaZuma. Bathi indodana yami ehlala eGoli esizokhulumela umndeni wakwaChonco. Baze bangitshela ukuthi uZuma usewukhiphile uR184 000, kwathengwa izimoto.”Uthe okumenze wafuna ukuphumela obala ngalolu daba ukuthi uyabona ukuthi uZuma uyamdelela njengoba engasafuni ukubonana naye futhi nendodana yakhe ithi ayisafuni ukuzihlanganisa nalolu daba, “kanti noNonka ubengasazibambi izingcingo zami futhi useyibhlokhile inamba yami.”UMNUZ Fartescue Chonco uthi usalindele uMnuz Jacob Zuma namademeshe akhe Isithombe:SITHUNYELWEKwenzeka lokhu nje uNonka usehlale efake indandatho. UChonco uthe uNonka wamhlawula futhi wamkhulisa esemncane waze wafundela umsebenzi eVarsity College. “Akakaze wafunda ezikoleni zabantu abamnyama kuphela kodwa ubefunda kwezixube izinhlanga kuphela. Bengehla ngenyuka naye kusukela ngisakhe eThornville kwaze kwaba ngihlala kwaPata. Ngisho nomama ohlola izintombi (uDkt Nomagugu Ngobese) wazi mina ngoba waze wafika nakwami ngiseseThornville, wafike wamyala ukuba aze angakuyeki ukuhamba uMkhosi woMhlanga.” Uthe washaqeka futhi kwaphela namandla uma ethola ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ithandana nomuntu omdala kangaka futhi onesithembu samakhosikazi angaphezu kukanina kaNonka. “Kodwa yayingasekho into engangizoyenza ngoba kwase kwenzekile.”Uthe wahlangana nonina kaNonka esahamba edayisa izingubo emigwaqweni futhi engumfelokazi wakwaNyathi.“Wabe esesebenza njengokhondathi wamabhasi ami. Savumelana ngokuthi sizothandana futhi ngimenzele konke kodwa ngeke ngimshade. Ngamfica esenezingane ezimbili zalapho ayeshadele khona,” kusho uChonco. Imizamo yokuthola kubo kaNonka nonina, uNkk Nombuso Mokoena, ayiphumelelanga kodwa okhulumela uZuma, uMnuz Ray Zuma, wenqabile ukuphawula, wacela intatheli inikeze inamba yakhe kuChonco (ubaba).Esethintwa uChonco uvumile ukuthi ukhulumile noRay Zuma okhulumela umndeni, kodwa wathi usazoxhumana noJacob Zuma.“Udaba ungaqhubeka nalo ngoba usengidelele kakhulu uZuma.” UChonco uze wakhombisa ithimba leSolezwe NgoMgqibelo izithombe zikaNonka esemncane futhi nomama omncane kaNonka.

IDINGA ukubukwa ngeso elibanzi indaba yenqubomgomo ehlongozwa wuMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, okuhloswe ngayo ukufundisa abafundi abenza uGrade 3 kuya kaGrade 5 ngokukhishwa kwezisu kwabakhulelwe bengahlosile nokuvikela ukukhulelwa, ngokuthi badle amaphilisi athile emuva kokuya ocansini.Inzima le nkinga ebhekene nohulumeni. Kuthiwa babalelwa ku-15 000 ezweni abafundi abakhulelwe. Isikhathi uhulumeni asinikeze umphakathi ukuba uphawule, sincane. Kuthiwe ukuphawula kuzophela ekupheleni kwezayo. Indaba yokukhulelwa kwabafundi kangaka ezweni elidume ngokuba neningi elingamakholwa, isho lukhulu.Sibona ukuthi bekuzoba ngcono ukube uhulumeni usungule ithimba elimukela izincomo ngokuthi kwenziweni, kunokuthi aqale ngokwenza ezakhe izincomo umphakathi ungakasho lutho.Siyayidinga inqubomgomo esuselwe ebantwini emazingeni aphansi futhi kungabi nohlangothi oluzibona lubukelwe phansi ekubunjweni kwayo. UMntwana waKwaPhindangene, ongumholi we-IFP, wake wathi abanye abaholi ababesethimbeni elabumba inqubomgomo sekukhululeke izwe, bathi uma bebuka emuva, bangayikholwa eminye yemithetho eshaywe yibona uqobo.Kungenzeke yini namanje kuphinde leso? Sekukhona abathi kuhamba phambili abaziyo ukuthi izingane zabo azithinteki lapho.

MHLELI: Kwelingashayi eceleni ake ngiphawule ngemikhuba eyenziwa abantu abaya ezinkonzweni zemingcwabo. Uma kuqala kungena inkonzo yomngcwabo kuyaye kube nomphathi wohlelo oqala ngokuzethula asho ukuthi ungubani wakwabani.Uma esezethulile ungena ohlelweni. Baye benze izinto ezingefani-ke ngoba omunye ubiza lonke uhlu lwezikhulumi nezihloko ezizokhuluma ngaphansi kwazo, omunye avele aqale uhlelo. Kunento engiphatha kabi eyenziwa abasuke besenkonzweni. Bahlala kungaphumi noyedwa uma kusaqhubeka uhlelo zize ziphele izikhulumi, kuthi uma ophethe uhlelo eselubuyisela kobaba abazosikhonza ngeZwi leNkosi ubone sebephuma abantu.Uma ubafica phandle ubathola sebezixoxela abanye sebebhema. Kwabangwani neZwi leNkosi ngoba lingukuphila? Enkonzweni ngaphakathi kusala omama abaningi nedlanzana labesilisa. Uma ubheka emnyango ubona kumiwe sekuyizixongololo, ungaphika ukuthi kusemngcwabeni ungathi kusephathini. Uma kunethaveni eduze abanye bazithengela utshwala baphuze. Ishumayela inceku yeNkosi ize ijuluke ishumayeza izihlalo zasehholo. Ubani kanti osuke eshunyayezwa phakathi kosedlulile emhlabeni nathi esiphilayo?Abantu okumele bezwe iZwi yithina esisaphila hhayi ongasekho ngoba yena usewuqedile owakhe umsebenzi, indaba isisele nathi.Imisiko yasemishadweni isigqokwa emingcwabeni, angazi noma kwenziwa wukuthi imishado inqabile yini. Ukudla baze baphinde amapuleti sengathi umuntu usedlela ukulala.Edmund NgcoboE-Hammarsdale

ZIFINYELELE kwangqingetshe izingxoxo zamaholo kwa-Eskom njengoba izinyunyana zicele ukuthi kungenelele uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uMnuz Nhlanhla Nene nebhodi lakwa-Eskom ezingxoxweni zamaholo.Izolo iNational Union of Mineworkers (NUM), iNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) neSolidarity ithe ngeke ikwazi ukuphawula kabanzi ngesiphakamiso sakamuva se-Eskom ngoba izingxoxo zisesigabeni esibucayi.UMnuz Livhuwani Mammburu, okhulumela iNUM kuzwelonke, uthe: “Izingxoxo zamaholo zisesigabeni esibucayi. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi izinyunyana zicele umhlangano noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali kodwa besingakaziswa ukuthi uzoba nini. Asikwazi ukukhuluma nabezindaba okwamanje.”Uthe bazoxoxisana namalungu abo ngesikhathi besalinde umhlangano noNene ngoba yiwona amalungu okufanele asho ukuthi ayasamukela isiphakamiso noma afuna uchatha. “Izinyunyana zithemba ukuthi umhlangano noNene uzozisiza ukuthi zifinyelele esivumelwaneni ne-Eskom. Okwamanje zizoxoxisana nabasebenzi ukuzwa uvo lwabo,” kusho uMammburu.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi i-Eskom ibibeke phansi u-7% ngoLwesibili kanti izinyunyana sezifuna u-8%.Ekuqaleni kwesiteleka izinyunyana bezifuna abasebenzi banyuselwe amaholo ngo-15%, kube nesibonelelo sezindlu sika-R2 000, kumiswe ama-labour brokers nokuthi kuqashwe ngokuphelele onogada.Bebefuna nokuthi bakhokhelwe izinyanga eziyisithupha uma bethatha ikhefu lokubeletha nabesilisa bathathe inyanga eyodwa ezokhokhelwa uma abalingani babo besanda kubeletha.

KUYISITAYELA kwabanye ukuzithathela isinqumo sokungayi ocansini, iningi labo okungabesifazane abathi abazihlanganisi nendoda. Yize lokhu kujwayeleke kwabakholwayo, ukungayi ocansini okubizwa nge-celibacy ngomunye umkhuba osujoyinwe ngisho abangasindisiwe. Umuntu ozibophezela kulo mkhuba ubizwa nge-celibate ngoba usuke ezinqumele ukuthi ngeke aye ocansini.UNksz Amanda Ndiki obizwa ngeQueen of Celibacy njengoba eseneminyaka eyisithupha engayi ocansini, uthe akaluhaleli nhlobo ucansi noma indoda.UNksz Ndiki (38) obuye abe ngumvangeli, uthe ukuba yi-celibate akuhlangene kuphela nenkolo kodwa yisinqumo somuntu. Encwadini yakhe ethi Stepping Into Your True Self, uyachaza ngalesi sinqumo sakhe.Uthe isikhathi esiningi umuntu usuke efuna ukuzithola ukuthi yini emjabulisayo, azinike isikhathi ngokuzazi kabanzi. Yize abanye bethi lo mkhuba ngowabesifazane, uthe bakhona nabesilisa abazinqumela ukuba ngama-celibate.“Kwesinye isikhathi senza izinto ngoba nakhu abanye bezenza njengakho ukuya ocansini. Ngokwabantu uma ujola kumele uye ocansini kanti akumele kube njalo. Uma uzikhethela ukungayi ocansini usuke ufuna ukukhombisa ukuthi awulawulwa yimizwa yakho. Abanye baya ocansini ngisho bengathandi kodwa ngoba kumele kwenzeke,” echaza.Uveze ukuthi ukuzithathela isinqumo sokungayi ocansini usuke ugwema ukugcina ulala nabantu abaningi ngoba kuyenzeka ubudlelwano buphele, udlulele phambili. Uthe ukulala nomuntu kwenza unamathele kuye ngokomoya, yingakho abanye bekhetha ukungayi nhlobo ocansini.Ezinye izizathu athe zenza abanye bathathe lesi sinqumo, ukuthi basuke befuna ukuphola uma kungahambanga kahle ebudlelwaneni bezothando.UNksz Ndiki ucacise ngokuthi kwehlukene ukuzithiba ocansini okubizwa nge-abstinence nesinqumo sokuba yi-celibate.“Ungakwazi ukuzithiba ocansini kodwa usebenzise ezinye izindlela zokujabulisa imizwa yakho. Uma uyi-celibate awuzijabulisi ngalutho kodwa ugwema konke okuhambisana nocansi. Uma uzithiba usuke uzibekele isikhathi esithize kodwa kwi-celibacy kuyenzeka uzibekele lesi sinqumo ingunaphakade,” kusho yena.UNksz Ndiki oke washada wabuye wahlukanisa, uyavuma ukuthi akulula kulesi sinqumo. Uthe uma usaqala ukusithatha kungcono ungajoli nhlobo ukuze ugweme izilingo. Yize abanye abangama-celibate bejola, yena uthe akajoli nhlobo futhi akanasizungu sendoda. Ukugwema izilingo uthe kubalulekile ukungabuki izinhlelo zethelevishini ezizovusa imizwa.Owesifazane ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe wathatha lesi sinqumo eminyakeni emine edlule emuva kokuphoxeka emshadweni. Uthe wayevele ezinqumele ukuthi uyolala nomuntu ayoshada naye kuphela . Kuthe uma behlukana naye wazinqumela ukuthi ngeke aphinde aye ocansini nenye indoda.UNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPscychologist uthe ezinye izizathu ezidala abantu bathathe lesi sinqumo kubalwa ukudlwengulwa, ukulinda umshado nokuhlukumezeka ebudlelwaneni. Uthe abanye basuke bengaluthandi ngokwemvelo ucansi, athe babizwa ngama-asexuals.

text: ITHOLAKALE ishonile indoda (52) yaseMbongolwane obesekuphele isonto inyamalele emuva kokuthi iphume ngesudi yesele endlini yentombi ibalekela abalisa okuthiwa babeyifuna ngezibhamu.Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi isidumbu sikaMnuz Kwazikwakhe Mfanothi Lushozi onyamalale ekupheleni kwenyanga edlule sitholakele sinamanxeba okungakaqinisekiswa ukuthi ngawani. ULushozi unyamalale ngoJuni 30 eKopokopo lapho okuhlala khona intombi yakhe emuva kokuthi kufike amadoda angaziwa emfuna ngezibhamu. Kuthiwa waphuma endlini enqunu ebalekela la madoda okuthiwa aphinde atshela intombi yakhe ukuthi afuna isibhamu sakhe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa asevule icala lokubulala mayelana nesigameko sokutholakala kukaLushozi eshonile.“Isidumbu sakhe sitholakele eKopokopo endaweni engakude nala ayebhekwa khona. Isidumbu sakhe bese sonakele futhi sinamanxeba okulimala. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwesidumbu yiyona ezocacisa ngokufa kwakhe,” kusho uZwane.Izolo umndeni kaLushozi awuzange utholakale ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sewuzwile ngokutholakala kwesidumbu sakhe ntambama ngeSonto.Ngesikhathi ebikela leli phephandaba ngokuduka komyeni wakhe, uNkk Lungile Thabisile Lushozi, uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesigameko sokunyamalala kwakhe kodwa washo ukuthi batholile ukuthi ubesentombini yakhe.FUNDA: Unyamalele ohlaselwe ehlezi neshendeUthe umyeni wakhe wayevakashele izihlobo zakhe eHammarsdale ngesonto ezobuya ngoLwesihlanu olwandulela usuku anyamalale ngalo.UNkk Lushozi uthe wayethole ucingo olwalumexwayisa ukuthi angalali ekhaya ngoba kunabantu abafuna umyeni wakhe abangamenzakalisa.Uthe wambikela umyeni wakhe ngalokhu wathi uyabuya ngoLwesihlanu olwalandulela usuku okuthiwa wanyamalala ngalo.Ngokusho kwakhe bathi uma bezama ukumshayela ucingo bangamthola ocingweni kwathi eseshayelwa ntambama ucingo lwabanjwa yintombi yakhe yababikela ukuthi kufike abantu ekuseni ngehora lesine befuna umyeni wakhe kodwa wakwazi ukuphunyuka wabaleka enqunu.Umkakhe uthe bathi uma beya emaphoyiseni bathola ukuthi intombi yomyeni wakhe ayisibikanga isigameko sokuhlaselwa nokunyamalala kwakhe. Uthe saze sabikwa nguye.

text: Umbuzo: Sineminyaka emithathu sishadile nomyeni wami. Siyathandana kakhulu kodwa emasontweni amathathu edlule ngithole ukuthi uke waba nobudlelwano nentombazane esebenza ngasesitolo sethu.Lokhu ngikuthole ngithi ngisebenzisa ucingo lwakhe. Akazange aphike kodwa uthi yinto eseyadlula nekungamele ngizikhathaze ngayo. Ngiyahluleka ukudlulisa le nto, ngilokhu ngicabanga ukuthi akathokozile ngami. Okungixaka kakhulu ukuthi uthi wonke amadoda ayayenza le nto ngakho ayikho into engiyikhalelayo.Angazi ngempela ukuthi ngenzenjani ukuze ngimuthembe futhi.Thuli, SowetoImpendulo:Akulona iqiniso ukuthi wonke umuntu wesilisa akathembekile. Kuyinto umyeni wakho ayisho ukuze azizwe engcono ngesenzo sakhe.Kuyinto enhle ukuthi uyalibona iphutha lakhe futhi uphumele obala ngesenzo sakhe. Uma ethi akusekho lutho phakathi kwabo kuzomele uthembe akushoyo.Kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthi umethembe ngokuphelele futhi umyeni wakho kodwa ayikho enye indlela. Uma ufuna ukulungisa umshado wenu kuzomele uzincenge.Umbuzo:Umyeni wami weminyaka emihlanu ufuna ukuthatha omunye unkosikazi. Ngikubeke kwacaca ukuthi angizimisele ukuba sesithenjini ngoba akazange angitshele izifiso zakhe ngaphambi kokungena kulo mshado. Ngangingeke ngingene kuwo ukube ngangazi.Thulisile, KWANONGOMAImpendulo:Isithembu akuyona into evele ikwehlele nje. Sinesiqiniseko sokuthi umyeni wakho wangena kulo mshado azi ukuthi uyasithanda isithembu kodwa esaba ukukutshela ekuqaleni ngoba azi ukuthi ngeke uvumelane naye. Isithembu yinto okumele uzilungiselele yona, ungene emshadweni wazi ukuthi kuzoba khona omunye unkosikazi emva kwesikhathi.Ngeshwa umyeni wakho uzodinga ukuxoxa, avumelane nawe ngaphambi kokuthatha omunye unkosikazi.Uma ngabe wena ungavumelani nesinqumo sakhe kuzoba yinto enzima kakhulu ukuthi aqhubeke wena ungathandi. Qhubekani nixoxe umnike izizathu ezikwenza ungahambisani nesinqumo sakhe.Umbuzo:Ngingumama owathola umntwana ngisemncane kakhulu, manje sengiqala ukubona izimpawu engingazithandi kumntwana wami ona-13 weminyaka. Useqale ukukhombisa ukukhonza abantu besilisa ngendlela emangazayo. IYAQONGA ingcindezi yokuthi uhulumeni ehlise uphethroli njengoba amaqembu epolitiki nezinhlaka zomphakathi nezokuthutha okubalwa kuzo Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP), Democratic Alliance (DA), Organisation Undoing TAX Abuse (OUTA), nePeople Against Petrol and Paraffin Increase (Pappi) ziwufuna wehlile.Esithangamini nabezindaba ebesiseTshwane, umholi weDA, uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, uthe uhulumeni we-ANC ulwa nabantu abampofu eNingizimu Afrika ngoba unyuse intela yezimpahla ebizwa nge-Value Added Tax (VAT) yasuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%, wanyusa intela ekhokhwa kuphethroli, wafaka intela kashukela kanti nophethroli unyuka njalo njengoba kusukela ngo-Ephreli kuze kube manje ubulokhu unyuka.“Ngesikhathi uRamaphosa eba wuMengameli ilitha likaphethroli lalibiza uR14.12 kodwa manje selibiza uR16, okusho ukuthi abantu sebekhokha uR100 owengeziwe uma begcwalisa izimoto zabo. Siphakamisa ukuthi ehlise intela kaphethroli ngoR1 ukuze libize ngaphansi kukaR15,” kusho uMaimane ocele abantu baseMzansi ukuthi bamashe nabo ngoLwesibili oluzayo ngo-10 ekuseni njengoba bezoya emahhovisi oMnyango weziMali eTshwane, ukuze uhulumeni abezwe njengoba befuna kwehle uphethroli.UMnuz Visvan Reddy wePappi umemezele ukuthi bazoba nokhukhulelangoqo wesiteleka ngoLwesihlanu ozomisa yonke into. “NgoLwesihlanu sinxusa abantu bakuleli ukuthi bahlale emakhaya, bangayi emsebenzini, nabafundi bangayi esikoleni ukuze batelekele ukukhuphuka kukaphethroli njengoba ukukhuphuka kukaphethroli kuhlukumeza wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uReddy.Ngakolunye uhlangothi i-IFP ibhalele uRamaphosa incwadi imcela ukuthi angenelele odabeni lokunyuka kukaphethroli ngoba abantu abasakwazi ukuphila.Esitatimendeni esifakwe ekhasini le-IFP uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa okhulumela i-IFP kuzwelonke, uthe encwadini abayibhalile bacela uRamaphosa ukuthi eze namasu okwehlisa uphethroli futhi ayeke ukucasha.“Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uMengameli Ramaphosa akhulume nabantu baseNingizimu abatshele ukuthi uzothatha ziphi izinyathelo ukwehlisa uphethroli. Unethimba eliqinisekisa ukuthi kunezimpahla ezingakhokhelwa intela iValue Added Tax (VAT) kodwa akanalo elibheka inkinga kaphethroli onyuka njalo,” kusho uHlengwa.Uveze ukuthi incwadi bayithumele ngoMsombuluko ngoba befuna uRamaphosa aphumele obala asho ukuthi yena nohulumeni we-ANC bami kuphi ngalolu daba lukaphethroli.Uzwakalise ukukhathazeka ngokuthi uSomlomo wePhalamende, uNksz Baleka Mbete wasichitha isicelo sabo sokuthi kukhulunywe ngodaba lokunyuka kukaphethroli ePhalamende.UHlengwa uthe ukunyuka kukaphethroli kuhlukumeza kakhulu abantu abampofu ngoba akunyuki wona kuphela kodwa kunyuka ukudla, ugesi nezinye izidingongqangi.“Sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uMengameli Ramaphosa ehlise ikhabhinethi yakhe enamalungu amaningi, alwe nenkohlakalo, aqinisekise ukuthi kuboshwa izifociya kuyo yonke iminyango kahulumeni ukuze leyo mali izofakwa kwintela kaphethroli,” kusho uHlengwa.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kukaRamaphosa ayiphumelelanga njengoba abehhovisi lakhe bengayiphendulanga imibuzo yeSolezwe.

source: kushubile osomatekisi bevimbezela abashayeli betaxify nabe uber
text: BATHWALE kanzima abashayeli bezimoto ezincane ezithutha abantu iTaxify ne-Uber ngesikhathi bevinjezelwe osomatekisi enkundleni yezemidlalo eChesterville, eThekwini, ngoLwesihlanu.Laba bashayeli abebengaphezu kuka-20 kuthiwa bavaleleke kule nkundla usuku lonke, osomatekisi bososeshini bezindawo ezakhele iTheku “bebathumbe” nezimoto zabo, befuna uR5 000 imoto ngayinye ukuze idedelwe. Ngokusho komunye wabashayeli beTaxify, yena nozakwabo bavinjezelwe yizimoto ezincane ezintathu ngesikhathi bepake ngaphandle kwaseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, eHoward College ekuseni.“Kufike osomatekisi abathathu kithina basiphoqa ukuthi sibalandele siye emhlanganweni ophuthumayo. Sifike enkundleni yezemidlalo eChesterville sekukhona ezinye izimoto ezingaphakathi zeTaxify neze-Uber,” kusho lo mshayeli.Uthe lezi zimoto bezihamba zivinjwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, zibizelwa kulo mhlangano mbumbulu.“Ubungekho umhlangano, bebezositshela ukuthi abafuni ukuphinde basibone sisebenza ngoba asinazo izimvume zokuthutha abantu. Bathe imoto ngayinye izodedelwa ngoR5 000. Bagcine sebethi asikhokhe uR500 ngokubona kuqhubeka isikhathi,” kusho lo mshayeli.Omunye umshayeli uthe basizwe ukufika kwamaphoyisa abehlome eyizingovolo, aphoqe labo somatekisi ukuthi babadedele.“Sesihamba sijeqeza ngoba bathe i-hoot yemoto soyishaya ngesiphongo. Izindawo ezisemalokishini sesiyasaba ukuzihambela ngoba asazi siphephe kangakanani,” kusho omunye umshayeli.Uthe abazi lo msindo ususwe yini ngoba bebazi ukuthi iseGoli kuphela lapho abangabafuni khona.NgoMashi nonyaka ePitoli kubulewe ngesihluku isitshudeni saseNanda, uSiyabonga Ngcobo, esasingumshayeli weTaxify.Usihlalo kasoseshini waseChesterville uMnuz Mbongeni Mkhize uthe bangu-12 ososeshini abangaphansi kweTheku abangeneme ngokusebenza kwezimoto zeTaxify ne-Uber.“Sekuphele amasonto amathathu sizama ukuhlangana nezikhulu ze-Uber neTaxify kodwa sihluleka. Sibone kungcono ukuthi sivimbe izimoto zabo ukuze basondele kithina. Abakwazi ukungena emsebenzini wethu sithule nje,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe kuzosiza ukuthi le nkinga isheshe ixazululeke ingaze iphume esandleni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa aseCato Manor abizelwe kule ndawo ukuyoxazulula isimo, alikho icala elivuliwe.

source: imibono nami ngibona luzoba yinkinga uhlelo oluzobamba abajolayo
text: MHLELI: Ngivumelana noMnuz Bonginkosi Grey Phungula embonweni wakhe mayelana nohlelo okubikwa ukuthi sekusemome ukuba lukhonjiswe kwithelevishini. Lolu hlelo ngibona sengathi luzokwenyusa izinga nezibalo zokubulawa kwabantu besifazane uma abathandana nabo sebebabambile ukuthi bayabajolela.Ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo, njengoba vele sanda isibalo samadoda azibulalayo ngenxa yezinkinga ezihlukahlukene, kusobala ukuthi eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela manje sizobe sinamadoda ambalwa ingxenye enkulu kuzobe kungabantu besifazane.Ama-mashi nemikhuleko ehlelwayo ngeke kusisize ngalutho kulobu bunzima esibhekene nabo. Okudingekayo wukuhlangana kwamadoda aqoqe nabafana abazofundiswa ngokubaluleka komuntu wesifazane nokuthi uyisidalwa esikhethekile kuMdali kwazise indalo iza ngomuntu wesifazane. Kungaba yinto enhle futhi uma kuzobuye kube khona nezinhlelo kwithelevishini ezizolekelela kulo mkhankaso.Umkhuleko uwodwa ngeke usize ngoba ukukhuleka nje kuphela singenzi lutho kwakha isithombe sokuthi uMdali simenza isisebenzi sethu ngokuthi sizovele simtshele ukuthi sifunani bese esinika lokho esikufunayo.Kumele kube khona esikwenzayo bese kuba yima sikhuleka simnxuse uMdali ukuthi emizameni yethu asivulele izindlebe zalabo esizobe sibafundisa. Ama-mashi ewodwa ngokubona kwami awasizi ngoba kuvele kumashe abantu abangayenzi le nto emashelwayo yingakho kuthi kukade kukhona imashi uzwe ntambama sekukhulunywa eyokuthi sekuhlukunyezwe umuntu wesifazane kumbe ingane.Kunento ehlale ishiwo engelona iqiniso lena yokuthi abantu abenza lezi zinto bafelwe wonembeza. Iqiniso elimsulwa lithi unembeza womuntu awufi. Into eyenzekayo wukuthi umuntu uhlula unembeza wakhe.Unembeza uyamtshela ukuthi lokhu afuna ukukwenza akulungile kodwa yena avele athi pho kunani. Lokho kusho ukuthi usewuhlulile unembeza wakhe ngoba umkhuzile. Umuntu osahlulwa wunembeza wakhe yilowo okuthi uma efuna ukwenza okuphambene umkhuze unembeza bese eyawulalela.Akuqeqeshwe abafana ukuze babe ngamadoda akusasa aqotho bafundiswe ukuvuma ukuhlulwa onembeza babo. Indoda yangempela ehlulwa unembeza wayo okuthi noma ngabe ithukuthele kangakanani kodwa ingenzi into ephambene nentando yoMdali.Thembenkosi Mbuyazi

source: kuboshwe umfundisi nengoduso kutholwa owesifazane ebulewe
text: KUBOSHWE umfundisi waseGeorge, eWestern Cape, nengoduso yakhe, basolwa ngokubulala owesifazane ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga kaJulayi ukuze bahlomule ngemali yomshwalense wempilo abese bemuthathele wona.UNksz Siphosile Pamba (25) okhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesihlanu lwesonto eledlule, eZone 9 eThembalethu, uvele isikhasha enkantolo yeMantshi eGeorge izolo ngezinsolo zokubulala uNksz Hlompo Mohapi (25) ofihlwe ngoMgqibelo.Ngemuva kwakhe kube sekuboshwa umfundisi athandana naye uMfu Melisize Monqo (30) osolwa ngecala lokubulala nokukhwabanisa njengoba kuvele ukuthi wathatha umshwalense wempilo ngegama likaMohapi.Amaphoyisa aphinde athatha nemoto etholwe kuMfu Monqo.UHLOMPO Mohapi waseThembalethu ongcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo. Isithombe: George HeraldOmunye wesilisa uMnuz Phumlani Qusheka (28) waboshwa kusadlule izinsuku kutholwe isidumbu sikaMohapi.Lomsolwa wabanjwa neselula kaMohapi, isidumbu sakhe satholwa sinamanxeba okugwazwa esifubeni.Bobathathu abasolwa bazovela enkantolo ngoLwesithathu (Julayi 25) lapho bezobekwa khona amacala ngokuhlangana, kanti kulindeleke ukuthi bafake isicelo sebheyili.

ABANTU baseNingizimu Afrika abasayingeni eyokudla upholoni nama-vienna okwavela ukuthi sekudlule nenqwaba yemiphefumulo emuva kokuqubuka kwesifo esibulalayo iListeriosis.Kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukuthengwa kwalokhu kudla okusuke sekuphekiwe njengopholoni, amasosishi, amaviyena nokunye, kwehle ngo-75%, kwathi ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo yenyama yengulube kwehla ngo-50%, okuyinto eseyenze ukuthi izinkampani ezidayisa lokhu kudla zehlelwe yinzuzo ngo-40%.UMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, utshele iPhalamende kuleli sonto ukuthi lesi sifo sidale nokuthi kube nabantu abangaphezu kuka-2 000 abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi.Uthe nabantu abazizamela ngokudayisa ukudla, okubalwa amagwinya nokunye okusheshayo njengamasosishi, bashayeke kakhulu ngenxa yale nkinga.“Ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvela izindaba ngalesi sifo, bashayeke kakhulu abantu abadayisa omagwinya, kodwa abanye bazisizile ngokuthi bayeke ukuwadayisa neminye mikhiqizo, bakudayise kodwa lokhu abasuke bezenzele khona," kusho uMengameli Ramaphosa obephendula imibuzo yelungu lePhalamende leDemocratic Alliance, uLindy Wilson, obefuna umengameli achaze ukuthi sekwenzekeni kuleli selokhu kwaqubuka iListeriosis.URamaphosa uthe umbiko awuthole kwiSouth African Meat Processing Association, okuyiyo esekhaleni lokubheka konke okwenzekayo kule mboni selokhu kwaqubuka lesi sifo, ukhomba nokuthi izinkampani ezithintekayo ezikhiqiza lolu hlobo lokudla, zidla ngamapayipi nakwezezimali.Nokho lezi zinkampani sezinxuswe wuhulumeni ukuthi zingafeli ngaphakathi kodwa azifake izicelo zosizo lwezezimali eMnyangweni wezokuHweba nezeziMboni kuleli.Uthe isicelo ngasinye sizobhekwa, ngeke kuthathwe isinqumo esizofaka uwonke wonke.Umengameli uthe njengamanje lokhu okuvelayo kuwumbiko wesikhashana, ukhona umbiko ozophinde ukhishwe njengoba kusabhekwa nokuthi ungakanani umonakalo owenzeke nasezitolo ezidayisa le mikhiqizo.Selokhu saqubuka lesi sifo ngoJanuwari 2017, bangaphezu kuka-200 abantu asebeshonile okubalwa kubo nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa (ngokombiko wezibalo wangoMeyi nonyaka).

ANGASE asungule iqembu lakhe lezepolitiki uNkk Patricia De Lille osule kwiDA ngesonto eledlule ngesikhathi esephuma esikhundleni sakhe sokuba yiMeya kaMasipala waseCape Town.UNkk De Lille uthe uzocacisa kuleli sonto ngezinhlelo zekusasa lakhe kodwa kunamahlebezi aqinile okuthi uzosungula iqembu lakhe namakhansela asule kwiDA ngesonto eledlule.Ngesikhathi esula kwiDA, uNkk De Lille uthe uzizwa ekhululekile kwingcindezelo akade engaphansi kwayo ngoba ubengakwazi ukusiza abantu ngempilo engcono.“Ngikhululekile ekugcineni, indlela engizizwa ngayo ifana naleya yokuvota okokuqala ngo-1994 emuva kokuthi sithole inkululeko. Bengingakwazi ukuletha impilo engcono kubantu ngenxa yobandlululo oludla lubi kwiDA. Baningi abathi angizongena emaqenjini abo epolitiki kodwa ngisazocabanga kahle ngekusasa lami. Sisabonisana namakhansela asulile ukuthi sizokwenzenjani,” kusho uNkk De Lille.UMnuz Shaun August obewuSotswebhu kuMasipala waseCape Town uthe yena namakhansela asulile bayabonisana ngekusasa labo futhi baxoxisana nabantu abaningi.“Sixoxa nabaxhasi, abaholi bomphakathi nabo bonke abantu baseCape Town ngezinto ezahlukene ngoba asikazi okwamanje noma sizosungula inhlangano yepolitiki noma sizokwenzani. Engingakusho nje wukuthi iDA isakhathalele abamhlophe kakhulu ngoba abantu baseGugulethu, Khayelitsha naseMitchells Plain abanakiwe,” kusho * -August.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe uNkk De Lille angase avuse i-Independent Democrats okuzokwenza kube nokwehlukana kwezepolitiki ngoba inhlangano yakhe izobonakala njengekhaya lamaKhaladi okusho ukuthi kuzohamba abantu abaningi akade sebevotela iDA.“UNkk De Lille uyathandwa wumphakathi wamaKhaladi azibona sengathi awanakiwe, ngimbona ewushisa umbango eWestern Cape. I-DA ngeke inqobe ngamavoti amaningi. Emuva kokhetho luka-2019 kungase kube nohulumeni wokubambisana engingazi-ke ukuthi uzoholwa yiDA noma yi-ANC kodwa engingakuqinisekisa wukuthi uNkk De Lille uyobe ekhona uma eseneqembu lepolitiki,” kusho uKhumalo.

BUCHITHEKE bugayiwe kubalisa ababili nowesifazane oyedwa ababanjwe oqotsheni, beqeda ukuhlinza inkomo yokwebiwa kodwa babanjwe sebehlukaniselana inyama eMkhumbane, eMondlo, ekuqaleni kwesonto.Isolezwe ngeSonto lithole ukuthi uMnuz Vusumuzi Ngcobo (54) , Mnuz Lindokuhle Xulu (24),noSelby Nonhlanhla Xulu (48), baswele umgodi wokucasha kungena ezakwasidlodlo zingasadle nkobe zamuntu, zabashaqa.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa afike bejuluke bemanzi te, kungakhulumi muntu, kusha ummese nocelemba.Bekhipha izigixagixa zenyama bezibeka amaqoqo ukuze umuntu aphume nengxenye yakhe ayoshaya izoso nomndeni wakhe.Umthombo osondelene nalolu daba uveze ukuthi baboshwa nje bebesanda kufonela emakhaya, betshela imindeni yabo ukuthi ingapheki kodwa ilungise umlilo wokosa.Kuthiwa bengakaligwinyi zatheleka ezikaDalawane, zabahlaba ngemibuzo badla amazambane ashisayo, baphonswa evenini, kwathiwa bayochaza phambili.Ngokomthombo, amaphoyisa alunywe indlebe ukuthi sengathi idubukele kwaXulu, kuhlinzwa inkomo yokwebiwa.“Abuzile amaphoyisa ukuthi iyisima kanjani le nkomo ehlinzwayo babakaza abasolwa bangakwazi ukuchaza nokwenze amaphoyisa abafakaozankosi, aqoqanezimbazo nemimese nakho konke akufaka njengobufakazi obuqanda ikhanda ukuthi babanjiwe nale nkomo,’’ kulanda umthombo.Akucacanga kahle ukuthi le nkomo ibiyebiwe kuphi nokuthi ibifike nini njengoba ihlinzelwa endlini nje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Colonele Thulani Zwane, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunabantu ababhadanywe bematasa behlinza emuva kokuba bempimpiwe emaphoyiseni.AFIKE kwaba ncane indawo amaphoyisa endlini obekuhlinzwa kuyo inkomo okuthiwa eyokwebiwa eMkhumbane eMondlo Isithombe : SITHUNYELWE“Amaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wenkomo yokwebiwa ase elunywa indlebe ukuthi ikhona inkomo ehlinzwa komunye umuzi.“Athe uma efika athola inyama ibekwe amaqoqwana, angacucuza afaka ozankosi kubasolwa, akhala emuka nabo,’’ kuchaza uZwane.Leli phephandaba lihabule ukuthi abasolwa bavelile eNkantolo yeMantshi eVryheid ngoLwesibili bebhekene necala lokutholakala nempahla okusolakala ukuthi eyokwebiwa.

KUTHIWA ubesephila ngokucasha ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa owesifazane waseNanda okusolwa ukuthi ubulawe obeyisoka lakhe elizinikele emaphoyiseni.Usathuthumela umndeni kaNksz Thandazile Hlengwa (40) waseCongo, eNanda, isidumbu sakhe esitholakale namanxeba okugwazwa ngaphansi kombhede ngeSonto. Umufi kuthiwa ubeqashe kwaSkhokhokho khona eNanda okuyilapho ebulawe khona. Umfowabo uMnuz Sipho Njapha, uthe umufi ubengasahlali emqashweni ngoba ebalekela umsolwa athandana naye ngo-2015.“Bese kuhlala amadodana yakhe emqashweni ngenxa yokubalekela umsolwa. Ngesikhathi besathandana umsolwa nguye obevakasha emqashweni. Besazi ukuthi sebenezinyanga ezine behlukene ngoba umsolwa ubemhlukumeza,” kusho uNjapha.Uthe umsolwa ubenodlame emshaya umufi, asabise nangokubulala amadodana akhe aneminyaka engu-15 no-13. UNjapha uthe umufi waqala kubo eCongo ngoMgqibelo ezobona unina ngaphambi kokudlulela emqashweni wakhe.“Ubebuyele ukuzothengela izingane ukudla emqashweni, akhokhe nerenti. Wayezofika alale emqashweni bese eya esontweni ngakusasa,” kusho uNjapha.Umndeni kamufi uthe washayelwa ucingo yindodana endala kamufi nomakhelwane, ibika ngesigameko.UNksz Sphiwe Cele owafika endaweni yesigameko uthe bangena nomakhelwane namadodana kamufi.“Umbhede ubuphakanyisiwe isidumbu singaphansi kwawo sambozwa ngeshidi elimhlophe. Besinenxeba lokugwazwa esiswini nasentanyeni. Sisola ukuthi umsolwa waqale wamdlwengula usisi ngoba iphenti belehlile engagqokile,” kusho UNksz Cele.UNKSZ Sphiwe Cele noMnuz Sipho Njapha umndeni kaNksz Thandazile Hlengwa okusolwa ukuthi ubulawe isoka lakhe lamfihla ngaphansi kombhede. IVideo: ZANELE MTHETHWAUthe namanje izingane zikamufi azikho esimeni esihle ngokomqondo njengoba zibone isidumbu sikanina. Kuthiwa zabikela omakhelwane ukuthi azimboni futhi endlini kukhiyiwe. Omakhelwane bagqekeza endlini kanti bazozithela phezu kwesidumbu. Wazinikela emaphoyiseni ngalo iSonto. Umndeni kamufi ukhala ngokuthi uzobe ungaphephile uma umsolwa ethola ibheyili, ikakhulukazi izingane zikamufi abesabisa ngokuzibulala.
