Ngesonto elizayo umsolwa kulindeleke abuyele enkantolo ukuyofaka isicelo sebheyili.

AKUCACI ngokubulawa kowesilisa waseMkhomazi okuthiwa uke wasebenza ematekisini, okusolwa unogada wendawo yobumnandi eThekwini ngokushona kwakhe.UMnuz Percy Ndlovu (32), kuthiwa udutshulwe entathakusa yangoLwesihlanu endaweni yobumnandi ePhoyinti, eThekwini. Abangani bakhe nabamaziyo balokhu bekhale njalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngoNdlovu okuthiwa ubedume ezindaweni zobumnandi, edume nangokwazisa umndeni wakhe. Izolo Isolezwe lihlulekile ukuthola umndeni kamufi nemininingwane ngokushona kwakhe. Omunye wabangani bakhe ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe bazana nomufi besahlala enkabeni yeTheku kodwa akanalwazi ngeminye imininingwane ngokubulawa kwakhe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuboshwe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-31 ngalesi sigameko.Uthe isigameko senzeka ngezithuba zabo 4 ekuseni endaweni yobumnandi ePhoyinti.“Umsolwa uboshwe amaphoyisa asePhoyinti wavela eNkantolo kaMantshi eThekwini ngoMsombuluko. Asikaziwa isizathu sokubulawa kukamufi kodwa amaphoyisa ayaqhubeka nokuphenya,” kusho uColonel Mbele.Imizamo yokuthola imininingwane yemiphumela yokuvela kukamsolwa enkantolo yephunzile.

NAKUBA iMavela High iyisikole sasemakhaya eJozini, okungenye yezindawo ezisasalele emuva kwezentuthuko kodwa siyakwazi ukudlisela ogageni izikole zasemalokishini nasemadolobheni njengoba sesikhiqize odokotela abacela ku-20, kusukela sasungulwa ngo-1980.Uma ufika kulesi sikole ubona izindonga zaso ulahlekelwa ithemba ngenxa yokuba sesimeni esingagculisi kodwa ubhema ukholwe uma usuchazelwa ngempumelelo yaso.Lesi sikole singesinye sezikole ezenze kahle ku-matric ngonyaka odlule njengoba sithole u-79.9%, sabalwa nezinye izikole eziphakamise isifunda uMkhanyakude.Isolezwe ngeledlule belikulesi sikole lifuna ukuthola kabanzi ukuthi impumelelo yaso ilele kuphi.Uthishanhloko wakulesi sikole, uMnuz Prudent Thembeka Ndlovu, uthe ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwazo zonke izinhlaka kubalwa othisha, abazali, isigungu esilawula isikole nomphakathi yikhona okuletha impumelelo.“Kuhle ukusebenzisana kwethu, uma kunezinkinga umphakathi uyeza esikoleni kuboniswane. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izinto zihambe kahle,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe bazimisele ngokuthi benze kahle kakhulu kulo nyaka.“Wonke umuntu usuke efuna ukuthi zonke izingane ziphumelele, isikole sithole * -100% kodwa kubuye kungenzeki. Engingakusho ukuthi sizimisele ngokwenza kangcono kakhulu kulo nyaka,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu.Uthe yize beyisikole sasemakhaya kodwa bayakwazi ukumelana nezikole zasemadolobheni nasemalokishini ngendlela abafundi babo abaphumelela ngayo.“Kusukela isikole sasungulwa ngo-1980, bacela ku-20 abafundi asebengodokotela abaphuma esikoleni sethu. Kule minyaka emithathu nje edlule, kuphume abafundi ababili esikoleni sethu abenza izifundo zobudokotela,” usho njalo.Uthe akayibali eyonjiniyela, othisha, nabahlengikazi ngoba bona baningi kakhulu.“Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi abafundi bethu bayakwazi ukukhipha unyawo kulezi zifundo ezithathwa njengezilukhuni iMaths neScience,” usho kanje.Ubonge inhlangano ezimele, iZisize, ngokulekelela ekutheni isikole senze kahle.“’Le nhlangano isisiza ngezinto eziningi njengoba ikwazi ukusiza izingane ebezikhungethwe izinkinga ezahlukene, iphinde isize nasekuhleleni izinhlelo zokululeka abafundi ngezifundo abangazenza uma sebeqede ukufunda,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu.Uthe le nkampani iphinde ikhuthaze abafundi ibatshele ukuthi njengoba bephuma emakhaya akusho ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukwenza kahle uma sebefike emanyuvesi.“Zikhona izinselelo esibhekene nazo njenge sikole esizama ukuzilungisa okubalwa kuzo indaba yokushoda kwamagumbi okufundela njengoba kumanje kukhona nabafundi abafundela eLaboratory ngoba bengenalo ikilasi abangalisebenzisa,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu.Uthe ukushoda kwamakilasi kudalwe ukwenyuka kwesibalo sabafundi abanabo, njengoba kulo nyaka benezingane ezingu-1 132.“Bakhona abathembisa ukusisiza ngoba sizimisele ngokuthi la bafundi sibakhiphe eLaboratory,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu.Uthe enye yezingqinamba abayibonayo ukuthi kunabafundi bakaGrade 8 no-9, asebengenwe umkhuba wokusebenzisa izidakamizwa esikoleni sabo.“La bafundi baphuza utshwala okuyinto eyingozi ekusaseni labo, siyacela ukuthi kube khona ukubambisana nabazali ukuze siyinqobe le nto,” kusho uMnuz Ndlovu.Uthe abafundi babo abadala abebenza kahle babuye babacele ukuthi bazofundisa lezi zifundo akade bezazi kakhulu.IPhini likathishanhloko, uMnuz Ndlela Mpontshane, uthe ngaphandle kokuhlabana kwezemfundo, abafundi babo baphinde benze kahle nakwezemidlalo.“Isikole sethu sesithole izindebe eziningi emikhakheni ehlukene kwezemidlalo kubalwa ibhola lezinyawo nesibhakela,” kusho uMpontshane.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe likulesi sikole ngeledlule, lalamela omunye wabafundi abadala, uSphila Dlamini, efundisa abafundi iScience.USphila owathola o-distinction abayisikhombisa, manje wenza unyaka wesithathu ezifundweni zakhe zobudokotela. Uthe uyakujabulela ukubizwa esikoleni ukuthi azosiza ngoba ufisa ukubona abafundi abeza ngemuva kwakhe nabo bephumelela.“Kuyintokozo kimina futhi ngizizwa ngikhethekile ngokuthi isikole singikhethe ukuthi ngibe ingxenye yaso yize noma sengaphuma khona,” kusho uSphila.Uthe ufisa ukuthi ahlale eyisibonelo esihle kubafundi baseMavela.“Okunye engikwenzayo ukuthi ngihlale ngibakhuthaza ukuthi bangaphumelela ezifundweni zabo uma bezimisela,” kusho uSphila.Ilungu lo mphakathi elingumakhelwane nesikole, uMnuz Sanele Mngomezulu, lithe iMavela iyisibusiso emphakathini njengoba ikwazi ukukhiqiza abafundi abasezingeni eliphezulu yize isendaweni yasemakhaya.Asikho isidingo sokuthi izingane zethu sizifunele izikole kwezinye izindawo ngoba nathi sinaso isikole sethu esenza kahle futhi esiziqhenyayo ngaso,” kusho uMngomezulu.UMngomezulu ubonge othisha ngokusebenza ngokuzikhandla okwenza abafundi benze kahle.“Kubalulekile ukuthi sibabonge othisha uma benza kahle emiphakathini,” kusho uMngomezulu.

I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal isiphinde yakugcizelela okushiwo uMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa yathi ngeke iwulokothe umhlaba ongaphansi kweSilo samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini.Ekhuluma engqungqutheleni ebidingida udaba lomhlaba eCoastlands Hotel, eThekwini, izolo uMdidiyeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uthe umhlaba owu-13% osezandleni zamakhosi awukho ezinhlelweni zabo zomhlaba abazowuthatha ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo.“Akekho umuntu ofuna ukuthatha umhlaba weNgonyama Trust. Umhlaba esifuna ukuwuthatha ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo yilowo owu- 78% osezandleni zabamhlophe,” kusho uMabuyakhulu.Uthe kuyishwa ukuthi ithimba lalowo owake waba ngumengameli, uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe, elaphakamisa ukuthi umhlaba weNgonyama Trust kumele uthathwe, alikaze lixoxe namakhosi nobuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.“Kusukela kuqale indaba yethimba likaMotlanthe siyakuqaphela ukuthi sekukhona amaqembu ezombusazwe angosomathuba asedlala ipolitiki eshibhile ngalolo daba ukuze azuze amavoti,” kusho uMabuyakhulu.Uxwayise ngokuthi udaba lomhlaba lubucayi wathi kumele luphathiswe okwezikhali zamaNtungwa.Uthe umbiko wethimba likaMotlanthe ususePhalamende akukathathwa sinqumo ngawo.“Njengoba siqonda ukuthi iPhalamende lisebenza ngendlela eqondile futhi ecacile kusazobhungwa ngombiko nomphakathi unikwe ithuba lokuthi uphawule ngawo ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinqumo,” kusho uMabuyakhulu.Ethula uhlelo lukaThuma Mina eKZN ngempelasonto uRamaphosa ukugcizelele ukuthi uhulumeni kaKhongolose awunazo izinhlelo zokuthatha umhlaba weSilo.Uphawule kanje ngemuva kokuhlangana neSilo emuva kwembizo kaZulu ebisoLundi lapho iSilo sishaye phansi ngonyawo sathi akekho umuntu ozoke alokothe umhlaba waso inqobo nje uma sisadla amabele.Isilo sithe sizowuvikela umhlaba waso njengoba uZulu enza ngesikhathi etholana phezulu namaNgisi ezimpini ezahlukene kudala.Ingqungquthela yayizolo ibihanjelwe yizikhulu zikahulumeni wesifundazwe, amakhosi, izinduna nabamele iNgonyama Trust.Bekukhona nelungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uNkk Edna Molewa, noSolwazi Sipho Seepe.

text: MHLELI: Thina siyisizwe esifundiswe ukuthi uma umuntu omdala ebona ubugwegwe ekwenzeni komuntu omusha, engezokuba nalo ikusasa eliqhakazile ngenxa yezinyawo zakhe ezinamabatha, umuntu omdala usheshe abone ukuthi ikusasa lakhe alicacile.Ukutshelwa komuntu omusha ukuthi ikusasa lakhe limfiliba kusuke kungasho ukuthi uyaqalekiswa ngalokho. Naba abaholi bombusazwe bamatasa balwa izimpi zabo zezikhundla, ukuze bezohlala bephethe kodwa abakhathalele ukuthi isizwe silimala kangakanani ngokwenza kwabo.Banomgolo ngempela abaholi bombusazwe ngoba into bona abayilwelayo wukuthi bahlale bephethe ngisho sebebona ukuthi bahlulekile ukuyisa izidingo kubavoti. Kunokuba kuthiwe bahlulekile kodwa kunalokho bangamane umunwe bawukhombe engxenye esikhundleni sokuthi umunwe bawubhekise kubona. Into futhi abayinkinga ngayo wukuthi uma kuphethe iqembu elithize, bangancamela ukuthi leyo mali behlale phezu kwayo kunokuba kugcinwe izidingo zabantu. Ingani phela babuye babuswe wukuthi kumele kuvele bona emphakathini khona bezohlala njalo bephethe kuze kubuye uJesu. Lokho njalo kwenziwa yiqembu limbe lezepolitiki.Kubulawa amakhansela ngenxa njalo yawo umgolo. Kubulawa abaholi ngenxa yawo njalo umgolo. Kugxijwana emithonjenei yezindaba yiwo njalo umgolo lowo. Kuhlaselwana mahlanze noma bukhoma ngenxa yayo njalo ipolitiki. Ngesikhathi besahlaselana kumele njalo ukuthi baphinde banikezwe elinye ithuba lokuthi baphathe iminyakanyaka. Sizofikaphi ingempela uma sinihlobo olunjena lwabaholi na? Ngiyazibuza ngiyaziphendula ukuthi ngabe isiphetho kuyoba yini, ngohlobo olunjena lwabaholi.Into engiyibona ngabaholi akukhona ukuthi bakhalela ukuthi bashintshe impilo yabantu njengoba besho. Mhlawumbe kungaba khona lokho kodwa okukhulu nokuhamba phambili, ukuthi kubuse amaqembu abo amanye engabusi. Okunye okubabusayo ukuthi bakhiphe amathenda ngendlela yabo. Kuthi kubantu kulethwe lokhu okumbalwa bese kudunyiswa kumiwe phezu kwendlu. Lokho sikujwayele uma kuzoba nokhetho ngokuhlukana kwalo. Lapho ke intuthuko sisuke siyibona isigeleza njengamanzi. Kunele kungadlula lolo khetho bese kuthi nya. Siqhubeke-ke sithi sinabaholi abasithandayo kwalapho.Mina ngibuye ngisole nabo abavoti ngokuthi beqhube uthando phambili lweqembu noma lwamaqembu, yize kubonakala ukuthi inqola iya eweni ngalo iqembu noma amaqembu. Inkohlakalo idla lubi kwabanye abaholi, hhayi bonke. Ithi noma isitholakele baphikelwe kuthiwa abayenzanga bayasukelwa. Kube sengathi bayaboshwa okungatheni. Uyothi uzwa yena kanye lowo msolwa ongumholi usegixabezwe ngesinonile isikhundla futhi.Ngamafuphi lokho kuyindlela yokumbonga ukuthi ukhwabanise kahle. Abaholi bethu baqokelwa ezikhundleni kwala noma ngisho benganamava azo futhi bengakufundele lokho. Kungenxa yokuthi kuyacatshangelwana ngoba nakhu wawubanjwe ndawonye umzabalazo wenkululeko. Yingakho iminyango ethize kahulumeni ihlala njalo inezinkinga ngenxa yalo uhlolo lukahulumeni olugwenxe.Bona kanye abaholi laba bansondo banolimi olubi uma bekhuluma, okuthi ekugcineni kushe izwe ngenxa yezinkulumo zabo ezingalungile ngisho nakancane.Nabo abavoti mabake beyifakele izibuko le ndaba yohlobo lwabaholi abasibusayo.Yisemkhulu NzimandeEPORT SHEPSTONE

ABEBEYIZITSHUDENI asebehlale isikhathi eside bengaqashwa emuva kokuphothula izifundo zabo basabisa ngokungazibandakanyi ezinhlelweni zokuvota ngoba bekhala ngokunganakwa.Laba abebeyizitshudeni abebevela ezindaweni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal, bamashele eCity Hall eThekwini beyozwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwabo ngokungaqashwa kwabo yize sebephothule izifundo zabo. Bathe bazimisele nangokuba nokhukhulela- ngoqo wemashi ozoba sezifundazweni ezahlukene bezwakalise ilaka labo ngokungaqashwa.Baveze ukuthi abanye babo sebeneziqu ngazimbili kodwa bahleli emakhaya abasebenzi.UMnuz Nkulululeko Ndlovu, ongomunye walaba ophothule izifundo zakhe ze-Accounting ngo-2016, uthe njengoba befuna ukuqashwa ababhekisile kuphela kuhulumeni wakuleli kodwa bafuna nezinkampani ezizimele zazi ukuthi abaneme ngokuhlala emakhaya bengayitholi imisebenzi.ABAFUNDI asebephothula iziqu zabo emkhakheni ehlukene bathi bakhathele ukwenza ama-internship. Isithombe: GCINA NDWALANEUNdlovu uthe babhekise nakumaqembu ezepolitiki athe enza izethembiso eziningi ngesikhathi efuna ukuvotelwa kodwa kuze kube manje alikho iqembu lezepolitiki elishoyo ukuthi kuzokwenziwani ngenqwaba yezifundiswa ezingaqashiwe.“Besilokhu sikhuthazwa ukuthi sifunde, safunda njengoba kushiwo kodwa manje imisebenzi asiyitholi futhi akukho okwenziwayo ukukhombisa ukuthi isimo sizoshintsha,” kusho uNdlovu.Ungomunye wabathole izikhala zokufundela umsebenzi nokulindeleke ukuthi bayeke ekupheleni kwale nyanga ngoba sekuphele isikhathi sokuqeqeshwa kwabo.Befunda uhlu lwezikhalazo zabo, bathe bafuna kuqedwe imibandela yokufundela umsebenzi njengoba bethe abantu banikwa unyaka owodwa bese bethi uma sebefuna umsebenzi kuthiwe kufuneka abantu asebesebenze iminyaka emithathu. Bakhale nangokuthi banikwa imali encane uma bethole izikhala zokufundela umsebenzi. Bathe uma sebephothule ukufundela umsebenzi bashiywa kanjalo, bangaqashwa.‘Singabantu abasha abahluphekile asebethule isikhathi eside...”ZINXENXA abanye abahlezi emakhaya neziqu zabo izifundiswa ezingene emgwaqeni namajazi azo zayigxoba namhlanje eThekwini zikhalaza ngokungaqashwa.Video:@Mcebo_Khubapic.twitter.com/T26IRR4plO— Isolezwe Newspaper (@IsolezweNews)July 3, 2018UNksz Portia Mthombeni, owenze izifundo zePsychology esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme i-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthe usechithe iminyaka emibili engasebenzi. Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi abanye babo banemindeni ebheke bona ikakhulu uma sebethole izikhala zokufundela umsebenzi. Kuba yinkinga uma sebeyekile, sebengasatholi mali.Umeluleki weMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mlungisi Ntombela, uthe bazozibheka izikhalo zabebeyizitshudeni bese bezidlulisela eminyangweni efanele.

ABANTU besifazane basanenkinga yokuthola usizo oluphephile lokuhushula izisu njengoba namanje kusenesibalo esiphezulu sabesifazane abasahushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingagunyaziwe ukwenza lo msebenzi.Kukholakala ukuthi zilinganiselwa ku-260 000 izigameko zokuhushulwa kwezisu okuthiwa zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kusanda kuvela engqungqutheleni eyaziwa nge-Abortion and Reproductive Justice: The Unfinished Revolution III ebikuleli ebidingida izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo abantu besifazane uma bezama ukuyothola izinhlelo zokuhushula izisu nokunye.Umbiko we-Amnesty International wango-2017 usanda kuveza ukuthi yize sekuneminyaka engu-21 kwaphasiswa umthetho ovumela abesifazane ukuthi bazithathele bona isinqumo sokuhushula izisu kodwa ziseziningi izinkinga.Ngokusho kwalo mbiko, zingaphansi kuka-7% izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezingu-3 880.Lesi sibalo singaphansi kakhulu kunesibalo sezikhungo ezingu-505 uhulumeni ahlele ukuthi zenze lo msebenzi eNingizimu Afrika.Yize ukuhushulwa kwezisu kusemthethweni kuleli, kukholakala ukuthi izigameko eziphakathi kuka-52% kuya ku-58% zenziwa ezikhungweni ezingekho emthethweni.Ingqungquthela ebingesonto eledlule e-Eastern Cape, obekukhona kuyona abantu abalinganiselwa ku-285 basemazweni angu-26 emhlabeni wonke, ilandela eyayiseCanada ngo-2014.Imibiko yakamuva yoMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal ikuvezile ukuthi abantu besifazane bagcina benezinkinga ngenxa yokuhushula izisu ezikhungweni ezihushula izisu ngokungemthetho.Lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni abantu besifazane babe nezinkinga ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo ukulimala kwesibeletho, ukuphuphuma kwezisu nokunye.Umbiko wakuleli weSaving Mothers wango-2012 uveze ukuthi abantu besifazane abangu-186 abaphuphunyelwe yizisu balinyalelwa nayizibeletho ezikhugweni zikahulumeni.UMnuz Jacques van Zuydam, ongumqondisi jikelele wezokuthuthukiswa kwabantu kuMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke uthe kubajabulisile ukuba yingxenye yengqungquthela. Uthe ngesikhathi bebheka izinhlelo ezifakwe emuva kwengqungquthela i-International Conference on Population and Development Programme of Action ebiseNingizimu Afrika ngo-2014 bathole ukuthi ziningi izingqinamba ezikhona kuleli okufanele babhekane nazo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu okuhlela aba yinto ekhona ngempela (awagcini ngokubhalwa phansi).“Izinkinga zokungalingani kwabantu ngokobulili, ngokwezezimali nangokwendlela umphakathi oyiyona ziyaqhubeka nokucindezela amalungelo okuhlela abantu besifazne. Ngo-2015 iKhabhinethi yaseNingizimu Afrika yanquma ukuthi amalungelo abesifazane okuhlela abe kulawo amqoka emigomeni yakuleli,” kusho uVan Zuydam.Uthe la malungelo ayehlanganisa namalungelo entsha okuhlela nokusungulwa kwemithetho ezosiza ekutheni amalungelo afezwe ngendlela kuzo zonke izindawo.Ingqungquthela beyihlelwe yizinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa kuzona uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi kuzwelonke, uphiko olwaziwa ngeCritical Studies in Sexualities and Reproduction Research Programme olusesikhungweni semfundo ephakeme iRhodes University nabanye.USolwazi Cathi Albertyn ongusolwazi kwezomthetho esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme i-University of the Witwatersrand uthe imithetho ehambisana nokuhlela ihambisana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlela.“Abantu besifazane bayadinga ukuthi banikwe indawo yabo emphakathini nakwezezimali nasekutheni bazikhethele izinhlelo zokuhlela. Abesifazane badinga ukunikwa inkululeko yokuthi bazikhethele ngabakwenza emizimbeni yabo,” kusho uSolwazi Albertyn.Ngo-2015 iKhabhinethi yaphasisa uhlelo olubhekele izinhlelo ezithinta amalungelo okuhlela ezibandakanya intsha, iNational Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Healthand Rights Framework Strategy (2014-2019).UVan Zuydam uthe uhulumeni uzimisele ngokuqhubeka nokulwa le mpi nokusabalalisa ivangeli lokulwela amalungelo abantu besifazane okubalwa kuwo amalungelo okuhlela nakwamanye amazwe.Uthe bazimisele ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abesifazane okuhlela ayahloniswa.

SEKUPHELE amasonto amabili siduve emakhazeni isidumbu somfundisi waseMnambithi umngcwabo wakhe omiswe yinkosikazi endala ethole ukuthi idivoswe ingazi umyeni washada nomunye.UMfundisi Vika Mazibuko (46) webandla lamaZayoni elingatholakalanga igama lalo, washadelwa wuNksz Dumazile Vilakazi (45) ngo-2001. UNksz Vilakazi uthe owesifazane asebebanga naye isidumbu wafika ezokwelashwa, wagcina ehlala iminyaka emithathu ekhaya.“Ngagcina sengimthatha njengengane yami ngoba wazinikela nangokugcwele esontweni. Ngo-2007 umyeni wami wahamba nayo le ntombazane.”Uthe abazange badivose nomyeni wakhe, waqhubeka wahlala emzini wakhe. Uthole ucingo kuninazala wakhe emtshela ukuthi uMazibuko ushonile ngoJuni 24.“Ngaya lapho abehlala khona umyeni wami, umnakwethu wangikhombisa incwadi ekhomba ukuthi ngadivoswa ngo-2009. Ngithole ukuthi umyeni wami uphinde washada nayo le ntombazane ngo-2013,” kusho uNksz Vilakazi.Ngenxa yokumangazwa ukudivosa engazi, uNksz Vilakazi uye enkantolo wavimba ukuthi kudedelwe isidumbu. Uthe akaze awathole amasamanisi edivosi futhi kwakumele kube khona akutholayo uma bedivosa ngoba babehlanganise amafa. Inkantolo inqume ukuthi imindeni ibonisane ngalolu daba.UNksz Vilakazi uthe umnakwabo ugcine evuma ukuthi angcwabe ngesonto eledlule wabuye wajika.“Sigcinana naye enkantolo wathi kulungile ngingcwabe, ngenza namalungiselelo okungcwaba ngeSonto. Kuthe sengiyolanda isidumbu ngoMgqibelo odlule ngathola enye incwadi yasenkantolo ethi ngingangcwabi,” kusho yena.Uthe bekumele baphindele bonke enkantolo ngoMsombuluko kodwa umnakwabo wangafika. Uveze ukuthi kufike amadoda abesonta nomufi, asabise ngokuthi uzophucwa ngisho umuzi ahlala kuwo.UNksz Vilakazi, ongumsebenzi wasezindlini, uthe uke wamzama ummeli ozimele waxakeka ngenxa yemali.Umnakwabo, uNksz Ncamsile Gamede (30), ucingo ulunikeze omunye wesifazane ochaphe intatheli ngenhlamba. Kuthe noma ebuzwa igama lakhe waqhubeka nenhlamba esabisa nangokuthi uzoyilungisa intatheli uma ike yakhipha udaba.Udadewabo kamufi, uNkk Mabaso, elingatholakala igama lakhe, ubhoke ngolaka wathi useganile, akafuni ukufakwa ezindabeni.Ummeli ozimele, uNksz Nolwazi Malimela, weNN and Associates, uthe kungenzeka ukuthi idivosi kaNksz Vilakazi yakhangiswa ephephandabeni ngoba kuyenzeka uma abantu bengasahlali ndawonye.Uthe uma umfundisi ebeseshadile akumele azixake ngokufuna isidumbu, kunalokho kumele ayofaka isicelo sokuthola ingxenye yamafa akhe ngoba babeshade umshado ohlanganisayo.

KUSAQHUBEKA ukubulawa kwabantu eMbumbulu ngenxa yombango wengoma namatekisi phezu kokuba inkosi yesizwe uMnuz Khehla Makhanya noNgqongqoshe wezokuPhepha KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda sebekhuzile bathi akubekwe phansi izikhali.Sebeyisishiyagalombili manje abantu asebebulewe kule ndawo emasontweni amathathu edlule kusukela kuqale impi yomshoshaphansi okusolakala ukuthi isisusa sayo wumbango wengoma namatekisi esigodini sakwaNgqinya.Kubikwa ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-80 abantu asebebulewe kule ndawo kusukela ngo-2016.Esehlakalweni sakamuva, esenzeke ngoMgqibelo, kuthiwa uMnuz Luya Bhengu ubehla etekisini, ehamba nentombi yakhe, ngesikhathi edutshulwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thulani Zwane, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko wathi amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala.FUNDA: Kuphume izidumbu ngenxa yengoma“Owesilisa kuthiwa ubehamba nentombi yakhe edilika etekisini. Okwamanje imbangela yokuhlasela ibingakaziwa, amaphoyisa asaphenya, bekungakaboshwa muntu,” kusho uZwane.KUBULAWE abanye abantu ababili eMbumbulu namhlanje ekuseni lapho kuqhubeka khona impi yomshoshaphansi okusolwa ukuthi isuswe ingoma.pic.twitter.com/yUjKxBw0mK— Isolezwe Newspaper (@IsolezweNews)June 21, 2018UKaunda usanda kuhambela kule ndawo lapho ehlangane nezinhlaka zomphakathi wafike wakhuza, wathi akubekwe phansi izikhali.UNgqongqoshe ufike wamemezela ukuthi sebesungule ithimba eliyisipesheli elizophenya ngokubulawa kwabantu kule ndawo.“Ikhona into ethi kunombango osuswe ingoma. Lo mbango uhamba uze ufake nendaba yamatekisi ngoba abanye abantu abayingxenye yengoma bangosomatekisi,” kusho uKaunda.Uthe nabo abazi ngempela ukuthi yini ebangwayo.Umthombo weSolezwe kule ndawo uthe nakuba ukhona umbango wengoma oke waba khona kodwa lokhu kubulalana kwakamuva kuhlobene nempi yamatekisi.“Abantu baseMbumbulu badlelwe umzila wabo abantu abaziwayo futhi abasatshwayo embonini, yingakho kukhona impi,” kusho umthombo.Uthe ngendlela isimo esishube ngayo abanye osomatekisi baseMbumbulu sebeze bazidayisa izimoto zabo ngoba besaba ukubulawa.

MHLELI: Ngithi angidlulise lokhu ikakhulukazi kule nyanga yamadoda aseMzansi.Kunemashi yabesifazane ebihleliwe ngomhlaka 19 Julayi 2018 eqondaniswa nale nyanga ngoba kwabesilisa ekhuluma ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane nezingane akhona namadoda abeyingxenye yayo okuyinto enhle kakhulu ukuze kuzwakale ulaka lawo amadoda. Ngiyafisa ukuba izinhlangano ezithi zikhulumela amadoda kuthi kule nyanga ezoqala u-Agasti zisukume zihlele imashi yokuhlukumezeka okubhekiswe emadodeni ngabantu besifazane.Ngiyafisa futhi ukugcizelela ukuba kumele alalelwe namadoda iphele indaba yokuthi kube sengathi abesifazane bodwa abahlukumezekayo ngoba lokho kubhebhezela ukungazwani phakathi kobulili.Inkulumo yami icacile ayidingi kutolikwa,akekho ngisho uhulumeni imbala okhuluma ngokuhlukumezeka kwamadoda.Akekho ongazi ukuthi nawo ayashaywa, odliswa izingane okungezona ezawo, nawo ayabulawa, athethiswa amacala ngisho engenze lutho njl. Ayikhuzwe yonke lento kungakhethwa iphela emasini.Richard MbonambieNdwedwe

UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo ePhakeme useyalele abesikhwama esiboleka izitshudeni imali yokufunda, iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS), ukuthi bangaqhubeki nokwamukela izicelo zezitshudeni ezifuna ukuxhaswa ngemali ngonyaka ozayo.Encwadini ebhalwe nguNkk Naledi Pandor, ayibhalele uSihlalo webhodi lakwaNSFAS, uMnuz Sizwe Nxasana, eputshukele kwabezindaba, uthe ukhathazekile ngendlela isikhwama esihlela ngayo izinhlelo zokuxhasa izitshudeni, okubalwa kuzo ukuphuza kwaso ukuphasisa izicelo nokuphuza ukukhokhela izitshudeni eziphasisiwe.Kule ncwadi ukhala ngokuthi lesi sikhungo kubonakala sengathi asikwazi ukulawula izigidi zemali okumele sixhase ngayo izitshudeni.Lesi sikhwama bekumele sivule ithuba lokufakwa kwezicelo zika-2019 kusasa. Kule ncwadi uthe kunenqwaba yezitshudeni ezingakakhokhelwa imali yokufunda kwalo nyaka.Okunye okuvelayo wukuthi ubuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa yisikhwama ezikhungweni zemfundo ezehlukene abusebenzi kahle, okuholela ekutheni ulwazi lwezitshudeni olufakwa kubo lube nezinkinga.Kuvele ukuthi uNkk Pandor uke wabhalela ibhodi lesikhwama phambilini ethi akulungiswe izinkinga ezikhona mayelana nokukhokhelwa kwezitshudeni imali yokufunda.Waphakamisa ukuthi isikhungo masiqhamuke nendlela yokuxhumana yezobuchwepheshe esebenza kahle exhumanisa izicelo ezifakwa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nehhovisi elikhulu lalesi sikhwama.Okhulumela iNSFAS, uMnuz Kagisho Mamabolo, uthe ibhodi lesikhwama nabaphathi baso basebenzisana nomnyango namathimba abo asebenza ezikhungweni ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona.Uthe zilinganiselwa ku-20 000 izicelo zika-2018 ezingakaphothulwa okusamele ukuthi lesi sikhwama sithathe isinqumo sokuthi ngabe izitshudeni ezifake izicelo zizohlomula yini esikhwameni.“Uma iNSFAS inikeza izitshudeni imali engekho amaphepha adingekayo, kuzoholela ekutheni ibukeke njengabantu abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi wabo. Uhlelo lwa-online seluyakuvumela ukuthi izitshudeni zifake amaphepha azo adingekayo zisebenzisa lolu hlelo.UMnuz Zola Saphetha, unobhala weNehawu, uthe izinkinga zakwaNSFAS zidalwa wukuthi lesi sikhungo sisebenza sengathi siyi-spaza, kuqashwa izihlobo.UNkk Pandor uthe kunzima ukuthi asivikele lesi sikhwama ekuhlaselweni wumphakathi nezitshudeni ngenxa yokuthi kusenezitshudeniezingakazi ukuthi ngabe zizohlomula yini kusona ebezifake izicelo zokuhlomula kulo nyaka.

text: MHLELI: Kwelakho elingakhethi iphela emasini, ake ngithembe ukuthi uzolishicilela lolu daba lwami. Benginemali ebengiyonga kwa-Old Mutual, okuthe uma sengibona ukuthi itoho lizophela noma inini nganquma ukubazisa kwa-Old Mutual.Nangempela bangikhokhelile imali ekade ngiyilondolozile. Inkinga yami isekutheni ngoJuni 26 baphinde bayibamba imali noma sengibazisile ukuthi ngeke ngisakwazi ukukhokha ngoba itoho selizophela.Sengigqigqe kaningi emahhovisi asePinetown bathi angilinde izinsuku eziyisishiyagalolunye. Kuze kube manje imali yami abayibuyisile yize babethe izozibuyela yona. Uma ngibashoyela izingcingo zabo zikhala kathathu zivaleke.Seyiningi kakhulu imali yami edliwe u-Old Mutual ngenxa yamaphutha enziwa abasebenzi bakhona. Ngonyaka odlule bangqwambise uR23 000 ngenxa yephutha lomsebenzi wabo.Ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi imali yami engaka yaphelelaphi njengoba sebephinda bentshontsha nalena nje?Angisophinde ngizihlanganise ne-Old Mutual ngoba kusobala ukuthi abaqeqeshekile abasebenzi bakhona kepha into abayaziyo ukungcofa amaselula abo, ekugcineni bakutshele ukuthi akungeneki kwi-internet yabo (offline)Thamsanqa MbongwaeLuganda

UKHUNGATHEKILE umndeni wakwaMathonsi kwa-H eNtuzuma okufe indodana yawo edutshulwe kubhiyozwa emuva komngcwabo wendoda ebisolwa ngobugebengu.UThandolwethu Mathonsi (19), okuthiwa ubeyisikhokho ekushayeni isidudla, kuthiwa ufike kubhiyozwa ezokwenza adume ngazo ehamba ngemoto kayise iToyota RunX ebisetshenziswa nguye isikhathi esiningi. Ngesikhathi ethi uyapaka kuqhamuke umuntu wamdubula kabili.Isolezwe linayo i-video ekhombisa uThandolwethu efika embhiyozweni ngemoto yakhe, wathi esapaka kwaqhuma isibhamu.Ikhona indoda ebonakala sengathi iyabaleka ngemuva kokuqhuma kwesibhamu.Okhulumela umndeni wakwaMathonsi, uMnuz Nhlanhla Mathonsi, uthe indodana yomfowabo ibingesona isigebengu kodwa ibize emngcwabeni wesigebengu ngoba kade ibizwe ngabangani bayo abebefuna izoqhudelana nezigebengu ngokushaya izidudla.“Umfana womfowethu ubengesona isigebengu kodwa ufonelwe ngabangani bakhe eseSabatheni njengoba singamaNazaretha lapha ekhaya bathi akeze emngcwabeni wesigebengu sendawo esisale enkundleni ngesikhathi sona nabangani baso bedubulana namaphoyisa eVerulam ngeledlule,” kusho uMathonsi.Ugxeke amaphoyisa ngobudedengu obuholele ekushoneni kwendodana yomfowabo.“Siwumndeni siyakhala ngempela ngamaphoyisa sikholwa wukuthi amaphoyisa ngaphambi kokuthi ahambe emngcwabeni bekumele ahlakaze isixuku. Okunye esikutholile wukuthi asheshe ahamba futhi,” kusho uMathonsi.UMathonsi uthe bafe olwembiza ngokufa kukaThandolwethu ngoba ubeyingane ekhuthele futhi ekhaliphile.Uthe inkonzo yesikhumbuza sikamufi izoba ngoLwesine khona eNtuzuma kuthi inkonzo yomngcwabo ibe khona eNtuzuma kodwa yena uzofihlelwa amathuneni asekhaya eJozini.Okhulumela amaphoyisaKwaZulu-Natal, uLt Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe bayakuqinisekisa okwenzeke ngoMgqibelo kwa-E eNtuzuma lapho owesilisa oneminyaka engu-19 edutshulwe ekhanda.“Uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela kodwa washonela endleleni ngenxa yokulimala. Imbangela yokudutshulwa kwakhe ibingakaziwa. Amaphoyisa aseNtuzuma aphenya icala lokubulala kodwa okwamanje bekungakaboshwa muntu,” kusho uZwane.Mayelana nokugxekwa kwamaphoyisa ngobudedengu, uZwane uthe bona bagada umngcwabo hhayi imibhiyozo eyenzeka uma usuphelile. “ Amaphoyisa ayahamba uma ebona ukuthi kuthule,’ kusho uZwane.

ISIMISIWE emsebenzini iMenenja kamasipala waseJozini ngemuva kokukhala kwamakhansela ngo-R11 million osebenze kwakhiwa umgwaqo oyikhilomitha elilodwa eMkhuze nezigidi ezintathu zokulungisa amahhovisi omkhandlu.UMnuz Kuhle Khumalo umiswe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku ngo-9 ngemuva komhlangano wamakhansela obusemini. Umiswa nje bese kuqalwe uphenyo olwenziwa yiMunicipal Public Account Committee (MPAC) oluqalwe ngesonto eledlule.UKhumalo utshele Isolezwe izolo ukuthi akukho okuningi azokusho ngoba usaxhumana nabameli bakhe.“Ngithole i-SMS ngo-9 ebusuku ngoMsombuluko ebingazisa ukuthi sengimisiwe emsebenzini ngakho ngizocela imibuzo uyibhekise kwimeya ngoba mina ngimatasa ngixhumana nabameli bami ngalesi simo,” kusho uKhumalo.Ngesonto eledlule Isolezwe libike ngenkombankombane yaseJozini ephakathi kwamakhansela noKhumalo ngokusebenza kwezigidi zabakhokhi bentela.Amakhansela kaKhongolose nawe-IFP abeshaya amakhala ngemali yokwakha umgwaqo waseMkhuze abasola ukuthi imali yasetshenziswa budedengu.Amakhansela abuye asole uKhumalo ngokuthi “wadla” u-R3 million wokwakha amahhovisi kamasipala.Kuthiwa wanikeza usonkontileka imali umsebenzi ungakakhangiswa.Kuthe uma umsebenzi sekufanele uqale kwavela ukuthi usonkontileka akasakwazi ukuqhubeka ngoba imali idliwe uSars.UKhumalo ngakolunye uhlangothi uyacacisa ukuthi isinqumo sokwakha umgwaqo ngo-R11 million sathathwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu owawungomhla ka-12 Meyi 2017 lapho iMeya, uDelani Mabika, yasayina ukuba kwengezwe u-R3 million ku-R8 million okwakufanele wakhe umgwaqo.UKhumalo usola ukuthi umiselwe ukulwa nenkohlakalo eJozini.FUNDA:Umsindo ngekhilomitha lomgwaqo elibize uR11 millionUveze ngesonto eledlule ukuthi wavula icala koKlebe ukuze baphenye amanye amakhansela ngokunyamalala kuka-R5 million okwakuhlelwe ukuba kwakhiwe izakhiwo ezithile zomphakathi. Le mali kuthiwa yasayinelwa njengesebenzile kodwa izakhiwo azikaze zibe khona.IMeya yaseJozini uMnuz Delani Mabika ithintwa iqale yaba namancoko yathi ivukwa wumoya ngalolu daba.“Ngicela ungithinte emuva kwemizuzwana ngoba ngibheke eHluhluwe emhlanganweni ophuthumayo. Uma ungangithintanga kuqala nami ngizobuyela kuwe,” kusho uMabika.Kuthe ngemuva kwemizuzwana abeyibekile wathintwa kodwa ucingo lwakhe belumatasa. Ngemuva kwalokho beseluvaliwe kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engatholakali.Kwenzeka lokhu nje Isolezwe lithunyelwe umyalezo okhomba ukuthi ubuvela kuKhumalo ewuthumele kubaholi abathile bezombusazwe ebalisa ngesimo abhekene naso.Umyalezo uKhumalo uyawuphika uthi akawazi futhi akekho umholi amthumelele.Kulo myalezo kubhalwe ukuthi: “Laba bantu bafuna ukungimisa emsebenzini bangesulela ngezinto engingazazi. Bagxambukela nasemsebenzini wami. Bafuna kubenabasebenzi engibaxoshayo noma ngibehlise ezikhundleni ukuze kungene abafunwa yibo.”UKhumalo uthe akawazi lo myalezo kanti uqale ukusabalala emasontweni amabili edlule.

UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa udonse ngendlebe amalungu enhlangano ngokuthi akalindele muntu ozogijima aye enkantolo eyophosela inselelo ingqungquthela nobuholi obusha KwaZulu-Natal.URamaphosa ubekhuluma emuva kokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho lwezikhundla zobuholi obusha KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni yesishiyagalombili ebihleli eDurban University of Technology izolo. Le ngqungquthela eke yaphonselwa inselelo enkantolo, iqale ngoLwesine yasongwa izolo.Amalungu enhlangano agijime aya eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngoLwesine eyomisa ingqungquthela kodwa afike achithwa.URamaphosa utshele izithunywa ezingu-1 700 ukuthi kufanele kusetshenzelwe ubumbano hhayi ukuklwebhana futhi kuhlukanwe nezinkantolo.Uthe uyazi ukuthi kuningi ukungezwani enhlanganweni wathi kukhona ngisho abangakhulumisani nokuyinto athe kufanele iphele.Ebuholini obusha kwesikaSihlalo kukhethwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala okhethwe ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, iPhini lakhe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu othole amavoti angu-912 equmba phansi uMnuz Willies Mchunu (obuye abe nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe) ovotelwe abangu-816.KwesikaNobhala wesifundazwe ebesinombango obushisa phansi kunqobe uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli evotelwa abangu-951 ehlula uMnuz Super Zuma othole angu-701.KwesePhini likaNobhala kunqobe uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka oqumbe phansi uNkk Bongi- Sithole-Moloi (obuye abe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko namaSiko) noMnuz Mluleki Ndobe (obuye abe yimeya yaseHarry Gwala) ngamavoti angu-834.EsikaMgcinimafa sibuyele kuNkk Nomusa Dube Ncube (obuye abe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu) okhethwe ngaphandle kokuphoselwa inselelo.Okuqaphelekile ukuthi i-ANCYL esifundazweni ibe nezwi ekukhethweni kwabanye abaholi okunguHlomuka kwesePhini likaNobhala noNtuli kwesikaNobhala njengoba bebephakanyiswe yilo lolu phiko.Belilokhu lubelesele ukuthi kudingeka ushintsho kungene abantu abasha ezikhundleni kuxutshwe. Usihlalo omusha uZikakala naye uhambe emazwini kaRamaphosa wathi sekuyisikhathi sokulwela ubumbano.“Asizele ubuqembuqembu nezikhundla la, kufanele sazi ukuthi ukhetho luyinqubo yentando yeningi nje kuphela.“Akekho umuntu ohluliwe nonqobile kodwa kunqobe i-ANC,’’ kusho uZikalala.Khonamanjalo i-ANC eGauteng ikhethe ubuholi engqungqutheleni yayo ebise-Irene, eTshwane.KwesikaSihlalo kubuyiselwe uNdunankulu wakulesi sifundazwe uMnuz David Makhura.IPhini lakhe kwaba uMnuz Panyaza Lesufi, uNobhala kwaba nguMnuz Jacob Khawe, iPhini likaNobhala kwaba nguNkk Nomantu Nkomo-Ralehoko, kwathi uMgcinimafa kwaba nguMnuz Parks Tau.

AMADODAKAZI kalowo owayeyinkosikazi kaDkt Nelson Mandela, uWinnie Madikizela-Mandela, asaqhubeka nokulwela ubunikazi bomhlaba kaMandela oseQunu okunesithabathaba somuzi kuwo.Ngokwephephandaba eliphuma ngeSonto, iSunday Times, uZindzi noZenani Mandela, sebefake lolu daba eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuphikisa isinqumo senkantolo yokudluliswa kwamacala (Supreme Court of Appeal), esachitha uMdikizela-Mandela ngesikhathi efuna ubunikazi bale ndlu.Encwadini yamafa eyashiywa nguMandela, umuzi waseQunu washiywa ezandleni zeNelson Rolihlahla Mandela Family Trust, ukuze kuhlomule umndeni wakhe wonke ngayo. Umuzi njengamanje uphethwe ngunkosikazi kaMandela, uNkk Graca Machel.Umhlaba ofunwa ngamadodakazi kaMadikizela Mandela wanikezwa uMandela ngeminyaka yama-90, waba ngaphansi kwegama lakhe yedwa. UMadikizela Mandela udlule emhlabeni egqigqa izinkantolo ezama ukuguqula lesi sinqumo. UMadikizela-Mandela wayekholelwa ngukuthi ngokomthetho unelungelo lokuba ngumnikazi walo mhlaba okwakhiwe kuwo lo muzi.Waveza ukuthi lo mhlaba wawunikezwa ngo-1989 kodwa wanaka ngo-2014 ukuthi wawungaphansi kwegama lika-Mandela, nokuyilapho eqale ukuphakamela lolu daba. Inkantolo enkulu e-Eastern Cape ngokunjalo nenkantolo yokudliliselwa kwamacala bamchitha uMadikizela-Mandela.UZindzi noZenani bathi sekuyibo abazoqhuba lolu daba njengoba bekholelwa ukuthi unina kwakumele anikezwe amalungelo obunikazi bomhlaba naye. UMadikizela Mandela udlule emhlabeni nonyaka. Wahlukana noMandela ngo-1996.IOL

source: i ancyl ifuna untuli esikhundleni sikanobhala
text: I-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal isiphumele obala yathi ifuna uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli ukuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe okulindeleke ukuthi isingathwe ungakapheli uJulayi.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokusonga inyanga yabantu abasha ehholo lomphakathi iMichael Gwala eNtshangwe, uMgcinimafa we-ANCYL uMnuz Thobelani Ncampalala, uthe bafuna ukuthi abantu abasha bangene ezinhlakeni ze-ANC ukuze nabo bahlale etafuleni uma sekuthathwa izinqumo.“Yingakho siyi-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal sithi sifuna uqabane uMdumiseni Ntuli akhethwe njengoNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, asididekile ngalokho esikushoyo, uMdumiseni uke wahola i-ANCYL eKZN futhi uyiqabane ekade lalinethwa zimvula uphinde abeyisibonelo kithina, sifuna ukuba yisifundazwe sokuqala lapho uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni kungumuntu omusha,” kusho uNcampalala.Uthe i-ANC eKZN idinga umuntu onjengoNtuli kwesikanobhala njengoba isemkhankasweni wokuqeda indaba yezinhlangothi.NoSihlalo we-ANCYL eThekwini uMnuz Thembo Ntuli uhambe emazwini kaNcampalala wathi bangajabula ukubona uNtuli engunobhala wenhlangano esifundazweni.UNtuli uphakanyiselwa esikhundleni obekuhleli kuso uMnuz Super Zuma. Nakuba liphakanyiswa igama likaNtuli kodwa akhona amanye amaqabane afuna kubuye uZuma.UNcampalala uqhube wathi enye into abafuna ukuyibona ukuthi uNobhala-jikelele we-ANCYL, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, akhethwe njengelungu lesigungu esihola isifundazwe.“Sifuna ukuthi uNzuza uma esebuya eLuthuli House eseqede ihlandla lakhe abuye KwaZulu-Natal azoba essigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe, iProvincial Working Committee,” kusho uNcampalala. Uthe uNzuza usesebenze ezinhlakeni ezahlukene enhlanganweni waze wafika eLuthuli House.“Omunye umholi esifuna akhethelwe esigungwini esihola inhlangano nguSihlalo wethu esifundazweni uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu,” kusho uNcampalala.Uthe njengobuholi besifundazwe baphinde bavumelana ngokuthi baseke unobhala wabo uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo kwesikamengameli we-ANCYL njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni ngoSepthemba.Uthe bafuna ukubona abantu abasha babambe iqhaza kuyo yonke imikhakha kubalwa ekuholeni nakwezomnotho.Isolezwe lizamile ukuxhumana noMdumiseni Ntuli ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi uzamukela kanjani izindaba zokwesekwa wuphiko lwentsha kodwa ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa.

source: uphendulwe iqhawe enkantolo ududuzane zuma malema
text: UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters, uMnuz Julius Malema, usegxeke impatho etholwe uMnuz Duduzane Zuma ngesikhathi evela enkantolo izolo.UZuma ubevele enkantolo yamacala athinta imali wanikezwa ibheyili kaR100 000 ecaleni lenkohlakalo lapho esolwa ngokuthi wazama ukugwazela owayeyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, ngoR600 million kodwa uJonas wawunqaba.Izolo uMbuso ubeke uDuduzane icala lenkohlakalo kodwa udaba olube sematheni kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuvela kwakhe efakwe ozankosi ezinyaweni, okuvame ukwenziwa uma kuvela abasolwa ababhekene namacala abucayi.Umbuzo obuhamba phambili ezinkundleni ngowokuthi ufakelweni ozankosi ngaloluya hlobo ekubeni kunguye ozinikele emaphoyiseni.Ekhuluma nentatheli yeSABC ngoLwesibili uMalema uthe uDuduzane usezoba yiqhawe kuleli ngoba abantu bazozwelana naye ngenxa yendlela aphathwe ngayo."Akumele senze abantu okungenzeka ukuthi baphule umthetho amaqhawe ngenxa yendlela esibaphatha ngayo. Buka into eyenzeke kuDuduzane. Namhlanje uDuduzane uyiqhawe ngenxa yendlela aphathwe ngayo enkantolo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayazwelana nabantu ababukeka engathi bayizisulu. Akumele sihlasele abantu okungenzeka ukuthi bayizigebengu ngendlela ezobaphendula amaqhawe," kusho uMalema.Uqhube waveza nokuthi kumele abantu abasolwayo balandelelwe kuphela uma sekunobufakazi obanele ukuthi babhekane nengalo yomthetho enkantolo."Kunomehluko phakathi kwepolitiki necala elisenkantolo. Enkantolo kumele uveze ubufakazi obungashiyi ungabazane ngezinsolo umsolwa abekwa zona. UMalema ufike abange umsindo abange umsindo, bese beyagxuma abeNPA ngisho bengenabo ubufukazi. Ngakho kumele sikwazi ukukuhlukanisa lokhu kokubili. Sizoqhubeka sibange umsindo ngezinto esizisolayo kodwa oKlebe neNPA akumele badudwe ngabakuzwa ePhalamende. Kumele baqhubeke bona bayofuna ubufakazi, uma sebebutholile kumele baphathe abasolwa ngendlela ngoba ukungakwenzi lokhu kubaphendula amaqhawe," kuphetha uMalema.Icala likaDuduzane lihlehliselwe uJanuwari 24 wonyaka ozayo ngoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.

MHLELI: Ngibhala le ncwadi ngisuswa udaba oluke lwaba sematheni olwakhulunywa uMnuz Julius Malema. Impela bonke laba bantu abamkhuzayo kuyacaca ukuthi abakaze basebenze nabomdabu baseNdiya noma babasebenzele.Mina ngisebenzela owomdabu waseNdiya. Ayikho inhlobo yosizi engingaluthwele. Uyangithuka zonke izinsuku zikaThixo aze angibeke isandla ngezinye izinsuku. Ungihlukumeza sengathi angiyena umuntu ophilayo onemizwa nenhliziyo.Yingakho ngimangala nje uma kunabantu abalwa nenkulumo kaMalema kuthiwa ubhedile, abanye baze bathi kumele axolise ebe ekhuluma iqiniso lodwa futhi uqinisile uma ethi lo mkhuba udlange kakhulu le eThekwini.Kungakhulunywa nje ngeminyaka eminingi sathola inkululeko, mina nje ngingomunye wabangayazi inkululeko ngenxa yomqashi wami. Ngiyacela futhi uma kukhona ongangichushisa angisize ngale nkinga engibhekene nayo angithinte noma engabe abaKhomishini yamaLungelo aBantu.Jabu NxumaloENanda

source: imibono zizolekelelwa yini izingane esihlukwini sothisha abazishayayo
text: MHLELI: Kanti ngempela yini eyolekelela izingane zabantu abantulayo esihlukwini sokushaywa zilinyazwe abantu okufanele engabe bazinika uthando njengothisha bazo. Angihambisani nesiphakamiso seCOSAS sokuziphindisela kodwa ngicabanga ukuthi kuzomele ilekelele abazali ekuvuleni amacala ezinkantolo nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abenzi bokubi bayaboshwa.Ngisuswa wudaba olwaphuma kwiSolezwe langomhla ka-29 June 2018 lapho kwavela udaba lomfundi (9) waseMfume ofunda esikoleni iBaniyena Primary School olaliswe esibhedlela eyohlinzwa isandla ngenxa yokulinyazwa uthisha ngoba wayedlala eshaya amafoli, kwathinteka isicabha sekotishi likathisha. Wubulwane njena lobu mawulandela kahle isizathu sokushaywa kwezingane.Okufike kucike wukuhudula izinyawo kwamaphoyisa ekebopheni uthisha ebe eshaye ingane wayilimaza emini kabha bese beloku bethi basaphenya. Baphenya ini ngoba izingane zashaywa. Lingathanda kanjani lona lelo phoyisa eliphenyayo uma ingane yalo ibuye esikoleni seyiphuke ithambo lesandla sekumele iyohlinzwa ngoba ishayelwe ukudlala kwathinteka isicabha sekotishi likathisha?Ungathola ukuthi lelo phoyisa eliwumphenyi yilona eseliphenduke umxhumanisi linxenxa umzali ukuthi asule icala ngoba selifunjathisiwe. Benze njalo siyabazi. Singajabula iphepha lethu esilithembayo lisazise ngokuthi sekuhambe kwafikaphi ngalolu daba. Ngeke sikubekezelele ukubunjwa kwesizwe esinodlame okwenziwa othisha abamnyama ezinganeni ezimnyama.Ingane ekhule ngesihluku senduku nayo uma seyikhulile yenza loko emndenini wayo noma ebantwini bangaphandle.Bhekani Ngwane

ILAHLWE yicala yafakwa ohlwini lwabahlukumeza ngokocansi indoda yaseScotland okuthiwa isibaqedile abesifazane ilala nabo kodwa ibe ingenawo umphambili, ibalutha ngokuthi inawo bese ibadlokodla ngento ethize esikhundleni somphambili.Kuthiwa uMnuz Carlos Delacruz (35) ubebathatha abesifazane abayise endlini yakhe, afike acime ugesi bese ethatha le nto yakhe engaziwa abadlokodle ngayo.Kuthiwa emuva kocansi owesifazane ubesala nobuhlungu obungabekezeleleki aze agule. Kuthiwa babili abesifazane abaphumele obala ngalezi zinhlungu emuva kokuba beye enkonzweni yasekamelweni nalo mlisa.Kuthiwa lo mlisa wayenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abesifazane abamboni enqunu ngoba wayehlala ewucimile ugesi.Kuthiwa abesifazane bathuke bacishe bashayeka phansi sebethola ukuthi lo mlisa akanawo umphambili ubebashaya ngemfe iphindiwe. Kuthiwa kuvele ngesikhathi ebhadle esitokisini esehlolwa udokotela kwatholakala ukuthi awukho nhlobo umphambili.Omunye owesifazane ake athandana naye phambilini kuthiwa wambamba lo mlisa ukuthi akanawo umphambili kodwa uyambawulisa, usebenzisa induku thizeni.Kuvele ukuthi uzivumele phambi kwenkantolo ukuthi empeleni akanawo umphambili ubesebenzisa amaqhinga akhe.- The Daily Mail

INKAMPANI ephehla ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, i-Eskom, ithi luzoqala phansi uhlelo lokunqanyulwa kukagesi emuva kokuthi abanye abasebenzi bayo belaxaze umsebenzi bavala amasango aya eziteshini zikagesi ngoba befuna ukukhokhelwa amabhonasi.Esitatimendeni, i-Eskom itshele amakhasimende ayo ukuthi mawabe nezinhlelo zokulungiselela ukunqanyulwa kukagesi futhi abheke nama-website omasipala bawo.I-Eskom ithe ukunqanyulwa kukagesi kuzodalwa wukuthi kunabasebenzi abavimbela abanye ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo.“Kungenzeka unqanyulwe ugesi ngenxa yesiteleka. Sesibize amaphoyisa ngoba kufanele sizivikele iziteshi zethu,” kusho i-Eskom esitatimendeni.Iphinde yathi izoxoxa nezinyunyana ezifuna kunyuswe amaholo ngo-12% nabasebenzi banikwe amabhonasi.Bekulindeleke ukuthi izinyunyana zihlangane nezikhulu zakwa-Eskom ngoLwesihlanu emuva kokuthi izinyunyana zithe ziwafuna ngenkani amabhonasi.“Sikhathazekile ukuthi abasebenzi bakhethe ukuteleka yize sisazoxoxa nezinyunyana ngoLwesihlanu. Ukuteleka akusho ukuthi akuvinjwe abanye abasebenzi ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo. Isiteleka sizodala umonakalo emnothweni nakubantu baseNingizimu Afrika,” kusho i-Eskom.

KUBOSHWE isihlobo ngokuthunjwa kosana olunezinyanga ezintathu lwaseHibberdene, olwanyamalala ngenyanga edlule.Ubusulahle ithemba umndeni kaLuyanda Simamane, obumthungatha nasezibhedlela, watholwa ngoLwesine eLamontville, eThekwini. Unina kaLuyanda uNksz Vuyisile Simamane (21), uthe kuboshwe umzala wakhe. Kusolwa ukuthi ingane yebiwa ngowesifazane othandana nalo wesilisa oboshiwe. UNksz Simamane uthe lo wesifazane wayeqala ngisho ukumbona kodwa wayazi ukuthi uthandana nomzala wakhe.“Besingazani kahle nale ntombazane ebithandana nomzala wami futhi angiqondi ukuthi ngabe bebeyintshontshelani ingane. Sithole ukuthi ngoLwesine le ntombazane yafika kubo yashiya khona ingane, yabaleka. Unina washayela amaphoyisa ewabikela ngoba wayesola ukuthi yile ngane eyebiwe eHibberdene,” echaza.FUNDA:Kusolwa isihlobo ngengane eyebiweUNksz Simamane obekhuluma nephephandaba esesibhedlela izolo, uthe ingane yangeniswa ngoLwesine ukuze ihlolwe isimo sempilo. Uveze ukuthi ulinde umbiko kadokotela namuhla mayelana nesimo sengane.Uthe namanje usamangele ukuthi bekuyini inhloso yokwebiwa kwengane yakhe. UNksz Simamane uthe bekunzima kuyena njengoba ingane ibingaziwa kodwa ujabulela ukuthi itholakale iphila. Uchaze umzala wakhe njengomuntu ophuzayo, osolwa nangobugebengu. Uthe bebengahlali ndawonye kodwa ubevakasha kubo. UNksz Simamane uthe bese bebheke ngisho ezibhedlela bethungatha ingane. Uveze nokuthi ingane yakhe ithunjwa nje ibisancela ibele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal Lieutenant-Colonel Thulani Zwane uthe ingane itholakale emzini thizeni eLamontville, ingekho esimeni esihle. Uthe kuboshwe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-21 esigcemeni sakwaV eMlaza.Uveze ukuthi umsolwa uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzumbe ngoLwesihlanu, amaphoyisa asafuna umsolwa wesibili. Imininingwane yasenkantolo ibingakatholakali. Usana lwanyamalala ngoJuni lulele nonina, owavuka lungasekho. Bekuvele kusolwa owesifazane obethandana nomzala wakhe ngaleli cala.

SIKHULU isikhalo kwabanye abazali asebefisa ukuthi ngabe izikole sezivuliwe njengoba bekhala ngokuhlupha kwezingane. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana sekwenziwe nehlaya lencwadi esabalalisiwe, okuthiwa ibhalwe abazali bebhalela othisha benxenxa ukuthi zivulwe izikole. Yize lokhu kwenziwa ihlaya, bakhona ngempela abazali abangazi ukuthi bazokwenza kanjani ukuthi izingane zingabi nesithukuthezi emakhaya. Uma amaholidi ezingane engahlelelwe, zigcina ziganga, zenze nezinto ezizozixabanisa nabazali.OyiMarketing Manager yakwaBudget Insurance, uNkk Susan Steward, uthe okuningi kokujabulisa izingane kudinga imali. Uthe ikhona indlela yokugwema ukuchitha imali eningi kodwa uphinde ujabulise izingane. Uveza ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlela amaholidi okuvalwa ezikole, kubekwe nemali. Nazi ezinye zezinto ezingamasu okujabulisa izingane.Akudingeki uchithe imali uyisa izingane ema-cinema, nawo asemba eqolo. Ungaboleka amaDVD ahlabahlosile ziwabuke ekhaya. Ungazenzela * -popcorn ekhaya, ziwuthokozele zibuka amaDVD.Imidlalo efana nama-puzzle noma amakhadi, ungayenza ukuthi izingane zichithe ngayo isizungu.Kukhona nezincwadi ezixoxa indaba ngezithombe. Ungasiza izingane ukuthi zihlobise lezi zithombe. Lesi yisikhathi sokuthi izingane zifunde nokwenza imisebenzi yasendlini. Ungazifundisa ukubhaka nokupheka noma ukulungisa ingadi.Izingane ziyakujabulela ukuba sepaki ngoba inkulu nendawo yokudlala.Phatha amathoyizi nebhola ukuze zikwazi ukuchitha isizungu epaki. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ziyakuthanda nokushutha izithombe.

SEKUBOSHWE indoda yesibili ngokubulawa komholi wophiko lwentsha kwi-ANC, odutshulwe ngakubo eMlaza ephuma engqungqutheleni yenhlangano ngoMgqibelo.UMnuz Bongani Usher Mkhize (25), ubenguSihlalo we-ANC Youth League (YCL) eCoastal KZN College eyiPhini likaSihlalo we-ANC ku-ward 88 eMlaza. Indoda yokuqala eneminyaka ewu-29 izinikele emaphoyiseni ngosuku lobugebengu. Izolo amaphoyisa aveze ukuthi sekuboshwe indoda eneminyaka ewu-24 mayelana nokufa kukaMkhize.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uBrigadier Jay Naicker, uthe indoda yokuqala ibhekene necala lokubulala nokuphatha isibhamu esingekho emthethweni.“Ngezithuba zabo-9 ekuseni ngoMgqibelo umufi udutshulwe umsolwa owaziwayo emgwaqweni uYose Drive kwa-V eMlaza. Isibhamu atholakale naso sike sasetshenziswa kwesinye isehlo sobugebengu. Sithathiwe ngamaphoyisa,” kusho uNaicker.UNaicker uthe indoda yesibili iboshwe eMlaza.Uthe womabili amadoda azovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza namuhla.Uveze ukuthi asaziwa isizathu sokubulawa kukaMkhize kodwa amaphoyisa asaphenya.Izindaba zokufa kukaMkhize zidalulwe nguNobhala we-ANCYL esifundazweni, uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi eThekwini.Utshele abezindaba ukuthi uMkhize ubengumholi osemncane kodwa obesebenza ngokuzikhandla. USabelo uthe kuyabakhathaza ukubulawa kwabaholi ngale ndlela, wanxusa ungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa ukuthi asheshise uphenyo. Imiyalezo yenduduzo nesililo bekulokhu kuqhubeke njalo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abaningi bekhala ngokuba wumholi oqotho kukaMkhize.Ngesikhathi sokuloba ubungakatholakali umndeni kamufi.

IZAZI zomnotho zigqugquzela abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya futhi bamukele ukuthi intengo kaphethroli izolokhu yehla yenyuka, ngendlela okwenzeka ngayo ngoba uhulumeni akakezi namasu okwehlisa intela kaphethroli.UMnuz Doctor Sangweni oyisazi somnotho enkampanini iDolsden Oracle, uthe uphethroli othengwa kwamanye amazwe uthengwa ngentengo ebekwe ngamazwe awukhiqizayo bese uma ufika kuleli ufakwe intela ehlukene okungekaphethroli nesiza abalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo.Uthe uhulumeni nokuntenga kwerandi kwenza iNingizimu Afrika iwuthenge ngemali eningi uphethroli.“Uhulumeni nguye olawula intengo kaphethroli ngokuthi uma usufike kuleli afake intela. Mhlawumbe ukube intela iyehliswa bese amagaragi eze nentengo yawo yamalitha ngabe kunokuncintisana phakathi kwawo.Akufanele intela imbe eqolo ngoba yilokho okwenza ilitha likaphethroli limbe eqolo,” kusho uSangweni.Mayelana nodaba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza uphethroli wayo wakwaSasol, umcwaningi wezomnotho, uMnuz Sakhile Dlamini uvumile ukuthi ukhona uphethroli okhiqizwa eNingizimu Afrika osuselwa emalahleni.“Kuyimanje iSasol ihamba phambili ezinkampanini ezikhiqiza uphethroli osuselwa emalahleni emhlabeni jikelele.Lo phethroli ubizwa nge-synthetic fuel futhi kudala waqala ukwenziwa kuleli, ngesikhathi uhulumeni wobandlululo evalwa ukuthi athenge uwoyela emazweni angaphandle.Ube esesungula iSasol okuyiyona ekhiqiza iSasol fuel eminyakeni engu-63 edlule,” kusho uDlamini.Uthe lolu hlobo lukaphethroli lwaqala ukwenziwa eGermany ngabo-1920 futhi uyasetshenziswa emazweni amaningi.UDlamini ucele abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya bathenge lokho okuyizidingo ngoba azikakenziwa izinhlelo zokwehlisa intela kaphethroli eNingizimu Afrika.

source: isililo ngokubulawa kobeyi anc ngozingqokloze phambi kwabantu
text: KUKHALWA nxazonke ngowesifazane waseCato Ridge okusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe wabulawa umakhi bebanga imali abeyikweleta.UNksz Cacisile Gumede (34), obengumabhalane eMsunduzi Clinic, eCato Ridge ophinde abe yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu egatsheni le-ANC kuwadi 1 kule ndawo, kusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe nguMnuz Sdu Sitole, odabuka eMozambique obemakhela indlu, ngoMgqibelo, ebusuku.USitole umangaze umphakathi ngesikhathi ezingqokloza ngesibhamu kubuka umphakathi emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza, ngesonto ekuseni.Kuthiwa kutholakale imali, egcwele igazi isaphazeke emzini kaNksz Gumede. UNksz Gumede ochazwa ngozakwabo emtholampilo njengomuntu obewuthanda umsebenzi wakhe, ezithobile obekulula ukusebenza naye kodwa obengenqeni ukukukhalima uma ebona ukuthi usuphume endleleni.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo uthe: “Lesi sigameko senzeka ngesikhathi uNdunankulu wesifundazwe sethu, uMnuz Willies Mchunu eseqale umkhankaso wokuthi kube nemikhuleko, yokukhulekela isihlava semikhuba emibi eyenzeka esifundazweni sethu. Njengoba kuyinyanga yamadoda kunesidingo esikhulu sokuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa nokunqanda izenzo zokuhlukumeza ezenziwa ngamadoda kwabesifazane. Sizwelana kakhulu nomndeni ngalesi sigameko,”UMnuz Sihle Zikalala ilungu lobuholi besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uthe uNksz Gumede ubewuthanda umsebenzi wakhe we-ANC futhi ubekuqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukusebenzela ukwenza ngcono impilo yabantu.“Besisalindele lukhulu kuNksz Gumede, sisebenza kanzima ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi sakha abaholi bakusasa, okulindeleke ukuthi ababambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isizwe sethu. Siyakholwa ukuthi amaphoyisa azokwenza umsebenzi wawo. Sinxusa nomphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza emkhankasweni wokunqandwa kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabesifazane kulesi sifundazwe,” kusho yena.FUNDA: Kusolwa isikweletu ngozingqokloze eMlazaUDkt Dhlomo kulindeleke ukuthi ayohlanganisa amehlo nomndeni kaNksz Gumede namhlanje.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uLt Col Thulani Zwane uthe amaphoyisa asesiteshini samaphoyisa eMsunduzi aphenya icala lokubulawa kowesifazane oneminyaka ewu-34 odutshulwe wabulawa, ekhaya lakhe ,kaMhali, ngakolunye uhlangothi awaseMlaza avule idokodo lophenyo ngokuzibulala kukaSitole.“Kusolwa ukuthi owesilisa ozidubule emarobhothini kwaV, eMlaza uyathinteka kulesi gameko,” kusho uZwane.

USEKOLUNYE utaku uMnuz Mduduzi Manana osule esikhundleni sokuba yilungu lePhalamende kuleli sonto njengoba amalungu ekomiti ebelizomqondisa ubugwegwe efuna akhokhe izindleko zawo.UManana owayeyiPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme kodwa wasula ngemuva kokushaya abesifazane endaweni yobumnandi, uzisulele ePhalamende ngoLwesibili wathumela incwadi ehhovisi likaSotswebhu we-ANC izolo emazisa ukuthi useyasula.Izolo amalungu ekomiti lezimilo acele iPhalamende ukuthi liphoqe uManana ukuthi akhokhe izindleko zawo zokusuka lapho abe khona ngoba eze esigungwini sokumqondisa ubugwegwe.Isigungu sokumqondisa ubugwegwe bekufanele sibe izolo kodwa ngenxa yokuthi uye wasula emsebenzini asihlalanga.USihlalo waleli komidi, uMnuz Aumsen Singh, uthe uManana ubazi ukuthi kufanele avele ekomitini lokuqondisa ubugwegwe ngodaba lokushaya abesifazane ngonyaka odlule kodwa wasula emsebenzini.Amanye amalungu ePhalamende athe uManana bekufanele asule ngonyaka odlule emva kokulahlwa yicala lokushaya abesifazane kodwa yena wakhetha ukusula izolo ngaphambi kokuthi aqondiswe ubugwegwe.Amalungu amahlanu ePhalamende aphoqeleke ukuthi asuke ezindaweni ezihlukene aye eCape Town lapho bekuzolalelwa khona udaba lwakhe.Lilodwa ilungu lePhalamende ebeliseKapa, lilinde uManana okunguNksz Liezl van der Merwe we-IFP.USingh usuke eThekwini, uNkk Annelie Lotriet weDA noNkk Sam Matiase we-EFF basuke eBloemfontein baya eKapa. UNkk Rosalia Morutoa we-ANC usuke eGauteng.UMnuz Lemias Mashile we-ANC usuke eMpumalanga ngoba naye ubazi ukuthi kuzoqondiswa uManana ubugwegwe.USingh uthe bazocela usizo lwezomthetho ePhalamende ukuze uManana akhokhe izindleko zabo.Uthe bebephoqelekile ukuthi baye eKapa ngoba bekufanele.“Sicele uSotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, ukuthi sibheke icala likaManana ukuze uma sekuqala umsebenzi wePhalamende kungabikho okusiphazamisayo. Asazi ukuthi uManana kungani esule sekusele usuku ukuthi avele ekomitini lethu ngoba kudala aziswa ukuthi uzoqondiswa ubugwegwe,” kusho uSingh.Amalungu eDA ne-IFP athe uManana ubengafuni ukuxoshwa yingakho esule ngomzuzu wokugcina.UNksz van der Merwe uthe bayakwamukela ukusula kukaManana kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi ubezisola ngesenzo sakhe sokushaya abesifazane ngoba kumthathe unyaka ukusula.

USOBISHINI owesifazane waseSobantu, eMgungundlovu, okweleta umasipala waseMsunduzi uR220 000 wezindleko zamanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nokuqoqwa kukadoti. UMasipala uveze ukuthi le mali eyeminyaka engu-14 edlule.Umnikazi wendlu, uNksz Nomusa Ngcobo, uthe umndeni wakhe wathenga lo muzi ngo-1999 kodwa itayitela langabhaliswa ngaphansi kwegama lo muntu womndeni, okuyinto abebengayazi.UNksz Ngcobo uvumile ukuthi abakaze bakhokhe ngisho isenti selokhu baqala ukuhlala kule ndawo ngoba abakaze bathole incwadi ebayalela ukuthi bakhokhe. Uthe owayengumnikazi wendawo ubazise ngenyanga edlule sebehlelela ukubhalisa indlu ngaphansi kwabantu bomndeni.Umnikazi wendlu uNksz Nomusa Ngcobo uthe umndeni wakhe wathenga lo muzi ngo-1999"Ngiye kwamasipala ngafika ngatshelwa ukuthi lesi yisamba engisikweletayo samanzi, ukuthuthwa kwendle kanye nokuqoqwa kuka doti. Ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabo basazise ukuthi udaba seludluliselwe kubammeli. Uma bethi asiyikhokhe le mali angazi ukuthi sizokwenzenjani," kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Ikhansela lewadi uMnuz Sandile Dlamini uthe lo mndeni usumazisile ngalolu daba futhi uhlela ukuhlangana nabomkhandlu kuleli sonto."Lesi samba angisiqondi ukuthi sivela kuphi ngoba awukho umuzi kuleli lokishi ongakweleta imali engaka, futhi sengiwubonile nomuzi okukhukunywa ngawo," kusho yena.Uthe ikhona neminye imizi kuleli lokishi ekweleta imali eqala kuR80 000 kuya kuR100 000."Kuyacaca ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngendlela okubalwa ngayo izindleko ngoba nami bake banginikeza isamba esingesona. Ngemuva kokuxhumana nabo babala kabusha kwavela isamba esiyiso," kusho yena.Uthe kuzobaluleka ukuthi ilungiswe indlela umkhandlu obala ngayo izindleko ezikweletwa abantu.Okhulumela umasipala uThobeka Mafumbatha uthe isamba esikweletwa yilo wesifazane siyiso."Lesi samba esama-rates, ukuqoqwa kwendle kanye namanzi. Akukaze kukhokhelwe lokhu kusukela ngo-2004 futhi sinakho ubufakazi balokho.Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kulo muzi kuphezulu kakhulu," kusho uMafumbatha.The Mercury

ULALE ebaliwe owesifazane waseChina obenikela ngocansi emadodeni abhale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuthi ofunayo akeze kuye uzomnika aze acikeke. Lokhu kwenzeke eHaitang Bay.Kuthiwa lo wesifazane odalulwe ngokuthi unguNksz Ye uboshiwe ngecala loku-khangisa ngocansi. Kuthiwa lesi sime-mezelo sale ntokazi sidale isiyaluyalu esingakaze sibonwe njengoba izinkumbi zamadoda bezithutheleka ehhotela ebihleli kulona.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa alunywe indlebe ngalolu daba alusukumela agcina emgaxe ozankosi lo wesifizane.Kuthiwa ufake izithombe zakhe esele ngedilozi wafaka nombhalo ohambisana naso isithombe okhomba ukulangazelela abesilisa wabhala nenombolo yegumbi azotholakala kulona.Kuthiwa abalelwa ku-3000 amadoda athutheleke kule ndawo efuna ukuyozidelisa mahhala engakhokhi nendibilishi. Kuthiwa izingcingo bezingena ubuthaphuthaphu amadoda efuna ukukhuluma nalo wesifazane.Abasehhotela bakuqinisekisile ukuthi uyavela emabhukwini abo nesikhathi angena ngaso kuleli hhotela.Kuthiwa emuva kokuvela kwaleli hlazo alenzile ube esephoqwa ukuthi aphume aphele kuleli hhotela. Kuthiwa uzivumele yena emaphoyiseni ukuthi uwufakile lo mbhalo. Ugcine ekhokhiswe inhlawulo ngesenzo sakhe esithathwe njengesihlambalazayo. - The Daily Mail

UMHOLI womphakathi oyisilomo, odume nangokutetemukisa izingane zendawo aziyise ebhishi, usolwa ngokudlwengula amantombazanyana ayisikhombisa. UMnuz Xolani Ngidi, oneminyaka ewu-40, kuthiwa ubedlwengula amantombazanyana aneminyaka esukela kwemine kuya ku-12 ngezindlela ezahlukene. Amanye kuthiwa ubewabiza, awagcobe uVaselina bese ewanukubeza.Ngokwabazali balezi zingane, umsolwa unguSihlalo weCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) emijondolo yaseManyaleni, e-Unit 2, eChatsworth ngaseThekwini.Kuthiwa uneloli elithutha udoti endaweni, abegibelisa kulona izingane, ebelenza ukuthi izingane zimthande ngoba ubehlale ezipha izinto ezimnandi.Lo msolwa uvele izolo eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth.Umphakathi nabazali bebephume ngobuningi bezothamela icala, bebhikisha nangaphandle kwenkantolo.“Eyami ingane uqale ukuyidlwengula ikade yenza uGrade 1. Ngithole manje seyenza uGrade 3 ukuthi kade aqala ukuyidlwengula,” kusho omunye wabazali.Uthe izingane zabo ubezinunusela ngemali nangamamaswidi. Ngokusho kwabo, umsolwa ungumuntu ozimele kahle endaweni, yingakho izingane zabo bezithanda ukuyodlala nezingane zakwakhe.Bathe emzini kamsolwa kunezinto eziningi zokudlala izingane njengozwingi, amabhayisikili nokunye okuningi okuthandwa izingane.INGXENYE yomphakathi obutheleke eNkantolo yeMantshi eChatsworth eThekwini, uzobhikishela owesilisa osolwa ngokudlwengula izingane zamantombazane emijondolo yaseManyaleni endaweni:Isithombe TUMI PAKKIES“Besiyaye singanaki uma izingane zethu ziyodlala khona ngoba naye unezingane. Bezidlala ndawonye nezakhe kwakhe,” kuchaza omunye wabazali.Njengendoda emi kahle, kuthiwa umsolwa ubenganqeni ukulayisha izingane zomakhelwane azivakashise ebhishi ziyozijabulisana nezakhe.Bathe izingane zabo azisafuni nokuya esikoleni ngoba zihlekwa ngezinye, kwazise sekuyaziwa ukuthi kunezinsolo zokudlwengulwa wumsola.“Ezinye umchamo usuyaziphumela nje, azisakwazi ukuzibamba ngenxa yokudlwengulwa. Abanye babantwana bethu sebehlala bezinwaya amathanga sengathi banotwayi. Badlala le ndoda endala.”Abanye abazali bathe izingane zabo sezihlale zikhala uma kwenzeka zibuka ithelevishini ekhombisa izithombe zabantu ababambanayo ngoba kuba sengathi lokho kwenzeka kuzona.Nakuba abanye babo bethe izingane zabo zithola ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo njalo ngenyanga, abanye bathe ezabo kuselukhuni satshe ukuthola lokho ngoba abazi ukuthi kumele benze njani.

BAGWETSHWE odilikajele abalisa abathathu abalahlwe ngamacala okubulala ngesihluku amaphoyisa esigamekweni esenzeke ngoSepthemba 2015 emijondolo yaseNamibia, eNanda. IJaji laseNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini uXolile Ntshulana likhiphe lesi sigwebo ngoMgqibelo lathi sizobafundisa isifundo ababulali abangakhombisi ngisho ukuzisola.ULindokuhle Mchunu (20), uSboniso Khubisa (22) noSabelo Mkhize (28) baphinde bengezelwa eminye iminyaka ngamanye amacala. Bathola iminyaka engu-15 ngokubamba inkunzi behlomile, emihlanu yokuzama ukubulala baphinda bathola eminye engu-15 nezinyanga ezingu-12 ngokutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.Kuthiwa benza ubuqili baya esiteshini samaphoyisa bayozenza abacela usizo lokuhambisa incwadi yenkantolo kumuntu thizeni bafika bawajikela amaphoyisa.USeargent Vusumuzi Moyane noSeargent Ntombikayise Precious Jojisa bephucwa izibhamu bakhunyuliswa nezimpahla zomsebenzi. Bababophela evenini babavalela bahamba bayobabulalela kwenye indawo bazama ukungqongqisa imoto yamaphoyisa ngomlilo. Phakathi kwezibhamu ababezisebenzisa kwakukhona i-AK 47 ne-9mm okuthiwa babebadubula ngazo kwala ngisho becela uxolo baqhubeka babadubula. Kuthiwa uJojisa wasinda ngenxa yokuthi wazenza umuntu oshonile waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela eMhlanga wahlala inyanga. UNkk Lihle Moyane ongunkosikazi wephoyisa elabulawa ubekhona enkantolo uthe nakuba simgculisa isigwebo kodwa ngeke simbuyise umyeni wakhe.“Lezi zinhlungu ziyohlala zikhona enhlizweni yami. Njalo uma ngibona abasolwa begibela ebhokisini siyabuya isithombe sesihluku abasenza kumnyeni wami,’’ kusho uNkk Moyane.Ilungu lomndeni womunye wababulali uSipho Mkhize elingafunanga ukudalulwa lithe ibambe ngakho ngokugwetshwa kwakhe ngoba bebefuna ajeze nabo bengumndeni ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi wayengabenza le nto. Kuvele ukuthi lo mlisa uvele unenxanxathela yamacala ake amlahla phambilini.

UBEPHUME kubo eyotadisha umfundi waKwaMshayazafe, eNanda, oshiswe ngempelasonto nesoka lakhe, nokusolwa ukuthi bashiswe obeyisoka lobegadiswe umjondolo okwenzeke kuwo isehlo.UNomasonto Zuma (17) obefunda uGrade 11 eSiyathuthuka High, ushe wangqongqa noMbusiseni Langa (18) ngentathakusa yangeSonto. Lesi sehlo kuthiwa sisuswe yingxabano ebiphakathi kukamsolwa nobeyintombi yakhe ebigada umjondolo oshile.Kuthiwa umsolwa wafika endlini ngezithuba zabo 9 ngoMgqibelo ebusuku ezobona uNksz Anelisa Vezi (24) okuthiwa bebethandana naye, ehlala kulo mjondolo onamakamelo amabili. Ingxabano isuswe wukuthi umsolwa ufice uNksz Vezi enoyise wezingane, kwaliwa.Elandisa Isolezwe uNksz Vezi, uthe ubesenamasonto amabili ehlukene nomsolwa wabuyelana noyise wezingane zakhe ezingamawele anezinyanga ezingu-17.“Bengicabanga ukuthi wamukela uma ngimtshela ukuthi sengibuyelene noyise wezingane. Ubevele engezile ngobuhle ngoba akazange angitshele ukuthi uyeza. Wafika walwisa uyise wezingane, ngaphuma ngabalekela kwamakhelwane. Izingane zami zize zathathwa ubhuti wakwamakhelwane,” echaza.Uthe ingxabano iqhubeke kwaze kwashaya izithuba zabo-11 ebusuku, omakhelwane banquma ukuthi umsolwa asale eselala khona endlini ngoba sekusebusuku. UNksz Vezi uthe yena walala kwamakhelwane nezingane. Kwelinye ikamelo elingaphandle elixhumene nendlu obekuxatshanwa kuyo, bekujwayele ukulala uLanga uma evakashelwe intombi yakhe.UNOMASONTO ZUMA oshe nesoka lakhe kuhlaselwa umjondolo abebelele kuwoKuthiwa kwezwakala ngezithuba zabo 2 ekuseni kusha endlini, izicishamlilo zafika emuva kwendaba. Kutholakale isidumbu sikaNomasonto nesikaLanga endlini.UMnuz Sthembiso Xulu onguyise kaNomasonto uthe ubengazi ukuthi uyathandana nomufi. Uthe waphuma ephethe ibhuku lesikole kungathi uyofunda. Uveze ukuthi ubehlakaniphile esikoleni futhi ethanda nokubhala izinkondlo.Oyisihlobo sikaLanga, uMnuz Thokozani Ntuli uthe ubenenyanga efike eThekwini ephuma KwaMaphumulo.“Intombi kamfowethu besiyazi ngoba ibijwayele ukumvakashela futhi ibingaqali ukulala. Ngesikhathi kuvalwe izikole yahlala isonto lonke. Umfowethu ubeya kule ndlu ngoba eseyolala ngoba lapho efikele khona indawo ayanele kahle. Sisola ukuthi umsolwa ubengazi ukuthi kunabantu abalele kwelinye ikamelo, ubethi ulaya intombi yakhe,” kusho uNtuli.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuphenywa amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwezidumbu ezishile eNanda. Uthe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-33 uboshiwe wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi eNtuzuma izolo, kanti kushaye isikhathi sokuloba ingakatholakali imininingwane yasenkantolo yokuthi icala lihambe kanjani.

MHLELI: Ngoba isiphekiwe sengithi mangiyiphule ngiyihlukanise ngezithebe mayelana nodaba oluphakanyiswe ngokubanjwa kwabantu eNquthu obelushicilelwe ephephandabeni lomhla ka-13.Yiqiniso elingephikwe lelo, sengikubone izikhawu kwenzeka phambi kwami kuyilapho ngingeke ngenze lutho. Bayabulala laba bafana abadlali. Imbangela yakho konke lokhu wukucanasa kwabashushumbisi bezidakamizwa ezidayisa udede kuleli dolobha.Ngikusho lokhu ngoba umphakathi namaphoyisa uyabazi laba bantu abashushumbisayo kodwa abathathelwa zinyathelo ngoba wobhululu babo. Okungamaphoyisa bayakucubuzelela. Thina njengomphakathi kasiphephile. Angiphathi uma sekuhwalele kumele wazi ukuthi ungahle ungafiki nasekhaya.Uma ushayisa sekuhlwile kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uthola into ezokubeka ekhaya. Kuke kwatholakala izidumbu ezine zababulawa ngobusuku obubodwa.Ingalo yomthetho kuleli imfishane kakhulu. Lokhu ngikusho ngoba ziningi izigameko zokubulawa kwabantu kodwa kuthuleke kube sengathi akwenzekanga lutho.Amabhubesi uma engaboshwa afuyelwe ukuba asidle asiqede. Kwala noma umphakathi usibambile isigebengu usiyise emaphoyiseni unele ungahamba sidedelwe usibone sesibhampa sinilandela sinichomela ngoba sesidedelwe. Sesiyoqhubeka la sigcine khona.Kwesinye isikhathi umphakathi uwaluma indlebe amaphoyisa baboshwe abenzi bokubi maqede inkantolo ibakhiphe ithi abukho ubufakazi . Ngicela ukuba kujutshwe ithimba elizonqanda ukubhebhetheka kwamaphara adlangile eNquthu.OkhathazekileeNquthu

USEMANZINI owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma nomndeni wakhe njengoba behlelwe yifu elimnyama kudlula indodana yakhe, uVusi Nhlakanipho Zuma, esibhedlela iMilpark Hospital, eGoli ngeSonto ebusuku.UVusi ubeneminyaka engu-25.Osondelene nomndeni kaZuma futhi owayeyilungu lo Mkhonto weSizwe, uMnuz Carl Niehaus, uqinisekise lezi zindaba ngoMsombuluko ekuseni. Uthe imininingwane ngokushona kukaVusi ubengakayitholi kwazise ubengakaxhumani nomndeni kaZuma."Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uVusi, oyindodana yalowo owayenguMengameli kuleli uZuma, ushonile izolo (ngeSonto) ebusuku ngemuva kokuxinwa wukugula. Anginaso isiqiniseko sokuthi ubephethwe yini nokuthi unjani umndeni njengamanje kodwa ngizoxhumana nawo maduze," kusho uNiehaus.Ngokwemibiko, uVusi Zuma ungumagcino ezinganeni zikaZuma noNkk Kate Mantsho Zuma, owazibulala ngo-2000. Kwabazalwa noVusi kubalwa namawele uDuduzile noDuduzane Zuma.Okhulumela uZuma, uMnuz Vukile Mathabela, naye uziniqisekisile lezi zindaba wathi kusazoqokwa ozokhulumela umndeni ozoveza eminye imininingwane ngokuhamba kosuku.

ANGAPHEZULU kuka-100 amagatsha e-ANC KwaZulu-Natal angeke abe yingxenye yengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi besifundazwe eqala namhlanje enyuvesi yaseZululand, oNgoye.Lawa magatsha awazange ahlangabezane nemibandela ebekiwe yokuthi akwazi ukuthamela ingqungquthela. Kanjalo nobuholi bezifunda ezintathu okuke kwaba nezehlakalo zokubulawa kwabaholi okuyiHarry Gwala, Moses Mabhida neLower South Coast buhlakaziwe, buzoya kule ngqungquthela kodwa abuvoti.Lokhu kuvezwe nguMxhumanisi wethimba lesikhashana elihola le nhlangano esifundazweni, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ekhuluma nabezindaba ngamalungiselelo ale ngqungquthela.UZikalala uthe bagculisekile ngoba amagatsha amaningi ahlalile bahlangabezana nokuthi * -70% wamagatsha ukuthi kumele ahlale ukuze kube nengqungquthela. “Angaphezulu kuka-800 amagatsha okuhlolwe ukuthi akulungele yini ukuya engqungqutheleni. Angu-686 aphasile okuyiwona azoya engqungqutheleni. Mabili amalungu igatsha ngalodwa azoya engqungqutheleni.”Uthe ingqungquthela eyamagatsha, wathi sebeyilungele ingqungquthela.Uthe bahlalise izingqungquthela zezifunda eziyisithupha ngempumelelo wathi bese kusele lezi ezintathu ezihlakaziwe. “Wonke amagatsha anikwe ithuba lokuthi alethe izikhalazo zawo. Ubuholi bukazwelonke bebuseMoses Mabhida ibona obuzonquma ukuthi imaphi amagatsha azoya engqungqutheleni.”UNksz Nocawe Mafu, isithunywa sesigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano kulesi sifundazwe, uthe uyajabula ukuthi iyahlala ingqungquthela, wathi uthemba ukuthi izoba yimpumelelo.Ebuzwa ngezinsolo zalabo okuthiwa kabaneme abazomashela ubuholi obusha ngelizayo, uthe akukho abasakutholile.“Akukho esisakutholile mayelana nabantu abathi bazomasha noma abazoya enkantolo ngoba bengeneme. Uma kwenzeka i-ANC iyobhekana nakho ngendlela efanele,” kusho uNksz Mafu.UZikalala uphawule nangokubulawa kwabaholi wathi ngenye yezinselelo ababhekene nayo.“Lezi zehlakalo zenza kube nokungathembani kumalungu. Sisebenzisana nabezomthetho ukuze kunqandwe lesi sihlava kuboshwe abenzi bobubi. Sikholelwa ngukuthi ezobulungiswa zingazinqanda lezi zehlakalo.”Ubuholi besifundzwe bahlakazwa ngemuva kokuba kukhona uhlangothi olwavunwa yinkantolo yaseMgungundlovu ngokuthatha njengento engekho imiphumela yengqungquthela eyakhetha uZikalala njengoSihlalo ngo-2015 eMgungundlovu noMnuz Super Zuma njengoNobhala.Kule ngqungquthela kulindeleke ukuthi uZikalala abuyele njengokugiya kulesi sikhundla, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kukhulunywa ekaMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, owayekhulumela ubuholi obahlakazwa ophinde abe yiphini likaSotwebhu le-ANC esiShayamthetho sesifundazwe njengoNobhala wesifundazwe.

UMZALI oziba ingane uma imbikela ngokunukubezwa kunamathuba amaningi okuthi naye akhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Lokhu kushiwo uConstable Lihle Mlotshwa woPhiko oluphenya amacala odlame emndenini, oluvikela izingane, luphenye namacala athinta ucansi, iFamily Violence, Child Protection and Sexual Offenses Unit (FCS), ngesikhathi kunemashi yezingane ezifunda ezinkulisa zaKwaNgcolosi, izolo.Izingane bezinxusa umphakathi ukuthi uzivikele okuhambisana nomkhankaso wesonto lokuvikelwa kwezingane, iChild Protection Week.UConstable Mlotshwa uthe umzali akangayizibi ingane uma imtshela ukuthi kubuhlungu esithweni sangasese ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi inukubezwe ngokocansi.“Izingane azikwazi ukukhuluma zichaze konke futhi ziyakhohlwa. Kuyenzeka ikhohlwe uma ingamboni lowo muntu kodwa uma eqhamuka ikhumbule. Uma seyifike emaphoyiseni isho ukuthi yamtshela unina ukuthi kubuhlungu waziba, thina sibopha umzali,” kusho yena.UNksz Sinegugu Ngobese wophiko olukuMasipala weTheku, i-Environment Affairs, olubheka ukuthi izakhiwo nemvelo okuseduze nezinkulisa akuyibeki yini engcupheni impilo yezingane, uthe ukufundisa izingane enkulisa engaphephile kuwukuhlukumeza ilungelo lengane.“Inhloso yophiko ukubheka ukuthi amathoyilethi asesimeni futhi ayisibalo esanele abafundi, ikhishi lisesimeni, isikhotha nezihlahla eziseduze ngabe kunqunyiwe yini ngeke kwenzeke kuqhamuke izilwane ezingalimaza izingane. Konke lokhu kuyingxenye yemithetho elawula idolobha, asikwenzi ngoba sifuna ukuhlukumeza abanikazi bezinkulisa,” kusho yena.UNksz Busi Dladla, osekomitini likasoseshini wezinkulisa wakule ndawo, uthe abazali kumele baqaphele omalume abahambisa izingane ezinkulisa.“Ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi imoto isesimeni futhi inamaphepha afanele, mzali yiba nesiqiniseko sokuthi umalume akadluli emathaveni nengane ngoba izingane zibuka akwenzayo bese zicabanga ukuthi kuhle,” kusho yena
