text: ISIGUNGU esiphezulu se-ANC sijube ikomiti elixazulula izikhalo ukuthi lisebenzisane nethimba lesikhashana le-ANC eKZN ukulungisa zonke izikhalazo zamalungu ayise le nhlangano enkantolo.Esitatimendini esikhishwe nguNobhala jikelele uMnuz Ace Magashule izolo ngemuva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu obuse-Irene, ePitoli, ngoMsombuluko, uthe uma kwenzeka lokhu bazokwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona ngaphandle kwasezinkantolo.UMagashule uthe inhloso ukubumba inhlangano wathi ukusebenzisana kuzokwenza ukuthi ingqungquthela ihlale ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga ezayo. “Umhlangano oyisipesheli wesigungu sikazwelonke ujube izithunywa zalo ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinkinga nezikhalazo ziyalungiswa. Mkhulu umsebenzi osuwenziwe siyanxusa ukuthi baqhubeke basebenzisane.”Uthe kumele amalungu akwazi ukuphakamisa izinto angeneme ngazo ikakhulu izikhalo.“Siyanxusa ukuthi amalungu asebenzise izinhlaka zangaphakathi. Kuyofika isikhathi lapho sizothi kuphela la kulabo abangafuni ukusebenzisa izinhlaka zangaphakathi abagjimela ezinkantolo ekubeni bengazange balandele yonke imigomo.”Amalungu angeneme amisa ingqungquthela yesifundazwe ngomzuzu wokugcina ekhala ngokuthi kunamagatsha ashiywe ngaphandle. nangempelasonto kube yiso leso eMoses Mabhida kwamiswa ingqungquthela olunye uhlangothi oluthi beyihlaliswa isinyenyela.Odabeni lwase-Easern Cape, uthe bafuna isixazululo sezepolitiki ukuze sisize inhlangano njengoba kukhona abaye enkantolo. ELimpopo uthe yonke into isimi ngomumo mayelana nengqungquthela ezoqala ngoLwesihlanu yokukhetha ubuholi.ENorth West uthe bajube ikomiti elibheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke ukuthi linqume ngozoba nguNdunankulu kusasa wathi namhlanje kuzoba nomhlangano oyisipesheli waleli komiti ukuze linqume.EGauteng nakhona uthe mkhulu umsebenzi owenziwe ukuze kuhlaliswe ingqungquthela ingakapheli inyanga ezayo.“Siyanxusa ubuholi bezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuthi zilandele imigomo yenhlangano mayelana nokuthi busingathe kanjani eyobuholi enhlanganweni nokuthi kulandelwe imigomo buphinde bunike izinhlaka ithuba lokuthi zikwazi ukuletha izikhalo.”

KUMISIWE ukufunda okwesikhashana esikoleni eBunguni Secondary kulandela ukuvuka umbhejazane kwabafundi, bashisa isikole bekhala ngokungabibikho kokudla.Izolo akuzange kufundwe kulesi sikole esiseNkanini, eMuden ngaphandle kwaseGreytown, emuva kwesigameko sangoMsombuluko lapho abafundi beqale bashaya khona othisha ngamatshe, baphihliza nezimoto zabo. Kuthiwa othisha baphume sebephelezelwa amaphoyisa. Abafundi basale baphihliza wonke amawindi esikole basokhela ngomlilo sasha sangqongqa.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke emuva kwesonto abafundi bebhale incwadi bebuza uthishanhloko ukuthi “balamba kangaka ikhona yini inkinga?” Kuthiwa bebefuna izimpendulo ukuthi kungani begcine ukudla ngoMeyi 15 nonyaka. Sekuphele amasonto amathathu kungadliwa namanzi engabonwa.Uthishanhloko kuthiwa wabhala incwadi wayihlohla eMnyangweni wezeMfundo nophakela lesi sikole ukudla emuva kwesikhalo sabafundi.NgoMsombuluko kuthiwa kuqale ngokujwayelekile ukufunda esikoleni kodwa kwathi sekuyisikhathi setiye abafundi bangabuyela emakilasini, kuthiwa yilapho beqale khona ukudedela amatshe bewabhekise kothisha.Othisha kuthiwa babaleke bangena endlini yabo yokuhlangana, amatshe elokhu ebalandela.Kubizwe amaphoyisa nabanye abazali ukuba bazolamula.Othisha bakhishwe amaphoyisa, babaleka.Abazali bafikile esikoleni bezolamula kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya njengoba abafundi bevele bokhela isikole ngomlilo besebenzisa amafutha.USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Ndoda Manyoni ethintwa izolo, uthe badumele ngalesi sigameko ngoba izingane zabo zizophazamiseka ezifundweni.“Kunzima nokuba ngikhulume ngalento njengoba isikole sishe saphela. Wonke amawindi esikole abulewe, kushe amagumbi okufunda, ihhovisi, indawo egcina impahla yesikole. Esikutholile ukuthi abafundi abazange besabuyela emakilasini beshaya othisha ngamatshe, kubizwe amaphoyisa, bagcina ngokushisa isikole. Asazi noma abafundi noma imidlwembe enza lento. Esikwaziyo ukuthi abafundi bakhala ngendaba yokungabi bikho kokudla namanzi esikoleni. Uthishanhloko ubesalulungisa udaba,” kusho uManyoni.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi abazi ukufunda kuzoqhubeka nini.“Nginezingane ezintathu kulesi sikole, efunda uGrade 12, 11 no-9. Angazi ngizokwenzenjani uma kuvalwa isikole, izingane ngizozilusisa izinkomo yini njengoba singenayo imali yokuziyisa kwezinye izikole. Namhlanje (izolo) bekumele kubhalwe izivivinyo zika-matric wangonyaka odlule kodwa akwenzekanga njengoba isikole sishisiwe. Kunomhlangano ebesinawo othisha bafike begadwe amaphoyisa ngoba besaba. Akufundwa nje esikoleni, asazi koze kufundwe nini ngoba isikole simoshwe saphela,” kusho uManyoni.Emuva komhlangano wayizolo kuphume umbono womhlangano ophuthumayo nokulindeleke ukuba uhanjelwe ubuholi bendawo okubalwa nenkosi.Lo mhlangano uhlelelwe uLwesihlanu ekuseni.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa uthe bayalwazi loludaba futhi benza konke okusemandleni ukuba isimo sibuyele kwesijwayelekile bese kuyafundwa. Uthe basenza uphenyo ngendaba ethinta ukudla kwabafundi naso isigameko sangoMsombuluko ukuthi senzeke kanjani.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt. Col Thulani Zwane, uthe kuvulwe icala lokucekela phansi impahla.“Kushiswe isikole, kwaphoswa amatshe kwalinyazwa izimoto namakilasi. Izimoto ezine ezilinyaziwe. Amacala avulwe esiteshini eMuden, uphenyo luyaqhubeka kodwa akekho oboshiwe,” kusho uZwane.

AKUVUMI ngisho ayibuke indlu okushe kwangqongqa kuyo indodakazi yakhe eneminyaka ewu-19, eshone igoyise isoka KwaDukuza kuleli sonto.UNksz Gugu Dludla (35), obengekho ngesikhathi kwenzeka lokhu, uthi uvuswe wucingo ngeSonto ekuseni obemshayela emazisa ukuthi indodakazi yakhe uLuwiza Dludla (19) yaseZimpempeni nesoka lakhe bokheleke ngomlilo ezintatha ngeSonto.ULuwiza ushone endleleni ebheke esibhedlela, isoka lona lisesimweni esibucayi esibhedlela.“Angazi kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni ngoba bebelele ekamereni lami kodwa akushanga lutho kulo. Into eshile yizintambo zikagesi naphezu kwefriji.“Kuyisono ukuba nemidlinzo kodwa kukhona izinto ezingashile okufanele engabe zishile nazo. UNkulunkulu kuphela owaziyo, sesibonga nokuthi kukhona osindile phakathi kwabo,” kusho uNksz Dludla.ULUWIZA Dludla oshe nendlu kubo ngempelasonto edluleUthe lesi yisilonda esisekude ukuphola ngoba uLuwiza bekuyindodakazi yakhe yokuqala yokugcina njengoba enganazo ezinye izingane. “Angazi ngizophinde ngingene kanjani kule ndlu. Angazi noma kusazohlaleka yini lapha ekhaya emuva kwaleli bhadi. Ngihlukumezekile. Kuningi ebengisakubheke kuye ngoba ubenza izifundo zeTourism yize ebesaphazanyiswe wukugula,” kubalisa uNksz Dludla.Ilungu lomndeni wesoka elicele ukungadalulwa amagama, lithi lishaqekile ngoba kwehla lesi sigameko nje bebazi ukuthi basendlini yesoka (31).Udadewabo omncane wesoka, ohlala nalo kubo, uthi bebezwana futhi akukho akubona kuyinkinga ngelanga abagcine ngalo.“Ngaqala ngayobheka endlini yakhe kuqala ngesikhathi ngivuswa kuthiwa sebetholwe besha nendlu. Angazi bahamba nini ngoba ngabagcina bekhona.“Ngisadidekile ngoba nomuntu oshile unengane futhi uyena osebenzayo la ekhaya.Kodwa sesilinde yena ukuthi asichazele kahle ngokwenzeka uma esephapheme,” kusho udadewabo wesoka.Ukushona kukaLuwiza kushiye namalungu omphakathi ekhala. ULuwiza ubengomunye wabalandeli bomculi kamaskandi uStezie Mhlanzi weMabayeni Amahle. UStezie uthe bagqemeke ingozi engeqiwantwala ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaLuwiza.Amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal asiqinisekisile isigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe kusaphenywa.“Imbangela yokusha ayikakaziwa okwamanje kodwa uphenyo luyaqhubeka,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.IMeya yaKwaDukuza uMnuz Ricardo Mthembu ithe umasipala uthole ngomzuzu wokugcina ngalesi sigameko ngenxa yemigudu elandelwayo bekungaselula ukuthi kufakwe isandla okwenze wakhipha ephaketheni lakhe.

text: MHLELI: Bengicela kwabohlanga kesibheke emuva lapho sisuka khona ukuthi ngabe sisayibambe ngakho noma isisiphunyukile isidla utshani? Ake sibheke isimo phansi kwalezi zihloko ezilandelayo.(1)imisebenzi (2)ubugebengu (3)ezokuhlaliswa kwabantu.(4)umhlaba.(5)abohlanga.Ngike ngizibuze ukuthi imbangela yokuswela umsebenzi ngabe yini? Ngike ngibone izikhangiso zomsebenzi ziziningi futhi zisho nemiholo emihle bese ngixakeka ukuthi pho kungani izingane zakwethu zihlale zikhala ngokungaqasheki zibe zifundile. Uma ulandelisisa inkinga ngamava.Ngiwufakazi walokho ngoba ngiye ngibone ezikhangisweni kufuneka abanamava eminyaka ewu-3,5,7 alowo msebenzi.Bekunganjani uma uhulumeni wethu ake abhekelele abafowethu nodadewethu abahleli neziqu zabo emakhaya ngenxa yamava angekho adingwa wumsebenzi abawufundele. Imalimboleko ebizwa ngoNSfas boyoyibuyisa nini behleli neziqu emakhaya.Benginombono othi njengoba uhulumeni ekwazi ukunikeza izibonelelo kubantu abahlwempu nabo akazame ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ngokomsebenzi awufundele athole lelo thuba lokusebenza esizana nasebemkantshubomvu ukuze azuze amava awumgoqo ekutheni aqasheke. Ngicabanga ukuthi singabasiza leso sibonelelo sokuthi bakwazi ukuzibheka besafuna amava. Ubugebengu ngicabanga ukuthi imbangela yabo ukusweleka komsebenzi.Yebo singephike ukuthi nokufuna imali esheshayo nobuvila nakho kunomthelela ebugebengwini. Okunye okuyinkinga wukuhlaliswa kwabantu ezindaweni ezingakulungele ukuhlala - ezingahlelekile, ezingenagesi, amanzi ukuthuthwa kwendle nemigwaqo.Uma ngikhumbula kahle indawo ekulungele ukuhlalisa umphakathi iqala ihlolwe wochwepheshe ukuthi kukhonani phansi nokuthi kumele izakhiwo zibe wuhlobo olunjani anduba kuhlaliswe umphakathi.Umhlaba ngane zakwethu ukhona ubanzi inkinga ukuthi siyakwazi yini ukuwusebenzisa?Asingafani nomuntu othenga imoto engakwazi ukushayela bese igcina isisetshenziswa ngabakwaziyo, ingabi nanzuzo kuye. Bengingacela singabohlanga kesihlukane nobuvila nokufuna ukwenzelwa wuhulumeni ngaso sonke isikhathi. Asimlekeleleni ukuze naye asisize kwesikuvezayo. Sasingavoteli ukuhlala sikhangezwa wuhulumeni. Sasivotela ukuba sikhululeke. Uhulumeni ake asilalele uma sikhala kungaze kushiswe izakhiwo zomphakathi kube yima elalela. Lokho kukodwa nje kusiphindisela emuva ngoba kusasa uzothi akanamali yokusisiza usalungisa umonakalo odaleke ngenkathi kubhikishelwa izimfuno zomphakathi.Ngakhoke ngiyacela bafowethu nodadewethu isikhathi sokushisa nokulimaza izinsiza sesadlula. Akusezona ezobandlululo sekungezethu, yimali yabakhokhi bentela esidlala ngayo. Ake sibe nezinye izindlela zokukhononda nohulumeni asheshe ezwe angalindi ukuthi abantu baze baphelelwe yisineke.Asingazitholi sesifana namanye amazwe ase-Afrika ngobuphofu ngoba nawo ayefana nathi ekusukeni. Asiqapheleni ngane zakwethu singazibulali sibhekile.Sesikhululekile manje asiyibambeni ingasiphunyuki, sokhomba bani ngomunwe? Abakuhulumeni abangazinothisi bona nemindeni yabo. Balapho nje bathunywe yithina.Petrus RadebeEMadadeni

Ziningi izinhlobo zamakhanda abuhlungu kakhulu ezikhona kodwa namhlanje sizothi qaphu qaphu ngambalwa kulawo anomgudu othile olandelekayo uma ekuhlasela. Ubuchopho abukwazi ukuzwela ubuhlungu ngoba abunazo izinsiza zokubuzwela. Ebuchosheni kunenqwaba yemithambo nemizwa futhi zikhona nezicubu ezizungeze intamo nobuso konke lokhu kuyakwazi ukuzwela ubuhlungu. Ubuhlungu obuzwelwa yilezi zingxenye bugcina buzwele okungathi ubuhlungu osebusuka ebuchosheni uqobo ngenxa yokuthungelana kwemizwa. Namhlanje ngikhethe ukukhuluma ngamakhanda ambalwa alandela imigujwana ejwayelekile.Kunamakhanda anomkhuba wokuqala ukuhlasela emini yasekuseni okanye njalo ntambama.Kuphinde kube namakhanda aqala njalo ebusuku, ngesikhathi cishe esisodwa, ikhanda elikuvusa njalo ngezinhlungu.Kunamakhanda ankenketha uma uya ocansini, avele abhebhetheke kakhulu uma ufika kuvuthondaba.Angikwazi ukushiya ikhanda elibamba lisonte uhlangothi oluthile lobuso, elifika ngezikhawu linkenkethele ukuthi hayiza.Ngikhethe ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinhlobo, sike siziyeke lezi ezinye esizijwayele ngoba sesike sakhuluma nzulu ngazo phambili. Ayikho indlela yokulapha ikhanda ngaphandle kokuthola imbangela yalo bese ulapha yona. Kuba nzima kakhulu uma uthi uya kumsizi wezempilo bese ekutshela ukuthi akasazi isizathu sokuthi ube nezinhlungu ezingaka zekhanda, ube wena ufa ungalali ukuqaqanjelwa. Ekugcineni bazokunikeza okokuthomolalisa izinhlungu uma bengashongo ukuthi hamba uyobona nodokotela woluleko lwezengqondo. Akukho okubi ngokuthi udokotela wakho akuse olulekweni lwezengqondo uma isimo sisho njalo. Engikushoyo ukuthi lokhu makwenzeke sekuhlolwe ngokwanele kufunwa isizathu esiwumsusa wekhanda. Akekho umuntu ongenayo ingcindezi yomqondo kodwa akusiyena wonke umuntu le ngcindezi emphathisa ngekhanda elingalawuleki. Kungumsebenzi kadokotela ukuphanda isizathu esiwumsusa walezi zinhlungu. Abantu bakithi bakhathele ukuzibona bethalaliswa, benyanyalatwa.Ikhanda eliqala emini yasekuseni nantambamaKunamakhanda abangelwa ukushintsha kwamakhemikhali agcwalelene egazini. Isibonelo salapha yikhanda elidalwa utshwala. Ikhemikhali ewutshwala ingena ithontelane egazini bese ichamsela izinhlotshana zamanye amakhemikhali athi angafinyelela ezingeni elithile bese edala ikhanda elibihlungu. Nendlala (ithyroid evuvukele) njengoba yenza ukuthi umzimba usebenze ngokweqile nje lokhu kufukamela kuchumisa amakhemikhali amaningi egazini. Lolu chungechunge lokufukamela kuchamiselwe kuzokwenza izicutshana zemithambo nemizwa kuqale ukusonteka, kugxumagxume, kugcine kwenze ikhanda elibuhlungu. Yingakho izinhlungu zekhanda zalapha ezingaba ngaphambili ekhanda, ngemuva okanye emaceleni ekhanda kwabanye zenza okusankwatshu ekhanda okuba buhlungu kungabekezeleleki. Abanye baze bathi kungathi ushaywa unhlangothi. Leli khanda lizwela kancane emishanguzweni yezinhlungu, uyiphuza uze ukhathale. Isikhathi esiningi ezigulini esizibonayo, imbangela nomsusa wale nhlobo yekhanda, yindlala esuke ivuvukele. Kubalulekile ukuthi omuntu okhala ngaleli khanda, ahlolelwe kubhekwe ukuthi indlala kayivuvukele na, bese kuthi uma kunjalo lowo othintekayo aqale amaphilisi aqondene nalowo msuka. Okunye okumele sikukhumbule ukuthi indlala egula ngale ndlela kuningi engakona ngaphakathi emzimbeni, kugcine ukugula kwakho sekunompele ezindaweni eziningi.Ikhanda eliqala njalo ebusukuKunenhlobo yekhanda, ubuhlungu balo buqala njalo ebusuku ngesikhathi esisodwa. Leli lona livamise kubantu asebethe ukukhula ngeminyaka ikakhulu. Ubuhlungu bekhanda buvela ebusuku ngesikhathi esisodwa njalo, uvuka nje wena ngaleli khanda eselibuhlungu. Le nhlobo yekhanda ibuya iphindelela, kokunye ize ibalelwe ezikhawini ezingaphezu kuka-10 ngenyanga.Ikhanda locansiKukhona abantu abaphathwa yikhanda elibuhlungu, libe yinto ekusheshisayo uma uya ocansini, izinhlungu lezi ziya phambili uma ufika kuvuthondaba. Kucatshangelwa ukuthi leli khanda lidalwa ukwehla kwegazi eliya ebuchosheni ngoba phela wena isigubhukane nje usuthe emzimbeni wakho igazi ulidinga kakhulu emazansi nomzimba. Akuyena uwonkewonke oba nalesi simo ocansini.Ubuhlungu obusanyazi esayidini lobusoKukhona ubuhlungu okuvele kunyazime isayidi lobuso kube sengathi uyashokheka ohlangothini. Iminjunju lena ilandela umuzwa omkhulu olapha ebusweni, kuhlanganisa isimongo nezinhlafuno. Lokhu kuhlaseleka kwalo muzwa kunezikhawu ngezikhawu.Okubalulekile ngazo zonke lezi zinhlotshana zamakhanda ukuthi ziyelapheka. Kumqoka ukuthola isiphethu esiwumsusa bese kulashwe kuliwe nalo mbaseli.Mpilonde!

SEZIQALE phansi izinkinga esikoleni samabanga aphezulu eMbumbulu esacishe savalwa ngenxa yokungaziphathi kahle kwabafundi, asebekhala ngesibhaxu kuthishanhloko.Abafundi baseMbambangwe Secondary abafunda u-matric badube amakilasi izolo nangoLwesithathu bekhala ngokuthi abasakwazi ukubekezelela ukushaywa nguthishanhloko, bakhala nangokuthi uyabathuka. Njengoba abafundi abaningi baka-matric bezoqhubeka nokufunda uma kuvalwa izikole namuhla, abaseMbambangwe abacele ukungadalulwa bathe abalubhadi esikoleni. Bathi sekukaningi bekhononda ngokushaywa manje sebenqume ukulusukumela lolu daba. Izolo bathe sebecele ukubonana nothishanhloko bamtshele okokugcina ngezikhalo zabo.Kuke kwavalwa amehlo ngesimo salesi sikole ngo-2014 kukhalwa ngabafundi abangalawuleki. Abanye babesolwa ngokuzihlanganisa namaqembu ezigebengu bese beqhubeka nezimpi zabo esikoleni. Ngo-2015 kwangenelela ikomidi iMbumbulu Education Forum ukulungisa isimo sesikole obesekuhlongozwa ukuthi sivalwe.USihlalo wekomiti inkosi Nathi Maphumulo, uthe bebengakezwa ngezinkinga zabafundi. Uthe uyadumala uma sebeqala olunye uthuthuva phezu kwemizamo yokulungisa isikole.“Uma abafundi bekhala ngokuqiniswa kwesandla nangokushaywa kumele baveze ubufakazi. Asihambisani nokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi kodwa ngeke sikhulume futhi ngento engenabo ubufakazi. Kuyadumaza lokhu ngoba isimo sesikole bese sibuyela kwesijwayelekile nathi sesigculisekile. Kuningi osekushintshile ngoba nohulumeni uthembise ukulekelela ukuze kunyuke nemiphumela ka-matric,” kusho uMaphumulo.Uthe ungomunye wabanxenxe iMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ukuthi ivakashele kulesi sikole nonyaka. UNkk Gumede ovakashile lesi sikole ngoFebhuwari, wanikela ngezimpahla zesikole wathembisa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi isikole senza kahle. UMaphumulo uthe konke lokhu bekuyimizamo yokuthi abafundi bakhuthazeke, isikole singabuyeli esimeni sakudala.Uthembise ukuthi bazolulandela udaba nezikhalo zabafundi.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lesi ngesinye sezikole esike sahlupha ngezinkinga phambilini.“Sizocela umbiko kwisekethe ukuze sithole ukuthi sinjani isimo esikoleni. Kudingeka sazi ukuthi yimiphi imizamo eyenziwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda akuphazamiseki, ikakhulukazi njengoba kuthinteka no-matric,” kusho uMlotshwa.Mayelana nezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuthishanhloko uthe badinga ubufakazi ukuze baphenye.

BANGASE babhekane nezimbila zithutha abasolwa ngobutabane abazohambela umhlangano wamaNazaretha, aseBuhleni kaJulayi njengoba sekusabalele amahlebezi okuthi bazothelwa isibhaxu uma beke bafika.Amalungu aleli bandla okuthiwa adinwe ayaveva ngezitabane okuthiwa uma zisemhlanganweni noma entabeni zisuke zize emfuleni wokweshela, noma ziye ocansini nezithandana nabo, ahlanganise uhla lwamalungu lwabasolwa ngokuba yizitabane athi kumele bathelwe induku uma befikile. Abanye kulaba abakulo luhla kuthiwa bathatha amantombazane nabafana babathembise ukuthi bazokwelashwa njengoba kuzobe kuzokhulekwa, uma sebefike babajikele babanukubeze.Kulolu hla kukhona amagama abesilisa nabesifazane, nemininingwane yokuthi baphuma kweziphi izindawo.Lolu hla lubhalwe ukuthi ‘Sikhipha isitabane eBuhleni, ingqikithi kaJulayi” bese kulandela amagama alabo abasolwa ngobutabane.Lolu luhla Isolezwe elinalo lusatshalaliswa emalungeni ebandla ngema-SMS noma ngoWhatsapp kodwa okhulumela leli bandla, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe ubengakezwa ngalo.NgoJanuwari abasolwa ngokuthi bayizitababane bathola isibhaxu, entabeni, iKhenani.Umthombo waleli phephandaba ongaphakathi uthe abasunguli balolu hla badinwe ukuthi cishe wonke amasonto kubikwa izigigaba okuthiwa zenziwe ngabasolwa ngobutabane emathempeleni, abazigqajayo ngokuthi baningi futhi bona banemali.“Abanye abantu abasolwa ngobutabane abakhokheli, abafundisi nabanye abantu abanezikhundla ebandleni. Basolwa ngokuthi basebenzisa izikhundla zabo ukubiza abagilwa,” usho kanje.UMncwabe uthe ibandla labo alibandlululi futhi abababuzi abantu abangalungu abo ngesikhathi bebhabhadiswa ukuthi baphila yiphi impilo.“Uma eyinhlalisuthi simthatha njengomuntu wesilisa kanjalo nowesifazane uma egqoka isiketi simthatha njengowesifazane. Siyazi ukuthi phakathi ebandleni bakhona abaya ocansini nabanobulili obufana nobabo kodwa lokhu akuvunyelwe ukuthi kwenziwe esontweni ngoba nabashadikazi abavunyelwe ukuya ocansini ngesikhathi somhlangano ngoba le ndawo ngeyokuthandaza,” kusho yena.UMnuz Willington Myeni womkhandlu ovikela ukuhlukunyezwa kwamaNazaretha, iNazareth Judiciary Council, uvumile ukuthi lolu hla uke walubona wathi kodwa bayaphenya.“Ukushaywa kwabantu esontweni akuvumelekile, abayitabane kumele bazi ukuthi njengoba besebandleni lamaNazaretha kumele balandele imigomo ebekiwe,” usho kanje.

IZIKHULU zamabhange ezingamalungu eBanking Association of South Africa (Basa) zithi zizimisele ukutakula izinkampani zikahulumeni ezinenkinga yezimali ukuze zingacwili kakhulu ezikweletini.Lesi simemezelo senziwe yisikhulu esiphezulu seBasa, uMnuz Cas Coovadia oveze ukuthi ngoLwesibili kaJuni 19 babenomhlangano noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Nhlanhla Nene, owamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan nePhini likaNene, uMnuz Mondli Gungubele.“Emhlanganweni sachazelwa ngesimo sezinkampani zikahulumeni nezingqinamba zezimali ezibhekene nazo. Sihambile sayokhuluma namalungu ethu siwachazela ukuthi uhulumeni udinga sisize izinkampani zakhe ukuze zikwazi ukukhokha izikweletu. Kuyoba yishwa uma lezi zinkampani zingase zeqiwe yizinyanga ezikweletini zazo. Amalungu ethu okungamabhange avumile ukusiza ngoba awafuni kube nabantu abaphelelwa wumsebenzi nokuthi umnotho wethu uwe,” kusho uCoovadia.Uthembise ukuthi bengamabhange bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukusiza izinkampani zikahulumeni ezifana ne-Eskom ukukhokha izikweletu zazo nokuthi zibuyelwe wuzinzo uma kukhulunywa ngokuphathwa kwezimali.“Uhulumeni uvumile ukuthi uzozilalela iziphakamiso ezenziwayo zokuthi izinkampani zakhe zenze imali. Uphinde wazibophezela ukuthi uyena ozobhekana nesikweletu uma izinkampani zihluleka wukukhokha. Izingxoxo zethu nohulumeni ziyaqhubeka ngoba sifuna indlela yokuthuthukisa umnotho wezwe,” kusho uCoovadia.Isazi somnotho nezomthetho, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa, sithe kufanele ishayelwe izandla iBasa ngesimemezelo sayo yize simbaxambili.“Isitatimende seBasa sihle uma kuwukuthi inkohlakalo efake izinkampani zikahulumeni kulesi simo esikuzo izokhucululwa ngoba abantu abadayisa amalahle kwa-Eskom bayawabizisa. Uthe isikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Phakamani Hadebe uyasithemba ngoba singumuntu owuhloniphayo umthetho kodwa akazi noma sizophumelela yini ukukhuculula inkohlakalo yeminyaka.“Ukuze i-Eskom ikwazi ukusebenza kahle, yenze nemali ngathi kungaqalwa phansi kuqashwe kabusha izinkampani eziwudayisela amalahle. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi kudala i-Eskom yayinezikhulu ezingu-81 kodwa manje zingaphezu kuka-500 ,” kusho uDumisa.Uthe ngisho kwaSAA kunoSihlalo weBhodi othembekile futhi okwaziyo ukuvusa izinkampani eziwayo uMnuz Johannes Bhekumuzi Magwaza kodwa akazi ukuthi kuzomthatha iminyaka emingaki ukukhuculula inkohlakalo yeminyaka.

BEKULINDELEKE ukuba libuyele enkantolo maduze ukuze kuqale ukuthethwa kwecala elithinteka kulo lokulunyiswa kwabantu ngezinja iphoyisa elidutshulwe ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu lingena emzini walo.UConstable Musawenkosi Khwela ubephuma emsebenzini ngoLwesihlanu ngo-10 ebusuku ngesikhathi ehlaselwa ngabantu abangaziwa emzini wakhe eZwelibomvu ngaKwaNdengezi, bamdubula, walimala kanzima. Ulaliswe egunjini labagula kakhulu esibhedlela.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kwenzeka lokhu nje leli iphoyisa elisebenza ophikweni lwezinja eShongweni belilungiselela ukuba lona nozakwabo ababili, abanecala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza nelokukhwabanisa, babuyele enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo ukuze kuqulwe icala labo.UKhwela uphume ngebheyili ngo-Ephreli nonyaka emuva kokuba bedlulise isicelo sokunikezwa ibheyili enkantolo enkulu eThekwini, ababenqatshelwe yona yiNkantolo yeMantshi ePinetown.Yisicelo sikaKhwela kuphela esaphumelela. Uhlaselwa nje bese ebuyele nasemsebenzini.Basolwa ngokuthi bebefuna imali ebantwini, uma bengenayo babalumise ngezinja. Akukacaci ukuthi ukuhlaselwa kukaKhwela kumayelana nani.NgoMgqibelo ibamba loMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, likugxekile ukuhlaselwa kukaKhwela.“Abahlasela amaphoyisa bazobhekana nolaka lomthetho. Sifisela u-constable olimele ukuba alulame ngokushesha,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni wephoyisa ayiphumelelanga izolo njengoba abaphathi bamaphoyisa beveze ukuthi ucele ukuba izinombolo zawo zinganikezwa abezindaba ngoba awufisi ukuxoxisana nabo ngokwenzekile.

SEKUPHUME incwadi eyalela ukuthi kuboshwe igeza lomlingisi eliyisilomo emdlalweni woMzansi Magic, iThe Queen elisolwa ngokungondli.Lo mlingisi leli phephandaba elingeke limdalule ukuvikela ingane, kuthiwa sekuphele izinyanga ezinhlanu engayondli indodana (2) yakhe. Kuthiwa umlingisi unamanye amadodakazi amabili ahlale ebonakala nawo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ejabule. Kodwa akanaso isikhathi sale ndodana.Lesi sizathu kuthiwa yisona esenze unina wengane ongusomabhizinisi wakhetha ukumyisa enkantolo. Kuvela nokuthi lo mlingisi uke wayalelwa yinkantolo ukuthi eze kuzodingidwa lolu daba kodwa wangalubhada.Ethintwa lo wesifazane waseGoli, uvumile ukuthi umbophile umlingisi, wathi: "Okungixakayo ukuthi incwadi yokumbopha yaphuma ngoMeyi 24 kodwa namanje akaboshiwe. Ngeledlule ungishayele ucingo ecela ukuthi sikhulume wathembisa ukuthi uzokwenza konke okuphathelene nengane kodwa lutho. Ulokhu engishayela ucingo engitshela ukuthi indodana yakhe yokuqala nokugcina lena akafuni okuzomhlukanisa nayo. Phambilini ubeyondla ngoR6 100, angazi wabuye wadidiswa yini njengoba esebaleka. Angifuni sithandane, angilweli imali, ngifuna enze into efanele, ondle."Eqhuba uthe ukumbopha yinto yakamuva, uqale wenza konke okusemandleni, wathinta nomndeni womlingisi. “Abakubo ngiyazi akuwona umsebenzi wabo ukondla ingane. Kodwa ngizamile ukukhuluma nonina, wathi akukho angakwenza angikhulume noyise wengane. Ngibazisile nabasemsebenzini wakhe ngenkinga engibhekene nayo kodwa alukho usizo engilutholile, kunalokho bathe abangene kulolu daba."Leli phephandaba linazo izincwadi zasenkantolo eziqinisekisa ukuthi lo wesifazane ubopha umlingisi. Nama-emails awathumele umqashi womlingisi, ecela ukuthi angenele odabeni, bamphendula.Owezokuxhumana kwiThe Queen, uLesedi Matsunyane Ferguson uvuke ngolaka ngalolu daba, wathi ngeke aphawule ngalo akayekwe, maqede wavala ucingo. Imizamo yokuthola lo mlingisi ayiphumelelanga, ubengalubambi ucingo izinsuku zilandelana. Nemiqhafazo athunyelelwe yona akazange ayiphendule.

KUSASA, iNingizimu Afrika izobe igubha usuku oluthinta abaningi kuleli, uSuku lweNtsha. Ngokomlando uJuni 16 waba wusuku olubalulekile ngo-1976 eSoweto lapho kwabhikisha khona izinkulungwane zabantu abasha begqoke imifaniswano yabo yezikole belwisana nokufundiswa nge-Afrikaans ezikoleni. Kwabhikisha abafundi ababalelwa ku-20 000.Ngokwezibalo ezivela kwaSA History kwabulawa abafundi ababalelwa ku-176 kulo mbhikisho. Omunye walabo bafundi kwaba nguHector Pieterson (13), isithombe sakhe esasabalala umhlaba wonke esezingalweni zikaMbuyisa Makhubu owayeneminyaka engu-18 ngaleso sikhathi.Lesi sithombe sathathwa uMnuz Sam Nzima, odlule emhlabeni nonyaka.Kubafundi ababoshwa ngaleso sikhathi kubalwa nesazi sezomnotho nezepolitiki kuleli, uSolwazi uBonke Dumisa. UDumisa waboshwa ngoJuni 28, 1976 waze waphuma ejele ngoJulayi 28 ngo-1977.Engxoweni neSolezwe ngokubaluleka kwalolu suku, uthe kuyamjabulisa ukubona ukuthi ukuzinikela kwabo kusathela izithelo. “Kuyangijabulisa ukubona sivuna izithelo ezinhle ngokuzinikela kwethu ngaleso sikhathi. Kwaba yisikhathi esinzima kimina ukuba sejele isikhathi esingaka kodwa ngangiqonda esasikulwela ukuthi kubalulekile.”Ngemuva kokuphuma ejele uDumisa akazithelanga ngabandayo kwezemfundo njengoba namhlanje eneziqu ezihlukene okubalwa kuzo nezeMasters of Laws (LLM).Ngendlela ecishe ifane no-1976, eminyakeni edlule izitshudeni zakuleli beziyigxoba ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi #FeesMustFall, befuna imfundo yamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni owayengumengameli kuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngoDisemba nyakenye amemezele imfundo yamahhala kuleli, waveza nokuthi izovivinywa eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela nonyaka.Abaningi basithakasela lesi simemezelo, nokho uDumisa uthe asiguqulanga okuningi. “Ngokubona kwami kwenziwa isimemezelo ngento ebesivele ikhona futhi yangabe isalandelelwa. Izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme besezivele zizama ukwamukela izitshudeni ezivela emakhaya ahlwempu ngohlelo lweNSFAS, umehluko ukuthi sebamukela nzivela emakhaya aphila ngemali engaphansi kukaR600 000 ngonyaka. Kodwa into ebalulekile kakhulu wukuthi nalezo zitshudeni kumele zigqugquzelwe ukuthi ziphase kahle uGrade 12 ukuze bezothola amaphuzu anele ukwena izifundo ezinamathuba omsebenzi.”UDumisa uthe intsha kumele igqugquzelwe ukuthi ifundele ukungena emkhakheni wamakhono ashodayo kuleli ukuze ihlomule kahle. “Sesikhathele ukugqokisa izingane zethu amajazi amnyama bese ziyohlala emakhaya zingawutholi umsebenzi. Ukuze zihlomule kahle ngemfundo ephakeme kumele zingene emkhakheni enamakhono adingekayo emnothweni wakuleli.”

source: kuzophela ukushaywa umoya emahhovisi kosigaxamabhande bamaphoyisa
text: KUZOPHELA ukushaywa umoya emahhovisi kosigaxamabhande bamaphoyisa asebezophakwa emgwaqweni balwe nobugebengu obehlukene, ikakhulukazi ukubanjwa kwenkunzi kwezimoto zemali nokubulala.Izolo ngaphambi kokuthi uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, noKhomishana wamaphoyisa, uLt-General Khehla Sitole, bethule izinhlelo zabo zokulwa nobugebengu esithangamini nabezindaba, kubikwe izenzo ezintathu zokubanjwa kwezimoto zemali eMpumalanga.USitole uthe bazotshala inqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni khona kungeke kubelula ezigebengwini ukuthi ziqhubeke zenze ubugebengu.“Sizojuba noLt-General ukuthi bahole amathimba ethu esizobe siwaphaka emgwaqweni,” kusho uSitole.Uveze nokuthi bazosebenzisa nezobuchwepheshe angazange adalule okuningi ngazo ukufihlela izigebengu induku emqubeni.“Siyazi ukuthi amanye amaphoyisa ayathinteka ezehlakalweni zobugebengu. Lawo esiwabambayo siyawaxosha embuthweni, siwabeke namacala ayobhadla ejele,” kusho uSitole.Uthe kunoLt- General abathathu ababaxoshile ngoba bebethinteka ezehlakalweni zenkohlakalo.“Siyaluseka futhi uphenyo olwenziwa wuphiko oluphenya amaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID).Yize luqhuba uphenyo lwalo nathi siyaqhubeka nophenyo lwethu lwangaphakathi,” kusho uSitole.Ephendula mayelana nophenyo olwenziwa yithimba eliphenya ngokubulawa kosopolitiki KwaZulu-Natal, uCele uvumile ukuthi umsebenzi waleli thimba awujabulisi.Uthe emacaleni cishe awu-40 okubulala mhlawumbe bane abantu ababoshiwe ngawo.“UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wajuba oNgqongqoshe abaphethe izinhlaka zezokuphepha ukuthi bahlanganise amakhanda ukuze balwe nendaba yokubulawa kwabantu eKZN. Ngingasho ukuthi sesiwuhambisile umbiko wethu wokuqala kuMengameli. Ngingakuveza ukuthi akajabule ngokuphelele ngokwenziwayo,” kusho uCele.UMqondisi we-Institute for Security Studies, uSolwazi Johan Burger, ekhuluma nabakwa-eNCA ngemuva kwesithangami sabezindaba sikaCele noSitole, uthe bese belinde isikhathi eside ukuzwa ukuthi iziphathimandla zamaphoyisa zinaziphi izinhlelo zokulwa nobugebengu.UBurger uthe bayakwamukela ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa emgwaqweni, wengeza ngokuthi wathi naye uyakholwa wukuthi lokhu kuzosiza kunciphise ubelelesi.Uthe kodwa ukutshalwa kwenqwaba yamaphoyisa ngeke kusize ngalutho uma ezobunhloli zingekho bukhali.“Ngisakhala ngithi kumele kubuyiswe uphiko lwamaphoyisa olwavalwa iSerious and Violent Crime Unit. Lolu phiko lwasebenza ngenkulu impumelelo futhi amanye amaphoyisa ayesebenza kulona asekhona embuthweni,” kusho uBurger.Uthe ufisa futhi ukuthi kusungulwe i-Anti Corruption Unit ngaphakathi emaphoyiseni ezobhekana ngqo nenkohlakalo.

source: abaholi be anc mabayikhiphe ezinkantolo ngoba izofa iphele nya
text: MHLELI: Ake ngithathe leli thuba ngizwakalise umbono wami malunga nokumiswa kwengqungquthela ye-ANC. Isifundazwe sakwaZulu Natal siyisifundazwe ongafunga uthi sabulawa yiqili maqe lazifela zonke izinto ezingakhi ziqala la. Lokhu okwenzekile kucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi i-ANC izibulala yona ngoba kusho ukuthi njalo uma kukhona ukungaboni ngasolinye kuyiwa ezinkantolo.Uma i-ANC ihluleka ngo-2019 ingakhali ngamuntu, izisole yona. Futhi kungase kuqhubeke ukubulawa kosopolitiki emuva kwalesi sivimbelo senkantolo ngoba uzokhumbula ukuthi izifunda noma amagatsha abengeyona inxenye yengqungquthela okubalwa kuzo iHarry Gwala, Moses Mabhida nangala ko South Coast yilapho kwabulawa abantu okusolakala ukuthi babengahambisani nokuba khona kwengqungquthela.Kwaba yiphutha elikhulu elenziwa amalungu e-ANC ukuyisa umbutho enkantolo ekubeni i-ANC inabo ubuholi obuphezulu. Kusho ukuthi i-ANC iphethwe yizinkantolo. Iqembu lisuke selizifake enkingeni uma lithembele kakhulu ezinkantolo, ngisho noma bethi bajezisa ilungu lombutho livele liye enkantolo, isibonelo iDA ixakwe yilungu layo uPatricia de Lille.Umbuzo uthi iANC izophuma kanjani kulolu taku abazifake bona kulona ngoba phela yona ayisenawo amandla.Abaholi beANC abayikhiphe ezinkantolo abahluliwe bakwamukele lokho ngoba izofa iphele nya.Njabulo GebasheeMzimkulu

UZOBE udlubhe umfaniswano weBafana Bafana ezinkundleni zaseRussia umndeni waseMlaza kwa-J ohlabane ngethuba lokuyobuka iNdebe yoMhlaba.Umndeni wakwaMasuku wehlelwe yinhlanhla emva kokuba indodana yawo eneminyaka eyisithupha, uThato, inqoba umncintiswano wenkampani yezicathulo iToughees wokuzibeka ethubeni lokuyozibuka eduze izinkakha zebhola zidudulana eRussia. Unina kaThato, uNkk Hloniphile Masuku, uthe babengalindele ukuthi uzonqoba kodwa bajabule njengoba bezolibangisa eRussia ngoLwesithathu oluzayo ngoJuni 13.“Sasingalindele ukuthi uzonqoba kodwa kuthe uma sebesithinta sathokoza. UThato uyalithanda ibhola kanti nathi siwumndeni ongabalandeli bebhola. Sijabule nangethuba lokuya ezweni langaphandle okokuqala ngqa,” kusho uNkk Masuku.Uthe ukujatshulelwa kwendodana yakhe kukapakele komakhelwane nasesikoleni efunda kuso iClarence Primary. Umndeni wakwaMasuku uzohlala isonto eRussia kanti uzobuka umdlalo owodwa bukhoma weNigeria.“Sikhethe umdlalo weNigeria ngoba sifuna ukuyoseka abakhaya bethu kodwa sizobe sigqoke ijezi leBafana ngoba sifuna kubonakale ukuthi sivelaphi,” kusho uNkk Masuku othe bangabalandeli beKaizer Chiefs. Kubadlali lo mndeni ozolindela ukubabona kubalwa ukaputeni weSuper Eagles oke wadlalela iChelsea FC e-England, * -Obi Mikel, umdlali we-Arsenal * -Alex Iwobi nomdlali weLeicester City uWilfred Ndidi. Umndeni wakwaMasuku uzohlala isonto lonke ezweni laseRussia. INdebe yoMhlaba izoqala ngoJuni 14 ngomdlalo weRussia neSaudi Arabia.

Bavuke umbhejazane osomabhizinisi abanezinkontileka zokuqoqa udoti eThekwini bachitha udoti emgwaqweni uM4 edolobheni bekhala ngokungakhokhelwa.Baqale ngokuqoqana ngaphandle kwaseMoses Mabhida Stadium lapho bekulindeleke ukuthi imenenja kamasipala, uMnuz Sipho Nzuza, ibe khona ukuze bayinike uhlu lwezikhalo zabo njengoba bethi sekuyophela izinyanga ezintathu bengaholelwe. Umbhikisho ubuhlanganisa izinhlangano zosomabhizinisi ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo Isandlwana, Kojo, MKVA, Umlazi Business Forum neDelangokubona.Osomabhizinisi basuke eMoses Mabhida baya kobhikisha emgwaqweni uM4 basakaza udoti emgwaqweni.UMnuz Mandla Mhlongo, onguSihlalo weMlazi Business Forum, uthe sebesaba nokuphuma ezindlini zabo ngenxa yokwesaba abantu ababasebenzelayo ngoba sekuyophela izinyanga ezintathu bengabaholele wathi abakwazi ukuholela abasebenzi babo ngoba nabo abaholelwe. Uthe kuyabathusa ukuthi imenenja yedolobha ayifikanga ukuzozwa izikhalo zabo ngoba iMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, yayithe uma benezikhalo mabazisiye kwimenenja yedolobha.Omunye wosonkontileka obekhona uthe bazoya ezindaweni ezinemigwaqo emikhulu eThekwini bachithe udoti kuzona.“Ngeke siphinde siwuchithe udoti eMlaza sesizowuchitha edolobheni ngoba izikhalo zethu azizwakali uma udoti siwuchitha eMlaza. Sizoya naseMhlanga uma bengazilaleli izikhalo zethu."IPhini lenhloko yezokuxhumana eThekwini, uMnuz Mandla Nsele, lithe osonkontileka abane abengamele umsebenzi wokuqoqwa kukadoti abaqashwe ngumasipala bakhokhelwe. Uthe osonkontileka abancane abaqashwe abakhulu abangeni ngaphansi kukamasipala, banobudlelwane babo bodwa.UNsele uthe bayaxolisa ngokuphazamiseka okukhona ngenxa yokungaqoqwa kukadoti.“Kwezinye izindawo kunokuphazamiseka kokuqoqwa kukadoti okwenziwa uphiko lwangaphakathi. EMlaza awuqoqwa udoti ngenxa yesimo esingesihle esidalwa wukuthi abasebenzi bethu bavalelwa emahhovisi eGarden Refuse kwa-V. Enye iloli lethu lashaywa ngamatshe ngoJuni 12. Sibe nenkinga efanayo ezindaweni ezisenyakatho lapho abasebenzi bethu abathathu balimala besemsebenzini nezimoto zethu zashaywa ngamatshe,” kusho uNsele.Uthe ngokulekelelwa amaphoyisa akwaSAPS nawakwaMetro bazoqala ukuthutha udoti eMlaza wathi bacela imiphakathi ibambisane nabo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa akwaMetro, uSenior Superintendent Parboo Sewpersad, uthe kube nokuphazamiseka kokuhamba kwezimoto ngemuva kokuthi kusaphazwe udoti emgwaqweni kodwa bekunezinhlelo zokuthi kube khona abazowuqoqa.

source: indodana ixabane nonina yazilengisa ethempelini lamanazaretha
text: INGXABANO ebe phakathi kukanina nendodana ngempelasonto ngenxa yephathi ebeyisendaweni, iyona okusolwa ukuthi iholele ekuzilengiseni kwendodana ethempelini lamaNazaretha aseBuhleni, Impumelelo, eliseMpumelelo eFrance, eMgungundlovu, nokuyilapho umufi ebekhonza khona nomndeni.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo ongaphakathi kuleli bandla ocele ukungadalulwa, uNduduzo Shezi (19) obefunda uGrade 10 eMzuzo High School kule ndawo, uqale wahilizisana nonina ngoba efuna ukuya ephathini ngenkani ebusuku.“Emva kokuhilizana nonina, wagcina evumile (unina) ukuthi akaye ephathini nakuba kungokokuqala ukuthi aye ephathini,” kusho umthombo.Ngokomthombo, uNduduzo wabuya ngo-11 ebusuku ngempelasonto baphinde bathusana nonina ngoba ebuze ukuthi kungani ebuya sekuhambe isikhathi ngalolu hlobo.“Umfana wathi kunina akamshaye okungcono uma kungukuthi wenze into engafanele kunokuthi amthethise,” kubeka umthombo.Kubikwa ukuthi entathakusa ngo-1 ngalolo suku, uNduduzo waphuma kubo, unina wazitshela ukuthi hleze usaphuthuma kubangani bakhe abekade ehambe nabo ukuya ephathini.Umthombo uthi emva kwesikhathi esithile uNduduzo ehambile, abazali bakhe bathola imilayezo kumaselula abo evela kwindodana ivalelisa futhi ixolisa ngesenzo ehlose ukusenza (sokuzibulala) nakuba ingazange ichaze ukuthi ifuna ukwenzani.Ngakusasa sekubonakala ukuthi indodana ayibuyi, umthombo uthi abazali bayo namalungu ebandla aphuma umkhankaso eyifuna.“Kodwa kuye kwasishaqisa ukuthi agcine etholakele ethempelini, kubonakala intambo emqaleni eduzane nalapho eshonele khona,” kusho umthombo.Uthe okuphinde kube yindida, akucaci kahle-hle ukuthi noma lona wesilisa uzilengisele esihlahleni esisethempelini, noma kukhona abambulele base bemthatha bezombeka esihlahleni esisethempelini bemfake intambo emqaleni.“Okuye kwasidida ukuthi ubenemihuzuko ebusweni, manje sixakwa wukuthi ubelimale kanjani ebusweni ebe ezilengisile,” ubuze kanje umthombo.Okhulumela ibandla laseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe ubengakezwa ngalesi sigameko, nakuba enolwazi ngethempeli elikule ndawo.“Siyazwelana kakhulu nomndeni ngokwenzekile,” kuchaza uMncwabe. Uthe njengebandla banenhlangano yentsha ebizwa ngokuthi INABACHU, lapho beyiyala khona ngezindlela zokuziphatha emakhaya nasebandleni.Uthe ukuya emaphathini ngezinye zezinto abangazikhuthazi njengebandla ngoba akuthandazwa khona, kungenzeka uhlangabezane nezinkinga.“Siphinde futhi sibe nenkonzo ka-23, 25 neka-14 lapho siyala khona bonke abesilisa nabesifazane ngendlela yokuziphatha,” kugcizelela uMncwabe.Uthe njengoba sekwenzeke lesi sigameko nje, sekuzomele umndeni uligeze ngembuzi ithempeli.“Okuzokwenzeka manje ukuthi sibikele inkosi, bese umndeni uthenga imbuzi okuzohlanzwa ngayo ithempeli. Umshumayeli okhona kuleli thempeli uyena okuzomele engamele lowo msebenzi,” kuchaza uMncwabe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe bebengakezwa ngalolu daba.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela ungatholakalanga umndeni kamufi ukuthi uphawule ngalolu daba. Kubikwe ukuthi umatasa njengoba ulungiselela umngcwabo wakhe.

UMXHUMANISI wobuholi besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, ucacise ngenhloso yakhe yokuhambela icala lobengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma osolwa ngenkohlakalo. UZuma ubevele okwesibili eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu lapho kubonakale khona inqwaba yabaholi namalungu e-ANC eyomeseka. UZikalala uthe ukubonakala kwakhe eseka uZuma kungenxa yokuthi usuke efuna ukuqondisa ukukhuluma okungekuhle okusabalele ngabaholi benhlangano.Uthe usuke eziyele njengesakhamuzi sakuleli hhayi njengelungu noma umholi we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. Uveze nokuthi usazoqhubeka nokuya ngoba akaboni hlazo yena kulokho.“Uma uzoqaphelisisa ngalolo suku lwecala ngangifake ijakhethi ye-ANC kodwa ngayikhumula sengiya ecaleni ngoba bengiya njengomuntu nje bengingayomela i-ANC. Angiyiboni inkinga kulokho ngoba wonke umuntu uvumelekile ukuya enkantolo,’’ kusho uZikalalaEsekhuluma nabezindaba eceleni uthinte nendaba yekhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana eholwa iPhini leNhloko yamaJaji uRaymond Zondo. Ikhomishini isiqalile ukwenza umsebenzi wayo njengoba abanolwazi bengaluletha kuyona.UZikalala uthe abantu abangalinge babhule babe yizangoma ngodaba lokulawulwa koMbuso wathi kufanele ikhomishini inikwe ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wayo ukuze kuvele iqiniso. UZuma ungomunye wabavelayo kwabasolwa ngokuba nesandla ekulawulweni koMbuso yidlanzana. Usolwa ngokuvumela abangani bakhe bakwaGupta ukuzitapela emalini yabakhokhi bentela.UZikalala wesekwe uNkk Nocawe Mafu oyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kuzwelonke, othe angaya kokweseka uZuma noma nini.“Nami nje ukuba benginaso isikhathi bengingaya ngoba yinto engenankinga ukuya ecaleni likaZuma,’’ kusho uNkk Mafu.UZikalala ugxeke ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kuzwelonke uMnuz Bheki Cele ngokuhlomekisa amalungu enhlangano.Ukhale kakhulu ngesitatimende sikaCele asenze ngonyaka odlule ngoDisemba lapho athi amalungu awaqhubeke nokuyisa i-ANC ezinkantolo ukuze iqonde ngqo.UZikalala uthe lesi sitatimende siyadukisa asiyisizi inhlangano.Usole nabanye abaholi abasezinhlakeni zikazwelonke ngokuba nesandla ekutshaleni uqhekeko enhlanganweni wathi kuyadinga ukulungiswa lokhu.“Ngesikhathi sixoxa namaqabane kuvelile ukuthi kukhona ukungeneliseki ngezinto ezehlukene kodwa okunye okuvelile kube yinkinga yabaholi bakuzwelonke abaphehla ukungezwani.’’UCele ethintwa ngalezi zinsolo ezenziwe uZikalala uvele wangaphawula wathi akakwazi ukukhuluma nabezindaba ngalokho.

source: alikho ivoti eliya kukhongolose umhlaba ungakabuyiswa
text: ABAHOLI bezenkolo basabisa ngokuthi bazonxenxa amalungu amabandla abo ukuthi angayivoteli i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo uma kuze kufika isikhathi sokhetho umhlaba ungakabuyiselwa kubanikazi bawo.Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uMbhishobhi Bheki Ngcobo webandla laseZayoni oyingxenye yabaholi bezenkolo nosomabhizinisi abaseka lowo obengumengameli wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe sebethathe isinqumo esithi alikho ivoti eliya kuKhongolose uma umhlaba ungakabuyiswa.“Kuzomele futhi ubuholi be-ANC obukhona buyeke ukuhlukumeza uZuma bulokhu bumkhandela amacala ngoba indlela yokunqoba ukhetho incike kuyena uZuma,” kusho uNgcobo.Uthe bazoqhubeka nokumeseka uZuma kuze kufike ekugcineni.“UZuma uyena kuphela umuntu obezokwazi ukuxazulula indaba yomhlaba njengoba esekhishiwe esikhundleni mancane amathuba okuthi umhlaba ubuye,” kusho uNgcobo.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi bethula izinhlelo zabo mayelana namalungiselelo omlindelo kaZuma njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu ngamacala enkohlakalo athinta udaba lokuthengwa kwezikhali.Ebuza ukuthi bayithathaphi imali yokuqhuba imikhankaso yokweseka uZuma, uNgcobo uthe bacela kosomabhizinisi baphinde basebenzise izinsiza zamabandla abo.“Asizuzi lutho ngokweseka uZuma lokhu esikwenzayo sikwenza ngoba simthanda,” kusho uNgcobo.Umkhulumeli weMKMVA kuzwelonke, uMnuz Carl Niehaus, uthe amalungu omakadebona boMkhonto weSizwe azophuma ngobuningi bawo ezokwesaka uZuma owayenguKhomanda weMK.Uthe uzoza ecaleni likaZuma efake umfaniswano we-ANC.“Ubuholi besigungu esiphezulu senhlangano bashaya isikhala ngokuthi buthi akuvunyelwe ukugqoka izikibha zenhlangano emibuthanweni yokuseka uZuma esenkantolo,” kusho uNiehaus.Umholi weBLF, uMnuz Andile Mngxitama, uthe uZuma ushushiswa ngoba nakho elwela abantu abampofu.“SiyiBLF sithi akayekwe phansi uZuma akuboshwe owayengumengameli wakuleli ngesikhathi sobandlululo uMnuz FW de Klerk ngamacala okuhlukumeza abantu,” kusho uMngxitama.UMnuz Nkosentsha Shezi weNafupa SA uthe bathenjiswa ukuthi izwe lizophumelela kwezomnotho uma kuphuma uZuma kodwa isimo siba sibi kakhulu kunakuqala.Uthe kusukela ephumile uZuma abantu sebekhokha intela ephezulu.Induna yamabutho uMnuz Innocent Mkhize uthe nabo bazobe bekhona bezoseka uZuma ngoba uyingxenye yamabutho.Uthe imvume yokweseka uZuma abazange bayithole koNgangezwe lakhe kodwa bameseka ngoba nakhu eyingxenye yamabutho. Umlindelo uzoqalwa ngokuthi kube nojenga lwezimoto ngoLwesine emini bese kuthi ntambama kube nomlindelo ozoqala ngehora lesithupha ntambama uphele ngehora lesithupha ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu. NgoLwesihlanu kuzoba nemashi ezosuka kuBotha iphele enkantolo.

source: umholi we ifp ukhala nge anc
text: UMENGAMELI we-IFP Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uxwayisa ngokuthi uma udaba lomhlaba wamakhosi lungaxazululwa luzodala ukuthi kubheduke udlame bese kuchitheka igazi.Ekhuluma izolo emhlanganweni wezinsuku ezine lapho kubhungwa khona ngodaba lomhlaba wamakhosi eMayville, eThekwini, uButhelezi uthe kumanje abantu baqalile ukuzithathela umhlaba ngendlela engekho emthethweni ngemuva kwekhwelo le-EFF.“Abantu sebeqalile ukuzithathela umhlaba, ngakolunye uhlangothi uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa umile ekutheni ukuthathwa komhlaba ngendlela engekho emthethweni ngeke kubekezelelwe ngoba kuphambene nomthetho. Lokhu okwenzekayo kuzodala ukuthi kube nokungqubuzana,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe kumanje alukho uhlelo olucacile lokuthi uhulumeni uzoyilungisa kanjani indaba yomhlaba wathi lokhu kudala ukudideka kubantu.‘’Njengamakhosi okuyithi esibheke umhlaba sifuna ukwazi ukuthi udaba lomhlaba lulungiswa kanjani,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe uhulumeni we-ANC kade aqala ukugquza amakhosi wathi lokhu ekwenzayo manje le nhlangano kuwukushayelela isipikili sokugcina ukuqeda ngamakhosi.“Ngesikhathi kunengqungquthela ye-ANC yomhlaba ngenyanga edlule lowo owayenguNobhala-jikelele kaKhongolose futhi owake waba nguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe wakhuluma kabi ngamakhosi waze wawabiza ngondlovukayiphendulwa ezizweni zawo, akekho noyedwa umholi we-ANC oke wamkhuza uMotlanthe, kuyacaca ukuthi lo mholi we-ANC ubeveza umbono wale nhlangano ngamakhosi,” kusho uButhelezi.UButhelezi unxuse amakhosi ukuthi ayibheke kahle indaba yokuvotela i-ANC ngoba sekucacile ukuthi ayiyingeni indaba yawo.Uthe umhlaba kumele uvikelwe njengoba kwenza okhokho babo belwa nabamhlophe ngesikhathi beqola umhlaba.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezaBasebenzi, Inkosi Phathekile Holomisa, lithe umhlaba ngowamakhosi lathi kumele awuvikele kunoma ngubani ofuna ukuwaphuca.“Uma kufika umuntu ezothatha umhlaba amadoda endawo kumele asukume alwe, amaphoyisa kumele afike sekukhona okwenzekile,” kusho uHolomisa.USihlalo weNgonyama Trust, iJaji Jerome Ngwenya ukhulume kabanzi ngodaba lwamatayitela wathi abantu bafunzwa imfundisoze ngawo ukuze babone kunesidingo sokuthi amakhosi aphucwe umhlaba.“Abantu batshelwa ukuthi izindawo zamakhosi azinamatayitela lokho okusho ukuthi akuzona izindawo zabo lezi abahlezi kuzona okuyinto engesilo iqiniso,” kusho uNgwenya.Uthe imfundiso yaseNtshonalanga efakwe kubantu kuthiwe amatayitela abalulekile wathi ingakho abantu kuthiwa ababambise ngezindlu zabo uma beboleka imali emabhange.

IPHINI lomqeqeshi we-Orlando Pirates, uRulani Mokwena, liqininisekisa eyezinguquko ezinqala ezizokwenzeka eqenjini ngaphambi kokuqala kwesizini ka-2018/2019.IPirates iqede isizini ka-2017/2018 isendaweni yesibili kwi-log ye-Absa Premiership. Icindeze ompetha iMamelodi Sundowns kwaze kwaba sekugcineni. Ithimba labaqeqeshi bePirates belizivalele esifubeni izifiso zalo ngoba belilokhu lithi lisazama ukwakha iqembu.Umqeqeshi, uMilutin “Micho”Sredojevic, uphumele obala sekuzophela isizini ngokuthi iqembu lesifinyelele ezingeni lokunqoba izindebe ngoba sebesakhile isisekelo esiqinile. EZimnyama zizohambisana neSundowns emqhudelwaneni iCAF Champions League ngesizini ezayo.UMokwena uthe zinkulu izinguquko ezizokwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthatha inya­thuko yeCAF. Kunenqwaba yabadlali asebevele bakhonjwa kwiPirates okukhona kubo uLinda Mntambo, no-Abel Mabaso abebekwiChippa United. UMeshack Maphangule weBlack Leopards kuthiwa usevumelene nePirates. Kubadlali okuthiwa bayashiya kukhona uThamsanqa Gabuza, Ayanda Gcaba, Thamsanqa Sangweni nabanye.“Isikwati sizoqina kakhulu. Sizoligcina iningi labadlali kodwa sizoqina kakhulu ngesizini ezayo. IChampions League iyeza ngakho kufanele sengeze abadlali, sithole nabanye abasezingeni eliphezulu. Sidinga ukwengeza okungenani zonke izindawo. Nasethimbeni labaqeqeshi kuzoba khona izinguquko,” kusho uMokwena.Maphakathi nesizini kusabalale amahlebezi okuthi uSimo Dladla, umqeqeshi weKings yaKwaZulu-Natal edlala kwiNational First Division (NFD), uzojoyina ithimba labaqeqeshi kwiPirates. Kumanje iphini lesibili likaMicho nguBenson Mhlongo owayengumdlali wePirates.Abadlali bePirates abebekade beqokelwe imiklomelo yePremie Soccer League (PSL) babuye belambatha. U-Innocent Maela ukhale ngaphansi kuSiyanda Xulu kowe-Absa Premiership Defender of The Season, kwathi uMusa Nyatama wahlulwa nguSiphesihle Ndlovu weMaritzburg United kowe-Absa Premiership Midfielder of The Season.UMicho ubengakufihlanga ukuthi uNyatama uyena okufanele akhale emuke nomklomelo womdlali ovelele, i-PSL Footballer of The Season, ogcine ugoduke noPercy Tau weSundowns.“Okubalulekile wukuqokwa kule miklomelo. Kodwa-ke abantu okubafanele ukuwina bawinile. Lokhu kuzosigqugquzela ukuthi sisebenze kanzima,” kuphetha uMokwena.

UMHLAZIYI wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthi ubuholi be-ANC kuzwelonke kumele bungenelele, buziphathele isifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natal ukuze kuphele umdonsiswano okhona obeka ikusasa leqembu engcupheni.Engxoxweni neSolezwe izolo, uKhumalo uthe zimbili izinto ezingaqeda umdonsiswano okhona eKZN. Ukuthi ubuholi bukazwelonke buziphathele noma bujube umakadebona weqembu othembekile futhi ongekho ezinhlangothini ukuthi kube nguyena oshanelayo.“I-ANC eKZN isiphenduke inhlekisa ngezinto eziqhubeka kuyona ezidalwa ukuthi abukho ubuholi,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe inkinga ye-ANC eKZN izinhlangothi,“Ngendlela okujule ngayo ukungaboni ngasolinye ngisho nokusebenzisana lokhu okuzanywayo ngeke kuze kulunge ngoba uhlangothi oluthile lungadonsa lubheke lena nolunye lwenze okufanayo,” kusho uKhumalo.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Xolani Dube, onguMcwaningi kwisikhungo iXubera Institute, uthei-ANC eKZN isifana nento engekho.“Kumele sivume ukuthi uKhongolose eKZN usufana nento engekho usuziphendukele inkampani eqasha abantu,” kusho uDube.UDube uthe akacabangi ukuthi i-ANC esifundazweni inendaba nokhetho lwangonyaka ozayo.“Kuyimanje amaqabane ayisana ezinkantolo ngenxa yokubanga amandla, angiboni olunye uhlangothi lungakhankasela olunye ukuthi lungene emandleni, ingakho ngithi abanandaba nokhetho,” kusho uDube.Uthe iyodwa into ebangwayo, iphalishi.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha esifundazweni imiswe ngumzuzu wokugcina ngamalungu enhlangano anganeme asezifundeni ezintathu iMoses Mabhida, Lower South Coast naseHarry Gwala.Lawa malungu akhala ngokuthi ayancishwa ubulungu benhlangano nokuthi ashiywa ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zombutho emagatsheni.Kungakapholi maseko kumiswe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe, kuleli sonto kube sekumiswa ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha baseMoses Mabhida.Izingqungquthela eKZN zimiswa ngamalungu enhlangano ahambisana noMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.

BANGENA bephuma abantu abazobona intombazane yaKwaMaphumulo osekuphele inyanga inganyakazi emuva kokuhlinzwa ngenxa yomdlavuza wobuchopho.UNksz Nomusa Khuzwayo unina wesiguli watshelwa esibhedlela ukuthi akayomnakekela ekhaya uNosipho Dube (5). Kuthiwa waqalwa wukugula ngo-Ephreli. Unina uthe walaliswa esibhedlela eStanger kwathiwa uneTB ye-meningitis. Wadluliselwa eNkosi Albert Luthuli Central eThekwini waqaliswa imishanguzo.“Wayexhuga kodwa ekhuluma. Kwathiwa angisayine ukuze ayokwenza i-scan kwatholakala ukuthi unamanzi ekhanda. Bangitshela ukuthi kumele ayohlinzwa akhishwe amanzi ngavuma,” kusho yena. Uthe ingane yahlinzwa ngo-Ephreli 21 yangaphinde yavula amehlo.“Sahlaliswa esibhedlela bathi kumele enze esinye i-scan bathola umdlavuza. Wabhotshozwa entanyeni kwathiwa kuzoshiswa umdlavuza wangaphaphama. Ngagcina ngibuyiselwa esibhedlela eStanger ngoMeyi 11 sakhishwa ngoMeyi 28,” kusho yena.Akasakwazi nokunyakaza UNksz Nomusa Khuzwayo onakekela indodakazi yakhe uNosipho Dube okuthandwa unomdlavuza, owakhishwa esibhedlela ngoba sekuhluleke odokotela. Video: ZANELE MTHETHWAWatshelwa ukuthi ipayipi elisentanyeni ephefumula ngalo kumele liyoshintshwa emtholampilo. Ngosuku aya ngalo emtholampilo uthe bamphindisela esibhedlela bathi kungaphezu kwabo. Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni, uNksz Ncumisa Mafunda, uthe yize bengavumelekile ukudalula isimo sesiguli kodwa ingane iphethwe wukugula okuxakile okusaxilongwa abezempilo. Uthe unina wachazelwa ngendlela okumele anakekele ngayo ingane wakhombisa ukukuqonda konke. Uphikile ukuthi waxoshwa emtholampilo wathi okwakudingeka kwenziwe enganeni kwakudinga isibhedlela.Uveze nokuthi umzali bekumele abuyele esibhedlela kusasa kodwa wathi akasazimisele ukuya esikhungweni sezempilo. UNksz Mafunda uthe bahlela ukumeluleka uNksz Khuzwayo bazame nezinye izindlela zokumsiza.

UDELE imali ayihola ngokuba ngummeli wasemajajini wagxila ekulungiseleleni iComrades Marathon umpetha walo nyaka wabesifazane, u-Ann Ashworth odle ubhedu izolo emjahweni obusuka eMgungundlovu uphelele eMoses Mabhida Stadium, eThekwini.U-Ashworth (34) ogijimela iMassmart ungene entanjeni ngo-6:10:04 walandelwa womunye umgijimi waseNingizimu Afrika, uGerda Steyn, ogijimela iNedbank ongene ngo-6:15:34.Umgijimi waseRussia, u-Alexandra Morozova, ungene endaweni yesithathu ngo-6:20:21. Wayekade eqede endaweni yesibili nyakenye ngemuva kukaCamille Harron wase-USA ongazange abuye ukuzovikela isicoco sakhe ngenxa yokulimala.Ekhumula nabezindaba u-Ashworth ubonge umndeni nomqeqeshi wakhe ngokumeseka. Ubengalindele ukunqoba yize bona bebekholelwa kuye.“Kungishaqile ukuthi nami ngila. Ngilandele iqhinga lo mqeqeshi. Bekuwumjaho ongajwayelekile ngoba usheshe zibekwa. Kodwa ngizitshele ukuthi ngizogijima ngendlela ebengihlele ngayo. Ngiyabonga kakhulu emndenini wami nomqeqeshi ngabangenzele kona. Bengingasebenzi izinyanga ezimbili. Uma ungasebenzi uwu-advocate awuholi. Ngiyabonga futhi angizisoli ngesinqumo sami,” kusho u-Ashworth odabuka eKapa kodwa osezinze eGauteng.USteyn ungomunye wabebebhekiwe ukuthi banqobe kwabesifazane. Ngo-Ephreli udle ubhedu kwiTwo Oceans Marathon.Emjaweni wabesifazane kuqale kuhamba phambili umpetha wango-2016, uCharne Bosman, kodwa ogcine edlulwe yilaba abebemlandela. Ugcine eqede endaweni yesihlanu ngo-6:33:08.“Umjaho wabesifazane ubusezingeni ebelilindelekile. Besingekho isikhathi sokuhlala ngemuva. Leli golide lingena ezindondweni esengizitholile kulo nyaka,” kusho uSteyn.USteyn, oneminyaka ewu-28, uthe akasoze ayeka ukugijima iComrades Marathon yize abanye bemthatha ngokuthi usemncane.UMorozova ubalise ngokungayitholi imali yakhe yanyakenye. Uthe inhlangano eyengamele ezokugijima, i-Athletics South Africa (ASA), ifuna isiqiniseko sokuthi ukufanele yini ukugijima iComrades.Yize kunjalo uthe isimo abhekene naso asizange simthene amandla okuthi abuye kulo nyaka.Umengameli we-ASA, * -Aleck Skhosana, uthe: “Izwe lakhe limisiwe yi-IAAF thina esilandela imithetho yayo. Igama lakhe alikho ohlwini olwathunyelwa yiyona lwabagijimi abavumelekile ukubamba iqhaza emiqhudelwaneni. Ngeke sikhulume ngemali. Uma ufuna ukukhuluma ngayo kumele ulandele yonke imigudu efanele.”Abaphume phambili kwabesifazane:Ann Ashworth (6:10:04)Gerda Steyn (6:15:34)Alexandra Morozova (6:20:21)Tanith Maxwell (6:20:35)Charne Bosman (6:33:08)Sophia Sundberg (6:45:24)Devon Yanko (6:47:44)Sarah Bard (6:49:05)Carla Malinaro (6:52:16)Yolande Maclean (6:52:16)

BUCHITHEKE bugayiwe kubhuntsha umngcwabo eMpophomeni, ngaseHowick, ngempelasonto umndeni ungena ushaqa ibhokisi likamufi ngesikhathi kunenkonzo yomlindelo.Umndeni kaMnuz Bhekisisa Msane (62) waseShowe obehlala ekhweni kankosikazi omncane eMpophomeni ufike washaqa ibhokisi nesidumbu ngoMgqibelo ebusuku kulandela ukungaboni ngaso linye nomndeni kaNksz Sandile Ndlovu abehlala naye. UMsane bekumele afihlwe ngeSonto kodwa kugcine kungenzekanga abakubo sebelande isidumbu ekhweni.Omunye obekhona kwenzeka lokhu kodwa ongathandanga ukudalulwa uveze ukuthi uMsane unamakhosikazi amabili aziwa umndeni bese kuba khona noNksz Ndlovu owabhala ngasese naye umndeni ungazi.“Ubehlala ekhweni. Kuthe esegula bamphindisela emakhosikazini akhe. Bekuthi uma esesindile bamlande ngoba kudliwa imali yakhe yempesheni nekhadi lokuhola belihlala kumkhwekazi wakhe. Intombi kuyaziwa ngisho endaweni ukuthi bese ikipitile namanje ushone uMsane ingekho izwe ngoba isishayelwa ucingo,” kusho umthombo.NgoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi kunomlindelo kuthiwa umndeni kamufi awuzange ukhulume lutho ungene waqonda ebhokisini kugcwele amakholwa ecula.“Ngibone sekushaywana, abebepheka baphuma nokudla kwathelwana ngakho. Amakholwa asale ecula, bathatha ibhokisi bahamba nalo kodwa nakhona bebelandelwa amatshe ngemuva. Abanye bahambe belimele nami ngithole imihuzuko,” kusho umthombo.UNkk Ntombi Msane oyilungu lomndeni kamufi uthe baphoqwe yisimo ngoba bebebona ukuthi uMsane uzongcwatshwa ezintabeni.“Ukuba ubenomuzi besizovuma amngcwabe. Sinqaba ngoba unamakhosikazi amabili asemthethweni futhi nekhaya elikhulu likhona lapho engangcwatshwa khona. Siqale emaphoyiseni eMpophomeni, sadlulela enduneni nasekhanseleni sayobika. Silufakile enkantolo udaba sayobika naseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya kwathiwa awukho emthethweni umshado wabo kodwa kuzothatha izinyanga ezimbili ukuthi usulwe. Sibone kukude kakhulu sayolanda isidumbu yize bebesithuka besishaya,” kusho uNkk Msane.Ethintwa uNksz Ndlovu uthe uMsane wamshada engasathandani namakhosikazi akhe.“Wagula wangena esibhedlela abantu bakubo bengamsizi waze wacela ukuthi sithuthe siyohlala ekhaya alungise nempesheni. Kuyiphutha ukuthi bengikipitile, ngiyasebenza ePinetown. Sebenzela ukudicilela igama lami phansi. Kuyimanje umzimba ubuhlungu ngitubekile ngoba kwase kuliwa. Noma bengimthanda umyeni wami kodwa sesithathe isinqumo sokubayeka nesidumbu. Sengigqoke inzilo yize ngingamngcwabanga umyeni wami,” kusho uNksz Ndlovu ekhihla isililo.

SEBEVULE icala lokwehliswa isithunzi abashadile, uRomeo noBasetsana Kumalo, ngemuva kokusabalala kwemibiko ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zokuthi kune-video yocansi kaRomeo nomunye usaziwayo wesilisa.Indaba yasuka ngemuva kokuthi umbhali wezincwadi uJackie Phamatse abhala ekhasini lakhe ukuthi uzwe ingxoxo phakathi kowesifazane osembonini yethelevishini encenga omunye umngani wakhe ukuthi angayisabalalisi i-video yakhe ephuzile nomyeni wakhe esocansini nosaziwayo wesilisa.Kusuka lapho abanye bavele bacabanga ukuthi kukhulunywa ngalabo saziwayo abangosomabhizinisi.Esitatimendeni bathe bavule icala futhi bafaka isicelo sencwadi yokuvikelwa kwabanesandla kulokho. Bathe bayathemba ukuthi lokhu kuzothumela umyalezo oshubile kulabo abasabalalisa imininingwane engamanga ngabanye ngaphambi kokuthola ubufakazi noma ukucabanga ubungozi balokho.“Umonakalo owenzeke kithina ngokomoya nangokomsebenzi awukaleki. Ngaphezu kwalokho lokhu kusatshalaliswa kwamahemuhemu kulimaze izingane zethu emoyeni esihlale sizama ukuthi zingaveli emehlweni abantu.”Bathe bekunzima ukuthula ngesonto eledlule.“Ukuthula kwethu bekungekhona ukuthi kunobuqiniso ngalezi zinsolo kodwa yingoba besishaqekile futhi sihlukumezekile ngalokhu nangendlela okusatshalaliswe budedengu ngayo.”

NJENGOBA uJuni uhlonzwa njengenyanga yentsha, sekuvele izibalo ezishaqisayo zentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika yesilisa emnyama okuthiwa iqengqeleza phambili ngokucwila ezinkambeni zikaFaro. Ngo-1976 intsha yakuleli yayilwa namaBhunu ifuna ukuqedwa kokufunda ngesibhunu zonke izifundo, kodwa eyanamuhla enye yayo ingene shi kwizidakamizwa.Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngabomkhankaso oqwashisa ngokucwila otshwalweni i-Aware Organisation.Lolu cwaningo luveza isithombe sokuthi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuthengwa utshwala buka-R3.8 billion ngonyaka. Kubantu bakuleli balinganiselwa ku-60% abaphuza utshwala kanti kubona bangu-34% abaphuza ngokweqile. Kulesi sibalo isilinganiso sekota ngabesilisa abamnyama abaneminyaka eqala ku-24 kuya ku-35 abazithola becwile kubona ngendlela exakile.Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi iningi lentsha yakuleli kuthi ineminyaka engu-12 isuke isilingeka ifise ukuzwa ukuthi utshwala bunambitheka kanjani.Enye iyadikila ingaphide ibuthinte ngenxa yokungathatheki kodwa enye iyabuyela kubona igcine isibujwayele. Ngeshwa enye iyedlulela igcine isiyimulutha yotshwala. Le ntsha isuke inezizathu ezahlukene ezisuke siyiholele kulo mbulalazwe. Phakathi kwezizathu ezibaliwe ezidoba intsha wukuthi iningi layo isuke isiphothule isikole, isanda kuqala umsebenzi futhi isizithathela izinqumo ngemali yayo.Kulapho kwabanye kuqala kube nengcindezi yokufuna ukubukwa, ukudlisela kontanga nakwabobulili obehlukile. Enye intsha ibulawa amahloni, ukuze iwaqede isebenzisa utshwala bese bekwazi ukukhuluma babe nesibindi noma benze okuthile abasuke behlukela ukukwenza bengaphuzile.Ukuhlanganyela nabangani nemindeni emicimbini, nakho kuyabahlohla abanye ukuba bagcine bekhothakhothile kwezikaFaro ngenxa yokungafuni ukusala ezintweni.Inkinga iba lapho uma abanye sebephenduka izigqila zotshwala. Izinqumo nezibopho abanazo empilweni zigcine sezithikamezwa wukuphuza kakhulu. Lapha singabala ukuthi umuntu akhohlwe yinto asuke eyikhulumile, wukuvuka sekudlule isikhathi, wukudala umonakalo njengokushayela ephuzile noma ukuba nenkani angalawuleki. Ngalezi zizathu kuphela imisebenzi, kuchitheka imishado nothando kwabanye ababe besahlonishwa kuphele nokwethenjwa.Kuzona singabala ukuwa nokuhluleka wukuhamba uqonde okungaholela ekulimaleni nokufa imbala.Utshwala obuningi emzimbeni womuntu kungadala ukuthi inhliziyo ime noma umuntu akhingcwe ngumphalazo wakhe ashone. Ukuphuza ngokweqile entsheni kuphinde kusolwe ngokwanda kwezigameko zokuzibulala uma inengcindezi empilweni yayo. Ukuphuza kakhulu kungagcina omunye umuntu esehanjelwa wumqondo nokungadala umonakalo emqondweni, omunye agule ngekhanda.Kwabesifazane abakhulelwe utshwala bulimaza ingane ibe nesifo iFetal Alcohol Syndrome esuke isakhula kuyena.Ucwaningo olwenziwe yi-University of Cape Town ngo-2014 kuya ku-2015 bulinganiselwa ku-4.8 billion utshwala obuthengiwe.Isikhulu esiphezulu kwi-Aware * -Ingrid Louw uthe kubalulekile ukuthi intsha yazi kabanzi ngobungozi botshwala obuphuzwa kakhulu.“Bakhona abantu abaphuzayo kodwa ngendlela ehlelekile nengenabo ubungozi, bese kuba khona labo abacwilile,” usho kanje.Uthe kulabo abacwilayo kubona, kubalulekile ukubazisa ngobungozi obunabo empilweni yabo nakweyabanye abantu.“Ucwaningo lwethu luveze ukuthi abantu bakuleli abasethuki uma bebona izimoto zishayisana kade zigijima ngesivinini esiphezulu nasekuboneni izidumbu zindiza ngenxa yengozi lapho kusuke kudalwe wukushayela imoto komuntu ephuzile. Akukuhle lokhu. Kusitshela ukuthi kukhona lapho singenzi kahle khona, yingakho sizozama ukulungisa isimo ngemikhankaso yethu,” usho kanje.Lo mkhankaso wokuqwashisa ngobubi bokuphuza ngokweqile, unethemba lokuthi uma kungasetshenzwa kubanjiswane kungaphela ukubikwa ngezingozi zemigwaqo ezidalwa abashayela bephuzile, ukuphuza kwezingane nezinye izinto ezimbi ezidalwa wutshwala.Ezinye zezizathu ezoholela entsheni ukuthi iphuze:Ukubona abanye abantu bephuzaUkufoma nokufuna ukuzilawulaUkufuna ukuzama izinto ezintsha empilweni ezizokwenza umuntu aveleleUkungazethembiUkuhehwa okungelona iqiniso njengezinhlelo zethelevishini nezikhangiso.

ABE-KZN Sharks Board bagqugquzele umphakathi ukuthi ulalele abaxwayisa abantu ngokubhukuda emabhishi njengoba esesusiwe amanethi avimba oshaka emabhishi aseNingizimu yeKwaZulu-Natal, kwazise osayidinsi sebeqalile ukubonakala.UMnuz Mike Anderson-Reade weKZN Sharks Board, esitatimendeni uthe sekuyisikhathi sokufika kosayidinsi kanti amanethi avimbela oshaka ukuthi beze osebeni asusiwe emabhishi ukuze osayidinsi nezinye izilwane ezihambisana nabo njengamahlengethwa zihambe ngokukhululeka.Uma kuza osayidinsi amanethi ayasuswa ngoba uma ehleli izilwane ezihambisana nabo ziyabhajwa emanethini zigcine sezifa kanti nosayidinsi abahambi ngokukhululeka.“ISharks Board izoqhubeka nokuqapha isimo ngokusebenzisana nomasipala abanamabhishi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphephile kanti nosayidinsi bahamba ngokukhululeka,” kusho u-Anderson-Reade.Uthe osayidinsi babonakele eRamsgate, eMthwalume naseMthethweni. Uveze ukuthi amahlengethwa namaCape Gannets okuyizinyoni ezihambisana nosayidinsi nazo ziboniwe ngaseMazeppa Bay yize bezingeziningi.Osayidinsi baheha inqwaba yezivakashi ezisuke zifuna ukubadoba kanti ezinye zisuke zijabulela ukubona amahlengethwa, izinyoni nezinye izilwane ezisuke zijaha osayidinsi.Abanikazi bamahhotela agudle ulwandle nabo sebeqalile ukukhangisa ngezindawo zokuhlala koMargate, Ramsgate, eThekwini, nakwezinye izindawo.

BEKUYIPHUPHO lakhe leminyaka ukuyodlala phesheya umfundi wesikole samabanga aphezulu oqokelwe ukuyodlala kwiNdebe yoMhlaba yeRugby, eMalaysia.USange Matebese (17) ofunda uGrade 12 eDurban Girls High, uqokelwe ukuyodlala eqenjini leTouch Rugby Under 18. Lo mfundi odlala iRugby nasesikoleni, waqala ngo-2016 ukudlalela iqembu lesifundazwe kulo mdlalo osenabamnyama abambalwa. Ngaphandle kokudlalela iqembu lesifundazwe, uphinde aqeqeshe elesikole.“Ngangivele ngibatshelile abazali bami ukuthi ngelinye ilanga ngiyodlala kwindebe yomhlaba. Ngiwumuntu okholelwa ekufezeni wonke amaphupho,” echaza.USange wayevele ekhethiwe ukuyodlala phesheya ngonyala odlule kodwa wabanjwa umdlalo weshashalazi. Uyilungu leYoung KZN Perfomers adlala kulo imidlalo yeshashalazi.“Kwakusele isonto ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umdlalo weshashalazi ngesikhathi ngiqokelwa ukuyodlala phesheya ngonyaka odlule. Ngenxa yokuthi angifuni ukuqala into ngingayiqedi, ngakhetha ukuqhubeka nomdlalo weshashalazi,” kusho uSange.Okumenze wakwazi ukuqokwa ukuyodlala phesheya kulo nyaka ukuthi wabonwa umqeqeshi edlala kwiSenior Inter-Provincial Tournament eqenjini labesifazane. USange usesungule neqembu lakhe leTouch Rugby elibizwa ngamaScorpions. Useqeqesha nomfowabo omncane naye osedlalela iTouch Rugby Under 15 esifundazweni. Unina uNkk Busi Sange uthe uyabamangaza umfutho wendodakazi yakhe. Uthe ubamba kwasani kodwa aphumelele kukho konke.“Kulo nyaka kudingeke ukuthi ayeke ukwenza ezinye izinto ukuze agxile ezifundweni nakwi-Rugby,” kusho yena.USange Matebese (17) ofunda uGrade 12 eDurban Girls High, uqokelwe ukuyodlala eqenjini leTouch Rugby Under 18. Isithombe: SIBUSISO NDLOVUUSange osamile ekudlaleni imidlalo yeshashalazi, ungumholi wabafundi ekilasini aphinde abe ngukaputeni weTouch Rugby noweDrama esikoleni.Kuthiwa ukudlala yinto yakhe ngoba ngisho esakhula awukho umdlalo angakaze awenze.Uke wadlala iBasketball wabuye waba ngukaputeni weqembu lokubhukuda nelabagijimi esikoleni. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi uma eseqede * -matric ufuna ukuyokwenza iSport Sciences enyuvesi ukuze afunde kabanzi ngezemidlalo. Kudingeka ukuthi aqokelele uR42 000 ukuze uhambo lokuya eMalaysia lube yimpumelelo njengoba bezikhokhela izindleko. Unina uthe bafisa noma ubani ongabalekelela ukuhlanganisa le mali. Indebe yomhlaba izoba amasonto amabili ngo-Agasti lapho bezodlala namaqembu ahlukene okubalwa iNew Zealand ne-Australia.

USESABA nokuya esikoleni umfundi waseCastle Hill Primary, eNewlands West eThekwini emuva kokuba kuthiwe uhlukunyezwe womunye umfundi oyibhoklolo, omdonse amankwahla waze wavuvukala, wabuya kudokotela.Unina walo mfundi, esingeke simdalule ukuze kuvikelwe isithunzi somfundi, uthe usefisa nokuyikhipha ingane esikoleni ngoba iphoxekile kakhulu. Lo wesifazane ubethukuthele eveva ethi impilo yengane yakhe isengcupheni uma kunezigameko ezinje esikoleni."Alukho usizo esiluthola esikoleni ngoba lezi zingane zikhonjiwe ziyaziwa, kufanele ngabe kubizwa abazali bazo zijeziswe kodwa akwenziwanga lokho.“Kuthiwa kunamabhoklolo aphuca izingane imiphako yazo kodwa akukho okwenziwayo ngalokho. Inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu, ukube akuwona uJuni ngabe ngiyayikhipha ingane yami kulesi sikole,’’ kubalisa unina wengane.Uthe indodana yakhe iyile kudokotela wayihlola, wathola ukuthi awukho umonakalo otheni. Unina wengane ukhathazeke ngokuthi kungenzeka umonakalo uvele emuva kwesikhathi eside isindala ingane.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe inkinga yezingane eziqonela ezinye ezikoleni idlongile. Ukhale ngokuthi izimpande zayo zisemuva emakhaya lapho izingane zingafundiswa khona ngendlela.“Esimweni esinjalo siyaphenya bese sijezisa lowo mfundi osuke etholakale enecala ngoba ngeke kubekezelelwe ububhoklolo. Yinto embi kabi ukuthi kube nomfundi ohlukunyezwa adonswe ngomphambili esikoleni,’’ kusho uMthethwa.Unina wengane uthe usebuya ngisho kosonhlalakahle ngoba ubonile ukuthi ingane yakhe yethuka izanya, iyesaba ukuya esikoleni ngoba iphenduke inhlekisa ezinganeni efunda nazo.Uthe okumcika kakhulu ukuthi kuthalalisiwe esikoleni sengathi akwenzekanga lutho.

SIGCINE singcwatshwe ngeSonto isidumbu sendoda yaseShowe ebesibangwa umndeni nabasekhweni layo eMgungundlovu ngesonto eledlule.Leli phephandaba ngeledlule libike ngesigameko sokulwa kwamalungu omndeni kaMnuz Bhekisisa Msane (62) nomndeni wakwaNdlovu okuyikubo kukankosikazi wakhe omncane nokuyilapho ashonele khona. UMsane, ngeSonto ungcwatshwe emzini kayise eShowe wazilelwa amakhosikazi akhe amadala amabili okunguMaSibisi noMaNxumalo.Lithintwa ilungu lalo mndeni, uNkk Ntombi Msane uthe konke kuhambe ngohlelo abebelufisa njengomndeni. Uveze ukuthi namakhosikazi akhe ayewashiye ngemuva amnikeze inhlonipho amngcwaba ngaphandle kwezaba aze amzilela.“Sifihle kahle, namanye amalungu omndeni abengazi asizwe ukubona udaba kwiSolezwe. UMsane simngcwabe kahle eduze kukanina,” kusho uNkk Msane.Eqhuba uthe bewumndeni babonga ukuthi uMsane akazange angcwatshwe phezu komunye umuntu emathuneni kahulumeni ekubeni enodedangendlala wendawo.“Siyabonga kubantu abakwazi ukusisiza sayolanda isidumbu. Namakhosikazi akhe ayabonga ngokuthi ugcine ubuyile umzimba womyeni wawo. Ukube abazange bajahe impi kwaboniswana kahle ngabe nabakwaNdlovu bakwazile ukumungcwaba uma bebenothando,” kusho uNkk Msane. Leli phephandaba ligcina ukukhuluma nowesifazane owaphucwa isidumbu uNksz Sandile Ndlovu wathi akukho asafisa ukukwenza ngesidumbu ngoba usemzilele umyeni wakhe uyawukhulula lo mndeni ukuthi umngcwabe ngaphandle kwakhe.Kuthiwa kwaba nempi ngesikhathi umndeni wakwaMsane uyolanda isidumbu sawo eMgungundlovu sekunomlindelo. Kuthiwa kwakushayanwa ngamatshe kwagcina kubhuntshe nomngcwabo, umndeni kaMsane usuthathe isidumbu sawo.

AZIKATHOLAKALI izihlobo zowesilisa okuthiwa udutshulwe washona ngonogada ngoMsombuluko emuva kokuhlasela umuzi wesalukazi ezokweba eMhlali. Kuthiwa lo msolwa ubevele ehlupha ngokuhlasela izaguga kule ndawo njengoba esigamekweni sokugcina ebebamba inkunzi isalukazi esineminyaka engu-73.Lo wesilisa imininingwane yakhe engakatholakali njengoba engaziwa, kuthiwa ubesenezinye izigameko abefunelwa zona ezihlobene nokuhlasela izaguga.Kuthiwa isalukazi sivuswe umsindo ekuseni, okuthe uma siyobheka emnyango, umsolwa wasikhombisa isibhamu wafuna izimpahla.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant-Colonel Thulani Zwane uthe azikatholakali izihlobo zikamsolwa futhi akwaziwa nokuthi ubehlalaphi. Uveze ukuthi isalukazi besisalele emzini waso eSalt Rock ngesikhathi sivuswa umsindo egcekeni. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubesehambile endlini yesalukazi ngesikhathi ethungathwa onogada abazimele emuva kokubikelwa ngalesi sigameko.UZwane uthe umsolwa ubesolwa ngamanye amacala amabili nawo ahlobene nokuphanga emizini ekuyona le ndawo.“Umsolwa usabise isalukazi ngesibhamu maqede wathatha iselula, imali nezinye izimpahla. Isalukazi sishayele inkampani yonogada, yathungatha umsolwa obesaseduze nendawo yesigameko. Onogada bebezama ukumbamba, wadubula kuqala onogada baphindisela kwashona umsolwa,” kusho uZwane.Umufi kuthiwa utholakale nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni okusolakala ukuthi yisona abekhombe ngaso isalukazi.“Kuvulwe icala lokuphanga kuhlonyiwe, kwavulwa nedokodo lokufa komuntu eliphenywa amaphoyisa aseMhlali. Kusolwa ukuthi isibhamu esitholakale kumufi sasintshontshwe komunye umuzi ngesikhathi kuphangwa ngoMeyi nonyaka,” kusho uZwane.UZwane uthe isalukazi asilimalanga kulesi sigameko ngoba umsolwa uphume nezimpahla kuphela.

source: imibono ngishayela izandla umalema ngesibindi sakhe
text: MHLELI: KwiSolezwe langoLwesithathu, Juni 20, phansi kwesihloko esithi: IDA ivulele uJuju awokucwasa. Ngithi ake ngibeke owami umbono. UMalema ukhuluma ngezinto ezigqitshiwe. Ngesibindi sakhe ngimushayela ihlombe.Mhlawumbe ngaphambi kokuqale bagijimele ezinkantolo ontabakayikhonjwa, kungakuhle baqale babheke ubuqiniso bale nto ekhulunywa nguJuju, bazenzele ucwaningo, ikakhulukazi ngalezi zindawo ezinabomdabu baseNdiya abaqashe abamnyama. Kungaba yisemalolini, emakhishini, hardware, ezitolo zokudla njalo-njalo. Uma beneqiniso bayobuya, bamxhawule uMalema, bathi wayeqinisile.Okwe-DA ke khona kuwusizi. Banendlela ebasebenzela kahle kabi yokuphusha abomdabu phambili, ukulwela ububi babo. Ake ngithi uma ucheme nabacwasi ngeke ukubone ukucwasa. Uma ungakubacindezeli ngeke nangengozi uyibone ingcindezelo. Ngicela umphakathi ubathethelele abantu abafana nomfo kaMphithi. Kanti yini wena ongayilindela emntwini olala ngengubo enye nabacwasi? Ngiyolokhu ngasho ukuthi kusezindebeni zomlomo kuphela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibumbene. Hamba uye emapulazini. Uzobona ukuthi abantu bakithi bahlukunyezwa kanjani. Umfo kaMalema ukusho kucace ukuthi, hhayi bonke. Lapho ngimshayela elikhulu ihlombe. Sengathi banganda abaholi abakwazi ukukhuluma ngezinto ezithi zenzeka zibe zifihlwa.

source: kusazothatha isikhathi ukuguqula isimo sezwe langeni
text: OMUNYE wabaqokwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuheha abatshali bezimali uthi abantu kumele babekezele ngoba kusazothatha isikhathi ukuguqula isimo sezwe.UNksz Phumzile Langeni, oyiPresidential Investor Emissary, ubekhuluma nosomabhizinisi izolo esithangamini senhlangano iBusiness Leadership South Africa (BLSA) eThekwini. Uqokwe ngo-Ephreli nabanye abathathu ukuthi bazame izindlela zokungenisa ezweni li * $1 billion eminyakeni eyisihlanu. Utshele osomabhizinisi ukuthi umkhankaso kamengameli obizwa ngeThuma Mina, ngeke uphumelele uma engalekelelwa.Uvumile ukuthi isimo ezweni simanzonzo kuzo zonke izinhlangothi, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho.“Abantu balahlekelwe yithemba, kubonakala ngokwanda kwemibhikisho nsuku zonke. Awulula umsebenzi esinikwe wona kodwa okuhle wukuthi umengameli uhambe phambili wadlulisa umyalezo. Kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthola izindlela zokuheha abatshali bezimali nokudayisa kahle izwe lethu. Emazweni angaphandle uma ufika khona babuza ngesimo sezepolitiki esingesihle nenkohlakalo. Lezi ngezinye izinto ezixosha abatshali bezimali,” kusho uNksz Langeni.Yize ethe kuzothatha isikhathi ukulungisa isimo, uNksz Langeni uthe kukhona okuthembisayo osekwenzekile selokhu kuthathe umengameli omusha. Phakathi kwakho ubale ukuqokwa kukandunankulu omusha eNorth West emuva kwezinkinga nokungalawuleki kwesifundazwe. Unxuse osomabhizinisi ukuthi basizane nohulumeni ukushintsha isimo, wathembisa ukuthi bazohlangana nabo ezifundazweni zonke ukuzwa umbono wabo. Ugcizelele nokuthi balekelele ukudala amathuba omsebenzi ngoba uhulumeni ngeke akwazi eyedwa.UMnuz Bonang Mohale oyisikhulu seBLSA, uthe osomabhizinisi bahlalelwe wumsebenzi omkhulu wokubuyisa isithunzi sezwe. Uthe inkinga yamazwe ase-Afrika akukona ukuthi ahlwempu kodwa ukuthi awalawulwa ngendlela efanele.“Inkinga yisekutheni sikhetha abaholi abangafanelekile kodwa sinayo ingcebo. Umsebenzi esibhekene nawo manje wukubheka ukuthi silwa kanjani nokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Kumele sibheke nokuthi sizozinciphisa kanjani izindleko zikahulumeni nengqalasizinda ebizayo engadingeki,” kusho uMohale.Uthe osomabhizinisi kumele babe phambili ekusizeni umengameli emkhankasweni wokuthunywa. Njengoba bezohambela zonke izifundazwe bebonisana noso­mabhizinisi, kumele basho ukuthi kungani bengafuni ukutshala izimali kuleli. Abanye osomabhizinisi izolo bakhale ngezinga lokwehla kwemfundo abathe linomthelela ekungaqashweni kwentsha.

SEKUQUBUKE indida ngesitshudeni sesikhungo semfundo ephakeme eThekwini, esithanqazeke esitezi sashona ngoLwesihlanu, osekuvele nezinsolo zokweba.Lesi sitshudeni sesilisa okuthiwa sifunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT), besisuka esitezi sesithupha ophikweni lwaseML Sultan kusona lesi sikhungo. Imininingwane yalesi sigameko nekamufi ibingakatholakali kodwa sekuvele imibiko eminingi ngaye njengoba abanye bekuphika ukuthi ubebaleka.Lolu daba belusematheni nayizolo ekhasini likaFacebook lezitshudeni abanye bebemgagula nangegama umufi. Ezinye izitshudeni ziveze ukuthi umufi ubekade ephuca owesifazane iselula, wabaleka. Zithe ubejahwa ngesikhathi eziphonsa esitezi, waphahlazeka kwachitheka ubuchopho.Ezinye izitshudeni kuFacebook zithe ziyamazi umufi futhi ziyakungabaza ukuthi ubentshontsha njengoba zingamazeli okubi. Zisole ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ubezama ukuzibulala ngezinkinga ezithize.Lesi sigameko esishaqise izitshudeni senzeke ngezithuba zabo 4 ntambama.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant-Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe kuphenywa idokodo lokufa komuntu esiteshini eBerea.Uthe kabanayo eminye imininingwane ngomufi ngaphandle kokuthi uphonseke esitezi kulesi sikhungo.Ongumengameli wesigungu sezitshudeni eDUT, uSphephelo Mthembu, uthe ngeke akwazi ukuphawula ngoba usemngcwabeni wacela ukubuye athintwe.Isitatimende esikhishwe wuphiko lwezokuxhumana nabezindaba eDUT sisiqinisekisile isigameko kodwa yangavela eminye imininingwane futhi sangacacisa ukuthi yisitshudeni esishonile.“Isikhungo sisazama ukuthola eminye imininingwane eqondile ngalesi sigameko, esisabikelwe ukuthi ngesokuzibulala. Uma sesithole yonke imininingwane sizokhipha umbiko ocacisayo,” kusho isitatimende.

INHLANGANO yezokusakaza iSouth African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) iqoke uMnuz Madoda Mxakwe ngengesikhulu esiphezulu sayo noNkk Yolande van Biljon njengesikhulu esiphethe izimali zale nhlangano.Lezi zindaba zimenyezelwe nguSihlalo weBhodi, uMnuz Bongumusa Makhathini izolo.Uthe izikhulu ezintsha zizosebenzisana noMnuz Chris Maroleng obhekelele ukusebenza kweSABC kanti zizoqala ukusebenza ngoJulayi 1.Uchaze uMxakwe njengomuntu okhaliphile okwaziyo ukushintsha izinhlangano ezingayingenisi imali, azenze zibe nenzuzo.UMxakwe uneziqu zeMA (Global Political Economy) azithola eNyuvesi yaseSussex e-United Kingdom, izitifiketi zokuhola amabhizinisi azithola eLondon Business School, ezePDG kwiBusiness Administration azithole eGordon Institute of Business School (GIBS) nezinye.Useke wasebenza kwaNestle eyisikhulu esibhekelele ukukhula kwale nkampani eMozambique, Namibia, Botswana, Swaziland naseLesotho.UMkhathini uthe uNkk van Biljon naye unamava kwezamabhizinisi njengoba ebesebenza kwaDenel ephethe izimali.“Uyena oweza nohlelo lokushintsha izinto kwaDenel. Ubesebenza kwaGlad Africa Group, uneziqu zeBCom Accounting, B Compt (Hons), B Comm (Hons) neze M Comm (Taxation). Ukuqokwa kwalaba kusho ukuthi sizimisele ukuheha ongoti emikhakheni ehlukene ukuze beze namacebo okuthuthukisa iSABC, balethe ubuchwepheshe besimanje bagculise namakhasimende ethu,” kusho uMakhathanini.Uthe ukuqokwa kwezikhulu kuzoletha amakhono amasha, kuqinisikise nokuthi ubulili nazo zonke izinhlanga zimelelekile.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezeMpilo kuleli, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi noNgqongqoshe walo mnyango KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, banelisekile ngokusebenza kwenkampani ekhiqiza amakhondomu, eseDube Trade Port.Ngemuva kokuvalwa kwengqungquthela ebidingida izinto ezithinta isifo sofuba, eThekwini, ngesonto eledlule uDhlomo noMotsoaledi bavakashele isikhungo esakhiwe ngokusebenzisana nenkampani yase-United States, iHBM neSA Potection Services.
