Lesi sikhungo sibizwa ngokuthi iHBM-SA.Lesi sikhungo sikhiqiza amakhondomu angu-700 000 ngosuku. Lawa makhondomu aphakelwa ezikhungweni zezempilo zakuleli, amanye adayiswe emazweni angaphandle. Kulindeleke ukuthi le nkampani yenyuse isibalo somkhiqizo wayo kungekudala njengoba iqhubeka nokunweba ibhilidi esebenzela kulo.Amakhondomu akhiqizwa kulesi sikhungo, iMax Condoms, angene esikhundleni seChoice azosatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni.Le nkampani, eyakhiwe ngoR150 million, iqashe abantu abangu-150 bendawo. Ngaphambi kokuthi kusungulwe le nkampani, uMnyango wezeMpilo bewuwathenga eChina amakhondomu asatshalaliswa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Ngemuva kokuthi uhulumeni esungule uphiko oluyisipesheli lokuthuthukiswa komnotho, eDube Trade Port, uthathe isinqumo sokuthi le nkampani ibe kulesi sikhungo esenzelwe ukuthi kube lula ukuthi kuthunyelwe izimpahla kwamanye amazwe.UDkt Dhlomo uthe: “Ungqongqoshe kumjabulisile akubone kulesi sikhungo waze wethembisa ukuthi uzobuya maduze azosivula ngokusemthethweni. Okumjabulise kakhulu ukuthi lesi sikhungo singakwazi ukukhiqiza amakhondomu angu-1.4 million ngosuku. Thina kulesi sifundazwe sishaye izinyoni ezimbili ngetshe elilodwa ngokuvulwa kwalesi sikhungo esifundazweni sethu, ukuba khona kwaso kusho ukuthi ngeke sishodelwe ngamakhondomu njengoba ezobe ekhiqizwa lapha. Kuzoba lula ukuthi athunyelwe ezikhungweni zezempilo kulesi sifundazwe,” usho kanje.Amakhondomu athathwa njengesivikeli esiphephile esingavikela ukukhulelwa okungadingekile nokudluliselana ngezifo socansi.Izibalo zezempilo kuleli zikhombisa ukuthi amantombazane aneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24 kunamathuba amaningi okuthi athole igciwane lengculazi nokuthi akhulelwe engahlelile. Lokhu kunomthelelela wokuthi kube nabafundi abaningi abaphume esikoleni bengaziphothulile izifundo zabo ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu nasezikhungweni zezemfundo eziphakeme.UDhlomo uthe uhulumeli usaqhubeka nokugqugquzela ukuthi abantu basebenzise uhlelo lokuzivikela oluhlanganisa izindlela ezembili ngesikhathi esisodwa, iDual Protection. Abesilisa basokwe kodwa baqhubeke basebenzise amakhondomu, njalo uma beya ocasini, abesifazane basebenzise amaphilisi noma umjovo wokuhlela nekhondomu, njalo uma beya ocansini.

BABHODLA umlilo onogada, abagada ama-ATM abathi bamuhluzwe ngamaphoyisa abecabanga ukuthi baziyizigebengu ezicupha imishini yemali, eMpangeni.UMnuz Mbongeni Gcabashe noMnuz Thembinkosi Ndlovu abasebenza enkampanini yonogada iTrinity Protection enenkontileka nabakwaStandard Bank bathi behlelwe yilesi sigameko bephuma kolungisa i-ATM yakwaStandard Bank , enxanxatheleni yezitolo i-Assenwood Centre, eseRichards Bay ngoLwesine ebusuku.UGcabashe obehleli esihlalweni somgibeli emotweni, engabhaliwe ukuthi eyenkampani abebehamba ngayo uthe uqaphele ukuthi kunemoto ebihamba ebibasola ngesikhathi besebenza.Lo mshayeli uthi bacabanga ukuthi ubikele amaphoyisa bathi akabuzanga lutho kubona, ubebabukile besebenza emshinini. Balinde kancane baphinde babuyela kuwo beqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela awunankinga yini njengoba ubuchwepheshe ababusebenzisayo bebukhombise ukuthi unenkinga.“Sihambe ibanga elincane singasayiboni le moto sabona kuqhamuka inqwaba yamaveni amaphoyisa ngemuva kwemoto yethu. Ebingaphambili isimisile, sama. Ngiphume kuqala ngaphakamisa izandla, ngiphethe ikhadi lokusebenza, angikwazanga nokubuza kwenzenjani, ngoba kuqhume impama, nebhuzu ngalahleka phansi nalo ikhadi ebengiliphethe,” echaza.Ngesikhathi esalele phansi uthe amanye amaphoyisa ahambe aya kuzakwabo obengumshayeli wabuzwa ukuthi kungani imoto abahamba ngayo ingabhaliwe futhi eqashiwe.UNdlovu uthe uchazile ukuthi inkampani ikwenza ngamabomu lokhu ngoba uma kunzeka behamba ngezimoto ezaziwayo bangaba sengcupheni yokudutshulwa yizigebengu.Ngemuva kwalokho bathi amaphoyisa abashiye kanjalo angachaza lutho futhi angasho ukuthi abaye esiteshini bayoveza bonke ubufakazi bokuthi bayasebenza.“Esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni amaphoyisa abekhona asibuze ukuthi yithi yini ebesihamba ngePolo Vivo ebisolisa, savuma. Sabuza ukuthi kuthiwa siyasolisa ngobani athi kungene ucingo luchaza le moto njengesolisayo. Indaba yonakale uma sesithi sizovula icala ngoba sishayiwe. Amaphoyisa aphika ukuthi lawo maphoyisa abephuma kulesi siteshi, athi kungenzeka ukuthi sishaywe ngonogada abebesebenzisa izimoto zamaphoyisa. Kube umzukuzuku ukuthi sivule icala,” kusho Gcabashe.Uthe kwale noma sekufika umphathi wabo esiteshini ezobuza ukuthi kwenzekeni iphoyisa elithe liwukhomanda lanqaba negama lalo kodwa icala ligcine livuliwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCol Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuvulwe icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza esiteshini samaphoyisa eMpangeni.“Lolu daba luthunyelwe ophikweni oluphenya amacala athinta amaphoyisa,” kusho uCol Mbele.

ZITHOLE ithuba lokugonyuluka okokuqala ngokuhlukunyezwa kwazo ezinye izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi ebeziyingxenye yomcimbi obekudingidwa kuwo ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane emanyuvesi.UNksz Nonjabulo Mncwabe, ofunda e-UKZN eHoward, ugonyuluke ngokuthi ngonyaka odlule udlwengulwe umuntu obewumngani wakhe omnike indawo yokuhlala. Uthe akakwazanga ukukhuluma ngale nto ngenxa yokuthi yamkhubaza emoyeni ngoba engazitsheli ukuthi umuntu asondelene naye angamenza into enje. Uthe uze wakwazi ukukhuluma ngalesi sehlo okokuqala njengoba bekunenkulumo ngalesi sihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane izolo ngesikhathi kuhlangene izitshudeni eziphuma emanyuvesi ehlukene nezikhulu zezinhlaka ezehlukene eCoastal TVET College kwa-V eMlaza.Esinye isitshudeni, u-Amanda Zoleka, siveze ukuthi sathwalwa sifunda uGrade 10 sathola ukuthi nguyise owayehlele ukuthi amshadise esemncane. Sesishadisiwe sakhulelwa, saphuphunyelwa isisu sineminyaka engu-15. Sesisesibhedlela sathola usizo lwabezenhlalakahle sakwazi ukuphuma kulo mshado.Uthishanhloko weCoastal College eThekwini, uMnuz S B Ndlovu, uthe abazali kumele banakekele izingane zabo bahlale nazo ukuze bakwazi ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izingqinamba ezibhekana nazo zonke izinsuku.IPhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakame kuzwelonke, uMnuz Bhuti Manamela, livule lo mcimbi ngokuthi licele ukuthi kube nomzuzu wokuthula, kukhunjulwa bonke abesifazane ababulawa amadoda abebethandana nawo kubona abale uZolile Khumalo owayefunda eMangosuthu noJabulile Nhlapo owayefunda e-Unisa, eVanderbilpark. “Ukubulawa kwabantu besifazane abayizitshudeni kuyalikhinyabeza izinga lezemfundo njengoba ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besimame kungenye yezinkinga esibhekene nazo emanyuvesi. Njengoba kuqala inyanga yabantu abasha sizosebenzisa le nyanga ukuqwashisa izitshudeni ngokubhebhetheka kokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane emanyuvesi.”Uthe bazoba nezinhlelo ezibonakalayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyaliwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besimame emanyuvesi.“Lezi zinhlelo sizoziqala kuwo amanyuvesi sithi: ‘phansi ngokuhlunyezwa kwabantu besimame, phansi, phansi ngama-blesser phansi.’ Sithi sekwanele ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besimame.”Kuwona lo mcimbi kukhonjiswe nomdlalo washashalazi othi iKomeng, obhalwe waqondiswa umlingisi wakuleli uSello Maake kaNcube.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe i-iKomeng indlela akhethe ukukhuluma ngayo nabantu besilisa.“Ngalo mdlalo waseshashalazini ngifuna ukunika abantu besilisa umyalezo ngoba kungathi kukhona izinto ezibakhathazayo abangakwazi ukukhuluma ngazo. Ngalo mdlalo ngiphinde ngikhuze abantu besilisa abenza imikhuba emibi emizimbeni yabantu besimame njengokubadlwengula. Ngifisa bazi ukuthi kabanalo igunya lokuzenzela noma yini emzimbeni yabantu besimame,’’ kusho uSello.Izitshudeni zasemanyuvesi ehlukene zisebenzise leli thuba ukuthi zigonyuluke ngezinye zezinkinga asebhekane nazo zokuhlukunyezwa.

ABAZALI besikole samabanga aphansi eLovu bathi bazoqhubeka nokubhikisha uma uMnyango wezeMfundo ungamxoshi uthishanhloko obambile, abamsola ngokungaphathi kahle isikole.Kusukela ngoMsombuluko abazali base-Andrew Zondo Primary babhikisha ngaphandle kwesango lesikole, bakhala ngokuthi abamfuni uthisha obambe emuva kokushona kukathishanhloko ngo-Ephreli. Lo thisha wesifazane Isolezwe elinalo igama lakhe, kuthiwa ubevele eyiphini likathishanhloko ongasekho uMnuz Sihiya, igama lakhe elingatholakalanga. Kuthiwa lo thisha ongafunwa uke wabamba ngesikhathi kugula uSihiya, abazali abakhala ngokuthi izinga lokuphasa lehla ngaleso sikhathi. Bakhala nangokuthi kuningi osekushintshile kusukela ebambile, okubalwa nokumisa abahlanza isikole. Kuthiwa abafundi yibona asebehlanza ngisho amathoyilethi esikoleni.Izolo abazali baphindelile ukuyoqhinqa emasangweni esikoleni, kwaze kwabizwa amaphoyisa azoqapha isimo.Ongusihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Thami Magubane uthe abakuphaza-misanga ukufunda ngoba babhikisha ngaphandle kwesango.“Kuningi esingakuthandi ngebamba likathishanhloko. Kunamaphepha esikole alahlekile selokhu eqalile ukubamba. Kuduke ngisho amabhuku amasheke esikoleni,” echazaUMagubane uthe akusebenzeki nalo thisha amsola ngokungahloniphi abazali nangendlela akhuluma ngayo. Uveze nokuthi lo thisha usebhalele umnyango ethi akakwazi ukusebenza kahle esikoleni ngoba kudliwe imali.“Naye uke waphatha isikole ngesikhathi ebambile, kumele ngabe uyazi ngokulawulwa kwesikole njengoba esekhala ngokudliwa kwezimali. Sibona ukuthi uyahluleka zisuka nje ukuphathaisikole. Ngeke siyeke ukubhikisha, sifuna abomnyango bamlande bahambe naye,” kusho uMagubane.Uthe bahlakazwe ngamaphoyisa ngoMsombuluko bebhikisha ngaphandle kwesango. NgoMsombuluko kuthiwa ubengekho uthisha obhikishelwayo kodwa izolo ufikile ngoba bekugade amaphoyisa esikoleni.Okhulumela umnyango esifundazweni uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe abahambisani nokugxambukela kwanoma iziphi izinhlaka zomphakathi esikoleni ngoba kuphazamiseka ukufunda. Unxuse ukuthi abanezikhalo balandele imigudu efanele ukuze udaba lulungiswe.

text: UYISE wowesilisa osolwa ngokubulala umfundi waseMangosuthu University of Technology, osedume ngokuqhuba intwala ngewisa, uthi kunzima ukukholwa yizinsolo ezibekwe kuMnuz Thabani Mzolo (23).UMnuz Mthembeni Majola oyikhansela le-IFP onguyise kaMzolo ongamzali uthi ubechitha isikhathi esiningi naye njengendodana yakhe. Uthi njengoyise kunzima ukukholwa yonke into eshiwoyo ngaye.“Sizokholwa uma sekuphuma ubufakazi benkantolo obuzoveza ukuthi esikabani isibhamu,” usho kanje.Phambilini kuke kwavela ukuthi uMajola ubegadwa wuMzolo, kodwa uthi lokhu akulona iqiniso. Uthi bebehlale bendawonye ngoba uMzolo eyindodana yakhe yize engamzali.Uthi njengomndeni bamazi njengengane ezithobile futhi ehlale ilubalubela ukufukula abanye.UMzolo usedume ngokuqhuba intwala ngewisa njengoba kuleli sonto kuvele ukuthi ukhombise iMantshi umunwe ophakathi nendawo.Nakubantu abasuke beyothamela icala, usedume ngokuthi avele abakhombe ngophawu lwesibhamu esebenzisa iminwe yakhe.UMajola uthi kwenzeka lokhu nje uMzolo ubesemfundisa inkonzo emvakashisa emathempelini ahlukene ebandla lakaShembe.“Thina njengomndeni wakhe sizokholwa ngesikuzwa ngenkantolo, nakhona kube nobufakazi obuphathekayo.Okunye okushiwo abantu emaceleni ngeke sikulalele kakhulu,” kusho uMajola.Uthe uMzolo ubewusizo ezinganeni eziningi ezifundisa izibalo, sekukhona nezineziqu ngenxa yakhe.Mayelana nokuthi uMzolo ubewunogada, uMajola uthe: “Ubengeke abe ngumfundi aphinde abe ngunogada, ubehlala ehamba nami ngoba sihlobene."Ukuba unogada kuhambisana nezinto eziningi namalayisensi enziwayo. Akakaze angigade futhi angazi kuqhamuke nobani lokho,” kusho uMajola.UMajola uthe uyazi ukuthi umndeni wakaKhumalo uphatheke kabuhlungu ngokwenzekile, nabo bayazwelana nawo kodwa abafuni ukuhlangana nawo kusenje.“Uma abantu bebhekene nesimo esifana nalesi akumele nibajahe eduze. Sifisa baphole kuqala bese sikwazi ukubavakashela. Nathi sisadidekile kodwa uma enganikezwa abameli abawaziyo umthetho, kuningi okungavela ngaleli cala,” kusho uMajola.Ephetha uthe uma ligcina ngokumlahla icala futhi naye ekuvuma konke okuvezwa yinkantolo bazokwamukela njengomndeni ukuthi kunohlangothi lwakhe abebengalwazi.NgoLwesine iNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini isichithile isicelo sebheyili sikaMzolo kulandela ukuvela kwenkinga yekheli lakhe eliqondile njengoba nezinye zezihlobo zakhe zimuhlangulile.

KUPHELA ngisho ubungani kwabesifazabe uma kubangwa indoda, bagcina sebelwa bodwa. Akujwayelekile ukuthi uma abesifazane sebethole ukuthi indoda ibabhangqile balwe nayo kodwa baklwebhana bodwa. Lo mkhuba kade waqala njengoba nasezikoleni bekunomkhuba odume ngokuthi ipero, lapho abesifazane babelindana sekuphume isikole belwela ukuthi bajola nomfana oyedwa.Yize nabesilisa belwa bebanga intombi, uNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPsychologist uthi abafana kuyenzeka badlulise uma bebanga intombi kusajolwa nje. Kwehlukile lokhu kwabesifazane athe ngisho bekade bengabangani uma kuke kwabangwa indoda kuphela konke. Uthe yindlela abadalwe ngayo abesifazane eyenza ukuthi bebodwa bangasekani futhi bangaziboni bebalulekile. Uthe isikhathi esiningi abakwenzayo ukujabulisa owesilisa abazi ukuthi yilona joka abanalo.“Owesifazane wadalelwa ukujabulisa owesilisa ngoba ngisho intombazane ingakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yasendlini, abadala bayibuza ukuthi iyokwenzenjani endodeni. Lokhu kwenza owesifazane akhule azi ukuthi kumele ajabulise indoda kukho konke akwenzayo. Uma owesifazane ethole ukuthi babanga indoda eyodwa nomunye, ulwisa umnakwabo hhayi indoda."Uveze ukuthi kumele ngabe yindoda okuliwa nayo ngoba iyona eshelayo kodwa akwenzeki lokho. “Kuke kwaduma indaba yokubizana ngo-star kwabesifazane ababanga indoda. Lelo gama alipheli ngisho indoda ingasathandani nabo. Uma abesifazane beke babanga indoda abaphinde bazwane. Abafana kwesinye isikhathi uma bebanga intombi bagcina bezwana bodwa, babone owesifazane kunguye onephutha bambize nangamagama alumelayo."Umbhali uNksz Nancy Roxanne waseKenya, esihlokweni esikhuluma ngombango wamadoda kwi-website, i-Eve Woman uthe kuwubuwula ukuthi abesifazane balwe bodwa. Uthe kumele balwise indoda bobabili. Uthe indoda emthanda ngempela owesifazane ngeke imbeke esimeni sokuthi kumele ancintisane nomunye othandweni. “Kuyihlazo futhi kwehlisa isithunzi ukubona abesifazane abahle bechitha isikhathi ngokubanga indoda. Abanye bathukana ngisho ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bebanga indoda yona esuke iziphumulele. Uma ujola kumele wazi ukuthi asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi indoda izothembeka kuwena."Ukhuthaza ukuthi uma owesifazane ebamba ukuthi indoda imbhangqile, ungalinge ulwise umnakwenu, ilwa nendoda.Uthe abanye baze baqhoshelane ngokuthi ubani oyintombi yangempela neshende kodwa iqiniso ukuthi bobabili basuke benziwe izilima yindoda.“Asikho isicoco sokulwela indoda. Kunalokho indoda inibona nobabili ngingaphusile ukuthi ningalwa nodwa nibanga yona.”

USEPHENDUKE isilomo uNkanyiso Buthelezi , ongumqeqeshi we-hockey esikolèni sodumo saseNanda esaziwa ngeNanda Seminary. Lensizwa eneminyaka engu-23, ithi umphakathi awuwuvali umlomo ngamagalelo ayo ekuthuthukiseni izinga lomdlalo we-hockey emphakathini njengoba waziwa ngokuthi ngowabantu bebala elimhlophe.Uthando lwakhe lwalo mdlalo lisuka kude njengoba laqala esenza amabanga aphansi eBonisanani Primary, okuyisikole esiseNtuzuma esigcemeni sakwaG.Akugcinanga lapho njengoba wagcina esethole umfundaze kwezinye zezikole zabadla izambane likapondo saseMhlanga esaziwa ngeNorthwood High nakholelwa ukuthi samsiza kakhulu ngokuthuthukisa izinga lakhe njengomdlali.INanda Seminary izoqala imidlalo yeminyaka yonke ebizwa nge Spar School Girls Hockey Challenge lapho bezobe beqhudelana nezikole eziyisithupha ezisenkabeni yeTheku okubalwa kuzo iDurban Girls High, Durban Girls College, Hoerskool Port Natal, Maris Stella, Ridge Park High neSt Henry. Lo mqhudelwano unamuhla use-3 Schools’ Trust astroturf, eGlenwood.“Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele sikushintshe ukuthi sibukele i-hockey njengomdlalo wabantu abamhlophe. Ngiqala ukuzibandakanya nalo mdlalo ngike ngabhekana nezingqinamba zokubukwa ngelinye iso emphakathini engiwakhele ngenxa yokuthi bebengaqondi kahle. Izinto seziqala ukujika manje njengoba kwezinye izikhathi ngimiswa abantu ubuthaphuthaphu befuna ngibacobelele ngolwazi enginalo nglo mdlalo,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthi yize ewumuntu omatasa ngenxa yomsebenzi njengoba engumabhalane kuMasipala weTheku kodwa akumkhinyabezi ukuthi aphinde adlalele ikilabhu yangakubo i-Ink Hockey Club edlala ngaphansi kwesigaba esiphezulu kwi-Durban Central.Ukumela iqembu lesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal Hockey team, ngonyaka ka-2006 kwezinye zezinto eziyohlezi zimthokozisa kakhulu.Ukumela iqembu lesizwe kuseyiphupho alibona lisazofezeka njengoba ekholelwa kuthi iminyaka isangakuyena nanothando analo lalo mdlalo. Uzibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokutshala ulwazi emphakathini awakhele nawubona usukhombisa olukhulu ugqozi muva nje.Mekubalwa nabanye abantu asebenze lomdlalo wazakhela idumela eNanda alisali igama likaBongi Gabuza oqeqeshwa nguye uButhelezi.Le ntokazi edabuka eStanger KwaDukuza ikholelwa wukuthi kwayisiza kakhulu ukufunda esikoleni zabebala labamhlophe nekwenza yagcina isizibandakanya nalo mdlalo. Uthi waqala lomdlalo esaneminyaka eyisikhombisa esenza amabanga amancane eDarnall Primary School wangaphinda wabheka emuva kusukela lapho.“Uma ngikhuluma iqiniso, ngifike eNanda ngathola liphansi kakhulu izinga le-hockey ngoba besijwayele ukudlala nabantu abasezingeni kakhulu. Ushintsho lukhona impela kodwa kuzothatha isikhathi kuthi libe ngelincomekayo,” kugoqa Gabuza, owenza unyaka wesithathu enyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika ( Unisa) kwiziqu zobuthishela.Ukholelwa wukuthi uhulumeni akenzi lutho ekuxhaseni lolu hlobo lomdlalo ezindaweni zasemalokishini nabona kuyingqinamba eyenza lo mdlalo ungathuthuki ngalendlela elindelekile.Lo mdlali odlala emuva usehlale iminyaka emibili neNanda Seminary Hockey team nanethemba lokuthi libukeka liqhakazile ikusasa lalo mdlalo emphakathini njengoba uthando lwawo luqubuka mihla namalanga.Ngeminye imininingwane ungalandela ikhasi lomqhudelwano le-Facebook .

text: INHLOKO yophiko lezokushushisa uShaun Abrahams usefunge wagomela ukuthi noma ngubani othinteka enkohlakalweni yaseVrede dairy farm uzobhekana nengalo yomthetho."Siyaluphenya lolu daba. Uma uphenyo lwethu luholela ekutheni kubekwe abanye abantu amacala noma ikanjani sizokwenza lokho,"kusho u-Abrahams namhlanje ngesikhathi echazela ikomidi lezamaphoyisa ephalamende. Uthe akekho ozophunyuka ngisho noma kwenzakalani.U-Abrahams ubephendula amalungu ephalamende abeveza ukungenami kwawo ngokusebenza kwalolu phiko lwezokushushisa, akhale nangokuthi lolu phiko kuhlanganisa namaHawks bamandla ekubopheni izisebenzi zikahulumeni kodwa alusondeli kosopolitiki.Kuke kwaba nezikhalo ngosopolitiki abafana nowayengungqongqoshe wezokuMbhiwa, uMosebenzi Zwane noNdunankulu waseFree State ophinde abe nguNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, u-Ace Magashule, okunenkolelo yokuthi baneqhaza elibalulekile abalidlala enkohlakalweni yaleli famu kodwa akukho okwenzeka kubona.

APHAZAMISE ukwakhiwa komgwaqo amalungu omphakathi aseMawoti, eNanda, adilizelwa izindlu kusukela ngo-2014, athenjiswa ukunxeshezelwa ngemali angakayitholi.Abantu, asebehlala ezindlini zomxhaso, bathe sebekhathele ukubanjiswa udonga ngesinxe-phezelo. Zibalelwa ku-34 izindlu okuthiwa zadilizwa kule ndawo ngesikhathi uNkk Zandile Gumede oseyiMeya yeTheku eseyikhansela. Umphakathi uthe wathembisa ukuthi uzonxeshezelwa kodwa azisafezeki izethembiso.UNkk Thomza Mthembu ongomunye wabathintekile uthe batshelwa ukuthi kuzokwakhiwa umgwaqo oxhumanisa iMawoti neTafula ngakho kumele basuswe.“Kwabizwa imihlangano sitshelwa ukuthi sizofakwa ezindlini zomxhaso kodwa sizonxeshezelwa nangemali. Ngenxa yokuthi sasingafuni kube sengathi sivimbela intuthuko savuma ukudilizelwa. Okusiphatha kabi wukuthi sibona sekuya emaphethelweni ukwakhiwa komgwaqo kodwa asikanxeshezelwa. Sizwa kuthiwa abanye sebakhokhelwa,” kusho yena.Uthe ngesonto eledlule bavimbe ogandaganda abalungisa umgwaqo bathenjiswa ukuthi bazobizelwa emhlanganweni nemeya, ogcine ungaphumelelanga.UMnuz Phillip Falithenjwa, othe ukhishwe emzini wakhe ngo-Ephreli nyakenye, uthe batshelwa ukuthi bazonxeshezelwa ngokushesha."Satshelwa ukuthi siyongena ezindlini zomxhaso sesinikiwe imali yesinxephezelo. Ngamangala ngishayelwa ucingo wumkami ngisedolobheni engitshela ukuthi sekufike abakwamasipala bazodiliza. Bathi uma ngibabambezela ngiyoyithola inconzuliwe imali yesinxephezelo ngoba imishini yokudiliza iyakhokhelwa,” kusho uFalithenjwa.UMnuz Bongani Qhansi oyikhansela uthe imeya iyalwazi udaba futhi izophuma imali yesinxephezelo.“Ngiwance-ngile amalungu omphakathi ukuthi angaphazamisi ukwakhiwa komgwaqo ngoba ngizohlangana nawo nezinhlaka ezithintekayo ukucacisa udaba. Kumele baqonde ukuthi kunemigomo elandelwayo ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwemali. Imeya iyona ebalwelayo ukuthi banxeshezelwe hhayi ngokunikwa izindlu zomxhaso kuphela. Ngesonto eledlule ibizimisele ukuhlangana nabo kwaba yibona abashintsha uhlelo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe okucasule umphakathi wukuthi kukhona asebenxeshezelwe. Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba uMasipala weTheku ungaphendulanga ngalolu daba yize bethunyelelwe i-email ngoMsombuluko.Udaba lokudilizelwa kwabantu izindlu eMawoti lwaba sematheni abaningi bekhala ngendluzula.Ngo-Okthoba 2015 Isolezwe labika ngokukhishwa ngesidlozana kukaNkk Manazile Tekana, ongomunye wabadilizelwa banganikwa indawo yokuhlala. Wakhala waze wabhuquza encenga amaphoyisa nabasebenzi bakamasipala bangawubhidlizi umuzi wakhe.

SIKHULU isililo ngokubulawa kwevolontiya le-ANC laseMfume ebeligqugquzela ukuvota.Kuthiwa uMnuz Nqobizwe Mkhize (46) waseSimahleni, eMfume uhlaselwe abalisa abangaziwa abathathu elele nomkakhe ezintatha kuzosa kube nguMgqibelo. Kuleya ndawo kuphinde kwabulawa abalisa ababili, uMnuz Sibonelo Hlongwane noMnuz Nathi Hlengwa abatholakale bedindilize emgwaqweni buqamama nalapho okuhlala khona uMkhize.Kuthiwa laba balisa bangene batshela umkakhe okhulelwe ukuthi akamboze angababuki base bedubula uMkhize kaningana. Kuthiwa izinhlamvu ezintathu zingene ekhanda.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala.“Kukholakala ukuthi kuthe uma kugamanxa ihora lesibili ekuseni kwatheleka abasolwa abathathu abebehlome ngezibhamu, bakhahlela isicabha bangena kwaMkhize bamdubula. Udubuleke amahlandla amaningi kwesingenhla. Isizathu sokubulawa kwakhe asikaziwa,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.Isigameko sesibili kukholakala ukuthi senzeke ngaphambi kwehora lesithathu lapho okuhlaselwe khona uHlongwane noHlengwa abadutshulwe abalisa abangaziwa abebehamba ngemoto. Lesi sigameko senzeke emuva kokubulawa kukaMkhize.UCaptain Gwala uthe laba balisa bashonele endaweni yesigameko. Uthe isizathu sokubulawa kwabo asikaziwa.Ikhansela lakuleya ndawo, uMnuz Ayanda Ndlovu, lichaze uMkhize njengomuntu obezinikele emsebenzini weqembu nasekusizeni umphakathi. Uthe nguye obenikwe umsebenzi wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.“Ubengumuntu obethandwa kakhulu wumphakathi. Silahlekelwe njengeqembu nomphakathi ngoba ubezinikele futhi esebenzisa ngisho imali yakhe ukwenza imisebenzi yeqembu. Kubuhlungu kakhulu okwenzekile. Sishaqekile nangokubulawa kukaHlongwane noHlengwa abatholakale befile. Sinxusa noma ubani ongaba nolwazi ukuthi asebenzisane namaphoyisa ukuze kutholakale izigilamkhuba,” kusho uNdlovu.UNdlovu uthe inkosikazi kaMkhize okulindeleke ukuthi ibelethe kule nyanga isesimeni esingesihle ngokomphefumulo ngenxa yokubulawa komyeni wayo ibhekile.UMxhumanisi wekomiti lesikhashana le-ANC KwaZulu-Natal Mnuz Sihle Zikalala uthe bashaqekile ngesigameko esenzeke kuleya ndawo. Uthe banethemba lokuthi amaphoyisa azosebenza kanzima ukuthola abathintakayo.Izolo uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele uye kuleya ndawo eyokhuluma nomphakathi. UCele uthembise amalungu omphakathi ukuthi amaphoyisa azophenya ngesigameko sokubulawa kwalaba bobathathu. Uqhube wathi amaphoyisa azophenya nangamacala osekunesikhathi engaphothulwa. Elinye lalamacala uthe ngelokubulawa kowayengunozinti wePirates neqembu lesizwe, uSenzo Meyiwa, elisahlalise kabuhlungu izihlobo zakhe nomphakathiwonkana.“Sicele umphakathi ukuthi usebenzisane namaphoyisa uphinde ubike amaphoyisa angenzi kahle kodwa uthi uwabika nawo ube ukhumbula ukuthi akhona amaphoyisa enza kahle nokufanele usebenzisane nawo,” kusho uCele.Uthe uxoxe nenkosi yendawo wathola ukuthi lesi sigameko kungenzeka ukuthi asihlobene nezepolitiki.Noma kunjalo uCele unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze kanzima ukuthola abenzi bobubi ngisho kungathiwa abantu abaphezulu.

IMBONGI ephinde izigaxe kwezomzabalazo, uMzwakhe Mbuli, ikhwele yadilika kubelaphi bendabuko ibagxeka ngokungasizi ngalutho ekubeni bethi banamandla.UMzwakhe uthe ubone esiteshini sethelevishini sase-USA, iHistory Channel, ukuthi abaphenyi beFBI babuye basizwe yizanusi zakhona ukuxazulula amanye amacala kodwa eNingizimu Afrika kunenzukazikeyi yecala lokubulawa kowayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, uSenzo Meyiwa.“Uma ngempela benamandla yini bengasho ukuthi wubani owabulala uSenzo?“Uma benamandla njengoba besho, kungani bengawasebenzisanga ngesikhathi kusabhoke ubandlululo, bathumele amabhunu ngisho nangezinyosi ukuze ziwatinyele.Ngisakhula kwakuthiwa kunesibuko esigwazwa yizangoma kufe umuntu, yini bengasebenzisanga sona?“Ngibone nje abaholi bethu begugela emajele futhi abanye beshonela ekudingisweni. Nathi sazabalaza kanzima njengamadelakufa ukuze leli zwe likhululwe kodwa bekhona abelaphi bendabuko.”IMBONGI engusaziwayo uMzwakhe Mbuli ithi abelaphi bendabuko abalekelele ekutholweni kwababulali bakaSenzo MeyiwaIsithombe: Dumisani DubeUthe akuzwayo ngabelaphi bendabuko wukuthi bathenga izicubu zabantu abanebala elimhlophe ukuze bakhande imithi yokuthakatha kunokusiza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.“Ngolunye usuku ngaxoxelwa ubaba ukuthi iNkosi uShaka waninda isigodlo sakhe ngegazi ebusuku.“Ngosuku olulandelayo wathumela umbiko ophuthumayo, wathi akubizwe izanusi ezizobhula.Cishe zonke izangoma zashaya eceleni, zanuka abantu abamsulwa abangenacala kodwa sisodwa isanusiesayishaya esikhonkosini.”Uthe uphonsela inselelo zonke izangoma nezinyanga ukuba zithole ukuthi ngobani ababulali bakaMeyiwa.“Uma ngempela benawo amandla adlulele mababambe iqhaza bancedise amaphoyisa ukuze kuxazululwe udaba lokubulawa kukaMeyiwa.“Kolunye uhlangothi kukhona abalokhu belulaza igama leSilo ngokubulala abantu bebala elimhlophe.“Laba bathakathi mabahlukane nobulwane nobuvaka kodwa abasize kutholakale ababulali bakanozintiwe-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana.“Mangiphothule ngokukhuza abazalwanembumbulu badlisa abantu utshani, izinyoka, amagundane, baphinde babaphuzise nophethroli.“Emakholweni angempelasicela imikhuleko ukuze kusombululeke izinkinga zokubulawa kwabantu ngesihluku,” kuphetha uMzwakhe.

INKAMPANI eholela abantu izibonelelo zikahulumeni, iCash Paymaster Services (CPS) ikhala ngokuthi izobe ingasenayo imali ngoMeyi uma uhulumeni engayinyusi imali ayikhokhela le nkampani ukuze yenze umsebenzi.Izolo abameli beCPS, batshele amajaji eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuthi uma unganyuswa uR16.44 okhokhwayo ukuze iholele abantu izibonelelo kusho ukuthi izohluleka wukuqhuba ibhizinisi layo.Ummeli weCPS, u-Adv Les Morison, uthe uma beqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi ngemali encane abayinikwa wuhulumeni kusho ukuthi njalo ngonyaka bazolahlekelwa nguR70 million.UMorison uphinde wathi bafuna inkontileka yabo ilulwe ngezinyanga eziyisithupha baholele abantu kuze kube nguSepthemba.IJaji uJohan Froneman ubuze uMorison ukuthi kungani iCPS ibona kufanele yenze inzuzo ngoba kudala iholela umphakathi izibonelelo?UMorison uthe iCPS ifuna ukuthola yonke imihlomulo yenkontileka yayo.“Inkontileka yethu neSassa isemthethweni futhi uMnyango wezeziMali kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi imali iyanyuswa ukuze iCPS ithole umhlomulo obhekile,” kusho uMorison.UMnuz Gilbert Marcus, ongummeli weFreedom Under Law, uthe iCPS kufanele ikhokhe uR705 million ewuthole enkontilekeni yayo engekho emthethweni.Uthe ngeke bavume ukuthi iCPS ingakhokhi lutho ngoba ihlomule ngendlela engafanele.UChief Justice Mogoeng Mogoeng, uthe iFreedom Under Law kufanele ifake udaba lwayo eNkantolo eNkulu ukuze iCPS ikhokhe uR705 million.“Akufanele yini ikhasimende lakho liqale eNkantolo eNkulu uma lifuna iCPS ikhokhe inzuzo eyayithola ngokungemthetho?” kubuza uMogoeng. UMarcus uthe kuyishwa ukuthi iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) yaze ngoNovemba ukuthi ngeke ikwazi ukuholela abantu kulo nyaka kodwa yalinda ukufaka isicelo sokuthi kululwe inkontileka yeCPS njengoba isifake ngoFebhuwari.UMarcus uthe njengoba kunomengameli omusha noNgqongqoshe omusha wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNkk Susan Shabangu, banethemba lokuthi izinto zizoshintsha.ICPS ithe iwenza kahle umsebenzi wokuholela izibonelelo zikahulumeni njengoba isikhokhe uR720 billion selokhu yathola inkontileka ngo-2012.Isinqumo asikakakhishwa kulolu daba.

UZIMISELE ngokubamba iqhaza ekulweleni amalungelo abantu besifazane umfundi ka-matric (17) ophila nebala elimhlophe ozomela iNingizimu Afrika engqungqutheleni ezobhunga ngezinkinga zabesifazane.UGoldgirl Phakathi ofunda eNqabakazulu Comprehensive High KwaMashu uthe ufisa sengathi abantu besifazane bangafunda ukuzethemba kukho konke abakwenzayo bazi ukuthi ukuba ngabantu besifazane akubenzi babe ngaphansi kwabesilisa.UGoldgirl ungomunye wabafundi abahambele ingqungquthela ezobe iseNew York, iCommission on the Status of Women 2018 ehlelwe yi-United Nations.Lo mfundi, ohambe izolo, kulindeleke ukuthi abe kule ngqungquthela kusukela ngoMashi 12 kuya ku-23 nonyaka.Uthe njengoba ephila nebala elimhlophe uzithole ecwaswa ezindaweni ezithile okubalwa kuzo nasesikoleni ngenxa yokuthi abanye abafundi bebengaqondi ngabantu abaphila nebala elimhlophe.Lo mfundi uthe okumqinisa idolo wukuthi umphakathi aphuma kuwona KwaMashu kwa-J awuzange umcwase. Uthe lokhu kumenze wakhula engazizwa enesici futhi engenza noma yini eyenziwa ngabantu abalingana naye.Uthe ufisa sengathi nabantu besifazane bangafunda kulokhu bazi ukuthi noma kungaba khona abazobacwasa kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi ngeke besakwazi ukwenza noma yini abafisa ukuyenza. Njengoba esengqungqutheleni kulindeleke ukuthi akhulume ngezingqinamba ezicindezela abesifazane namantombazane asezindaweni ezisemakhaya.“Abantu besifazane basemakhaya nabaselokishini bacishe babhekane nezingqinamba ezifanayo kodwa laba abasemakhaya kuba nzima kakhulu kubona. Kimina, enye yezinto eziyinkinga kakhulu okufanele kuliwe nayo wukukhulelwa kwezingane zisafunda, wukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa nokungalingani phakathi kwabantu besifazane nabesilisa. Ngisho kungathiwa yiselokishini noma yisemakhaya abantu besifazane nabesilisa abanikwa amathuba afanayo - lokhu kufanele kushintshe ukuze kuthuthukiswe abesifazane,” kusho uGoldgirl.Uthe abanye bakholwa ukuthi akubalulekile ukulwela amalungelo abesifazane ngoba bethi ngeke kushintshe lutho kodwa yena akakholwa yilokho.UGoldgirl, othole leli thuba ngokuba yingxenye yohlelo olucija abesifazane olwaziwa ngeWomen’s Leadership and Training Programme, uthe uzimisele ngokusebenzisa lonke ulwazi azoluthola ukufukula abesifazane.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo usanda kuhambela esikoleni salo mfundi eyomhalalisela ngokuqokwa kwakhe emfisela nendlela enhle ohambeni lwakhe.

IZAZI zomnotho zidonse ngendlebe abantu ukuthi babophe izifociya ngoba kuzoshuba njengoba sekuzozwakala ukunyuka kwentengo ekhokhwa uma uthenga impahla, iValue Added Tax (VAT) enyuke ngo-1% isuka ku-14% yaya ku-15%.UMnuz Jason Urbach oyisazi somnotho kwiFree Market Foundation, uthe ukunyuka kweVAT kuzoshubisa ngoba kuzozwela kuwo wonke umuntu.“Abantu kufanele babophe izifociya ngoba intela izobaphilisa kabuhlungu. Abampofu bazoyikhokha iVAT ngoba akudliwa impuphu kuphela kodwa bayayidla inyama nokunye okuningi. Bazokhokha kakhulu noma begibela ngoba ukunyuka kwentela kaphethroli kusho ukuthi osomatekisi bazonyusa imali yokugibela, ukuze benze inzuzo,” kusho u-Urbach.UNobhala weCosatu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Edwin Mkhize, uthe namhlanje bazoqhinqa ngaphandle kwamahhovisi oMnyango wezeziMali eMgungundlovu, emgwaqweni uChief Albert Luthuli ngoba bafuna yehliswe iVAT.“Silindele ukuthi uhulumeni wethu njengoba ehlale ethi uyabalalela abantu, asilalele ayehlise iVAT ngoba ihlukumeza wonke umuntu. Yebo kukhona ukudla okuthiwa uma ukuthenga ngeke uyikhokhe iVAT kodwa lokhu akuwususi umthwalo emahlombe abantu. Sifuna uhulumeni ayehlise iVAT,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe banethemba lokuthi uhulumeni uzoyehlisa iVAT ngoba umkhankaso wabo wokuthi yehle uyaqhubeka.UMengameli weCosatu, uMnuz Sdumo Dlamini uthe baxoxe nobuholi be-ANC ngodaba lweVAT kodwa bebengakaxoxi noMnyango wezeziMali.Uthe sebeqalile ukumasha ngoba bafuna ukuthumela umyalezo ocacile wokuthi abahambisani nokunyuka kweVAT.Khona manjalo inkampani ekhiqiza ukudla iWillowton Group, iveze ukuthi ngeke iyinyuse iVAT ngo-Ephreli, Meyi nangoJuni ukuze ivikele abathengi.Isikhulu esiphezulu seWillowton Group, uMnuz Zubeir Moosa sithe bayazi ukuthi iVAT izoshubisela abathengi yingakho bekhethe ukungayinyusi kuyo yonke imikhiqizo yabo okungenani izinyanga ezintathu.“Sicela nezinye izinkampani zingayinyusi iVAT izinyanga ezimbalwa, ukuze abathengi bangathwali kanzima,” kunxusa uMoosa.

OMUNYE wabesifazane abazocobelela abanye ngemfihlo yokuphumelela ezithangamini ezizoqala ngoMgqibelo ezibizwa ngeSat-Sof-Fro Salon Seminar, uthe abesifazane kumele bafunde ukuzimela kwezezimali. Isithangami sokuqala sizoba seGreen Park eSandton eGoli.UNkk Nelisiwe Masango, oyiWealth Coach, uthe kusenhliziyweni yakhe ukufundisa abesifazane ukuthi bangathembeli kumuntu ekutholeni imali. Ungomunye wabangu-12 abaqokwe ukucobelela abanye ngolwazi kulezi zithangami esizozungeza amadolobha ehlukene. Lezi zithangami zihambisana nomkhankaso obizwa nge#WearYou, ohlose ukutshala ukuzethemba kwabesifazane.“Kubalu-lekile ukuthi singabe-sifazane sicathulisane, sithuthu-kisane ukuze kwakheke isizwe esiqotho. Ngijabulile ngokukhethwa ukuba yingxenye yalo mkhankso ngoba kusho ukuthi ngiyisibonelo kwabanye. Ngijwayele ukululeka abesifazane ngezezimali futhi ngikholwa ukuthi ukubanikeza amathiphu kulo mkhakha kungalwenza ushintsho,” kuchaza uNkk Masango.Echaza ngomkhankaso i#WearYou, uthe kusho ukuthi uma ungowesifazane kumele uphikelele ngisho isimo singavumi.“Lokhu kusho ukuzethemba, umamatheke ngisho isimo singavumi kodwa ekugcineni uphumelele ngoba uyayazi inhloso onayo empilweni. Ukuzethemba kowesifazane kuyikho konke ngoba uma umuhle uzethemba kakhulu. Uma uzinakelela nangendlela obukeka ngayo uba semathubeni angcono, “ kusho uNkk Masango.Uthe uma unaka indlela obukeka ngayo kuba lula nokuthi abantu bakwethembe. Ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuzihlonipha nokuzethemba athe kuvula yonke iminyango. Uthe abanye abantu bahlaziya ibhizinisi lakho ngendlela obukeka ngayo yingakho abesifazane kumele babe bahle kusuka ekhanda kuya onyaweni.Abahleli balo mkhankaso nezithangami bathe bakhethe abesifazane abasemikhakheni ehlukene yempilo ukukhuthaza nabanye. Isithangami sokuqala sizogxila ekuzithuthukiseni kwabesifazane kwezezimali. Ngaphandle kokucwala izinwele, abesifazane kuthiwa bangenza lukhulu kwezamabhizinisi.Abanye abazoshiyelana inkundla kulezi zithangami nguNksz Samke Mhlongo ongumsunuli weThe Next Chapter Wealth Partners. Uyaziwa ekuhlaziyeni ezomnotho emaphephabhukwini, kwiMetro FM, eNCA nakwezinye iziteshi zomsakazo. Kukhona noNksz Aurelia Nxumalo ongummeli ogxile kwezamabhizinisi noyilungu leCorporate Counsel Assocaition of SA. Isithangami esilandelayo sizogxila ekutheni ulisebenzisa kanjani ikhono ngento oyithandayo, ulenze ibhizinisi. Lapho kuyobe kuboshelwe umpheki wodumo lweCheri Yase Kasi uSunshine Shibambo nabanye.

ININGI labantu besifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola abantwana abanezinkinga zokukhulelwa, abanalo ulwazi lokuthi banenkinga.Umbhali we-website yezempilo i-healthline echaza ngezifo eziholela ekutheni kube nzima ukuthola izingane, uNkk Stephanie Watson, kule website uthe u-26% wabantu besifazane abasesigabeni sokuthola izingane, unesifo esidalwa ukungasebenzi kwama-hormone esihlasela umgudu wenzalo iPolycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS).Abesifazane abanalesi sifo uthe bajwayele ukuya ezinsukwini zabo isikhathi eside noma babe nezimpawu zokuthi bane-hormone yabesilisa eningi i-androgen.Abanalesi sifo baba nenkinga yokuba noketshezi ezikhwameni ezigcina amaqanda okuholela ekuthini ngesinye isikhathi amaqanda abo angaphumi uma sekuyisikhathi sokuthi aphume.UNkk Watson uthi akwaziwa ukuthi iPCOS idalwa yini kodwa abesifazane abanayo bajwayele ukuba nezimpawu zokopha kakhulu uma besezinsukwini zabo noma beqiwe yizinyanga bangayi esikhathini.Kwesinye isikhathi bamila uboya emzimbeni kakhulukazi emalungeni omzimba afana nasebusweni okuvamise ukuthi kube yihwanqa, intshebe, uboya obusesifubeni nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba.UNkk Dalene Barton Schuster encwadini yakhe ekhuthaza ukuthi kusetshenziswe amakhambi emvelo uma kwelashwa lesi sifo iNatural Fertility Info uthe lesi sifo kuyenzeka sibe wufuzo uma kukhona oke waba naso emndenini.Ngokolwazi alubhale kule ncwadi uthe kuyenzeka sidalwe ukudla okungafanele, ingcindezi nokuba nokhwantalala kwesinye isikhathi ukusetshenziswa kwemithi yokulawula ama-hormones isikhathi eside.Okunye athe kuba nomthelela ekutheni abesifazane bangakhulelwa wukuvaleka kwamashubhu aziwa ngama-fellopian tubes.Izinkinga zokungabatholi abantwana uthe ziyenzeka nakwabesilisa. Kubona uthe ukuhlolwa kokuqala kuvamise ukuthi kuveze ukuthi inkinga idalwa yini kanti abesifazane kudingeka bahlolwe izikhawu eziningi ngaphambi kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi yini inkinga.

text: UKUQOKWA kukaMnuz Bheki Cele esikhundleni sokuba nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kujabulise abaningi abebelokhu bekhale njalo uma kwenzeka ubugebengu bethi akubuyiswe uCele, ngakolunye uhlangothi kunalabo abanovalo nongabazane ngobuholi bakhe, uDELI MNCWABE uyahlaziyaSEKUNGUMLANDO ukuthi kuphelile ngoNgqongqoshe obemandla nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, kwangena oke waba nguMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele obelokhu ekhaleleka njalo uma kuvela ukuthi izigebengu ziyazicanasela eNingizimu Afrika.Yize iningi likhombise ukujabula kodwa umlando wakhe ngesikhathi enguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eminyakeni edlule, ubuyise uvalo nongabazane ngobuholi bakhe kwabaningi.Okhulumela inyunyana yamaphoyisa iPopcru, uMnuz Richard Mamabolo uthe bayakwemukela ukuqokwa kukaCele, wathi bayazi ukuthi uhlalelwe umqansa ongenyukwa mbongolo njengoba kufanele asebenze kanzima ukubuyisa isithunzi sezokuvikela.“Siyakwemukela ukuqokwa koNgqongqoshe abazosebenza emkhakheni wezokuphepha. Siyazi ukuthi uCele akamusha kulo mkhakha. Useke wasebenza njengokhomishana, isipiliyoni sakhe asithola ngokudlula sizomsiza ukungena athi khaxa asebenze kushunqe uthuli.“Okukuqala okufanele akwenze wukudiliza inqwaba yezikhulu kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni, aphinde aqinisekise ukuthi anele amaphoyisa eziteshini,’’ kusho uMamaboloAkumangazi ukubonakala kwezithombe zikaCele nama-video edansa abantu bejabuliswa yisinqumo sikaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Eqokwe ngayizolo uCele, ufike lazwakala izwi lakhe njengoba ekade ehambele inkonzo yesikhumbuzo samaphoyisa aseNgcobo.“Akumele nife niphethe izibhamu,” waphinde watshela amaphoyisa la mazwi ake wawasho phambilini ukuthi amaphoyisa kumele ashaye enyameni kwizigilamkhuba.I-DA ikhuze umhlolo ngokubuyiswa kukaCele yathi kuyichilo eliphindiwe. UMnuz Zakhele Mbhele obhekele ezamaphoyisa uthe akasiboni isidingo sokubuyiswa kukaCele emaphoyiseni.“Kuyethusa ukuthi umuntu owake watshela amaphoyisa ukuthi awadubule enyameni ezigebengwini usebuyisiwe. Sihlala sigcizelela ukuthi umbutho wamaphoyisa udinga ukuphathwa abantu abafanele,’’ kusho uMbhele.Kunenkolelo yokuthi uCele uyaziswacisa izigebengu ngamazwi nangemiyalelo ayinika amaphoyisa.Nokho akhona amaphutha nogcobho ababonwa yilabo abangaphakathi emaphoyiseni, abakholwa wukuthi umuntu okulesi sikhundla kumele kube wumuntu osemnkantshubomvu emaphoyiseni.Kwamanye amaphutha akhonjwa kuCele, kubalwa udaba okukholakala ukuthi lwamxoshisa ekubeni wuKhomishana wamaPhoyisa, kubalwa udaba lokuthengwa kwesakhiwo samaphoyisa, nalapho owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi, * -Advocate Thuli Madonsela athi ingcabha yayikuCele ngalolu daba.Okunye okumdalele amazinyo abushelelezi yizinkulumo zakhe. Kuzona kubalwa ayenza ngesikhathi kuphenywa kabanzi icala lokubulawa kuka-Annie Dewani nokwakusolwa umyeni wakhe uShrien ngokumbulalela kuleli. Lolu daba lwagcina ukunakwa kusekhona uCele ngemuva kwalokho kwathuleka ngalo kwagcinwa kuboshwe uXoli Mngeni noMziwadoda Qwabe kwathi owayesolwa phambili uDewani waphunyula.UCele wabiza umsolwa ngenkawu esuke ezweni layo yazogila ubugebengu lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu akwehlanga kahle kwabaningi. Kwaphoqa ukuthi agcine ehlele ngezansi axolise ngenkulumo yakhe.Enye inkulumo ngeyokugqugquzela amaphoyisa ukuba adubule ashaye enyameni ezigebengwini, abuze emva kwendaba.Olunye udaba kube ngolombutho owaziwa ngeleTRT (amabherete) ake asolwa ngobuge-bengu nokungaziphathi kahle. Indlela abesebenza ngayo ibishiya imibuzo nezinsolo zokunga-hambisi kahle.Ubudle-lwano obuqinile phakathi kukaCele bubonakale ngisho esephumile esikhundle-ni sokuba ngukhomi-shana njengoba ake wakho-mbisa ukuweseka amanye awo ngesikhathi evela eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini eyoqula icala.Lokhu kukhombise ngokusobala ukuthi nakuba kwake kwakhona umsindo wokuthi akakaze abe yiphoyisa njengoba aye ngumkhuzi wawo, kodwa ukusebenza ngokuzimisela nokuba ngumuntu okwazi ukuxhu-mana nalo mbutho, kwenze waba ngumuntu ogcina ethenjwa yiwo.Phezu kwakho konke lokhu iningi labantu lithi uCele ubenza okufanele futhi unguMesiya ozokhipha umphakathi wakuleli ebugqileni obudalwa wukudlanga kobugebengu.Ubufakazi wukuthi ngesikhathi engukhomishana wamaphoyisa wenze umphakathi waphila ngokuphepha ngenxa yokuthi ubugebengu bubonakale behla.UCele waziwa ngokuzibambela mathupha efika endaweni yesigameko azibophezele ekuxazululeni inkinga nokuhambela imiphakathi abheke ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ebhekene nazo.Nakuba nabanye bekwenza kodwa okukaCele kuyadlulela nokungenye yezinto emenze wathandwa ngabantu.Akekho ongakhohlwa ukuthi uCele uphinde abe nendaba nendlela amaphoyisa abukeka ngayo. Lokhu kubonakale ngesikhathi egqugquzela ukuthi awajime futhi akhece imikhaba, kugqame isifuba.Phakathi kobugebengu obebudla lubi kulezi zinsuku kubalwa ukuqolwa kwezimoto ezithwala imali.Nakuba kungakapheli ngisho isonto kodwa uCele usephawulile ngalokhu wathi ngesikhathi sakhe waqeda ngalolu hlobo lobugebengu. Uthe uzibophezele ukuqeda nya ngabo nangobunye obuphilisa lubhojozi umphakathi.Ukubuya kwakhe azohlenga isizwe yinto osekunesikhathi ikhaleleka. Lokhu kubonakale ngemikhankaso ethi #BringBhekiCele ne-#BringNdosiBack ebishisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Kwayena ubelibeka ngembaba elokuthi uyakhumbula futhi usawulobizela lo msebenzi. Ngamanye amazwi inkulumo ayenza emngcwabeni wowayengumsakazi uNat “Cool Kat” Gumbi, lapho athi ukhathele wukujahana namaklabishi, ufuna ukujaha izigebengu, lifezekile.

US’MANGELE ZUMA uxoxe noMntwana uThulani Zulu, okhulumela iNdlunkulu, ukuthola kabanzi ngalo mnikelo ka-R5 ocelwe yiSilo Samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzuluYEBO kunjalo, ivulwe ebhange i-Absa. Ngicela ukulungisa sonke lesi sikhathi benginikeza abantu izinombolo ezingaphelele. Izinombolo ze-akhawunti ezifanele zithi 924 198 1117. Igama le akhawunti lithi Zulu Zwelithini Land Prosecution from Repossession, uma ulinqamulela uthi: ZZLPR.KUNGANI iMbumbe iqoke ukuvula i-akhawunti kwa-Absa?OKWAMANJE iSilo asikho kuleli, siseMorocco. Uma sibuya sizovula ama-akhawunti nakwamanye amabhange akuleli. Inhloso yeSilo wukufinyelela kuwo wonke umuntu ongumZulu oseNingizimu Afrika, nangaphandle.NGABE isiqalile ukungena iminikelo?KUFANELE, into ephazamisile wukuthi benginezinombolo ezingaphelele ze-akhawunti esivuliwe. Ngiqale ukubona sengifonelwa abantu bethi banenkinga yokufaka iminikelo yabo ngoba izinombolo ze-akhawunti aziphelele. Ngiphoqeleke ukuthi ngisithinte iSilo ngiqinisekise izinombolo. Umuntu ongaqinisekisa yisona iSilo ngoba imiyalezo yokungena kwemali ingena efonini yaso.KUNGANI iSilo silufake enkantolo lolu daba lomhlaba?NGESIKHATHI kuthathwa lesi sinqumo, akuzange kuxoxwe neSilo. Sibonile ukuthi uma singasukumi sisebenzise izinkantolo, sizozithola siphucwa umhlaba. Umhlaba uyinto enkulu kithina sizwe samaZulu. Siwusebenzisela ukutshala, kudla khona imfuyo yethu, sakhe khona, siphinde singcwatshwe kuwona. Umuntu ongahlali emakhaya ngeke akuqonde lokhu.UTHINI ngabangahambisani nalesi sicelo seMbube?BAKHONA abanemibono eyahlukile. Abantu abakhumbule ukuthi umnikelo lo, njengasesontweni, umuntu unelungelo lokuthi angawukhiphi. Abantu abayeke ukukhipha amagama ayiziswana, baphendule iSilo. Akuyona inhlonipho leyo.OKHULUMELA iNdlunkulu, uMntwana uThulani Zulu, unxuse abantu abangahambisani nesicelo seSilo Samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini, somnikelo kaR5 ukuthi bayeke ukukhuluma amagama ayiziswana Isithombe: SIGCINIWEISILO sifinyelele kanjani enanini lika-R5?SIBONILE ukuthi iyona mali wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuyikhipha. ISilo siyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi bayahlupheka. Abanesifiso sokukhipha engaphezulu bamukelekile ukwenza njalo.NGOBANI abanenkinga enkulu ngokukhipha lo mnikelo?ABANTU abahlala emadolobheni, emhlabeni osikiwe. Abavuka ekuseni baye emsebenzini babuye bayothenga emakethe. Abaphili ngokulima nokufuya. Kungangcono basixolele, bayeke ukukhuluma ngento abangayazi.KUNGANI iMbube icela umnikelo kubantu kube kukhona imali eyithola kuhulumeni?OHLAKANIPHILE uyazi ukuthi iSilo sinikezwa imali esuke ikalelwe izidingo zaso njengokuphucula izigodlo zaso. Le nto ayiqondene nohulumeni ngakho asikwazi ukuthatha leyo mali.

UGWETSHWE udilikajele olahlwe yicala lokudlwengula umfana oneminyaka eyisikhombisa eNtshanga. Inkantolo yesiFunda eCamperdown igwebe indoda eneminyaka ewu-33 ngecala lokudlwengula.Kuthiwa lesi sigameko sabikwa esiteshini samaphoyisa eNtshanga ngemuva kokuthi lo mfana edlwenguliwe ngoMeyi 2016.NgoMeyi 2, 2016 umgilwa waficwa wumdlwenguli eyedwa kubo unina engekho, wamgila imikhuba. Umdlwenguli wabanjwa ngamalungu omphakathi esadlwengula umgilwa, abiza amaphoyisa. Kwavulwa icala lokudlwengula esiteshini samaphoyisa eNtshanga. Icala ladluliselwa ophikweni oluphenya amacala odlame lomndeni, ukuvikelwa kwezingane namacala ocansi ukuze aliphenye.Khonamanjalo inkantolo yesiFunda eMpangeni igwebe uJulio Mapsangane (38) iminyaka engu 10 ngokudlwengula owesifazane oneminyaka engu-55 eMpangeni.Kuvele ukuthi ngo-Okthoba 14, 2017 umgilwa wayephuza eGxigxi, eMpangeni, nabangani bakhe ngemuva kwesikhathi wazumeka walala wabe esedlwengulwa. Kwavulwa icala ladluliselwa ophikweni oluphenya ngamacala odlame lomndeni, ukuvikelwa kwezingane namacala ocansi eMpangeni. UMapsangane waboshwa ngecala lokudlwengula.

UNGQONGQOSHE omusha weMfundo ePhakeme uNkk Naledi Pandor usefunge wagomela ukuthi uzoshanela amabibi enkohlakalo kulo mnyango nasezikhungweni zemfundo kuleli. UNkk Pandor usanda kuqokelwa kulesi sikhundla esuka kwesokuphatha uMnyango wezeSayensi noBuchwepheshe ngesikhathi kushintshwa iKhabhinethi. Lesi sikhundla besiphethwe uDkt Hlengiwe Mkhize ngaphasi kweKhabhinethi kaMnuz Jacob Zuma osedla endala manje.UNkk Pandor utshele ikomiti lasePhalamende elibhekele imfundo ephakeme ukuthi akezwani nenkohlakalo nokungethembeki.“Uma kukhona ukudliwa kwezimali zomphakathi ngeke sisinise amahleza kuzoshuba, ngiyizonda kabi indaba yokuphathwa budedengu kwezimali zabantu,’’ kusho uPandorUNkk Pandor ukhuluma kanjena nje kusanda kuvela izindaba zokuthi uphiko lwabaphenyi lulandela udaba lwesamba esingu-R 3 million okuthiwa yabhubhudlwa eTshwane South Technical Vocational Education and Training College, okwenziwa ngayo imicimbi yabafundi.Uthe umnyango wakhe uzoqhubeka nokweseka amakolishi bawahlinzeke nangemali nangamaqhinga okuyiphatha .Uthe ubona ushintsho olukhulu emnyangweni kusukela ku-2004 nango-2009 ngesikhathi usahlangene nowemfundo eyisisekelo.“Kumanje sizama ukuqhamuka namaqhinga azosisiza ukuze konke kuhambe ngendlela. Uhulumeni uzama ukubambisana nezinhlaka ezahlukene nezasemazweni omhlaba ukuze siyidudule le nqola yezemfundo.”

source: usenethemba lokuthi uzakwabo uzolulama abuyele ekudlaleni
text: UKUBUYELA ekudlaleni i-triathlone ngo-2009 ngemuva kokuthi ngo-2005 aba sengozini yemoto eyamphula umlenze wesokunxele, kwenza uSandile Shange, ongumngani kaMhlengi Gwala, aqine idolo ukuthi nozakwabo usazobuyela kulo mdlalo.UGwala (26) waseNdwedwe kodwa osezinze eChesterville kusuke igidigidi emhlabeni wonke ngesonto eledlule kusabalala izindaba zokuhlaselwa kwakhe esahwa imilenze yizigcwelegcwele.Uhlaselwe entathakusa ezivocavoca ngebhayisikili lakheNgoLwesihlanu uGwala evakashelwe nguNgqongqoshe weZemidlalo, uTokozile Xasa, eSt Augustine Hospital, odokotela bakhe bathi mancane kakhulu amathemba okuthi abuyele ekudlaleni.Nokho uShange unomlando omenza abone ngendlela ehlukile.“Nami kwakushiwo kanje kimi ngo-2005. Ngashayiswa yimoto ngasala ngiphuke izindawo ezimbili emlenzeni. Udokotela wayethi ngeke ngisakwazi ukubuyela ekudlaleni i-triathlone,” kusho uShange waseLamonti.“Wathi imilenze sekungeyokuhamba kuphela. Ngo-2007 kodwa ngabuyela ekudlaleni. Bengishaya imijaho emifishane. Ngo-2009 ngaqala ngashaya i-Ironman. Ngashaya emifushane kwathi ngasekupheleni konyaka ngashaya ephelele. Ngiqhubeke kanjalo-ke, ngishaya emifishane nemide. Ngabuya ngamushiya emangele udokotela ngizomkhombisa izindondo zami,” kusho uShange.Uthe umlenze olimele kakhulu ngowesokudla osahwe esihluzwini kanti owesokunxele usahwe ngaphambili embaleni.Elandisa ngempumelelo kaGwala, uShange uthe:“Isasa likaMhlengi liqale ngo-2013 enqoba i-long run kumaSA Champs eBattery Beach. Ngaqala lapho ukumbona ukuthi uzoba yisilomo. Okwamdalela isasasa kakhulu wukuthi i-long run ibijwayele ukunqotshwa abantu abavela kwezinye izifundazwe. Wafika yena wayijika le nto.“Siqale lapho ukuba abangani, yena wayethathwa yindlela engibhukuda ngayo njengomuntu omnyama nami ngichazwa yindlela agijima ngayo. Ngamtshela ukuthi ngenza i-triathlone. Wangiphendula ngokuthi uyalesaba ibhayisikili, akakaze acabange ukuthi angaze aziwe njengomdlali walo.“Ngamtshela ukuthi sizoncenga kancane sibone sifikaphi. Wavuma kanjalo engazi ukuthi uzogcina eseyisolomo. Wawina izigaba walokhu edlondlobala waze waya phesheya kwezilwandle," kuchaza uShange.UShange uthe ukulimala kukaGwala kuphazamise izingane abezisiza ezilolonga.“Ukulimala kwakhe kuphazamisa abantu abaningi ngoba ungumuntu owusizo. Kunezingane zaseMkhambathini ezika azihlalise kubo azijimise."

UDABA lwebandla laseNgcobo, iMancoba Seven Angels Ministries, okusolwa amalungu alo nabasolwa ngokuqotha amaphoyisa ngokuyokhosela kulo, lusematheni kulezi zinsuku.Uma kukhulunywa ngaleli bandla, kubalwa abesifazane abalinganiselwa ku-100 okuthiwa bayizigqila zocansi kuleli bandla, abantu okuthiwa badayise imizi yabo, yizimoto zabo nokunye ukuze banike abaholi baleli bandla yonke imali abanayo.Bona bahlezi abanabo omazisi, nezingane azinazitifiketi zokuzalwa, izingane ezineminyaka ewo-12 zikhulelwe ezinye zisanda kubeletha.Lokhu sekuqubule umbuzo wokuthi yibandla elinjani elenza izinto ‘eziwubuSathane’ kanje?Inhlobo yenkolo engachaza kangcono ngeSeven Angels yileyo ebizwa nge-cult.Lolu hlobo lwenkolo yilapho abantu thize abaliholayo, abenza amakholwa abo akholelwe ezintweni ezithize ngendlela yokuthi bangenza noma yini ukufezekisa abakukholwayo.ISeven Angels le kuthiwa inabesilisa abawu 7 abayiholayo, abathi bayizingelosi ezithunywe wuNkulunkulu.NgokukaSihlalo weKhomishini ebhekele ezenkolo namasiko kanye nezilimi kuleli, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluza, leli bandla bebazi ngalo.“Sakhuluma nabasonta khona ngo-2016 abasitshela ukuthi bafundiswe ukuthi bahlale balinde ukubuya kukaJesu.“Bangabi nalutho kodwa balandele imiyalelo ‘ yezingelosi’ okungabaholi bebandla,” kusho uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva.NgokuMbhishobhi Vusi Dube, lolu hlobo lwenkolo alukholelwa ekutheni uJesu Krestu uyindodana kaNkulunkulu, futhi aluyisebenzisi iBhayibheli.“Abantu abalandela lolu hlobo lwamabandla likholelwa yizinto ezishiwo umuntu abamlandelayo. Abalifundi iBhayibheli.“Uma kwenzekile balifunda, bakhetha okuzoba yingxenye ebasekelayo ngayo lokho okuthile abafuna ukukwenza ukuze bacashise iqiniso,” kusho uDube.Uthe laba bantu bavamise ukuba yiqeqebana elithile ezlizibiza ngabangcwele elingafuni ukuzihlanganisa nabanye abantu abaningi.“Bayaye bathi bona sebelindele izulu. Banomkhuba wokuzivalela bebodwa benze imikhuba ethile njengokuthi bathi bathandaza ndawonye. Ekugcineni kuyaye kungaqondakali ukuthi kanti ngempela kwenziwani,” usho njalo.“Bavamise ukusebenzisa izisekelo ezingamanga ngenhloso yokudoba abantu. Umholi wabo uvamise ukuthi atshele abamlandelayo ukuthi uboniswe into ethile nguNkulunkulu, bese nabantu bayamlandela,” kuchaza uDube.UDube ukholwa wukuthi kumele izincomo zekhomishini kaNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, zinakwe ukuze amabandla afuze lawa, angayitholi indawo kuleli lizwe.UFata Smilo Mngadi webandla lamaRoma aKhotholika, uthe igama lawa mabandla abizwa ngawo, asukela esikhathini sobandlululo.Uthi phambilini uma ungumuntu omnyama esungule ibandla, belibizwa ngaleli gama le cult.Uthe nakuba yena ekholelwa wukuthi uJesu uyindodana kaNkulunkulu, ngeke abagxeke abanye abakholelwa kokunye, ngoba konke kungamandla kulabo abakholelwa yikho.Ngokwakhe, uhulumeni wakuleli kwakumele abeke imigomo eshoyo ukuthi abantu kumele bakhonze ngaluphi uhlobo, ukuze akwazi ukubhekana nalabo abaphambana nemithetho esuke ibekiwe.Wenze isibonelo ngodokotela, wathi kunomkhandlu obalawulayo uma kwenzeka benza okuphambene nomthetho.“Kumele amasonto kucace ngawo ukuthi enzani. Noma selibhalisiwe ngokusemthathweni, kumele kwazeke ukuthi yisonto elikhonza amadlozi yini noma okuthile, ukuze kusasa uma selenza okuphambeme nalokho, lithathelwe izinyathelo.NgokukaMbhishobhi Nathi Zondi weTruevine Community Church, abantu bakuleli bayamthanda uNkulunkulu ngendlela yokuthi baze basebenzise izindlela zokuduka bebe bengaqondile.Uthe ukwanda kwalolu hlobo lwalawa mabandla ulubone kahle ukuthi likhona kuleli ngenkathi lizethula phambi kweKhomishiniebhekele ukuvikela amalungelo eNkolo, ezamaSiko neziLimi emphakathini ngenkathi yenza uphenyo lwayo ngendlela abefundisi bamabandla abaziphathayo ngayo.“Lolu hlelo lwamabandla lugcwele umhlaba wonke. Lukhona nase United States of America,” kuchaza yena.Uthe ngokujwayelekile lolu hlobo lwamabandla luvamise ukutshela abalandeli balo ukuthi yonke into ifinyelela esiphethweni, ngakho asikho isidingo sokusebenza nokuya esikoleni uzilungiselele okusasa.“Uma lokho kungenzeki, bayazibulala ngoba laba abantu basuke bebhekene nengcindezi enhlobonhlobo,” usho kanje.Nazi ezinye zezinto ababhishobhi abathe kumele abantu baqaphele ngayo uhlobo lwalawa mabandla:* Uma lelo bandla lingalisebenzisi iBhayibheli futhi lingakholelwa ku-Jesu noNkulunkulu.* Uma ukwenza kwalo kuphambana nezinto ezikumthethosisekelo wezwe, njengokwehlisa abantu isithunzi nokuhluku-meza amalungelo abo.* Uma liqhakambisa izinto eziphathekayo ngaphandle kokuphakamisa ubukhulu bukaNkulunkulu.* Uma kukhonzwa kakhulu umholi webandla, kuthiwa abantu abadayise konke balethe konke abanakho kubaholi.

UNGQONGQOSHE wamaPhoyisa uBheki Cele useqinisekise ukuthi kuzobhekwa impilo ephilwa ngamaphoyisa, nanethemba lokuthi lokhu kuzonciphisa ubugebengu.UCele, obeyingxenye yethimba longqongqoshe bezokuphepha ebeliphendula imibuzo ephalamende namhlanje, uveze ukuthi akusekho ukujikela emvakwendlu kumele iphenyiwe indlela amaphoyisa aphila ngayo.Uthe bazolandela umyalelo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngesikhathi enza inkulumo ayeyibhekise esizwe, lapho agcizelela khona ukuthi kuzomele kubhekwe nempilo ephilwa abantu ukuthi iyahambisana yini nomholo wabo.Umbuzo bewuqhamuka kwiDA ne EFF akade befuna ukwazi ngempilo ephezulu ephilwa yilowo obeyibambela lika khomishana wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke Khomotso Phahlane, bekhala ngokuthi beyisolisa.

text: I-DA isisole uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngokuyishaya emuva ayishaye phambili ngesinqumo sakhe sokuthi umbuso ukhokhe izindleko zecala likaMnuz Jacob Zuma obengumengameli.UMnuz James Selfe ucashunwe emaphepheni asenkantolo ekhala ngokuthi kungani uRamaphosa evumela ukukhokhelwa kwezindleko zecala likaZuma kodwa ebe enqabe ukukhokha ezecala lamaphoyisa amahlanu angesikhathi sobandlululo, asolwa ngokusoconga uNksz Nokuthula Simelane.URamaphosa uzidonsele amanzi ngomsele ngesikhathi eqinisekisa ukuthi izindleko zamacala kaZuma zizothwalwa umbuso. Ukuveze lokhu ngesikhathi ephendula umbuzo obuhlonywe umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ephalamende phakathi nesonto.I-DA ifake amaphepha eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGauteng ngoLwesihlanu, ithi lolu daba aluthathwe njengoluphuthumayo.URamaphosa uthe kunesivumelwano esenziwa uZuma nowayengumengameli uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, ukuthi uZuma uzoyikhokha le mali uma elahlwa amacala.UZuma ubhekene namacala okukhwabanisa, inkohlakalo nokushushunjiswa kwemali.

source: usazokwazi ukubuyela ekugijimeni osinde esahwa imilenze
text: USAZOKWAZI ukubuyela kwezemidlalo umgijimi waseThekwini osinde emadodeni abezama ukumshumpula imilenze ngesaha lokusika izihlahla, ukuhlinzwa kwakhe okube yimpumelelo ngoLwesithathu.Odokotela abahlinze uMhlengi Gwala (27) amahora ayisihlanu esibhedlela esizimele, batshele umndeni ukuthi usazobuyela ekugijimeni yize kuzothatha isikhathi. Umngani wakhe uSandile Shange naye ongumgijimi, uthe bazijabule ngezindaba ezimnandi ngoba uGwala ubekhathazeke ngokuthi ngeke esakwazi ukugijima.“Odokotela bathe konke kuhambe kahle kodwa kusazothatha isikhathi ukuthi imilenze iphole ngoba kuthinteke nemisipha. Okuhle wukuthi usazokwazi ukugijima nokushova ibhayisikili. Into yokuqala ayibuza odokotela esanda kungena esibhedlela wukuthi usazokwazi yini ukugijima. Ngisho kungathatha isikhathi ukuphola kwakhe siyajabula ukuthi uzobuyela ekugijimeni,” kuchaza uShange.Uthe bazilolonga njalo entathakusa nomngani wakhe, olimale eyolanda yena. Uthe bebezilolongela iSA Champs ezoba ngoMashi 18 eBloemfonteni neHalf Iron Man engoJuni. Uthe umncintiswano wangoJuni ubuzokwenza ukuthi uGwala akwazi ukuncintisana ezingeni lomhlaba futhi ubesethubeni elihle.UNksz Fundi Magwaza ongunina kaGwala uthe ugcine ukubonana naye ngoLwesithathu ebusuku esibhedlela.“Simfice engakwazi nokukhuluma, wangakwazi nokusibona. Odokotela bathe ubesadakwe wumjovo namaphilisi emuva kokuhlinzwa. Siyathemba sizombona esengcono namuhla (izolo).”Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba usaqhubeka umkhankaso wokunikelela uGwala izindleko zokumelapha, umnikelo obusifinyelele kuR400 000. Umkhankaso wokunikelela uGwala uvulwe ekhasini iBackaBuddy lapho kunikele khona ngisho abakwamanye amazwe. UMnuz Patrick Schofield oyisikhulu seBackaBuddy, uthe imali izokhokhela izindleko zokwelapha uGwala, athengelwe nebhayisikili elisha. Uveze ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-898 abakuleli nakwamanje amazwe asebenikelile abanye basathembisile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe kuphenywa icala lokuzama ukubulala emuva kokuba abasolwa abathathu behlasele lo mgijimi.

KUFEZEKE izifiso zamaqembu aphikisayo osekuphele iminyaka zifuna ukuthi obengumengameli wakuleli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ayobhekana namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa okwavela ukuthi kwaba khona ubushompeshompe obuthinta uZuma kuwona.NgoLwesihlanu oyinhloko yophiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, uMnuz Shaun Abrahams, umemezele ukuthi uZuma uzoshushiswa ngamacala awu-16 ahlanganisa inkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nokushushunjiswa kwemali.“Kumele umthetho usebenze. Wonke umuntu uyalingana phambi komthetho. Sinikezwe amandla ukuthi sishushise noma ngabe ubani ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela,” kusho u-Abrahams izolo.Uthe sekuyinkantolo eyokusho ukuthi leli cala lizoqala nini ukuthethwa.U-Abrahams uthe uzokwazisa ummeli woMbuso ukuthi asenqabele isicelo sokudluliselwa kwalolu daba phambili.“Ngibonga nethimba elikwazile ukuza nobufakazi ngoFebhuwari bokuthi ngikwazi ukufinyelela kulesi sinqumo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe umazisile noZuma ngesinqumo sakhe sokumbizela enkantolo ngokuxhumana nethimba labameli bakhe izolo ekuseni.Ngokuka-Abrahams, abameli bakaZuma abazange babe nayo indlela yokuthi bangaphikisana nalesi sinqumo asesithathile.Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, * -Abrahams ubezinikezwe usuku lwangoLwesine njengelokugcina lokuthi aphothule ngalo lolu daba.NgoLwesithathu iCouncil for the Advancement of the South African Constitution (Casac), yehlulekile ukuvimba * -Abrahams enkantolo ukuthi angasithathi lesi sinqumo.Ibeke isizathu sokuthi akanawo amandla okukwenza lokho ngoba naye ulengelwa yifu elimnyama.Ngonyaka odlule iNkantolo ePhakeme yokuDluliswa kwamaCala, yasiqinisekisa isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu, sokuthi owayekade eyinhloko kaZwelonke yezokuShushiswa koMphakathi ngaleso sikhathi, * -Advocate Mokotedi Mpshe, wenza iphutha ngokwesula amacala enkohlakalo uZuma ayebhekene nawo.Amacala ayebhekene noZuma ahoxiswa ngemuva kokuthi kuvele ukuthi ukubekwa kwakhe amacala kwakunenhlese yezepolitiki.Kwavela ukuthi owayeyiNhloko yezokuShushiswa koMphakathi * -Adv Bulelani Ngcuka, nowayehola uphiko olwalubizwa ngoFezela, uMnuz Leornard McCarthy, babehlela ngasese itulo lokuba uZuma ashushiswe.Amacala ahoxiswa ngaphambi kokuthi afungiswe njengomengameli wezwe ngo-2009.

UMHOLI weNFP uNkk Zanele Magwaza-Msibi uziphendulele kumholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema othe kumele amiswe ekubeni yiPhini likaNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi nobuChwepheshe ngenxa yesimo sempilo emuva kokushaywa yisifo sohlangothi.UMalema ekhuluma emsakazweni ozinze eGoli, iPower FM noJJ Tabane ongumethuli wohlelo, uthe waze wakhuzwa ngamanye amalungu ale nhlangano ngesikhathi elibeka ngembaba elokuthi uNkk Magwaza-Msibi uholela into engekho ngoba isimo sakhe asisavumi ukuthi asebenze. UMalema uveze ukuthi abaholi abasebenza naye kuleli qembu bakhale ngokuthi ukhombisa ukungabi nazwelo esimeni esibhekene nomengameli weNFP.UNkk Magwaza-Msibi, obezifikele mathupha izolo emahhovisi eSolezwe, uziphendulele kokushiwo uMalema ngaye. Ekhuluma ngomlomo kaNobhala Jikelele weNFP uSolwazi Nhlanhla Khubisa, uthe inkinga yamaqembu aphikisayo anjenge-EFF wukuthi awazihluphi ngokubabuza bona njengeqembu kodwa avele akhulume nje.UNkk Magwaza-Msibi ubekhulunyelwa uKhubisa ngenxa yokuthi kusenzinyana ukukhuluma kuyena ngenxa yokugula.“UMagwaza-Msibi kuningi akwenzela umnyango njengePhini lezeSayensi nobuChwepheshe, ziningi izindawo azihambelayo esiza abafundi. Okunye okuhle ukuthi wakhethwa obengumengameli uJacob Zuma kanti noMengameli omusha uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa akazange asho lutho ngaye njengoba ekade ethula iKhabhinethi entsha,” kuchaza uKhubisa.Ngesikhathi kukhuluma uKhubisa, uNkk Magwaza-Msibi ubelokhu enqekuzisa ikhanda ekhombisa ukuthi uyavumelana nokushiwo unobhala wakhe.UNkk Magwaza-Msibi ubevakashele Isolezwe ngemuva kokuthi eqede umjikelezo wakhe wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota ngaphambi kokuthi kuvalwe izikhungo izolo ngo-5 ntambama.Izolo ukhombise obukhulu ubungcono, naye wakuqinisekisa lokho.

text: IZIDLELE amahlanga kumaSafta (South African Television and Film Awards) ifilimu Inxeba (The Wound), esanda kubuyiselwa emabhayisikobho ngemuva kokugxekwa ngeziqephu zocansi nokuveza izinto ezithathwa njengemfihlo yalabo abasuke beyosoka entabeni emaXhoseni.Le filimu iwole izindondo ezinhlanu emcimbini wokuhlonipha amaciko ngeqhaza lawo kwezokungcebeleka kuleli obuseSun City Superbowl, eNorth West, izolo.Lo mcimbi osakazwe bukhoma kuSABC2 izolo ebusuku, uthulwe ngosaziwayo uThando Thabethe noPhat Joe.Inxeba liwadlisele ogageni amanye amafilimu njengoba liqokwe njengefilimu evelele emunxeni iBest Feature Film. Umdidiyeli walo uJohn Trengove uwine indondo yokuba ngumdidiyeli ovelele kumunxa iBest Achievement in Directing-Feature Film.Iphinde yaphuma phambili kwiBest Achievement in Scriptwriting-Feature Film, lapho ekutuswe amagalelo kaJohn Trevonge, Malusi Bengu noThando Mgqolozana.Umlingisi oqavile wale filimu uNakhare odlala indawo kaXolani, uklonyeliswe ngendondo yokuba ngumlingisi wesilisa oqavile kumunxa iBest Actor-Feature Film.UBongile Mantsai odlala indawo kaVija uwine indondo yeBest Supporting Actor-Feature Film.Emikhomelweni yangoLwesihlanu uMatthew Swanepoel, uwine indondo kwiBest Editing-Feature Film.Izintokazi zaseMgungundlovu zibuye zihleka zodwa njengoba uJo-anne Reyneke odlala indawo kaThandi kwiBroken Vows ewine iBest Actress-TV Soap/Telenovela, kwathi uThuso Mbedu wawina iBest Actress-TV Drama ngokudlala indawo kaWinnie kumdlalo Is’thunzi.Abanye abawinile kubalwa:1.
