OWAYENGUMELULEKI wezezimali kaMnuz Jacob Zuma useveze ukuthi uzomhlinzela ezibini uZuma ngobufakazi obuqanda ikhanda abugodlile obuthinta amacala athweswe wona enkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa nokwehlisa imali ngomlenze. USchabir Shaik uthi ubephekwe ngobhojwana wuPhiko lwabaphenyi oKlebe abamjijimeze ngemikhonto yemibuzo eyishumi ngoZuma."Ngiphendule ngokukhulu ukwethembeka emibuzweni ebengiyihlonywa abaphenyi, emihlanu yale mibuzo imphenya izinqe uZuma. Phela ngangike ngasho vele ukuthi ngizofakaza uma ngicelwa, njengoba sengibiziwe nje akusekho ukwenza ngokunye," kusho uShaikUShaik kulindeleke ukuba abe ngufakazi oqavile uma seziyishuka imbodla kuZuma enkantolo.UShaik uke walahlwa amacala enkohlakalo ngo-2005 lapho okwavela khona ukuthi kunezimali ayezitamuza ngesikhathi kwenziwa isivumelawno sokuthengwa kwezikhali nenkampani iThint engaphansi kweThales.Nayo le nkampani ayisalanga ngaphandle njengoba izobe ihambisana noZuma uma seluqala ushikishi lwecala ngosuku olungakaziwa.Umthombo osondelene noShaik uthe lobu bufazi buzoqeda ngoZuma ngoba uShaik usadinwe wukuthi uZuma wambambisa amaqubu entenesha ethi uzomnika ushwele kamengameli ahlukane necala kodwa wangakwenza lokho.Uthe uShaik uphethe lonke ulwazi ngokwenzeka esivumelwaneni sokuthengwa kwezikhali.Nakuba wathi uZuma akalesabi ijele noma angaboshwa kodwa akucaci noma usengawaphinda amagama akhe njengoba sekungase kuye ngamagama enkehli.UZuma wayekhuluma emcimbini we-ANC eBilanyoni, eDumbe, ngoNovemba 2016, lapho watshela khona inqwaba yabantu ukuthi akafuni ukusatshiswa ngejele ngoba yinto engathi shu."Bafuna ukwesabisa i-ANC ngokuya ezinkantolo, asizukwesaba-ke thina ngisho ngingaboshwa namhlanje angilesabi ijele mina ngikwejwale ukuboshwa.“Ngadonsa ishumi leminyaka ejele, angilesabi ngiphuma khona lapho ungibona nje," kusho uZuma owayenanelwa wumsindo wabantu.Khona manjalo owayenguMqondisi woPhiko lwezokuShushiswa * -Adv Mokotedi Mpshe uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi isinqumo sakhe sango-2009 sokuhoxisa amacala kaZuma sashaya khona akazisoli ngaso.Uthe wayengekho ngaphansi kwengcindezi ngesikhathi enza lesi sinqumo namanje usakholwa wukuthi kwakufanele sibe njalo.

UKUBA wumama omatasa okudingeka alande izingane esikoleni, aziyise kwezemidlalo kwenze uNkk Nthati Mthembu asungule i-app ebizwa nge-Live Connected ezomkhumbuza konke okufanele akwenze.UNkk Mthembu ohlala eSandton, eGoli, ongungoti wezobuchwepheshe, uthe, i-app wayisungula ngo-2016 emuva kokubona ukuthi izingane zakhe sezidlala imidlalo ehlukene, udinga ukukhumbula ukuyozilanda.“Uma uwumama osebenzayo kuba nzima ukuhlela ukuthi izingane zakho ziya kanjani esikoleni, ikakhulukazi uma zibuye zidlale imidlalo ehlukene. Kwakulula ngesikhathi zisafunda enkulisa kodwa njengoba sezikhulile kufanele ngihlele umalume ozozilanda, ozoziyisa kwezemidlalo kanjalo aqiniseke ukuthi zibuyela endlini ziphephile,” kusho uNkk Mthembu.Uthe ngo-2016 uqale ukuyivivinya i-app yakhe ngokumema izihlobo ukuthi ziyisebenzise, wabona ukuthi izoxazulula izinkinga zabantu abaningi.“Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi ngishiye emsebenzini ngigxile ebhizinisi lokwakha leLive Connected App ngoba izosiza abantu. Ufike uyifake efonini yakho ene-android bese ufaka abantu oxhumana nabo ukuze bakwazi ukukhumbula konke odinga bakwenzele kona. Isibonelo uma sekuyisikhathi sokulanda ingane iLive Connected App izokhumbuza umalume noma ugogo ukuthi alande ingane esikoleni,” kusho uNkk Mthembu.Uthe unezingane ezimbili kanti iLive Connected App iyamsiza ukuxhumana nababheka izingane, ogogo nabashayeli.Uthe iyasiza nokuthi ubone umnyakazo wengane yakho ngoba umuntu omfake kule a-app kuyavela ukuthi usefikile esikoleni sengane, usekuphi.“Abazali babuye bakhathazeke ngokuphepha kwezingane zabo, le App izobasiza ukuthi bazi ukuthi zikuphi ngokuveza imininingwane yokuthi abazigadayo noma abazilandayo bakuphi. Uyakwazi ukumbona umuntu esuka aze ayofika lapho eya khona,” kusho uNkk Mthembu.Uthe okwamanje le App inabantu abangu-200 kodwa isibalo siyakhula usuku nosuku ngoba omama bafuna ukuhlela kahle usuku lwabo.“Uma ungathandi ukufonela abantu ngomzuzu wokugcina ngoba usukhohliwe ukulanda ingane esikoleni noma uvelelwe yinkinga ethile, iLive Connected izokusiza ukuxazulula lezo zinkinga.Wenza izinhlelo zakho ngesikhathi bese yona ikhumbuza bonke abantu odinga bakusize,” kusho uNkk Mthembu.

KUBONWA ngokusa esibhedlela kumfundi waseMangosuthu University of Technology, uSamkelo Ndlovu (17), okuthiwa ushaywe kanzima ozakwabo ngeSonto eledlule bemsola ngokuntshontsha isikhwama semali komunye wabafundi.Umndeni walo mfundi odabuka eHopewell, eMgungundlovu owenza unyaka wokuqala ezifundweni ze-Information Technology, bathi bafuna ubulungiswa kulolu daba. Uyise uMnuz Nkosinathi Ndlovu uyavutha ngokulimala kwendodana yakhe, uthi isono sayo kwaba ukutholisela ngesikhwama semali kwase kuthiwa isebile.Uthi kuthiwa wasithola isikhwama semali wamemezela efuna umnikazi, wavela wabonga kwaba kuhle kanti uzobuya nequlu labafundi sebezomshaya.Uthi indodana yakhe yashaywa yaze yakhumuliswa yanqunu yamodeliswa isikole sonke kuhlekiswa ngayo. Kuthiwa bamshaya baze bamthela ngensipho yokuwasha izitsha ebusweni bemxhopha ngayo bemkhomba ngesibhamu bemdinda nangomshiza.Uveze nokuthi kumanje indodana yakhe ilaliswe eKing Edward VIII emuva kokuba iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial ithe ayingangayo.“Thina simfice esibhedlela ePrince Mshiyeni esakwazi ukukhuluma washo ukuthi babemklinya ngentambo ye-laptop bethi uyena ohlala entshontsha izinto.“Umbuzo wami uthi, kwakungabizwa ngani amaphoyisa uma kunjalo kungani eshaywe kabi kangaka?’’ kusho uNdlovuUthe bakhathazekile ngoba udokotela uthe, lo mfundi unenkinga yezinso ezingasebenzi kahle ngenxa yokulimala kabi.Okhulumela isikhungo uMnuz Bheki Hlophe uthe isigameko asikabikwa kubona kodwa uma icala livuliwe, amaphoyisa azosebenzisana nophiko lwabo lwezokuvikela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthi kuvulwe icala lokuzama ukubulala emuva kokuthi umgilwa ehlaselwe ngumsolwa owaziwayo.

source: intsha ye anc ibopha uzille ngolwamanzi
text: UPHIKO lwentsha ye-ANC eWestern Cape lubopha uNdunankulu uHelen Zille wakhona ngokuhluleka ukuhambisana neminye imithetho yasesiShayamthetho mayelana nenkinga yamanzi.Esitatimendeni esifungelwe esibonwe yi-Independent Media, lolu phiko lwentsha olusesifundeni iDullah Omar, ngokolukhulumelayo uMnuz Winston Erasmus, lusola uNkk Zille ngokuhluleka ukuqoka ikhomishini yezemvelo njengokusho kwesigaba 71 sesiShayamthetho.Lesi sicelo esiphuthumayo sizolalelwa namhlanje yiNkantolo eNkulu eWestern Cape. Kumangalelwa uNkk Zille noSomlomo SharnaFernandez.Lolu phiko luthi isomiso esibhekene nesifundazwe sibhebhezelwe ukungaqokwa kwale khomishini.U-Erasmus uthe ukungaqokwa kwayo kuphambene noMthethosisekelo wesifundazwe.Uthe uSomlomo uhlulekile ukulawula izikhulu zikahulumeni njengoNkk Zille. Inhloso yesicelo sabo wukuphoqa uZille ukuthi asungule le khomishini.Okhulumela i-ANCYL esifundazweni uMnuz Muhammad Khalid Sayed uthe ukuba uZille wayisungula ikhomishini ngabe isimo samanzi asikho kuleli zinga esikulona manje.Kwenzeka lokhu nje umholi weDA uMmusi Maimane usanda kuveza ukuthi kungenzeka ukuphela kwamanzi nya eKapa kungenzeki.UZille nosomlomo abazange bayiphendule imibuzo abathunyelelwe yona ngomqhafazo kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.

source: uboshiwe owesilisa  obezivikela ngogebhezi lukanina owafihlwa ngo
text: AMAPHOYISA aseLimpompo asebophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-21 osolwa ngokumba ithuna likanina owafihlwa ngonyaka ka-2001, wakhipha ugebhezi lwakhe.Lo wesilisa wasesigodini saseDithabaneng, eGa-Mphahlele, uboshwe kuleli sonto ngemuva kokubikwa amalungu omphakathi asale eshaqekile ngemuva kokumbona ehamba nogebhezi. Kubikwa ukuthi lo wesilisa ubehamba nalolu gebhezi ngisho eya ezitolo noma ebhange, njengendlela 'yokuzivikela'.UColonel Moatshe Ngoepe uthe umsolwa wakhipha ugebhezi lukanina emathuneni nyakenye ngoDisemba."Amalungu omphakathi ambona ehamba endaweni ephethe ugebhezi lomuntu, axhumana namaphoyisa. Ngesikhathi efika amaphoyisa athola ugebhezi lomuntu endlini yomsolwa. Kwakugcwele namathambo enkomo," kusho uNgoepe."Ngaphezu kwalokho, sesitholile futhi ukuthi umsolwa ubephatha ugebhezi lukanina ngesikhwama uma eya ezitolo noma emabhange, ngoba ubekholelwa ukuthi luyamuvikela ezingozini," kuqhuba yena.Lo wesilisa uzovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eLebowakgomo ngecala lokucekela phansi ithuna maduze.- African News Agency/ANA

source: icishe yasha yaphela inxanxathela yezitolo olundi
text: UKUBE alifikanga iloli elicisha umlilo livela esikhumulweni iPrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Airport, ngabe ishe yangqongqa inxanxathela yezitolo Ulundi Plaza ngoba uMasipala wasoLundi awunalo iloli lokucisha umlilo omkhulu.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMenenja kaMasipala wasoLundi, uMntwana uNkosenye Zulu, engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe emuva kokusha kwezitolo ezinhlanu, ikhemisi nezindawo zokusebenzela odokotela ezintathu, oLundi Plaza, ngoLwesibili ntambama.UZulu uthe umlilo uqale esitolo sefenisha i-OK Furniture wase uthungeleka ekhemisi, wadlulela ezitolo zezimpahla nasendaweni kadokotela wamehlo, eyowamazinyo neyowezifo zonke (GP).“Imenenja yakwa-OK ithe umonakalo ubalelwa ngaphezu kuka-R2 million. Abanye abanikazi bezitolo bebesaqoqa impahla engashanga ngoba umlilo uqale kwa-OK kwase kuhanguleka ezinye izitolo. Sibuhlungu ngale nhlekelele evelile futhi sicela umhlonishwa uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube asilekelele sithole iloli lokucisha umlilo,” kusho uZulu.Uthe uma kunomlilo baye basebenzise iveni enethangi lamanzi ukuwucisha kodwa le veni ihlulekile wukucisha owayizolo.“Uma umlilo umkhulu siye sicele usizo kuMasipala waseZululand oneloli lokucisha umlilo elilodwa ukuzisa bonke omasipala abancane. NgoLwesibili, belisayoseviswa ngakho siye saxakeka. Kusize ukungenelela kweMeya yaseZululand, uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, osicelele iloli lasePrince Mangosuthu Buthelezi Airport ukuba lizosicishela. Ukube alifikanga ngabe kushe yonke into,” kusho uZulu.Uthe abakwazi ukuzithengela iloli labo lokucisha umlilo ngenxa yokuthi bathola imali encane kwisabelomali sikazwelonke futhi ababaningi abantu abakhokha ama-rates njengoba bengumasipala wasemakhaya.Imeya yasoLundi, uMnuz Mfana Ntshangase, ithe baphatheke kabi ngokusha kwenxanxathela yezitolo ngoba kulapho abantu basemawadini awu-24 asoLundi bethenga khona.“Siyathemba uphenyo luzocacisa ukuthi umlilo uqalwe yini ngoba kuyashaqisa ukusha kwezitolo. Siyacela abantu bakithi bazithibe bangayi ukuyocosha impahla eshile ngoba bangase bawelwe yisakhiwo njengoba sishile,” kusho uNtshangase.Imizamo yokuthola ukuphawula kwabakwa-OK Furnitures ayiphumelelanga ngoba abasekomkhulu labo bengathandanga ukuphawula ngokusha kwesitolo sabo esisoLundi.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bawutholile umbiko wokusha kwezitolo Olundi kodwa alikho icala elivuliwe futhi nembangela yomlilo ayakatholakali.UMnuz Lennox Mabaso, ophethe ezokuxhumana eMnyangweni kaNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe kusazophenywa ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani ukuthi uMasipala wasoLundi ungabi nezinhlelo zokucisha umlilo.“Umnyango usiza omasipala abawu-54 futhi abathengelwa bonke amaloli okucisha umlilo. Kufanele uMasipala wasoLundi uhlele ukuthi uzozibhekelela kanjani izinhlekelele zomlilo. Akufanele uthathe imali ungenzi lutho,” kusho uMabaso.

ISINQUMO sakamuva senhloko yeNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) uMnuz Shaun Abrahams sokuvusa amacala angu 16 abhekiswe kulowo obengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma sesisuse inkulumo mpikiswano.Phakathi kwemibuzo evukayo yilena: Kungani u-Abrahams ethathe lesi sinqumo? Kungani isinqumo esifana nalesi sithathwe uZuma esanda kushiya ekubeni ngumengameli wezwe? Sisho ukuthini lesi sinqumo?Ukuphendula umbuzo wokuqala, omunye uzothi u-Abrahams wenza ubulungiswa. Abanalombono bawubheka njengokhombisa ukuzimisela ngomsebenzi wakhe. Kimina zimbili izizathu ezenze u-Abrahams wathatha lesi sinqumo. Esokuqala yingcindezi akade ebhekene nayo esuka emaqenjini aphikisayo, amalungu e-ANC nezakhamuzi zezwe, nalabo abazimisele ngokubethela isipikili sokugcina kuZuma.Isizathu sesibili ukuthi kwayena u-Abrahams uhleli ngesinqe esisodwa njengoba isikhundla sakhe sizulelwa ngamanqe. Ngaleyo ndlela uzama ukuzivikela yena uqobo.Maqondana nombuzo wesibili kunabazothi kuqondene nokuthi ubufakazi okade bufunwa buvele ngesikhathi uZuma esezophuma esihlalweni kanti vele iNPA isizokhipha isinqumo sayo. Kungenzeka kube khona okubambekayo kulo mbono. Ngokubona kwami isizathu esimqoka ukuthi kunababona ukuthi njengoba uZuma engaseyena umengameli we-ANC nowezwe, amandla akhe asemancane. Okwesibili ukuthi abantu abaningi ababehambisana noZuma ngo 2007-2009 manje bacula elinye iculo. Okwesithathu, u-Abrahams nabanye bayamesaba uRamaphosa kanti futhi abanye bezama ukuthi abethembe.Umbuzo wesithathu yiwona engizogxila kuwo. Ukubuyiswa noma ukuvuswa kwalamacala kusho izinto eziningi. Phakathi kokunye singabala lokhu okulandelayo:-Ukusebenza ngokungenzeleli kwengalo yomthetho;-Ukukhombisa ukuthi ingalo yomthetho yinde;-Ukulalela izimvo zabantu;-Yimiphumela yokusebenza kwamaqembu aphikisayo ephalamende, ikakhulu i-DA;-Ukunikeza uMnu. Zuma ithuba lokuhlanza igama lakhe;-Ukucindezela uZuma nokumlulaza esizweni nakumazwe omhlaba;-Ukuqeda ukuqagela ngokuthi ingabe lezi zinsolo ziyiqiniso yini noma cha.Kuyiqiniso elingephikwe ukuthi zonke lezi zizathu zinakho okuphathekayo. Kodwa ngizozigoqa ngezimpendulo ezimbili. Eyokuqala ukuthi lokhu kusho injabulo kulabo okukade babefuna ukuthi uZuma ashushiswe, hhayi ngoba befuna kwenzeke ubulungiswa kodwa ukuze kufezeke izinhloso zabo zepolitiki. Okwesibili, lokhu kusho ukudumala nokucasuka kulabo abezwelana noZuma obelokhu elandelwe ngabezindaba.Kulabo abajabulayo, kungenzeka ukuthi basheshe bahleka kwasho ingoma kaDonny. Amalungiselelo alokhu kushushiswa azothatha isikhathi eside. Kwalona icala liyodonsa iminyaka.Kulabo abahambisana noZuma, sekucacile ukuthi ukugwema inkantolo ngalolu daba akusekho. Kodwa-ke lokho akusho ukuthi impi iphelile. Eqinisweni uZuma udinga uxhaso kakhulu manje kunango 2007-2009 ngoba usephendukelwe ngisho ngamanye amalungu eqembu lakhe - osomathuba!Mangigcine ngokusho ukuthi ubulungiswa ekuqulweni kwaleli cala yikhona okuzosho ukuthi isimo siyazinza yini ezweni noma kusuka uthuli lwezichwe. Ngamafuphi, ijaji elizosingatha lolu daba kanye nabasizi balo kuzodingeka kube ngabantu abawazi kahle umsebenzi wabo nabangathengeki kalula. Ofakazi kuzodingeka kube ngabantu abayaziyo into abayikhulumayo. Kuyoba kuhle uma kwenziwa ubulungiswa ngaleli cala. Kodwa uma kudlalwa ipolitiki, kuyoba yihlazo kubona bonke abathintekayo kuloludaba.*USolwazi Bheki R. Mngomezulu usophikweni lwezifundo zepolitiki e-University of Western Cape.

AYIFUNI nokuyizwa indaba yesonto likayise indodana yomholi wesonto laseMzimkhulu okwahlubuka kulo isonto lase-Eastern Cape, iMancoba Seven Angels Church.UMnuz Msizi Jali uyindodana kaMnuz Ndumiso Jali oke wabambisana noMnuz Siphiwo Mancoba ongumsuguli weCrusade Church. Amadodana kaMancoba ahlubuka kuleli sonto ngemuva kokushona kukayise asungula iMancoba Seven Angels ngo-2015.UJali, othi naye ubengasakwazi ukungena emzini kayise ngemuva kokushiya leli sonto ayesesonte kulo iminyaka eyishumi, uthe bese kunesikhathi engakwazi ukuya kubo. Uthe ubegcina ngokukhuluma noyise ecingweni.“Ngayeka ukufunda kwaGrade 8 ngesikhathi ngisuka kumama sengizohlala nobaba. Ngatshelwa ukuthi inqubo yesonto ayikuvumeli ukuthi sifunde ngoba kunomoya kaSathane ezikoleni. Ngahlala njengoba kwakushiwo. Zaziziningi izingane ezazisesigabeni sokufunda ezazingafundi njengami. Kwakunezinto engangingazizwa kahle njengako ukuthi awuvumelekile ukukhuluma ngenkonzo yethu. Uma ubingelela umuntu awumbuzi impilo nokuthi uyilungu lesonto akabe esahlangana nomndeni wakhe. Ngake ngakhuluma nentsha eyayingangami sibona sengathi amalungelo ethu acindezelekile ngoba ngeke sisebenze imisebenzi ecacile ngoba asifundile. Bonke babebona njengami kodwa bengakaze baphile enye impilo besaba ukuphuma esontweni. Nganquma ukushiya kuleli sonto ngalibangisa eKapa ngiyozama impilo,” kusho yena.Uthe wayazi ukuthi ukuphuma kwakhe kwakusho ukuthi akasakwazi ukuxhumana noyise. Yingakho bekunzima ukuthi avakashe yize uyise engazange asho ukuthi akangamvakasheli.Eseshonile uyise uthe wakhuluma namalungu omndeni wawatshela ukuthi uyise uzongcwatshwa ngendlela ejwayelekile okungcwatshwa ngayo abantu.“Amalungu esonto awazange ayizwe kahle into engangiyisho ngoba ayelindele ukuthi ubaba angcwatshwe emathuneni ethengwayo futhi angcwatshwe amalungu ebandla ambalwa. Iningi lawo lakhombisa ukungahambisani nengangikusho. Ngabacacisela ukuthi kuzoba khona namalungu omndeni azohlanganyela nathi. Sacela ukuthi basidedele sizile ngendlela esiyaziyo. Kwaba ukuhamba kwabo,” kusho uJali.Uthe kuningi okumphatha kabi okukhulunywa ngabantu ngesonto likayise abathi likhonza enkolweni kaSathane.“Ngesikhathi ngisasonta kulo bekuthiwa uSathane ungaphandle. Thina sikhonza uNkulunkulu. Angazi ukuthi yiliphi iBhayibheli elalifundwa ngoba iBhayibheli lalifundwa uMancoba kuphela. Iningi lezingane lalingakwazi ukufunda,” kusho uJali.Uqhube wathi zonke izinsuku uthunyelelwa izithombe ezisabekayo ezisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa ngezendlu yakubo emise okwenyoka. Kushiwo nezinto ezisabekayo okuthiwa ziyenzeka kuyo.“Engikwaziyo wukuthi abebesonta kuleli sonto bebenziwa ukuthi bakholwe yilokho okushiwo kulo futhi akekho obeke akhulume ngokwenzeka kulo. Angazi noma leyo ndlela iyona yini okukhonzwa ngayo uSathane. Angazi ukuthi yini le ebiyenza ukuthi abantu bakholwe yilokhu ebebetshelwa kona yize abanye babo befundile,” kusho uJali.Uthe ngeke alivule isonto uzoqhubeka nebhizinisi likayise lokudayisa amabloksi.

UMENGAMELI we-IFP, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uxwayisa uhulumeni we-ANC ngokuthi kumele uluphathise okwezikhali zamaNtungwa udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ukugwema ukuthi izwe lingagcini selifana neZimbabwe.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha uSuku lwamaLungelo aBantu eKing Zwelithini Stadium eMlaza izolo, uButhelezi uthe udaba lomhlaba lujulile akumele lusingathwe noma yikanjani.“Ngikhuluma nje abantu baseZimbabwe bagcwele lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngoba bebalekela ukuhlupheka okukhona ezweni labo kusukela kwathathwa umhlaba kwabamhlophe.Nathi vele siyazihluphekela njengoba iningi lisaphila ngaphansi kwendlala. Umbuzo wami uthi sifuna ukuhlupheka phezu kwalokho esinakho?” Kubuza uButhelezi.Uthe umnotho waseZimbabwe ubuqinile ulandela owaseNingizimu Afrika kodwa manje usudonsa kanzima.“Obengumengameli waseZimbabwe, uMnuz Robert Mugabe ulibulele izwe lakhe ngokusingatha budlabha udaba lokuthathwa komhlaba. Kuhle ngoba leli zwe lingomakhelwane bethu. Kumele ngabe kukhona esikufundile khona,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe bayamuzwa uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ethi umhlaba uzothathwa kodwa kumele kwenziwe isiqiniseko sokuthi umkhiqizo wokudla awuphazamiseki.“Sithule silindele ukubona ukuthi kuzokwenzakani,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe i-IFP ayikanqumi ukuthi imi kuphi odabeni lokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo.Njengoba uqina umkhankaso we-ANC wokuthi kubuyiswe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, sekukhona amazwe asentshonalanga asesabise ngokuthi azolinswinywa leli uma like lawuqhuba lo mkhankaso.Uphinde waxwayiswa ngesiphakamiso sokuthi kufakwe izimayini nokunye ngaphansi kukahulumeni.“Thina sikhulele khona kwi-ANC. Into ebikhulunywa wukuthi kufakwe izinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Nami ngaze ngahamba ngayohlangana nowayengumengameli waseTanzania ongasekho, uMnuz Julius Nyerere okunguye owayethathwa njengobaba wase-Afrika, ephusha indaba yokufakwa kwezinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Yena futhi uNyerere wabuye washintsha wasixwayisa ngokuthi udaba lokufaka izinto ngaphansi kukahulumeni lulibulele izwe lakhe,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe ngesikhathi umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema efike kuyena ezoxolisa ngemuva kokumdelela, wamxwayisa ngodaba lokufakwa kwezimayini ngaphansi kukahulumeni.“Kuyabokalala ukuthi uMalema akazange angilalele njengoba esaqhubeka nalolu daba. Kodwa isisho sesiZulu siyasho ukuthi isalakutshelwa sibona ngomopho,” kusho uButhelezi.Uphinde wasola uMalema ngokukhomba ngomunwe isihlalo seSilo Samabandla uGoodwill Zwelithini, ngokuthi athi akuthathwe kungaphansi kwaso.Uthe inkulumo kaMalema ethi iSilo akumele sisatshwe kodwa kumele sihlonishwe, ayizange yehle kahle.“Kade kwasa ngithukwa ngodaba lomhlaba. Ukuba izinhlamba ziyahlala ebusweni ngabe angisabonakali,” kusho uButhelezi. Wengeze ngokuthi wathatha isinqumo sokuthi achibiyele umthetho iNgonyama Trust ngo-1994 ngoba wayefuna ukuvikela amanenjana omhlaba ayesesele kowase uthathwe ngabamhlophe.UButhelezi uphinde wakhala ngokuthi yize leli selibe ngaphansi kwentando yeningi iminyaka engu-24 kodwa iningi labantu lisaphila ngaphansi kobubha.Uthe isikhumbuzo somgubho wamalungelo abasikhumbuli ngokuzila kodwa ngokuqinisekisa ekuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu.

USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waKwaSwayimane ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu emuva kwesigameko lapho isoka kuthiwa lifike erenki langqokloza intombi yalo ngesibhamu liyisola ngokujola nomunye usomatekisi.Kuthiwa uNksz Khule Buthelezi (24), osebenza kwesinye isitolo sokudla kule renki, izolo udutshulwe yisoka lakhe anengane nalo, okuthiwa bahilizisane nalo kwathi uma ebaleka lamdubula esiphundu.Kuvele ukuthi isoka liyimenenja erenki yaKwaSwayimane eseWartburg.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ozibonele ukuthi akekho obengasondela kumsolwa ngoba isibhamu ubesiphethe ngesandla elokhu ekhuluma.Kuthiwa ubelokhu eseduze kwesidumbu esinyakazisa ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umbulele umufi.Ngaphambi kokuba adubule intombi kuthiwa uqale wajaha usomatekisi osekhulile amsola ngokujola nonina wengane. Kuthiwa usomatekisi ubalekile emva kwalokho umsolwa wabuyela kumufi wamdubula.Isolezwe lithole ngomunye umthombo ukuthi isimo bese simuncu erenki. Kuthiwa umsolwa ushiye umufi wathi usayobheka usomatekisi ukuze aqede ngaye bese eyozinikela emaphoyiseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko wathi amaphoyisa aKwaSwayimane avule icala lokubulala.“Umsolwa oneminyaka engu-29 uboshelwe icala lokubulala nokutholwa ephethe isibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Uzovela enkantolo yaseNew Hanover kusasa (namhlanje) ngecala lesibhamu aphinde avele ngoLwesine ngelokubulala enkantolo efanayo,” kusho uZwane.Isolezwe lithinte umndeni kamufi, owesifazane ongazidalulanga igama uthe abekho abadala abangakwazi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba.Isolezwe lithole nokuthi bese kunesikhathi umufi ethandana nesoka. Umsolwa kuthiwa ukhulele erenki ngoba waqala ewasha izimoto, waba wumsizi wabashayeli njengoba bese ebheke umsebenzi. Kuthiwa ubelokhu ememeza ethi usomatekisi ojola nentombi yakhe umthathele ngoba enemali enamatekisi.

BASABISA ngokuwuvala thaqa uMlaza osomabhizinisi abaqonqa udoti kuleli lokishi abasola uMasipala weTheku ngokungabakhokheli.Osomabhizinisi abangosonkontileka baseMlaza abaqoqa udoti abavale umgwaqo ngodoti izolo bathi kusekuncane lokhu abakwenzile. Bathe uma umasipala ungahlangani nabo, ubakhokhele imali yabo basazoqhubeka nokuvala umgwaqo nanganoma yisiphi isikhathi kuleli lokishi. Lezi zinkampani aziwulandanga udoti futhi zathi ngeke ziwulande.Omunye wosomabhizinisi abangosonkontileka abaqoqa udoti, uMnuz Nathi Sibalukhulu, uthe kusazoba nzima kubantu baseMlaza uma kuqhubeka ukuthi bangakhokhelwa.Uthe bonke bebengakhokhelwe ngoFebhuwari kanti abanye abakhokhelwanga ngoJanuwari nangoDisemba.“Kuqale ngokuthi kube khona osonkontileka abangakhokhelwanga ngoDisemba. Sibe sesiqala silukhuluma lolo daba. Sithe sisematasa nalo kwase kubakhona abangakhokhelwa ngoJanuwari. Kuthe ngenyanga edlule umasipala wavele waqopha umlando wangasikhokhela sonke. Sihlalile salinda sizitshela ukuthi lesi simo sizolunga kodwa kwangenzeka. Sesicele kaningi ukuhlangana nomasipala kodwa kwangenzeka. NgoMsombuluko besisemahhovisi kamasipala ngoba bekuhlelwe umhlangano kodwa saze sahamba singanakwanga muntu,” kusho uSibalukhulu.Uthe bazovimba yonke into ehambayo kuleli lokishi kuze kube umasipala uhlangana nabo ukhokhe nemali obakweleta yona.Kwanamuhla (izolo) sizobavimbela abazobe bebuya emakhaya bese siqhubeka nokuvala umgwaqo. Kubuhlungu kithi ngoba njengoba singakhokhelwe asikwazi ukukhokhela abasebenzi bethu abaphinde babe ngomakhelwane bethu. Njengoba bengakhokheliwe kusho ukuthi imindeni yabo ayidlile nathi asikwazi ukukhokhela izimoto esisebenza ngazo,” kuqhuba uSibalukhulu.Ukuvalwa komgwaqo kushiye amalungu omphakathi engeneme njengoba abantu bekhale ngokuthi baphazamisekile ezinhlelweni zabo.UMnuz Thulasizwe Gumede (57) oyilungu lomphakathi, uthe bavuke umgwaqo uvalwe ngodoti. Uthe abantu abakwazanga ukuhamba ngoba amatekisi abengahambi kahle.Usole labo abebebhikisha ngokungawucabangeli umphakathi.“Kungcono ukube bebeyobhikisha emahhovisi abaphathi babo labo abangabaholele. Bangaphazamisi umphakathi ngoba lokhu kufana nokuthi bahlukumeza wona,” kusho uGumede.Omunye wosomabhizinisi abadayisa izithelo nenyama, uMnuz Sipho Mbhele, uthe uze waqala emuva kwesikhathi ukusebenza ngoba uthathe isikhathi eside eyothenga impahla ayidayisayo. Uthe namakhasimende abengemaningi njengokujwayelekile izolo ngoba abantu abaphumanga. Uthe bafisa sengathi ingalungiswa le nkinga.Uphiko olubhekele ukuqoqwa kwadoti kuMasipala weTheku luxolisile kubahlali baseMlaza ngokungalandwa kukadoti.“Umasipala unxusa amalungu omphakathi ukuthi agcine udoti emakhaya ukuze kugwemeke ukusabalala kokungcola. Umphakathi uzokwaziswa uma sekuqalile ukuqoqwa kukadoti. Umasipala usebenza kanzima ukulungisa lesi simo. Siyaxolisa ngokuhlukumezeka komphakathi ngokungalandwa kukadoti,” kusho lolu phiko.

UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), uMnuz Julius Malema, ugxeke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuseka i-ANC yize bengayethembi ukuthi ingabavikela ezintweni ezibathwalisa ubunzima nsuku zonke.Ethula umkhankaso wayo wokhetho eGoli izolo, uMalema uthe kubhekwe ukuthi ukhetho lwangonyaka ozayo lube nezinga eliphezulu lokuncintisana selokhu kwaba nokhetho lwentando yabantu ngo-1994.UMalema utshele amalungu e-EFF, eStandard Bank Arena, eGoli, ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baseka i-ANC kodwa bese bethembela kwi-EFF ukuthi ixazulule izinkinga zabo zansuku zonke.“Njalo uma abantu beshaywa ngabelungu batshela i-EFF kutwitter kodwa uma beyovota, bavotela i-ANC.”Uthe i-EFF iyona egcwele abantu abamnyama selokhu yasungulwa eminyakeni emihlanu edlule.“Asikho esinye isixazululo ngaphandle kwe-EFF. Kufanele nivotele i-EFF.”Kule nyanga i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) izobhalisa abantu ukulungiselela ukhetho lwangonyaka ozayo.UMalema uthe izifundiswa ezimnyama ziyazitshwa uma kufanele zikhushulelwe izikhundla ezinkampanini ezizimele kodwa abamhlophe bayavunwa.“Odadewethu abamnyama baholelwa kancane uma kuqhathaniswa nezintokazi ezimhlophe. Odadewethu kabakhushulelwa izikhundla kodwa abamhlophe bakhushulelwa izikhunndla njalo emuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu. Abamnyama basebenza iminyaka emihlanu bengakhushulelwa izikhundla.” kusho uMalema.I-EFF inhlangano yesithathu ngobukhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ilandela i-ANC ne-DA .Abantu abangakubhaliselanga ukuvotela iqembu lakhe bayizigebengu. “Sithi bonke abantu emagatsheni e-EFF ezweni ababhalisele ukuvota. Uma ungabhalisile kusho ukuthi uyisigebengu. NgoMashi 10 no-11 wonke umuntu kufanele ayobhalisa ikheli lalapho ehlala khona.”Kulabo abangahambisani nokuqedwa kweNgonyama Trust ephethe umhlaba weSilo, uMalema uthe abalwesabi udlame uma abantu befuna ukuluqala ngoba bethi bavikela Ingonyama Trust.“Kungani umbuso wamaZulu kufanele uphathwe ngendlela ehlukile kuneminye, izwe libe liphethwe ngentando yabantu? Kungani kufanele sisabe uma kukhuluma wona? Sibuswa ngentando yabantu, akekho umuntu okufanele asisabise ngodlame. Labo abasisabisa ngodlame bayakhombisa ukuthi abacabangi kodwa-ke asilusabi udlame,” kusho uMalema.Ngo-2016 i-EFF yathola u-8% wamavoti kanti iyona eyaba nomthelela omkhulu komasipala okwakungawinanga amaqembu amakhulu kuwo. Yasebenzisana ne-DA komasipala abakhulu okubalwa kubo iTshwane, Johannesburg neNelson Mandela Bay lapho kwakhishwa khona i-ANC.“Sizoyikhipha iDA kuMasipala waseNelson Mandela Bay ngoba ayivotanga odabeni lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Abantu bethu bafuna umhlaba.”Uthe ngeke bavote ne-ANC uma ingafuni ukufaka owayenguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Mcebisi Jonas, kwesobuMeya eNelson Mandela Bay.“Uma i-ANC iza nomuntu ongafanele ngeke sivote kusho ukuthi uTrollip uzoqhubeka nokuba yiMeya. Akukho okusiphoqayo ukuthi sivote neDA noma ne-ANC. Siseka uJonas ngoba uyindoda engagwazeleki ngoba wanqaba * -R600 000 000 ayewuthenjiswa ngabakwaGupta. Sifuna umuntu ongenagcobho,” kusho uMalema.

ZIYIHAMBELA kahle izinto ingqwele yomhlaba kwi-800m yabesifazane, uCaster Semenya, othole iziqu zakhe kuleli sonto emkhakheni weSports Science eNorth West University.USemenya uveze lezi zindaba ekhasini lakhe le-instagram ngoLwesibili, efaka isithombe sakhe egqoke ijazi lezifundiswa enze uphawu lokucijisa izandla phezu kwamahlombe ajwayele ukulwenza ngemuva kokunqoba imijaho.Lena kubukeka kuyinyanga ezomphatha kahle uSemenya. Ngempelasonto edlule wephule irekhodi leminyaka engu-35 kwi-1000m.Le mpelasonto kungenzeka iphele esasigcinile isicoco sakhe sakuleli kwi-800m nakwi-1500m njengoba kuqhubeka imidlalo ye-ASA National Championship eTuks Stadium, ePitoli.USemenya ufudukele eNorth West ngo-2015 ngemuva kokuhlukana nowayengumqeqeshi wakhe uMaria Mutola. Ngokusho kwale ntokazi yaseLimpopo, lesi kwakuyisiqalo “esisha empilweni” ngemuva kwesigameko sika-2009 lapho yayisolwa ngokuthi ayikufanele ukugijima nabesifazane ngenxa yendlela edaleke ngayo.“Le ndawo ithule. Akukho okuningi ongakwenza kuyona ngaphandle kokujima, ukudla, ukulala nesikole. Ngifunda iSports Science ngoba ngathatha ikhefu ngemuva kuka-2009 ukuze ngilungise impilo yami,” kusho uSemenya kweminye imithombo yabezindaba.Kusukela lapho lo mgijimi akabange esabheka emuva enqoba igolide kuma-Olympic ngo-2016 kwi-800m. Unyaka wonke odlule akekho omehlulile kuleli banga edla ubhedu kwi-IAAF Diamond League nakwi-IAAF World Championship, nethusi kwi-1500m.Kulo nyaka kubhekwe ukuthi aqhubeke nokuphakamisa ifulegi lakuleli kumaCommonwealth Games aseGold Coast, e-Australia ngo-Ephreli. Nyakenye * -Akani Simbine oyibamba kwi-100m ugcine ezitholile iziqu zakhe ze-Information Science e-University of Pretoria ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu ezenza.

KUQINISWE ezokuphepha zePhini likaMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Allen Thompson, osinde ngokulambisa edutshulwa abesilisa abebehlomile, abashaqe zonke izikhwama zakhe zama-laptop ebezinemiqingo ebalulekile eminye okungeyophenyo oluqhubekayo oluthinta uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal.UThompson ujahwe waze wafika esibhedlela yiBMW emhlophe ebihamba abesilisa abebezifihle ubuso befake nama-gloves ngoLwesihlanu ntambama eMhlanga, eThekwini.UMengameli weNatu uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo, uthe baziqinisile ezokuphepha zikaThompson.“Ethanda noma engathandi ngisithathile isinqumo sokuthi ngiqinise ezokuphepha kwakhe. Uma kunje kudingeka ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi uphephile. Yitulo ebelihleliwe leli, asingabazi ngalokho siyiNatu,” kusho uNgcobo.UNgcobo uthe i-video yasesibhedlela ikuveza konke okwenzeka bemjaha bemfaka ngaphakathi, baphuma bashaqa izikhwama emotweni yakhe.“Inhlamvu ibiya ekhanda ngoba ingene maqondana nalo. Sifuna amaphoyisa abambe abenzi bobubi, bagwetshwe. Ngeke sivume ukusatshiswa noma sithuliswe, sizoqhubeka nokulwa ukuze kuphele inkohlakalo,” kusho uNgcobo.Usho lokhu nje le nyunyana iseqhulwini lokufuna ukuthi umnyango wezemfundo esifundazweni ufakwe ngaphansi kokulawulwa ngumnyango wezemfundo kuzwelonke.Le nyunyana yakhala ngokunyuka kwemali eyabelwe uhlelo lwamaqakelo abafundi oseludle uR109 million lusuka kuR20 million onyakeni owodwa.Ingena ingenile imiyalezo yokukufisela ukululama kukaThompson njengoba i-ANC, IFP, NFP kanjalo neSadtu zithi zifuna amaphoyisa aphenye ngalesi sehlakalo.UMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu, uSihlalo wekomiti lesikhashana le-ANC esifundazweni, uphawule ngokuthi kule mpelasonto kube nezehlakalo zokudutshulwa kwabaholi okubalwa naye uThompson.USihlalo weNFP esifundazweni, uMnuz Vikizitha Mlotshwa, uthe bakhathazekile ngalesi sehlakalo wathi kuyacaca ukuthi yinto ebihleliwe.“Yinto ebihleliwe lena, yingakho sithi akube nophenyo olunzulu ngoba kuthathwe nemiqingo ebalulekile emotweni ethinta nendaba yenkohlakalo yamaqakelo abafundi nokungakhokhelwa kothisha bakwaGrade R,” kusho uMlotshwa.Uthe bafuna uNdunankulu amukele isicelo saleli qembu sokuthi kungenelele iSilo odabeni lokubulawa kwabaholi.UNkk Thembeni Madlopha-Mthethwa omele i-IFP kwezemfundo esiShayamthetho, uthe kumele kusheshiswe uphenyo ukuze kutholakale abathinteka kulesi sehlakalo.Uthe kushiya imibuzo eminingi ukudutshulwa kukaThompson njengoba ebeyingxenye yemashi ebisesiShayamthetho yokukhalaza ngezinkinga ezibhekene nomnyango futhi usekhaleni lokuthi umnyango ufakwe ngaphansi komlawuli.UNobhala jikelele weSadtu uMnuz Mugwena Maluleke, usigxekile lesi senzo wathi amaphoyisa kumele aphenye abambe abenzi bobubi.“Noma engelona ilungu lethu kodwa unathi emzabalazweni wokulwela othisha. INatu neSadtu ibhikishe ngaphandle kwesiShayamthetho bekhala ngothisha bakwaGrade R. Simfisela ukululama okusheshsayo.”Okhulumela amaphoyisa uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuphenywa icala lokubamba inkunzi nelokuzama ukubulala, akukaboshwa muntu.

source: ezothando ngashada ngenqubo yesonto umyeni wami akangigculisi
text: UMBUZO: Ngishade ngo-2015 nomyeni wami ngenqubo yasesontweni yokuthi akujolwa futhi asibonani size sishade. Iqiniso lithi angazi ngaluthwa yini kulo muntu. Akasiyo nhlobo le nto engangiyifisa empilweni yami. Akanakho nokukodwa nje okungijabulisayo.Lokhu ngaqala ukukuzwa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa nje sishadile, ngabekezela ngoba ngithi mhlambe asikazani kahle. Kodwa kuyangicacela manje ukuthi akusilo ubambo lwami lolu, ngehluleka ngisho ukuzenzisa. Manje useGoli ngokusebenza, uma efikile ngifisa ngabe usehambile. Okubi nje sesinomntwana. Ngifisa ngisho ukuduka nezwe kunokuba kulo mshado kodwa uma ngicabanga ngomntwana wethu ngivele ngihlale. Ngicela ningisize.Igama ligodliwe, eThekwiniIMPENDULO:Uma ushada nomuntu, noma ngabe kungaluphi uhlelo, nishada nobabili senikhulile, ninesipiliyoni sempilo ngokwehlukile. Abekho ababili abashada bese bayanamathelana ngokushesha. Kuthatha isikhathi ukunamathela koshade naye.Akekho noyedwa oshadile, oshade ubambo lwakhe. Sonke njengabashadile sifunda ukunamathela omunye komunye nsuku zonke.Uthando akuyona imizwa kodwa ukuthatha isinqumo nsuku zonke ukuthi uzozinikela ngenhliziyo yakho yonke kulo omganile.Bheka ukuthi yini ngempela ongayithandi ngomyeni wakho, bese nihlala phansi nikhulume. Siqinisekile ukuthi kukhona naye angakuthandi ngawe, ngoba sonke njengabantu asimsulwa.Ukuhlala nomuntu nithandane nize nihlukaniswe ukufa isinqumo ozithathela sona wena wedwa kuqala. Uthatha lesi sinqumo wethembise ukuthi uzomthanda lo oshade naye ngaphandle kokunaka amaphutha akhe. Usuke unquma ukuthi ubudlelwano benu bomshado buyobuswa yintethelelo, ukuthula nokwethembana. Ukuthanda umuntu akuzenzekeli, kuyasetshenzwa.UMBUZO:Sesineminyaka cishe ewu-9 sashada. Ngagana indoda emadodeni, sabusiswa nangezingane ezimbili. Akakaze angihluphe ngalutho. Uyena kuphela osebenzayo, njengoba savumelana ukuthi mina nginakekele izingane nomuzi wethu. Wenza konke engicabanga ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe yindoda.Inkinga nje ukuthi nginesizungu emshadweni wami. Ngazinikela kuye nakulo mshado ngale ndlela yokuthi yonke impilo yami ingomyeni nabantwana bami. Anginampilo ngaphandle kwabo. Akukho engingakwenzi ukujabulisa wonke umuntu la ekhaya. Kodwa mina angisenawo awami amaphupho, futhi loku kungiphatha kabi. Ngicela ningisize.Londiwe, eThekwiniIMPENDULO:Akuve kulula ukuzibona usugwinywe umshado unganakile. Loku kwenzeka kakhulu kubantu besifazane ngoba bangabantu abazinikelayo sidalo. Kuyinto enhle ukuthi uyayibona le nkinga kusemanje.Kufanele uzinikele umshadweni wakho ngokuphelele kodwa ungazikhohlwa phela nawe. Qala ngokuthi kube nelanga nje elilodwa lakho esontweni lapho wenza khona noma yini oyithandayo eqondene nawe. Kungaba ukuyozivocavoca noma ukuya ekhaya kini uyobonana nabakini owaziyo ukuthi bayakuthanda. Zijwayeze ukuba nesikhathi esithi wena. Uma wawunabangani ngaphambi kokushada qala uvuselele lobo bungani. Kuyingozi enkulu ukulahlekelwa impilo yakho usesemshadweni ngezinhloso zokujabulisa umyeni wakho.Hlala phansi uvuselele konke okwakuyiphupho lakho. Kungaba ukuqhubeka nezifundo, ukuqala ibhizinisi noma ukubuyela emsebenzini nje. Cabangisisa nokuthi, njengoba ungasasebenzi nje, wawuyingxenye engakanani ekuthatheni leso sinqumo? Hlala phansi nomyeni wakho umtshele inkinga obhekene nayo.UMBUZO:Ngineminyaka ewu-38, ngiganwe unkosikazi ona-27 weminyaka. Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule uqale ukusabisa ngokushiya phansi umshado wethu ngenxa yobudoda bami obungasenamandla. Akukho engingakwenzi ekhaya njengendoda, inkinga yinye nje kuphela, ile yobudoda bami. Sengiyizame yonke imishanguzo nezimbiza ezivusa umlilo kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Kwala ngisho sengimthengela imoto kanokusho ukuzama ukumehlisa umoya kodwa lutho akulungi. Umshado wami usengcupheni. Ngenzenjani?IMPENDULO:Siyazwelana nawe mfowethu. Akulona iphutha lakho ngempela kodwa kumele umzwele noma kunjalo unkosikazi wakho. Kuthatha umuntu oqotho ukuhlala emshadweni ongenalo ucansi, okanye omunye engagculisekile khona ngokocansi. Kona kuyahlaleka, akuyona into engaze inenze nehlukane. Okubalulekile ukuthi nifunde nibe nezinye izindlela zokuzijabulisa.Xhumana nathi ku:Facebook: Mo&PhindiInsta: Mo_PhindiEmail:[email protected]

IKHUNJULWE njengeqhawe inkakha yomthwebuli waseNingizimu Afrika, uMnuz Sam Nzima, oshone ngoMgqibelo. Igama likaNzima laduma umhlaba wonke ngemuva kwesithombe asithatha sikaHector Pieterson ngoJuni 16, ka-1976, ngesikhathi abafundi bakuleli bebhikishela ukuthi kuqedwe umthetho wokufundiswa kwesibhunu kuleli.Lesi sithombe indlela esaduma ngayo saze sangena ohlwini lwezithombe eziwu-100 ezaguqula umlando ephephabhukwini elihlonishwayo emhlabeni lase-United States, iTime Magazine. Noma sakhombisa isithombe esiyiso ngokwakwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika ngaleso sikhathi, uNzima wazidonsela amanzi ngomsele ngaso. Wadingiswa endaweni ayehlala kuyo eSoweto, wabuyela eLilydale eMpumalanga waphinde wanqatshelwa ukuthi aqhubeke nokuthathe izithombe. Amaphoyisa kahulumeni wobandlululo amsola ngokuveza isithombe esibi ngeNingizimu Afrika.Phakathi kwabadlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kaNzima kubalwa noMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa otuse amagalelo akhe ngezikhathi zomzabalazo.“Akekho oyophinde afane noMnuz Sam Nzima. Wathwebula izithombe eziziveza ubuhlungu abantu ababebhekene nabo ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Wabamba iqhaza ngokuphikisa imithetho yobandllululo kwaze kwaba yisikhathi semibhikisho yabafundi eSoweto. Siyosikhumbula njalo isithombe sakhe sikaHector Peterson esaba wuphawu lokulwa nempoqo yokufundiswa kwesibhunu ezikoleni zabansundu,” kusho uRamaphosa esitatimendeni.

ASABISA ngokuya enkantolo amalungu e-ANC KwaZulu-Natal angahambisani nokuthi kuhlale izingqungquthela zezifunda neyesifundazwe.Esithangamini nabezindaba eMargate Hotel ngasePort Shepstone izolo, uMnuz Howard Msomi ongunobhala kwisifunda esincane se-ANC eMzumbe, uthe bazoyilandela yonke imigudu yangaphakathi enhlanganweni lapho bezobe bezwakalisa izikhalo zabo ngokuhlala kwezingqungquthela kodwa uma bengakutholi ukujabula bazophoqeleka ukuthi baye enkantolo.UMsomi uthe kunezifunda ezine iLower South Coast, Moses Mabhida, Harry Gwala nabaQulusi ezinezinkinga okungamele izingqungquthela kuzo ziqhubeke.“Thina sithi izingqungquthela akumele zihlale ngoba isimo esikhona ezifundeni asikho kahle, sifuna kuxazululwe zonke izinkinga ezikhona ngaphambi kokuthi kuhlale izingqungquthela,” kusho uMsomi.Uthe banezikhalo ezaziwayo asebezidlulisile zokunqatshelwa kwamaqabane ubulungu benhlangano nokukhishwa kwamanye amalungu emiqulwini yamalungu.UMsomi uthe bayaphikisana nalokho okushiwo yisigungu esiphezulu senhlangano ebhekelele ukusebenza kwansukuzonke iNational Working Committe (NWC) ukuthi amagatsha esifundazwe asekulungele ukuhlalisa izingqungquthela.I-NWC ihambele izifunda zezifundazwe yathola ukuthi eziningi zazo sezikulungele ukusingatha izingqungquthela ngaphandle kwezintathu iLower South Coast, Moses Mabhida neHarry Gwala.UMnuz Siyabonga Hlongwa onguNobhala wegatsha le-ANC eMoses Mabhida uthe abakwazi ukuthi bangaya ezingqungqutheleni kusabulawa abaholi benhlangano.“Sikhuluma nje sihlangane lapha eLower South Coast sekubulewe abaholi ababili benhlangano, lokho kunika isithombe sokuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngaleyo ndlela akukuhle ukuthi kungahlala izingqungquthela,” kusho uHlongwa.UMnuz Bheki Nzimande oyilungu lesigungu esihola iHarry Gwala ukuchithile ukuthi baphakamisa ukuthi izingqungquthela zingahlali ngoba besaba izimbangi zabo ukuthi zizobathela ngehlazo.“Asesabi ukuya ezingqungqutheleni kodwa sithi sifuna kuyiwe enkundleni ziyozwana amandla sekuxazululwe zonke izinkinga, ngeke siye ezingqungqutheleni zezifunda namagatsha antshontshiwe,” kusho uNzimande.UMNUZ Howard Msomi waseMzumbe ekhulumela amalungu e-ANC athi azingahlali izingqungquthela zingakalungiswa izinkingaUthe esifundeni sabo iHarry Gwala kunemihlangano yamagatsha ebihlaliswa ngoSihlalo be-ANCYL emagatsheni aseThekwini okuyinto ephambene nomthethosisekelo.“Kukhona futhi eminye imihlangano yamagatsha ebihlaliswa ngosihlalo benhlangano yosomatekisi iSouth African National Taxi Council (Santaco),” kusho uNzimande.UMnuz Sifiso Dlamini waseThekwini uthe izimbangi zabo kumele zingakhohlwa ukuthi bazifaka enkantolo mayelana nomphumela wengqungquthela yesifundazwe ka-2015.“Kumele basilalele, uma bengafuni sizohlangana nabo enkantolo,” kusho uDlamini.Ingqungquthela yokuqala yezifunda yokulungiselela ingqungquthela yesifundazwe isihlalile esifundeni iGreater KwaDukuza.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMxhumanisi we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, uthe sekumi ngumumo ngamalungiselelo ezingqungquthela ezine okumele zihlale kule mpelasonto.UZikalala uthe bazozihlalisa izingqungquthela eyaseMalahleni, Far North, Nkosi Bhambatha naseMusa Dladla ukuze kukhethwe ubuholi obusha.“Zonke izinhlelo zokulungiselela lezi zingqungquthela zihambe kahle futhi sinethemba lokuthi zonke izingqungquthela zizoqhubeka njengoba kuhleliwe,” kusho uZikalala.

UBESENDLELENI eyongcwaba ugogo wakhe u-Akhumzi Jezile (29) wodumo lweYOTV futhi obengumdidiyeli wohlelo lomculo kuSABC 1, iLive Amp, okushaqeke iningi kuzwakala ngokudlula kwakhe emhlabeni engozini yemoto, e-Eastern Cape, ngoMgqibelo ekuseni.U-Akhumzi, Siyasanga Kobese owaduma ecula eqenjini iJoyous Celebration, Thobani Mselemu obesezakhele igama ngokubonakala ezikhangisweni zekwithelevishini, uSkhumbuzo Mbuthuma obeyisazi sezobuchwepheshe besimanje nomunye ebelingakaveli igama lakhe, kuvela ukuthi bashone ujuqu imoto abebehamba ngayo ishayisana nenye emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka, uN6 eduzane kwaseQueenstown.ULindelani Mkhize, obesondelene no-Akhumzi futhi owake wasebenza noSiyasanga kwiJoyous, uthe namanje basashaqekile.“Ngesikhathi behamba bangitshelile ukuthi sebeyasuka. U-Akhumzi ubeya emngcwabeni kagogo wakhe ezoya nasemshadweni wesihlobo sakhe. Laba abanye ngoba nabo abakhona e-Eastern Cape bacela ukuhamba naye ukuze baye emakhaya,” kuchaza uLindelani.THOBANI Mselemu“Sisasangene ngempela ngokwenzekile, sisamangele futhi sishaqekile. Ikusasa lika-Akhumzi beliqhakazile njengoba ebengumuntu onekhono elimangalisayo uma kuziwa ekubeni uphrojusa nomqondisi wezinto ezehlukile kwithelevishini. Besisondelene kakhulu futhi into ebisenza sisebenze kakhulu ndawonye wukuthi ubengumuntu okhuthele futhi kukuningi esibona ngaso linye kukhona,” kusho uLindelani.Uthe u-Akhumzi noSiyasanga ubungeke ubahlukanise njengoba bebekuthanda ukuhlala bobabili.“Bobabili bebethanda ukudlala nokuhleka. Bebengabangani abakhulu. IJoyous, kusuka kwabadala kuze kube yilaba abakhona manje basathukile ukuzwa lezi zindaba,” kuchaza uLindelani.UPercy Vilakazi okhulumela umndeni wakwaJezile uthe okwamanje umndeni ushaqekile ngalesi sigameko.“Bangabantu abakholelwa kakhulu kuNkulunkulu njengoba no-Akhumzi bekungumuntu okholwayo. Umthandazo yiyona into abathembele kuyo manje ukuze bakwazi ukwemukela lezi zindaba,” kuchaza uVilakazi.Uthe okwamanje abakazi ukuthi izinhlelo zezinkonzo zalaba zizohlelwa kanjani kodwa bazokhipha konke ekuhambeni kwesonto.UCaptain Namhla Mdleleni okhulumela amaphoyisa ase-Eastern Cape uthe kusaphenywa ngembangela yale ngozi.SIYASANGA KobeseUthe imizimba yabantu abathathu isihlonziwe kushoda ababili akade bekhona emotweni ebihamba o-AkhumziNe-ANC nalo lidlulisele amazwi enduduzo emndenini yalaba ngokudlula kwabo emhlabeni.Okhulumela leli qembu uPule Mabe uthe kubathusile ukuzwa lezi zindaba beyiqembu.“Laba bobathathu bathinte impilo yabantu bakuleli ngezindlela ezihlukene. Sifisa ngathi imindeni yabo ingathola amandla kulesi sikhathi esinzima njengoba besazama ukwamukela lezi zindaba,” kusho uPule.Uthe benguKhongolose bathemba ukuthi imindeni yalaba izothola ukududuzela njengoba kungalinyalelwe bona bodwa kodwa lonke elakuleli.

KUSHIYE isililo emnyangweni wezempilo esifundazweni ukushona kwezimenenja ezimbili ebezisebenza ezibhedlela zaKwaZulu-Natal, ngoMsombuluko.UNKK Thandazile Octavia Manzini (55), ungoti wokubelethisa obebuye abe yi-Operations Manager ophikweni lokubelethisa esibhedlela eManguzi, ushone ngesikhathi imoto abehamba ngayo ishayisana neloli kuR33, ngasesiqiwini iSmangaliso, kwathi uMnuz Phathakahle Jali (41) obeyi-Operations Manager ebhekelele imitholampilo engomahamba nendlwana esibhedlela uNtunjambili, ngaseKranskop, wadutshulwa wabulawa, ngamadoda angaziwa esemzini wakhe, ngoMsombuluko.UNkk Manzini kuthiwa ubephuma koqeqesha abanye abahlengikazi emtholampilo KwaMsane ngesikhathi kwenzeka le ngozi. UJali kuthiwa uhlaselwe ngamadoda amabili angaziwa esemzini wakhe ntambama, avulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise kuye, washonela khona lapho.UDkt Siphiwe Vumase isikhulu esiphezulu esibhedlela iManguzi, uthe balahlekelwe kakhulu ngokushona kukaNkk Manzini obesesebenze iminyaka ewu-30 kulesi sibhedlela.“Ubefundisa abanye abahlengikazi lapha eMkhanyakude. Ubesebenza kahle kakhulu ophikweni lokunciphisa ukudlulela kwegciwane lengculazi enganeni ezalwa umama onegciwane onalo, iPrevention of Mother to Child Transmission of HIV. Ngenxa yokuzimisela kwakhe sekuphele iminyaka emithathu singakaze sibe nenkinga yokushona kwengane ngesikhathi unina eyibeletha noma ngemuva kokubeletha.”UMNUZ Phathakahle Jali obeyi-Operations Manager ophikweni lwemitholampilo engomahamba nendlwana, esibhedlela uNtunjabili, odutshulwe wabulawa esemzini wakhe, ngoMsombuluko Isithombe: SithunyelweUPastor Klaas Manzini umfowabo kaNkk Manzini uthe bashaqeke kakhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kukankosikazi kamfowabo.“Namanje kusenzima ukwamukela kodwa kumele samukele ngoba sizifikele mathupha endaweni yesigameko, sibone siqhamuka ukuthi mancane amathuba okuthi usaphila, bekuyinhlekelele yengozi leya,” kuchaza yena.Uthe unkosikazi kamfowabo ubewuthanda umsebenzi bekuthi noma besenkonzweni abashayele ucingo esibhedlela abuze ukuthi ngabe konke kuhamba kahle yini.UJali okuthiwa ubenamakhosikazi amabili, kuthiwa uqale ukusebenza kulo mnyango ngo-2001. Efika kulesi sibhedlela kuthiwa wayengu-staff nurse, waba ngu-professional nurse, waba yi-clinical nurse practitioner wagcina esekulesi sikhundla ashone ekuso. Ushiye amakhosikazi akhe nezingane eziyisikhombisa.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kulesi sifundazwe, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, uthe kubuhlungu ukushiywa yilaba basebenzi bezempilo abashone kabuhlungu. “Kubuhlungu ukushiywa ngozakwethu ngale ndlela. Kusazoba nzima ukuthola abantu abebezinikele njengabo emsebenzini,” kusho yena.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCol Thembeka Mbele, usiqinisekisile isigameko sokudutshulwa kukaJali, wathi kuvulwe icala lokubulala, eliphenywa esiteshini samaphoyisa eKranskop.

text: KUGCINE kumenele ngoMgqibelo owesifazane waseNkunzani, KwaNongoma, obhunyelwe uyise wezingane ngophethroli wamokhela ngomlilo.UNksz Nompumelelo Mthembu (28) ushone ngoMgqibelo kulandela ukubhunyelwa ngophethilolu nguyise wezingane zakhe, ngoba enqaba ukuba bebuyelane.Umufi onezingane ezintathu nomsolwa, kuthiwa ubesebuyele kubo njengoba ngoMashi wamshaya waze wamdlokodla isitho sangasese ngesagila umsolwa kulandela ingxabano ethinta imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni yezingane.Wahlala isikhathi esibhedlela uNksz Mthembu ekhishwa isagila njengoba umndeni uthe kwaze kwaphoxeleka ukuba akhishwe nesibeletho...Udaba oluphelele kwiSolezwe ngoLwesine.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke, uDkt Zweli Mkhize, usethole isicelo esiphuthumayo kuMcwaningi Mabhuku jikelele, sokuthi angenelele emuva kokusatshiswa kwabenza uphenyo kuMasipala weTheku nowaseMsunduzi.Esitatimendeni uMkhize uthe uMcwaningi, uMnuz Kimi Makwetu, uthe ufuna kungenelele umnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana emuva kokuthi kudingeke ukuthi kuhoxiswe abebenza uphenyo ngoba besatshiswa.“Lezi zehlakalo ziyashaqisa futhi azamukelekile. Kwenziwe into engavumelekile, asikwazi ukuvumela isimo lapho kusatshiswa abantu abacwaninga amabhuku bangabe besakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo. Kumele kuhlonishwe umsebenzi wezikhungo ezifana nalezi ziqhubeke nomsebenzi ngaphandle kokwesatshiswa,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe bazosebenzisana neminyango yezifundazwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyaqhubeka ukwenziwa komsebenzi komasipala ababili.USihlalo wekomiti elibhekele uMcwaningi Mabhuku ePhalamende, uMnuz Vincent Smith, uthe kuyaqala ukuthi kube nokusatshiswa kwabaphenyi KwaZulu-Natal wathi kwezinye izifundazwe yinto asebeke bayizwa.Uthe akuvumelekile ukuthi kusatshiswe abasebenza kuleli hhovisi wathi kumele amaphoyisa aphenye abambe abenzi bobubi.Umcwaningi usanda kudedela umbiko ongemuhle ngesimo somasipala bakuleli.“Sinxusa abezepolitiki ukuthi basize izisebenzi zomcwaningi mabhuku ukuthi ziqhubeke nomsebenzi wazo. Kumele umcwaningi asebenze ngaphandle kokwesaba.”IMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, uthe bazoqinisa ezokuphepha kubasebenzi abenza ucwaningo.Uthe kudingeke basheshe babuye ngemuva kokuzwa ngalokhu kade bengaphandle kwezwe.“Ngiyalele inhloko yezokuphepha, uMnuz Dumisani Bhengu, ukuthi akhe uhlelo lokuvikela izisebenzi zomcwaningi mabhuku. Siyaxhumana nehhovisi likamcwaningi ukuze kuleli sonto babuyele bazosebenza,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Uthe lesi sehlakalo akumele siphinde senzeke wathi bazimisele ekutheni bathole imibiko emihle yezimali.UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe uzophenya ngokushesha.“Asikwazi ukuvumela ukuthi umcwaningi mabhuku aphume nyova komasipala ngoba esatshiswa. Senza yonke imizamo siwumnyango ukweseka omasipala ukuze bathole imibiko emihle yezimali,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube.

ILUNGU lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC elijutshwe ukuba libheke ukusebenza kwesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Edna Molewa, liyakuchitha ukuthi uKhongolose esifundazweni unezinkinga ezinzima ezingenza ukuthi ingqungquthela yesifundazwe ingabikhona.Ekhuluma esithangamini nabezindaba eMeander Manor Hotel, eSalt Rock, izolo ngemuva kwengqungquthela yesifunda iGreater KwaDukuza, uNkk Molewa uthe ubuholi bukazwelonke bufike esifundazweni buzohlola isimo samagatsha nezifunda bathola ukuthi iqembu likulungele ukuthi lingaba nengqungquthela yesifundazwe.“Nakuba zikhona izikhalo kodwa ngezamagatsha ambalwa ezifundeni ezehlukene ezingeke zadala ukuthi kumiswe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe,’’ kusho uNkk Molewa.Uthe akukho okuphambene abakwenzile kodwa balandele yonke imigomo ekumthethosisekelo weqembu mayelana nezingqungquthela.“Umgomo weqembu uthi ukuze kube nengqungquthela kumele * -70% wamagatsha ube sesimeni esihle. Cishe zonke izifunda zingaphezu kwalesi sibalo esifunekayo.”Uthe ingqungquthela yesifundazwe izoba khona ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMeyi.“Bekulindeleke ukuthi ingqungquthela ibe ngempelasonto kaMeyi 18-20 kodwa lokho kubukeka kungeke kusenzeka ngoba kukhona izifunda ezizobe zihlangene. Akukwazi ukuthi kungaba nengqungquthela yezifunda kube kuneyesifundazwe.”Uthe noma ngabe kuthiwa kukhona izifunda ezinenkinga lokhu ngeke kuyiphazamise ingqungquthela yesifundazwe.“Izithunywa kaziyi engqungqutheleni yesifundazwe ngoba zithunywe yizifunda zazo kodwa ziya ngoba zithunywe ngamagatsha azo.”Uncome ingqungquthela yaseGreater KwaDukuza wathi ibe yimpumelelo enkulu wanxusa zonke izifunda ezisazokhetha ukuthi zisike iphethini kwaDukuza.Ubongele nobuholi obusha besifunda iGreater KwaDukuza wathi uyathemba ukuthi buzokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela.Ingqungquthela yaKwaDukuza ikhethe ubuholi obusha ngo-elethu engqungqutheleni ethathe izinsuku ezimbili.UMnuz Ricardo Mthembu obevele enguSihlalo wesifunda uphinde wabuyela esikhundleni sakhe okwesithathu. Uke waba nguSihlalo we-ANCYL esifundeni.UMthembu uthe ujabule ngokuthi amaqabane aphinde amthembe ngokuthi usengakwazi ukuwahola.Uthe uzosebenza kanzima ukuzama ukuqeda ukwehlukana okukhona kumalungu.“Ukwehlukana okukhona enhlanganweni kubhebhethekiswa wubuholi, yithina futhi esisukayo siyoxova amagatsha,” kusho uMthembu.Uthe uzimisele ngokusebenzisana nesigungu sakhe ukuyisa uKhongolose phambili.Ingqungquthela yaKwaDukuza ngeyokuqala KwaZulu-Natal ngemuva kokuthi ubuholi bukazwelonke bathatha isinqumo sokuthi zime kancane.Ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke ukuthi kube neyezifunda ezine kanye kanye okukhona kuzo iMusa Dladla, Far North, Emalahleni neNkosi Bhambatha.Ngempelasonto ezolandela kulindeleke ukuba kube neyeMoses Mabhida, Abaqulusi, Harry Gwala neLower South Coast.Ukuphumelela kukaMthembu esifundeni iGreater KwaDukuza kusho ukuthi uhlangothi lukaMnuz Sihle Zikalala lusahamba phambili ngo 1-0, njengoba kulungiselelwa ingqungquthela yesifundazwe.Kodwa akwaziwa ukuthi izozala nkomini kulezi ezinye izifunda eziyisishiyagalombili okusamele zihlangane.

YIBO laba bantu abafunwa uthuli amaphoyisa okusolwa ukuthi angawalekelela ecaleni lokuphehla udweshu enkundleni yezemidlalo eMoses Mabhida Kuloba uS’MANGELE ZUMA. Izithombe: ZITHUNYELWELolu hlu luveza amadoda awu-11 nabesifazane ababili ababeyingxenye yabalandeli bebhola ababeyobuka umdlalo weNedbank Cup phakathi kweKaizer Chiefs neFree State Stars emasontweni amabili edlule.Ulinganiselwa kuR2.6 million umonakalo odaleke eMabhida ngesikhathi iChiefs iguqiswa ngo 2-0.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uBrigadier Jay Nacker, uthe ithimba labaphenyi nenhloko yabashushisi isikhiphe izithombe zabantu abakholelwa ukuthi bangabalekelela ngophenyo.“Sinxusa bonke laba abavela kulezi zithombe ukuthi bathinte abaphenyi becala ngokushesha. Sicela namalungu omphakathi ababonayo laba abasezithombeni ukuthi afonele uCaptain Reddy kwinombolo ethi 082 458 5630 noma uDetective Warrant Officer Mlungwana ku 082 662 7762,” kusho uNaicker.Uthembisile ukuthi ulwazi abazoluletha emaphoyiseni luzoba yimfihlo, wathi bamukelekile nalabo abafisa ukungazidaluli.NgoLwesithathu abasolwa abathathu, oMnuz Siphosenkosi Memela (35) onomuzi eSavanna Park, ungumshayeli wamaloli ahamba amabanga amafushane, Sibongiseni Khumalo (29) owaseKlaarwater, uyimenenja erenki yamatekisi noKhwezilomo Madiba (35) waseBizana ongumshayeli wetekisi, bavele enkantolo kaMantshi eThekwini.Laba basolwa ababhekene namacala amathathu, elokudala udlame emphakathini, elokungena enkundleni ngaphandle kwemvume nelokuhluleka ukulandela imiyalelo yamaphoyisa, banikezwe ibheyili kaR1 000 umuntu emunye.Bazobuyela enkantolo ngoMeyi 25 sebehambisana nomsolwa owaboshwa kuqala, uMnuz Phelelani Jojisa (32) waseMayville naye ongaphandle ngebheyili kaR1 000.UJojisa okuthiwa ungumlandeli we-Orlando Pirates, ubhekene necala lokungena enkundleni ngaphandle kwemvume kanti kungenzeka andiswe amacala akhe uma kuvela ubufakazi.Ngaphambilini uNaicker uveze ukuthi bangu-20 abantu ababefakwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bemataniswa nalolu dweshu.Uthe ukuvezwa kwabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kusizile ukuze amaphoyisa alandele uphenyo.Ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi ukuvela kwabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana akubanikezi igunya lokuthi bababophe, kudingeke ukuthi benze uphenyo olunzulu, kutholakale nobufakazi.

USAFISA ukulanywa yinoma abangaki owesifazane ogane esithenjini eNdwedwe, obegcagca ngosuku olulodwa nomnakwabo.UNkk Thokozile Lushozi, uKaMakhoba (49), usehlale iminyaka engu-19 noMnuz Sabelo Lushozi (57) abegcagca naye izolo. Ugcagce nomnakwabo uNkk Khanyisile Lushozi, uMaKhumalo (43). UKaMakhoba othe wafika kwaLushozi eneminyaka engu-17, uthe wayevele efisa ukuthola umnakwabo ozomlekelela ngoba miningi imisebenzi emzini wakhe. ULushozi obeganwa izolo uyinyanga edumile eNdwedwe, aphinde abe nendawo yokusebenzela oThongathi.“Ngijabulile ukuthi ekugcineni sengize ngangena ngokusemthethweni kwaLushozi ngoba kade ngalinda. Bekukuningi ubaba obekumele akulungise, kwabambezela nomshado. Ngajabula ubaba engitshela ukuthi sekukhona uMaKhumalo ngoba bengivele ngigqilazeka. Engingakuthandi ukufihlelwa uma sekukhona olandelayo. Namanje anginankinga ngisho ngingalanywa abangaki ngoba mningi umsebenzi layikhaya. Ubaba uyinyanga usebenza nabantu kakhulu, kudingeka sibuye sibasize, sipheke namakhambi,” kuchaza uKaMakhoba.Uthe akaze abe nenkinga yokuhlala noMakhumalo, abapheka ekhishini elilodwa naye.UMaKhumalo uthe wafika kwaLushozi esazi ukuthi uyoba ngowesibili.“Siphathene kahle noKaMakhoba kungathi udadewethu. Akukho esikwenza singabonisananga. Sihlukana ngoba sekuyolalwa. Umuntu unezinsuku zakhe zokuvakashelwa ubaba futhi asinankinga,” kusho uMaKhumalo.ULushozi obehleka yedwa, uthe ubesalungisa izinto zasemsamo nezomndeni njengoba ebengakwazi ukugcagca. Uthe akaze aganwe phambilini, yingakho enqume ukuthi abashade ngosuku olulodwa ngoba vele bayezwana.“Engikwenzayo ngikutshelwa ngabaphansi engisebenza ngabo, yibona nabangivumele ukuthi amakhosikazi ngiwashade ngosuku olulodwa. Bangibonisa la makhosikazi, yingakho sihleli ngokuthula,” kusho uLushozi.Ebuzwa ngemfihlo yokwenza isithembu sakhe sizwane, uthe ukuthi wasinikwa abaphansi akazenzelanga. ULushozi uthe yize okwamanje emphethe kahle amakhosikazi akhe, ngeke aphike ukuthi ngeke esaganwa. Uthe ukhokho wayenamakhosikazi angu-19. Ugcizelele ukuthi akukho okwakwenziwa uKaMakhoba obekungamanelisi kodwa wathatha uMaKhumalo ngoba kuwumyalelo wabaphansi. Umphakathi ubuphume ngezinkani kule ndawo uzobuka umngcagco.

source: kubulawe amakhansela amabili ele ifp nele anc ngolwesihlanu
text: KUBE uLwesihlanu lwegazi KwaZulu-Natal njengoba kubulawe amakhansela amabili amaqembu ehlukene i-ANC ne-IFP ngobusuku obubodwa, behlaselwa ngesibhamu ezigamekweni ezehlukene.UMnuz Sibuyiselo Dlamini (35) waseDlebe khona Olundi, obeyikhansela emkhandlwini iZululand, udutshulwe ngasedolobheni Olundi emzileni uR66 King Dinuzulu Highway ngesikhathi imoto yakhe imiswa amadoda angaziwa avulele ngenhlamvu washonela khona lapho. Kuthiwa lesi sigameko senzeke kuyoshaya u-7 ntambama.IPhini loMkhulumeli we-IFP kuzwelonke uMnuz Joshua Mazibuko, uthe bafe olwembiza ngalo mholi obekhombisa ukukhalipha kodwa esemncane."Le nsizwa besigadla ngayo njengoba ibibuye ibe umholi wentsha Olundi, silimele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwayo. Asifuni-ke ukuqala sishaye amathambo siqagele ngoba kuyahlupha lokho. Sizodedela amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo ukuze sithole kahle ukuthi bekwenzenjani,’’ kusho uMazibuko.Kwesinye isigameko ikhansela le-ANC emkhandlwini uMsunduzi ebelibuye libe umholi oqavile esifundeni iMoses Mabhida, nalo lisocongwe ngobusuku obufanayo. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, sivele isimo simanzonzo kulesi sifunda njengoba kuze kwamiswa nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi kwesabelwa ukuphepha kwabantu.UMnuz Musawenkosi ‘Qashana’ Mchunu (45) uthelekelwe amadoda angaziwa ngakwaPata, eMgungundlovu ehamba ngemoto yakhe ngo-7 ntambama. Kuthiwa la madoda avulele ngenhlamvu waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, kwafika kwamenela.Umxhumanisi ebuholini besikhashana be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, kuthiwa uhlangabezane nembibizane exoshwa kubo kukamufi."Angixoshwanga nginqume ukuthi ngingangeni ngoba ngibona amaqabane ehlukene phakathi kunezinhlangothi ezimbili. Sithume oyedwa ayosimela emndenini," kusho uZikalala.Uthe kuzofanele amaphoyisa alubeke eqhulwini lolu daba lokubulawa kwekhansela."Lesi sihlava silokhu siqhubeka sidala kungabibikho uzinzo esifundazweni. Siyacela amaphoyisa kube khona akwenzayo ngempela ayifakele izibuko le nkinga," kusho uZikalala othe bahambele umndeni beyobabaza lo muga.Uthe bayazwelana futhi neqembu i-IFP nayo eyehlelwe yisigameko esifanayo sokusocongwa kwelungu layo.Ibamba lomkhuzi wamaphoyisa esifundazweni uMajor General Bhekinkosi Langa, uzigxekile lezi zigameko zokubulawa kwamakhansela.Uthe amadokodo asedluliselwe ethimbeni eliyisipesheli elizophenya.Unxuse namalungu omphakathi angaba nolwazi ukuthi asize athintane namaphoyisa aseduze nawo.

UMENGAMELI weSouth African Football Association (Safa), uDanny Jordaan, ukholwa wukuthi kuzolotha konke obekwenzeka ngombango wesikhundla, kugxilwe emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa ibhola eNingizimu Afrika.UJordaan uphinde waqokelwa kwesokwengamela iSafa ngaphandle kokuphikiswa embuthanweni wokukhetha obukade useSandton Convention Centre eGauteng ngoMgqibelo. Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa bekubukeka uzoshisa phansi umbango wesikhundla kodwa uJordaan ugcine eselungenele yedwa ukhetho. Ukhetho lucishe lwabhuntsha kulandela ukuthi kube khona abafaka incwadi yokulumisa enkontolo kodwa bachithwa.UJordaan uthe ukholwa wukuthi sesidlulile isivunguvungu, wadalula izinhloso zakhe njengoba esethatha elinye ihlandla.“Ngethemba ukuthi konke kuzobuyela esimeni esijwayelekile ebholeni laseMzansi. Ikakhulukazi isikhathi esiphakathi kuka 2018 no-2022. Sifuna ukubheka ukuthi singaliqinisa kanjani ibhola labesifazane ezweni. Sibonile kusukela kwabaphethe imidlalo ukuthi esigungwini sikazwelonke sinabesifazane abathathu kuphela. Kodwa kumaLFA nasezifundeni sinabesifazane abangu-810 abasebenza ebholeni emazingeni aphansi,” kusho uJordaan.UJordaan ubuyela esikhundleni nje, ubhekwe ukuthi afeze izethembiso zakhe ngokuthuthukiswa kwebhola eMzansi. Iningi aliyizwa indaba yakhe.UJordaan uphumele obala ngesifiso sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingenele umbango wokusingatha iNdebe yoMhlaba yabesifazane.“Ngokwabadlali sifuna ukwenyusa isibalo sabesifazane nokwethula iligi ngo-2019 nokubheka ukuthi singakwazi yini ukusingatha iNdebe yoMhlaba yabesifazane. Sizoqoka ikomiti elizohlela, uma sekukhona elikhutholile, sizohlala phansi nohulumeni nongqongqoshe wezemidlalo ukuzwa ukuthi uyahambisana yini nathi. Uma ubheka amanye amazwe asingathe iNdebe yoMhlaba, ngo-1994 asingatha eyabesilisa kwathi ngo-1999 asingatha eyabesifazane. Lokho kwasiza ekukhuliseni ibhola labesifazane.“Uma ubheka iFrance yasingatha iNdebe yoMhlaba ngoo-1998 futhi izosingatha eyabesifazane ngonyaka ozayo * -2019. I-Germany yasingatha eyabesilisa ngo-2006, yasingatha eyabesifazane ngo-2011,” kusho uJordaan.“Inselelo wukuthi uyisebenzisa kanjani ingqalasizinga yeNdebe yoMhlaba. Ngo-2010 sadlula kakhulu kokwakulindelwe kithina. Eyabesifazane inamaqembu angu-24, hhayi angu-32 kodwa ngesikhathi siqeda iNdebe yoMhlaba ngo-2010, isidingo sezinkundla sanyuka. Sesihlale iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, akufanele silinde kakhulu.”

LIFUNA izincazelo ikomiti elibheka ukusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi, iStanding Committee on Public Accounts (Scopa) kwiSassa ngokusebenza kukaR4 million kuhlelwa umcimbi owodwa KwaZulu-Natal. Leli komiti lithi mithathu imicimbi eyahlelwa, uwodwa wabiza uR4 million.USihlalo waleli komiti uMnuz Themba Godi, ugxeke ukungalandelwa kwemigudu efanele ngesikhathi kusebenza imali engaka ngomcimbi owodwa.KuR4 million kuthiwa kwaqashwa itende ngoR485 000, izindlu zangasese ngoR490 000, ukuhlobisa izihlalo ngoR487 000, okokwendlala phansi etendeni ngoR482 000, ukuphekela izicukuthwane kwaba nguR493 000, izinto zokuthutha kwaba nguR493 000, i-sound system yaba nguR492 000, kwathi izipho zaba nguR480 000.Isikhulu seSassa esasibambile uNksz Pearl Bhengu kuthiwa uyagula ngakho akakwazanga ukufika azochazela ikomiti izolo ePhalamende.“UNksz Bhengu waphuthuma ukugunyaza le micimbi, wakwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokufuna ama-quotations amathathu okuyinto edingekayo. Kuyacaca ukuthi kwanyuswa imali kule micimbi,” kusho uGodi.Uthe ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu uMnuz Abraham Mahlangu, noNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi uNksz Susan Shabangu bazibophezele ekutheni zizothathelwa izinyathelo izikhulu ezithintekayo nemali izobuyiswa uma kunesidingo sokuthi ibuye.“Sinxuse uNkk Mahlangu ukuthi ayibheke indaba yonogada abanikwa uNksz Bhengu kusuka ngo-2012 nemali eyasebenza kulokhu. Sizoyibheka eyokuthi ngelanga esiyophonsa ngayo imibuzo le nhlangano kube nomnyango kamgcinimafa.”UMnuz Tim Brauteseth, okhulumela iDA kwiScopa, uthe bazobhalela uNksz Shabangu ukuze kuthathelwe izinyathelo ngokushesha owayenguNgqongqoshe walo mnyango uNksz Bathabile Dlamini noNksz Bhengu ngokusebenzisa uR16 million ngemicimbi engaqondakali.“Emhlanganweni weScopa kuvele ukuthi uNksz Bhengu wasayina uR16 million ngoDisemba nyakenye ukuze kwenziwe imicimbi yokufundisa kungalandelwanga imigudu efanele.“Baphendula iSassa ibhange labo lokushushumbisa imali ngezinto ezingabasizanga ngalutho abantu abahola imali yempesheni,” kusho uMnuz Brauteseth.Uthe ukususwa kukaNksz Bhengu KwaZulu-Natal akusizi ngoba wenza umonakalo omkhulu wathi kumele amiswe ngokushesha kusenziwa uphenyo, uma etholakala enecala abuyise le mali eyasebenza.

UPHITHENE ikhanda umculi waseThekwini kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe amadodana akhe amabili ngesihluku ekhaya lakhe eShongweni Dam ebusuku.Isihlabani somculo wombhaqanga uSandile Khwela, owaduma kwiMadlala Brothers, uthi uthuke esevuswa wucingo oluvela kunina ethi sekudutshulwe uNkosingiphile Vilakazi (15) obefunda uGrade 10 eMargot Fonteyn Secondary, eKlaarwater, noMxolisi Mzimela (18) obefunda uGrade 11 eThokozamnganga High, eShongweni Dam.UKhwela uthi laba badutshulwe ebusuku ngoLwesine emva kwehora lesishiyagalombili behleli kusofa.Bobabili badutshulwe kabi ekhanda nasemzimbeni amanxeba amaningi.“Sisadidekile ngoba bayizingane asazi kungani bebulewe ngale ndlela. Umama uthi ubeselungiselela ukulala, kanti uzothi esanda kucisha ugesi kuqhume isibhamu siphindelela. Omunye ubenamanxeba awu-6, omunye bamdubule kawu-7,” kusho uKhwela ekhathazekile.Eqhuba uthe sebesabela impilo yabo ngoba kuyacaca abaphephile kulo mndeni kulandela izigameko eziningi ezimbi ezenzeka zilandelana.UBULAWE ezoya komela isikole emdlalweni omkhulu webhola uMxolisi MzimelauNkosingiphile Vilakazi (15) obefunda uGrade 10 eMargot Fonteyn SecondaryEchaza laba ababulelwe uthe bekuyizingane ezilalelayo futhi ezithobekile ngisho esikoleni othisha bebehlala bezincoma.“UMxolisi izolo bekumele ayodlala ibhola nesikole njengoba kuse esebulewe. Izinhliziyo zethu zibuhlungu, sihlukumezekile kodwa akukho esingakwenza ngaphandle kokwamukela isimo esehle layikhaya,” kusho uKhwela.Lo mndeni wehlelwa yilo mshophi nje ubusanda kuba ondabuzekwayo kulandela ukunqoba kwelinye lama lungu omndeni iDusi Canoe Marathon, uSbonelo Khwela.Izinhlelo zomngcwabo bezingakahlelwa njengoba leli phephandaba likhulume nomndeni isigameko sisanda kwenzeka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko.“Bebehleli endlini ngesikhathi behlaselwa abasolwa ababili abangaziwa babadubula. Abezimo eziphuthumayo baqinisekisile ukufa kwabo endaweni yesigameko. Okwamanje ibingakaziwa imbangela yokubulala. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala, amaphoyisa aKwaNdengezi ayaphenya,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.

IBALEKE yaduba nebandla inkosazana eBuhleni kwaShembe exakwe wumama ongumkhokheli osolwa ngobutabane okuthiwa ubefuna ukuya nayo ocansini.Inkosazana (19) okhonza ethempeleni eKushumayeleni, KwaNongoma, elingeke lidalulwe igama layo, ithe isisaba nokuya esontweni ngemuva kokuthi umkhokheli akhonza naye embizele edokodweni lakhe wamtshela ukuthi umile kahle ufuna ukuthi baye ocansini, ngesikhathi besentabeni eKhenani, oZwathini, ngoJanuwari.Inkosazana ithe umkhokheli wayincoma ngesikhathi begeza, wathi ime kahle futhi nobuntu bayo bukhulu. Wabe esethi ucela amvakashele edokodweni lakhe.“Yize ngingayithandanga inkulumo kamama u... (esho isibongo sakhe), ngaya edokodweni lakhe ngoba ngiyamhlonipha. Okwangixaka ngedokodo lakhe wukuthi ngaphandle lihlotshiswe ngezimbali ezibomvu. Ngazibuza ukuthi ngabe kungani lize lihlotshiwe kangaka kodwa ngabuye nganganaka. Sengingenile wajabula wanginika izipho -ushokoledi, iyoghurt nomnazaretha omude ofakwe ublomu. Ngathi ngisamangazwe yilezi zipho wabe esesondela kimi engithinta ethi uyangithanda uchazwa nayizwi lami. Ufisa sithandane. Angikwazanga nokuyiphendula le nto ayishoyo ngoba ngimazi engumama ohloniphekile. Ngabona kungcono ngiphume ngibaleke,” kusho inkosazana.Ithe selokhu yagcina ukuya esontweni ngaleso sikhathi ngoba isaba ukuthi uzohlangana nomkhokheli kodwa akazi ukuthi izombhekelwa ngubani.Ithe ibikele umkhandlu obhekelele ukuhlukunyezwa kwamaNazaretha, iNazareth Judiciary, ukuze umcebise ukuthi kumele enze njani.UMnuz Wellington Myeza, ilungu lomkhandlu, uvumile ukuthi udaba lubikiwe kubo wathi nabo bengumkhandlu abakwazanga ukuluxazulula. Bacele izeluleko kwiKhomishini evikela amalungelo eNkolo, uLimi namaSiko.Uthe bane abesifazane ababike ukuthi bahlukunyezwe ngabesifazane abakholwa wukuthi bayizitabane besohambeni oluyingcwele ngoJanuwari.UMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, okhulumela abaseBuhleni, uthe kuyamangaza ukuthi udaba lufinyelele kwabezindaba ngesikhathi esibi kusanda kuphuma isinqumo senkantolo esichitha uNyazilwezulu.“Udaba luthunaza ibandla futhi selunesikhathi lwenzeka. Kungani luputshuka manje. Ngilubona sengathi nalo luyingxenye yokudicilela phansi isithunzi sethu. Ikomiti lebandla yilo okumele luludingide, angiboni ukuthi ukuphumela kwalo kwabezindaba kuzoyisiza ngani inkosazana,” kusho uMncwabe.

I-ANC kuzwelonke isigxeke isigameko sokuhlaselwa kwethempeli eVerulam, eThekwini, ngoLwesine ithi lesi senzo siwukuphazamisa inkululeko yezenkolo eshicilelwe kumthethosisekelo wezwe.UMnuz Pule Mabe okhulumela i-ANC uthe ofakazi kulesi sigameko baveza ngokusobala ukuthi yinto ebihleliwe le yokuhlasela leli thempeli. Uthe kufanele kugxekwe ngazo zonke izindlela noma yimiphi imizamo yokuhlalisa lubhojozi abantu ngenxa yezenkolo.UMabe uthe beyinhlangano ebusayo bashaqekile ukuthi kukhona abantu abenza isenzo esibi kangaka njengoba onke amabandla ezenkolo evikelwe kumthethisisekelo.“Siyacela amaphoyisa uphiko loKlebe ukuba lusilekelele ngoba sifuna ukubabona bejeza abenze lokhu. Sithi dudu emndenini yoshonile, sifisele nalabo abasesibhedlela ukululama okusheshayo.”Kulesi sigameko esinyantisa igazi kutheleke abalisa abangaziwa abahlasela amalungu ebandla abethandaza ababhokoda ngommese ebanquma noqhoqhoqho kwafa oyedwa abanye baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.Kunezinye izingxenye zethempeli ezithungelwe ngomlilo ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko.Leli cala ligcine lithathwa uphiko loKlebe nokuyilona oluzolulandela luzame ukuthola umnyombo walo. Lokhu kuhlasela akuqondakali ukuthi kusukelaphi njengoba sekusabalele nemibiko ethi kungase kuhambisane nezenzo zobushokobezi.Ibamba loMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uGeneral Bheki Langa uthe, kunethimba labaphenyi elijutshwe ukuba lizingele libambe abasolwa bajeziswe.- ANA
