text: UMCULI weKwaito uMshoza ubhalele uBabes Wodumo incwadi yokumeseka kulesi sikhathi njengoba kusanda kuvela izinsolo zokuthi ubehlukunyezwa owayeyisoka lakhe, uMampintsha.NgoLwesihlanu olwedlule abantu abaningi kuleli basale beshaqekile ngezinsolo ezivele kwiMetro FM, ohlelweni iThe Drive olwenziwa uMo Flava noMasechaba Ndlovu, lapho uMasechaba aveze ukuthi uyazi ngokuhlukunyezwa kukaBabes Wodumo, athi bekwenziwa uMampintsha.Lo mculi wasekwa abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngemuva kokuvela kwalolu daba, abanye babhekisa intukuthelo yabo kuMampintsha, obengumphathi wakhe nasesitebeleni abeqopha kuso iWest Ink.UMshoza, naye obhekene nodaba olucishe lufane njengamanje, ube ngomunye wosaziwayo abathumelele lo mculi amazwi enduduzo nokumeseka kulesi sikhathi.“Amanxeba abuhlungu ngaphakathi kodwa ngaphandle sishaya sengathi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngesikhathi ngizwa ngesimo obhekene naso izolo ebusuku ngihlulekile ukulala! Bengilokhe ngizibuza ukuyhi senzeni olubi? Sizophendukela kubani?” kubhala uMshoza encwadini ayibhekise kuBabes.Lo mculi uqhube waveza ukuthi akukho lula ukukhuluma ngokuhlukumezeka nokuthi uyafisa ukuba seduzane noBabes kodwa uvinjwa ukuthi usekubhaceni.“Njengoba ngikubhalela le ncwadi ngisekubhaceni, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa. Lo muntu wesilisa uzame ukungiphuca isithunzi sami, kodwa ngikwazile ukuthola amandla ngaphuma. Ngiyathemba ukuthi nawe ngelinye ilanga uzowathola amandla okuthi sekwanele!” kuqhuba yena.UMshoza uthe uBabes akaqine kulesi sikhathi wamazisa nokuthi akekho yedwa. Uthe amanxeba azophola futhi bazoyilwa ndawonye impi yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane.“Ngelinye ilanga lezi zinyembezi zizophenduka zibe yinjabulo,” kusho uMshoza.Incwadi ebhalwe uMshoza'Sengifisa ukwazi ukuthi yena uyongivikela nini emhlabeni' - MampintshaEngxoxweni neSolezwe ngalolu daba uMampintsha uthe usola isandla sesithathu ngezinsolo abekwe zona.Part 2: ‘UBabes uyongivikela nini emhlabeni?’#BabesWodumo#Mampintsha#MasechabaVideo:@FaneleBengupic.twitter.com/bj0he4QanH— Isolezwe Newspaper (@IsolezweNews)May 20, 2018“Inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu kakhulu kuyabonakala ukuthi kunesandla sesithathu. Sikahle noBabes, makufakwa kakhulu izinto zothando, akekho umuntu ongenayo inkinga othandweni kodwa ngendlela asebebeka ngayo: izinto zezibhakela, omongozima nokuphuka komlenze, ngivele ngadunyelwa ngoba naye uBabes uvele waxakeka ukuthi imilenze yayiphuka kanjani, izibhakela kanjani.“Angisona isilwane, uyangazi naye. Ngiyamthanda ngimphilela kakhulu, manje sebengihlasela ngaye. Bengifisa naye uBabes sengathi uNkulunkulu angasisiza, akwazi ukubona lezi zinto zezitha ngoba ekugcineni njengoba ngangimvikela kusuka kuqala uBabes kuze kuba manje, ngaze ngashintsha impilo yami ngendaba yakhe ngoba ngangimthanda," kusho uMampintsha.Lo mculi namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi aziphendulele ohlelweni lukaMasechaba noMo Flava kwiMetro FM.

SELUNGENELELWE uNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka kuzwelonke uTokozile Xasa udaba olusematheni lokuduba uhlelo lwethelevishini bukhoma kowayengumdlali wamaBhokobhoko, u-Ashwin Willemse ngoba ecikwa ukubhuqwa uNaas Botha noNick Mallet.UXasa ukhiphe isitatimende izolo emini emuva kwalesi senzo esenzeke ngoMgqibelo ebusuku uWillemse, Botha noMallet bebesohlelweni olushayelwa uMotshidisi Mohono, kuhlaziywa imidlalo yeVodacom Super Rugby.UWillemse utshele uBotha noMallet (abebedlala ngezikhathi zobandlululo) ukuthi ngeke akumele ukusebenza nabantu abambukela phansi ngokwebala lakhe. Uthe ngeke akwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza nabantu belokhu bembhuqa ekubeni babedlala ngezikhathi zobandlululo.“Kusukela ngaqala ukuzikhulisa ekuziqeqesheni njalo ningibuka njengomdlali owafakwa ngenxa yebala lakhe,” kusho uWillemse ngaphambi kokubalula injabulo yakhe ngokuthi konke lokhu okwenzekayo umhlaba uyabuka kwazise bekubukhoma.Ungqongqoshe uthe: “Le ndlela yokuziphatha kwabathile bebala elimhlophe ngokuzitshela ukuthi ubumhlophe babo busho ukuthi bangcono, kufanele iphele. Ukube akubona ubulwane obabuhambisana nenzondo enkulu yabamnyama ngabe asibanga khona isidingo sokuthi kuze kulwelwe ukuthi isibalo sabamnyama silingane nesabamhlophe,” kusho uXasa.Ukhumbuza izwe lonke ukuthi uWillemse udelelwa nje, akayena umdlali wamaBhokobhoko ojwayelekile kodwa ngo-2003 waqokwa waba iSA Rugby Player of the Year, Young Player of the Year nePlayer’s Player of the Year. Abadlali abafana noWillemse, Bryan Habana noSiyamthanda Kolisi bayisibonelo sokuthi abebala elimnyama abafakwa embhoxweni ngoba kwandiswa isibalo kodwa ithalente libuzwa kubona.UXasa utshele iSuperSport ukuthi iphuthume nophenyo kodwa akulindele ukuthi bakhishwe emoyeni uBotha noMallet.“Uma inkakha yethu ibizwa ngokuthi ingumdlali wokwandisa isibalo sabamnyama lokhu kwenziwa abantu esebenza nabo kwithelevishini, kufanele senze njani? Ukuqhubeka nokubonakala kobuso bukaBotha nobukaMallet kwithelevishini kuzobe kuchaza ukuthi iSuperSport iyavumelana nalobu buzimuzimu ababukhomise kuWillemse,” kusho uXasa.Isikhulu esiphezulu kwiSuperSport, uClinton Van der Berg, sithe: “Sizoqinisekisa ukuthi senza uphenyo olunqala ngalokhu okwenzekile. Siphoxeke kakhulu futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele uma sesiqedile ngophenyo lwethu."Ngesikhathi kuqeda ukwenzeka lokhu, uThando Manana owaziwayo ngokulwela amalungelo abamnyama ezintweni ezithinta umbhoxo ubhale kwiTwitter ehlanganisa naye uWillemse emtshela ukuthi: “Kade ngangikutshela ngalaba ababili (uBotha noMallet) ubavikela. Ngiyajabula ukuthi usuze wazibonela. kufakwe negama likaRobert Marawa kule-Twitter.

IKHOMISHINI yamalungelo abantu ithole igunya lokuvimbela uMnuz Edward Zuma, indodana yowayenguMengameli ukuthi angaphinde enze inkulumo noma izitatimende ezingadala uhlevana emphakathini.UZuma izolo ubevele enkantolo yezokuLingana eThekwini lapho elahlwe khona ngamacala okuhlambalaza, wayalelwa ukuthi axolise ngokubiza uMnuz Pravin Gordhan ngomdayisi, ngonyaka odlule. UZuma uphinde wayalelwa ukuthi akhokhe inhlawulo kaR60 000.Umyalelo ophumile ulandela isivumelwano esenziwe nguZuma nenkantolo izolo.Encwadini evulelekile ngoJulayi ngonyaka odlule, uZuma wahlasela uMnuz Derek Hanekom noGordhan wababiza ngabadayisi nabeseki bosomabhizinisi abamhlophe.UZuma wachaza uGordhan njengeqabane elikhohlakele kwi-ANC, elicabanga ukuthi amalungu kaKhongolose amnyama afanelwe ukusebenza emapulazini atshale umoba.Wabe esebiza uHanekom nge-Askari elimhlophe nenja eqeqeshelwe ukucindezela abantu abamnyama.Ngaleso sikhathi uyise wayesanda kukhomba indlela uHanekom noGordhan.UHanekom noGordhan bobabili babuyiswa nguMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Ikhomishana yamalungelo yakhipha umyalelo othi inkulumo kaZuma isusa uhlevana.Inkantolo inqume ukuthi uma uZuma engawuthobeli umyalelo wenkantolo uzothathelwa izinyathelo.

USATHUTHUMELA owesifazane osinde ngesikhathi indoda yakhe idutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu ngamaphoyisa okuthiwa abephenya entathakusa yangoLwesine eNseleni.UNksz Sihle Mdletshe ubesendlini ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa emzini wabo noMnuz Bhekizenzo Msweli (66), odutshulwe amanxeba amathathu esifubeni wadlavazeka nengalo. UNksz Mdletshe uthe bebelele ngezithuba zabo-1 entathakusa ngesikhathi bezwa kukhonkotha inja egcekeni.“Sesake sangenelwa izigebengu phambilini zizogqekeza imoto. Izimoto ezimbili ubesezipaka eduze komnyango wendlu ukuze ezwe uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngesikhathi inja ikhonkotha wavuka wathatha isibhamu sakhe esisemthethweni, wayovula umnyango wasekhishini lapho bekukhonkotha khona inja,” kuchaza uNksz Mdletshe.Uthe umufi ubesawuvula nje umnyango wezwa kuqhuma isibhamu. Uveze ukuthi wesabile ukuphuma, wezwa umufi ekhala ngokuthi uyafa.“Ungene ekamelweni esaphethe isibhamu, opha kakhulu esifubeni, wafike wawa. Ngizwe kukhona okuqhuma sengathi yibhomu ngasemnyango, ngavele ngaphuma sengiphakamise izandla ngizikhalela kuleli qulu lamadoda ebelisegcekeni. Bangiphushele emnyango bangena endlini bebuza ukuthi ngobani abanye abakhona. Ngibatshele ukuthi kunezingane ezilele kwelinye ikamelo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe kuleli qulu lamadoda bekukhona eyodwa egqoke umfaniswano wamaphoyisa. Usola ukuthi lama doda eqe uthango ngesikhathi engena egcekeni ngoba ebehamba ngezinyawo. Ubone kamuva ukuthi nephoyisa lidubulekile. Uthe la madoda acele awavulele isango efuna ukuvulela i-ambulensi. Emuva kwalesi sigameko uNksz Mdletshe uthe kufike amaphoyisa okuyilapho eqinisekise khona ukuthi nguzakwabo odutshuliwe.Uveze ukuthi usamangele ukuthi ubulaweleni uMsweli ngoba nesibhamu besisemthethweni. Umufi, okuthiwa ubethutha izingane zesikole, ushonele esibhedlela ngoLwesine ekuseni. UNksz Mdletshe uthe ngesikhathi behlaselwa yizigebengu ngo-2016 umufi waqhumisa isibhamu wagcina eboshiwe, waphucwa nesibhamu kodwa icala labuye laphela, nesibhamu sabuyiselwa kuye.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa abelandela uphenyo ngabasolwa abebefuneka ngamacala okuphanga nawokudlwengulwa enziwa ngo-2017.“Amaphoyisa angqongqozile azazisa kodwa kwakhona odubulayo ngaphakathi endlini kwadubuleka iphoyisa ekhandla. Amaphoyisa aphindisele ngenhlamvu kumufi odubuleke esifubeni.“Umufi utholakale nesibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi bayiswe esibhedlela nephoyisa. Kuvulwe icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala, idokodo ladluliselwa kwi-Independent Police Investigative Directorate”.

UMBUZO: Mhla zingu-30 kule nyanga ngizobe ngihlanganisa iminyaka engu-65 kanti kuzobe sekuyisikhathi sokuya empeshenini. Ngizobe ngiqeda iminyaka engu-42 nezinyanga ezinhlanu ngisebenzela uhulumeni. Sonke isikhathi ngisebenza bengikhokha imali nyanga zonke kwi-GEPF - isikhwama sempesheni sabasebenzi bakahulumeni.Ngishadile kanti umhlomulo wami wempesheni uzoba iholo lesibili. Nginemali engiyilondolozile kodwa ngihlela ukungayikhiphi ingakapheli iminyaka emihlanu emuva kokuya empeshenini. Ngihlela ukusebenza izinsuku ezimbalwa ngesonto, ukuze ngikwazi ukuqhubeka nokuhola. Kubukeka ngingeke ngiwuswele umsebenzi.Ngingakhetha kokubili; ukuya empeshenini noma ukwesula emsebenzini. Kepha iningi lozakwethu likhetha ukwesula emsebenzini, lithathe isamba semali kunokuhola impesheni nyanga zonke. Isizathu salokhu wukuthi kungenzeka imali yesikhwama seGEPF isetshenziswe ukutakula iminyango kahulumeni edonsa kanzima. Ukukhula kwemibono mayelana nenkohlakalo kuleli kubhebhethekisa ungabazane.Impendulo:Ukuze ukwazi ukuthola izeluleko ezigcwele kubalulekile ukuqonda kabanzi ngesimo sakho sezimali. Lokhu kubandakanya impahla, izindleko, iholo lazinyanga zonke, intela, isimo sakho sokutshala imali, uhlelo lwefa nokunye. Kuyaye kuhlelwe ngokwezidingo nesimo sakho.Uma ingekho le mniningwane lesi seluleko sizokubeka esithombeni uma ukhetha ukwesula emsebenzini okanye uthathe impesheni.Ukuya empeshenini:Ibhonasi, phecelezi i-13th cheque, ungayilondoloza ukuze kunyuke isamba semali eminyakeni emihlanu.Kuhle ukuba nomshwalense wokungcwaba wenani lika-R7500 kepha kungenzeka ukuba ungeneli izindleko zomgcwabo, itshe nokunye. Kungamele wengeze imali.Imali ekhokhelwa ikhefu inezindleko zentela kepha awulahlekelwa uma wesula emsebenzini.Isibonelelo somshwalense wezempilo sika-R2 159 ngenyanga, ekhuphuka ngonyaka, sikhokhwa impilo yakho yonke.Uma udlula emhlabeni ingakapheli iminyaka emihlanu, umuntu oshade naye uzoqhubeka nokuthola imali bese kuthi emuva kweminyaka emihlanu ahole * -50% wempesheni yakho. Ezinye izimali ziyacwila. Konke lokhu kutholakala uma ukhetha uhlelo lwempesheni olunozinzo kanti olukhuphuka ngo-7.5% (leli phesenti lingaphezulu kwe-inflation).Isamba semali yempesheni esingu-R500 000, nangaphansi, asikhokhelwa intela.Ngokwemigomo yezomsebenzi, ingxenye yemali yempesheni ngeke ibe nezindleko zentela ngokomgomo ka-31 March 1998.Ukwesula emsebenzini:Uma wesula emsebenzini ngalesi skhathi ulahlekelwa yile mhlomulo elandelayo;Ibhonasi yaminyaka yonkeUmshwalense wokungcwabaIsbonelelo somshwalense wezempiloUkukhokhelwa kwekhefu ngokheshiUmhlomulo wokwesula emsebenzini ungafakwa esikhwameni esiseceleni kanti imali ungayigcina ngokuyitshala kutshalomali ozikhethele lona kuze kube uya empeshenini.Uma wesula emsebenzini, ukukwazi ukukhipha okukodwa kokuthathu kwisamba semali (uma isamba sokuqala singekho ngaphezulu kuka-R500 000 awuyikhokhi intela).Isamba esisalayo ungasitshala kwi-living annuity okanye uthathe i-life annuity ene-life assurer.I-life annuity ehlanganiselwe ingathengwa kumshwalense. Kunezinhlelo ezehlukene ezikhona kanti i-annuity ingahlanganiswa ne-inflation ekhokhwa kuze kube kushona oshade naye.I-living annuity inikeza igunya lokuba uzithathele izinqumo kanye nomeluleki wezezimali. Kulolu hlelo ukukhishwa kwemali kuba kanye ngonyaka (imali elinganiselwa ku- 2.5% wesamba semali esingakhuphuka sibe ku-17.5%) yize singaphakamisa ukuba ibe phakathi kuka- 5 no-6%. Uma udlula emhlabeni, yonke imali idluliselwa kwabasohlwini lwabazohlomula okanye izingane zakho. Bangaqhubeka nokukhipha imali.Okubi ngalolu hlelo lwe-living annuity ngukuthi, ubungozi botshalomali bubheka wena. Izinqumo ezingaphusile nokukhipha imali ngokungenamkhawulo kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle kuwe ngakho-ke kusemqoka ukuba ufune umeluleki uma uya empeshenini.Ukuxhumanane- Inkunzi Wealth Group sishayele ku-087 1600 018, noma usithumelele i-email ku:[email protected]

ULAHLWE yicala wagwetshwa izinyanga ezintathu ebhadla ejele owesifazane wase-United Arab Emirates obepequlula iselula yomyeni wakhe ngesikhathi yena esathatha isithongwana.Lo wesifazane kuthiwa unele wabona ukuthi isinqandamathe sakhe sihuqa obudala, wathi ngibonwa yini wayigwexa iselula ethutha izithombe nemiyalezo ekufaka kwenye iselula ukuze akucubungule kahle esenesikhathi.Kuthiwa ubethumela nakumaselula odadewabo imiyalezo ayisolayo. Kuthiwa le ndoda ithe ivuka yabona ukuthi lo wesifazane ubematasa ngeselula yayo yavele yafaka icala enkantolo idinwa ukuthi akazihloniphi izindaba zayo zangasese.Inkantolo yaseRas Al Khaimah ebihlalele lolu daba ithe impela le ndoda ihlukunyeziwe, aphuliwe amalungelo ayo.Lo wesifazane uthe umyeni wakhe wamnika inombolo eyimfihlo yokuvula iselula ngesikhathi ebambe ukuthi kunowesifazane oyishende lakhe abhizi naye.Kuthiwa leli zwe linomthetho oqondile othinta izindaba zobuchwepheshe besimanje namaselula.Abantu kuTwitter bebezwelana nalo wesifazane bethi ukube bekungekho mikhuba ayisolayo, ubengeke ayiguduze iselula yendoda yakhe.Bathi kuyihlazo ukuthi indoda igqume ejele umkayo. Abanye bebethi kukahle impela ukuba ayobhadla ejele ngoba upekequla izindaba ezingahlangene naye. -The Daily Mail

INYUNYANA yamaciko, iCreative Workers Union of South Africa (Cwusa) KwaZulu-Natal, izibophezele ekubambisaneni neSolezwe ekulweni nesihlava sokubulawa nokuhlaselwa kwabantu besifazane.Ukwanda kwezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kwenze Isolezwe lahlela umkhuleko ngaphansi komkhankaso i#Sekwanele. Umkhuleko ngowokushweleza kuNkulunkulu ukuthi lezi zigameko ziphele. Uzoba seThekwini Community Church ngo-10 ekuseni ngoLwesine.Omunye wabaholi beCwusa, uThokozani “T’zozo” Zulu, uthe bazoba yingxenye yomkhuleko ngoba abahambisani nokuthi abantu besifazane bahlale behamba bejeqeza.“Aseneme ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane, babalulekile empilweni ngoba yibo inzalabantu,” kusho uT’zozo.Uqhube wathi bayabafundisa nabaculi abasafufusa ngokuthi benze umculo onomyalezo ukuze kushintshe izwe.“Ngihlale ngithi akukwazi ukuthi umculi athi efika bese ecula ngokuthi uyisikhokho kangakanani. Kungcono abhale ingoma enomyalezo. Bheka nje sizenzile izingoma ezikhuluma ngokuphepha emgwaqweni, iVal’ingozi, kukhona enye ye-Operation Hlasela eyayikhuluma ngokuthi abantu babikeubugebengu emaphoyiseni ubugebengu futhi kukhona nenye esayenza noPhuzekhemisi eyayigxeka ukucwasa ngokobuzwe. Zonke izinto ezikhungethe umphakathi siyaye sikhulume ngazo ngoba ubuciko buneqhaza elikhulu. Bheka nje oHugh Masekela noMbongeni Ngema bayibamba ishisa belwa nobandlululo kanjalo noSam Nzima obefihlwa ngempelasonto,” kusho uT’zozo.Umkhuleko uzoqala ngo-10 ekuseni kanti wonke umuntu uvumelekile.

IVULELWE icala lokushaya imeya kaMasipala Umfolozi uMnuz Smangaliso Mgenge okuthiwa ishaye ikhansela leDA bebanga ihholo lomphakathi iHlanganani eJ1 eSikhaleni ngeSonto.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Sphesihle Magubane oyikhansela le-DA, ingxabano eholele ekushayweni kwakhe iqale ngombango wehholo okuthiwa belizosetshenziselwa umhlangano weqembu. Uthi bahlangabezane nembibizane ngesikhathi bethola ukuthi ne-ANC iyalisebenzisa ihholo. "Ngangena ehholo esasilicelile kumasipala kanti sekukhona uMgenge namanye amalungu e-ANC. Ngazama ukuchaza, bavele balwa nami bangethuka, uMgenge wangiphushela odongeni wangishaya wangidonsela phandle."UMgenge uyakuchitha konke lokhu uthi, empeleni yena ubelamula ngesikhathi kukhona ukuhilizisana phakathi kwamalungu e-DA nawe-ANC. "Ukube ngamshaya, ngabe usaphila kodwa? Ngabe akahambi ekhuluma kanje ukube washawa lo muntu. Bangena ngendlovuyangena emhlanganweni wethu wokulungeselela ingqungquthela yesifunda iMusa Dladla. Amanye amalungu ethu ayefuna ukumqondisa, ngangena ngamshwelezela."Uthe umangele uma sekuthiwa uvulelwe icala lokushaya ekubeni kuyena owayelamula.LIFUNA ubulungiswa ikhansela le-DA uMnuz Siphesihle Magubane omangalele iMeya uSimangaliso Mgenge ngokumshaya Izithombe : ZITHUNYELWEUMagubane uthe luselude ukhalo olusazohanjwa ngoba usazoludlulisela kwezinye izinhlaka lolu daba."Umuntu osesikhundleni sikaMgenge kufanele abe umgqugquzeli woxolo, hhayi abe uphakimpi," kuqhuba uMagubane othe lokhu akwenzayo kuyingozi ngoba isifundazwe sihlaselwe udlame lwezepolitiki, okungaziwa ukuthi kuzoze kuthandazwe muphi umthandazo ukuze luphele.UMgenge ukhale ngokuthi leli khansela alihloniphi likhombise ukuba luhlaza ngesikhathi likhuluma nabo libafica emhlanganweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi icala livuliwe wathi kodwa akekho umuntu osaboshiwe kusaqhubeka uphenyo.

SELUZONGENELELWA uMnyango wezeMpilo nowezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal udaba lokuhlala kwezingane ehostela labesifazane, uMasipala weTheku othi lokhu kuphambene nesimo sempilo yazo.Izolo iNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini itshele abameli bezinhlangothi zombili ezithinteka kulolu daba ukuthi bathintane nale minyango ukuze iphenye ngesimo senhlalo yezingane kuleli ehostela elibizwa ngeThokoza. Umasipala ukhala ngokuthi leli hostela alilungele ukuhlala izingane futhi ligcwele. Abesifazane abahlala kulo, izolo bathe bancamela ukuhlala nezingane zabo ngaphandle kwaleli hostela elisemgwaqweni uYusuf Dadoo eThekwini, uma inkantolo igcina ibalahla.Ijaji lithe yize lizizwa izikhalo zomama abangafuni ukuhlukaniswa nezingane zabo, azikulungele ukuhlala kuleli hostela. “Nisho ukuthi ingane yomfana eneminyaka engu-16 kuhle ukuthi isebenzise indlu yokugeza nabesifazane nezinye izingane zamantombazane?” kubuza ijaji.Lithe ngeke kulunge nokuthi kuvunyelwe kuphela izingane zamantombazane ukuhlala nonina ngoba kuzobe kuncisha ilungelo ezabafana. Liyalele abameli ukuthi namuhla babuyele kulona ukuzobhunga ukuthi bazoyimisa kanjani eyokufaka iminyango kulolu daba. Liphakamise nokuthi le minyango inikezwe okungenani izinyanga ezimbili ukuze iphenye ngesimo sasehostela. Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoLwesihlanu.U-Advocate Sarah Jane Linscott omele abahlali, ukwamukele ukuthi kuthintwe iminyango kodwa wakhala ngokuthi sekuyisikhathi eside umasipala ungenazinhlelo ngalolu daba njengoba lwangena enkantolo ngo-2015.Omama bebephume ngobuningi, abanye bebehamba nezingane zabo. Bekukhona nabahlali bamanye amahostela abazwelana nomama baseThokoza.UNksz Phumzile Mpontshane usehlale eThokoza kusukela ngo-2002, unezingane ezimbili eneminyaka ewu-10 neno-2. Uthe ngeke akwazi ukuhlukana nezingane zakhe njengoba sekwande ukuhlukunyezwa kwazo. Uthe angenza noma yini ukuze avunyelwe ukuhlala nezingane zakhe.UNksz Zakhona Radebe onamadodakazi amabili eno-4 no-12, uthe akazimisele ukuya ndawo futhi uzohlala nezingane zakhe. Uthe uma umasipala ubakhipha awubafunele izindlu abazohlala kuzo nemindeni. Udaba lombango wezingane kuleli hostela lwangena enkantolo ngo-2015. Omama bebekhala ngokuthi bayazishushumbisa ngenxa yokuthi azivunyelwe ukuhlala.

source: amabhizinisi ethu awiswa yilaba bokufika emalokishini
text: YIZE uhulumeni KwaZulu-Natal usungenelele odabeni lokuzanywa kokususwa kwabadayisi bokufika ezindaweni zabamnyama kodwa kubukeka kuvunguza umoya ongemuhle. Ubuholi beNorth Regional Business Association (Norba), bunqumele ugwayi katiki laba badayisi abangakudabuka eSomali nase-Ethiopia ukuthi baphume kulezi zindawo lungakashayi uLwesine. UDELI MNCWABE uxoxe kabanzi nonobhala weNorba uMnuz Mlungisi Mncube ngalolu daba.YIZIPHI izinkinga eninazo ngokudayisa kwabokufika?ZININGI izinkinga esinazo, futhi siqale ngo-2015 . Laba bantu abahambisi ngendlela, bawisa amabhizinisi ethu.Sikhathele yibona. Uma uhulumeni engasizi sizobakhipha ezindaweni abadayisela kuzona.KUNGANI nizoze nibakhiphe. Benzeni?LABA bantu bafika ezindaweni bakhe eceleni kwebhizinisi lakho. Uma sebefikile baqhamuka nentengo ephansi eyenza amakhasimende angabe esathenga kuwena, kugcine kulimale ibhizinisi. Abanye bagcina bewelwe amabhizinisi abeseneminyaka, edonsa ko-40. Laba bantu bayingozi ngoba nezimpahla zokudayisa bazithola mahhala ngoba basetshenziswa amaNdiya angabanikazi bezinxanxathela zezitolo zabadayisela abadayisi ezibhekene nenkinga yokuhweba ngoba izimpahla zabo azithengwa manje. Thina uma sithi siyothenga sifika sebenikwe konke.NGICELA ungicacisele ephuzwini lokuthi bayaphiwa izimpahla zokudayisa. Lokhu kwenzeka kanjani ngoba ngicabanga ukuthi baningi abangakuthokozela ukuphiwa impahla yokudayisa?NGIYABONA awungizwa kahle uma ngithi bayanikwa, bayaphiwa nje. Ngicabanga ukuthi bahlangana emasontweni kanje. Kusuka abanikazi bezinxanxathela nezitolo ezidayisela abadayisi, bathenge indawo ezindaweni zabamnyama, bafake abalisa mhlawumbe abane noma abahlanu ukuba badayise. Bawola amakhasimende ngokubiza kancane. Akupheli sikhathi esingakanani ibhizinisi labo likhule, kuthi laba abafakwe kulona nabo baphume baqale awabo ngokushesha. Uma sesiwile esakho, bafuna ukusirentela kodwa futhi uma unqaba bavele bafake inqwaba yamakhonteyina.KUNGENZEKA yini ukuthi nina nihlulwa wukuncintisana?KUYINI kanti ukuncintisana? Ngoba phela laba bantu abazile ngokuncintisana kodwa bazowisa umsebenzi wethu. Yingakho sinxuse ikhomishini yezokuncintisana ingenelele.NJENGOBA nibeke umnqamlajuqu kuzokwenzekani?UMA kungekho sixazululo sizobakhipha ezindaweni abasebenzela kuzona ngenkani.LOKHU enizokwenza ngeke yini kususe uthuthuva olungaholela ekuhlukunyezweni kwabokufika?ASINANDABA noma lungasuka ngoba kuzoveza ihlazo likahulumeni lokwehluleka wukusizwa. Sizobanxusa baphume, uma bengakwenzi sizothatha impahla yabo siyoyilahla eDube Tradeport. Anginendaba nejele uma ngiboshwa, bakhona abazosala benze umsebenzi kodwa mhla ngaphuma kuyonakala.

source: imibono ngiwubona uxova izindlu zasendlunkulu umnyango wakwacogta
text: MHLELI: Kunento edumazayo ngoMnyango wezobuholi boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal. Ngabe abanye ondabezitha KwaZulu-Natal bayayibona yini indlela amakhosi aphethwe ngayo? Lo mnyango uxova izindlu zasendlunkulu ngenhloso yokuqhatha ukuze kufezeke izinhloso zawo.Thina eMabovini eMsinga sinenkinga yokuphoqwa yilo mnyango ukuba siphathwe ngenkani yinkosi engafunwa yisizwe nengafanele ukubusa. Singabantwana baseMabovini sathatha incwadi eyabhalwa yisizwe yokungayethembi inkosi saze sacela owabe engumengameli ngo-2014 ukuba asitholele uNgqongqoshe uNomusa Dube-Ncube nebala sahlangana naye eThekwini.Wabe esethumela ithimba labameli kwathi ngomhla ka 23 ngoDisemba 2014 kwafika ithimba lakwaCogta laba nomhlangano nathi laphinde laba nomunye eceleni neqeqebana lenkosi basitshela izinto ezehlukene. Kwasikhalisa kakhulu lokho.Kwaba nomunye umhlangano wakwaCogta ngomhla ka-28 Agasti 2015 basitshela ukuthi asivele sikhohlwe ngoba osesikhundleni ngeke asuswe kusona ngoba esakhe sizichithela isikhathi. Kwaze kwakhuza omunye wabo wathi akaxolise owayesho lokho kwasibonisa ngokusobala ukuthi umnyango uchemile.Ngo-2004 mhla ka-29 kuJanuwari owayengumengameli uMnuz Thabo Mbeki wayevakashele eMsinga eTugela Ferry ngambhalela incwadi ngimazisa ngobuqili bukaCogta. Wangeluleka ngeKhomishana kaNhlapho ngo-2005 ngagcwalisa ifomu ngalithumela kuyona maqede kwathula kwathi nya. Kuze kwathi ngo-2015 ngezwa sengithintwa wumasipala waseMsinga, ngithintwa abasesiteshini samaphoyisa ngoba babengenalo ucingo lwami saxhumana nabo base bethi asihlangane esikoleni iSomashi High.Udaba lwahlalelwa phansi izinhlaka zonke zikhona. Sesilinde iminyaka emithathu njengoba u-2018 sekungowesine nawo usuzophela. Umbuzo uthi ngabe kuyasetshenzwa noma kuyadlalwa?Besicela iSilo samaBandla sibambisane noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bangenelele kulolu daba lwaMabovu ngoba noNdunankulu sesimbhalele sahluleka akasiphenduli.Senzani J Ngubane (Umntwana)

source: ushicilele incwadi esejele owabulala intombi yakhe
text: UBHALE incwadi esejele exwayisa abantu ngokushintsha indlela abacabanga ngayo, umbhali waKwaMashu owaboshelwa ukubulala intombi yakhe.ULungelo Shandu (31) oseneminyaka emibili ephume ngoshwele ejele, ubhale incwadi ethi Success and Wealth Through The Bible. Le ncwadi wayibhala ejele yaphuma ngo-2015 esaboshiwe njengoba ehlale iminyaka emine ngaphakathi.“Ngaboshelwa ukubulala ngoba umzala wami ngamfica elele nentombi yami. Ngabashaya bobabili ngezandla ngingaphethe sikhali, umzala waphunyuka wabaleka. Intombi yashona, ngaboshwa ngagwetshwa iminyaka engu-10 kwalengiswa emibili. Ngalivuma icala enkantolo, ngabhalela nomndeni wentombi ngixolisa ngesenzo sami,” echaza.Uthe ngaphambi kwalesi sigameko wake wayikhuza intombi yakhe ngezenzo zayo ezimbi, wathembisa nokuthi ngelinye ilanga uyoyishaya ayibulale.Lokhu kwamfundisa ukuthi izenzo zomuntu zisukela emicabangweni yakhe njengoba nakuyena kwenzeke kanjalo.UShandu uthe ngaphambi kokuboshwa wayephuza kakhulu utshwala edla nezidakamizwa.Waqhubeka nalokhu engaphakathi ejele, washintsha eminyakeni emibili yokugcina ayihlale khona.“Ukuba sejele kwanginikeza isikhathi esiningi sokufunda. Ngaphuma sengifunde izincwadi ezingu-100, ngafunda ngisho iBhayibheli. Yize ngizisola ngesenzo sami kodwa ukuhlala ejele akuyimoshanga impilo, kunalokho kwayilungisa. Ngesikathi ngingaphakathi ngafunda ukuhweba, ngafunda nolimi iSpanish nomdlalo iHigh Jump.”Uthe walucela uxolo emdenini kamufi, wacela osonhlalakahle bamhlanganise nawo ngesikhathi esejele. Kule ncwadi ufundisa abantu ngokunaka imicabango yabo ukuze bathathe izinqumo eziphusile. Uthe incwadi yakhe isishintshe abaningi abafakazayo ukuthi isibasizile ukubhekana nezinselelo zempilo. Incwadi ifundisa nokuthi abantu baphola kanjani ebuhlungwini benhliziyo nokuthi baphile impilo enokuthula.Iyatholakala ezitolo zakwa-Adams and Griggs nakwi-internet. Ngaphandle kwencwadi uShandu uhambela imiphakathi nezikole enikeza izinkulumo ezakhayo.Lokhu wakuqala engaphakathi ejele, ephumela emiphakathini ukuyoqwashisa nangezidakamizwa.Uke wasebenza neMeya yaseMgungundlovu uMnuz Themba Njilo emikhankasweni yokuthuthukisa umphakathi.Uke waba nohlelo lwezinkulumo ezakhayo kwiMbokodo FM wabuye wahamba noMnyango wezokuBuciko, amaSiko nezeMidlalo KwaZulu-Natal.

ISAZI sezulu sithi lizona kuze kube yimpelasonto KwaZulu-Natal kodwa okwamanje asikho isexwayiso esikhishiwe kwazise kulindelwe u60% wemvula ezindaweni ezigudle ugu nezimaphakathi nesifundazwe.UMnuz Wisani Maluleke, oyisazi sezulu kwaSouth African Weather Service, uthe namhlanje izulu lizoqhubeka nokuna kuyo yonke iKwaZulu-Natal kusukela eMargate kuze kuyoba seKosi Bay kodwa izothi ukuncipha kusasa kwazise kulindelwe ukuthi liguqubale.NgoMgqibelo kulindelwe u-30% wemvula ekuseni nantambama,Uthe kuzoba nomoya ogudla ngamandla ezindaweni ezigudle ugu.UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe amathimba akhe ezinhlekelele ami ngomumo.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba, uNkk Dube-Ncube uthe namhlanje uzobe eKwaNongoma eqwashisa abantu ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu njengoba kuqala ihlobo.Uthe ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuza nezinkinga zezikhukhula, ezombani, izishingishane nomlilo wamadlelo.Kulindeleke ukuthi namhlanje kuqale uhlelo lokunika abantu izinsiza zokuvika umbani.Ezinyangeni ezimbili ezidlule kufe abantu KwaNongoma emuva kokushaywa wumbani.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe uzovakashela imindeni eshelwe yizindlu ngenxa yezulu futhi uzobe ehambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Belinda Scott.“Ngaphandle kokuvakashela umphakathi ngizophinde ngikhiphe amathimba ezinhlekelele ukuze ahlale eqaphile ngoba ucwaningo luveza ukuthi umbani uhlasela kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal futhi kushona nabantu. Ngizoqwashisa umphakathi ngomthelela wesivuvujikelele ukuze uhlale uqaphile,” kusho uNkk Dube-Ncube esitatimendeni.Mayelana nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ezivimba izulu KwaNongoma, uNkk Dube-Ncube uthe baqale ukuzikhipha ezindaweni zasemakhaya ngoba izulu elibulala abantu livamise ukudlalela ezindaweni ezisemakhaya.

MHLELI: Ake ngizwakalise ukukhathazeka kwami ngokuhluphekela amanzi endaweni yakithi eCinci, kwesaKwaMthethwa.Ompompi bomile emagcekeni, amanzi sawagcina ngo-2014 kuzoba wukhetho lukazwelonke. Uma udinga amanzi kufanele uyogwedla ipitsi. Kuyathusa ukuthi eminyakeni engu-24 kusekhona abantu abaswele amanzi nezindlu zomxhaso. Amaloli aletha amanzi afika kanye emuva kwezinyanga ezimbili.Izindlu zomxhaso zabhaliswa, kwafakwa izinombolo, kwakhiwa zangaphela, kume izindonga nje. Lokho-ke kushiya imibuzo yokuthi imali eyayikhishelwe ukwakhela abantu izindlu yashonaphi.Ngiyafisa ukuba izikhulu zomnyango oqondene nokunikezelwa kwamanzi emphakathini nezomnyango wezezindlu zike zivakashele eCinci zibone usizi esikulo.Robert MdladlaECINCI

source: unqatshelwe ibheyili osephenduke umgodi onganukwanja emndenini wakhe
text: UNQATSHELWE ibheyili owesilisa owabiza uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngegama lokucwasa abantu abamnyama eliqala ngo-K, kwivideo eyasabalala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngenyanga edlule. UMnuz Kessie Nair (60) ubhekene namacala ayisikhombisa okwehlisa isithunzi namabili okukhomoza umuntu ukuba ephule umthetho.UNair unqatshelwe ibheyili enkantolo yeMantshi eVerulam ngoLwesithathu ekuseni. IMantshi uNcumisa Gcolotela izwakalise ukushaqeka ngokwashiwo uNair kwivideo ayifaka kuFacebook. Ngesikhathi echitha isicelo sakhe sebheyili uGcoboleta uthe esinye sezizathu salokhu ukuthi uhlulekile ukunikeza inkantolo  eminye iminingwano yendawo angahlala kuyo ngaphandle kwekamfowabo oziqhelelanisile naye.Enkantolo uNair ubebukeka engakugqizi qakala konke obekushiwo yiMantshi ngesikhathi yethula isinqumo.FUNDA:Udutshwe wumndeni ocwase uRamaphosaUGcoleta uqhube wathi ukusetshenziswa kwegama eliqala-ngoK lokucwasa kuyohlezi kuzwisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ubuhlungu.Uthe uNair ukhombisa ukungaqodi ukuthi abucayi kangakanani amacala abhekene nawo. Uthe ukhombise nokudelela inkantolo ngokunqaba ukusebenzisana nomphenyi wecala.  Udaba luhlehliselwe u-Okthoba 24.Ngesikhathi evela phambilini enkantolo uNair waveza ukuthi unesifo senhliziyo ngakho ngeke akwazi ukuba sejele ngoba usohlwini lwabalinde ukufakelwa inhliziyo. Umndeni wakhe waveza ukuthi uma ephuma ejele ngebheyili awufuni nakumbona kufanele azibonele ukuthi ushonaphi.

SIYAQHUBEKA nokushuba isimo kwiDemocratic Allaince kulandela imibiko yokuthi uNkk Patricia De Lille angase ashaye ungqimphotho odabeni lokusula njengeMeya yaseCape Town.NgoLwesine ekuseni ngesikhathi kuhlangene umkhandlu, uSotswebhu omkhulu weDA eKapa, uMnuz Shaun August, uthuse abaningi ememezela ukuthi uyasula kulesi sikhundla futhi uyasula njengelungu leDA ekhala ngokucwaswa kuleli qembu.“Isinqumo sami akusona engivele ngasithatha kalula nje uma ubuka ukuthi ngichithe iminyaka emibili edlule ngithwele kanzima ngenxa yokucwaswa nokucindezelwa iDA ebikubhekisa kimi,” kusho u-August.“Ngeke ngisakwazi ukusebenzela iqembu elibukela phansi imizamo yami yokuthi abantu balingane kuleli. Ngeke ngisakwazi ukusebenzela iqembu elisho okunye lenze okunye ngapha.”AMALUNGU e-ANC ejabula kulandela ukusula kukaMnuz Shaun Abrahams njengekhansela nelungu leDA ngoba ethi akasakwazi ukukumela okwenziwa yiDA kwiMeya yaseKapa uNkk Patricia De Lille. Isithombe: Ayanda Ndamane African News Agency (ANA)Isimemezelo sika-August silandelwe amanye amalungu amane eDA nawo athe ayayilaxa le nhlangao. Amakhansela asulile uMnuz Siya Mamkeli, uNksz Suzette Little, uMnuz Greg Bernado noMnuz Thulani Stemela.Ekuseni uDe Lille ugxeke abaholi be-DA athe bamatasa babeka isithombe esibi ngaye kwabezindaba. Lokhu kulandela umbiko kaBowman Gilfillan obuphenya ngezinsolo zobukhonyovu nokungaphathwa kahle kwezimali kumasipala waseKapa.UDe Lille usekuchithe kaningi ukuthi kukhona ubukhonyovu obuthinta yena kulo mkhandlu, kangangokuba wathembisa ukusula njengeMeya uma iDA ihoxisa amacala emsola ngawo.Nokho iDA kamuva nje isanda kweseka umbiko kaBowman kanti sekubikwa ukuthi uDe Lille angase ashintshe umqondo ngokusula kulesi sikhundla abathembise ukukwenza ekupheleni kuka-Okthoba.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili ngesonto elizayo amaphoyisa amabili nonogada abasolwa ngokuthumba usomabhizinisi nokusolwa ukuthi kuthinteka amabhizinisi nodaba lwamathenda ngokunyamalala kwakhe.UMnuz Sikhumbuzo Mjwara (41) ulahleke ekupheleni kuka-Agasti nonyaka kade eseNkantolo yaseVerulam ehamba icala lombango phakathi kwakhe nozakwabo ababanga naye ubunikazi bendawo ephambili yokudla eMhlanga, iBarrio. Umndeni wakhe uveze ukuthi wazi ukuthi uzakwabo wakokotela amaphepha amenza kube nguyena ophethe le ndawo yokudla eseMhlanga ekubeni bengalihlanganisele ibhizinisi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uLt Colonel Thulani Zwane ukuqinisekisile ukuthi babophe abasolwa ababili ngodaba lokuthunjwa kwalo somabhizinisi.“Uphiko lwe-Organised Crime Unit lubophe abasolwa ababili abaneminyaka engu-35 no-37 ngo-Okthoba 3 ngecala lokuthumba. Bavele eNkantolo yaseVerulam, icala lahlehliselwa u-Okthoba 15. Bagcinwe esitokisini. Omunye umsolwa oneminyaka engu-37 uboshwe ngo-Okthoba 4. Uvele enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 5. Naye usatokile,” kusho uZwane.Laba bobathathu bazobuyela enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 15.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi izolo kuboshwe elinye iphoyisa lisemhlanganweni wokuqeqesha abaphenyi ngalo leli cala kodwa lokhu akuzange kuqinisekiswe ngamaphoyisa.Kuboshwa laba nje lo somabhizinisi akakatholakali.Umfowabo walo somabhizinisi uMnuz Philani Bhengu ethintwa yiSolezwe izolo uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi abazi ukuthi umfowabo ukephi.“Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi kukhona ababoshelwe ukuthumba umfowethu, okubuhlungu ukuthi asazi ukuthi ukephi kuze kube manje. Asazi noma uthunjelwe umbango wamabhizinisi akhe noma amathenda. Siyasola nokho ukuthi ukulahleka kwakhe kusondelene nomsebenzi wakhe abewenza wamabhizinisi namathenda. Sisebumnyameni nje. Sesithembe laba ababoshiwe ukuthi bazokhuluma iqiniso,” kusho uBhengu.UMjwara kuthiwa waduka ngelanga athathwa ngalo ngamaphoyisa, phambi kwengoduso yakhe nonogada wakhe eNkantolo yaseVerulam, akaphindange wabonakala. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi bemthatha bathi uyophenywa ngecala elithize elithinta amathenda.

source: i anc emhlanganweni ophuthumayo ngolwevbs mutual bank
text: ABAHOLI be-ANC eLimpopo ngoMsombuluko bazohlangana nabaholi benhlangano eLuthuli House kulandela ukuvela kwe-ANC kulabo abasolwa ngokuhlomula ekuxetshulweni kwezigidigidi zamarandi kwiVBS Mutual Bank.NgeSonto i-ANC ithe ayinaso isiqiniseko ngokuthi yayithola yini imali eyavela ngokukhwabaniswa kwemali ebalelwa ku-R2 billion kuleli bhange. I-ANC ihlangana nje igama layo livezwe owayengusihlalo weVBS Mutual Bank, uMnuz Tshifhiwa Matodzi, obale neDA, SACP ne-EFF kulabo ‘abahlomula’ kwimali eyebiwe.Okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uMnuz Pule Mabe, uthe uyazi ngezinsolo zokuthi iqembu elibusayo lacela futhi lathola uxhaso kuleli bhange.“Siyazi ngalezi zinsolo futhi sisazama ukuthola kwihhovisi lomgcinimafa ukuthi ziyiqiniso yini. Okwamanje ngeke ngikwazi ukuphawula ngokuthi izinsolo ziyiqiniso noma cha. Ngisalinde ubufakazi. Izinsolo ezibucayi lezi ngakho sidinga ukucophelela,” kusho uMabe. Uthe inhlangano ebusayo ayifisi ukuchitha lezi zinsolo bese kujika kuvele ukuthi bayithola imali kuleli bhange.Okhulumela iDA kuzwelonke uMnuz Solly Malatsi ukukhahlele ngezinyawo zombili ukuthi yake yacela noma yathola uxhaso kwiVBS Mutual Bank.“I-DA ayikaze ithole ngisho isenti kwiVBS. Lezi zinsolo azilona iqiniso,” kusho uMalatsi.NgoLwesine ngesonto eledlule iDA yavula icala ifuna bonke abathintekayo ekudliweni kwemali yeVBS Mutual Bank babhekane nengalo yomthetho. Noma uMatodzi ebalwa njengobhongoza ekudliweni kwemali kwibhange lokuqala ebeliphethwe abantu abamnyama kuphela kuleli, akahlatshwanga ngemibuzo ngesikhathi u-Adv Terry Motau enza uphenyo. UMotau uthe akakhulumanga noMatodzi ngoba ukhombise ukungathembeki ngesikhathi edlelwa impahla yakhe.“Ukuphika kwakhe ukuthi uyingxenye yabantu abadale le nhlekelele ebhange kushayisana nobufakazi obuningi obukhomba ukuthi nguyena obengubhongoza wayo yonke lento. Ngenxa yokuzihlangula kwakhe ngabona ukuthi kuzofana nokumosha isikhathi ukumnikeza ithuba lokuthi abeke uhlangothi lwakhe. Lokho uyokwena kwenye inkundla ngesinye isikhathi,” kusho uMotau.I-EFF ngakolunye uhlangothi ithe izophendula ngalezi zinsolo esithangamini nabezindaba ngoLwesibili.

MHLELI: Sidinga ukushayelwa ihlombe isimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu- Natal uNkk Weziwe Thusi. Ngokombiko weSolezwe ngo-Okthoba 8, 2018 ungqongqoshe ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi bahlele imindeni enkulumeni okuthiwa ayethule ngeWorld Population Day.Empeleni kufanele ngabe bonke abaholi yivangeli abalishumayela ngokukhulu ukukhuthala leli lokukhuthaza abantu ukuhlela umndeni.Ivangeli lokuhlelwa komndeni yinto esiyidinga cishe ukudlula zonke izinto esizolokhu sicefezelwa ngazo njengoba kuza imikhankaso yokhetho maduzane nje. Kuliqiniso elaziwayo ukuthi ububha okuhlasele abantu abamnyama kubuye kubangelwe nayikho ukuzalwa kwezingane kungaziwa nokuthi zizokondleka kanjani.Akusavamisile ukuzwa abantu bekhuluma inkulumo ebaluleke njengalena eyethulwe nguNkk Thusi.Eminyakeni edlule ihhovisi likaNdunankulu wesifundazwe saKwaZulu Natal lamemezela ukuthi linemali eyizigidi elizoyisebenzisa ukulwa nama-blesser. Kuyadabukisa ukusho ukuthi leyo mali kwagcina kungacacanga kahle ukuthi yabe izosetshenziswa kanjani ukuze ihlenge eyabe iphume egameni labo.Mhlawumbe bekungakuhle leyo mali uma kungukuthi isakhona iphinde isetshenziswe ukuphusha imikhankaso yokuqwashisa mayelana nokuhlela umndeni.Yize indaba yokuhlela umndeni ithinta wonke umuntu kodwa kungaba ngumqondo omuhle ukuthi imikhankaso enjalo igxiliswe kakhulu entsheni ikakhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemijondolo.Ucwaningo lwami lukhomba ukuthi abesilisa nabesifazane abasebasha bathola izingane besafunda isikole. Baqeda isikole noma bashiye phakathi bayosebenza emadolobheni amakhulu bafike bahlale ezindaweni eziyimijondolo nasemahostela baqhubeke nokuthola izingane ngaphandle kokuqondisisa kahle isimo sabo sezomnotho. Nezingane ezisuke zizalelwe ezindaweni ezingahlelekile nazo ziyakhula ziqhubeke nokuzalela khona lapho zikhulele khona.Izingane abazithola edolobheni bazihambisa emakhaya lapho bevela khona. Nakhona emakhaya kusuke kunezingane abazishiye khona abazithola besafunda isikole. Abanye bazigcina khona emadolobheni zikhulele emijondolo ngezizathu ezahlukene.Yize izingane ezizalwe zakhulela emalokishini zizalisana kodwa kuvamise ukuthi emva kokuthola ingane eyodwa zingabe zisaqhubeka nokuzala kuze kube yisikhathi esifanele. Kungalezi zizathu ngithi ukugqugquzelwa kokuhlela umndeni kufanele kuhanjiswe nakakhulu ezindaweni engizibalule ngenhla. Mhlawumbe namabandla amahlelo ahlukene kungakuhle abambisane nezinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuphusha lo mkhankaso.Ngokombiko we-United Nations eminyakeni engu 50 ezayo isibalo sabantu emhlabeni kulindeleke senyukele ku-9 billion. Ngokwe-United Nations kumele kuqhanyukwe nezindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukudla ukuze abantu bezoba nokudla okwanele emhlabeni jikelele.Umbiko we-United Nations usitshela ukuthi ukwanda kwabantu kumele kuhambisane nokubakhona kokudla. Impela kuzofanele siyisukumele sonke le ndaba ngoba iKZN ihlala ihamba phambili uma kukhulunywa ngezinto ezinomthelela omubi kwinhlalakahle yomphakathi.Eugene Biyela

PHEZU kokuba uhulumeni elokhu emile ekutheni ngeke badilizwe abasebenzi kodwa kucace bha izolo uNgqongqoshe weziMali uMnuz Tito Mboweni ethula isabelo sezimali samaphakathi nonyaka ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle njengoba ekubeke kwacaca ukuthi ayikho imali ezofakwa yokukhokhela abasebenzi.UMboweni uthe isivumelwano samaholo singaphezulu ngoR30.2 billion kunalokhu obekuhleliwe.Uthe ngenxa yalokhu ngeke kube khona imali ezofakwa ngumgcinimafa. “Ayikho imali ezofakwa okungeyabasebenzi. Ayikho imali yamaholo. Iminyango kuzomele ifune imali ngaphakathi ukuze ikhokhele abasebenzi. Kuzomele ibhekisiswe eyokusebenza isikhathi esengeziwe kanjalo nokukhokhelwa kwabantu amabhonasi ngokwenza kahle."Uhulumeni ubehlele ukuthi uzokhokha uR212.5 billion wamaholo abasebenzi onyakeni wezimali kodwa le mali yanyuka ngemuva kwesivumelwano yaba nguR242.7 billion, yanyuka ngoR30 billion.Imali ekhokhelwa abasebenzi ingu35% wemali echithwa nguhulumeni.Isimemezelo sikaMboweni, oyiphindile le nkulumo yokuthi ngeke ifakwe enye imali kumaholo abasebenzi, sisho ukuthi iminyango kuzomele ithathe imali kwezinye izinhlelo okusho ukuthi kuzothinteka izinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezidingo emphakathini.Uhulumeni uqashe abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-1.3 million.ICosatu iyaveva ngesimemezelo sikaMboweni mayelana nokunyuka kakhulu kwesabelo sezimali sabasebenzi bahulumeni.UNobhala weCosaut uMnuz Bheki Ntshalintshali, uthe kuyadumaza ukuthi kugxekwe abasebenzi ngezinkinga ekubeni kungebona abadle imali kwa-Eskom, bakha iNkandla noma bathumela imali eDubai.Uthe abasebenzi abahambi namakhosikazi abo uma beya kwamanye amazwe wathi othisha, abahlengikazi namaphoyisa basebenza kanzima.“Asimzwanga uNgqongqoshe ekhala ngoR2.4 million oholwa oNgqongqoshe okubalwa naye. Uhulumeni akanalo uhlelo lokwehlisa ikhabhinethi eyanda njalo nokulawula izinkampani ezingaphansi kwakhe.”Uthe bamshayela ihlombe ngesimemezelo asenzile sokuthi ngokuvalwa kwezikhala kwezempilo kodwa besifuna ukuzwa ngendaba yamaphoyisa abalelwa ku-56 000 azinze emahhovisi engabe atshalwa ensimini.Ukhale kakhulu ngokungavalwa kwezikhala zothisha, abahlengikazi, ojele, amaphoyisa nodokotela.UNobhala jikelele weSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu) uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, uxwayise uMboweni ngokuthi bazolwa naye uma ediliza abasebenzi.Uthe kumele ehlise ikhabhinethi kungadlalwa ngabasebenzi abazikhandlayo besebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.Uqhube wathi agcwele amakilasi, amaphoyisa ayashoda nokutih akumele kwehliswe isibalo sojele.Esithangamini sabezindaba ngaphambi kwesabelo sezimali uMboweni uthe kumele ikhabhinethi ingabi nongqongqoshe abangaphezulu kuka-25 ngoba akuwakhi umqondo.Uthe akuwakhi umqondo ngakwezimali ukuthi kube nongqongqoshe abangu-35, ababa namaphini abo okusho ukuthi ongqongqoshe bangu-70.

text: USADIDEKILE umndeni womfundi waseMbumbulu oshone ebuya ekhempini yokuvalwa kwezikole yokulungiselela izivivinyo zika-matric.UMxolisi Mzulwini (20), obefunda eMasakhane High, kuthiwa ubephakathi kwabafundi abebehlangene e-Adams College abebefunda njengoba bekuvalwe izikole. Uyisemkhulu, uMnuz Phikinkani Mzulwini, uthe namanje basadidekile ukuthi umzukulu wakhe uthathwe yini ngoba wahamba ewumqemane ekhaya. Uthe washaya ucingo esesikoleni ebika ukugula. NgoLwesithathu olwedlule bamtshela ukuthi akabuyele ekhaya.“Sisola ukuthi ukudla abakudlile okumgulisile ngoba ubekhala ngesisu, ethi kuyashisa nasesifubeni. Ngesikhathi eshaya ucingo esesikoleni wabika ukuthi baningi nabanye abafundi abagula njengaye, yingakho sisola ukuthi kukhona abakudlile,” kusho uMzulwini.Uthe uMxolisi wabuya ngoLwesithathu waya emtholampilo kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Ukugula kwamqinisa waze washonela ekhaya ebusuku ngalo uLwesithathu.“Bafikile othisha bakhe bezosikhalisa, nabo bathi abazi kwenzekeni. Nabo ngibatshelile ukuthi umzukulu wami wahamba engenalutho lapha ekhaya. Sixakekile uma esebuyiswa ukugula ekhaya,” kusho uMzulwini.Omunye wothisha ongathandanga ukudalulwa uthe bakhona nabanye abazali abakhale ngokugula ezinganeni nabo abasola ukudla.Ngesikhathi sokuloba umndeni kamufi ubulungiselela umngcwabo ozoba ngoMgqibelo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe bayazwelana nomndeni womfundi oshonile. Mayelena nokuthi kunabasola ukudla okwadliwa ngabafundi uthe ngeke agxile emibikweni engaqinisekisiwe.“Sizocela ihhovisi lesifunda lisithumelele umbiko ngalolu daba,” kusho uMlotshwa.

ISOUTH African Social Security Agency (Sassa) ithi bazozithola izibonelelo zabo zikahulumeni abantu abawu-17 million abaziholayo noma kuqhubeka isiteleka sabasebenzi abangamalungu eNational Education, Health and Allied Workers Union (Nehawu).UNobhala Jikelele weNehawu uMnuz Zola Saphetha, uthe isiteleka siyaqhubeka futhi akekho umsebenzi wakwaSassa ozoba semsebenzini kusukela namhlanje kuze kube bathola izimfuno zabo.USaphetha uveze ukuthi abasebenzi abazange baqeqeshelwe ukusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lokuholela abantu oluhambisana nokugingqa izithupha olubizwa nge-biometric enrolment.Esitatimendeni uMnuz Paseka Letsatsi obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwaSassa uthe baphoxekile ukuthi iNehawu isabisa ngokuteleka ngenxa ye-biometric enrolment.“Abasebenzi baqeqeshwa ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwalolu hlelo ukuze bakwazi ukulusebenzisa. Alulusha uhlelo lwe-biometric enrolment belwenziwa nakudala. Umehluko wukuthi bekusetsenziswa * -inki nephepha ukuze oholayo agingqe isithupha. Ngesikhathi iSassa isinenkontilekaneCash Paymaster Service (CPS) ngo-2012 * -inki nephepha kwaphela ngoba abantu bese bezigingqa kwikhompyutha izithupha okuyikona esikubiza ngebiometric enrolment,” kusho uLetsatsi.Uthe ngisho ngoJuni wonyaka odlule ngesikhathi iSassa yethula umbiko enkantolo yomthethosisekelo yasho ukuthi esikhundleni sokugingqa izithupha ephepheni sezizogingqwa kwikhompyutha kusetshenziswa i-biometric enrolment.Isikhulu esiphezulu esisabambile kwaSassa, uMnuz Abram Mahlangu sithe kuyishwa ukuthi iNehawu iyateleka yize sekuke kwaxoxwa nayo ngalolu hlelo.“Besixoxisana kahle neNehawu saze savumelana ngokuthi ngeke baqondiswe ubugegwe futhi sizothuthukisa izinga lokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze bakwazi ukuluqonda kahle lolu hlelo lwe-biometric enrolment,” kusho uMahlangu.Uphinde waveza ukuthi babe nomhlangano neNehawu ngoSepthemba 25 lapho babefuna ukukhombisa ukuthi lusebenza kanjani uhlelo olusha lokuhola kanjalo nolwe-biometric enrolment kodwa iNehawu yaphuma kulowo mhlangano.“Sicela iNehawu izoxoxisana nathi ukuze sikwazi ukuthola isisombululo kulolu daba lwe-biometric enrolment siqhubeke nokusiza abantu,” kusho uMahlangu.
