IFUNGA iyagomela iDA ithi izoya ngenkani eziteshini zamaphoyisa iyohlola ukusebenza kwazo nakuba sekuphume incwadi evimba amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuba agasele eziteshini zaKwaZulu-Natal engacelile.IBamba likaKhomishana wamaphoyisa eKZN, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, lisanda kukhipha incwadi evuthayo ethi akekho usopolitiki ovunyelwe ukufuhleleka esiteshini engacelanga, afike apekequle afune namabhuku ezimali. Lokhu kungenxa yokugasela kweDA eziteshini ezehlukene ithi izohlola isimo.Encwadini uMkhwanazi uthi akukhathalekile noma ngabe yiliphi iqembu elifikayo alingemukelwa futhi linganikwa lutho elikufunayo. Udaba lucasule iDA yaze yalanda umholi wayo kuzwelonke, uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, obeseThekwini ngoMgqibelo, ezophikisa incwadi ekomkhulu lamaphoyisa esifundazweni. Ufike ehambisana nomholi waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, bayihlaba bayihlikiza indaba yencwadi kaMkhwanazi bathi ishaye eceleni. UMaimane uthe banelungelo elisemthethweni lokugasela eziteshini ngoba bamele abantu.‘’Lowo okhiphe incwadi angazosijwayela kabi asiyingeni indaba yayo. Umbhedo wani lowo awushoyo. Le nto iphambene nomthetho futhi thina sifuna ukubambisana namaphoyisa hhayi ngoba silwa nawo. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi yini le efihlwayo eziteshini abangafuni siyibone,’’ kusho uMaimane enanelwa yihlombe labalandeli beDA. Uthe amaphoyisa awakwazi ukuzenzela umathanda engagadwe muntu futhi amalungu eSishayamthetho abekelwe lokho ukugada ukusebenza kwezikhungo zomphakathi.“Ngingama kanjani nje ePhalamende ngitshele izwe ukuthi angikwazi ukuyohlola isimo esiteshini esithile? Bazothini abantu uma bezwa leyo nto njengoba bethembele kithina. Uke ufike esiteshini ubone ukuthi amaphoyisa awazi lutho kuduma upotiyane uma uwabuza,’’ kusho uMaimane.Uthe banika uMnyango wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal izinsuku eziwu-14 ukuba uphendule esikhalweni sabo. Isithunywa ebesivela emnyangweni simukele incwadi sathi sizoyedlulisela kuMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda onguNgqongqoshe womnyango bese ephendula.NoMncwango uhambe emazwini kaMaimane wathi uMkhwanazi ushaye phansi-ke ngoba bazoqala phansi ukuhambela iziteshi.

USOMABHIZINISI waseShowe, uMnuz Brayce Mthimkhulu obezibiza ngeNgonyama yamaHlubi, ulahlwe yicala eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu ngoLwesihlanu wayalalelwa ukuthi angaphinde azibize ngeNgonyama futhi akhokhe nezindleko zecala.UMthimkhulu ubefakwe enkantolo wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, ngemuva kwesikhalo esifakwe yiNdlunkulu yamaHlubi kuwona. INdlunkulu yamaHlubi yafaka isikhalo ngoMthimkhulu emnyangweni oqale wamyalela ukuthi angazibizi ngeNgonyama kodwa waqhubeka. UMthimkhulu ubebangisa iNgonyama yamaHlubi ebusayo, iNkosi Muziwenkosi kaLangalibalele Radebe eseMtshezi.Icala abebhekene nalo lokuzibiza ngeNgonyama belisingethwe yijaji Jerome Mnguni.Ijaji lithe, uMthimkhulu angaphinde azibize ngeNgonyama yamaHlubi noma enze umcimbi egameni lobukhosi bamaHlubi ngoba akayona inkosi. Liphinde lamyalela ukuthi kumele akhokhe izindleko zecala ebelifakwe enkantolo.Icala abebhekene nalo alithathanga sikhathi lisenkantolo njengoba kufike kwaphuma isinqumo kwaba sekuphelile njalo ngoMthimkhulu.UMthimkhulu uqale ukuvela ngo-2014 ethi nguye iNgonyama yamaHlubi esemthethweni. Wenza indumezulu yomcimbi wokuzigcoba njengeNgonyama emzini wakhe eShowe. Wayememe umphakathi nosomabhizinisi, abanye ababeqhamuka eGermany.Ngemuva kwalo mcimbi kusuke umsindo kukhala abaseNdlunkulu yamaHlubi ngoMthimkhulu obekuthiwa usegcobe namakhosi angaphansi kwakhe futhi eqhakambisa ukuthi uzobumba isizwe samaHlubi. Ubesezibiza nangoMthimkhulu III.Ngo-2016 umnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezoMdabuKwaZulu-Natal uxwayise uMthimkhulu uthi makangabizwa ngeNgonyama ngoba abukho ubufakazi balokho. Waphinde wamyalela ukuthi makayeke ukugcoba amakhosi ezindaweni ezihlukene esifundazweni ngoba akanalo ilungelo lokwenza lokho wathi uzobhekana nomthetho uma eqhubeka.

source: urapulana seiphemo uvele enkantolo kwelokungayikhokhi intela
text: INKAKHA yomlingisi, uRapulana Seiphemo, odume ngelika Tau Mogale okuyindawo ayilingisa kwiGenerations: The Legacy, uvele kafushane enkantolo yamacala ezimali ngoLwesine ekuseni ngezinsolo zokungayikhokhi intela.Umbuso usola uSeiphemo ngokungayikhokhi imali yentela kusukela ngonyaka ka-2010 kuya ku-2013. AbeSouth African Revenue Services bathi lo mlingisi ukweleta imali engaphezulu kukaR48 000.Icala lihlehliselwe uNovemba 13 njengoba abameli bakhe becele ukunikezwa isikhathi sokuthi bake baxhumane nabakwaSARS bahlele ukulungisa lolu daba.USeiphemo waziswe ukuthi lizoqhubeka leli cala uma engaxhumani nabakwaSARS.Abameli bakhe baxolisile bathi usezame kaningi ukuxhumana nabakwaSARS kwangaphumelela.Ngesikhathi inkantolo isahleli lo mlingisi ubebukeka ekhululekile.Ubephelezelwa uzakwabo alingisa naye kwiGenerations, uZoe Mthiyane, olingisa indawo kaZitha othandana noTau kulo mdlalo.Nyakenye ziqinisekisiwe izindaba zokuthi sebeyathandana laba.Lo mlingisi uvela enkantolo ngalolu daba nje, abanye osaziwayo okubalwa kubo umethuli wezinhlelo uBonang Matheba, nomdlali webhola uTeko Modise nabo basobishini nabaqoqi bentela kuleli njengoba nabo bebengayikhokhi intela.

UPHUME ngebheyili umdlali weqembu lebhola iSundowns, u-Andile Jali oboshwe ngoMsombuluko ekuseni ngemuva kokuvulelwa icala lokushaya nokulimaza impahla. Ngokwe-website ebhala ngezindaba zebhola iKick-Off, u-Andile ubevele enkantolo yeMantshi yaseHatfield, ePitoli, icala lakhe lihlehliselwe inyanga ezayo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGoli, uLieutenant Lungelo Dlamini ekhuluma neSolezwe uthe, umsolwa uboshwe ngemuva kokuba khona komsindo endaweni ahlala kuyo, nokuthe kufika amaphoyisa asesiteshini iBoschkop ambopha.“Ugcinwe esitokisini usuku lonke lwangoMsombuluko, waze walala khona. Ubhekene namacala amabili kodwa okwamanje njengoba ebevele ekuseni (izolo) asazi ukuthi icala lihambe kanjani,” kusho uLieutenant Dlamini.Lo mdlali kuvela ukuthi ngoMsombuluko ezintatha wafika emzini wakhe ahlala kuwo nonkosikazi nezingane, uNonhle, kwaba nokuhilizisana phakathi kwabo. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kusanda kuvela izindaba zokuthi usecwile ezinkambeni zikaFaro, nokuyinto engasalawuleki.Iphephandaba lesingisi libike ukuthi ngesikhathi * -Andile efika endlini kube khona umsindo oqubukile phakathi kwakhe noNonhle.Kuthiwa kula alimaze khona imoto kaNonhle kodwa uNonhle akukho la alimale khona. Okhulumela iSundowns uThulani Thuswa, ucele ukuthi angaphawuli ngalolu daba.Laba bobabili uthando lwabo bebengalufihli ezinkundleni zokuxhumana njengoba uNonhle ebehlala ekhombisa indlela abaphila ngayo. UNonhle no-Andile banezingane ezintathu okuyintombazane endala namawele okungelomfana nentombazane.

UKUGEMBULA, ukwehlukana kwenkolo kungezinye zezinto ezidala udlame olugcina luholele ekutheni kuliwe ezikoleni.UDkt Zithobile Mkhize-Ngidi oyiphini likathishanhloko eVikingozi High, ngaphandle kwaKwaMakhutha, osanda kuthola iziqu zePhD kwiPublic Administration, egxile kwiPeace Studies, eDurban University of Technology (DUT), izolo ubenesigcawu sokucobelelana ngolwazi sokuhlomisa ezinye izitshudeni ebenza iziqu zePhD.Ubegxile ekufundiseni ngokuthi ulwenza kanjani ucwaningo olungagcini ngokubhala iphepha kodwa lufundise umphakathi noma isikhungo, izindlela zokuvikela lokho obekucwaningwa ngakho.Uthe yena wenze ucwaningo lwakhe ezikoleni ezimbili zaseMlaza.Kulesi sikole uthe waqala isigungu esihlanganisa abazali, othisha nabafundi esibizwa ngokuthi iWe Care, lesi sigungu yiso esibheka abafundi okusuke kubonakala ukuthi banodlame.Inhloso yalesi sigungu uthe ukunqanda ukuthi kube nodlame kulesi sikole ngoba izinhlelo ezikhona njengamanje ezikoleni ezokungenelela ngemuva kokuthi kube nodlame.UDKT Zithobile Mkhize-Ngidi osanda kuthola iPhD yePublic Admninistration, egxile kwiPeace Studies, eDUT Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO“Ocwaningweni lwami ngizwe izinto nami njengothisha ebengingazazi ezifana nokuthi ezikoleni kuyagembulwa ngokudlala amaphepha ne-spin.“Lezi zinto abafundi bathi zidala ingxabano kwabazidlalayo bengasafuni ukwamukela ukuthi uma behluliwe kumele banikeze abanye isiteki semali ebekuvunyelwene ngaso.”Okunye athe ubeqala ukuzwa ngakho ukuthi abafundi bakhonza emabandleni ehlukene kukhona abazibukela phansi izinkolo zabanye. “Laba bafundi kuthiwa bahlale becuphene, uma kuke kwaba nento encane ebaphambanisayo kuyaliwa ngoba vele bayazondana ngenxa yenkolo.”Isigungu asisungula kulesi sikole uthe sisalwenza lolu hlelo kanti ngokubona kwakhe zehlile izigameko zokulwa kwabafundi ngenxa yalo.USolwazi uGeeff Harris oyinhloko yohlelo olufundisa ngoxolo kuyo le nyuvesi, iPeace Building Programme uthe kumele kube nendlela yokuthi uDkt Mkhize-Ngidi aludlulisele ulwazi alutholile eMnyangweni wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal.

UTHUKE kwaphela nasozwaneni unina womfana (15) waseManenberg ezwa ngomdlalo omusha obizwa nge- Treintjie (isitimela), lapho abafana abancane bebukiswa khona izithombe zocansi ngaphambi kokudlwengulwa ngabafana abadala.Lo wesifazane oneminyaka engu-32 uthe uthole iqiniso ngalo mdlalo ngemuva kokuba indodana yakhe eneminyaka eyisikhombisa imtshele ukuthi inukubezwe ngokocansi ngabafana emgwaqweni ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule.Uthe kwakuwu-Okthoba 4, indodana yakhe nabangani bayo bedlala ekhaya ngesikhathi edalula le mfihlo.“Umfana wami wathi abafana abathathu bamthatha emgwaqweni bamyisa kubo komfana omdala lapho bamgingqela khona embhedeni bamkhombisa izithombe zabantu abenza imikhuba etafuleni,” kusho umama.“Wafaka i-lipstick kuye futhi wanikezwa amakhekhe netiye kanye nabanye abafana ababili, base bedlwengula indodana yami, kunomunye umfana wesine owayebukela. Wakhala futhi ebatshela ukuthi kubuhlungu. Kunesinye isigameko lapho umfana ongubhongoza edlwengula indodana yami eyedwa.”Umama uthe wabe esethatha indodana yakhe, wayiyisa esiteshini samaphoyisa eManenberg wavula icala futhi indodana yakhe yelulekwa ngengqondo. Ukuhlolwa odokotela kuveze ukuthi umfana wadlwengulwa futhi wakhombisa unina abafana abamnukubezile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uSergeant Noloyiso Rwexana, uthe amaphoyisa asaphenya amacala okudlwengula.“Leli hhovisi lingakuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zehlakalo zenzeka kaningi phakathi kwabafana abambalwa abadala nabancane abaneminyaka eko-6 ubudala.“Oneminyaka engu-15 usebiziwe wazophenywa ngalesi sigameko futhi usayohlolwa umqondo. Abaphenyi basathungatha abagilwa abangakawabikeli amaphoyisa ngokubehlele,” kusho uRwexana. -ANA

IZINSOLO zokuzibulala kwengwazi yomrepha uJabulani “HHP” Tsambo zishiye abantu abaningi besisaba isifo ukhwantalala. Kusolwa ukuthi lesi sifo sibe nomthelela ekushoneni kwakhe njengoba phambilini eke waveza ukuthi unaso. US’MANGELE ZUMA uxoxe noMnuz Sipho Simelane ongumbhali wencwadi eqwashisa ngokhwantalala iKiller in My Head.ISIFO somqondo nomphefumulo lapho umzimba usuke ufuna ukuphila kodwa ingqondo ifuna ukuzibulala. Odokotela bathi uma unalesi sifo, ama-chemicals engqondweni awafiki kwelinye icala lengqondo.SIDALWA yini lesi sifo?ZININGI izinto eziholela ekutheni umuntu abe nalesi sifo. Siphila esikhathini esinzima lapho isimo somnotho sisibi. Ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi, ukuthatha izinqumo imiphumela yazo engahambisani nezinhlelo zakho, ukulahlekelwa ilungu lomndeni noma ukuhlukumezeka thizeni, kungaba ngezinye zezinto ezibanga lesi sifo. Kuyenzeka futhi ukuthi sibe wufuzo emndenini.UMBONA kanjani umuntu onalesi sifo?UHLALE ekhathele, ukhathala emphefumulweni phakathi nasemzimbeni. Kuba nzima ngisho ukuvuka embhedeni. Uyashintsha umuntu indlela abeyiyo, aqale afise ukuba yedwa. Omunye ushintsha indlela adla ngayo, obedla kancane adle kakhulu, odla kakhulu angakuthandi ukudla. Uma esafunda uyaphazamiseka esikoleni. Osebenzayo kubonakala ngokushintsha kwendlela asebenza ngayo, agcine esesalela ngemuva.ABANTU abanjani abaphathwa yilesi sifo?ASIKHETHI bala lamuntu. Kuqala komncane kuye komdala, ofundile nongafundile. Abantu bazitshela ukuthi isifo esiphatha abantu abahluphekayo, asebelahle ithemba empilweni. Akunjalo kukhona abantu abafundile, abanemali yonke abanaso lesi sifo. Izingane ezincane ezihlukunyezwe ngokocansi noma ekushintsha impilo yazo ngemuva kokudivosa kwabazali, ziba naso lesi sifo.SIYALAPHEKA yini lesi sifo?IPHUTHA elenziwa abantu ukucabanga ukuthi umuntu onalesi sifo unamadimoni, udinga ukuthandazelwa. Umthandazo wodwa awuselaphi lesi sifo. Umuntu kumele ahambe udokotela ozomnika amaphilisi azomsiza ukulapha lesi sifo.UNGAMESEKA kanjani umuntu onalesi sifo?KUMELE umlalele uma ekhuluma. Uthole ukuthi yini inkinga yakhe umeseke ngaso sonke isikhathi. Abanalesi sifo bafela ngaphakathi ngoba abantu abaningi abasiqondi. Akumele umshiye ahlale yedwa isikhathi eside. Udinga uthando nokwesekwa.YINI eholele ekutheni ubhale le ncwadi?NGO-2011 ngazama kathathu ukuzibulala. Okokuqala kwagqashuka intambo engangilenga ngayo esihlahleni. Ngaya kwesinye isihlahla lapho okwavele kwagqashuka igatsha engangizilengisa kulo. Okwesithathu ngayolala kujantshi wesitimela ngifuna singigaye kodwa kwaphela amahora singaqhamuki. Ngo-2013 ubaba wami owayena-73 wazibulala yize yena wayethi kumele ngiqine ngibe yindoda.

source: kudutshulwe amadoda asolwa ngokubulala onogada egoli
text: KUBULAWE amadoda amabili eClermont, eThekwini abesolwa ngokubulala onogada ababili eMoroka eGoli, kule nyanga okusabalale ivideo yawo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ebulawa.Kuthiwa laba basolwa okuvela ukuthi ngabaseNkandla, baficwe emjondolo thizeni ngamaphoyisa abelandela umkhondo wabo, oyedwa wabo kuthiwa uvulele ngenhlamvu ebhekise emaphoyiseni, namaphoyisa aphendula ngezulu lezandla bashonela khona lapho.Izithombe zalaba basolwa sebeshonile nazo sezisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, belele phansi kugcwele igazi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uBrigadier Vishnu Naidoo uthe amaphoyisa azamile ukubopha oMnuz Lindokuhle Cebekhulu (24) noMbuyiselo Mthonti (26) kodwa laba balwa bagcina ngokudutshulwa bashona. Laba basolwa ngokubulala onogada ababili eGoli ngo-Okthoba 10 nonyaka.

source: akakasithathi isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe ude lille olaxaze ida
text: AKAKATHATHI sinqumo ngekusasa lakhe uNkk Patricia De Lille ngoLwesithathu omemezele ukuthi uzosigcina isinqumo sakhe sokusula njengeMeya yaseKapa.UDe Lille umemezele lezi zindaba engaphandle kweNkantolo eNkulu yaseWesterm Cape lapho afake khona isicelo sokuthi kuchithwe imibiko emibili eyenziwa abameli beBowman Gilfillan ebiphenya ngendlela abephethe ngayo umasipala.Noma udaba lusaqhubeka enkantolo, uDe Lille uthe akaguquki kwisinqumo sakhe sokusula kwesobuMeya wabe esememezela nokuthi uyalishiya iqembu leDA ngemuva kwesikhathi eside ‘ecindezelekile’ kuyona.Usayine incwadi yakhe yokusula njengeMeya emastebhisini khona enkantolo. UDe Lille usula nje usanda kubekwa icala lokukhwabanisa ngemuva kombiko weBowman oveze ukuthi bekwenziwa umkhonyovu ngamabhasi eMyCiTi.Omunye wabaphenywayo ngalezi zinsolo ukhomishina wezokuthutha osamisiwe emsebenzini, uMelissa Whitehead, okusolwa ukuthi uyathinteka ekukhwabanisweni kwethenda likaR286 million lamabhasi ahamba ngogesi.Ngesikhathi kuhlangane umkhandlu ngeledlule kwavunyelwana ngokuthi udaba ludluliselwe emaphoyiseni ukuze kuphenywe bonke abathintekayo. Ngesikhathi uhleli lowo mhlangano kwabamuncu kusula amanye amalungu awu-5 eDA esola le nhlangano ngokucwasa nokucindezela uDe Lille ngalezi zinsolo abathi abukho ubufakazi bazo.UDe Lille uthe uyasola ukuthi abammeli beBowman Gilfillan bebesebenzisana nosopolitiki ukumbhixa ngezinsolo zokuthi ubedla imali yabakhokhi bentela.

BEKUSAMILE ukusebenza kumaplanti akwaToyota izolo okubalwa eseProspecton, eThekwini, naseBoksburg, eGoli, njengoba sisaqhubeka isiteleka sabasebenzi.Lesi siteleka esiqale ngoMsombuluko siphazamise ukusebenza kulezi zindawo, okushaye isikhathi sokuloba izolo kusaqhubeka izingxoxo kubaqashi nabasebenzi. Izolo, okhulumela abakwaToyota South Africa Motors (TSAM), uMnuz Clynton Yon, uthe bazimisele ukuxoxa nabasebenzi ukuze kuqhamukwe nesixazululo ezinkingeni ababhekene nazo. UYon ugxeke isitatimende esenziwe yiNumsa sokuthi inkampani ayifuni ukuxoxisana nenyunyana. Lesi sitatimende besishiwo nguNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola.Ngesikhathi sokuloba izolo abamele inyunyana bebehlangene eNkantolo yaBasebenzi nabaqashi kudingindwa udaba lwesiteleka. Abasebenzi bakhala ngokuthi sekunesikhathi inkampani ingafuni ukuzwa izikhalo zabo.UMnuz Mandla Gambushe onguMgqugquzeli weNumsa esifundazweni, uthe bafuna abasebenzi bangawukhokhi uR10 000 ababebolekwe wona ngesikhathi kunezikhukhula ngonyaka odlule. Phakathi kwabakhala ngakho abasebenzi ukuthi bafuna kushintshwe izingubo zokusebenza, bangakhokhi esejari yenkampani, kuqashwe nabasebenzi abaphelelwa yizinkontileka nyakenye.IMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede izolo inxenxe abaqashi nabasebenzi bakwaToyota ukuthi baxoxe ukuze sisheshe siphele isiteleka. “Ngikhathazekile ngalesi simo ngoba uma isiteleka siqhubeka kuzolimaza zombili izinhlangothi. Njengezwe sizame ngayo yonke indlela ngemikhankaso yokudala amathuba emisebenzi futhi iTheku liphambili kulo mkhankaso. Abaqashi nabasebenzi kumele bagweme izimo ezingaholela esitelekeni ngoba kuthunazeka nesithunzi sezwe.”UNkk Gumede ucele nokuthi izinkampani ezizimele sibambisane nohulumeni ukuguqula isimo nokuqeda ukungalingani emnothweni.

source: uphele kamuncu umshado kushona umngani wabebeshada
text: UPHELE sekumuncu umshado obuseNseleni ngeSonto kushona umngani wabebeshada obeyolanda abanye esikhumulweni sezindiza iKing Shaka International eThekwini.UMnuz Mpilo Ndlazi (30), waseRichards Bay, obezoshadelwa ekuqaleni konyaka ozayo, ushone ngesikhathi imoto abehamba ngayo ishayisana nenye okuthiwa ngeyomndeni waseSwazini. Ingozi yenzeke emgwaqweni uN2 eMthunzini, kwashona abanye abathathu abebesemotweni yaseSwazini okushaye isikhathi sokuloba ingakatholakali imininingwane yabo.Umfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Nqobile Ndlazi, uthe indlela imoto yakhe eshe ngayo bathole sekudlule isikhathi ukuthi nguyena. Uthe bekungekho obekukhombisa ukuthi imoto ekabani ngoba ibishe yangqongqa.“Umfowethu ubesemshadweni womngani wakhe, umshado ungakaqali ngesikhathi ephuma eyolanda abanye eThekwini. Siyacabanga ukuthi bekuyizikhathi zasemini ngoba umshado ubungakaqali kodwa thina sithole umbiko ngabo 5 ntambama. Umyeni obeshadelwa uze wathumela enye imoto ngoba abasesikhumulweni sezindiza bebekhala ngokuthi kade belindile,” kusho uNdlazi.UNdlazi uthe umufi ubesanda kuthembisa umshado ingoduso yakhe ngo-Agasti 4. Bebehlele ukuthi bashade ngoFebhuwari noma ngoMashi ngonyaka ozayo.Umufi, owafundela ubuthisha e-University of Zululand neCivil Engineering eMangosuthu University of Technology, uke wafundisa unyaka owodwa eTholokuhle High, eNseleni, ngo-2007.UMNUZ Mpilo Ndlazi oshone esezoshadelwa Isithombe:FACEBOOKKuthiwa ubesengene nasebhizinisi lokuhweba ebelimenza ahambele amazwe.UNdlazi uthe umfowabo ubaziwa ngabantu abaningi ngoba ubebathanda abantu. Emethembisweni wakhe kwakugcwele nosaziwayo bethelevishini. Ubaziwa futhi nangokudlala izinsimbi emculweni.Isililo sikhulu nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana abamaziyo bebalisa ngokushona kwakhe. Kubona kubalwa no-Eugene Mthethwa weqembu leKwaito iTrompies othe bekungumngani wakhe.Ngokwesitatimende sabezimo eziphuthamayo i-IPSS Medical Rescue, bathathu abasindile engozini bangeniswe esibhedlela. Kuthiwa umshayeli weMercedes uvaleleke emotweni kwadingeka akhishwe ngezindlawu. Abathathu abebekwenye imoto bashonele khona lapho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe abashonile abakakhonjwa yimindeni yabo. Uthe amaphoyisa aseSikhaleni asaphenya ngembangela yengozi.

source: bazozithola izimfanelo zabo abadilizwe ebhange ivbs
text: BAZOZITHOLA zonke izimfanelo zabo abasebenzi baseVBS Mutual Bank abazodilizwa njengoba umuntu obhekelele leli bhange okwamanje ememezele ukuthi abasebenzi bazokwehliswa besuka ku-126 kusale abawu-26 kuphela.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uNkk Louise Brugman obhekelele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi le-curator, uthe abasebenzi batshelwa ukuthi bazodilizwa ngoMeyi 13 ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinhlelo zokuthi abantu abakade belondoloze imali yabo eVBS bayoyikhipha eNedbank.Uthe abasebenzi bacelwa ukuthi bafake izicelo zezikhala eziwu-26 futhi uhlelo luhamba kahle ngoba sebeqokiwe abawu-25.“Esingakuqinisekisa wukuthi kuzodilizwa abasebenzi abawu-100 kusale abawu-25. Abadiliziwe bazozithola zonke izimfanelo zabo,” kusho uNkk Brugman.Mayelana nokuthi omasipala bazoyithola yini imali ababeyifake eVBS, uNkk Brugman uthe uma sekushaqwe impahla yezikhulu zaseVBS nabanye abahlomule ngokungemthetho kuzobuya uR1.5 billion okusho ukuthi omasipala nalabo ababefake imali engaphezu kukaR100 000 bazoyithola imali yabo.Udonse ngendlebe abakweleta iVBS ukuthi baqhubeke nokukhokha ngoba ukungakhokhi kuzobafaka enkingeni.U-Adv Terry Motau oze nombiko oveza ukuthi kunabantu abahlomule ngokungemthetho eVBS uthe akasabi lutho njengoba sekukhona abasabisa ngokumbopha.Ekhuluma ne-IOL uMotau uthe, “Angikhathazekile ngalabo abasabisa ngokungithathela izinyathelo zomthetho ngoba ngiyabona ukuthi abakaze bawufunde umbiko wami. Angikaze ngithi kunomuntu onecala kulo mbiko. Engikushilo wukuthi kunemali eyaphuma ebhange, yakhokhelwa abantu abathile, ngasho nokuthi bathole malini. Akekho engithe unecala.”Khonamanjalo, Isilo samaVenda uToni Mphephu Ramabulana, sithi sizoyikhokha yonke imali okubikwa ukuthi sayithola kutanyuzwa imali yeVBS Mutual Bank ngokungemthetho.Kubikwa ukuthi uMphephu Ramabulana wathola uR17 million kuleli bhange. NgeSonto uMphephu uveze ukuthi uzimisele ukuyikhokha le mali uma kuwukuthi wayithola, okuyinto ayichithayo ukuthi yenzeka.“Kuyishwa ukuthi * -Adv Motau neWerksman Attorneys bakubona kungenasidingo sokuthi nginikezwe ithuba lokuveza olwami uhlangothi. Ngokwazi kwami awukho uR17 million engakhokhelwa wona. Anginakho ukungabaza ukuthi uMotau nabeWerksmans Attorneys bayazi ukuthi ukuvela kwegama lami kulo mbiko kusilimaza kanjani isithunzi sami ngokunjalo nobuKhosi baseVenda. Ngifanelwe ukuphathwa kangcono,” kusho uMphephu Ramabulana encwadini ayibhalele isizwe sakhe.Uphinde waveza ukuthi miningi iminikelo ayithola kubantu abahlukene.Uthe uma kukhona imali ayithola kudliwa imali yaseVBS Mutual Bank, wayithola engazi ukuthi iphume ngomkhonyovu.“Ngiyazibophezela ukukhokha imali uma kunobufakazi bokuthi yaphuma ngezindlela ezingafanele, uma isibaliwe ukuthi malini eyaphuma ngomkhonyovu ngizoyikhokha,” usho kanje.Uzwelane kakhulu nabantu abaphazamisekile ngokudliwa kwemali eVBS Mutual Bank esho nokuthi wayengazi ukuthi kunomkhonyovu kuleli bhange.Namhlanje kulindeleke ukuthi i-EFF iphendule ngezinsolo zokuthi nayo yadla ngesikhathi kwebiwa imali esondele kuR2 billion eVBS.Lolu daba luphinde luthinte abaholi ababili abaphezulu be-ANC eLimpopo.Izolo ubuholi be-ANC kulesi sifundazwe bebuhlangene nobuholi obuphezulu be-ANC eLuthuli House buzocacisa ngokwenzeka eVBS.

source: i da ivulele ungqongqoshe icala lokuqamba amanga
text: I-DA ivulele uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wabesiFazane, uNksz Bathabile Dlamini, icala lokuqamba amanga ebe afunga wagomela ukuthi uzokhuluma iqiniso lodwa.Izolo, uNkk Bridget Masango weDA, uthe bavulele uNksz Dlamini icala esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseGoli emuva kokuthi iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ithe izodlulisela umbiko kwiJaji uBernard Ngoepe elisophikweni lwezokushushisa ukuze lunqume ukuthi uzoshushiswa yini uNksz Dlamini ngokuqamba amanga efungile.IJaji uNgoepe lathola ukuthi uNksz Dlamini waqamba amanga ngeqhaza lakhe enkingeni yokuholwa kwezibonelelo zikahulumeni.UNkk Masango uthe uNksz Dlamini akufanele asebenze kuhulumeni ngoba ungumuntu obudedengu.Uthe babhalele noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bemcela ukuthi axoshe uNksz Dlamini kwikhabhinethi yakhe.“Sicele uMengameli ukuthi abe esemxoshile uNksz Dlamini ngoLwesihlanu ngoba akawuhloniphi umthetho," kusho uNkkMasango.

AKALIBONI iphutha elenzeke emshadweni wakhe owesilisa okusabalale i-video yakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ephikisa izifungo zomfundisi.UMnuz Linda Mthethwa obeshadelwa uNkk Tiny Mthethwa eNtuzuma ngoMgqibelo, uthe akonakalanga lutho emshadweni wakhe ngoba ubengeke avume ukufunga amanga. Utshele Isolezwe ukuthi selokhu kusabalele le video umkakhe udinga ngisho ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo ngendlela aphatheke kabi ngayo ngokushiwo ngabantu ngabo.“Inina nje enibona kube khona okonakele emshadweni wami. Ngokwami umshado uhambe kahle, kumanje ngihleli nomkami sesinayo nencwadi yomshado. Umkami sengihlale naye isikhathi eside bengingeke ngizotshelwa ekugcineni umfundisi ukuthi sizohlukaniswa ukufa. Kungani kuze kumele kufakwe ukufa ezifungweni sengathi kukhona okumele abulale omunye. Ubuf...kuphela obuyohlukanisa mina nomkami ngoba okwamanje usaziphethe kahle,” echaza.UMthethwa othe unezingane ezintathu nomkakhe, uthe usola umthwebuli wabo ngokusabalala kwezithombe zabo ne-video.Ngemuva kokuvela kwe-video abantu abaningi kuFacebook nakuTwitter bebekhala ngokuphoxa kukaMthethwa, bedabukela umakoti.ESINYE sezithombe ezisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zomshado kaMnuz Linda Mthethwa noNkk Tiny Mthethwa emuva kokusabalala kwama-video umkhwenyana ephikisa izifungoKule video, uMthethwa uma kumele afunge ukuthi bayobekezelelana uma becebile noma bempofu, uphendula ngokuthi vele bampofu. Ebuzwa ngalokhu uthe vele ubephendula okuyikona.“Vele ngingene ezindlekweni ezinkulu kabi nasezikweletini ngilungiselela ukuthi lolu suku lube luhle. Kulezi zikweletu engingene kuzona kuyacaca ukuthi ngeke ngisaphinde ngicebe ngoba kusekude ukuthi ziphele,” kusho uMthethwa.BUKA:Uphikise umfundisi ngezifungo emshadweni wakheKwenye i-video uMthethwa ubonakala eyohlangabeza umakoti ngaphambi kokuqala komshado. Ugaqa ngamadolo kukhaphethi obomvu, usukuma esephambi komkakhe, ambambe ngengalo. Nalapho uthe akaliboni iphutha ngoba ubekhombisa ukuthi umthanda kangakani umkakhe. Wenqabile ukuphendula ukuthi ubephuzile yini njengoba abanye besola lokho. UNkk Mthethwa uthe akukho asazokusho ngoba vele umonakalo usuwenzekile. Uthe uphatheke kabi ukuthi ngeke kusacisheka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okubhalwe ngabo.

source: umndeni awenelisekile ngencazelo mayelana nelungu elishone ejele
text: USELE nemibuzo ngelungu lawo elishonele ejele umndeni waseMgungundlovu, othi awanelisekile ngencazelo ngokuholele ekushoneni kwalo.Umndeni kaThembinkosi Nyathi (25) waseMpolweni, uthe umngcwabe ungakhululekile ngoba akucaci ukuthi wabulawa yini ejele. Uninalume kamufi uMnuz Sakhephi Nyathi, uthe wayegwetshwe ngo-2013 ngecala lokushaya nokugqekeza kanti bese kusele kancane aphume ejele. Uthe waqala waboshelwa eNew Prison kodwa ushonele eSevontein.“Udadewabo obejwayele ukumvakashela ejele futhi ubengakaze ambikele ukuthi kukhona axabane nabo. Kwafika ojele ekhaya ngoSepthemba 29 bezobika ukuthi uThembinkosi ushone ngayizolo. Basitshela ukuthi bekugwazana iziboshwa ejele, bangacacisa uma sibuza eminye imibuzo ngesigameko. Bathe uma sifuna enye incazelo kumele sikhulume nabaphathi bejele,” kuchaza uNyathi.Uthe isidumbu basilande ejele ngo-Okthoba 1 kodwa baxakeka uma bengawaboni amanxeba okugwazwa. UNyathi uthe umbiko kadokotela ohlole isidumbu uveza ukuthi walimala ekhanda. “Okubuhlungu, besilindele ukuthi aphume noma yinini umshana ngoba ubesewutholile ushwele. Sisola ukuthi ojele banolwazi ngokubulawa kwakhe. Asikholwa ukuthi wagwazwa isiboshwa,” kusho uNyathi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCaptain Nqobile Gwala uthe kuvulwe idokodo ngokufa komuntu. “NgoSepthemba 28 kwafika umbiko wesibhedlela ngokufa komuntu, amaphoyisa anikela khona. Ngesikhathi efika esibhedlela amaphoyisa akhonjiswa isidumbu sesiboshwa esineminyaka engu-25 kodwa kungabonakali manxeba emzimbeni. Kusalindwe ukutholakala kombiko ogcwele wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuthola ukuthi umufi wabulawa yini.”UMnuz Thulani Mdluli okhulumela amajele esifundazweni ucele ukuthunyelelwa i-email ngoMsombuluko, ngoLwesibili wathembisa ukuthi bazophendula uma sebecubungule udaba. Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba izolo engakaphenduli.

UNGQONGQOSHE woMnyango wezaseKhaya kuleli, uMnuz Malusi Gigaba ubizelwe ukuba azochaza ukuthi kungani umnyango wakhe wavumela isamba sikaR67 million osikweleta inkampani engenamali yezobuchwepheshe, sikhuphukele kuR800 million.Ngokwabaphenyi, lesi samba esikweletwa iDouble Ring Trading sinyuke kakhulu ngemuva kombango ophakathi kwayo noMnyango wezaseKhaya ngo-2009, njengoba manje sesifinyelele kuR794 million.ULorenzo Pavoncelli, ongomunye wabaphenyi abaqokwe yiSAF Trust ukubheka uhlelo lokuvalwa kweDouble Ring Trading, uthe bafuna uR794m, ozothathwa kubakhokhi bentela.Izincwadi ezibizela uGigaba eNkantolo eNkulu yaseSouth Gauteng ziphume kuleli sonto. Uzovela phambi kwenkantolo ekupheleni kwale nyanga ukuze azochaza ngokungakhokhelwa kwale nkampani okuyinto eyenze kwaba nabantu abangu-150 abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi, nokuphoqe le nkampani ukuba ivale.Ngokwezincwadi, uGigaba engase agqunywe ejele uma engaveli ngaphambi kwenkantolo.IDouble Ring Trading yanikezwa umsebenzi nguMnyango wezindaba zaseKhaya ngo-2005, ukufaka uphiko olwaluzogxila kwezobuchwepheshe ezakhiweni zalo mnyango eziseTshwane.Okhulumela lo Mnyango, uMnuz Thabo Mokgola uvumile ukuthi bazitholile izincwadi ezibizela uGigaba enkantolo.

source: uramaphosa umise abashushisi emsebenzini ngamacala athinta imali
text: UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa umise emsebenzini iPhini loMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi u-Adv Nomgcobo Jiba no-Adv Lawrence Mrwebi onguMqondisi wezokuShushiswa koMphakathi ngamacala athinta imali, ukuze kuphenywe ukuthi bakufanele yini ukuba kulezi zikhundla zabo.URamaphosa umemezele lezi zindaba izolo ntambama esho nokuthi uphenyo lokuthi o-Adv Jiba noMrwebi bakufanele yini ukuba sezikhundleni zabo luzophathwa yiJaji leNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo eselathatha umhlalaphansi uNkk Yvonne Mokgoro.“Emuva kokubona ukuthi kunezinsolo zokuthi anikufanele ukuba sehhovisi ngithathe isinqumo sokunimisa emsebenzini ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ezobulungiswa zisebenza ngendlela, ikakhulukazi uma kuthintwa amacala enkohlakalo nokusetshenziswa kwemali yezwe. Niphethe izikhundla eziphezulu kwezokushushisa yingakho kufanele nime emsebenzini kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo ngokuthi nifanelekile yini ukuba kulezi zikhundla,” kusho uRamaphosa.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi o-Adv Jiba noMrebi bake bamiswa emsebenzini emuva kokuthi inkantolo inqume ukuthi bakhishwe ohlwini lwabameli ngo-2016. Lesi sinqumo siye sachithwa yinkantolo yokudluliswa kwamacala ngoJulayi walo nyaka.U-Adv Glynnis Breytenbach okhulumela iDA kwezobulungiswa uthe bayasamukela isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuphenya ukuthi u-Adv Jiba noMrwebi bakufanele yini ukuphatha izikhundla zabo ngoba abakufanele ukuphatha lezi zikhundla.Uthe iNingizimu Afrika ifanelwe wukuba nabashushisi abahlonipha umthetho hhayi laba abasebenzisa umbuso ukufeza izinhloso zabo.

source: ufuna ahoxiswe amacala abekwe wona u omotoso
text: UFUNA ahoxiswe amacala abekwe wona umfundisi osolwa ngezenzo zokuhlukumeza amantombazane ebandla lakhe nokushushumbisa abantu, uPastor Tim Omotoso, odabuka eNigeria.Icala lika-Omotoso nabesifazane ababili asolwa nabo liyaqhubeka njengamanje eNkantolo eNkulu yasePort Elizabeth. U-Omotoso weJesus Dominion International Church ezinze eThekwini, ubhekene namacala angaphezulu kuka-60, okubalwa kuwo ukuphula umthetho i-Sexual Offences Act, okukhona phakathi kwawo amabili okudlwengula. Abesifazane asolwa nabo baboshwa ngoNovemba nyakenye kanti bangaphandle ngebheyili kaR2 000.U-Omotoso uboshwe oKlebe esikhumulweni sezindiza iPort Elizabeth International Airport ngo-Ephreli ngonyaka odlule. Abameli bakhe bazise inkantolo ukuthi uyawachitha onke amacala abhekene nawo.Baveze nokuthi abaneme ngokuthi ubufakazi obuningi obethulelwe inkantolo abuvezi ukuthi asolwa ngakho u-Omotoso wakwenza ngaluphi usuku. Baphinde bacela nokuthi uJaji Mandela Makaula ukuthi angabe esaluhlehlisa lolu daba ngoba umsolwa usehlale ejele unyaka wonke.Ngaphandle kwenkantolo abalandeli balo mfundisi bebeze ngobuningi bezomeseka bethi umsulwa.UMakaula uthe uzokhipha isinqumo ngo 3 ntambama.- Udaba lusaqhubeka.

KUZOQHUBEKA ngo-Okthoba 22 ukuqulwa kwamacala abhekene noMfundisi Timothy Omotoso osolwa ngokudlwengula nokushushumbisa abesifazane.Izolo ufakazi wokuqala kuleli cala, uNksz Cheryl Zondi, ubephekwa ngemibuzo abammeli baka-Omotoso webandla iJesus Dominion International Church. UNksz Zondi (22) ungomunye wabesifazane ababalelwa kwabangaphezulu kuka 30 abasola umfundisi ngokubanukubeza ngokocansi kusuka ngo-2009 kuya ku-2017 okuwunyaka aboshwa ngawo esikhumulweni sezindiza ePort Elizabeth.Zithe zisuka nje ummeli ka-Omotoso, u-Adv Peter Daubermann, wathi akayitholi imibiko yokuhlaziywa kwemiqondo yabamangalele umfundisi.UDaubermann uthe lokhu kuba nomthelela uma esepheka ngemibuzo abantu abafakazayo. Uvezele uNksz Zondi izithombe nama-video akhe esesebandleni lika-Omotoso ebukeka ejabule.UNksz Zondi uthe wayephoqwa ukuthi ahlale ebukeka eneme ngazo zonke izikhathi futhi amoyizele. Uthe ukungakwenzi lokhu kwakuzomenza abukeke njengomuntu ongahambisani no-Omotoso.Uchaze lo mfundisi njengendoda ebinamandla futhi ilawula impilo yabo.UNksz Zondi uthe wayenukubezwa ngokocansi cishe zinsuku zonke esikhathini esingangeminyaka emibili nohhafu. Ngesikhathi echaza ngokubaleka kwakhe endlini ababevalelwe kuyo eMhlanga ubelokhu ekhala kwaze kwadingeka ukuthi kumiswe ukuqulwa kwecala.Uthe wathatha uR300 awunikezwa wumfundisi ngaphambi kwenkonzo enkulu wawugcina ukuze agibele ngawo.“Ngangifuna ukuhamba sebelele bonke endlini kodwa kwakukhona owesifazane owayesekhishini, ngazitshela ukuthi namhlanje ngiyakwenza lokhu noma ngiyafa. Ngathatha ukhiye, ngaphuma ngathatha isikhwama sami ngangena emotweni eyi-cab ngatshela umshayeli ukuthi akalinde” kusho uNksz Zondi echaza ngendlela abaleka ngayo emzini ababehlala kuwona.UNksz Zondi uthe wayesaba ukubikela amaphoyisa ngokunukubezwa ngokocansi ngoba amaphoyisa ayekhona ebandleni lika-Omotoso.“Ngangingenawo amandla anele okumelana nayo yonke le nto ngaleso sikhathi. Ngangingakwazi ukubikela amaphoyisa ngoba ayemphelezela yonke indawo aya kuyo. Ayelahla phansi amajakhethi awo ukuze ahambe phezu kwawo. Ngangingawathemba kanjani amaphoyisa ngemuva kwalokho?” kuchaza uNksz Zondi.UNksz Zondi uqale ukufakaza ngoMsombuluko. Icala limisiwe ukuze abhale izivivinyo. IJaji uMandela Makaula limufisele inhlanhla. Kulindekele ukuthi aqhubeke nokufakaza uma eseqedile ukubhala.Khona manjalo ngaphandle kwenkantolo silokhu sikhule njalo isibalo sabeseka uNksz Zondi njengoba izolo kujoyine ngisho abahleli be#TotalShutDown ne-ANCWL, egxeke abesifazane abebegqoke imifaniswano yayo abebeseka u-Omotoso. Nabesekau-Omotoso abapheli amandla balokhu bekhona ngaphandle enkantolo.

BAPHUME becijeke kuyo yonke imikhakha abesifazane ohlelweni lwaminyaka yonke olwenziwa yi-Independent Institute of Education (IIE) Varsity College, oluhlose ukubathuthukisa kwezomnotho nangokomqondo.Babheme bakholwa abebehambele umcimbi, iLadies to Legends, olwenziwe yilesi sikhungo eThekwini ngaleli sonto. Lo mcimbi waminyaka yonke uhambisana nenkolelo yokuthi kuhlomula sonke isizwe uma kuqeqeshwa kahle ingane yentombazane.Bekuxoxwa ngezinto eziningi zokuthuthukisa abesifazane, ikakhulukazi kwezemfundo. Izikhulumi bekunguCarol Mkhize ongunobuhle nomlingisi. Bekukhona noDkt Langa Mngoma naye obuye amodele noNksz Rowena Singh onguthisha noyimenenja yeLadies to Legends e-IIE’s Varsity College.UDkt Mngoma ongudadewabo kaNandi Madida ongumculi nomlingisi, uyaziwa kwezokumodela ikakhulukazi ekukhangiseni ngezimonyo. Nonyaka uqokwe nabanye abesifazane ababili base-Afrika ekubeni amanxusa okukhangisa ngezinwele zemvelo. Ukhethwe noLee Litumbe waseCameroon noLaurie Frempong waseGhana kulo mkhankaso owenziwe yinkampani yezinwele iMizani.Phakathi kwezihloko obekukhulunywa ngazo kubalwa ezempilo nokuziphatha kwabesifazane besimanje.UCarol ophinde aqeqeshe abazivocavocayo, ukhulume ngengcindezi azithola ehlangabezana nayo ezama ukuzenza umuntu angayena ngesikhathi efika kwezokulingisa. Ufundise abesifazane ngokuthi ukuzivocavoca kungabasiza kanjani ukuze bakwazi ukuphila nasemqondweni.UDkt Mngoma ugcizelele ukuzinakekela umzimba nangendlela yokudla efanele.“Kumele sizifundise umkhuba wokudla ngendlela efanele nenempilo uma sifuna ukuphila kahle. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi siqale ngokufundisa intsha ngalo mkhuba,” kusho yena.UNkk Singh ugcizelele ukubaluleka kokufundisa izingane zamantombazane, athe owesifazane uyakwazi ukuzikhandla aphumelele uma efundile. Kucelwe nabanye abesifazane abebethamele lo mcimbi ukuthi baxoxe izindaba zabo ezingasiza abanye ukuze basekane. Kugcizelelwe ukuthi akukho abesifazane abangeke baphumelele ukukwenza uma bebambisene.OyiManaging Director ye-IIE Varsity Collge uNkk Louise Wiseman uthe kubalulekile ukuzithuthukisa kwabesifazane yingakho bebiza abemikhakha ehlukene ukukhuthaza nabanye.Uthe ngunyaka wesine kwaqala ukwenziwa lolu hlelo ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa abesifazane abasebasha. Uthe bathokoze kakhulu ngezihloko obekukhulunywa ngazo ezithinta abesifazane umhlaba wonke.Kulo nyaka uthe umkhakha wezamabhizinisi kulesi sikhungo uzokhipha nomfundaze kwabayisishiyagalombili abafuna ukufunda khona.

KUTHIWA abamnyama basenomqondo wokuthi umdlavuza ngowabelungu, okwenza bangazihluphi ngokuwuhlolela.Lokhu kuvele izolo emcimbini wokuqwashisa ngomdlavuza webele, iBreakfast for Boobies obuhlelwe inhlangano elwa nalesi sifo, iPink Drive eThekwini. UNkk Janice Benecke olawula igatsha lePink Drive esifundazweni, uthe kusewumqansa ukuthi abantu bawuqonde kahle umdlavuza. Uthe ezindaweni zasemakhaya banenkinga yokuthi abantu abakholwa ukuthi nabo bangangenwa umdlavuza.“Kuningi okuyizinkolelo eziyize njengokuthi abanye bacabanga ukuthi uma uhlolela umdlavuza ngo-Okthoba usemathubeni amaningi okuwuthola ngoba yinyanga yokuqwashisa ngawo. Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi umdlavuza awukhethi ngisho iminyaka. Sike saba nengane eneminyaka emibili etholakale inomdlavuza webele,” kuchaza uNkk Benecke.Uthe bayazama ukuqwashisa ngisho ezindaweni ezisemakhaya nasezikoleni. Ukhale ngokuthi abasebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni bathatha isikhathi ukwelashwa ngenxa yokugcwala, yingakho behamba zonke izindawo ukuyohlolela umdlavuza.UNkk Dany Ribbink (42) ongomunye wabaphila nomdlavuza webele uxoxe ngobunzima abhekane nabo eqala ukuthola ngawo. Uthe waqala ukuhlinzwa ngoMashi enesigaxa ebeleni. Uveze ukuthi unina naye wathola ukuthi unomdlavuza eneminyaka engu-39.“Ngangisaba kakhulu emuva kwesonto ngihlinziwe ngoba kwaba noshintsho nasempilweni yami. Ingono yami yaphenduka yaba mnyama nesikhumba sashintsha. Ngilindele ukuyohlizwa futhi ngesonto elizayo kodwa sengamukele, nomyeni wami uyangeseka kakhulu,” kusho yena.Ukhuthaze abesifazane ukuthi bathole umbono wesibili kadokotela ukuqinisekisa isimo sempilo yabo. Uthe lokhu kusiza nangokuthi uzinike isikhathi sokwamukela, uthole nodokotela ozokwelapha ngendlela efanele.UNkk Sarah Walters oyiGenetic Counsellor, ukhulume ngokubaluleka kokuhlola emndenini wonke uma kukhona onomdlavuza. Uveze nokuthi kumele ngisho engekho onomdlavuza abantu bazijwayeze ukuhlolelwa ama-genes ukuze babone uma kukhona osengcupheni yokuwuthola.Kulo mcimbi kuvele ukuthi imali isayinkinga kakhulu kwabanomdlavuza ngoba ukwelashwa kumba eqolo. Lokhu kufakazelwe nanguNkk Ribbink othe akuwona unyaka omuhle emndenini wakhe ngenxa yezindleko zokwelashwa.Abesifazane bahlolelwe umdlavuza bafundiswa nendlela yokuzihlola amabele emakhaya. Uhlelo beluphethwe * -Olwethu Leshabane owaziwa emnncintiswaneni kaMrs South Africa nasohlelweni lwethelevishini iReal Housewives.

UKUSHISA ithayi noma ukuchela igceke ngoshiboshi akuzibalekisi izinyoka emzini wakho.Lokhu kushiwo uMnuz Jason Arnold owungoti obamba izinyoka eThekwini. Uthe izinyoka eziningi aseke wazibamba emizini yabantu zisuke zikulo lelo gceke okusuke kukade kushiswa kulo ithayi noma elichelwe ngoshibhoshi  ngenhloso yokuthi iphume lapho icashe khona.Uthe inyoka iphuma lapho icashe khona kuphela ima ibona sengathi isivalelekile noma izibona sengathi isengozini.“Angazi ukuthi ubani owaqhamuka nesu lokushisa ithayi nokuchela ngamanzi anoshibhoshi egcekeni. Abanye batshala ishaladi noma u-anyanisi eduze kwezindlu ngoba bekholwa ukuthi kuzoqhelisa izinyoka, iqiniso ukuthi lezi zinto azizivimbi izinyoka ukuthi zihambe egcekeni. Uma inyoka izibona ukuthi ivikelekile iyazihlalela noma ngabe lezi zinto zenziwe kulelo gceke,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi izinyoka zibonakala kakhulu phakathi kulaSepthemba noNovemba ngoba yisikhathi lapho zisuke zimatasa khona zakha imindeni emisha, ngakho ziphuma lapho zisuke zicashe khona ukuze zithole ophathina.Uthe ezinye sezizathu ukuthi entswasahlobo kuba nezimvula  bese kuba nezinambuzane namaxoxo adliwa yizo izinyoka, ziyaphuma ziyozingela.Uthe yize indawo ngayinye kungenzeka ibe nezinyoka ezingu-25 ezehlukene kodwa zikhona izinyoka ezivamise ukubonakala  ezindaweni eziningi kuleli, njengemamba emnyama, night adder, vino snakes, Boomslang, istilletto neMozambique spitting cobra.Uthe nakuba zonke izinyoka zinobuthi  kodwa zikhona ezinobuthi obungabulali kodwa obuholela ekutheni uvuvukale noma ulahlekelwe yilelo lunga lomzimba elilunywe yinyoka njenge-stiletto.Uqhube wathi izinyoka ziluma abantu ngoba zisuke zicabanga ukuthi zisengozini noma ziyahlaselwa kodwa azibahlaseli abantu, uma inyoka ikubone kuqala uthe iyabaleka. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka ususe zonke izinto ezigaba yikhaya lezinyoka njengezinkuni, uthayela nezinye izinto ezingaba segcekeni. Uthe uma lezi zinto zikhona egcekeni kumele zinganciki enhlabathini ngoba izinyoka yiyathanda ukuhlala endaweni emnyama, azifuni ukuhlala endaweni lapho zizophazanyiswa khona izinja nezinye izilwane.  Izihlahla ezinde kanye notshani obude uthe nakho akudingeki ngalesi sikhathi.Uthe uma kwenzeka ulunywa yinyoka kumele ubophe inxeba ngebhandishi, bese uphuthuma esikhungweni sezempilo. Uthe kumele uqaphele ukuthi awuliqinisi kakhulu kuze kuphazamiseke ukuhamba kwegazi ngoba ungagcina uqunywa kanti inyoka ekulumile ayinabo ubuthi.Uqhube wathi kumele wehlise ukwethuka ngoba ukushaya ngamandla kwenhliziyo ngenxa yokwethuka kungaholela ekutheni ubuthi busheshe busabalale emzimbeni.Uthe ukukwazi ukuchaza ukuthi inyoka ekulumile ibinjani kuyabasiza abasesikhungweni sezempilo kodwa abasebenzi bezempilo  bayakwazi ukubona ngezimpawu zesiguli, ukuthi silunywe yiyiphi inyoka.Uma kuyingane engakhulumi elunywe yinyoka uthe kunzima ukuba nesiqiniseko sokuthi ilunywe yinyoka kodwa ezinye zezimpawu ongazibona ukuthi ingane iphalaze,noma ihluleke ukuphefumula kahle.

USINDE kukubi uthisha wesikole samabanga aphansi eNquthu ngesikhathi ehlaselwa abazali bengane ayifundisayo abamfice efundisa bamshaya ngenduku waba mabokoboko.Lesi sigameko senzeke esikoleni iLuvisi Primary, okwahlaselwa kuso kwabulawa umfundi nephini likathishomkhulu, uMnuz Vusi Ntombela ngo-2015, owayebuye abe nguSomlomo kuMasipala iNquthu owadutshulwa ngentululwane yezinhlamvu kwathinteka nabafundi omunye washona.Kulokhu kuthiwa kutheleke abazali bafica uNkk Mbali Moloi efundisa kwaGrade 3, bamshaya wanaba ngoba bemsola ngokuhlukumeza ingane yabo.“Bekungumama noyise womfundi kaGrade 3 abafike babuza ukuthi uphi umemu Moloi. Kuthe uma besuka baqonda kuyena bamngenela ngenduku. Izingane zikhale ubumayemaye sezithukile. Nathi sithukile ngoba phela besingazi noma bayamdubula yini njengoba kulesi sikole nothisha uNtombela wahlaselwa kanje wadutshulwa phambi kwezingane ayezifundisa. Indlela abamshaye ngayo ubengaboni ngisho emehlweni,” kusho omunye wabasebenzi.Uthe iphutha likaNkk Moloi wukuthi ngoLwesithathu ukhuze ingane efunda uGrade 3 ngoba ibihlupha omunye umfundi.Lo mthombo uthe okubi wukuthi uNkk Moloi uthe uma evula icala amaphoyisa aseNquthu amnqabela athi abantu okumele bavule icala abazali bengane ngakho yena uma elivula azombopha.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuzomele uNkk Moloi axhumane nomphathisiteshi waseNquthu ngalolu daba.“Singameluleka ngokuthi abuyele esiteshini acele umphathi wesiteshi ukuze amsize kusukunyelwe udaba lwakhe,” kusho uGwala.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, ushaqekile ngalesi sigameko.“Noma ngabe uthisha ubesephutheni kodwa akekho onelungelo lokumshaya. Laba bazali bekumele baye emaphoyiseni bavule icala ukuze aphenye ukuthi ngabe izinsolo ezibekwa umemu Moloi ziyiqiniso yini. Amaphoyisa aqeqeshiwe ngakho yiwona obekumele abikelwe. Bebezothini ukube bebembulala bese ekugcineni bethola ukuthi umsulwa? Siyasigxeka lesi senzo futhi laba bazali bangaba senkingeni uma uthisha ebavulela icala efaka nabameli bakhe,” kusho uMahlambi.

KUPHELILE ngesonto lomfundisi obhekene namacala okudlwengula ePort Elizabeth (PE), izolo okubhuntshe inkonzo umphakathi ubhikisha ngaphandle.Amalungu ebandla leJesus Dominion International eholwa nguMfundisi Timothy Omotoso, aphume esephelezelwa amaphoyisa ekhishwa ngababhikishi abazibiza ngeCitizens In Unity. Umbhikisho ubuholwa yi-ANC Youth League (ANCYL) ne-ANC Women’s League (ANCWL) kukhona namalungu e-EFF nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi. Izolo kujikijelwane ngamazwi phakathi kwamalungu ebandla nababhikishi abaqale ukuqhinqa ngaphandle kwesonto ngo-9 ekuseni.UMnuz Luyolo Nqakula okhulumela i-ANCYL kwelinye lamagatsha ePE utshele Isolezwe ukuthi bakujabulele ukuthi umbhikisho wabo ube yimpumelelo.“Sizamile ukukhuluma kahle nobuholi bebandla kodwa basidelela. Sithole ukuthi isonto alinaso isitifiketi futhi ibhilidi akumele liphendulwe isonto. Umyalezo wethu emalungwini ebandla ukuthi leli sonto alinandawo ePE futhi noma bangalibeka kuphi sizolivala,” kusho uNqakula.Uthe sebekhulumile noMasipala wakuqinisekisa ukuthi namuhla uzothumela ikomiti ukuyovala ibhilidi, kususwe nophawu lwebandla.Okhulumela i-EFF uMnuz Luvuyo Ponase uthe banqume ukuhlanganyela kulo mbhikisho ngoba lolu daba luthinta umphakathi. Uthe ibhilidi alikho esimeni sokuthi kube nesonto kodwa yindawo yebhizinisi. Ngesikhathi abazalwane bephuma esontweni abanye bebegxeka ababhikishi bethi ngeke bayeke ukweseka umfundisi abambiza ngendoda kaNkulunkulu. Omunye wabaholi bebandla onqabe negama lakhe utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ngeke aphawule lutho maqede wavala ucingo.FUNDA:UMasipala iNelson Mandela Bay ukuqinisekisile ukuthi ibhillidi lalingakhelwe ukuthi kusontwe kulo. Inhlangano yamabandla esimanje iChurch Leaders Council of South Africa ithe iyazwelana nabo bonke abesifazane abathinteka odabeni lokuhlukunyezwa u-Omotoso. Okhulumela inhlangano uMfundisi Nathi Zondi uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi konke lokhu kwenziwe egameni lesonto. Uthe bayathemba ukuthi kuzokwenzeka ubulungiswa kuleli cala abafuna lithethwe ngenhlonipho nangokuvikela abagilwa.UMFUNDISI Timothy Omotoso osolwa ngamacala okudlwengula. Isithombe: Raahil Sain/African News Agency (ANA)Icala lika-Omotoso elithethwa eNkantolo eNkulu ePE liqale ukushuba uNksz Cheryl Zondi ongomunye wabagilwa ethula ubufakazi. Kulindeleke kuvele abanye ofakazi njengoba icala libuyela enkantolo namuhla. I-Citizens In Unity izobhikisha namuhla enkantolo kanti UMengameli we-ANCWL uNksz Bathabile Dlamini uzobiza izithangami nabezindaba namuhla. U-Omotoso odabuka eNigeria ubhekene namacala angu-63 okubalwa awokudlwengula nokushushumbisa abantu. Uboshwe noNksz Lusanda Sulani NoZukiswa Sitho abasolwa ngokumsiza ekushushumbiseni amantombazane.

LIGCINE lifezekile iphupho lokuvulwa kwesikole esinobuchwepheshe besimanje kodwa esisemakhaya iMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence esiseNdumo, esifundeni uMkhanyakude, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal.Umqondo wokusungula lesi sikole esiqanjwe ngesishoshovu esaboshwa iminyaka ejele iRobben Island, uMnuz Mandla Mthethwa, waqhamuka nowayenguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo noNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Senzo Mchunu. UMchunu uyilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC aphinde abe yilungu lekomiti elibheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke lale nhlangano.Echaza ngokwamfikela kuze kube nomqondo wokuthi kube nesikole esifuze lesi, uMchunu uthe wayefuna abantu baseNdumo ukuthi bazuze inkululeko njengoba babengakaze bazuze lutho selokhu izwe lakhululeka.Uthe inhloso kwakuwukuthi izingane zakule ndawo zithole imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu zisemakhaya.UMchunu ubalule nokuthi wafike wakhomba indawo okwakuzokwakhiwa kuyona lesi sikole kwathi noma abadweba amapulani bechitha indawo esegqumeni ayefuna sakhiwe kuyona kodwa waqhubeka wama ekutheni ufuna sibe kule ndawo ngoba wayefuna abafundi ukuthi uma befunda babuke indawo ekude ababengafisa ukuya kuyona.UDKT Bhekisisa Mthabela uthishanhloko waseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence eNdumo emi egunjini lamakhompyutha Izithombe: SIBANI NGOBESE“Abadwebi babuya bathi kuzodla enkulu imali ukwakha isikole kule ndawo ngoba iphezulu futhi iyiwa. Ngabatshela bahlengezela izinyembezi ukuthi uma behluleka ukusakha kule ndawo engangiyikhombile, ngizobashintsha ngithole abanye ababezosakha lapho ngangifuna khona.” Uthe umbono wakhe wukuthi kube nesikole esizoba sendaweni yasemakhaya esifana nezenza kahle emadolobheni okwakuzofunda wonke umuntu ikakhulu abakule ndawo okuyibo ababencishwe amathuba. “Kuyangijabulisa ukuthi sigcine sivuliwe isikole. Sasifuna ukukhuphula izinga lezemfundo ngokwakha izikole zesimanje. Noma ngingakaze ngiye kosibona kodwa abantu bakhona bayangithinta njalo bafune ukuthi ngize ngizosibona lesi sikole. Nezinye esasizakha ngisasemnyangweni noma zazingeke zifike kulesi saseNdumo kodwa zazizoba sezingeni eliphezulu zifane nalezi ezisemadolobheni ezihlinzeka ngemfundo esezingeni ekubeni zisemakhaya,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe naseMsinga kwakunezinhlelo zokuthi kube nesikole esifuze lesi esasizofaka zonke izinto njengoba kwakuzohlanganyela yonke iminyango kahulumeni njengoba kwenzeka eNdumo kodwa akazi lolu hlelo lwaphelelaphi ngoba waxoshwa njengoNdunankulu.Lesi sikole kumanje sinoGrade 8, ngonyaka ozayo sizoba noGrade 9 kuthi ngo-2022 sigcine sesinawo wonke amabanga kubalwa * -matric.UDkt Bhekisisa Mthabela, uthishanhloko walesi sikole olandwe umnyango esethathe umhlalaphansi, uthe okwamanje bangu-135 abafundi bakwaGrade 8.Othisha bangu-10, amaHead of Department (HOD) mathathu.“Sekuvuliwe ukufakwa kwezicelo zokufunda ngonyaka ozayo kwaGrade 8. Asithathi kwaGrade 9 ngoba sihamba nabafundi abebefunda kulesi sikole. Abafundi sibasusa phansi size sifike nabo kwa-matric. Zingu-150 izikhala zakwGrade 8 ngonyaka ozayo, abeze abasafuna ukuthola izikhala ngoba ziyashesha ukuphela ngoba baningi abafuna izingane zabo zizofunda kulesi sikole.”Lesi sikole sinamagumbi angu-40 okufundela, i-swimming pool, amahhovisi ama-HOD, igumbi lamakhompyutha, izindawo zokukhanda izimoto, isayensi lab nokunye. Sinezindlu ezingu-10, ezinhlanu ezihlala abafana nezinhlanu ezihlala amantombazane. Indlu ngayinye ihlala abafundi abangu-20.“Kunabaqeqeshi bebhola, rugby, tennis, abokubhukuda ne-netball. Asigxilile kuphela ekufundeni kodwa nakwezemidlalo ngoba umfundi kumele kuvele ikhono lakhe bese eya lapho likhona leli khono.”ABAFUNDI baseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence eNdumoPhezu kokuba kukhokhwa uR12 000 kwabahlala emakhaya noR32 000 kwabahlala ngaphakathi kodwa isikole sikleliswe saba nguQuintile 1 ngoba sisemakhaya futhi nezinga lokungasebenzi kompakathi liphezulu.UMthabela uthe njalo ngemiSombuluko baqeqesha othisha lapho besuke beshoda khona.Nabafundi bahlonyiswa ngemikhakha ehlukene kulandwa abantu abavela emkhakheni ehlukene ukuzokhuluma nabafundi.“Njengoba sisemakhaya nje sifundisa isiNgisi njengolimi lokuqala kanjalo nolimi olwengeziwe. Lokhu sikwenza ngoba uma kukhona umfundi esibonayo ukuthi uzoshayeka ngoba efunde ezikoleni obekungakhulunywa kusona isiNgisi enze lolu limi njengolwengeziwe. Kodwa uma ephuma esikoleni abefunda ngaso isiNgisi engenankinga yokusikhuluma alwenze njengolimi lwasekhaya.”UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, evula ngokusemthethweni lesi sikole muva nje, uthe esakhula wayengakaze acabange ukuthi kunesikole esisendaweni yasemakhaya esingaba nedamu lokubhukuda.Uthe sakhiwe ngoR298 million wathi sikwelinye izinga. “Ngijabula ngokuthi kumanje lesi sikole sesiqalile siyasebenza. Ngonyaka ozayo sizoqhubeka nokwamukela izingane ezivela kuzo zonke izinkalo, yize sizobe sigxile kakhulu kule miphakathi eseduze.”Uthe bazohlinzekwa ngokudla kwasekuseni nsuku zonke abafundi nantambama kuzoba yiso leso.Abafuna izikhala bangathinta uMthabela ku-0849897711.
