text: MHLELLI: Ngiphawula ngodaba lwezimali eziqoqwa emarenke, abafowethu nodade abahweba embonini yezokuthutha umphakathi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi bakhulume ngazwi linye kubona bonke ososeshini kuqedwe izimali eziqoqwa esandleni umuntu oyedwa.Siyazi ukuthi kunezindleko ezikhokhelwayo kasoseshini bonke kunabasebenzi abaqashiwe wososeshini. Akwenziwe izinhlelo imali ikhokhwe ebhange kwi-akhawunti kososeshini. Uma usoseshini ungenayo i-akhawunti, ayivulwe ilabo abangamalungu abasebuholini benhlangano. Le nto yokuqoqwa kwezimali emarenke isikhiphe imiphefumulo eminingi kakhulu.Njalo uma ufunda iphephandaba kuvamisile ukuba nodaba lokuthi kubulawe usomatekisi. Ake kubhalwe okuhle ngale mboni abafowethu nodade abakuyona. Le mboni iyona kuphela ephethwe ngabamnyama ngokuphelele. Kulolu daba olwenzeke eThekwini kudutshulwa usomatekisi waseDurban Line okubuhlungu kudubuleke nomuntu okuthiwa ubezoqala ukusebenza ehlezi nomqashi emotweni.Bafowethu abasembonini ake siyicabangisise nale nto yokubulalana kule mboni nayo icekela phansi isithunzi semboni. Njengamanje ilona bhizinisi elisavule amathuba omsebenzi njengoba imisebenzi inqabile nje. Kubuhlungu okwenzekile ukuthi umndeni ulahlekelwe ilanga lawo ekade bethembile ukuthi uzoshintsha impilo emndenini njengoba kade esethole umsebenzi.Imboni yonke jikelele ayiphathwe ngendlela esemthethwen, izinto azenziwe ngokubonisana kuhlalwe phansi kubhalwe imithetho, iphele le nto yokuthi kulawule idlanzana elesatshwayo.Ntabeni Mfama WentabaEHammarsdale

KUZOQEDWA uhlelo lokuhambisela umphakathi waseMsinga amanzi ngamaloli ngenxa yokunyuka ngamandla kukaphethroli. Umasipala uthathe isinqumo sokuba kugxilwe ekufakweni amanzi adonswa phansi nasemifuleni ngamapayipi ukuze wonge imali.Lokhu kuvezwe iMeya yaseMsinga uNkk Buyiswa Ngcobo ephawula ngohlelo oluqhubekayo lokufakelwa kwamanzi ezigodini ezahlukene zaseMsinga oluqalwe ngesonto eledlule, oluphethwe uMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi.“Ngendlela uphethroli obiza ngayo sesibone kungcono ukuthi amaloli esiwasebenzisayo siwamise nakuba kungeke kwenzeke masishane kodwa yinto esifuna ukuyenza ngoba nakhu umasipala omkhulu ususilekelele wasifakela amanzi adonswayo afinyelela kalula emphakathini esiwakhele. Uphethroli uyinkinga kakhulu kithi njengoba singumasipala obheke imali yesibonelelo sikahulumeni. Izindawo zethu eziningi ezingenamanzi ziningi futhi zikude okwenza sikhokhele kakhulu uphethroli uma kuyiwa kuzo,” kusho uNkk Ngcobo.Uthe bazokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izigodi zithola amanzi afakwa ngamapayipi ngokushesha ukuze bahlukane nokusebenzisa amaloli.Uthe izizumbulu abazikhokha bethenga uphethroli sebezozisebenzisela ezinye izidingo zomphakathi waseMsinga.UMsinga uyingxenye yezindawo zaKwaZulu-Natal ezakhahlamezwa kakhulu isomiso kusuka ngo-2013.UNkk Ngcobo uveze ukuthi indawo yabo iyodwa yafelwa izinkomo ezingaphezulu kuka-2000 zomphakathi ngenxa yesomiso njengoba kwasekushe notshani namanzi.Yize uNkk Ngcobo ezishaya isifuba ngohlelo lokufakelwa kwabantu amanzi kodwa kukhona amalungu omphakathi akhonondayo ukuthi amapayipi afakiwe ezindaweni zawo awawakhiphi amanzi, okwenza bancamele uhlelo lwamaloli.UNkk Ngcobo uthe isimo lesi abasilungisayo ngoba ezinye izindawo ziyenyukela kodwa basebenza ngamandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyawathola amanzi.

SIYAKHULA isibalo sabantu abaququdwa yindlala. Izibalo zango-2016 zeStatistics SA, ezicubungula ngemindeni, iGeneral Household Survey, zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abangu-7.4 million babulawa yindlala kanti manje kulinganiselwa ukuthi lesi sibalo sesicishe siphindaphindeke kabili.Yize izibalo zikhomba lokhu kuyavela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isemazweni ayishumi okuthiwa ayakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele kodwa lokho kudla akufinyeleli kubo bonke abantu ngoba abanye abanayo imali eyenele yokukuthenga. Lezi zibalo ziholela ekutheni uhulumeni asungule izinhlelo eziningi ezizosiza ekutheni abantu abangakwazi ukuzikhiqizela ukudla abazokudla bathole izinsiza ukuze bakukhiqizele imindeni.Uphiko olubhekele ukudla enhlanganweni yezizwe, i-UN Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), luveze okushaqisayo ocwaningweni lwalo luka-2018. Kulolu cwaningo kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi abanye abantu bebulawa yindlala, okwenza ukuthi imizimba yabo ingakwazi ukwenza okumele ikwenze, abanye bakhuluphele ngokweqile nakho okubeka impilo yabo engcupheni. IFAO ithe lesi simo sidinga ukusukunyelwa ngokushesha kuqhanyukwe namasu okusiza abantu ukuthi badle ukudla okunezakhamzimba ezidingekayo.Imindeni entulayo kuthiwa kuba nzima ukuthi ithole ukudla okunempilo igcine idla ukudla okungenamsoco ngoba yikhona ekwazi ukukuthenga.UNgqongqoshe wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Themba Mthembu, uthe kubantu ababulawa yindlala kuleli abesifazane nezingane yibona abaningi.Uthe lokhu kuholele ekutheni izinhlelo zabo zibabhekelele kakhulu abesifazane ukuze kwehle isibalo.UMthembu ubesho lokhu ngesikhathi kugujwa usuku lokudla iWorld Food Day, KwaMachi, ngoLwesibili. Uthe ngokombiko we-UN bangu-43% abesifazane abasemkhakheni wezolimo emhlabeni kodwa uma sekubhekwa ngasohlangothini lobunini bomhlaba kuvela ukuthi balima emhlabeni ongewona owabo.“Abesifazane kulo mkhakha yibona abahlakula amasimu, batshale imbewu baphinde bavune kodwa umsebenzi wabo awuqhakambiswa. Yingakho lolu suku sibuye silusebenzisele ukuqhakambisa nokubonga abesifazane ngegalelo labo. Siqwashisa ngesimo sendlala esikhona, sisize umphakathi ngezinsiza, siphinde sinxuse amazwe omhlaba ukuthi nawo aphonse esivivaneni ukuze kusizwe abangenako ukudla okwanele,” kusho uMthembu.

I-EFF ithi usheshe waxolisa uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali kuleli, uMnuz Nhlanhla Nene, ngemihlangano yakhe nomndeni wakwaGupta ngoba kuningi esazokwenekela izwe okungamahlazo akhe enkohlakalo.Lokhu kudalulwe yiPhini likaMengameli wale nhlangano uMnuz Floyd Shivhambu.Lo mholi ubekhuluma ngesikhathi evula ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi KwaZulu-Natal, ebiseScottsville, eMgungundlovu, izolo ezosongwa namuhla.UNene ube sematheni kuleli sonto ngesikhathi evela phambi kwekhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.UNene waqala waphika ukuthi unobudlelwano nabakwaGupta kodwa washaya ungqimphothwe.Uze wakhipha isitatimende waxolisa ngokuhlangana nabo emzini wabo wathi useyabona ukuthi waphambuka.UShivhambu uthi bazompheka ngobhojwana, aze asule esikhundleni. Uthe baseza nemininingwane ngemali yesikhwama iPIC eyatholwa yinkampani yendodana kaNene.Uthe basazoliphenya ibheshu kuNene obethathwa njengengelosi uma kukhulunywa ngenkohlakalo kuleli.Usole ubuholi bukaMnuz Jacob Zuma ngokufaka abakwaGupta ephaketheni wathi bayitamuzile imali yezwe beyidla udede ngeqholo lokuthi bangobhululu bezikhulu zikahulumeni. Uqhube wathi i-EFF isimi ngomumo ukungena emandleni ishanele onke amabibi eqembu elibusayo.Le ngqungquthela kulindeleke ukuthi imemeze ubuholi obusha besifundazwe emuva kokuhlakazwa kwalobo obudala obebusolwa ngokuhuqa ubuthongo. Abebethwele ngeqoma kwesikaSihlalo wesifundazwe uMnuz Vusi Khoza noMnuz Vukani Ndlovu. Umbango ubushisa phansi phakathi kubonakala ukuthi nezithunywa zehlukene phakathi.ABEPHUME ngobuningi amalungu e-EFF abesengqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi KwaZulu-Natal ebiseScottsville eMgungundlovu ngoMgqibelo. Isithombe: Nqobile MbonambiZibalelwa ku-817 izithunywa ebezethamele ingqungquthela zivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Phakathi kwezinye izikhulu ze-EFF bekukhona noDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi ubelokhu ecule njalo kuhlokoma inkundla.

INDODA yaseMaoti, eNanda, esolwa ngokudlwengula iphindelele abesifazane, itshele iNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, izolo ukuthi ayisazi isibalo sabesifazane eyalala nabo, ababehluleka ukuyikhokhela imali yayo njengoba bengaphezu kuka-55 abesifazane eyayibagada bedayisa umzimba.UMnuz Amos Ganyeni Ngobeni (29) uqhubekile nokufakaza izolo esephonswa imibuzo umshushini wecala, u-Advocate Noxolo Dube.Umsolwa ubhekene namacala angu-47, kuwona kubalwa abesifazane abangu-19 okuthiwa wabadlwengula ezindaweni ezahlukene.Ngokobufakazi bukaNgobeni yena wayengabadlwenguli abaningi kula macala kodwa wayebakhokhisa ngokuya nabo ocansini njengoba babehluleka ukumkhokhela imali yokubagada eGandhi Peace Park lapho babedayisa khona.U-Advocate Dube ebuza ukuthi bangaki abesifazane ababesebenza ngaphansi kwakhe kumele bamkhokhele ngokubagada, uthe babebaningi kakhulu.“Kungaba nzima ukuba ngikutshele ukuthi isibalo sabo sasingakanani ababedayisa umzimba. Kodwa uma ngiqagela nje ababesePeace Park babengu-35 kuthi e-Ottawa babengu-20,” kusho uNgobeni.Ebuzwa ukuthi bonke wayebakhokhisa ngocansi uma bengenayo imali yokukhokha, uthe kwakuhluka.“Kwakuya ngabantu, abanye abesifazane babekwazi ukungikhokhela ngendlela, singekho isidingo sokuba bangikhokhele ngocansi.Abanye balaba besifazane babehlala isikhashana bese beyahamba uma sebenemali eyanele, babuyele emakhaya bangabe besawudayisa umzimba,” kusho uNgobeni.Uthe akukho lapho ayebhala khona phansi ukuthi ubani omkweletayo ngoba amantombazane adayisayo ubesewajwayele, ewazi ngekhanda ukuthi ubani ongakhokhile.“Ngeke ngiqambe amanga ngithi ngalala nabo bonke laba besifazane kodwa uma sekuvezwa izithombe zabo, ngiyakwazi ukubona ukuthi lona ngalala naye noma cha. Angizange ngiwabhale phansi amagama abesifazane engangilala nabo uma behluleka ukungikhokhela,” kusho uNgobeni.Ephonswa ngemibuzo uthe laba besifazane babekhokhisana uR50 ngomzuliswano owodwa kubantu ababethenga kubona umzimba. Yena imali yokubagada ngosuku kwakuba uR100. Uthe le mali babemkhokhela njalo ntambama uma sebeqede ukusebenza.Ukuqulwa kwecala kusaqhubeka.

BUBUYISELWE ngo-elethu ezikhundleni ubuholi be-ANCYL esifundeni iTheku ngemuva kokukhethwa ngaphandle kokuphonselwa inselelo engqungqutheleni ebisenkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida.Bekuvele kulindelekile ukuthi uMnuz Thembo Ntuli ophinde wakhethwa waba uSihlalo noMnuz Thinta Cibane naye ophinde wakhethwa waba uNobhala ukuba babuye. Amalungu alolu phiko eThekwini kade ehlale elibeke ngembaba elokuthi bawubuholi obubuyayo.Ingqungquthela yaseThekwini ngenye yezindlela yokulungisela ingqungquthela kazwelonke yalolu phiko okuhlelwe ukuthi ibe ngesonto elizayo eNasrec, eGoli.Abukeka emancane amathuba okuthi ingqungquthela kazwelonke ingaba khona ngesonto elizayo njengoba kumanje bamatasatasa ngezingqungquthela zezifunda.Ukubuyiswa kobuholi bukaNtuli noCibane kuqinisa umkhankaso kaNobhala we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, ogaqele isikhundla sokuba ngumengameli we-ANCYL.ITheku yisona sifunda sokuqala esaphumela obala sathi sifuna ukuthuma uSabelo esikhundleni sikamengameli wentsha.Ethula inkulumo yakhe ngesikhathi sekuvalwa ingqungquthela uNtuli uthe into yaseThekwini icacile bona bafuna uSabelo ukuba abe ngumengameli wabantu abasha.“Sizoya eNasrec siyokhetha uThanduxolo (Sabelo) abe wumengameli omusha wabantu abasha ngesikhathi sengqungquthela kazwelonke. Sizonxusa nezinye izifunda zesifundazwe nezinye izifundazwe ukuba nazo zimvotele,” kusho uNtuli,Uthe umkhankaso wabo kade waqala manje sebelinde ingqungquthela.UMnuz Jem Sithole waseMoses Mabhida, eMgungundlovu, uthe nabo balungiselela ingqungquthela yesifunda sabo ezoba khona maduze.“Isifunda sethu siseka uThanduxolo kwesobumengameli wentsha,” kusho uSithole.USabelo, osekwa kakhulu yiKZN neMpumalanga, ubanga isikhundla nabantu abaningi okubalwa kubo uMnuz Reggie Nkabinde onguMgcinimafa-jikelele we-ANCYL, Mnuz Mcebo Dlamini wodumo lwe-#Fees Must Fall noMnuz Sifiso Mtsweni, uSihlalo wesikhwama esibhekelele ukusiza intsha, iNational Youth Development Fund.

source: imibono kungaba yingozi ukufuna uyihlo wakho wangempela
text: MHLELI: Ngivumele ngibeke umbono wami mayelana nohlelo oluvezwa kumabonakude olubizwa ngoTatakho, lapho kusuke kufunwa ikakhulukazi ubaba wangempela wengane.Zikhona izingane ezihlezi nobaba abangazizali kodwa abaziphethe kahle njengezingane abazizalayo, bese kuba khona izingane ezifika nomama emendweni kungezona ezasemshadweni. Kuphinde kube nezingane ezihlezi kahle zondliwa futhi zifundiswa ngobaba abangazizali kodwa futhi uthole ukuthi kwayona ingane yazi lo baba njengobaba wayo wangempela.Wonke umuntu uyadinga ukwazi ubaba wakhe, noma ngabe usashona noma ngabe usaphila. Kunezingane namuhla ezakhuliswa ngobaba abangazizali okunamuhla ziphila kamnandi ngoba zakhuliswa kahle.Kunezingane ezihlukunyezwayo kumanje okuthiwa, "Wena kawusiyena owalapha ekhaya, hamba kini!" Uthole ukuthi ingane kayilazi elinye ikubo yazi lapha, kanti umndeni usuyibukisisile, wazanelisa ukuthi kakusiyona eyalapha ekhaya.Kwesinye isikhathi izithandani ziyavumelana ngokuba nemfihlo lapho indoda izothatha unina nengane yakhe, bavumelane ngokuthi lolu daba kuzokuba ngolwabo bobabili.Ngesinye isikhathi uma ingane ikhula iye ifune usiko lwakubo. Yilapho ke iye igule noma kube khona izinto ezingahambi kahle kuyona, igcine isiya kulaba okuthiwa bayabona, abanye ke kuye kuthiwe bayabona kanti kababoni.Iqala lapho ke inkinga, ufike umntwana atshelwe lokho namuhla kusasa atshelwe okuhlukile, ekugcineni bese ehlasela umama wakhe. Umama uhlaselelwa ukuthi kungani engalikhulumi iqiniso achazele ingane ukuthi ingeyakwabani? Uthole abanye sebeludlulisela udaba kuTatakho!Yilapho ke ingane ithola amahlazo kamama wayo ukuthi walala namadoda amangaka, kanti futhi akayazi okuyiyona eyamkhulelisa. Nakhona lapho kuyenzeka amadoda awakhumbulayo umama ukuthi waya nawo ocansini abe mathathu, nakhona lapho uthole ukuthi imiphumela iyawaphika la madoda amathathu.Kwesinye isikhathi omama bezingane bayalala namadoda ahlukene bese kuthi uma esekhulelwe abheke indoda engakwazi ukondla ingane bese ethi iyona ke ubaba wengane. Abesifazane bajwayele uma kuzikhulunyelwa nje bese bethi bayamazi bona ubaba wengane, kodwa uma ulandela uhlelo uTatakho ugcina sewutholile ukuthi lokho akusilona iqiniso.Uma ke imiphumela yamadoda amabili noma amathathu iyilandula ingane, ibe ibihlala futhi yazi ukuthi ubaba wayo yilona oshade nomama wayo, ishona kephi? Umama wayo ushona kephi? Ubudlelwane bengane nonina buba kuliphi izinga?Kuhle ukuthola iqiniso kodwa elingeke futhi lakushiya nomlilo osuyokusha inguna-phakade! Uma singalandela ukuthi labo abaphikwe yimiphumela okusho ukuthi kumanje ababazi abobaba babo, baphila kanjani ke kumanje? Sizothola ukuthi isimo sibi kakhulu kunakuqala udaba lungakayi kuTatakho.Kuyingozi ukufunwa kukababa yingane, kungcono kune ngubaba wengane oyifunayo. Nakhona futhi lapho, ake sicabange, sekuthiwa mina noma wena, kunobaba othi mina ngiyingane yakhe ngoba balala nomama wami, nomama avume ukuthi walala naleyo ndoda! Umama osekuvela ukuthi walala namadoda athize ekubeni eseshadile, angeke esahlala kahle emzini. Mhlawumbe nje selokhu lolu hlelo lwaqala baningi omama asebethuthile emizini yabo bahamba, ngoba vese bakhombise ukungathembeki. Kuyihlazo kakhulu ukuthi kwaziwe ukuthi ingane kamasibanibani akayazi ukuthi ingekabani!O’ Brien GcabasheEnanda

UJABULELA ukushintsha kwempilo yakhe owesifazane waseShowe obenenkinga yesisu esikhulu nokukhuluphala ngokweqile, ohlinzwe mahhala ngabakwaNetcare.UNksz Khanyiswa Thusi (36) obeseshaya isisindo esingu-180kg, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ubesezame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa isisu kodwa kungalungi. Wabhalela abakwaNetcare ngoDisemba 16 wonyaka odlule ecela usizo. Isikhalo sakhe safinyelelwa kuDkt Gert Du Toit wesibhedlela iNetcare St Augustine’s eThekwini, osebenza ophikweni iMetabolic Centre. UDkt Du Toit wacela nosizo kwiNetcare Foundation ukulekelela ngezindleko zokuhlinzwa.UNksz Thusi uhlinzwe ngoNovemba 27 emuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, ebonana nodokotela abahlukene nongoti bendlela yokudla. Uthe ubesephenduke inhlekisa ngobukhulu bakhe, esehlala egula.“Akukho engingakuzamanga ngizama ukunciphisa isisu, ngizame ngisho ijimu nokushintsha indlela yokudla. Bengingasakwazi nokulima kahle njengoba ngiziphilisa ngakho. Mkhulu umehluko engiwuzwayo emzimbeni wami, ngizizwa ngilula. Sekukhona ukudla engingasakwazi ukukudla, okuvele kubuye uma ngikuphoqa,” echaza.Uthe odokoteka bathe kuzothatha isikhathi esingangonyaka ukuze anciphe ngokuphelele.UDkt Du Toit uthe emuva kwesonto uNksz Thusi ehlinziwe ubesehle ngo-15 kg emzimbeni. Uthe ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa wancipha ngo-7kg.“Silindele ukuthi agcine eshaya isisindo sika-70kg, okuzosiza nokuthi angahlaselwa izifo. Sikujabulele ukwenza ushintsho empilweni kaNksz Thusi futhi usinike isizathu esibalulekile sokubuyisela emphakathini. Siyathemba ukuthi uzolulama ngokuphelele, aqhubeke nomsebenzi wakhe,” kusho uDkt Du Toit.UNkk Mande Toubkin oyiGeneral Manager kwi-Emergency, Trauma, Transplant and Corporate Social Investment kwaNetcare uthe bathinteka ngokubona isimo sikaNksz Thusi, bazibophezela ukuthi bamkhokhele zonke izindleko.UNksz Thusi uthe utshelwe ukuthi ukuhlinzwa kukodwa kubiza uR250 000. Leli phephandaba like labhala ngoNksz Thusi nonyaka, ngomsebenzi wakhe wokulima nokutshala amaButternut. Uthe kumanje usedayisela isitolo sakwaSpar eShowe kodwa usafisa ukufaka nakwezinye.

LIVELE eNkantolo yeMantshi oPhongolo iphoyisa lesiteshi saseNgwavuma elisolwa ngokudubula libulale umlisa ebelimsola ngokupaka kabi imoto emgwaqweni.UContsable Mxolisi Donda (30) usezikhindini ngecala lokufa kukaMnuz Sifiso Sithole (24) okuthiwa ubezoqala ukuqeqeshelwa umsebenzi wobuphoyisa naye. Kuthiwa leli phoyisa elidume ngesihluku endaweni, lahilizisana nomufi baze bashova iqupha isikhathi eside kubuka abantu. Kuthe uma umsolwa ebona ukuthi sengathi akaliboni elidlalayo ngamankomane walanda isibhamu somsebenzi emotweni wadubula umufi emphindelela washona. Kuthiwa ababekhona bathi umufi wadutshulwa ngemuva ekhanda esezama ukubaleka ebona ukuthi kulandwa isibhamu. Ngesikhathi ecela ibheyili enkantolo ubalule ukuthi unezingane azondlayo futhi izindleko zekhaya zibheke yena, wacela inkantolo ukuthi imdedele ukuze ayohlukanisa unyaka nezingane zakhe. Icala lihlehliselwe uLwesithathu lapho okulindeleke ukuthi kukhishwe khona isinqumo ngesicelo sebheyili yomsolwa.UMbuso ubuphikisana nokuthi athole ibheyili ukhala ngokuthi icala abhekene nalo libucayi.Enkantolo bekunenqwaba yabantu abebethamele icala bebhikisha bethi akangayitholi ibheyili ngoba uyiphoyisa elihlupha umphakathi.Umnewabo kamufi uMnuz Freedom Shongwe, uthe babambe umoya ngoba bafuna lo mlisa ahlukanise unyaka ekhulukuthu ngoba bahlukumezekile ngokubulawa komfowabo."Sifuna inkantolo yenze ubulungiswa kungaba kubi uma imdedela ngebheyili ngoba nathi akubanga mnandi kubulawa umfowethu. Ubengasebenzi kodwa indlela yakhe ibisicaca ngoba ubebiziwe emaphoyiseni esezoqeqeshelwa ukuba yiphoyisa," kubalisa uShongwe.

source: umfundi onomdlavuza wezinso unikelelwe ngendlu enogesi
text: UNIKELELWE ngendlu umfundi wasoLundi onomdlavuza wezinso obesekuphele iminyaka emithathu ehleli esibhedlela ngoba umuzi wakubo wodaka awuvumelani nesimo sakhe sempilo.UNokwethemba Dlamini (16), wasoThini, eNkonjeni ofakelwe izinso ngemuva kokuthi ezakhe zihlaselwe umdlavuza, ubesehlale iminyaka emithathu esibhedlela Inkosi Albert Luthuli, odokotela bethi akuphephile ukuthi ayohlala endlini yodaka eyodwa abehlala kuyo namalungu omndeni wakhe angu-20.UNokwethemba isimo somuzi wakubo siholele ekutheni abuye esegula kakhulu kungakapheli nesonto enikezwe ithuba lokuthi abavakashele ekhaya, ngemuva kwalokhu odokotela bathatha isinqumo sokuthi ahlale esibhedlela aze alulame ngokuphelele.UNksz Kholiswa Nonkwelo weSisekelo Foundation okuyinhlangano esiza izingane ezinezifo ezibucayi, eziphoqeleka ukuthi zihlale ezibhedlela ngenxa yesimo senhlalo emakhaya, ngokuhlanganyela noMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMasipala wasoLundi nosomabhizinisi bendawo bakhele le ntombazane indlu enamakamelo amane anikezwe wona ngokusemthethweni ngempelasonto.Kule ndlu uNokwethemba uzohlala nezingane zakubo nonina kuphela.UMnuz Mbulelo Baloyi womnyango uthe ungqongqoshe uMnuz Ravi Pillay uthinteke kakhulu ngesimo sale ntombazane eyahlaselwa umdlavuza ineminyaka eyisishayagalolunye.UNQQONGQOSHE wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ravi Pillay, uNokwethemba Dlamini noNksz Kholiswa Nonkwelo ngesikhathi kuvulwa ngokusemthethweni indlu ayakhelwe umnyangoUmnyango wakhe indlu, inkampani yendawo iMathamsanqamahle Trading and Projects yafaka ugesi, umasipala wathenga imibhede negilosa.UNokwethemba uthe ujabule kakhulu ukuthi usezohlala nomndeni wakhe ebese kunesikhathi eside ehlukene nawo.Uthe akufisayo manje ukuthi abuyele esikoleni , wagcina esikoleni kwaGrade7 eSivannda Higher Primary eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule.

source: uzowudlela esitokisini ukhisimusi umfundisi osolwa ngokudlwengula
text: KUQHUME isililo nomthandazo eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNtuzuma ngemuva kokuphikiswa kwesicelo sebheyili sikamfundisi weTowers of Faith Ministries International, uMphostoli Mxolisi Striker Shange.Lo mfundisi uzowudlela ejele eWestville uKhisimusi njengoba eyoze abuyele enkantolo ngoJanuwari 21 ngonyaka ozayo. UShange ubhekene namacala amane, okungamabili okudlwengula, elilodwa lokuthumba nelinye lokuhlukumeza ngokocansi amantombazane aneminyaka aphakathi kuka-14 no-18. Lawa macala kuthiwa uShange wawenza eLeisure Palace eNewlands West kusukela ngo-2014 kuya kuNovemba 12, 2018.IMantshi uBusisiwe Mkhulisi imnqabelile uShange ibheyili ngoba ithi wahluleka ukunikeza inkantolo izizathu ezinqala zokuthi kungani kufanele anikezwe ibheyili futhi waqamba amanga. Ngemuva kokuchitha isicelo sebheyili, uShange uqale wafaka phansi ikhanda ngaphambi kokuthandaza isikhathi eside. Uthe esuka lapho wagqolozela uMshushisi uSbongile Ngcobo isikhathi eside futhi engacwayizi.UShange ubuke uNksz Ngcobo waze wayosithela emgodini, elokhu emgqolozele.Abazalwane bavele basikhihla isililo futhi abanye bathandaza. Kukhona intokazi esencane ebigqoke izibuko yona evele yazigingqa phansi.Abesifazane abadala bathwale kanzima bethulisa amantombazane abegqoke izikibha ezinobuso bukamfundisi.Kulokhu uShange ungene enkantolo eswenke ngesudi ephuzi nehembe eliyisikotshi.Inkantolo beyigcwele phama abazalwane abebezoseka uShange. Isicelo sebheyili saqala sachithwa ngumphenyi wecala uSergeant Nomathemba Khwela owaveza ukuthi uShange uzophazamisa uphenyo futhi nempilo yakhe isengcupheni.Nomshushisi uhambe emazwini kaSergeant Khwela futhi wathi kuzodingeka uShange aqhamuke nento ephathekayo engenza anikwe ibheyili.Ngemuva kwesinqumo uNksz Ngcobo uphume ngomnyango ongemuva njengoba amakholwa abelokhu emkhombe njalo ngeminwe, emsola ngokuthi nguye obecindezela uShange.UShange ubemelwe wumnikazi wenkampani yabameli uMnuz Sandile Shoba weShoba Sandile Attorneys. Leli cala like laphenduka umantuntanendishi njengoba liqale enkantolo enguG, lagcina seliku-E ngenxa yokushisa nokungasebenzi komshini oqopha amazwi.

IZIGAMEKO zokugwazana kwabafundi esikoleni samabanga aphezulu KwaMakhutha zenze ukuthi uvalwe khona umkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane izolo.Umcimbi wokuvala imigubho yalo mkhankaso wenziwe yiMeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, okhale ngezigameko ezimbi ezenzeke kule ndawo. Yize singashiwongo ngegama isikole kodwa yiseMasakhane High lapho kuke kwagwazana abafundi ababili bashona ngo-Agasti. Imeya iveze izibalo zezigameko ezahlukene ezibikwe esiteshini samaphoyisa KwaMakhutha kusukela ngoSepthemba, ezinye zazo ezinyukile. Ithe ikhethe ukuvala umkhankaso KwaMakhutha ukukhuza umhlola wezigameko ezingezinhle. UNkk Gumede uqale waveza izibalo zokudlwengulwa ezibikwe esiteshini samaphoyisa, athe ngoSeptemba bayisihlanu abadlwenguliwe, ngo-Okthoba bayisishiyagalombili kwathi ngoNovemba balishumi.“Okubi ngalezi zibalo ziyenyuka kunokuba zehle. Lapha sikhuluma ngezibalo zezigameko ezibikiwe kuphela. Kungenzeka ukuthi baningi abanye abadlwenguliwe kodwa bangabika,” echaza.UNkk Gumede uveze nezibalo zokugqekezwa kwemizi ngoSepthemba ezibe u-39, zaba wu-35 ngo-Okthoba zaba u-44 ngoNovemba. Emacaleni okushaya ngoSeptemba abe ngu-34, ngo-Okthoba aba u-28 kwathi ngoNovemba awu-35. Imeya igxeke ukwanda kwamathaveni angekho emthethweni, ethe anomthelela ekubhebhethekiseni ubugebengu. Ezibalweni zamathaveni atholakele engenawo amalayisensi agcine engu-28 ngoNovemba, eqale engu-19 ngoSepthemba. Kwababulewe izibalo zikhomba ukuthi babe yisikhombisa ngoSepthemba bagcina beyisishiyagalolunye ngoNovemba. Kulo mcimbi imeya ibuye yapha ngamaphasela okudla imindeni edonsa kanzima. Ithembise ukuthi nezaguga zizothola izipho ungakashayi uKhisimusi.OnguSihlalo wekomiti leCommunity Service kuMasipala weTheku, uNkk Zama Sokhabase ugcizelele ukuthi kuvalwa kuphela imigubho ehambisana nomkhankaso kodwa abesifazane nezingane kumele bavikelwe unyaka wonke. Naye ukhale ngesigameko sokugwazana kwabafundi esikoleni, athe yikho okwenze ukuthi bawuvale KwaMakhutha umkhankaso. Umkhankaso wavulwa yimeya eSankotshe nakhona okuthiwa bekwande izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabadala. Emcimbini wayizolo kunandise umculi wowokholo uDumi Mkokstad obehambisana noBetusile. Umkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane uba minyaka yonke ngoNovemba 25 kuya kuDisemba 10.

KUSOLWA ubudedengu babasebenzi bakaMasipala baseZululand, ophikweni lwamanzi ngokushona kwengane yaseNcotshane oPhongolo, eminze emgodini obumbelwe ukulungisa ipayipi.ULuyanda Gumede (4) kuthiwa ubedlala nabanye ontanga ngoMsombuluko emini ngesikhathi ephonseka kulo mgodi obusugcwele amanzi emvula. Lesi sigameko sicasule umphakathi osola ukuthi ukungavalwa komgodi yikona okwenze ingane iphonseke futhi kusazodaleka omunye umonakalo.Ilungu lomphakathi, uMnuz Vusi Shamase, uthe umgodi wambiwa ngesonto eledlule wangavalwa kwaze kwangena amanzi.“Bekungafakwanga ngisho izintambo ezibomvu ezikhombisa ukuthi kunobungozi. Kubonakale ezinye izingane zilokhu zikhomba emgodini kanti uLuyanda ubevele engasabonakali. Kube yinhlanhla kwakona ukuthi angene yedwa kulo mgodi ngoba bezikhona nezinye izingane abedlala nazo,” echaza.UShamase uthe kumanje lo mgodi awukagqitshwa futhi kunesalukazi esinendlu eduze kwawo lo mgodi, naso esisengcupheni.UNkk Nontobeko Dlamini othe uLuyanda uzalwa ingane kadadewabo, uthe bashaqekile ngokwenzekile. Uveze ukuthi uLuyanda washonelwa abazali wase ekhuliswa nguyena.“Bengingekho ngisedolobheni, uLuyanda ngamshiya nomkhulu wakhe. Umkhulu ubematasa endlini, wangambona uLuyanda ephuma ebizwa ezinye izingane. Uzwe sekuthiwa uphonseke emgodini, wayomtakula waphuthunyiswa emtholampilo kwatholakala ukuthi useshonile. Indlela umgodi ojule ngayo ufika ehlombe kumuntu omdala,” kusho uNkk Dlamini.UMnuz Gabriel Zwane onguyise omkhulu kaLuyanda, uthe izolo ulubikile udaba emaphoyiseni. Ngesikhathi sokuloba amaphoyisa athe akuveli ukuthi kukhona icala elivuliwe.IPhini leMeya oPhongolo futhi eliyikhansela eNcotshane uNkk Busi Mvelase uthe, bakhathazekile ngalesi sigameko. Uthe kujwayelekile ukuthi abasebenzi bakamasipala bashiye imigodi ingagqitshiwe.“Kwaqhuma ipayiyi ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, ngashayela ucingo uphiko lwamanzi eZululand ngoba yibona ababhekelela ukulungiswa kwawo. Bambe umgodi bawushiya waze wagcwala amanzi. Ngizwe izolo (ngoMsombuluko) ukuthi sekushone ingane, ngaphinde ngababikela eZululand. Kubuhlungu ngoba sekushone ingane ngenxa yobudedengu babantu,” kusho yena.Uthe uyesaba ukuthi kusazolimala abanye ngoba umgodi usufakwe inhlabathi emuva kwesigameko, okusengabisha umuntu kuwona. Ucingo lukaSomlomo waseZululand uMnuz, Sbu Nkwanyana belukhala lungabanjwa, wathunyelelwa iSMS okushaye isikhathi sokuloba ingaphendulwanga.

SEKUPHINDE kwaqubuka umsindo ebandleni lomfundisi waKwaNongoma, uKing Prophet Saziso Ndwandwe, iHealing Hour Emmanuel Prophetic Global Ministry ngemuva kokulobola ngosuku olulodwa izelamani zakwaMdluli eBhambayi eNanda.Ngokusho komthombo ongaphakathi egatsheni laleli bandla elikhonzela enkabeni yedolobha laseThekwini, kunabazalwane abangayizwa indaba yakhe yokuqonywa yizelamani uNondu noTho.Umthombo uthe uNdwandwe (36), obuye asakaze kwiNanda 84.0 FM ngamaSonto, waqala wathandana noNondu baze batholisana ingane.“Bahlukana noNondu engakabelethi. Uthe esuka wayegxumela kudadewabo omncane (uTho) wamphuca ubuntombi bakhe. Uthe esethi uyomlobola, abakubo kwakhe bathi akasale esebathatha kanyekanye noNondu. Yingakho-ke ephoqeleka ukuthi abalobole kanyekanye ngoR8 000 (okusho ukuthi uR4 000 umuntu ngamunye),” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba uthe okucasule abanye abazalwane futhi abaze bambizela emhlanganweni uNdwandwe ukuthi kunohide lwamantombazane obekwaziwa ukuthi ujola nawo futhi awathembise umshado.“Umfundisi useyaganga ngempela ngoba kunentombazane esimbekezelele kakhulu uSne Mgobhozi, sonke ebesesazi ukuthi uzoyithatha. Kunenye futhi eneminyaka engu-18 esisanda kuzwa ukuthi uyigqekeze wayishiya. Kukhona nenye efunda eMangosuthu University of Technology kodwa edabuka KwaHlabisa nayo ayigqekezile,” kuphetha lo mthombo.Enye yala mantombazane okuthiwa uyigqekezile, iziqinisekisile lezi zinkulumo kwiSolezwe ngoMgqibelo.Kodwa icele ukungagagulwa ngoba yesabela ukuthi unina usayazi iyintombi.“Umfundisi wakhuluma nomama ukuthi ufuna ukungenza enye yamakhosikazi akhe kodwa umama wanqaba.“Ngelinye ilanga sagcina silalile naye umfundisi kodwa ngathi angifuni ukushada ngoba ngisafuna ukuqhuba izifundo zami,” kusho le ntokazi eno-18.USne uvumile ukuthi uyathandana nomfundisi kodwa wenqaba ukuphawula ukuthi kumphathe kanjani ukulobola kwakhe izelamani.Imizamo yokuthola izelamani noNdwandwe ayiphumelelanga futhi kwahluleka ngisho sebethunyelelwa nemiyalezo.UNdwandwe uthe okwamanje ngeke akwazi ukuphawula kahle ngalolu daba ngoba kukhona okusamenze wamatasa, kodwa uzobuye akhulume naleli phephandaba. Phambilini watshela leli phephandaba ukuthi unoxhaxha lwezintombi enkonzweni ayiholayo. Wathi uyakholelwa kakhulu esithenjini, nasekuqonyweni futhi uyakholelwa kukhona. Wathi zonke izintombi namakhosikazi akhe, ubaboniswa wuNkulunkulu.Ngo-2005 washadelwa nguVelile uMaDladla kwathi ngonyaka olandelayo walandelisa ngoThando uMaNgcobo ngaphambi kokubalamanisa ngezingoduso okungoNksz Ntombifuthi Mfekayi (24) waseMtubatuba, uNksz Sinothile Ntshangase (24) waseNewcastle noNonhle Ntuli (22) waKwaNongoma.Wathi akagcinile kodwa usazokwengeza ngabanye ababili ukuze agcine enesithembu samakhosikazi ayisikhombisa, ngokomyalelo kaNkulunkulu.Wathi yena wasindiswa ngo-2007 futhi unamandla alingana nawomsunguli webandla lakwaShembe, uMqaliwendlela.UNdwandwe uqale ukuzakhela udumo ngokuzishaya isifuba ngokuthi welapha isandulela-ngculazi futhi atholele abantu imisebenzi ngamatshe.

IGAMA lobenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma selivele ohlwini lwamagama abantu abaphakanyiselwe ukuthi bajutshwe ePhalamende emuva kokhetho luka zwelonke oluzoba ngonyaka ozayo.Igama lakhe kuvele ukuthi lingunombolo 74 emagameni angu-833 aphakanyiselwe ukuya ePhalamende. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi uZuma uma evuma ukuthunywa ePhalamende kuyohoxiswa yonke imihlomulo yakhe yokuthi wayengumengameli bese ehola imali yokuba yilungu lePhalamende. Uyokwephucwa abaqaphi nemali ayiholayo njengoba esehleli ekhaya.Okhulumela i-ANC okwesikhashana uMnuz Dakota Legoete uthe abanayo inkinga ngokuvela kwegama likaZuma ohlwini lwabantu abacatshangelwa izihlalo ephalamende."Indaba yamagama ayikaqedwa ngoba isazobukwa kahle uma sesihlangene. Umuntu nomuntu uzobhekwa ukuthi unakho konke yini okufunekayo ukuthi ayomela inhlangano ephalamende njengoba sifuna kube abaholi abaqotho.’’

SEKUQUBUKE indida ngokuthi babulaweleni abalisa ababili abangabokufika okuthiwa baqale bashawa ngaphambi kokuthi bashiswe babulawe.UMnuz Daniel Dunia wenhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu, i-Africa Solidarity Network (ASONET) uthe basadidekile ngokubulawa kwabalisa ababili baseCongo, uMnuz Alex Msambya (30) noMnuz Nakatanda Mazuruza (32), okuthiwa batholakale beshiswe babulawa emuva kokuthi begcine bebonakala beya e-Adams Mission ngoLwesibili oludlule.UDunia uthe izidumbu zalaba bobabili zitholakale ngoLwesine emakhazeni asePark Rynie emuva kokuthi benyamalale ngoLwesibili. “Bahambe bethi baya e-Adams Mission bayokhanda ifriji kodwa bangabuya. Kuthe uma sibona ukuthi abatholakali sababheka yonke indawo kwaze kwaba sithola ucingo lusibikela ukuthi basemakhazeni. Ngendlela abashe ngayo bekunzima ngisho ukubabona bese sisizwa yizingubo ababezigqokile,” kusho uDunia.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi akucaci ukuthi babulaweleni oMsambya noMazuruza. Ngokusho kwakhe, sebezame ngayo yonke indlela ukuthola kubantu balapho okuthiwa bashiselwe khona kodwa akekho ofuna ukuphumela obala ngalesi sehlakalo.Kwayizolo uthe bebehambele indawo yesigameko beyozama ukuthola ngokwenzekile kodwa bangamthola umuntu obacaciselayo.“Akekho ofuna ukukhuluma ngokwenzekile kodwa uma sizwa noma sibona indawo okwenzeke kuyona siyabona ukuthi bashawa base beshiswa ngamathayi. Yinto ebuhlungu kakhulu lena kuyabonakala nje ukuthi babulawelwe inzondo yokuthi ababona abakuleli ngoba uma siphenya asisitholi esinye isizathu,” kuchaza uDunia.Ukhale nangokuthi abagculisekile ngophenyo ngokufa kwalaba bobabili njengoba ethe kuze kube manje asikho nesisodwa isitatimende esesitathiwe kubantu balapho okubulawe khona oMsambya noMazuruza.Uthe okunye okumphatha kabuhlungu ukuthi uMsambya bekungaqali ukuthi ahlukumezeke ngenxa yodlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika, ngo-2015 kwenzeka nokwaholela ekutheni agcine engasahlali lapho ayehlala khona kodwa wagcina esehlala ezinkanjini ezazihlala abebalekele ukuhlukunyezwa emphakathini ababehlala kuyo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwezidumbu zabesilisa ababili beshisiwe eNkangala, e-Adams Mission. Uthe laba balisa abakaziwa kanti yima kusazokwenziwa ulibofuzo.

BAFUNWA uthuli amaphoyisa abesilisa abathathu okuthiwa bagasele esitolo eBuzi Cash & Carry oLundi bashaqa imali enguR154 000 bashaya bachitha nayo.Lesi sigameko okuthiwa sishiye umphakathi waseMtikini, oLundi, ushaqekile senzeke ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi kufika imoto ebithi izolanda kulesi sitolo.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe ngomthombo osondelene nalolu daba ngabo-1 emini kugasele amadoda amabili, eyodwa kuthiwa yona ibiqaphe ngaphandle kwasesitolo.Umthombo uthe indoda eyodwa ingene kulesi sitolo iqhuba ngesibhamu unogada wemoto ethwala imali. Kuthiwa iqonde kwisisefo esigcina imali. Ibe isibiza omunye wesifazane okukhokhwa kuyena  ukuba naye eze lapho kukhona isisefo esigcina imali.Kuthiwa indoda iphoqe unogada ukuba avule isisefo kodwa wavele wanikeza yona ukhiye.  Kuthiwa indoda ivule isisefo yathatha imali.“Imali okutholwe ukuthi ithathwe yila madoda kube wuR154 000,” kusho umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa.Ngaphezu kwalokho kuphoqwe lo wesifazane oshaya i-till ukuba ayokhipha enye imali nayo yathathwa. Kwenzeka lokhu nje, kuthiwa enye indoda ibahambe ikhipha imali kuwo wonke ama-till esitolo.Kuthiwa amadoda amabili aphume esitolo nemali esephethe nesibhamu sikanogada. Akwaziwa ukuthi la madoda ababaleke ngani endaweni yesigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe bathungatha amadoda amathathu basaphenya ngalesi sigameko.“Kuvulwe icala lokubanjwa inkunzi esitolo. Kusaphenywa ukuze kutholakale konke okwenzekile kulesi sigameko. Amaphoyisa athungatha abasolwa, akekho oseboshiwe,” kusho uZwane.Imizamo yokuthola umnikazi wesitolo ayizange iphumelele izolo njengoba izinombolo zakhe zingazange zitholakale.

BEKUNGUNYAKA onzima embuthweni wamaphoyisa njengoba kube nezigameko ezishaqisayo lapho kubulawe khona amaphoyisa, okubalwa nesokuqothwa kwamaphoyisa esiteshini eNgcobo, e-Eastern Cape, adutshulwa.Kulesi sigameko esenzeke ngo-Febhuwari nonyaka kwashona amaphoyisa amahlanu nesosha elilodwa. Lesi sigameko sathusa wonke umuntu kuleli ngoba lawa maphoyisa ahlaselwa esesiteshini sawo futhi kwagcina ngokuthi kuboshwe abasolwa kwelinye lamabandla akule ndawo, iMancoba Seven Angels.Ngaphandle kwalawa maphoyisa aseNgcobo, eKZN kushone inqwaba yamaphoyisa nonyaka. Amanye ebesemsebenzini, amanye engekho emsebenzini. Kokunye amanye azibulele ngenxa yezimo ezahlukene.Kwadutshulwa kwabulawa amaphoyisa awu-6 esiteshini samaphoyisa engcobo kugasela amadoda ayezofuna izibhamu. Isithombe: SAPS*ENgcobo kushone uWarrant Officer Zuko Mbini (45) noConstable Zuko Ntsheku (38) Nkosiphendule Pongco (32) Sibongiseni Sondlana (32) and Kuhle Metete (27). Iqulu lamadoda lagasela esiteshini saseNgcobo, esiphakathi kwaseMthatha nase-Queenstown avulela ngenhlamvu ebhekise kulawa maphoyisa. Kwaboshwa amalungu ebandla okwakusolwa ukuthi ayefuna izibhamu zamaphoyisa ukuze ezobamba inkunzi emabhange. Icala lisaqhubeka enkantolo.*UCaptain Dumisani Mhlanzi wesiteshi saKwaMaphumulo wadutshulwa izigebengu engekho emsebenzini kwesinye sezitolo zokudla KwaMaphumulo. Izigebengu kuthiwa zazibambe inkunzi kwesinye isitolo, zabe sezihlangana naye zangabuza, zavele zamdubula. Abasolwa ngokumbulala badutshulwa amaphoyisa abanye baboshwa.*UWarrant Officer Sibusiso Linda (54) wabulawa eMalukazi eSiphingo. Yena ubesebenzela esiteshini saseMlaza. Kuthiwa wahlaselwa ehlezi nomunye wesifazane emotweni yakhe. Wayengekho emsebenzini ngesikhathi edutshulwa.CONSTABLE MBIKO BUTHELEZI*Ngo-Agasti kubulawe uConstable Mbiko Buthelezi (36), wesiteshi saseNtuzuma odutshulwe esemsebenzini KwaMashu ehostela. UButhelezi wadutshulwa ehamba nozwakwabo belandela umkhondo wabasolwa ngemuva kokuzwa kuqhuma isibhamu, bazithela phezu kwabasolwa ababentshontsha. Omunye wabasolwa wabe esedubula amaphoyisa. UButhelezi washonela endaweni yesigameko.*Ngo-Okthoba kwadutshulwa uWarrant Officer Bhekisigcino Zethembe Khwela (54), wesiteshi saseMariannhill, esemzini wakhe KwaNdengezi. UKhwela wayesuka emsebenzini esesekhaya ngesikhathi ehlaselwa abantu abangaziwa. UKhwela wadutshulwa phambi kwendodana yakhe nomngani wayo.USERGEANT NONHLANHLA MAZIBUKO* NgoSepthemba kubulawe uSergeant Nonhlanhla Lindiwe Mazibuko (40) wasesiteshini saseMandeni owadutshulwa ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa esekhaya. Kusolwa kuthi wadutshulwa isoka lakhe kulandela ingxabano. Umsolwa ona-43 wazinikela emaphoyiseni.*UConstable Khayelihle Gwala (32) wesiteshi saseBabanango wazidubula eceleni komgwaqo emuva kokushayisa izinkomo ngemoto yomsebenzi ngoJulayi nonyaka. UGwala wayesebenza ebusuku, wathatha imoto yomsebenzi ngaphandle kwemvume. Waphuma emngceleni okumele ngabe wayesebenza kuwo ngemoto ebheke kubo KwaNongoma kanti uzovelelwa yingozi. Wasinda engozini yokushayisa izinkomo, wabe esephuma emotweni, wathatha isibhamu sakhe somsebenzi wazidubulela khona endaweni yesehlo, washona.*Isikhulu emaphoyiseni omgwaqo kuMasipala uMvoti, uThabani Ndaba (41), wadutshulwa emahhovisi alo masipala ephuma emhlanganweni ngoNovemba 1 nonyaka. UNdaba wabulawa esanda kunyuselwa esikhundleni. Kusaphenywa ngokubulawa kwakhe, akukaboshwa muntu.*Ngempelasonto kaDisemba16 nonyaka kushone amaphoyisa amabili ezingozini zomgwaqo ezehlukene. Kwesinye isigameko senzeke e-Atteridgeville ePitoli, iphoyisa lashayiswa umshayeli obedakiwe ngesikhathi kunesivimbamgwaqo. Elinye lashona engozini eyenzeke e-Olifantsfontein khona ePitoli kuR21.

source: iphithene amakhanda imndeni yabababoshwe ngelezidakamizwa e us
text: IPHITHENE amakhanda imindeni yabesifazane abathathu baseThekwini ababoshwe ngezinsolo zokushushumbisa izidakamizwa e-United States.Ababoshiwe ngoNksz Londiwe Shange (27), Wandile Mhlongo (29), Thembeka Sokhulu (36) baseThekwini noNksz Viwe Tshaka (23) ongowaseLusikisiki e-Eastern Cape. Baboshwe ngoNovemba 17 emkhumbini abebesebenza kuwo weMSC. Bavela enkantolo yeMantshi yaseFlorida eMiami ngoMsombuluko.Ngokwemibiko e-US babanjwe necocaine ka7kg. Uma betholwa benecala bangase bagwetshwe iminyaka eyishumi kuya kudilika jele.UNtokozo Mlambo, ongumzala kaWandile Mhlongo, uthe ube ngowokuqala emndeni ukwaziswa ngokuboshwa kwakhe kanti nguye okudingeke ukuthi atshele umndeni ngalezi zindaba. Uthe uNksz Mhlongo ubesekwinkontileka yakhe yesithathu esebenza kulo mkhumbi.“Unina zimuphathe kabi lezi zindaba. Uyazama ukuziqinisa kodwa uyambona uma uhlezi naye ukuthi umqondo wakhe ukwenye indawo,” kusho uNtokozo.Uthe umndeni uyahluleka ukuqonda ukuthi uzibandakanye kanjani nezidakamizwa.FUNDA:“Besingakaze sizitshele ukuthi angazibandakanya nezidakamizwa. Ngesikhathi sithola izindaba bengizitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe utholwe nesikali esincane abesisebenzisa kodwa uphathwa yi-Asthma futhi uyaziqhelelanisa nezinto ezingabeka isimo sempilo yakhe engcupheni. Ngibone ukuthi lubucayi kangakanani udaba ngesikhathi sengaziswa ngezinsolo ababhekene nazo."Uthe umndeni awunayo imali yokuya e-United States.Umfowabo kaNksz Sokhulu, uMnuz Lindokuhle Sokhulu unqabile ukukhuluma nephephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iThe Mercury.“Sisathukile, siyibone emaphepheni lento umndeni kungakakhulunywa nawo. Okwamanje akukho esingakusho,”usho kanje.Unina kaNksz Shange, ongalidalulanga igama lakhe naye uthe ngeke aphawule ngento asiyibone emaphepheni.Okhulumela uMnyango woBudlelwano Namazwe Angaphandle (International Relations and Co-operation)  uMnuz Ndivhumo Mabaya uthe bayaxhumana nababoshiwe.

LIZODLULELA eNkantolo eNkulu icala lamadoda amabili asolwa ngokubulala umqaphi wowayenguNdunankulu KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, njengoba icala labo lihlehlele unyaka ozayo.UMnuz Dumisani Cebekhulu (26) noNtuthuko Mkhwanazi (24) bebevele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMpangeni kuleli ngecala lokudubula babulale uMnuz Xolani Nkosi owayegada uMchunu. Igama leNkantolo eNkulu bazolazi uma sebezotshelwa ngosuku lwabo lwasenkantolo.Isidumbu sikaNkosi satholakala simbobombobo yizinhlamvu kubo sisemotweni yomsebenzi eDumisani Makhaye Village eMpangeni ngoJulayi 2015.Imantshi itshele laba balisa ukuthi babuyele enkantolo ngoJanuwari 19 sebezozwa usuku lokuya enkantolo enkulu futhi kusekhona amaphepha abasalinde ukuthi alethwe enkantolo. Njengoba kusalindwe usuku lwabo lwasenkantolo enkulu, bona bazobe begqunywe esitokisini kuze kushaye usuku lwabo lokubuyela enkantolo.UNkosi wabulawa ngesikhathi uMchunu esahleli esihlalweni sokuba undunankulu ngaphambi kokuthi akhonjwe indlela ngoMeyi 2016.Njengamanje uMchunu usesebenza ekomkhulu le-ANC eLuthuli House eGoli njengoba esekomitini labagqugquzeli.UMchunu wakugxeka kakhulu ukubulawa kukaNkosi, wanxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi asebenze ngokuzikhandla abophe abasolwa.Ukubulawa kukaNkosi kwadala ukukhuluma okuningi kusolwa izinto ezahlukene nokwamkhathaza kakhulu uMchunu.Ngesikhathi evele phambi kwekhomishini kaMoerane wakuveza ukukhathazeka kwakhe ngokubulawa kukaNkosi.Waze wakhala ngokuthi akanelisekile ngophenyo ngoba kwakukhona izinkomba zomkhondo kodwa kungaboshwa muntu.Ekhala nangokuthi ukhona umuntu owatholwa neselula kamufi nokukhomba ukuthi unolwazi ngokufa kwakhe.Kuvele nokuthi laba balisa ngaphandle kwecala lokubulala uNkosi babhekene nawokubamba inkunzi behlomile nelokuduna imoto. Kuvele nokuthi umsolwa wesithathu usagcwele amathafa kodwa amaphoyisa ayamthungatha njengoba kwavela ukuthi babebathathu abantu ababekhona kubulawa uNkosi.

ABANTU besifazane ababhukule balwele umhlaba bangalokhu belwela izinto ezincane ezifana namathoyilethi nezindlu ngoba zingadilika baphinde babuyele emgwaqweni beyolwa. Mabalwele umhlaba ngoba wona awuyi ndawo.Lokhu kushiwo umengameli wenhlangano yabesifazane abangabalimi, iWomen in Agriculture and Rural Development (Ward), uNksz Maureen Magubane, ngesikhathi kunesigcawu sabesifazane sokubonisana ngezindlela ezingasetshenziswa ukuze abesifazane bathole umhlaba, ebesiseThekwini, izolo.UNksz Magubane uthe sekukaningi ebona abantu besifazane begcwele izitaladi bekhala ngamathoyilethi noma ngezindlu kodwa ayikho imashi aseke wayibona abesifazane befuna ukunikezwa umhlaba.“Singabantu besifazane sicindezelekile ngasohlangothini lokunikezwa amalungelo omhlaba. U-80% wabasebenza emapulazini kuleli yithina kodwa uma sekubhekwa ukuthi ngobani abanikazi bomhlaba, u-1% kuphela wabantu besifazane abangabanikazi bomhlaba. Le nto isitshela ukuthi kusamele sibhukule silwe, silwele amalungelo ethu. Njengamanje kulukhuni satshe ukuthi umuntu wesifazane athole isiza emhlabeni wamakhosi. Uma engenayo indoda kudingeka abe nendodana okuyiyona ezomumela. Njengamanje kukhulunywa ngokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Uma lungekho uhlelo oluqondene nathi singabantu besifazane sizophinde sisale ngemuva futhi nakulona. Sifuna uhulumeni achaze ukuthi ingxenye engakanani yomhlaba ezokwabelwa abesifazane,” kusho yena.UDkt Hlengiwe Mkhize, iNational Convenor yeProgressive Women Movement of SA, uthe iNingizimu Afrika ichazwa njengelinye lamazwe anokungalingani okukhulu ngokobulili.UDKT Hlengiwe Mkhize oyiNational Convener yeProgressive Women Movement of SA (PWMSA)Uthe le nhlangano imele ukuqinisekisa ukuvikela abesifazane odlameni olubhekiswe kubo, ukuqiniseka ukuthi abesifazane bayafunda, bayahlomula kwezomnotho nokubatshela ngamathuba ezomnotho akhona.Izolo uthe inhloso enkulu yabo ukuzochazela abesifazane ngamathuba akhona kwezolimo nokuthi umhlaba ubaluleke kangakanani.UNKK Nompumelelo MhlongoUNkk Nompumelelo Mhlongo wophiko olubhekele ukukhiqizwa kokudla, iFood Security, eMnyangweni wezoLimo nokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi wasemaKhaya kulesi sifundazwe, uthe ukusebenza umhlaba kuqala ngokusebenzisa igceke onalo, uma selilincane bayakusiza ukuthi uthole isiqeshana esingaphezulu kwaleso onaso kwamasipala bakusize ukuze ukwazi ukukhiqiza ngoba inhloso yabo wukuthi wonke umuntu azikhiqizele ukudla azokudla nomndeni wakhe.

KUHLUKENE phakathi umndeni umfundisi webandla lamaZayoni eMtshezi ‘enikela’ ngesidumbu sendodakazi yakhe esokeningoba ethi lalobola, kodwaizingane zakhe, abafowabo nodadewabo bathi bayakweshwama lokhu.Njengamanje isidumbu sikaNksz Thabile Mpungose (46), sibangwa yilo mndeni nesoka nalo elithi yilona elizomngcwaba ngoba bese lilobole kushoda ngomshado kuphela, kodwa amanye amalungu omndeni awakwazi lokho, abemazi njengomuntu ozijolelayo nje.Lokhu kuvele emuva kokushona kwakhe uMnuz Mbongeni Mathe waKwaNongoma obaziwa njengesoka, eveza ukuthi usengumkhwenyana ngakho uzozingcwabela yena.Omunye wamalungu omndeni utshele leli phephandaba ukuthi uyise kamufi uMnuz Bangumuzi Mpungose wamukela uR30 000 njengelobolo kuMathe nokwenza avumelane naye ngokungcwaba umufi.“Uyanqaba ukuthi angcwatshwe ekhaya eMtshezi ngoba usaba ukuthi uMathe uzofuna ilobolo lakhe. Akekho umuntu obaziukuthi kukhona osekwakhokhwa ngisho ubhuti kamufi akabizwanga.“Nathi nezingane zakhe besingazi nosisi ubengakaze asitshele lokho. Noma ngabe kukhona abakukhipha kodwa ubengashadile,” kusho leli lungu lomndeni.Indodakazi kamufi uNksz Lungi Mpungose (28) ithe yize umkhulu wabo engafuni kungcwatshwe unina kubo bazoqhubeka nemizamo angcwatshelwe eStanger lapho ebenomuzi khona.UNksz Mpungose uveze ukuthi yena akasebenzi kodwa umfowabo (20) uzozithwala izindleko zomngcwabo. “Ushone kade esezohlala nathi eStanger ebuya KwaNongoma ngenxa yezinkinga ebebhekene nazo. Indaba yamalobolo asiyazi, akakaze akhulume ngayo siyiqabuka manje eseshonile. Siyasihlonipha isinqumo sikamkhulu ngoba uthe akasidingi isidumbu sakhe kwakhe. Sizokwenza imizamo yokuzingcwabela,” kusho uNksz Mpungose ekhathazekile.Ethintwa umkhulu wabo ubhoke wakhahlela waveza ukuthi ngeke alubhade kulowo mngcwabo.“Ngangingeke ngitshele bona. Uma umuntu elotsholelwa ubuza abafowabo.“Kodwa ngoba bayizingane ezingezwa abazibonele,mina uma umkhwenyana ethi akayi emgcwabeni ngizongayi nami. Lo oshonile uyazi ukuthi bese kusele umshado ubesanda kufika ezolanda imali yokwembesa abakhwekazi. Ngabe bese beshadilekulibazise bona,” kusho uMpungose.Eqhuba uvumile ukuthi umufi ubese nazoizinhlelo zokubuyela emzini wakhe eStanger nezingane sezibhaliswe ngakhona kodwa wathi lokho akusho ukuthi ubesehlukana noMathe.“Bebengaxabene lokho sekukhandwa yizo lezi zingane. Umkhwenyana ubemnakekela ngisho egula emhambisa kodokotela,” kusho uMpungose.Leli phephandaba liphinde lathola ukuthi kukhona nokushaya amakhala ngokushona kukamufi njengoba kuthiwa wamilwa iqhubu emlonyeni ngoMsombuluko wakhala ngalo kwaze kube ushonela erenki eMpangeni ngoLwesihlanu esendleleni ebheke eStanger.Ethintwa uMathe ngalolu daba uvele wangena ezintangeni waveza ukuthi naye unemibuzo ayibhekise kwiphephandaba ufuna ukwazi lizithola kanjani izindaba, kwaze kwaba ugcine engaphawulanga ngokugcwele.

source: imeya iphikisa imibiko yokuthi izoboshwa maduze
text: IMEYA yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede ithi imibiko yabezindaba mayelana nokuthi izoboshwa maduze ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa wumkhankaso wokuyinyundela nokungcolisa igama layo.Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba, uNkk Gumede uthe le mibiko ikhishwe ngesikhathi lapho kuqhubeka khona uhlelo lokuhlanganiswa kohlu lwamagama abaholi abangathunywa ezikhundleni nangesikhathisomkhankaso wokhetho lwangonyaka ozayo.“Kunenhlese yezepolitiki ngalezi zinsolo eqhutshwa ngabantu abathile abafuna ukufeza izinhloso zabo.Kuyishwa ukuthi izintatheli zivumela ukusetshenziswa kulo mdlalo wepolitiki,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Uthe indlela lezi zindaba ezingekho ezibhalwa ngayo ziphinde zibe nomthelela omubi edolobhenilaseThekwini.“Zonke lezi zinto engisolwa ngazo azinasisekelo, njengoba kukhulunywa ngethenda okuthiwa akuzange kulandelwe imigudu ngesikhathi ikhishwa. Leyo thenda okukhulunywa ngayo yakhishwa mina ngingakabi ngisho imeya,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Uthe kule mibiko yabezindaba akuveli ukuthi kwaba iliphi iqhaza lakhe ekukhishweni kwale thenda okukhulunywa ngayo.“Ngabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekusungulweni kophiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa emkhandlwini, iCity Integrity and Investigation Unit nokuthi lunikezwe amandla. Imina osekhaleni empini ebhekiswe enkohlakalweni ngaphandle kokwesaba nokwenzelela,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Uthe uzoqhubeka nokusebenzela idolobha futhi ngeke asabe ukuvikela ukwethembeka nesithunzi sakhe.“Nginxusa abezindaba ukuba bayeke ukuvuma ukusetshenziswa ukubhebhethekisa izindaba ezingekho,” kusho uNkk Gumede.Uthe kulemibiko yabezindaba akukho lapho lowo okhulumela amaphoyisa ebala khona igama lakhe ukuthi ungomunye wabantu okuhlelwa ukuba baboshwe khona maduze.Okhulumela oKlebe kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Hangwani Mulaudzi uthe kukhona uphenyo abalwenzayo mayelana nezinsolo zenkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa emkhandlwini weTheku kodwa wangawadalula amagama abantu ababaphenyayo.Uthe ziningi izikhulu ezisazoboshwa eThekwini ngemuva kokuboshwa kwezinye ezintathu ngeledlule ngamacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa.

source: i icasa nemizamo yokwehlisa intengo ye data ekhalisa iningi
text: ABANTU sebezokwazi ukubona ukuthi basalelwe yi-data engakanani kumaselula abo futhi izinkampani zokuxhumana ziyalelwe ukuthi zibazise uma isiphelile zingavele zithathe imali yabo.I-Independent Communication Authority of South Africa (Icasa) iyalele izinkampani zokuxhumana ukuthi zazise amakhasimende azo ngokusebenza kwe-data futhi kube yiwona azinika igunya lokuthi zithathe imali uma sekuphele i-data.Njengamanje uma kuphela i-data izinkampani zamaselula zivele zidle imali uma umuntu kade efake i-airtime. I-Icasa ithe ayifuni kushaye uFebhuwari abantu besathathelwa imali. NgoLwesithathu inkampani yezokuxhumana iMTN ithe amakhasimende ayo azokwaziswa nge-data esisele.“Amakhasimende ethu azokwaziswa ukuthi asebenzise i-data engakanani kusukela kwengu-50% kuya phezulu. Sizowacela ukuthi asinike igunya lokuthatha imali uma eseqede i-data,” kusho abakwaMTN esitatimendeni.ITelkom nayo yenza isimemezelo esifana nesikaMTN ngenyanga edlule futhi kulindeleke ukuthi nezinye izinkampani zamaselula ezingakazimemezeli lezi zindaba ukuthi zilandele maduze.I-Icasa ithe izosebenza kanzima ukwehlisa intengo ye-data ekhalisa abantu njengoba isaqhubeka nezingxoxo nezinkampani zamaselula ukuze zehlise izindleko zokuxhumana.

source: isibheke kwisizini yayo ka  imuvhango enomlando
text: UMSUNGULI weMuvhango, okulindeleke ukuthi kuqale isizini yayo ka-20 ngoJanuwari, uDuma Ndlovu (osesithombeni), uthe abantu abamnyama esikhundleni sokwesekana babheka amaphutha okucekelana phansi.UNdlovu, owaqala iMuvhango ngo-1997, uthe kusukela umdlalo waqala ziningi izingqinamba asebedlule kuzo. NgoJanuwari 9 lo mdlalo okhonjiswa kuSABC 2 ngo-9 ebusuku ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, uzobe uqala isizini yawo ka-20.“Sibe nohambo olunzima abantu besibheka ukuthi yini embi esiyenzayo ukuze siqumbeke phansi. Uma umuntu omnyama kukhona into enhle ayenzayo sibheka amaphutha simcekele phansi,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe ngesikhathi eqala iMuvhango, iSABC yayifuna izinhlelo ezikhuluma ngamasiko abantu abamnyama.“Kwaba yinkinga ngoba abantu babengajwayele ukuzibona ngale ndlela kwithelevishini. Ngenhlanhla kaNkulunkulu yadlondlobala kwaba nesasasa ngendlela engakaze ibonakale. Ngaleso sikhathi abantu babekhonze iBold and the Beautiful. Babethethisa ngisho umshayeli wetekisi bethi bazofika ngemuva kwesikhathi. Thina sasidlala ngo-7.30 ngoMsombuluko,” kuchaza uNdlovu.Uthe kwakunabanye ababethi umdlalo uzophela ngemuva kweziqephu ezintathu kodwa ngenxa yokwesekwa, ngemuva kweminyaka emine iSABC yanquma ukuthi badlale izinsuku ezimbili ngeSonto.UNdlovu uthe uzimisele ngokukhulisa umdlalo asungule neminye.“Sisungule imidlalo emithathu. UZalo lunababukeli abangu-10 million, iMuvhango iko-5.5 million kuthi iMbewu ibe ko-3.5 million. Kusho ukuthi ngosuku abantu abangu-18 million babuka imidlalo eqalwe yimi. Okwami ukuqeqesha abalingisi abasha futhi ngeke ngime njengoba nale eminye imidlalo isiphethwe ngabantu abasha. Nami ngaqala ngimncane futhi ngiyakholelwa kubantu abasha,” kusho uNdlovu.

SIGCINE sifinyelele ku-106 isibalo sezingane ezizalwe ezibhedlela ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal ngoKhisimusi, eziningi eziphume nezitifiketi zokuzalwa.UDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo onguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo esifundazweni ngoKhisimusi uvakashele isibhedlela ePrince Mshiyeni naseRK Khan ukuyonika izipho omama ababelethile. Ubehambisana noNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezaseKhaya uDkt Siyabonga Cwele osizane nabasebenzi bomnyango ukukhipha izitifiketi neMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede. UDhlomo ukhale ngokuthi isayinkinga indaba yokukhulelwa kwezingane njengoba bekukhona eneminyaka engu-16 komama ababelethe ngoKhisimusi.Lo mama omncane ubelethe esibhedlela iQueen Nandi Memorial eMpangeni, kwathi ababili abaneminyaka engu-17 babeletha ePrince Mshiyeni naseSt Apollinaris esifundeni eHarry Gwala.“Le ngane ebelethe ineminyaka engu-16 kusho ukuthi yakhulelwa ineminyaka engu-15. Kusobala ukuthi kusamele kuqiniswe imikhankaso yokuqwashisa ngokukhulelwa. Okubi ukuthi omama abaningi abashona bebeletha kusuke kungabancane ngoba bayasaba ukusho, baphuze nokuya emtholampilo bafihle ukuthi bakhulelwe,” kusho uDhlomo.Ezinganeni ezizelwe esifundazweni kubalwa abafana abangu-63 namantombazane angu-43. Kulesi sibalo kukhona namawele abelethwe esibhedlela eShowe okungumfana nentombazane.UCwele uthe uyajabula ukuthi izibhedlela eziningi esifundazweni sezinawo amahhovisi omnyango wakhe. Uthe inhloso yabo ukuthi izingane ezizwele zibhaliswe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 emnyangweni, wakuncoma ukuthi omama abaningi bafika nabo omazisi uma bezobeletha ukuze bathole izitifiketi. Unxuse nokuthi obaba baphelezele omama ezibhedlela uma beyobeletha ukuze nabo babhaliswe imininingwane yabo.IGauteng iyona enesibalo esikhulu sezingane ezizalwe ngoKhisimusi, esifinyelele ku-324. Isitatimende soMnyango wezeMpilo eGauteng siveza ukuthi isibhedlela iChris Hani Baragwanath Academic sibe nesibalo esiphezulu ngezingane ezingu-47 ezizelwe. UDkt Gwen Ramokgopa onguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo eGauteng ukhale ngokungababoni oyise bezingane ngesikhathi evakashele omama ababelethe ngoKhisimusi esibhedlela eSebokeng.Kuzalwe izingane ezingaphezu kuka-60 eLimpopo kwathi eWestern Cape kwazalwa ezingaphezu kuka-75.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo e-Eastern Cape uNkk Helen Sauls-August uncome onesi nodokotela ababelethise izingane ezingu-275. Zingaphezu kweshumi izingane ezizalwe eNorth West okuyiyona enesibalo esincane kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

UPHIKO lwentsha iYoung Communist League of South Africa (YCL) selunqumele ugwayi katiki isiteshi somphakathi Izwi Lomzansi 98.0 FM ukuba lubuyisele emoyeni ngokushesha umsakazi okusolwa ukuthi umiselwe ukufequza umfana aze achame. UNosipho Ngubane usebhuquza ekhaya ngemuva kokuvela kwe-video yakhe efequza omunye umfana.I-YCL ithe uma iZwi LoMzansi lingambuyisi uNosipho lizozifaka enkingeni ngoba ngeke yona ithule isonge izandla ngalolu daba, izolusukumela.Ngokuthola ngemithombo esondelene nalesi siteshi, lo msakazi wamiselwa ukufaka lesi siteshi ehlazweni nokushutha eduze kwemoto yomunye umsakazo. Lesi sigameko kuthiwa senzeka ngesikhathi iGagasi FM likhankasa kwiBeach Festival eThekwini ngoDisemba 1. UNosipho uvela edansela ingoma kaManqonqo ethi Eyadini, ezikhuhla ngezinqe waze wachama.IPhini likaNobhala lweYCL, uMnuz Isaac Luthuli, ukhwele wadilika kubaphathi.“Ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane kwenzeka ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu okusolwa ukuthi kwenziwe yiZwi loMzansi akukho emthethweni, kuyafana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane.FUNDA:Umiswe yisiteshi okhuhle owesilisa wazichamela“Ukube bekuwumsakazi wesilisa obedansa kanjeya bekungeke kube nenkinga. Njengoba kuwumuntu wesifazane osebenza kulesi siteshi uyavinjwa ukuba adlule emotweni yomunye umsakazi, okuwubulima. Abaphathi balo msakazo baphethe ngezandla sensimbi, bayaxhaphazana futhi bavilapha ukucabanga. Ukwehlulwa ubuciko kubenza baxhaphaze abasebenzi besifazane,” kusho uLuthuli.“Emhlabeni wonke jikelele wake wabonaphi umuntu ngokuzidansela nje sekuthiwa ungcolisa igama lesiteshi. Akukhona ukuthi wayedansa engagqokile, okuyinto eyihlazo noma waphoqa umfana owayejabulela umdanso. Ngakho ngiyasixwayisa isiteshi ukuba sibuyisele emoyeni lo msebenzi ngokukhulu ukushesha futhi bahoxise ukumshushisa.Yinhlamba kubuntu. Uma behluleka ukwenza njalo, bazozifaka enkingeni ngoba ngeke size sithule sisonge izandla,” kuphetha uLuthuli. Imithombo ithe usekhonjwe indlela kwiZwi Lomzansi kodwa uXulu usaphika ulala ngomhlane.“Wathi asimnikeze ikhefu ngoba kukhona asafuna ukukulungisa okuqondene naye.” Ebuzwa ukuthi uzobuya nini uNosipho, uXulu uthe ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari. Ethintwa uNosipho wenqabile ukuphawula, wathi nje “angisenankinga. sengicela ukuhamba,” kuphetha. Nayizolo uNosipho ubengekho emoyeni futhi isikhala sakhe besivalwe nguzakwabo, uMC Pholobas.

KUPHELE amathemba okuqashwa kwabanye abahlengikazi ngesikhathi bebona kuphume inqwaba yabahlengikazi abangasebenzi beyozama inhlanhla emkhankasweni woMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, wokuqasha abahlengikazi.Bangaphezu kuka-8000 abahlengikazi ababambe ulayini ezinkundleni zemidlalo ezingaphandle kwesibhedlela Inkosi Albert Luthuli belindele ukwenza inhlolokhono emuva kokuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni umemezele ukuthi ufuna ukuqasha abahlengikazi abangu-300. Umnyango bewucele ukuthi abahlengikazi abanezicucu zokuba ngo-enrolled nurses abangu-150 nabanezicucu zokuba ngama-enrolled nursing assistants abangu-150 bazofaka izicelo zomsebenzi.Abanye babahlengikazi bazwakalise ukuthi sebezoyizama inhlanhla kodwa abanalo ithemba lokuthi bazoqashwa ngoba bebona izinkumbi zabahlengikazi ebezime ulayini omude.UNksz Sdudla Zondi waseNew Hanover ngaseMgungundlovu, obeseneminyaka emithathu elinde ukuqashwa emuva kokuqeqeshwa esikhungweni esizimele iMpumalanga Nursing College, e-Appelsbosch uthe ufike ngehora lesine ekuseni ezinkundleni zemidlalo ngoba enethemba lokuthi uzoba ngomunye wabokuqala. Uthe uselindele ukuzwa noma yini kodwa unovalo ngoba bebebaningi kakhulu.UNksz Sibusisiwe Mambumbu (24) uthe ubeselinde ukuqhubeka ayobhala izivivinyo zenhlolokhono kodwa naye ukhale ngokufanayo“Angikholwa ukuthi ngizowuthola umsebenzi. Sibaningi kakhulu esize la kumanje (esho izolo) ngisamile kodwa ngifike ekuseni,” kusho uNksz Mambumbu.Omunye umhlengikazi othe uvela eZululand ocele ukuthi igama lakhe ligodlwe, uthe kungcono ukube bekuhlukaniswe ngezifunda abantu benze inhlolokhono ezifundeni zabo. Uthe abanye babo baboleke imali ukuze bagibele, kwababiza imali enkulu ngoba besuka kude.ABANYE abahlengikazi baqale ukulahlekelwa yithemba ngesikhathi befika bebona inqwaba yabantu abebezimisele ngemisebenzi engu-300 ekhishwe nguMnyango wezeMpilo KwaZulu-NatalIsithombe: MOTSHWARI MOFOKENG/African News Agency (ANA)Iningi labahlengikazi abebeze kule nhlolokhono baqeqeshwe ezikhungweni ezizimele.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal uDkt Sbongiseni Dhlomo, uthe kubuhlungu kakhulu ukubona abahlengikazi abaningi ngale ndlela bezozama ukuthola amathuba omsebenzi.“Kubuhlungu kakhulu uma ubuka izinkumbi zabantu bakithi ababalelwa ku-10 000 kuya phezulu abafuna amathuba emsebenzi abaqeqeshwa baba ngo-nursing assistant abanye baqeqeshwa baba ngo-staff nurse beqeqeshwa yizikhungo ezizimele zakhona la esifundazweni, babaqeqesha bangabenzela lutho, babashiya kanjalo bethi abazifunele imisebenzi,” kusho uDhlomo.Uthe baze baba nomhlangano nalezi khungo bezicela ukuthi azehlise isibalo sabafundi. UDhlomo uthe basizwe yimali ekhishwe yisikhwama sikamengameli wezwe.Uqhube wathi abantu bangabagxeka ngokuletha abantu, okukhona kubo abasuka kude ngenxa yezikhala ezingu-300.Uthe bakwenze lokhu ngoba befuna labo abazothathwa bakwazi ukuqala ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 1 ngonyaka ozayo. Unxuse abazobe bengathathwanga ukuthi bangalilahli ithemba.

text: Sanibonani. Namhlanje ngifisa sikhulume ngodaba lokuxolela bese sibheka nezimo ezivame ukubekwa yilo othi woniwe ezimenza angavumi ukuthethelela.Sike sathi sizihlalele sixoxa ngobunzima obake basivelela nezinye izinsizwa kwaqhuma izindaba ezihlekisayo abanye baze babalula nokuthi kunjani ukungaholelwa ngumqashi wakho kuze kwedlule usuku lomholo, kwaba khona nophawule indaba yokwephucwa emlonyeni lowo othandana naye.Kuzona zonke lezi zivuvaba ezihlukumeza abanikazi bazo, kube nesisodwa nje namanje engingakasithathi isinqumo sokuthi ukuba kwakuyimi owayebhekene nale mbedumehlwana nganginquma ukuthini.Woza nendlebe-ke (noma iso lakho) ngikuxoxele.Lo mlisa uthi wayevame ukugibela ibhasi lokuqala lasentathakusa njalo ekuseni uma eya emsebenzini.Kuthe langa limbe wavukwa yisisu ebusuku, lesi esiqala ngokubhavumula sikuvuse kube ngathi ushiswe yilahle lomlilo. Ziningi phela izinhlobo zokuphathwa yisisu, lesi akhuluma ngaso uthi uma sesikubambile ungaphambana nenyoka iza kuwe, uqonde ngqo kuyona uphinde uyeqe futhi maqede ungaqalazi emuva ukuthi iyakulandela. Uyaqonda-ke ukuthi bunjani lobunzima akhuluma ngabo.Uthi sam’bamba lesisu simkhipha waze washiywa yibhasi lokuqala ayevame ukulithatha. Ngenhlanhla wakwazi ukulinda waze wathola ibhasi elilandelayo. Ujabula nje kanti akabuzanga elangeni ukuthi kusekukhulu okuzomehlela.Nebala angene ebhasini abe nenhlanhla yokuhlala esihlalweni esingemuva komshayeli webhasi. Noma engakushongo lokhu kodwa ngiyasola indoda yasikhetha ngabomu lesi sihlalo ngoba ibheka ukuthi ukuhlala kwayo kuso kuzoyisiza.Lihambe ibhasi lithi nje lingafika endaweni eyigquma uma nje lithi thuthu lehla egqumeni ibhasi, kwasuka lokho. Ewu sathi isisu ngila, yathi le ndoda iyaziqinisa ibambelela esihlalweni iqinisa imihlathi, sathi isisu cha angenziwa kanjalo.Yaba yinye kuphela into eyayingenziwa yithi sonke, insizwa yaqunga isibindi yasukuma yaqonda ngqo kumshayeli iyomnxusa ukuthi amise ibhasi ukuze ikwazi ukwehla iyobhekana nale ngwadla. Okokuqala nje okwaba luphawu lokuthi idlozi layo liyifulathele, yathi ingakasibeki isicelo sayo, umshayeli washo ngesankahlu ukuthi “Wendoda, njengoba ubona kahle ukuthi akusona istobhi sokuma lesi, ubungelinde ngize ngime ukuze uzobuza ngoshintshi wakho ongaphele."Cabanga njalo ukuthi isisu asinamamenazi, asinanhlonipho. Yazama indoda ukuzikhalela ithi, "Mshayeli, awumise ibhasi ngikhishwa yisisu bo."Umshayeli waphendula ngokuthi kusemnyama ngeke akwazi ukuma esigangeni ngoba kuzobeka yena nabagibeli engozini yokubanjwa yizigilamkhuba.Yaqhubeka le ndoda ikhala ithi umshayeli akame okungenani uzoma maqede angalindi avele ayishiye khona lapho.Kwangathi nomshayeli uthelwe ngezibonkolo, etshela lo mgibeli ukuthi indlela ancenga ngayo sengathi iwubufakazi impela bokuthi kukhona amaqhinga ophezu kwawo, yikho kona kanye-ke, okwenza ayishaye ngamandla ibhasi.Ewu uyabona uma umuntu exoxa ngosizi lwakhe, niqale nonke ninsinsitheka nigcine senibona ethuthumela ukuthi lolo sizi alusadabukisi, kunalokho seluvusa intukuthelo.Akukho noyedwa owaba nesibindi sokumncenga umfo lo ukuthi akaxolele umshayeli. Kwathula kwathi cwaka!Emva kwalokho wonke umuntu wacabanga ukuthi uma kungenza lesi simo sibhekane naye wayengakwazi yini ukuthi avumele ukuthambisa inhliziyo axolele lo mshayeli?Ibuhlungu le ndaba ngendlela yokuthi akekho noyedwa kithi owabe esaqhubeka ebuza ukuthi ukwenqaba komshayeli kwaholela ekutheni yenze njani indoda.Kubili kuphela okunokwenzeka ukuthi kwagcina kwenzekile, okokuqala kungenzeka ukuba indoda yalahla ithemba yabuyela esihlalweni sayo yayobekezela kunzima kunjalo.Okwesibili-ke ngizocela ukuthi ngikushiyele kuwena ukuthi uzame ukucabanga ukuthi konje kwagcina kwenzekeni. Uma usuyitholile impendulo yesibili ngiyocela wenze kanje, ufike ungazise nami bese uqhamuka nesu elibukhali lokuncenga lo mnumzane ukuthi axolele loya mshayeli.Uma nawe wawungumshayeli wawungenze njani ngempela esimweni sokumiswa umgibeli kusempondozankomo sibe sazi ukuthi izwe selaba libi kanjani?U-Alex wethula uhlelo indaba emsakazweni iGagasi FM ngoMsombuluko ngo’7 kusihlwa bese ngoLwesibili kuya kuLwesine aqale ngo’6 kusihlwa.
