SESICELA ku-300 isibalo sababoshelwe amacala ehlukene eThekwini selokhu kuqale amaholidi kaKhisimusi.Lokhu kushiwo uSenior Superintendent Parboo Sewpersard okhulumela amaphoyisa kuMasipala weTheku, othe bayaqhubeka nezivimbamgwaqo nsuku zonke. Uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi abantu babonakala bengawuhloniphi umthetho njengoba beqhubeka nokwenza amacala phezu kokuba amaphoyisa etshalwe nxazonke. Kwababoshwe ngempelasonto uSewpersad uthe kubalwa nowesilisa ogwaze abesifazane ababili ngasebhishi eBlue Lagoon.“Owesilisa utholakale nobhushu nommese waboshwa. Unecala lokuphatha izikhali eziyingozi nelokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza,” kusho yena.Uthe bangaphezu kuka-65 ababoshelwe ukushayela bephuzile ngempelasonto, abangu-13 baboshelwa izidakamizwa eWentworth nasePhoenix batholakala nezinhlobo ezehlukene zezidakamizwa. Ubuye wathi amaphoyisa azoqhubeka nokubonakala emabhishi, ezinxanxatheleni zezitolo nasezindaweni zomphakathi ukuqinisa ezokuphepha. Kwesinye isigameko esenzeke eGreytown ngoMgqibelo kuboshwe owesilisa obeshayela iMitsubishi emhlope okuthiwa ubephuze ngokweqile. Kuthiwa isikalo sotshwala egazini besiphindwe ka-11 kunesamukelekile. Uphinde wabekwa icala lokuba nelayisensi yemoto esiphelelwe yisikhathi.Okhulumela abeRoad Traffic Inspectorate esifundazweni, uNksz Zinhle Mngomezulu ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwakhe.

source: abanalo isasasa ngemiphumela asebelinde iminyaka emine
text: BAPHILA ngokubamba amatoho abafundi osekuphele iminyaka emine belinde imiphumela yabo yezivivinyo zika-matric.Abafundi baseMashiyamahle High eNdwedwe bathi abanalo igugu lemiphumela yokuchibiyela kwabo kwango-2015, umnyango oyikhiphe ngoMsombuluko ngoba sebelahlekelwe yisikhathi esiningi lolu daba lusenkantolo. Bathi imiphumela yabo bafisa ukuyithola kummeli wabo okunguye abamqoka ukuthi abamele kulolu daba hhayi emnyangweni.UMthobisi Ntetha (23) uthe ubhuquza ekhaya ngemuva kokulahlekelwa umsebenzi wokuwasha izimoto eVerulam abewenza nyakenye.Uthe akakayi kobheka le miphumela okuthiwa abayilande ngoba ngokwazi kwakhe akuyona le abayifunayo.“Thina saya enkantolo ngoba singagculisekile ngokuthi umnyango usola ukuthi sakopela kodwa abukho ubufakazi obubambekayo. Esakuzwa ukuthi umnyango wathi washayelwa ucingo watshelwa ukuthi sikopelile. Sasifuna ukuthi inkantolo iphoqe umnyango ukuthi usinike leyo miphumela, le abayikhiphayo yokuchibiyela ilungile ngoba isinika ithuba elingcono lokuzikhethela kodwa akuyona le ebesiyilwela yonke le minyaka emine, yingakho ngingayanga koyilanda,” kusho uNtetha.Uthe ukungayitholi imiphumela yakhe kumenze walahlekelwa yisikhathi sakhe okungabe wasisebenzisa wayofundela i-Electrical Engineering ayezimisele ukuyifunda.“Njengamanje nginengane engingakwazi ukuyondla ngendlela ngoba imisebenzi eminingi ifuna umuntu ono-matric mina anginawo. Angikwazi nokuqhubeka ngiyofunda ngoba kufuneka sona isitifiketi sakwa-matric noma imiphumela, anginako kokubili,” kusho uNtetha.UBhekani Ngcobo (24), naye obeselinde imiphumela iminyaka emine, uthe uzwile ngaleyo miphumela kodwa akayilandanga ngoba akuyona abeyilindele.UNgcobo uthe ugcine esephoqeleka ukuthi afundele ukuthunga okuyinto abengayithandi ngoba ubengenabo ubufakazi bokuthi wawufunda u-matric.“Ngangifuna ukwenza iHuman Resource Management kodwa angikwazanga ngenxa yemiphumela yami eyabanjwa ngo-2014. Kubuhlungu okwenzeka kithi ngoba ababefunda ngemuva kwethu bayaqeda ukufunda emanyuvesi, ngisho nabaselamayo nabo abafunda kuso lesi sikole ngemuva kwethu ababanga nankinga, thina sibambekile kuthiwa sakopela kodwa abukho ubufakazi esitshelwa bona bokuthi sakopela,” kusho yena.UNtetha noNgcobo bangabanye ababafundibaka-matric ngo-2014 ababanjelwa imiphumelaya yabo. Uthishanhloko walesi sikole, uMnuz Zacharia Ntanzi, wamiswa kulesi sikole ngo-Agasti esolwa ngokugovuza abafundi abase bevala amasango ezikole zakule ndawo ngawo * -Agasti.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, ukuvumile ukuthi uNtanzi washintshelwa kwesinye isikole ngempoqo njengoba umnyango usaqhubeka nokumphenya ngezinsolo zokuthi wasiza abafundi ukuthi bakopele.

KUCHAZWE njengokuwa kwensika ukudlula emhlabeni kwesishoshovu se-ANC, uMnuz Mendi Msimang, odlule emhlabeni izolo ngemuva kokugula isikhathi eside.UMsimang, owayeyiHigh Commissioner yase-United Kingdom (UK), uchazwe njengengqalabutho eyalwela amalungelo abantu. Ungumyeni kaDkt Manto Tshabalala-Msimang, owayenguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo owadlula emhlabeni ngo-2009.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa udlulise amazwi endunduzo emndenini, kubangani, izihlobo nakubantu bakuleli ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi sishoshovu esamela i-ANC eLondon ngo-1960.Uthe uMsimang wabuya ekumeleni le nhlangano wabe esejutshwa e-UK ngowayengumengameli wezwe uDkt Nelson Mandela.“Sigobisa amakhanda sikhumbula ubaba Mendi Msimang ngoba izwe lilahlekelwe kakhulu ngaleli qhawe. Ukudlula kwakhe kumele kugqugquzele wonke umuntu ukuthi azigqaje ngomlando siphinde sihloniphe nezingqalabutho esezadlula.”URamaphosa uthe imininingwane yomngcwabo izokhishwa uma uhulumeni esebonisene nomndeni kanjalo ne-ANC.UMsimang ubeyilungu lekomiti elibhekela ukuziphatha kwi-ANC futhi esekomitini eliluleka ngokuthi obani okumele bahlonishwe ngumengameli kanti uke waba ngumgcinimafa wale nhlangano.Okhulumela i-ANC, uMnuz Pule Mabe, uthe kuwe insika ngokudlula emhlabeni kukaMsimang.Uthe ubeyilungu lale nhlangano iminyaka eminingi kanti wake waba nayilungu lophiko lwentsha.“Sishaqekile ngokudlula emhlabeni kwalesi sishoshovu ebesaziwa ngomalume Mendi. Wasebenza nezingqalabutho ezingoWalter Sisulu nezinye kwi-ANCYL.”Uthe wasebenza eqeqeshelwa umsebenzi enkampanini yabameli kaNelson Mandela no-Oliver Tambo.Waya ekudingisweni ngo-1961 ngesikhathi i-ANC ivalwa umlomo. Wabuya ezweni waqokelwa esigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC ngo-1991. Waba yilungu lePhalamende ngo-1994 waphinde waba nguSihlalo wekhokhasi ye-ANC ePhalamende.Waqokelwa kwesikamgcinimafa we-ANC ngo-1997 engqungqutheleni yaseMafikeng lapho owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki aqokelwa kwesikamengameli we-ANC. Waba ngumgcinimafa kwaze kwaba ngu-2007.Ngo-1999 uMsimang wahlonishwa ngendondo yesiliva nguMandela nezinye izishoshovu zomzabalazo.“Siyamhlonipha ngemisebenzi yakhe nokuzinikela ezweni. Sizoqhubeka sigubhe ubuholi namava akhe sigcine negama lakhe emlandweni ukuze izizukulwane zifunde ngaye,” kusho uMabe.Ne-UDM ngomlomo kaMengameli wayo uGeneral Bantu Holomisa ibhonge emswanini yadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kaMsimang.“Kumele simhloniphe ngokuthi sithuthukise impilo yabantu. Kumele siqede imijondolo sithuthukise ezempilo ukuze simhloniphe ngendlela ngoba ubengumuntu osezingeni elifanayo noMandela,” kusho uHolomisa.UNobhala jikelele weSaftu, uMnuz Zwelinzima Vavi, naye udlulise amazi enduduzo wathi ubemhlonipha kakhulu uMsimang.

SIGODLIWE isinqumo ecaleni ebelifakwe yiDemocratic Alliance (DA) enkantolo lokuphoqa owayenguMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuba azikhokhele izindleko zamacala abhekene nawo.NgoLwesithathu u-Adv Thabani Masuku obemele uZuma utshele amajaji ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ubengakashintshi ekutheni izindleko zecala zikhokhelwe wuhulumeni njengoba uZuma wasayina isivumelwano nalowo owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Thabo Mbeki ukuthi kube wuhulumeni okhokhayo.Ihhovisi likaRamaphosa lithe uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokukhokhela izindleko zecala likaZuma kuze kube inkantolo ithatha esinqumo esiphikisana nalokhu.IDA ne-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF) ifake icala enkantolo ngoba ifuna uZuma akhokhe uR15.3 million osusetshenzisiwe emacaleni akhe.Le mali isetshenziswe kusukela ngo-2006 ngesikhathi kushushiswa uZuma ngodaba lwama-spy tapes.UMmeli weDA u-Adv Sean Rosenberg uthe kushushiswa uZuma hhayi umbuso ngakho uhulumeni akufanele akhokhele abameli bakhe.U-Adv Thembeka Ngcukaitobi omele i-EFF uthe uZuma uphethwe ngezandla ezintofontofo ezimnika imali yombuso futhi kufanele abuyise imali esikhokhwe wuhulumeni.UMasuku usole iDA ne-EFF ngokudlala ipolitiki esho nokuthi izindleko zecala likaZuma azimbi eqolo.Uthe kubalulekile ukuthi ummeli kahulumeni eseke abantu abasebenzela uhulumeni noma ngabe babhekene namacala okudlwengula.UJaji Pieter Meyer, utshele uMasuku ukuthi uZuma waziqokela ummeli wakhe ongasebenzisani nommeli kahulumeni.UMasuku uthe akusiye yedwa uZuma okhokhelwa izindleko zecala wuhulumeni ngoba nomkhuzi wamaphoyisa ongasekho uMnuz Jackie Selebi wayexhaswe wuhulumeni.UJaji Aubrey Ledwaba uthe ukuthi kunabantu akade bethola uxhaso kuhulumeni akusho ukuthi lesi senzo silungile.UMasuku uthe lolu daba kufanele luchithwe ngoba ukuba kwalo enkantolo kubambezela ukuthethwa kwecala elibhekene noZuma kulokhu kubhekwa ukuthi wubani okufanele akhokhe.Uthe ukube iDA yayizimisele ngokuthi uhulumeni angakhokhi izindleko zecala kwakufanele ilufake enkantolo lolu daba ngo-2008.

source: kusewumqansa ukuthola ulwazi ngofakazi owashona eqashiwe
text: KUSEWUMQANSA emaphoyiseni ukuthola imininingwane mayelana nokubulawa kwesikhulu sikaMasipala waKwaNongoma, esisocongwe singaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi boMbuso.Ihhovisi likazwelonke emaphoyiseni sekuphele isonto lizama ukuthola ulwazi emaphoyiseni ase-Eastern Cape ngokubulawa kukaMnuz Bonginkosi Shoyisa (45), isidumbu sakhe esatholwa endlini abegcinwe kuyo ePort Elizabeth sesonakele, ekopolotwe amehlo wathelwa nge-acid.UShoyisa ubehlala kule ndlu eseWalmer ethathwa njengephephile ukuze akwazi ukuyofakaza ecaleni lokubulawa kowayenguMcwaningi maBhuku kaMasipala waKwaNongoma, uMnuz Archie Duma owayezodedela umbiko oshaqisayo wenkohlakalo emkhandlwini.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuleli, uColonel Brenda Muridili, uthe namanje basalinde izimpendulo ohlakeni oluqondene nalolu daba lokushona kukaDuma ngemuva kokuba Isolezwe lamthumelela i-email ngeSonto.“Abophiko oluqondene nalolu daba abakasiphenduli kuze kube manje. Sizokwazi ukuphawula uma sebesinikeze yonke imininingwane,” kusho uColonel Muridili.Kulolu daba umndeni ufuna izimpendulo ngoba amaphoyisa awutshela ukuthi ugulile uShoyisa kodwa umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu kaDkt Gregory Hanslo ukhomba ukuthi wabulawa wakhishwa namehlo, washiswa nge-acid.Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Simon Shoyisa uthe okubi ukuthi nonina, uNkk Nompumelelo Shoyisa, usebalekile ekhaya ngoba uyesatshiswa.Icala obekuzofakaza kulo umufi bekumele liqale ukuqulwa ngoMsombuluko eMthunzini ngemuva kokuba lisuswe KwaNongoma kodwa umsolwa, uMnuz Phakamani Innocent Mthembu ushintshe ummeli ngomzuzu wokugcina kanti usuku lokuqulwa kwalo selophuma ngoDisemba 12.

UNGENE ehlazweni owayengumgadli weKaizer Chiefs amaphoyisa ethola ukuthi umuzi wakhe usetshenziswa njengesidleke sokukhiqizia izidakamizwa eHillside, eGoli.NgokweSowetan, amaphoyisa agasele ekhaya lale nkakha ngoLwesithathu ekuseni batholwa ukuthi kunegumbi obekukhiqizelwa kulo imandrax.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uColonel Brenda Muridili uziqinisekisile izindaba zokuboshwa kowayengumgadli weKaizer Chiefs. Uthe kuboshwe nabanye abathathu ababanjwe kuwo lo muzi.Abasolwa amagama abo awakadalulwa njengoba bengakaveli enkantolo.Esitatimendeni, obambe izintambo kwesokuba nguKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuleli, uLietenant General Stefan Schutte ushaye amaphoyisa ihlombe ngokubambisana emzamweni yokwehlisa isihlava sokusatshalaliswa kwezidakamizwa kuleli.Abasolwa kulindeke ukuthi bavele enkantolo namhlanje.

OYINHLOKO yehhovisi likaMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, uthi bazoziphendulela ezinsolweni ezenziwa nge-ANC kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana ephethwe yiJaji Raymond Zondo.Izolo uKodwa ubekule khomishini obekufakaza kuyo owayenguNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uNksz Barbara Hogan, uthe i-ANC yabhalela ikhomishini icela ukwenza izethulo zayo, isalindile ukunikwa lelo thuba uma selivelile.Uthe bebengazi ukuthi uNksz Hogan wayebhekene nengcindezi nokuthi kunamalungu ayegxambukela ezindabeni zikahulumeni. “UNksz Hogan akakaze asibikele ngengcindezi ayebhekene nayo njengenhlangano futhi abantu abathintekayo ebufakazini abethulile bazoziphendulela. I-ANC nayo yabhala icela ukunikwa ithuba lokuziphendulela ezintweni ezishiwo kule khomishini. Sizolinda uSihlalo ukuthi asitshele uma ithuba selivelile. Asikwazi ukuphawula kakhulu ngezethulo zofakazi abangahlonywanga imibuzo ngabanye abantu kodwa sigqugquzela abantu ukuthi bazokwethula ubufakazi ukuze kuliwe nokusetshenziswa kombuso yidlanzana elifuna ukufeza izinhloso zalo,” kusho uKodwa.Izolo u-Adv Phillip Mokoena ohola ubufakazi utshele ikhomishini ukuthi uthole izitatimende ezimbili ezivela kuSihlalo we-ANC uMnuz Gwede Mantashe obephendula izinto zayizolo.UNksz Hogan usole owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zombuso njengoba wayefuna kuqokwe izikhulu ezithandwa wuyena ezinkampanini zikahulumeni.Uveze ukuthi uZuma wazama ukuvikela owayeyisikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Jacob Maroga owasula esikhundleni kodwa wafuna ukubuyiselwa kuso.“UMaroga watshela ibhodi ukuthi uyasula esikhundleni waze waphuma emhlanganweni ayekuwo. Waphinde wasihoxisa isinqumo sakhe kwase kungenelela uZuma owathi asimbuyisele esikhundleni. Njengoba uZuma wayengekho eNingizimu Afrika ngaleso sikhathi ngabuza kowayeyiPhini likaMengameli uMnuz Kgalema Motlanthe ukuthi ngenzenjani. Wangitshela ukuthi angenze okufanele ngikwenze ngoba ngeke agxambukele,” kusho uNksz Hogan.Uthe emuva kwalokho wathola ucingo kuZuma owathukuthele emtshela ukuthi akayeke lento ayenzekayo.Uveze ukuthi uZuma wamtshela ukuthi uMaroga usaseyisikhulu esiphezulu kwa-Eskom yize ibhodi lalinganeme ngomsebenzi wakhe.“Saba nenkulumo mpikiswano noMengameli ngoba nganginganeme neze ngoMaroga owayezenzela intando yakhe. Ngabona kahle ukuthi uMaroga ubexoxa noMengameli (Zuma) ngasese,” kusho uNksz Hogan.Uthe emuva kokucaca kokuthi akafuni ukulandela okushiwo wuZuma watshelwa ukuthi uMengameli uzomjuba eFinland ayoba yinxusa khona kodwa wanqaba ngenxa yokuthi umyeni wakhe oyisishoshovu somzabalazo, uMnuz Ahmed Kathrada, wayesethuthela eGoli.

source: kudume amakhanda befelwa yizinkomo ezidle ushevu
text: ZIKHIHLA esikaNandi izakhamuzi zaseNkunzi, eMnambithi, ezifelwe yizinkomo ezidle ushevu okuthiwa uthelwe wumuntu ongaziwa edlelweni zasala ziqumbile. Zibalelwa ku-20 sezizonke izinkomo ezifile nembuzi nayo okuthiwa ikhothe endaweni efanayo yaqumba.Abanikazi bazo bathi bafe olwembiza ngokufelwa yizinkomo, bathi basazibuza ukuthi ubebazondeni othele ushevu edlelweni ngoba le nto iyaqala ukwenzeka.UMnuz Nkili Mavimbela, uthe ezakhe ziwu-9 ezifile. Uthi kuvele kwaduma ikhanda ngoba izinkomo uzithatha njengensika yekhaya lakhe.“Uma unezinkomo uyakwazi ukuthi uma kukhona okuvelayo udayise inkomo upheshe leso sikweletu. Ngifuyile impela ngoba kukhona nezamadodana ami asekhulile, manje le nto isibuyisela emuva,’’ kubalisa uMavimbela.UMnuz Nkosenye Mazibuko naye obeklabise ezakhe izinkomo endaweni efanayo, uthe kufe ezingu-6.“Sithole ukuthi kukhona umuntu ochithe ukudla kwezinkomo okuthakwe noshevu ngoba uma inkomo idlile bekungathathi isikhathi eside ibonakale ingqasha iwa phansi. Iwusizo inkomo thina singabantu sigcina amasiko sihlabe kube nemisebenzi,’’ kuchaza uMazibuko ngokukhathazeka.Bathe umasipala wendawo ufikile uzobheka isimo kwatholakala ukuthi sekuvele konakele kodwa bazigqiba izinkomo ezinye bazithatha zayohlolwa.Okhulumela uMnyango wezoLimo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Phathisa Mfuyo, uthe bawutholile umbiko bawathatha amasampula ukuyohlola ukuthi yini edliwe yizinkomo.

LUYASHUBA udaba lukasomabhizinisi waseNtuzuma odilizelwe isitolo ngabasebenzi bakaMasipala weTheku namaphoyisa awo ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, osethole ummeli ozolungisa udaba lwakhe, wavula necala.UMnuz Nduduzo Magwaza (37) obengumnikazi weYoung Minds Tuck Shop, usamile ekutheni isitolo sakhe besisebenza ngokusemthethweni kodwa yilungu elithize lomphakathi elibikele uMasipala amanga ngaye. UMagwaza ubesedayise iminyaka engu-11 kulesi sitolo esiyikhonteyna. Uthe ufuna umasipala umbuyisele endaweni yakhe futhi umkhokhele nezimpahla ezicekelwe phansi ngesikhathi edilizelwa isitolo. Kuthiwa abasebenzi bakaMasipala namaphoyisa baklabhe ikhonteyna emuva kokuba kukhishwe incwadi yesexwayiso yokuthi uMagwaza kumele ayisuse.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuMasipala uSuperintendent Parboo Sewpersad, uthe isitolo sikaMagwaza besingabekiwe endaweni efanele ngoba besiphazamisa nokuhamba kwezimoto nomphakathi.FUNDA:Usola umona odilizelwe isitolo“Ubesexwayisiwe ukuthi akayisuse ikhonteyna kodwa wangakwenza lokho. Sithole izikhalo zokuthi kuyagcwala kakhulu esitolo sakhe, kuphuzwe notshwala futhi sinama-video awubufakazi. Kusolwa nokuthi kusetshenziswa nezidakamizwa futhi umnikazi wesitolo ubechitha ngisho indle kuyona le ndawo. Sinqume ukuthi sithumele amaphoyisa ngoba uMagwaza ubengasilalelanga isexwayiso,” kusho uSewpersad.Uveze nokuthi sebeyazi ngecala elivulelwe amaphoyisa kamasipala, athe lingamanga futhi bazolilandela. “Wanikwa isexwayiso esanele kodwa wakhombisa ukudelela umthetho ngoba esekwa yikhansela elihlangene naye. Useke wahlawuliswa uR4 300 ngenxa yokuphula umthetho nokungabi nayo imvume. Kumele aye eNkantolo eNtuzuma ngoDisemba 7 ukuyokhuluma ngendaba yenhlawulo. Sithole nokuthi incwadi ayisayinise umphakathi uthathe nabantu abangahlali kuleya ndawo,” kusho yena.Mayelana nezinsolo zezidakamizwa nokugcwala ngaphandle kwesitolo uMagwaza uthe akukho okubi obekwenziwa.“Kuyo uyonke indawo enesitolo kujwayele ukugcwala abantu ngaphandle, obekuyizingane ezingomakhelwane. Kule ndawo kudonsa noWiFi yamahhala obekwenza ukuthi abantu bagcwale bezosebenzisa yona. Abefika kaningi amaphoyisa nekhansela bezosesha kodwa bathole ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle,” kuchaza uMagwaza.UMnuz Thomas Ntshangase oyikhansela uthe naye umangele ukuthi kungani sidiliziwe isitolo ngoba konke bekuhamba kahle.

USENKINGENI owesifazane waseManzimtoti onezincwadi zomshado ezikhomba ukuthi ushade namadoda amabili.UNkk Ernestina Nkabinde owumfelokazi ka-Edward Muziwenkosi Masinga owashona engozini yemoto ngo-1990, usola uMnyango wezaseKhaya ngokuthi ngemuva kokushona komyeni wakhe wanikeza enye indoda enegama, isibongo nosuku lokuzalwa okufanayo nokomyeni wakhe inombolo kamazisi yomyeni wakhe, maqede ‘wamshadisa’ nayo le ndoda, ekubeni yena wabuye washada noMnuz Duncan Themba Nkabinde ngo-1997.Le nkilayitheka uthe uyizwe ngo-2015 ngesikhathi eshayelwa ucingo yibhange lithi uMasinga uyalikweleta njengoba beshade umshado ohlanganisa amafa kanti kumele azokhokha, kungenjalo ibhange lizodla imoto yakhe. “Ngabatshela ukuthi uMasinga washona. Bathi ngokolwazi abanalo uyaphila baze bangikhombisa umazisi afaka ngawo isicelo sokuboleka imali. Kulapho ngabona khona isithombe esifakwe kulo mazisi ngabona ukuthi ngesomunye umuntu.”Uthe waya eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya eSiphingo bamkhomba enhlokohhovisi eMgungundlovu. Kwathiwa akazibhekele ifayela lomyeni wakhe ngoba ngaleso sikhathi izitifiketi zazingakenziwa ngekhompyutha. Walithola ifayela, wafaka isikhalo ecela ukuthi lo mnyango ‘umbulale’ umyeni okuvela ukuthi usadla anhlamvana. “Akekho owake wangishayela ucingo engazisa ukuthi kwenzekani. Kwathuleka ngaze ngabuyela emahhovisi ngonyaka olandelayo. Ngatshelwa ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukumesula umyeni ngoba inombolo yakhe isetshenziswa ngomunye umuntu ophilayo ohlala eGoli. Uma ngibuza ukuthi kwenziwa yini ukuthi lo Masinga ophilayo naye ashade nami, uma kungabantu abehlukene, abakwazanga ukungiphendula. Ngabuza ukuthi kuzokwenzekani uma kushona oyedwa wethu nakhona ayiphumanga impendulo.”Uthe wanikwa inombolo yasePitoli kwathiwa akashayele khona ucingo abuze ukuthi kwenzekani ngalolu daba. Uma eshaya ucingo bathi akukho abakwenzayo akabuyele lapho afaka khona isikhalo, baqale phansi. Akuchazwa ukuthi yini eyinkinga.“Ehhovisi eliseMgungundlovu nabo bangikhomba ePitoli, angisazi ukuthi kumele ngenze njani. Kwenziwa yini umnyango ungibhalise imishado emibili kodwa wehluleke ukulungisa iphutha? Kanti lo mazisi wadayiswa yini?”Ngokuthola kweSolezwe, uMasinga ophilayo uhlala eKlerksdorp, wafaka isicelo sikamazisi ngo-1992. Akucaci ukuthi washada nini noNkk Nkabinde okubuye kuvele ukuthi ushade noNkabinde ngo-1997.UMnuz Thabo Mokgola wehhovisi lomnyango lezokuxhumana kuzwelonke uthe lolu daba uludlulisela kwimenenja yalo mnyango eKZN uMnuz Cyril Mncwabe ukuthi aluphenye.

USIHLALO kazwelonke we-ANC uMnuz Gwede Mantashe utshele iKhomishini kaZondo izolo ukuthi izikhulu zenkampani i-Oakbay Resources zazibabelesela kanjani zibanxenxa ukuthi bangenelele ngemuva kokuvalwa kwama-akhawunti ezinkampani zamalungu omndeni wakwaGupta ngamabhange amakhulu kuleli.UMantashe ubethula ubufakazi egameni le-ANC phambi kweKhomishini kaZondo. Uthe owayeyisikhulu esiphezulu kwi-Oakbay, uMnuz Nazeem Howa, wababhalela incwadi ecela ukuthi ahlanganiswe nezikhulu ze-ANC.“UHowa wayegcizelela udaba lokulahleka kwemisebenzi uma kuvunyelwa ukuvalwa kwama-akhawunti ezinkampani zamalungu omndeni wakwaGupta,” kusho uMantashe.Ngaphambi kokuthi uMantashe athule ubufakazi, kuqale uMnuz Mzwanele Manyi oke waba yiNhloko yoPhiko lwezokuXhumana kuhulumeni iGCIS. - ANA

IMANGAZE abafundi baleli phephandaba indoda ebhalele ingosi yeZothando muva nje, ikhononda ngobuvila nokungazithandi komkayo.Le ndoda ethe iganiwe, iveze ukuthi umkayo akazithandi futhi uyavilapha, okwenza kube iyona eyenza imisebenzi yasendlini. Le ndoda ithe lokhu sekuqeda nothando futhi kulimaza nomshado wayo. Kuzo lezi zinsuku omunye wesilisa naye ubhale kuTwitter ekhala ngokuthi umkakhe akasamhehi ngendlela asekhuluphele ngayo. Uthe ngesikhathi beqala ukuthandana wayenomzimba okahle osevele wazimuka wenza ukuthi angabe esabukeka.Lezi zinkulumo ziqubule imibuzo eminingi kubantu, abanye begxeka laba besilisa.Kulona okhala ngobunuku abanye babuze ukuthi uqale nini ukububona ubunuku. Babodwa abasole ukuthi kungenzeka sekukhona omunye wesifazane le ndoda esimbonile njengoba isigxeka umkayo.UNksz Zola Dudeni oyiPsychologist nomeluleki wezothando, uthe yizinto ezenzekayo lezi othandweni ngoba abanye basuke bezifihlile uma kusajolwa. Ulinganise ngesisho sesiZulu esithi izinkomo ziyantshontshwa, esisho ukuthi intombi iveza okuhle kuphela uma isafuna umendo.FUNDA:#Ezothando: Umkami akazithandi uyinuku nendlu igcina isihlanzwa yimi“Abantu bayaziqoqa kakhulu uma kusajolwa ngoba bencenge uthando, ngisho ivila alibuvezi ubuvila balo. Lokhu kubi ngoba uma sekuhambe isikhathi umuntu uyaziveza ubuyena. Kumele uma uqala ukuthandana nomuntu ungafihli lutho ngoba lokho kufana nokukhohlisa umuntu,” kusho yena.Ugcizelele ukuthi ngisho umuntu ezifihla ubuyena kodwa kuyenzeka zivele izimpawu. Uthe inkinga wukuthi uthando luyabavala amehlo abantu. UNksz Dudeni uthe kwesinye isikhathi noma kuvela izimpawu zokubi, omunye wenza sengathi akaziboni acabange okuthi kuzoshintsha uma sebeshadile.Uzigxekile izenzo zalaba besilisa abagxeka abashade nabo ngoba sebebona okubi.“Okumele kwenzeke ukuthi nabo abesifazane bangashintshi uma sebeshadile. Uma umyeni wakho wakuthanda ngoba uzinakelela, unomzimba okahle, ungaziyekeleli uma usuthole umshado. Ngeke sikuphike nakho ukuthi isikhathi esiningi indoda imgxeka kakhulu umkayo uma isithole omunye. Noma ngabe kubi kanjani okwenziwa uphathina wakho kumele umvikele, ungamgxeki phambi kwabantu,” kusho yena.UNkk Wanjiru Kihusa ongumbhali nomeluleki wezomshado one-website ebizwa ngeFamily Lounge, uthi akukho lapho umuntu kumele akhulume kabi ngashade naye. Uthe ngisho ngabe konakele kanjani emshadweni ukukhuluma kabi ngoshade naye kuyawubulala umshado, kunike nezitha ithuba lokungena phakathi kwenu.

BANGU-62 000 abahola impesheni KwaZulu-Natal okuthiwa abakawenzi amakhadi amasha njengoba sekuzonqanyulwa ukuwasebenzisa maduze.Lokhu kushiwo uMnuz Mbizeni Mdlalose okhulumela abakwaSouth Africa Social Security Agency (Sassa) esifundazweni, onxuse ukuthi njengoba sekuqalile ukuholela abantu basale sebeshaya namakhadi amasha.Phezu kokuba kuvalwa ukuholela impesheni ngoDisemba 14 njengoba kuqale ngoLwesithathu, uMdlalose uthe abahola emabhange nasePosini abaphoqiwe ukukhipha imali ngaphambi kwalolu suku lokuvala.Ukuholela ngalesi sikhathi kwenzelwa ukunqanda isiphithiphithi sikaDisemba njengaminyaka yonke. AbakwaSassa baxwayise ngokuthi umholo olandelayo uyoze ube ngoJanuwari, okusho ukuthi kumele bazicabangele.“Siqalile ukuholela ezikhungweni kodwa imali esekhadini ngeke iye ndawo ngisho sekudlule uDisemba 14. Okusiphatha kabi yilesi sibalo sabantu abasasebenzisa amakhadi amadala ngoba uma bengawenzi amasha bazoba nenkinga ngempela ngoJanuwari.“Kumele kushaye uDisemba 10 sebewashintshile ngoba uma kungenjalo ngeke bahole nhlobo ngoJanuwari. Akusagcwali ePosini futhi kuyashesha nokwenza ikhadi,” echaza.Mayelana nokuvalwa kokuhola ngoDisemba 14, uthe kushiwo kulabo abayithola ezikhungweni kuphela. Uthe ngoJanuwari konke kuzobuyela esimeni esijwayelekile, ukuhola kuzoqala ngomhlaka 1.UMdlalose unxusa abantu ukuthi bavuselele amakhadi nje, kukhona abakhalayo ngokuqolwa izimali zabo ezikhishwa emakhadini bengazi. Isolezwe selibike izikhawu ezimbili ngabakhishelwa imali emakhadini, ekhishwa kwenye indawo.UNksz Nobuhle Njapha okhulumela abePosini eKZN uthe ukuholela kuqalile futhi kuhamba kahle.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi abahola ePosini imali bangayikhipha noma yinini ngisho sekudlule umnqamulajuqu wokuholela.Kuthiwa babalelwa ku-500 000 kulo lonke elakuleli abangakawashayi amakhadi amasha okuhola.OyiNational Advocacy Manager yeBlack Sash uMnuz Hoodah Abrahams-Fayker ugcizelele ukuthi abantu bawashintshe amakhadi okuhola ukuze bangabi nenkinga ngoJanuwari.

USHAYWE ngoswazi oluncane usaziwayo uBonang Matheba ecaleni abebhekene nalo lokungakhokhi intela.Inkantolo yamacala emali eGoli ihlawulise uBonang uR30 000 ngoLwesibili ngokuhluleka ukukho intela ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwenzeke ngemuva kokuthi elivumile icala abethweswe lona lokungakhokhi intela eqondene naye uqobo kusukela ngo-2008 kuya ku-2017 neyebhizinisi lakhe iBonang Matheba Entertainment (Pty) Ltd kusukela ngo-2014 kuya ku-2017.Kulo R30 000 uR22 000 ubumaqondana noBonang kuthi uR8 000 kube ngowebhizinisi lakhe.Umshushisi obebambe leli cala wazise ijaji ukuthi uBonang uyikhokhile imali eyinhlawulo. Umshushisi uphinde wenza isincomo sokuthi inkantolo ilisonge udaba.Imenenja kaBonang, uDavin Phillips uthe uBonang ujabule ngesinqumo esithathiwe.Uthe njengoba selusombululiwe lolu daba usozogxila ezinhlelweni zakhe.

UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, uthe akukho okuphambene nomthetho akwenza ngesikhathi evumela owayeyiPhini likaKhomishana wakwaSARS, uMnuz Ivan Pillay, ukuba athathe umhlalaphansi kungafiki isikhathi sakhe.Izolo uGordhan uhambe nommeli wakhe u-Adv Tebogo Malatji emhlanganweni noMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Adv Busisiswe Mkhwebane, okade efuna uGordhan achaze ukuthi kungani avumela uPillay ukuba asheshe athathe umhlalaphansi amsayinele nempesheni.UGordhan utshele i-eNCA ukuthi u-Adv Mkhwebane udlala ngaye.“Sikhombise ngokusobala ukuthi akukho esasikufihlile ngesikhathi ngiwuNgqongqoshe weziMali. Ngangilandela umthetho futhi nokuqashwa kabusha kukaPillay kwakusemthethweni. Ngicabanga ukuthi ngingenza izinto ezingcono ngesikhathi sami kunokuthi ngizochaza le nto,” kusho uGordhan.Uthe u-Adv Mkhwebane uyadlala ngoba konke ayekwenza kucacile.“Akukho engangikufihla, konke kusemthethweni futhi sinabameli esasikhuluma nabo ngaphambi kokuthatha izinqumo. UMvikeli woMphakathi unenzondo.”UMnuz Oupa Segalwe, okhulumela ihhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umhlangano ube khona esho nokuthi u-Adv Mkhwebane ubefuna ukuthola ukuthi uGordhan wazithatha kanjani izinqumo ezithile.“UNgqongqoshe (Gordhan) uye waziphendulela futhi wanikeza uMvikeli woMphakathi amaphepha azomsiza. Okwenze ukuthi abizelwe emahhovisi oMvikeli woMphakathi wukuthi ubengaphenduli uma ebhalelwa,” kusho uSegalwe.NgoMsombuluko uGordhan kulindeleke ukuthi ayokwenza izethulo zakhe kwikhomishini kaZondo ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.

UFUNA ubulungiswa umndeni womlisa (22) waseBhobhobho eduze kwaseJolivet okuthiwa ushawe walaliswa esibhedlela abalisa abebemsola ngokweba uR50.Kuthiwa uMnuz Philani Msomi uhlaselwe abalisa bangakubo ngeledlule ngoba bemsola ngokuthi ungene endlini wabopha ingane yakhona eneminyaka engu-16 wase ethatha uR50. Umalume wakhe, uMnuz Mpiko Msomi, uthe umshana wakhe uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela emuva kokunenebulwa yilaba balisa okuthiwa bebemshaya ngomphini wepiki bephinde bamshaye nangobhushi ngoba bemsola ngokweba.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi laba balisa baboshiwe kodwa babuye badedelwa.“Kubuhlungu kuthina siwumndeni wakhe ngoba ulinyaziwe kabuhlungu waze walaliswa esibhedlela kodwa abantu abenze lokhu badedelwa. Asiqondi ukuthi kanti umthetho usebenza kanjani?” kusho uMsomi. Ukhale nangokuthi lesi sigameko senzeke ngoLwesibili ekuseni futhi sabikwa emaphoyiseni kodwa abasolwa baze baboshwa ngoLwesine khona ngeledlule ngoba naye eselandelele ezama ukuthola ukuthi ababoshiwe ngani?Uphinde wakhala ngokuthi ifomu iJ88 eligcwaliswayo elikhombisa amanxeba omuntu osuke elinyaziwe, nalo belingazange ligcwaliswe, wathi ukholwa ngukuthi nakho kube nomthelela ekutheni kugcine kudedelwa abasolwa. UMsomi osanda kudedelwa esibhedlela, uthe akaphathekile kahle njengoba abasolwa eseke wababona becanasa ngaphandle.Uthe akukho okucacile ngokuthi badedelwe kanjani laba balisa. Echaza indlela alinyazwa ngayo, uthe laba balisa bamthatha ngezikhathi zasekuseni ecenta kwamalume wakhe.“Ngesikhathi sebengithathile bangishaya ngenduku kwathi uma iphuka basebenzisa umphini wepiki nobhushi wotshani. Ubhushi babewuphendulile kodwa bewungisika uma bengishaya ngawo. Nginezibazi zawo ezingalweni nasekhanda. Ngase ngichama negazi ngesikhathi ngisanda kulimala. Namanje ngixhume ipayipi lomchamo,” kusho uPhilani. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCol Thembeka Mbele ukuqinisekisile ukuthi amaphoyisa avule icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza.Uthe kuboshwe abalisa ababili oneminyaka engu-35 noneminyaka engu-27. Uqhube wathi laba balisa bavele enkantolo ngoNovemba 19, wathi akazi ukuthi babuyela nini enkantolo.

UMA uzwa ngempumelelo yesikole iZama High, yaseManzana, Osizweni, eNewcastle, ungacabanga ukuthi ngesinye salezo zikole zasemalokishini noma emadolobheni kanti ushayephansi.IZama High eqala kwaGrade 8 iye kwaGrade 12, ngesinye sezikole eziphakamisela phezulu ifulegi lezikole zasemakhaya futhi ezibhukulile zavala igebe ebelikhona phakathi kwalezi nezikole nezasemadolobheni uma kuziwa ngasohlangothini lwemiphumela.Kubhekwe lukhulu nakwimiphumela yalo nyaka ka-matric yeZama High njengoba kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sithola u-100%.Kusukela ngo-2010, lesi sikole sihlale sikhiqiza iziqengqe zabafundi abamenywa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngokwenza kahle kwabo uma kukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric.IZama High ibihlonishwa ngisho nawuMnuz Senzo Mchunu oke waba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni ngamagalelo ayo kwezemfundo.Lesi sikole esingaphansi kwesiFunda iMajuba siyahloniswa ezweni lonke kanti amagalelo aso aziwa ngisho nawuNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyiSisekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga.Lesi sikole ngesinye sezikole ezamenywa nguNkk Motshekga ukuba zibambe iqhaza ohlelweni lomnyango, iThe Schools That Work, oluhlose ukuzama ukuqeda inkinga yokufeyila kwabafundi ezikoleni kuzwelonke.Ngaphandle kwalokhu, lesi sikole sike sahlonishwa ngomklomelo wokulala isibili kumaNational Matric Excellence Awards.Lesi sikole sachonywa uphaphe legwalagwala inkampani i-ATKV ngokuhlale senza kahle, ukuhlomula kwaso kuholele ekutheni le nkampani igcine isisiza nezinye izikole ezingomakhelwane baso.IZama idumile futhi ngokwenza kahle emculweni njengoba iqembu lomculo lesikole eliphekwa nguthishanhloko uMnuz Oscar Kubheka lihlale lizitamuzela izindondo kusukela ngo-2010.IQEMBU lomculo lesikole iZama High, sasOsizweni eNewcastle elidume ngokwenza kahle emculweniNjalo lesi sikole sihlale simele isifundazwe kumaNational Finals of South African Schools Choral Eisteddfod manje aziwa nge-ABC Motsepe Choral Eisteddfod.Ngo-2017, lesi sikole sawina kwiminxa emine kulo mqhudelwano womculo, umlawuli weqembu lomculo yena wanqoba indondo yeNational Best Conductor. Ngo-2018 seyibe yizingqwele kwiminxa emibili, yalala isibili kweminye iminxa emibili.Lesi sikole sesiqophe amacwecwe amathathu ngosizo lukaDkt Lucky Nkosi woKhozi FM.Iqembu lomculo lalesi sikole selike lamenywa ngisho nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuthi lizomculela kweminye yemicimbi yakhe.Engxoxweni neSolezwe, uthishanhloko uKubheka uthe impumelelo yesikole sakhe incike ekubambisaneni okuhle phakathi kwabo bengothisha nabazali.“NoNkulunkulu wangibusisa ngezingane ezifunda lapha esikoleni, ingane uma ifika ingqondo yayo ivele ishintshe izimisele njengezinye izingane,” kusho uKubheka.Uthe abazali babambe iqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yesikole ngoba bahlale benza isiqiniseko sokuthi yonke into ihamba kahle.UKubheka uphinde wabonga nomholi wesifunda sabo uMnuz Zembethe Nkosi ohlale emgqugquzela ukuthi enze kahle.“Umhloli wethu akathi ngoba izinto zihamba kahle bese eyayekelela kodwa uyaqhubeka angiphushe lokho kusiziza kakhulu isikole,” kusho uKubheka.UNGQONGQOSHE weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga, uthishanhloko waseZama High uMnuz Oscar Kubheka nePhini likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uMnuz Enver Surty bekweminye yemicimbi yokuklomelisa iZama ngokwenza kahle ku-matricUphinde wabonga nothishanhloko obekhona ngaphambi kwakhe uNkk Sbongile Mazibuko, wathi nguyena owakhe isisekelo esiqinile sesikole.USihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole uMnuz Nhlanhla Kubheka naye uhambe emazwini kathishanhloko wathi ukubambisana okwenza isikole siphumelele.“Enye into esiza isikole ukuthi siphumelele ukuziphatha nokuhlonipha imithetho yesikole,” kusho uKubheka.Uthe bahlale njalo befuna ukukhiqiza abafundi abazoba abantu abahlonishwayo emphakathini.

UKUKHULUPHALA kwezingane okudalwa ukuthi azisadlali kwenze ukuthi isikhungo samagugu nomlando eThekwini sibuyise imidlalo yakudala ngalama holidi kaKhisimusi. Kusukela ngoMgqibelo ozayo izingane zizofundiswa imidlalo yakudala ePhansi Museum eGlenwood, ukukhombisa abazali ukuthi akukona ukuchitha imali kuphela okungazijabulisa ngamaholidi. Le midlalo izodonsa uDisemba wonke njalo ngoMgqibelo.UNksz Thobeka Dlomo okhulumela lesi sikhungo uthe uma le midlalo iba yimpumelelo bazimisele ukuthi baqhubeke nayo ngisho sekudlule amaholidi.“Yize sihambisana nempucuzeko kwezobuchwepheshe kodwa siyafuna izingane zazi ngemidlalo yakudala. Izingane zamanje zichitha isikhathi endlini zidlala ngamaselula kwesinye isikhathi okungazifundisi yonke into. Le midlalo yakudala inezifundiso futhi yenza ukuthi izingane zinyakazise umzimba. Kumanje sinenkinga yokukhuluphala ngokweqile ezinganeni ngenxa yokuthi azisadlali,” echaza.Uthe yize imidlalo yenzelwe izingane, abadala bavumelekile ukuphelezela nabo bafundise izingane eminye yale midlalo.Uveze ukuthi nabo abadala bangafunda okuningi ngokuvakashela lesi sikhungo ngoba sinomlando. Imidlalo okulindeleke ukuthi ibe khona amagende, ingqathu, ushumpu, umagalobha, uqithi neminye imidlalo yakudala. Kungenwa mahhala kuyo yonke le midlalo.UNksz Dlomo uthe bafuna ukubuyisela isiko lokudlala ezinganeni njengoba ukudlala kwamanje sekuhlukile kunakudala. Uthe ukuphucuzeka sekwenza ukuthi ibukelwe phansi imidlalo yakudala ekubeni ibifundisa okuningi.

ABEFUNDISI besifazane bamahlelo ahlukene ezenkolo eThekwini banxuse abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo emabandleni ukuthi baphumele obala ukuze kuliwe nalesi sihlava.Esithangamini nabezindaba eCity Hall eThekwini izolo, uNobhala wabefundisi besifazane uNkk Ziningi Jali okunguye obefunda isitatimende, uthe sekwanele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane, wengeza ngokuthi bafuna ukuthi bonke abagila imikhuba babhadle ejele.“Siyakuqaphela ukuthi sekunabefundisi abaningi abagila imikhuba egameni lenkonzo okuyinto ethunaza umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu,” kusho uNkk Jali.Uthe abantu besifazane abahlukunyezwayo kufanele bangathuli ukuze unqandwe lo mkhuba odla lubi“Abantu besifazane ikakhulukazi izingane zamantombazane zisatshiswa ngokuthi zizoqalekiswa zilandelwe ngamadimoni uma zibika ngokuhlukunyezwa, umuntu ongakakhuli ngokomoya angasaba ngempela uma ezwa lokho angabe esakhuluma ngokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe,” kusho uNkk Jali.Uthe abefundisi abagila imikhuba basebenzela ubumnyama.“Iningi labo lisungula amabandla ngoba lifuna ukwenza imali liphinde lithokozise imizwa yabo ngokuhlukumeza abesifazane,” kusho uNkk Jali.Uthe bengabafundisi besifazane bayameseka uNksz Cheryl Zondi ongufakazi wokuqala emacaleni okudlwengula abhekene noMfundisi Tim Omotoso waseNigeria.“Ubufakazi obethulwe nguNksz Zondi sebungamyisa * -Omotoso ejele,” kusho uNkk Jali.Kulesi sithangami sabezindaba kukhona nomunye umzalwane ocele ukuthi angadalulwa ophumele obala wathi naye ubehlukunyezwa ngumyeni wakhe ongumfundisi, waze waphuma emshadweni.“Ngize ngaphoqeleka ukuthi ngiphume nasebandleni ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa obekwenziwa kumina,” kusho lo mzalwane.Kuphele isithangami sabezindaba kwabe sekuba nenkonzo ngaphandle kwaseCity Hall.

KUNGAKAPHOLI maseko inkantolo ihoxise icala lokungena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume ebelibhekene namalungu omphakathi angu-17 aseTete, KwaDukuza, amalunga alo mphakathi asephinde aboshwa ngecala elifanayo.Ngenyanga edlule amalungu awu-17 omphakathi wakule ndawo, aphuma ejabula enkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza, ngemuva kokuhoxiswa kwecala lawo, izolo abayisithupha babo babuye baboshwa ngemuva kokuthi bephinde bakha imijondolo kule ndawo.UMnuz Khulekani Mkhize osekomitini labakhe kule ndawo, uthe le ndawo bayicela enkosini yaKwaMagwaza yikho bebuyele kuyo bayokwakha ngemuva kokuhoxiswa kwecala kodwa okhulumela uMasipala waKwaDukuza, uMnuz Sipho Mkhize uthe banalo uhla lwabantu abavumelekile ukuhlala kule ndawo, ababoshiwe abekho kulo.“Njengomasipala sinemigomo elawula izakhiwo ezakhiwe ngokungemthetho. Izolo ithimba likamasipala lifice kunemijondolo eseyakhiwe ngaphandle kwemvume yabanikazi bomhlaba, eminye yawo beyingenalutho ngaphakathi. Ebingenalutho idiliziwe, ebinezimpahla sibophe zona izimpahla ukuze abanikazi bezofika bazochaza ukuthi ubani obanike imvume yokwakha.”Uthe abantu ababafica kule mijondolo akekho othi wanikezwa imvume yinkosi futhi kunzima ukukuqinisekisa lokho ngoba inkosi isanda kukhothama.“Okunye okwenza ukuthi kube nzima ukuthi akekho umuntu ophuma emkhandlwini wobukhosi bakwaMagwaza esamnikwa umndeni ohlala emkhandlwini, asazi ukuthi ngobani laba abathi bayazi ukuthi inkosi yasikela abathile iziza ngaphambi kokuthi ishone. Asikwazi ukudedela abantu bakhe bengenayo imvume yabanikazi bomhlaba,” kusho yena.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe kuboshwe abantu abayisithupha ngecala lokungena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume. Uthe umasipala uyidilizile imijondolo ebeyakhiwe ngokungemthetho kulo mhlaba.Ababoshiwe uthe kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMhlali namhlanje.

ANGASE aphuthwe yithuba lokuyofunda phesheya umfundi waseMobeni, eThekwini, okumele azigcwalisele imali yokuyofundela ezobuchwepheshe.UMhlengi Radebe (19) obefunda u-matric eGlenwood High, wamukelwe ukuthi ayokwenza izifundo zoLwazi Buchwepheshe eWilliam Penn University, e-United States of America (USA). Ukuthola ithuba lokuyofunda kuhambisana nokuthi uke wamenywa e-USA ukuyomela abafundi.UMhlengi, obekuvele kuyiphupho lakhe ukwenza izifundo zobuchwepheshe, uthe ngonyaka odlule waphasa ngo-A ababili.“Okwenze ngifake isicelo sokuyofunda phesheya wukuthi ziningi izinsiza zokufunda ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngifisa ukuthi uma sengiqedile ukufunda khona, ngibuye ngizothuthukisa abanye abafundi ngolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe,” kusho uMhlengi.Isicelo sakhe saphendulwa ngoJuni. Watshelwa ukuthi yize ezozikhokhelwa ezinye izindleko, kumele azikhokhele ezinye izifundo. Lokho kuchaza ukuthi udinga uR300 000 ukuze kufezeke iphupho lakhe. Bekumele ngabe uqale ukufunda ngo-Agasti kodwa wangaphumelela ngoba imali ayikahlangani. Uphinde wabhalela inyuvesi yamzwela, manje sekumele aqale ngoJanuwari.“Sengizamile ukubhalela osomabhizinisi ngicela uxhaso kodwa abekho abathembisayo. Ekhaya ngihlala nomama, ugogo nomkhulu nabo abangenawo amandla okuhlanganisa imali,” kusho uMhlengi.Echaza ngokuya kwakhe phesheya phambilini, uthe wakhethwa uthisha wakhe esafunda uGrade 9. Kwakufuneka abafundi abazokwethamela ingqungquthela yezobuholi ngo-2015 eWashington DC.

source: imilutha ididiyela isiphuzo ngama pads asebenzile
text: IMILUTHA yezidakamizwa isijike ukwenza njengoba kuthiwa isizitika ngokuphuza amanzi aphuma uma ipheke ama-pads (amaqakelo) abesifazane asesebenzile.Lo mkhuba omusha ubukeka uzobhincisela nxanye abezidakamizwa iwunga nenyaope. Kuthiwa uthandwa yintsha engenayo imali yokuthenge inyaope newunga ngenxa yokuthi imba eqolo. Ukuhlanganisa amaqakelo kulula ngoba bahambela imizi enabantu besifane baketule imigqomo bathathe amaqakelo asesebenzile noma baye lapho kulahlwa khona imfucuza bapequlule ukuze bathole amaqakelo.Kuthiwa uma sebewatholile amaqakelo asesebenzile, bawathatha bawabilise bese amanzi aphuma lapho bawaphuze.La manzi kuthiwa ayadakana, ulala ungazazi negama lakho, okuyinhloso enkulu yemilutha.Umsuka walo mkhuba, kuvela ukuthi ukhonjwa e-Indonesia njengoba ususabalele emazweni amaningi okubalwa neNingizimu Afrika.Ngokolwazi oluvela kweminye yemibiko wumkhuba osuneminyaka engaphezu kwemibili uqalile kodwa eNingizimu Afrika usanda kuqala ukubonakala eGoli. Kuthiwa umuntu ophuze le ‘jusi’ ephuma emaqakelweni, udakwa amakhemikheli asetshenziswe kuwona.Udokotela wabesifazane ongathandanga negama lakhe, uthe uyakweshwama lokhu.“Ngiyakweshwaba lokhu kodwa kunengozi kakhulu empilweni yomuntu,” usho kanje.Uthe okokuqala amaqakelo anekhemikhali i-Absorbent Core esetshenziswe ukubamba igazi kwiqakelo ukuthi lingagelezi."Lilodwa nje leli khemikhali alikulungele ukungena ngaphakathi liphuzwe ngoba alikudalelwe lokho kodwa lisebenza ukubamba okusaketshezi. Uma seliliningi ngaphakathi egazini lingaba yingozi.”Uqhube wathi i-chlorine nayo etholakala emaqakelweni ingakwenza ukuthi uma umuntu eyiphuzile azizwe esezulwini elincane. Udokotela udalule ukuthi ngokwesayensi uma into isibilisiwe amagciwane ayafa kodwa kukhona adlula aphile okuyiwo angabeka impilo yabaphuza lawo manzi asengcolile impilo yabo ibe sengcupheni.- Isolezwe ngeSonto

USIHLALO weBhodi yeTransnet, uDkt Popo Molefe, uthi ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule iTransnet ihlanganise ithimba longoti bomthetho nabaphenya amacala athinta imali ukuze baphenye ngokuphulwa kwemithetho ngesikhathi kuthengwa impahla enkampanini.UMolefe usho lokhu emuva kokuthi uMnyango weziMali uphakamise ukuthi zithathelwe izinyathelo zomthetho izikhulu zakwa-Eskom nezakwaTransnet ngodaba lokuthengwa kwempahla ezinkampanini zikahulumeni phakathi kuka-2012 no-2016.UMnyango weziMali wacela iFundudzi Forensic Services ukuthi iphenye. NgoLwesihlanu kushicilelwe umbiko weFundudzi.Phakathi kwezinto ebeziphenywa yiFundudzi Forensic Services wumsebenzi owenziwa yiMcKinsey eNingizimu Afrika, owenziwa yiRegiments Capital Management neTrillian Capital e-Eskom naseTransnet.UMnyango weziMali ucele oKlebe nophiko oluphenya ngamacala ezimali ukuthi baphenye ukuthi izikhulu zeTransnet neze-Eskom, okuhlanganisa uMnuz Anoj Singh owayephethe ezezimali e-Eskom, baphenywe ukuthi abagwazelwanga yiMcKinsey neRegiments.IFundudzi iphinde yakhala nangohlelo lokuthengwa kwezitimela eziwu-1 064.Esitatimendeni uMolefe uthe selokhu beqale uphenyo ezinyangeni ezine ezedlule banike izikhulu ezithile amaphepha okuthi kufanele zikhokhe imali ebalelwa kuR1.3 billion.Uphinde waveza ukuthi sekumiswe izikhulu eziningi kwaTransnet abale kuzo uMnuz Siyabonga Gama obeyisikhulu esiphezulu oxoshiwe, uMnuz Phetolo Ramosebudi obenguMgcinimafa kwaTransnet oxwayiswe ngokuthi uzomiswa waqoma ukusula emsebenzini, uMnuz Thamsanqa Jiyane, ophethe ezokuthengwa kwempahla eTransnet Engineering osamisiwe, uNkk Lindiwe Mdletshe oyiManager Supply Chain Services omisiwe noMnuz Edward Thomas oyiGeneral Manager of Finance naye umisiwe.UMolefe uthe okwamanje kusaqhubeka uphenyo futhi ngeke bame kuze kube kujeziswa abathintekayo.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-Eskom, uMnuz Phakamani Hadebe, sithe zizosetshenziswa iziphakamiso zombiko woMnyango weziMali futhi nabasebenzi benkampani bayalwa nenkohlakalo njengoba beza nemininingwane esizayo ukuthi kujeziswe abangayilandeli imithetho.Izolo uMnuz Khulu Phasiwe, obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwa-Eskom, uthe sebeqale isigaba sesibili sokucima ugesi kusukela ngo-12.15 emini kuze kube wu-10 ebusuku.Uxolisile ngokucinywa kukagesi esho nokuthi bawucima ukuze bonge lo okhona ngenxa yokuthi kushoda amalahle.Uthe abantu kufanele bangene kwi-website yakwa-Eskom ukuze babone ukuthi ugesi ucinywa nini endaweni abahlala kuyo.

ESIKHATHINI sanamhlanje ukhwantalala (depression) lubalwa phambili ohlwini lwezinto ezikhungethe abantu. Kubantu bohlanga lesi yisifo esiguqula imizwa yakho ngokushesha, nendlela ocabanga ngayo ngempilo, sifana nesisha njengoba abaningi besazifundisa ngaso.Enye yemibuzo evame ukubuzwa abantu abaningi ukuthi umnakekela kanjani umuntu onokhwantalala. Ongoti baveza ukuthi kunzima ukwazi ukuthi ungamlekelela kanjani umuntu ophethwe yilesi sifo nokuthi umeseka kanjani. Uma ungazi ukuthi wenze njani ngomuntu onalesi sifo, nanka amathiphu angakusiza unakekekele umuntu onokhwantalala. Ungakhohlwa ukuzinakekela nawe.-Thola ulwazi- Uma ungenaso isiqiniseko ngokuthi silwane sini ukhwantalala, kuhle ukuthi uzifundise. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi uqonde kangcono ukuthi umngani noma isihlobo sakho sidlula esimweni esinjani.-Muphe indlebe- Uma ophethwe wukhwantalala edinga umuntu angakhuluma naye, muphe indlebe uzame ukuthola ukuthi uzizwa kanjani. Ungambuza ukuthi yini ongayenza ukumsiza. Uma kunodaba olubucayi ofisa ukubhunga ngalo nomuntu onokhwantalala, kuhle ukhethe isikhathi nendawo lapho bekhululeke khona. Uma enengekile noma ecasukile kungcono ungaluphathi lolu daba kuze kube umoya wabo sewehlile.-Ithathele phezulu imizwa yabo- Uma umuntu enezimpawu zokhwantalala akukho lula ukuthi avele akhohlwe adlula kukho, noma ukuvele ajabule esithubeni. Uma ukhuluma naye kumele umkhumbuze ukuthi ukhona futhi uzomseka uma ekudinga. Lokho kwenza kube lula kubo ukuthi bavule izifuba zabo kuwe futhi kubenza babone ukuthi uqinisile uma uthi ukuthathela phezulu abadlula kukho.-Bazise ngosizo abangaluthola- Uma umngani wakho onokhwantalala esembonile udokotela noma oweluleka ngokomqondo kuhle kakhulu lokho. Ungabeseka ngokubazisa ngolunye usizo abangaluthola njengezinombolo abangazishayela ezimweni eziphuthuymayo. Ikhona nenhlangano elekelela abantu abaphethwe yilesi sifo, iDepression and Anxtiey Group etholakala ku-0800 12 13 14, kanti izingcingo zakhona zihlezi zivuliwe. Ungavakashela ne-website yabo ku:www.sadag.co.za-Tholakala ezimweni eziphuthumayo- Akukho lula ukuthi uhlale useduzane nawo wonke umuntu kodwa uma unomngani onalesi sifo, kuhle ukuthi utholakale kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho uma usola ukuthi kunesimo esiphuthumayo akuso, kuhle ube nezinombolo zabantu ongabathinta abangaba seduzane naye.-Zinakekele nawe- Kubuye kube nzima futhi kukhandlane ukunakekela umuntu onokhwantalala. Ungakwazi ukumsiza kuphela uma nawe uzinakekela. Qinisekisa ukuthi usaqhubeka nokwenza izinto ezikujabulisayo nokuthi usasithola isikhathi esanele sokuphumula. Cela usizo kwabanye abazimisele ukungenelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele umazise ophethwe yilesi sifo ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukumenzela konke, umazise ongamsiza ngakho.- www.reachout.com

AWUKHULULEKILE umndeni womfundi waseMadundube, eMbumbulu, otholakale eshonile ngeSonto egaxwe nentambo entanyeni, ongakholwa wukuthi uzibulele ngempela.Umndeni kaSbahle Ngcongo (13), obefunda uGrade 5 ePhangisa Primary, uthe uzokhululeka usuthole umbiko kadokotela ohlinze isidumbu ukuthi ngempela uzihilele yini njengoba kungacaci ngokushona kwakhe. USbahle kuvele ukuthi uzihilele kuveranda kubo.UNkk Benzani Ngcongo, onguninakhulu kamufi, uthe badidekile kunzima nokukholwa wukuthi umzukulu uzibulele.Uthe babelungiselela ukuya esontweni ngo-10 ekuseni ngesikhathi salesi sehlo.“Savele sabhocobala esithubeni nje nomzukulu sangabe sisaya esontweni. Sasihleli naye nonina, yena waphuma sanganaka ukuthi uyaphi. Unina waphuma eyombheka emuva kwemizuzwana ephumile umzukulu wamfica kuveranda elele phansi. Entanyeni kwakugaxwe intambo ebesiyisebenzisa uma sineka izingubo kuveranda futhi ihusha phansi kungabonakali ukuthi ubelenga kuyo,” kuchaza uNkk Ngcongo.Uthe okubaxakayo wukuthi ubengalengi futhi nentambo ibingamnsinyile entanyeni. Uveze ukuthi ubesashisa kuphuma igazi ngomlomo nangamakhala.“Sabiza amaphoyisa kwaqinisekiswa ukuthi useshonile. Silinde umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ngoba ubezohlinzwa emakhazeni aseScottburgh. Simuncu isimo ekhaya ngoba ngenyanga edlule besingcwaba ingane enonyaka ebanjwe ugesi khona egcekeni,” kusho uNkk Ngcongo.Unina omncane kamufi, uNksz Nunu Ngcongo, uthe akuvumi akholwe wukuthi uSbahle uzibulele.“Ubeyingane ethulayo futhi ephansi. Akukho nobekukhomnbisa ukuthi kukhona okumphethe kabi. NgeSonto wayewotawota ugogo wakhe izinyawo, bekhuluma ngokuya esontweni. Impela siyokholwa sesithole umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu ukuthi uzibulele ngoba kuningi okungasicaceli,” kusho yena.Umndeni uthe awuxabene namuntu endaweni ongamsola ngokwenzekile kodwa kunzima ukukholwa wukuthi ingane izibulele. Kuthiwa eduze kwesidumbu bekungekho ngisho into agibele kuyona njengoba kwenzeka uma umuntu ezilengisa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe amaphoyisa aseMbumbulu avule idokodo lokufa komuntu emuva kokutholakala kwesidumbu sentombazane ezilengisile. Uthe asikaziwa isizathu sokuzibulala kwengane.

KUPHENYWA isikole iSizibeni High eMgababa ngemuva kokuthi abazali bekhononde ngokuthi abafundi baka-matric banqatshelwe ukubhala izivivinyo zephepha lesibili leMaths ngoba kuthiwa bazokwehlisa izinga lokuphasa lesikole.Bangaphezu kuka-10 abafundi okuthiwa bakhishwe ephepheni sebezobhala kwathiwa ukuze bakwazi ukubhala izivivinyo zokuchibiyela ngonyaka ozayo, abalande izincwadi zodokotela ukuze kube sengathi babegula yingakho bengakwazanga ukubhala.Omunye wabazali, ocele ukungavezwa, uthe ingane yakhe ibuye ekhaya yamtshela ukuthi inqatshelwe ukubhala iphepha lesibili leMaths ngoMsombuluko ngoba kuthiwa izokwehlisa izinga lokuphasa.Ingane imtshele ukuthi akuyona yodwa kodwa baningi nabanye abafundi abanqatshelwe bakhishwa sebebhala.“Ibuhlungu le nto ngoba ingane yami kwi-timetable yayo kubhalwe ukuthi izozibhala zonke izifundo. Ilibhalile iphepha lokuqala leMaths ngoLwesihlanu olwedlule, elesibili akhishwe kulona,” kusho umzali.Uthe akazi uzoyithathaph imali yencwadi kadokotela ngoba akanayo.“Ingane yami yadudulelwa kwa-matric kodwa bengazi ukuthi izibhala zonke izifundo,” kusho umzali.Uthe uma umfundi eduduliwe kumele atshelwe ukuthi nazi izifundo azozibhala ezinye azibhale ngonyaka olandelayo.“Akukwazi ukuthi angakhishwa esezobhala ngoba kwa-timetable yakhe bekumele ifike inezifundo ezimbalwa azozibhala. Sifuna ukwazi emnyangweni ukuthi ngabe kuvumelekile yini ukuthi izingane zethu zikhishwe ephepheni zingabhali kuthiwe asilande incwadi kadokotela,” kusho umzali.Omunye umzali naye ocele ukungavezwa, uthe ingane yakhe ayizange ibhale iphepha lesibili leMaths ikhishwe isizobhala.Uthe udidekile ngoba ingane ibuye yamtshela ukuthi esinye isizathu esenze bakhishwe nezinye izingane ngukuthi abazange babekhona ngesikhathi kubuyekezwa isifundo.“Ingane yami yaphasa kahle kwaGrade 11 yayingadudulwanga. Ne-timetable yayo iyasho ukuthi izibhala zonke izifundo okubalwa kuzo iMaths iphepha lokuqala nelesibili obekumele ilibhale ngoMsombuluko kodwa eyakhishwa yangalibhala,” kusho umzali.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe akekho uthisha okumele anqabele umfundi ukuthi abhale izivivinyo.Uthe baxhumana nehhovisi lesifunda ukuze bathole ubuqiniso balokhu wathi bazothatha izinyathelo ezifanele kwabathintekayo.“Sithumele kumqondisi wesifunda ukuze aphenye. Sizobe sesithatha izinyathelo ezifanele.”Ngonyaka ozayo abafundi bazobhala kanye izivivinyo ngoJuni njengoba zingasekho ezokuchibiyela ebezibhalwa ngoMashi.

BAKHALA ngesiteleka esinodlame abaqashi bemboni yocwazi njengoba bethi amalungu eNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) ahlasela ozakwabo abangatelekile acekele phansi nempahla emafemini ahlukene.Isiteleka seNumsa siqale ngo-Okthoba 15 futhi sisaqhubeka namanje asikatholakali isixazululo sabasebenzi abafuna ukunyuselwa amaholo ngo-15% nokuthi abasebenzi abasezingeni eliphansi okuwuGrade H bahole uR40 ngehora esikhundleni sikaR20 ngehora. Bafuna ukubuyiselwa imihlomulo yokuphumula nebhonasi itholakale minyaka yonke.UMnuz Johan Pieterse oyisikhulu sePlastic Convertors Association of South Africa uthe bakhathazekile ngokuthula kwabezindaba ngodlame oluqhutshwa ngamalungu eNumsa atelekile.“Abasebenzi banelungelo lokuteleka kodwa abanalo ilungelo lokucekela phansi impahla nokuhlasela ozakwabo abangatelekile. Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi abezindaba ababiki ngalolu dlame kodwa bebe bebikile ngemashi yeNumsa ngesikhathi kuqala isiteleka. Siyalugxeka udlame lwamalungu eNumsa ngoba abanye abasebenzi bafuna ukondla imindeni yabo futhi akufanele bahlaselwe abatelekile,” kusho uPieterse.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba uPieterse uthembise iNumsa nobuholi bayo ukuthi bazoziphenya izigameko zodlame baqinisekise ukuthi abathintekayo bayaboshwa.UNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola okhulumela iNumsa uthe bayakuchitha ukuthi amalungu eNumsa ahlasela abantu noma acekela phansi impahla emafemini kacwazi.“Abaqashi bavele basukele amalungu eNumsa bathi anodlame ekubeni kunezinyunyana ezimbili ezitelekile okuyiNumsa neMewusa futhi kukhona nabasebenzi abangewona amalungu ezinyunyana abatelekile. Amalungu ethu ayawuhlonipha umthetho futhi ngisho eqhinqa ngaphandle kwamafemu anokuthula. Kudala sizama ukuxoxisana nabaqashi bemboni kacwazi ukuze kutholakale isixazululo kodwa ababuyeli kuthina,” kusho uNkk Hlubi-Majola.

UKHOLELWA ekutheni asikho isifundo nomkhakha ongeke ufundwe ngolimi lwesintu, owesifazane ohlonishwe ngendondo ngamagalelo okuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu.UNkk Muhle Sibisi ofundisa emkhakheni wakwaHumanities e-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), uhlonishwe ngeYoung Linguist Award emcimbini weminyaka engu-20 we-International Congress of Linguist. Bekuqala ukuthi lo mcimbi ubanjelwe kuleli selokhu wasungulwa njengoba ububanjelwe eKapa.UNkk Sibisi ohola nohlelo lwezilimi kwiSchool of Arts, khona e-UKZN, uthe ukuhlabana kwakhe ngale ndondo kusho ukuthi uyabonakala umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu.“Umkhankaso wokuqhakambisa izilimi zesintu akuyona into yakuleli kuphela kodwa eyawo wonke amazwe. Ngisho abe-Unesco bayakukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zilimi. Ukuthola kwami le ndondo kusho ukuthi nowethu umkhankaso uyabonakala. Izilimi zethu zanyathelwa kakhulu ngenxa yomlando wobandlululo, okuyimanje sizama ukulungisa lowo monakalo,” kusho yena.Uthe zonke izifundo ngisho ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kumele zifundwe ngezilimi zesintu. Uveze ukuthi e-UKZN sebeqalile ukusebenzisa amanye amatemu ezilimi zesintu abaqhamuke nawo.“Awukho umkhakha noma izifundo ezingeke zingafundeki ngezilimi zesintu. Uma sebefuna ukusigxeka laba abangafuni siqhakambise izilimi zethu, basishaya ngokuthi kunamatemu angeke asebenziseke kahle esiZulwini. Okuhle ukuthi ezinye izilimi ziyahambelana, kungabolekwa amagama ukwakha amanye amatemu. Awekho amagama angeke atholakele uma sizimisele, ngisho emkhakheni wezomthetho nowezesayensi,” echaza.UNkk Sibisi osefundise iminyaka emine e-UKZN, kumanje wenza iPhD lapho enza khona ucwaningo ngezilimi zesintu. Ucwaninga ukuthi amatemu esiZulu aseqalile ukusetshenziswa kulesi sikhungo ayazisiza yini izitshudeni ukuthi ziqonde kangcono ezifundiswa kona ngolimi lwazo.Ukuhlabana kwakhe ngendondo kunezelwe nayindlela alwethule kahle ngayo ucwaningo obeluhambisana nokukhuthaza izitshudeni zale nyuvesi ukuthi zihaye izinkondlo zisebenzisa amatemu emikhakha yemfundo ezikuyo.UNkk Sibisi ubonge umphathi wakhe uSolwazi Heike Tappe, athe nguye omkhuthazayo emsebenzini wakhe kulesi sikhungo. I-international Congress of Linguist yasungulwa ngo-1928 kanti izingcithabuchopho zezilimi zamazwe ahlukene ziyahlangana njalo eminyakeni eyisihlanu ukubhunga ngezokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi.

INHLOKO yamaJaji uMogoeng Mogoeng ixwayisa ngokuthi impi ayisona isisombululo ezingqinambeni ezibhekene nezwe kubalwa kuzo udaba lomhlaba nokucwasa.Ethula inkulumo yakhe kade enza isifundo ngowayengumegameli we-ANC ongasekho inkosi Albert Luthuli e-UKZN ngoMgqibelo, uMogoeng uthe udaba lomhlaba akumele lumbambathwe kodwa kumele kubhekwane nalo ukuze kutholakale isisombululo.Uxwayise ngokuthi yize kumele kubhekanwe nalo kodwa akumele luhlukanise phakathi isizwe.“Indaba yomhlaba kumele igcine ixazululiwe ukuze kuphele izilonda ezadaleka ngesikhathi abantu bephucwa umhlaba wabo. INingizimu Afrika iphiwe futhi inabantu abahlakaniphile, ngiyathemba ukuthi izokwazi ukuluxazulula lolu daba ngaphandle kokuthi kusuke impi,” kusho uMogoeng.Uthe kodwa udaba lomhlaba ngeke luze luxazululeke ngaphandle kokuxazulula udaba lokucwasa ngokwebala.“Ngiyabathanda abantu abamhlophe kukubona ukuthi bayakukholwa yini kodwa ngeke ngize ngimbandaze ngithi ukucwasa akukho lapha eNingizimi Afrika,” kusho uMogoeng.Uthe abamhlophe ibona abahamba phambili kwezomnotho, ngesikhathi abantu abamnyama bebhuqwa indlala.“Udaba lomhlaba lungaxazululwa ngokuthula kube nobumbano kodwa abamhlophe kumele bazi ukuthi abazange bafike namhlaba lapha,” kusho uMogoeng.Uthe lolu daba kumele luxazululwe egameni likaLuthuli owalwela isithunzi sabantu abamnyama.UMogoeng uphinde wakhwela wadilika kubaholi bezombusazwe wathi sebengenwe umkhuba wokufuna ukuzicebisa.Umzukulu kaLuthuli, uMnuz Mthunzi Luthuli, uthe bajabule ngoba isicelo sabo sokuthi kuphenywe kabusha ngokushona kukamkhulu wabo sesize savunywa.

IMITHETHO eyayishaywe yidlanzana labamhlophe elawula isibalo sabantu abasendaweni ethize yize yayingemihle kodwa yayenza ukuthi kwazeke ukuthi bangaki abantu abahlala kuleyo ndawo, kungafani namanje njengoba sekuyikampunzi edla emini.Lokhu kushiwo yisakhamuzi esidala saKwaMashu uMnuz Obede Mbatha (77) obekhuluma emcimbini wokugubha iminyaka ewu-60, kwasungulwa leli lokishi, izolo, othe kuyadumaza ukuthi manje akekho umuntu ozazi kahle izibalo zabantu abahlala kuleli.UMbatha othe wafika eThekwini ngo-1957, uthe abamhlophe bakha indlela yokuthi kube nesidingo sokuthi abantu abahlala ezabelweni abase besusiwe emihlabeni ababehlala kuyo emihle, babuyele emadolobheni bazosebenza, ngokusungula intela, i-poll tax.“Kwase kumele size emadolobheni siyosebenza ukuze sikhokhe intela. Yize kwakunjalo wawungazingeneli nje edolobheni, kwakukhona KwaMuhle lapho kutholakala khona imvume yokuthi usebenzei,” kusho yena.Uthe ngaphambi kokuthi ayohlala KwaMashu wayehlala eMkhumbane kodwa basuswa kabuhlungu balethwa KwaMashu, bakhelwa izindlu zamapulangwe abathi uma bekhishwa kuzo bafakwa ku-4 room owawuhlala imindeni emibili, kule mizi manje sekuyisesigcemeni sakwa L.“Kule ndawo kwakunepulazi lo mlimi uSir Mashall Campell, abantu epulazini lakhe bagcina sebelinqamulela ngokuthi iKwaMarshall, bagcina sebenqamulela ngokuthi iKwaMashu,” kusho yena.U-Edmund Mhlongo weK Cap uthe bambalwa abantu abaziyo ukuthi kungani kule ndawo kuthiwa kusesinqawunqawini.Uthe leli gama lasuselwa ekutheni omunye womama owayedayisa ukudla waphelelwa inyama wapheka inyama yenja. Amakhasimende akhe uma ebuza ukuthi lenyama emnandi kangaka eyani, wayewaphendula ngokuthi eyesinqawunqawu.ISIKHULU saseKcap uMnuz Edmond Mhlongo ekhuluma emgubhweni weminyaka engu-60 kwasungulwa ilokishi KwaMashu“Cishe akekho ongasazi isisho esithi wakhala phansi okwentshebe yaKwaMashu kodwa akekho ozihlupha ngokubuza ukuthi ubani leyo ntshebe. Iqiniso ukuthi leyo ntshebe indoda eyayinentshebe eyanqanyulwa ikhanda isitimela,” kusho uMhlongo.UNksz Jacinta Ngobese uthe intsha kumele izinuke amakhwapha ngokuphuza okwedlulele nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, okudlangile kuleli lokishi.

YIZE ephenduke inhlekisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uSotswebhu weDA, uMnuz John Steenhuisen, ngokuthi akanazo iziqu zemfundo ephakeme kodwa uthe kufanele ayekwe kulesi sikhundla sakhe ngoba usebenzela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.USteenhuisen ubetinyelwa ngabantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abanye bemhleka ukuthi wayegxeka umbiko waseNkandla, ethi indlela obhaleke kabi ngayo ngathi ubuwenziwa wumfundi kamatric.Wayengasali kwabagxeka owayebhekelele ukusebenza kweSABC, uMnuz Hlaudi Motsoeneng, ngokuthi akafundile yingakho ehluleka wukuphatha inhlangano yokusakaza.Akusiye yedwa uSteenhuisen umholi onesikhundla esibalulekile. I-SABC isike yaphathwa nguMnuz Hlaudi Motsoeneng ongenawo umatric kodwa owayezishaya isifuba ngokwazi umsebenzi ngoba wafika esemncane.Kumanje uMotsoeneng uthe bebengeke badilizwe abasebenzi ukube bekusaphethe yena eSABC ngoba uyawazi umsebenzi.OwayenguSihlalo weBhodi yeSABC, uNkk Ellen Khuzwayo, waphoqeleka ukuthi asule esikhundleni emuva kokuthi inyuvesi ayethi ufunde kuyo yaveza ukuthi akazange athole iziqu kodwa wagcina ngokubhalisa kuphela.Bekukhona nelungu le-ANC elaliwuNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko namaSiko futhi lithathwa njengencithabuchopho, uMnuz Pallo Jordan. UJordan wasula ePhalamende emuva kokuvela kwemibiko yokuthi akanazo iziqu zobudokotela.Izolo uSolwazi Belinda Bozzoli okhulumela iDA kwezemfundo ePhalamende uthe yize eneziqu zeSociology kodwa ubukela kuSteenhuisen ngoba ungumholi osebenza ngokuzikhandla futhi owuhloniphayo umthetho.Isolezwe libe selenza ucwaningo lathola ukuthi nosotswebhu we-ANC, uMnuz Jackson Mthembu, naye unomatric ngoba waxoshwa eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare ngenxa yokuba yisishoshovu somzabalazo.Osotshwebhu bamaqembu amakhulu abaneziqu zemfundo ePhakeme ngowe-IFP, uMnuz Narend Singh, oneziqu zeBachelor of Commerce azithola eNyuvesi yaseDurban Westville esibizwa ngeNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal noMnuz Floyd Shivambu oneziqu zeMasters in Political Studies and International Relations okwavela ukuthi isicelo sakhe sokwenza iziqu zobudokotela samukelwe kwenye inyuvesi.Kuke kwaba nenkulumompikiswano ngeziqu zikaMnuz Mark Kingon owukhomishana wakwaSARS osabambile, abanye bethi unomatric kuphela kodwa unesikhundla esiphezulu.UKingon usesebenze kwaSARS iminyaka ewu-34. Yize afika enomatric kodwa usenazo iziqu zemfundo ephakeme azenza iminyaka ewu-11. Kumanje uneziqu zeBachelor of Administration azithola e-Unisa.

UNGQONGQOSHE wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan usevulele umholi we-Economic Freedom Fighters uMnuz Julius Malema amacala ngokumdicilela phansi isithunzi.UGordhan uvulele uMalema icala lokumhlambalaza, ukudicelela phansi isithunzi sakhe nelokubhebhezela udlame eBrooklyn Police Station, ePitoli. UMalema ngeledlule ukhwele wadilika kuGordhan embiza ngenja esetshenziswa yizicebi ezingabelungu ukuqhwaga amandla oMbuso.Ekhuluma nabezindaba ngephandle kwalesi siteshi samaphoyisa uGordhan uthe sekumumi emphinjeni ukudelwa uMalema.“Esikuvezayo ukuthi ngeke sisakwazi ukumelana nokumbozwa kwenkohlakalo kuleli kusetshenizwa ukucwaswa ngokwebala, ukuhlaselwa kwemindeni kanye nokuhlaselwa kwezombusazwe. Ngakho nginqume ukuthi sekwanele,” kusho uGordhan.“Uma ufuna ukuqophisana nathi ngezombusazwe ayikho inkinga, kodwa uma uzoqamba uhlasele imndeni yabantu uhlukanisa iNingizimu Afrika phakathi. Akwamukelekile neze lokho. Ibala lomuntu isihloko esibucayi kulelizwe,” kuqhuba yena.FUNDA:Uchaphe uGordhan ngenhlambaNgeledlule uMalema uchaphe ngenhlamba uGordhan ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabalandeli be-EFF ngaphandle kwebhilidi okusingethwe kulo ikhomishini ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Ngaleso sikhathi uGordhan wayefakaza kule khomishini.“UGordhan uyinja yabelungu abasebenzisa uMbuso. Uma uhlasela kukhala bona, ukhohlakele futhi akahlukile kuloyo owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma. BakuWhatsApp ofanayo ophethwe wuCyril Ramaphosa. Bafunda inkohlakalo kwi-ANC. Mina angikhohlakele ngoba angikaze ngivakashele emzini wakwaGupta futhi angikaze ngizwane namalungu akhona,” kusho uMalema.UMHOLI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngaphandle kwebhilidi okusingethwe kulo ikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana ngeledlule. Isithombe: Dimpho Maja/African News Agency (ANA)Waphinde waveza nokuthi  uGordhan unamasheya ezinkampanini zabacindezeli futhi indodakazi yakhe yathola uR8 million ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni.Ngesonto uMalema uqhubekile nokukhuluma ngendodakazi kaGordhan eveza ukuthi kuyenzelelwa uma kusolwa yona.“Uma kuyindodakazi eyiNdiya, kulungile, udaba luvaliwe, asikho isidingo sokuthi kuphenywe izitatimende zaseBhange,” kusho uMalema.UGordhan uyakuchitha ukuthi akhona amabhizinisi ahlanganisa indodakazi yakhe nohulumeni.

UVEZE izindaba ezishaqisayo umlisa osolwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ecaleni lokubulawa kwamalungu omndeni wakwaKhoza ayisikhombisa abulawa angcwatshwa endlini eVlakfontein, eGauteng.Umbiko we-Eyewitness News uveze ukuthi uMnuz Ernest Mabaso (27) ongomunye wabasolwa ababili abasolwa ngokubulala amalungu omndeni akwaKhoza uthe wayephoqwe nguMnuz Fita Khupe (61) abasolwa naye kuleli cala ukuthi abulale lo mndeni. Ngesonto eledlule iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseProtea ikuhlehlisile ukulalelwa kokufakwa kwesicelo sebheyili kwalaba bobabili ukuze kuqhubeke izolo nanamuhla.Laba basolwa babhekene namacala okubulala amalungu omndeni wakwaKhoza ayisikhombisa uNksz Mbali Khoza (51), nodadewabo uNksz Dudu Khoza (46) indodakazi yakhe uNksz Nomfundo Khoza (28) nabazukulu uKarabo (11), uLuyanda (7) , uNkanyiso (2) noSibongakonke (2). UMabaso uphinde abhekane namacala okudlwengula.UMabaso okuthiwa wazenza ilungu lomndeni wakwaKhoza, ezibiza ngoSibusiso Khoza utshele inkantolo ukuthi uKhupe wamphoqa ukuthi adlwengule bese ebulala amalungu alo mndeni. Uveze ukuthi wayesaba ukuthi uKhupe uzombulala uma engakwenzi ayekusho.Izolo bekulalelwa ukufakwa kwesicelo sebheyili salaba bobabili. Ngokwe-Eyewitness News uMabaso uthe uKhupe wamphoqa ukuthi adlwengule izingane ezine ezingamalungu alo mndeni phambi kwakhe bese eziklinya azigqibe.Encwadini efungelwe efundelwe inkantolo, uMabaso kuthiwa uthe wasebenzisa isando ukushaya amalungu alo mndeni emakhanda njengoba ayeyalelwe ukuthi enze ngabantu ababemthumbile. Uthe wathunjwa ngabantu ababezenza amaphoyisa bamsabisa ngokuthi bazombulala uma engenzi ababethi akakwenze. Uthe uKhupe usebenzela laba bantu.UMabaso uthe akayena umuntu ongabaleka uma ekhishwa ngebheyili. Uthe angakwazi ukukhokha ibheyili engangoR5000. UKhupe kuthiwa uziphikile izinsolo ezibekwe nguMabaso ngaye wathi konke akushoyo kusemcabangweni wakhe.Ngokusho kombiko we-Eyewitness News inkantolo isale ishaqekile nemindeni yahluleka ukuzibamba ngesikhathi kufundwa incwadi efungelwe kaMabaso.Izidumbu zamalungu omndeni akwaKhoza zatholwa ngo-Okthoba 29 nonyaka zigqitshwe endlini abanye babo bekopolotwe amehlo emuva kokuthi begcine ukubonakala ngo-Okthoba 19.
