text: UNGAPHANSI kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi owesilisa okusolwa ukuthi wadlelwa umakhelwane wakhe imali yefa eyashiywa wumqashi wakhe ayesemsebenzele iminyaka engaphezulu kweyishumi kwisithabathaba somuzi oseLa Lucia eThekwini.USabelo Mdlovu obesebenza engadini emzini kaNkk Charlotte Davies, umyeni wakhe owayedayisa idayimane (naye ongasekho emhlabeni). Ngokomunye womakhelwane abasondele emzini kaNkk Davies, wayengumuntu othulayo owayekhuluma noMdlovu kuphela isikhathi esiningi.Yingakho uMdlovu nabanye omakhelwane bathuka boma ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ka-2012 kutholakala ukuthi uNkk Davies ushiyele omunye umakhelwane, uNkk Adline Pillay, imali esondele kuR60 million, wabe eseshiyela uMdlovu uR600 000 kuphela.Ukusolisa kwalolu daba kuholele ophenyweni olwenziwa amaphoyisa eminyakeni emine edlule kanti abasolwa okunguPillay, abammeli bakhe ababili uMnuz Rodney Reddy noP. Ramjatham, bavele okokuqala enkantolo yamacala athinta imali ngoLwesine oludlule. Babhekene namacala enkohlakalo, ukukokotela kanye nokushushumbisa imali. Baboshwe kulandele isinqumo se-Assets Forfeiture Unit (AFU) sokugodla umuzi obiza uR5.8 million ngokunjalo nemali engaphezulu kuka R2.3 million ebikwi-akhawunti yakwaStandard Bank kamsolwa.UMdlovu uvulele uPillay icala ngosizo lommeli obengumakhelwane kaNkk Davies, uMnuz Ferdinand Zondagh kanti njengamanje ungaphansi kohlelo lokuvikelwa kofakazi njengoba esabela impilo yakhe.UZondagh uyena owakwazi ukuthola incwadi kaNkk Davies esayiniwe yango-2008, okuyiyo eyakubeka kwacaca ukuthi kukokotelwe ukusayinwa kwencwadi yamafa njengoba izandla zazingafani. Engxoxweni nephephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iDaily News, uZondagh uthe uMdlovu waxhumana naye ngo-2014 wamazisa ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngencwadi yamafa kaNkk Davies.Noma aqale elekelela uMdlovu, uZondagh manje usemele abashana bakaNkk Davies, uMnuz Landgraf Pane noNkk Barbara Pane, abahlala eGermany.Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, lolu daba lwasuka ngoSepthemba ngonyaka ka-2012 uMdlovu efika emzini kaNkk Davies. Wangqongqoza izithuba eziningi engamtholi kwaze kwaba uthinta amaphoyisa afika ashaya phansi isicabha angena. UNkk Davies watholwa esedlulile  emhlabeni.Kuvela ukuthi uMdlovu wacela uNksz Pillay ukuthi amlekelele ngamalungiselelo omngcwabo njengoba uNkk Davies wayengenazo izihlobo kuleli.UMdlovu wazisa amaphoyisa noPillay ukuthi kunesisefo (safe) endlini. Sesivuliwe, kwatholwa incwadi yamafa namanye amaphepha ambalwa.“UPillay noMdlovu baya kwaRodney & Reddy Associates, okungabameli ababhalisa uNkk Davies incwadi yakhe yamafa. Incwadi yakhe yokugcina yasayinwa ngoJanuwari 21 ngo-2010,” ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo.Umhlaziyi wezobunhloli (forensic analyst) owaqhathanisa ukusayina kukaNkk Davies encwadini yango-2008 kanye nokusayina okubonakala encwadini yamafama wathola ukuthi kukokotelwe okusencwadini yamafa.Kule ncwadi uPillay uhlabana ngezigidi zikaNkk Davis, uMdlovu usala noR600 000 kuphela.NgoLwesine odlule uPillay, uReddy noRamjathan bathole ibheyili kaR2000. Udaba luzobuyela enkantolo ngoFebruwari 4.-Daily News

source: siyanda isibalo sabafundi abanukubezwa ngokocansi ezikoleni kwazulu natal
text: SIYANDA isibalo sabafundi ababhekana nokuhlukunyezwa nokunukubezwa ngothisha ngokocansi ezikoleni zaKwaZulu-Natal.Ngokwempendulo kangqongqoshe wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, abalelwa ku-33 amacala okunukubeza ngokocansi avuliwe ngo-2017/18. Angu-22 awokushaywa avulwe ngesikhathi esifanayo. UDlungwane udalule lezi zinombolo kulandela umbuzo weDA ePhalamende. Uqhube waveza nokuthi bangu-231 abafundi baKwaZulu-Natal abalulekwa ngokwengqondo.Okhulumela iDA esifundazweni uMnuz Rishigen Viranna, uthe leli qembu likhathazekile ngokungabikwa kwezigameko ezenzeka ezikoleni njengoba besola ukuthi othishanhloko bavikela abenzi bobubi nezikole zabo.“Lolu lwazi lukubeka kucace ukuthi izingane zethu azivikelwa ngendlela efanele ezikoleni. Izikole zethu kumele ngabe zindawo zokufunda eziphephile, kodwa kubukeka engathi liyakhula izinga lobugebengu njengoba ilokhe yande njalo imibiko ngothisha abahlukumeza abafundi,” kusho uViranna.Uthe ngesonto eledlule kubikwe ukuthi uthisha wakulesi sifundazwe usekhulelise abafundi abahlanu abafunda ezikoleni ezihlukahlukene eManguzi eminyakeni emihlanu edlule.“Noma sikushayela ihlombe ukuthi iSouth African Council of Educators (SACE) iyaphenya ngalolu daba, umbuzo uthi; kungani umnyango neSACE besukumele lolu daba sekukhuleliswe abafundi abahlanu?”Empendulweni yakhe uDlungwane uphinde aveze ukuthi babalelwa ku-16 othisha abahlaselwa abafundi kulesi sifundazwe.UViranna uthe uMnyango wezeMfundo uhlulekile ukuvikela othisha nabafundi, wathi kumele kuqashwe onogada ngokushesha ezikoleni ezishoda ngabo. Uthe kumele kube nendlela yokuqopha bonke othisha abatholwa benecala lokunukubeza ngokocansi ukuze bengakwazi ukubalekela kwezinye izifundazwe.

UMKHANDLU weTheku uthi umphakathi ungatatazeli awulinde imiphumela ezocacisa ukuthi ngabe izakhamizi zakuleli dolobha ezigule ngemuva kokudla amaqanda, ziguliswe yisalmonella yini.UMnuz Musawakhe Mayisela okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe ngemuva kokuthi odokotela ababone abantu ababalelwa ku-20 ebebegula ngemuva kokudla amaqanda bakuqinisekisile ukuthi iziguli abazibonile ziguliswe yigciwane isalmonella. Ngenxa yalokhu umasipala uyaphenya ukuthi isalmonella okuyigciwane elitholakala ekudleni okungaphekiwe, belisemaqandeni yini nokuthi ngempela lezi zakhamuzi ziguliswe wukudla okunalo yini.“Okwamanje abantu abehlise umoya, baqinisekise ukuthi bageza izandla uma bezothinta ukudla ngoba lesi sifo sisabalaliswa ukungahlanzeki. Ngiyethemba ukuthi lizophela isonto sesiyitholile imiphumela enemininingwane ephelele. Okwamanje bangaphezu kuka-20 abantu ababonwe ngodokotela ebebephalaza behlanjulukelwe nayizisu okungezinye zezimpawu ze-salmonella,” kusho uMayisela.Kuphazamiseke umcintiswano wokupheka endaweni yokudlela, i-Old Town Italy, eMhlanga abebengenele umcintiswano bephalaza ngemuva kokudla ukudla okunye kwakho obekuneqanda.AbakwaSpar obekuthengwe kubo amaqanda bathi basalinde imiphumela yocwaningo ezocacisa ukuthi ngabe amaqanda abo abenegciwane isalmonella ngempela yini. Okwamanje bathe amaqanda asazoqhubeka adayiswe, bazowakhipha uma bethola ukuthi anayo isalmonella.UMnuz Rowan Holt wenkampani ekhiqiza iBarn Eggs ephakela izitolo zakwaSpar uthe uphenyo lwesikhashana luveza ukuthi leli gciwane alikho emaqandeni abo kodwa wathi bazobambisana nabenza ucwaningo.UMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni uthe uzosiqapha isimo, kodwa ucwaningo lwenziwa uphiko lwezempilo lukaMasipala weTheku ngoba zonke lezi zigameko zenzeke eThekwini.

source: le khomishini kazondo izoyishaya iyibhuqe i anc
text: Bantabami ngokuzithoba ngiyacela isale seyimiswa le Khomishini kaZondo okuthiwa ngeyophenya ngokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana. Ngicabanga ukuthi nobengaboni useyabona manje ukuthi iKhomishini yokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana ifana nenunu emakhandakhanda ezoshaya ibhuqe u-ANC. Ukube nginawo amandla okufinyelela egoseni le Khomoshini yokulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana, uSolwazi uThuli Madonsela, kungabe ngiyambuza manje ukuthi uyathokoza yini njengoba abantu bakaKhongolose sebejikijelana ngemikhonto ongathi baloyiwe. Kungenzeka ukuthi leKhomishini yasungulwa ngoba kuhloswe ukuthi kwembulwe izinqe zikaZuma kodwa manje kubukeka sekuvela nezinqe zabantu abaningi.Ngisho ingane ekhasela eziko iyabona ukuthi kule khomishini kuhujwa inyamazane eyodwa enguZuma kodwa kugcina sekulimala nezinye izinyamazane ngenxa yokuthi abazingeli bazingela ngokushisa umlilo. MaSolezwe ngiyaphinda ngiyasho ukuthi lo mlilo obaswe kuleya Khomishini uyoshiya uKhongolose ushe wahanguka amashiya nezinkophe. Lezi gubhu ezishawayo kuthiwe uKhongolose ubumbene ngibona ongathi kusiniswa amahleza ngoba le Khomishini ikuveza obala ukuthi uhlakazeke phakathi okwamaqhezu ezinqe. Okufike kube yinkinga wukuthi ofakazi beza ngogqozi nofuqufuqu lokupenda uZuma njengesikhohlakali kodwa bagcine sebechaphazele noGwede Mantashe, uGodongwana noJeff Radebe sekuvela ukuthi babekhona emihlanganweni ethile. OkaVolos uthi le Khomishini kaZondo ifana nomgangela wezinsizwa nezintokazi zikaKhongolose okufanele umiswe ngokushesha ngoba kuyofikwa okhethweni sekukhishwene amehlo abanye bengasanamazinyo. Kuyishwa ukuthi amalungu ka-ANC abukeka engaboni ukuthi ukuyofakaza kule Khomishini kufana nokuthatha intambo uzikhunge ngoba ugcine usungene wavela ngesicoco. Ubufakazi bale nto engiyishoyo kube yisehlo esehlele uNhlanhla Nene osukwe wusinga wayokwethula ubufakazi kodwa wagcina eselahlekelwa yisikhundla sokuba uNgqongqoshe wezeziMali. Kufikisela ngosizi ukubona uPravin Ghordan efakaza, echaza ukuthi yena wakubona kanjani ukulawulwa koMbuso. Thina esibukelayo sesinovalo lokuthi kwayena uGhordan uyogcina eselahlekelwe yisikhundla sakhe ngoba kuyabonakala ukuthi akekho omsulwa.MaSolezwe, angisho ukuthi ngithini kodwa ngithi angiyenameli le nkulumo kaMengameli uRamaphosa yokuthi naye uzimisele ngokuyofakaza kule Khomishini. UMatamela kufanele ngabe usebonile ukuthi umuntu oyofakaza kule Khomishini usuke eqiqinge umgqomo kadoti eyowuchitha ngenhloso yokungcolisa abathile. Inkinga isekutheni ngesikhathi uchitha udoti uthi ungcolisa abantu ugcina nawe sewungcoliswe yilo doti owuchithayo. Bakwethu, mina nginovalo lokuthi ngelinye ilanga noZuma uyosukwa yikhanda lakhe aqiqinge amanabukeni angcolile kaKhongolose ayowachitha kule Khomishini kaZondo kuhayize abantu.MaSolezwe, ngiyazi uVolos waziwa njengesibhedi kodwa mina angikuboni ukubheda uma kungathiwa le Khomishini kaZondo imiswe okwesikhashana ngenxa yokushoda kwezimali. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kuyosuka umsindo kube nemibuzo yokuthi imiswe kanjani iKhomishini isanda kuqala umsebenzi wayo. Ngibona ungcono umsindo wokuthi iKhomishini ibanjwe ngophondo kunokuthi idedelwe igabavule, iveze amahlazo kube kubhekwe okhethweni.- Ngeso likaVolovolo

source: kukhalwa ngenkosi yasenquthu ekhokhisa abangaganiwe intela yobumpohlo
text: KUBATSHAZWA umhlola wenkosi yaseVulamehlo, eNquthu okuthiwa iphakamise ukuthi abangaganiwe bakhokhe intela yobumpohlo ekubeni umphakathi usukhathele wukukhokhiswa intela ngezinto ezehlukene. Kukhalwa nangemali ekhokhwa abashonelwe enguR600 umphakathi othi awazi ngeyani.Kuthiwa kweminye imingcwabo kuze kulamule inkantolo enquma ukuthi umuntu angcwatshwe. Inkosi kuthiwa isuke ishaya phansi ngonyawo, ithi ngeke angcwatshwe kungakhokhiwe.UMnuz Elliot Nkosi osekomitini lomphakathi elizama ukulwa nale mithetho, uthi abahleli neze kahle endaweni ngenxa yesandla sensimbi abaphethwe ngaso yinkosi. Uthe basanda kubabaza umhlola nje inkosi ithi abantu abangaganiwe kufanele bakhokhe imali njalo ngonyaka eyintela yokuba yimpohlwa.Kuthiwa inkosi ayinazwelo noma ngabe uyahlupheka noma ungumfelokazi, ifuna imali ngoshova kubona, ithumela izinduna zayo okuthiwa nazo azihleki azithi nsi.Ithintwa inkosi Thathezakhe Ngobese ngalolu daba, ithe yonke indawo inomthetho wakhona uma kukhona ongahambisani nemithetho akaye kwenye indawo.“Uma abantu beze enkantolo yenkosi bathola usizo mihla namalanga endaweni yakwaNgobese. Basuke bethi umabhalane wasenkantolo ukhokhelwa ngani?“Amaphepha nezigxivizo konke kukhokhelwa ngani?’’ kubuza inkosi.Ithe ngeke izwe ngabantu abasuka emadolobheni bexakwe wukubiza kwempilo bezohlala emakhaya bese befika bashaye imithetho ebhedayo.Ithe kwayena uNkosi lowo ophakamisa izikhalo wayesuke eHlobane koVryheid futhi abazi ngisho ithuna likayisemkhulu njengoba esezokhuluma ezesigodi sakwaNgobese.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Lennox Mabaso, uthe basalinde umbiko.“Silithumile ithimba lethu ukuthi liyozwa kahle ukuthi kwenzenjani, umphakathi ukhala ngani bese siyabona ukuthi senzanjani," kusho uMabaso.

AKEKHO owayecabanga ukuthi uyosheshe alulame umgijimi owasinda bezama ukumnquma imilenze ngesaha ngoMashi nonyaka, okumanje usengenele imijaho eminingi wawina neminye.Udaba lukaMhlengi Gwala (26) waseMayville lwaduma umhlaba wonke emuva kwesigameko esenzeka ngoMashi 6, ehlaselwa amadoda amathathu ehamba ngebhayisikili ngaseGlenwood eThekwini. Kwavulwa ngisho isikhwama somnikelo esafinyelela kuR100 000 emuva kwesonto sivuliwe. Lo mgijimi ophinde angenele nemincintiswano yamabhayisikili, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi okumenze washesha ukululama wukukhohlwa yilesi sigameko. Ngesikhathi engena esibhedlela odokotela bathi kusazothatha isikhathi ukuthi abuyele kwezemidlalo, wamangaza abaningi ephuma esezihambela esibhedlela ngo-Ephreli.“Bekungeke kungisize ukuzikhathaza ngokuthi ngobani ababezama ukungikhubaza futhi bekuzokwenza ngingasheshi ukululama. Njengoba bengakaboshwa, sengavele ngakhetha ukugxila emsebenzini wami,” kusho uGwala.UGwala ophinde abe ngumtakuli wasemabhishi kuMasipala weTheku, uthe waqala ngoJuni ukubhukuda njengendlela yokuzilolonga. Umjaho wokuqala wamabhayisikili uwungenele ngo-Agasti oyingxenye yokukhumbula uMnuz Nelson Mandela. Waqala ukugijima ngo-Okthoba emjahweni we-5150 African Triathlon eGoli.“Ngaqala ngokungenela owamabhayisikili ngoba bekungakalulameki kahle ukugijima. Ngenze kahle kulo mjaho ngoba ngaphuma isikhombisa kubantu abangaphezu kuka-100. Emkhakheni wontanga yami obizwa ngo-25-29 ngaphuma phambili,” kusho yena.UGwala uphinde wenza umjaho we-031 eSuncoast noweFNB lapho egijime khona u10km. Ngenyanga edlule ubekomunye umjaho eHowick kanti ngoMgqibelo uzongenela owamabhayisikili wakwaMr Price wokuqokelela uR1 million kubafundi abaswele. NgoDisemba uzongenela i25 Pier Challenge eNorth Beach. Uthe ngonyaka ozayo ufuna ukugxila emijahweni yokugijima ngoba uzobe eseluleme ngokuphelele. Wabuyela ngoSepthemba emsebenzini wakwaMasipala wahlonishwa nangendondo ye-Achievement Against All Odds emcimbini owenziwe uhulumeni wesifundazwe. Njengoba abaningi bejwayele ukubhala incwadi emuva kwezigameko ezibavelele, uGwala uthe akakucabangi lokho. Uthe usafuna ukugxila emsebezini wakhe ukuze angenele imijaho yakwamanye amazwe.“Mhlawumbe ngelinye ilanga ngiyoyibhala incwadi. Bakhona abebecela ukubhala incwadi ngami kodwa ngabamisa ngoba kuzongiphazamisa.”Udaba lwakhe lusaqhubeka nokuxoxwa emazweni njengoba esanda kuvakashelwa yiBBC neCNN okuyimithombo yezindaba esakazela umhlaba wonke. Ngenyanga edlule ubeyombesa ingoduso yakhe uNksz Hle Mokoena, wathi zizowushaya maduze.

ABASHUSHISI bombuso bahlongoza ukuhoxisa amacala avulelwe abantu okubalwa kubo abomndeni wakwaGupta athinta ukudliwa kwezimali zohlelo okwakumele luthuthukise abalimi abamnyama baseFree State.Okhulumela iNPA uMnuz Luvuyo Mfaku wazise iNews24 ukuthi incwadi yokuhoxiswa kwamacala isibhaliwe yathunyelwa abammeli bomndeni wakwaGupta ukubazise ngezakamuva ezithinta leli cala. Icala bekumele libuyele enkantolo yeMantshi eBloemfontein ngoDisemba 4 nonyaka.Abasolwa kuleli cala okunguVarun Gupta, isikhul esiphezul kwi-Oakbay uRonica Howa, umqondisi wenkampani iSahara u-Ashu Chawla, owayeyisikhulu seTNA Media uNazeem Howa, umqondisi wase-Estina uKamal Vasram, nezikhulu zikahulumeni uPeter Thabethe, Sylivia Dlami noTakisi Masiteng bona bathola ibheyili ngoFebruwari.Baboshwa ngezinsolo zokukhwabanisa, ukweba, ukwakha itulo lokukhwabanisa nokweba, ukuphula umthetho wePublic Finance Managemen Act, ukuphula umthetho weCompanies Act nokuphula umthetho wePrevintion of Organized Crime Act. Kuleli cala kusolwa ukuthi beba imali ebalelwa kuR250 yohlelo i-Estina Dairy Farm Project, eVrede.INPA iqhube yaveza ukuthi isizathu sokuhoxiswa kwamacala ukuthi basalinde obunye ubufakazi obuvela e-UAE nase-India.

INATIONAL Freedom Party (NFP) isiveze ukuthi iphenya kabanzi ngengxoxo eqoshiwe ngeselula lapho kukhuluma khona umlisa ozibiza ngenkabi edabuka KwaMaphumulo ezishaya isifuba ngokuthi isibaqedile abantu embonini yamatekisi nakwezepolitiki.Kule nkulumo ekuWhatsApp inkabi izwakala ibhadlaza igama lomunye umholi weNFP wesilisa ukuthi isebenza naye. Isolezwe ngeSonto liyizwile le ngxoxo eshaqisayo esabalele kuWhatsApp.Okhulumela iNFP, uMnuz Sabelo Sigudu, uthe bayitholile le ngxoxo bayaphenya ngayo. "Lolu daba lusethimbeni labameli bethu. Sifuna ukuthola kahle umsuka. Ngeke siyithathe kancane le nto ngoba isimo sokubulawa kosopolitiki siyaziwa eKZN. Asazi noma abantu nje abanqonde ukungcolisa igama lenhlangano njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni."Lo mlisa ozibiza ngenkabi ukhuluma nomunye wesilisa amtshela ukuthi ubeqashwe owesifazane ukuthi ambulale futhi usekhokhelwe ingxenye yemali yokumbulala. Inkabi iyazisho igama layo nesibongo, ithi ayesabi kwamaphoyisa yona kade kwasa inethwa zimvula kulo msebenzi.Lo ofonelwayo kuthiwa uyisikhulu enkampanini edumile ekhiqiza ushukela. Inkabi izwakala ithi lo mlisa usesinde izikhawu. Ithi ngelinye ilanga ngesikhathi sebeyombulala baphazanyiswa ukuqhamuka kwamaphoyisa endaweni okwakufanele bamthele othulini kuyo."Thina sisebenzisana nabamatekisi nosopolitiki, siqashwa ngoR250 000 futhi ubuchopho bendoda asibunqeni sibubamba nangezandla. Ngineminyaka emibili ngiphumile ejele abanye esisebenza nabo bangaphakathi. Empeleni siwu-6 senza lo msebenzi wokushaya abantu,’’ kusho inkabiLo ofonelwayo uzwakala ehlisa umoya ezwakala ukuthi wethukile, ethi kufanele baxoxisane balungise lolu daba. Iyaqhubeka inkabi ithi lo mlisa usindiswe ukuthi uyisihlobo sayo."Abazali bethu bayazi ukuthi siphila ngalo msebenzi, sayalwa ukuthi singasibulali isihlobo ngoba sojikelwa nayidlozi. Sisanda kushaya amaphoyisa amabili KwaMashu futhi sisebenzisana no (egagula igama lo munye wabaholi beNFP).’’Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Thulani Zwane, uthe lowo oshayelwe ucingo kufanele aye emaphoyiseni awalalelise leyo ngxoxo ukuze kuphenywe.

INHLANGANO elwela amalungelo ezingane, i-Operation Bobbi Bear, isinxuse abesilisa, ikakhulu obaba ukuthi bazivikele izingane kungabi yibo abazidlwengulayo.Lokhu kulandela ukuboshwa komlisa (38) waseMfazazane, eMthwalume, osolwa ngokudlwengula indodakazi (14) yakhe angayizali nokusolwa ukuthi useze wayikhulelisa. Kuthiwa lo mlisa onengane eneminyaka emihlanu nonina wale ntombazane uqale ukuyidlwengula ineminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye.Lo mlisa obevele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMzumbe, uzophinde avele ngesonto elizayo lapho okulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sebheyili.UNksz Sibongile Ngcobo we-Operation Bobbi Bear unxuse obaba ukuthi bazivikele izingane ngisho kungathiwa abazizali.“Siyabancenga obaba ukuthi babe ngobaba bangempela kungabi yibo abahlukumeza izingane. Sibona izigameko eziningi zezingane okuthiwa zidlwengulwe ngobaba. Nobaba osuke engayizali ingane usuke ewubaba wayo,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Kubuhlungu ukubona lesi simo ikakhulu njengoba kusazongenwa kumkhankaso we-16 Days of Activism for No Violence Against Women and Children obanjwa ngoNovemba 25 kuya kuDisemba 10.UNksz Ngcobo uthe omama kubalulekile ukuthi banakekele izingane zabo futhi baxoxisane nazo ukuze zikwazi ukubatshela uma kukhona izinkinga ezibhekene nazo.Uthe lokhu akushoyo akusho ukuthi unina wale ngane ubengayinakekeli.Uphinde wanxusa abazali ukuthi bangagcini kuphela ngokunaka ezabo izingane kodwa banakekele nezingane zasemiphakathini abavela kuyo.“Kufanele sithi uma sibona ingane emgwaqweni siyithathe njengeyethu. Masibe nomcabango wokuthi ingane yomuntu ingane yami,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.

source: umfundi wakwagrade  ugwaze wabulala owakwagrade  esikoleni
text: KULINDELEKE ukuthi avele namhlanje enkantolo umfundi wakwaGrade 11 osolwa ngokubulala umfana obefunda uGrade 1 esikoleni saseNorth West. Umfundi obulewe ugwazelwe esikoleni ngoLwesithathu ekuseni.Umnyango wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe uthe umsolwa ubecashe ethoyilethe lesikole kanti kusolwa ukuthi ulale kulo. Kubikwa ukuthi ubanjwe uthishanhloko wabe esebizelwa amaphoyisa.Kuthiwa umsolwa ubemazi umfundi obulewe kwazise wayethandana nodadewabo omdala abefunda naye esikoleni.Ungqongqoshe wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Jonas Sello Lehari kulindeleke ukuthi ahambele lesi sikole namhlanje ekuseni.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje nonyaka zilokhe zande njalo izehlo zokubulawa kwabafundi emagcekeni esikole.

USAPHITHENE ikhada unina wezelamani ezintathu zaseCaluza, eMgungundlovu, ezibulewe nabazukulu abane ngempelasonto eVlakfontein, eGoli ngempelasonto.UNkk Thoko Khoza ongunina kaNksz Mbali, Dudu noNomfundo Khoza ugcine ukukhuluma nenye yamadodakazi akhe ngesikhathi elungiselela ukuya enkonzweni ngoMgqibelo. Lawa madodakazi akhe abulawe nabazukulu abane bakaNkk Khoza okunguKarabo, Luyanda, Sibongakonke noNkanyiso base begqitshwa endlini nokusolwa obeyisihlobo ebesizenza udokotela ngokubabulala.UNkk Khoza uthe wasola ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle ngesikhathi eshayela izingane zakhe ucingo kodwa zingazibambi izingcingo. UNkk Khoza uthi uvalo luqale ukumshaya uma engamtholi uMbali kwiselula ngeSonto ekuseni ekubeni ubengalenzi iphutha lokuhamba engamthintanga.“Uvuka kakhulu ekuseni bese siyakhuluma ocingweni. Kodwa ngashaya ucingo isikhathi eside ngingamtholi ucingo luvaliwe. Kukhona engakusola kodwa ngalokhu ngizama ngaze ngashayela uDudu ucingo lwabanjwa yilo mfana ebusuku wathi sebelele bonke uzobatshela ukuthi bengishayela. Ngamangala ngambuza ukuthi yena akalele ngani, wathi usabhala amaphepha omsebenzi asesibhedlela ngoba besazi ukuthi udokotela. Ngisadidekile angisakwazi nakahle okunye,” kusho uNkk Khoza.IMeya yaseMsunduzi uMnuz Themba Njilo ivakashele amalungu alo mndeni izolo. UNjilo uthe umasipala uzobambisana noMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, owezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhunyaniswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal nowaseGoli ngamalungiselelo okufihla.“UNgqongqoshe waseGoli usesilekelele ngokuthuthwa kwezidumbu, namalungiselelo omngcwabo sesiqalile ukuwenza nomndeni. Sizowulekelela ngakho konke esingasiza ngakho ngoba nogogo siyabona usesele yedwa,” kusho uNjilo. Inkonzo yomngcwabo izoba sehholo lomphakathi eCaluza ngeSonto ngo-9 ekuseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGoli uCaptain Mavela Masondo utshele Isolezwe ukuthi basezithendeni zosolwa ngokubulala lawa malungu omndeni.“Amaphoyisa aseLenasia South aphenya amacala ayisikhombisa okubulala kulandela ukutholwa kwezidumbu zabo endlini abebehlala kuyo. Ukhona obethathwe amaphoyisa obehlala kulo muzi ukuze aphoswe imibuzo kodwa wabuya wadedelwa ngoba singakutholi okumhlanganisa namacala. Umsolwa akakaboshwa kodwa silandela umkhondo wakhe. Sinxusa nomphakathi ukuba usilekelele ngolwazi ongaba nalo, uthinte noma yisiphi isiteshi samaphoyisa,” kusho uMasondo.Izidumbu zalaba zitholwe ngoMsombuluko zigqitshwe endlini ngemuva kokuthi abanye abahlala egcekeni lalo muzi bezwe kunephunga elingajwayeleike futhi bengawaboni amalungu alo mndeni.

LIPHUCE iphoyisa isibhamu lazingqokloza ngaso emtholampilo lashona ibhungu (20) laseGamalakhe okuthiwa litakulwe amaphoyisa lishaywa umphakathi emuva kokuba sengozini yemoto eshiye abantu belimele.Kuthiwa uMnuz Vuyo “Boy Boy” Abdolo waseMagogogweni, eGamalakhe, uzidubulele emtholampilo iGamalakhe Community Health Centre ekhanda emuva kokuthi elanyulelwe amaphoyisa eshaywa umphakathi ngeSonto ekuseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokushayela budedengu avula nedokodo mayelana nokushona kwalo mlisa emuva kwalesi sigameko.UCaptain Gwala uthe kusolakala ukuthi lo mlisa uhluleke ukulawula imoto washayisa itekisi ebeyilayisha abantu esitobhini sebhasi iMasengeni. Kuthiwa ibe seyishayisa abantu abathathu balimala baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela.“Abagibeli nomshayeli kuthiwa bazamile ukumumisa ngesikhathi ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko. Kusolakala ukuthi umufi ushaywe amalungu omphakathi ngoba ezama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko emuva kwengozi. Kusolakala nokuthi ngesikhathi engaphandle komtholampilo endaweni yokupaka umsolwa uhlule iphoyisa ngamandla wathatha isibhamu salo wazidubula ekhanda ngesikhathi elinye lingaphakathi emtholampilo,” kusho uCaptain Gwala.UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Sibongiseni Dhlomo, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini ka-Abdolo athe kuthiwa ubentshontshe imoto yakubo ngesikhathi ebandakanyeka engozini.Uthe batholile ukuthi usizwe amaphoyisa amyisa emtholampilo waseGamalakhe nokuyilapho obekulindeleke ukuthi ahlolwe igazi ukuze kuvele ukuthi ubengaphuzile yini amanzi amponjwana. UDhlomo uchaze lesi sigameko njengesishaqisayo.“Sidabuke kakhulu ngalesi sigameko sokulahlekelwa umphefumulo wumuntu osemusha ngokungenasidingo. Akucabangeki ukuthi abazali bakhe babhekene nobuhlungu obungakanani kulesi sikhathi. Akulula ukubhekana nesimo sokushonelwa yingane ngenxa yento eqale iwukuganga yagcina seyiyinhlekelele enjena,” kusho uDhlomo.Uthe bayazi nokuthi bakhahlamezeke kangakanani abantu abebekhona ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko emtholampilo waseGamalakhe njengoba ethe babafisela ukuthi bathole amandla kuNkulunkulu ukuthi abasize babhekane nalesi simo. Uthe bazobasiza nalabo abadinga ukululekwa ngokomqondo. Unxuse namalungu omphakathi ukuthi akugweme ukuzijezisela abantu.Izolo, umalume ka-Abdolo, uMnuz Phumlani Mdlozini, uthe umndeni usesimeni esingesihle emuva kokwenzekile.Uthe akulula ukuthi bangakhuluma kakhulu ngakho ngoba kuphenywa wuphiko oluphenya amacala enziwa amaphoyisa Independent Police Investigative Directorate.Ngokusho kwakhe, umshana wakhe ube sengozini yemoto wase ehlaselwa amalungu omphakathi nokuyilapho okufike khona amaphoyisa amthatha amuyisa emtholampilo okuyilapho okwenzeke khona lesi sigameko.UMdlozini uthe umshana wakhe ubethathe imoto yakubo eyoyilungisa ngesikhathi kwenzeka ingozi.

INJABULO iphenduke usizi kubantu abadala nabagulayo abese bezitshele ukuthi bazohola ngoLwesithathu eNtshangwe kodwa babuya bulanzi ngenxa yokuthi abebezobaholela kabafikanga.UNksz Thembisile Gumede (54), ohola impesheni yokukhubazeka, ngomunye wababuye bebhangcuzela bevela eSthumba General Dealer eku-ward 4 eNtshangwe. UNksz Gumede, osekuphele iminyaka emine engakwazi ukuhamba ngenxa yokukhubazeka, uphuthwe wuR2 400 womholo ohlanganisa nesibonelelo sabazukulu.“Njalo uma ngizoya noma yikuphi ngiqasha imoto ngoba angikwazi ukuhamba. Nangosuku lokuhola ngisizwa wukuqasha imoto bese umuntu ngiyamkhokhela uma sengiholile. Ngibe senkingeni ngoLwesithathu ngoba ngilinde kwashona ilanga, ingafiki imoto esiholelayo,” kusho uNksz Gumede.Uthe ufike ngo-8 ekuseni esikhungweni sokuhola, kwaze kwashaya u-2 ntambama imoto ingafiki.“Bese sikhathele wukushiswa yilanga silindile. Ezinye izalukazi bese zigula ngenxa yokushisa kwelanga. Sizwe ukuthi izimoto ezisiholelayo zibonakele ziya kwesinye isikhungo kaMkhizwane kodwa zangeza kithina. Size satshelwa wumnikazi wesitolo esihola kuso ukuthi izimoto azisezi,” kusho uNksz Gumede.Uthe uphindele ekhaya elambatha, waxolisa nakumnikazi wemoto abeyiqashile asemkweleta ngenxa yokungaholi.UNksz Gumede uthe kufika usuku lomholo evele eselinde wona ngoba kusuke kungasekho lutho nasendlini.Uthe babuye belambatha nomunye umakhelwane wakhe abahola naye.Okhulumela abakwaSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) esifundazweni, uMnuz Mbizeni Mdlalose, uvumile ukuthi kuyaholelwa kulesi sikhungo. Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe abantu bayatshelwa uma kunezinguquko kodwa kulokhu okube yinkinga ukushintsha kosuku lokuhola. Uthe lokhu kudalwe wukuthi sekunosonkontileka omusha oholelayo.“Isikhungo siyaqhubeka nokuholela kodwa kushintshe usuku lokuhola kuphela. Kumele baye esikhungweni ngomhlaka 17 kuyona le nyanga ukuze bahole. Kungenzeka ukuthi abezwanga ngalezi zinguquko zezinsuku zokuhola. Kusekhona abanamakhadi amadala akwaCPS okungenzeka ukuthi bebethenjiswe ukuholelwa yibona. Singeke sikwazi-ke ukungena kulokho,” kusho uMdlalose.

LIZITHINTELE iziqandu iBamba likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, elisolwa ngokubiza omabhalane masembuthweni ngezithusanyoni ezingenamsebenzi walutho okufanele zikhonjwe indlela.Izinyunyana zamaphoyisa eziwotha ubomvu, iPopcru neSAPU zithumele izincwadi ezivuthayo zijijimeza lo sigaxamabhande oseyinkunzi eluvava kulo msebenzi. UMkhwanazi kusolwa ukuthi ukhwele wadilika komabhalane ehlangene nabo eChatsworth, eThekwini, lapho okuthiwa ubebatshela emehlweni ukuthi indaba yabo ifana nomdlalo nje kulo mbutho.Lezi zincwadi zitinyele kwezwela kuMkhwanazi ngoba ugcine eziphendulela ebhula umlilo obusha ubuhanguhangu ekhala ngokuthi kuhlanekezelwa inkulumo yakhe.“Ngesikhathi ngikhuluma kube khona elinye ilungu lombutho elikhale ngokuthi alihambisani nokushintshwa komabhalane babe ngamaphoyisa. Ngibe sengenanela leyo nkulumo ngokuthi nami kangihambisani nalokho ngoba kudala ukudideka ngokomsebenzi."Uthe uzohlangana nezinyunyana ukuze kulungiswe udaba.

source: ezothando nginenkinga ngomyeni wami ongafuni ukusebenza
text: Umbuzo: Sahlangana esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme nomyeni wami. Sibusiswe ngabantwana ababili. Umshado wethu awukaze ube mnandi selokhu kwathi nhlo. Inkinga umyeni ongafuni ukusebenza. Usuka ekhaya elimi kahle futhi ufundile ngakho angazi ngempela ukuthi inkinga ikuphi.Ujika nelanga imini yonke, mina ngimelwe yizo zonke izidingo zekhaya. Umndeni wakhe awenzi lutho ukwenza isimo sibe ngcono phakathi kwethu. Bengizitshela ukuthi umndeni wakhe uzoke ukhulumisane naye ukuze avuke azithathe njengendoda. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi akangazi nokuthi ngiyini mina umyeni wami. Sengihlalele izingane nje kuphela ngabe kade ngashiya.Mpho, eGoliImpendulo:Kungenzeka ukuthi umndeni wakhe awazi ngenhlalo yenu. Kuthiwa ingane engakhali ifela embelekweni ngakho alikho iphutha ngokuphumela obala ngobunzima obhekene nabo, ushilo nawe ukuthi umndeni wakhe ume kahle okusho ukuthi ungakwazi ukunisiza okwesikhashana.Kusengenzeka futhi ukuthi uyawuzama umsebenzi kodwa akawutholi, kucabange naloko okuyinto engaphezu kwamandla akhe naye.Umbuzo:Ngisemncane kanti ngishadelwe kuwo lo nyaka, sengishadelwa okwesibili. Okungimangazayo ngonkosikazi wami ukuthi uhleze ekhuluma ngomuntu ayethandana naye ngaphambilini njalo uma enabangani bakhe. Angazi ngempela ukuthi ngisithathe kanjani lesi senzo sakhe. Ngizizwa ngingathandwa kulo mshado ngenxa yokuthi ingathi inhliziyo yakhe isekomunye umuntu.Sandile, eThekwiniImpendulo:Kusobala ukuthi unkosikazi wakho akazinikezanga isikhathi esanele sokudlulisa umuntu ayethandana naye ngaphambi kokungena kulomshado. Mazise ukuthi kukuphatha kanjani uma ekhuluma ngesoka lakhe elidala kubangani bakhe ekubeni eseshade nawe.Umbuzo:Nginenkinga yomyeni oyingelosi uma engaphuzile kodwa uma eke wathinta utshwala ufana nesilwane. Ufika ekhaya ezinzulwini zobusuku uyosithuka nabantwana asishaye kuze kuse. Ngakusasa ungamphikela ukuthi bekunguyena. Kuvele kube sengathi akwenzakalanga lutho, impilo iqhubeke ngokujwayelekile.Ngiyazi ukuthi wakhula kanzima ekhaya lapho wayehlukunyezwa ngayo yonke indlela ongayicabanga kodwa manje le nto eyayenzeka kuyena useyenza kumina nabantwana. Ubulala konke esesikusebenzele kanzima sikwakha sobabili.Ngingenza kanjani ukuze umyeni wami abhekane nezinkinga zakhe ukuze nempilo yomndeni wethu ibe ngcono?Nozizwe, South CoastImpendulo:Utshwala isikhathi esiningi busetshenziswa ukuvala izinkinga ezithize umuntu asuke ebhekene nazo. Kodwa akhohlwe ukuthi uzokhohlwa izinkinga okwesikhashana ziphinde zibuye. Kubukeka sengathi kukhona nomyeni wakho asuke ezama ukukuvala ngotshwala. Zihamba kanjani izinto phakathi kwenu? Kuhamba kanjani emsebenzini wakhe? Akukho ongakucabanga okungamenza azifake otshwaleni ngale ndlela?Zama nokukhulumisana naye ngales siikhathi engasaphuzile ukuthola ukuthi yini ngempela emenza azilahlele otshwaleni. Umazise futhi ukuthi senihlalele ovalweni nabantwana ngoba anazi ukuthi uzobuya emsebenzini enjani. Okudlula lokho kuzomele umfunele usizo kwa-AA (Alcoholics Anonymous) yangakini ukuze bameluleke ngokufanele uma isimo singashintshi.Umbuzo:Ngikhathele indoda engidonsa ngekhala. Ihleze ifuna ukwazi ukuthi ngikuphi ngisho noma yazi ukuthi ngisemsebenzini. Uma ngivakashele abangani ifuna ukwazi ikheli lalapho sikhona ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi ngikhona ngempela yini. Sekuze kwadlulela ngisho ezimpahleni zami zokugqoka, ifuna ukuba nesandla ekutheni ngizogqokani. Uma ngigqoke into engayithandi sizoxabana siyoze sibuye la siye khona. Ngiphila kanjani nomuntu ofuna ukuphatha impilo yami ngale ndlela?Igama ligodliweImpendulo:Kuyacaca ukuthi umyeni wakho unokuzeya. Akukho ukuhlukumeza okudlula lokhu. Umyeni wakho udinga usizo ukuze akwazi ukuyeka le nto aseyiqalile.Sibona kukuhle ukuthi uqale uxoxisane naye ngokuthi ukwenza kwakhe kukwenza ungakhululeki futhi unovalo lokuthi uma engalutholi usizo kungagcina kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ebudlelwaneni benu.Uma engaliboni iphutha lakhe nangemuva kokuxoxisana naye sibona kungcono ukuthi umufunele usizo okusheshayo kodokotela bengqondo kungaze konakale kakhulu.Kusobala ukuthi zikhona izimo ezenze ukuthi abe kulendawo akuyona lapho engathembi lutho mekuza kumuntu athandana naye. Into enjengalena kukhona la esuka khona. Akekho umuntu ozalwa ezinyeza. Sinifisela inhlanhla.

OWESIFAZANE othi wayeyisinqandamathe sikaDonald Trump, uStormy Daniels, uthi lo mengameli wase-United States ushaya udaka kwinkonzo yasekamelweni.UStormy, ozakhele udumo ngamafilimu ocansi eMelika, udalule lokhu encwadini ekhuluma ngempilo yakhe lapho aveze khona nokuthi kubo bonke abantu aseke aya ocansini nabo, uTrump uyena ofathuze ukubadlula bonke.Uthe uTrump nokho ubengakugqizi qakala yena lokho njengoba ephikisana nombono wakhe ezibona eyinkunzi embhedeni.UStormy Daniles odume ngamafilimu ocansi eMelika usola umengameli Donald Trump ngokushaya udaka kwinkonzo yasekamelweni. Isithombe: AP Photo/Craig RuttleLo wesifazane oneminyaka engu-39 uqhube wadelela umphambili kaTrump ewufanisa nokapopayi.“Uyena owangicoba kunabo bonke abanye esengike ngalala nabo kodwa kwangicacela ukuthi yena wayengakuboni lokho,” kusho uStormy encwadini yakhe iFull Disclosure.Uthe walala noTrump ngesikhathi osaziwayo baseMelika bedlala igalofu eLake Tahoe, eCalifornia ngonyaka ka 2006. Encwadini uphinde athi kwakumufakela amahloni ukubona uTrump njalo kwithelevishini njengoba kwakumbuyisela umcabango wokuthi sebeke balala ndawonye.UTrump uyakuchitha ukuthi useke walala nalo wesifazane.

KUVELE ukuthi kukhona abebemcathamela uSihlalo wegatsha le-ANC ku-ward 12, KwaNdengezi obulewe ngabantu abebemlalele unyendle egcekeni lakwakhe ngoMsombuluko ebusuku.UMnuz Thulani Nxumalo (53) owake waba nguSihlalo womkhandlu olwa nobugebengu, iCommunity Policing Forum (CPF) iminyaka engaphezu kuka-10, udutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa ngesikhathi esegcekeni lakwakhe eRockdale KwaNdengezi ngesikhathi ephuma emhlanganweni we-ANC.Kuthiwa ngaphambi kokuthi abulawe uNxumalo, laba abebemfuna bake bazama ukumcuthela kwakhe emasontweni amabili edlule kodwa bangamthola ngoba akazange aphumele emnyango.Abahlaseli kuthiwa babecuthe emnyango, babonwa izingane zikamufi bazijikijela ngamatshe babe sebeyabaleka.Kuthiwa baphinde babuya futhi bangqongqoza ewindini nangaleso sikhathi wangaphuma.UMnuz Thulani Nxumalo obuleweUnkosikazi kamufi, uNkk Makhosi Nxumalo uthe ukhona umuntu obehlale eshayela ucingo umyeni wakhe embuza ukuthi ukuphi ngaso sonke isikhathi.“Ngaphambi kokuthi adutshulwe emasontweni amabili edlule, bakhona abantu abamcuthela lapha ekhaya kodwa wangaphuma, labo bantu babuyile futhi bazongqongqoza ewindini wangaphuma futhi, kanti nangosuku abulawe ngalo abebesemhlanganweni naye bathi ucingo lwakhe belulokho lukhala lona obeshaya ebuza ukuthi ukuphi waze wagcina eseluvala ucingo ngoba lumphazamisa,” kusho uNkk Nxumalo.Uthe nango-2004, umyeni wakhe wake wadutshulwa kodwa wasinda.Isekela likaSihlalo we-ANC ku-ward 12, uMnuz Mbongeni “Killer” Ngwenya uthe basadidekile ukuthi uNxumalo ubulawe ngobani nokuthi ubulaweleni.“Akukho ukungezwani esingathi kukhona ewadini, amaqabane abambisene kanti nekhansela le-ward okuyikhansela lomphakathi nalo asinankinga nalo kuyasetshenziswana kahle.”Uchaze uNxumalo njengomuntu obezilungele engafuni kuthiwe kukhona umuntu angazwani naye. “Uqabane uNxumalo ubelunge kakhulu indlela nesihluku abulawe ngayo bekungamfanele,” kusho uNgwenya.UMnuz Zenzele Thabethe we-ANC eHenry Bona Zone uthe ukubulawa kukaNxumalo yisenzo sobugebengu, akuhlangene nezombusazwe. “Sinxusa amaphoyisa ukuthi enze umsebenzi wawo futhi siyathemba ukuthi abenzi bobubi bazogcina bevelile,” kusho uThabethe.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli uthe uKhongolose uyakugxeka ukubulawa ngesihluku kukaNxumalo.“Nakuba imininingwane egcwele mayelana nokubulawa kwakhe kade ingakacaci kodwa kubukeka sengathi ababulali bebecashe egcekeni likamufi base beyamdubula amahlandla amaningi ngesikhathi efika kwakhe ephuma emhlanganweni wegatsha. I-ANC inxusa izinhlaka zezokuphepha ukuba ziphenye kabanzi ngokubulawa kukaNxumalo,” kusho uNtuli..Uthe uNxumalo bazomkhumbula njengomuntu obewuthanda umphakathi, ewuvikela nasezigebengwini.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Vishnu Naidoo uthe ukhona owesilisa odutshuliwe washona ngesikhathi esegcekeni lakwakhe kodwa wathi ngeke akwazi ukukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubeyini emphakathini.“Amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala, okwamanje imbangela yokubulala ibingakaziwa bekungakaboshwa muntu,” kusho uNaidoo.

UNGOTI wezemfundo owaziwayo ngokugxeka uhulumeni angahlonizi ngokuhluleka ukufukula imfundo yakuleli uSolwazi Jonathan Jansen uthi uma uhulumeni ungase ugxile kakhulu emazingeni aphansi ezemfundo ngeke ibe khona inkinga yezinkumbi zabafundi abashiya phakathi ukufunda bengafinyelelanga kwa-matric.UJansen ozinze eNyuvesi yaseStellenbosch oke waba ngumphathi weNyuvesi yaseFree State, ukhwele wadilika kuhulumeni ngokuthi akayikhathalele imfundo ngoba izingane zosopolitiki zifunda ezikoleni ezingcono.“Ukuze uhulumeni alungise inkinga yezemfundo kuleli, kumele kugxilwe emazingeni aphansi ikakhulu ezinkulisa (Grade R). Akungagxilwa emazingeni aphezulu ikakhulu emanyuvesi,” kusho uJansen ekhuluma engqungqutheleni yenyunyana yothisha iNaptosa eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu.Uthe izinto zimapeketwane kwezemfundo yingakho abafundi abawuhhafu wesigidi bengafinyeleli kwa-matric beshiya phakathi izifundo.Usho lokhu nje izinyunyana zothisha zihlale zikhala ngokuthi kumele kuqiniswe emazingeni aphansi ikakhulu uGrade R njengoba othisha bakhona bengaqashiwe ngokugcwele. Imfundo ethathwa njengebalulekile iqala kwaGrade 1.Uthe kukhulu ukwehlukana kwezemfundo njengoba izingane zabacebile zithola engcono.Unxuse othisha ukuthi bangalindeli uhulumeni ukuthi afukule imfundo kodwa babhukule bazenzele.“Ningalindeli uhulumeni ngoba ayikho into azoyenza ngoba izingane zongqongqoshe zifunda ezikoleni ezikahle. Sukumani nenzele izingane zabahlwempu ezidonsa kanzima.”Ukhale kakhulu ngenye yezinyunyana angayidalulanga ukuthi uma iteleka ayifuni kuvalwe izikole zabamhlophe ngoba yilapho kufunda khona izingane zamalungu ayo.Uthe ucwaningo luyaveza ukuthi umfundi ofunde esikoleni esinayo yonke into, noma lezo ezazaziwa njengazabamhlophe kuba negebe uma umqhathanisa nalabo abafunde ezikoleni zabamnyama wathi leli gebe alibe lisavaleka kuze kuphele iminyaka engu-12 yokufunda.Ugqugquzele ukuthi kufundelwe abafundi nezingane izincwadi wancoma nothisha bokufika ukuthi bayawazi umsebenzi wabo.UMnuz Basil Manuel, isikhulu seNaptosa sikhale kakhulu ngokuthi kunenkinga kwiMaths njengoba abafundi beyifeyila.Uthe izinga lokuphasa lesi sifundo liphansi wathi noma bedlulela kwamanye amabanga aphezulu isimo siba sibi kakhulu.UNksz Thirona Moodley, isikhulu sale nyunyana kulesi sifundazwe, uxwayise othisha ukuthi bangabacwasi abafundi noma bafake imizwa yabo uma befundisa.Ukhulume ngesehlakalo sikathisha osulile waseWestville Girls High, osolwa ngokubiza abafundi abamnyama ngegama lokubacwasa eliqala ngo-K.

source: umalema usole uramaphosa ngokuba nolimi olumbhaxambili
text: UMHOLI we-Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), uMnuz Julius Malema usefunge wagomela ukuthi abalandeli baleli qembu bazoqhubeka nokudla umhlaba ongasebenzi njengendlela yokuqinisa ingcindezi kuhulumeni ukuthi abuyisele umhlaba kubantu boHlanga kuleli.UMalema uxwayise uhulumeni ngokuthi intsha yakuleli izizwa inganakiwe selokhu kwaphuma uhulumeni wobandlululo, kwabekwa owentando yeningi ngo-1994.Udaba lomhlaba cishe ngoluhamba phambili ngaphambi kokhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo.“Njengamanje kunesizukulwane esisha esiphelelwa ukubekezela,” kusho uMalema ekhuluma ne-AFP.Babalelwa ku-28% abantu abangasebenzi kuleli kanti kwezinye izindawo intsha engasebenzi ibalelwa ngaphezulu kuka-50%.“I-EFF isungulwe ngesikhathi esihle ngoba siyakwazi ukusebenzisa intshisekelo yalesi sizukulwane ukuthi siqinise umzabalazo womnotho. I-EFF yazisa abantu ukuthi indlela yokuthola umhlaba, wukudla umhlaba ongasetshenziswa ukuze sizofakela uhulumeni ingcindezi, futhi sesibonile ukuthi kuyasebenza lokho. Manje uhulumeni nabaphethe umhlaba sebethi ‘mhlawumbe kumele senze okuthile’.UMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa wamemezela ukuthi uhulumeni uzobheka izindlela zokuguqula umthethosisekelo ukuze kudliwe umhlaba ngaphandle kokunxephezela. Lezi zindaba zathakaselwa abaningi, kodwa abanye bazwakalisa ungabazane ngokuthi lokhu kuzokwenzeka ngempela yini. URamaphosa kudingeke ukuthi aqinisekise abatshali zimali kuleli ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngendlela esemthethweni futhi ngeke kuthikameze umnotho wakuleli. Kamuva nje, uqinisekise uNdunankulu wase-United Kingdom, uNkk Theresa May, owazwakalisa ukuleseka uhlelo lokubuyiselwa komhlaba kubantu boHlanga kuleli. UMalema nokho uthe akamethembi uRamaphosa.“UCyril usho lokhu namhlanje, kusasa asho okunye, kuya ngokuthi ukhuluma kuphi. Thina asiguquki kwesikushoyo, baguquka njalo bona. I-EFF ilona qembu elisematheni eNingizimu Afrika namhlanje,” kuqhuba uMalema.UMalema uthe ePolokwane, lapho akhulela khona, sekudliwe inqwaba yomhlaba njengoba kunemindeni ebalelwa ngaphezulu kuka 3000 ehlezi kumhlaba umnikazi wawo ongowaseCanada.“Wabuya esefuna sixoxisane,” kuqhuba uMalema. Uthe ukudliwa komhlaba kuleli ngeke kuhambisane nodlame njengoba kwenzeka eZimbabwe.“Ngeke kube khona udlame ngoba ngicabanga ukuthi abanikazi bamapulazi abamhlophe bazimisele ngokubuyisela umhlaba kubantu abamnyama njengoba izingxoxo phakathi kwabo zisaqhubeka ngokuthi kuzomiswa kanjani ngodaba lomhlaba.”UMalema uthe umhlaba ungaphathwa abamhlophe nabamnyama uzoqala ube ngaphansi kukahulumeni bese uyacazwa phakathi kwabamhlophe nabamnyama.Uqhube waveza nokuthi akukho lula ukuthi abamhlophe bafudukele emazweni ase-Europe njengoba kunabanye asebezwakalise ukuthi bazothutha bahambe.“Ngo-1994 abantu babezitshela ukuthi abamhlophe bazoyifulathela iiNingizimu Afrika. Naba basakhona, bazoyaphi? Abamhlophe bakuleli abanemali bayahlupheka e-Europe. Bajwayele ukunakekelwa, abakwazi ukuzinakekela,” usho kanje.

source: imibono liyahamba itheku kukhongolose uma ungashintshi
text: Mhleli: Ngiyabonga ngokungipha isikhala ephephandabeni lakho. Ake ngibonge yize ngingazi ukuthi abaholi be-ANC eThekwini bafinyelele kanjani esinqumeni abasithathile. Umphakathi waKwaZulu-Natal uyayithanda i-ANC kodwa izinto eziningi ezenziwa wuKhongolose kulesi sifundazwe zenza umphakathi ubone kungafanele uzihlanganise nale nhlangano.Ngifunde ephephandabeni kuthiwa ubuholi be-ANC esifundeni iTheku bufuna ukuxoxa namalungu kaKhongolose akhetha ukuzimela okhethweni ngo-2016. Ake ngilungise lapha, bonke abazimela abakaze bawushiye uKhongolose yizinkinga nenkohlakalo okwenziwa ubuholi besifundazwe nobeTheku ezadala umphakathi uvele uthi abazimele nangempela kwenzeka. Ngenzela ukucacisa lokho. Okunye okumele sikukhulume wukuthi umphakathi omningi waseThekwini owalinyazwa ngokufunzwa amakhansela abaholi besifunda seTheku awujabulile.Namanje umphakathi usadiniwe. Ukukhuluma nabazimela ngeke kwenze mahluko. Nikwenza lokhu ngoba senifuna amavoti noma seniwuqala kabusha umbutho?Uma nilungisa amaphutha kumele nibize wonke amaqabane enawona kuqala ngoba umphakathi wazi wona la maqabane nina buholi besifunda anaziwa emphakathini. Naziwa ngemisebenzi yenu emibi yokufunza umphakathi amakhansela uma nihluleke ukuzithoba emphakathini ivoti ngo-2019 nango-2021 lizoya emakhanseleni azozimela futhi.Inkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo wukuthola ubulungu be-ANC emagatsheni. Kuyaqala lokhu akukaze kwenzeke. Selokhu kwangena lobu buholi ubulungu asibutholi. UNobhala wesifunda seTheku uMnuz Bheki Ntuli usikhomba konobhala emagatsheni. Njengoba onobhala kuyizingane zamakhansela sizobuthola kanjani ubulungu ngoba phela lezi zingane zivikela isinkwa zona ngobulungu? Kungani kumele kuthiwa asiye ehlathini sibhekile?Usho kanjani ukuthi angiye kumuntu ozohlezi engatholakali kodwa ngobusuku unikeza omama abathize ukuthi abayojoyinisa labo ababanike imixhaso kuphela? Miningi imikhuba ebuholini besifunda ngoba bunesandla kule nto eyenzeka. Uma beshayelwa izingcingo sengathi kabazi ngale nkinga kodwa emakhoneni bayahlangana nalaba bantu ababulala umbutho.Siwutholile umyalezo wokuthi emagatsheni aseThekwini wonke ngenyanga edlule bekujoyiniswa ubulungu. Umbuzo wami uthi ngaphambi kwalokho senihlanganile yini namaqabane wonke ama-ward nawachazela ngomyalezo? Njengoba sizokhipha imali yethu sizothemba kanjani ukuthi izokhokhelwa ngoba kade sasigileka sikhokhe bese siyakhishwa uma sekukhethwa ubuholi. Ngizokwenza isibonelo njengaku-ward 78 eMlaza lapho ikhansela lingusihlalo bese kuthi indodakazi yekhansela ibe ngunobhala bese indoda yalo iba kwiBEC. Kuyona leyo BEC kunezalukazi zaku-ward 84 ezinikwe ubulungu ku-ward 78 yini ezolunga?Lolu hlelo lokujoyinisa umphakathi kungani ningalwenzi ngenye indlela? Kungaphela isonto ubufakazi bungabuyile bokuthi ukhokhile nezimfanelo zakhe azithole njengoba zinjalo njengoba kunamakhansela eThekwini axosha noma akhela ababengahambisani nawo amatulo okuthi baxoshwe emisebenzini, kusalungiswa nalapho? Njengoba amalungu ekomiti ye-ward enikezwe umyalelo wokuthi alandele abantu abasebenzayo njengezinduna, kusemthethweni yini lokho baholi be-ANC? Kusemthethweni yini ukuthi ubulungu bethu buhlale ezikhwameni zamakhansela?Sengizovala laba bantu enabalaxaza ngo-2016 yibona abazokwenza ukuthi nikwazi ukungena emphakathini uma ningaxoxanga nabo, khohlwani baholi amavoti. Siyawuthanda impela uKhongolose kodwa uma niqhubeka nale nto yenu amagatsha amaningi azohamba kodwa ithuba lisekhona ngoba akumnandi ukubona iqabane elidala elazabalaza lingenabo ubulungu.Esinye isilwane okumele nibhekane naso yilesi okuthiwa wuhlu lwabazovotelwa ebuholini. Okukhishwa abantu abathandwa wumphakathi kuyona. Unobhala omusha wayichaza kahle sayizwa ukuthi isuke yenziwelani. Asithembe ngeke isenzeka. Unobhala, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, sesithembe wena nomfo kaZikalala ukuthi nizokwazi ukubuyisela uKhongolose ebantwini ngoba eyi uthando emphakathini bese luphelile kodwa nje ukuxolisa ngokuwufunza abantu abangaziwa kuyonisiza bese niyaqinisekisa ukuthi ngokulandelayo ngeke nisawuphinda. Niyobe nisebenzile. Nginifisela inhlanhla, sengathi konke okuhle ebenikucabanga ngombutho kungalunga baholi.Zamani KheswaEThekwini

KUNGENZEKA izifunda ezimbili ze-ANC ezingakabi nezingqungquthela zazo KwaZulu-Natal, okuyiMoses Mabhida neLower South Coast, zibe nazo ngemuva kokhetho lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo njengoba udlulile umnqamulajuqu obubekwe yisigungu sikazwelonke sale nhlangano obusekupheleni kuka-Agasti.Lokhu kushiwo nguNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu, okhulumela i-ANC esifundazweni, kulandela ukuthi ibe yimpumelelo ingqungquthela yaseHarry Gwala.Lesi sifunda sibe sematheni kubulawa abaholi abaningi, okubalwa kubona noMnuz Sindiso Magaqa, owake waba nguNobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League.Kule ngqungquthela kukhethwe umngani kaMagaqa esikhundleni sikamgcinimafa walesi sifunda, uMnuz Les Stuta, owageqa amagula ngokufa kwalo mholi ngesikhathi kunomngcwabo wakhe.UNkk Simelane-Zulu uthe konke kulele esigungwini sikazwelonke ngokuthi ngabe sizolivula yini elinye ithuba lokuthi kube nezingqungquthela.“Umnqamulajuqu wokuhlalisa zonke izingqungquthela ubusekupheleni kuka-Agasti ngakho kulele esigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC ukuthi siphinde sihlangane sinqume ukuthi sizolivula yini elinye ithuba. Uma lingavulwa elinye ithuba okusho ukuthi izingqungquthela zizoze zibe ngemuva kokhetho,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Zulu.Mayelana nobuholi obukhethiwe eHarry Gwala, uthe unethemba lokuthi uzoqhubeka umsebenzi obese wenziwe kulesi sifunda wokusibumba.“Sibafisela inhlanhla abaholi abakhethiwe eHarry Gwala. Lobu buholi ngeke sibunike umthwalo ongaphezulu kwamandla. Sinethemba lokuthi luzoqhubeka ubumbano,” kusho uNkk Simelane-Zulu.Uthe ngesikhathi kuqala ingqungquthela yalesi sifunda bathola incwadi eyayivela kwabanganeme bethi bazoya enkantolo kodwa bagcina bengayanga.Mayelana nokubulawa kwabaholi kulesi sifunda uthe wubugebengu lobu wathi izinhlaka zikahulumeni zimatasa zilwa nalesi sihlava.

source: imibono savelelwa ekolishi lamaphoyisa olundi senziwa opopayi
text: MHLELI: Ngikhala ngiyazithulisa ngesandla sobulwane obenza kuvalwe ikolishi lamaphoyisa eThekwini osekwehlele kwelethu oLundi. Siphethwe kabi singothisha abaqeqesha izitshudeni ukuthi zibe abavikeli bomphakathi.Akusasebenzeki ngendlela ekolishi siphathiswa okwezilwane. Selokhu lavulwa ngo-2005 ikolishi angikaze ngiyibone le nto yokuthi abafundi batshele othisha ukuthi sizokwenza ukuthi nokuthi, okuthile ngeke sikwenze. Ngeke usho ukuthi sisekolishi lamaphoyisa.Kuyesabisa ngoba nokwaseChartsworth kwaqala kanje kwangangenelelwa kwaze kwaliwa kwavalwa ikolishi. Uma uthi uqeqesha isitshudeni siyaphendula sithi uTraining Manager wathi singakwenzi lokhu. Empeleni asisakwazi okumele sikwenze noma singakwenzi ngoba sekushintshwe izinto eziningi kodwa akukho okubhawe phansi ukuze sibone ukuthi sekusetshenzwa kanjani.Sisatshiswa ngokuboshwa uma senza esikwaziyo nesikujwayele.Ziphathiswa okwabantu basenkulisa. Singabaqeqeshi sazi ukuthi sifundisela into eyenzekayo. Esibaqeqeshayo bazophuma bayosebenza engasekho obatotosayo. Sicela ukusebenza sakhe iphoyisa elizosebenza ngaphandle ngoba asidlali ibhayisikobho la senzela ukuthi umuntu aphume azi ukuthi kusetshenzwa kanjani noma kunzima kumele ube nendlela yokusebenza.Sicela uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele angenelele ukuze sizosebenza kahle sikhiphe amaphoyisa awadingayo ekolishi lasoLundi, hhayi lawa azophuma abulale abathandiwe bawo nazochoma ngezibhamu ahlukumeze abantu. Sifuna ukwakha abavikeli bezwe.Magaye ngenelelaSAPS Olundi

ISEMATHENI indaba yokwebiwa kwezinwele zokufakelwa ezibizwa ngama-weave. Ukwanda kwalo mkhuba sekwenza ukuthi abesifazane abafake lezi zinwele bahambe bejeqeza besaba ukuhlwithwa zona. Ukubiza kwalezi zinwele ezinye okuthiwa zitholakala emazweni aphesheya, yikho okwenza nezigebengu zicuthele odade abazifakile.Kuvele nokuthi eminye imishwalense isinezinhlelo zokukhokhela abantshontshelwe izinwele. Ngokombiko wephephandaba elisesitebeleni esisodwa neSolezwe, iBusiness Report, kuvele ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokhela ukwebiwa kwezinwele lungaphansi kwebhizinisi lezobuhle kweminye imishwanelense.UNksz Natasha Kawulesar oyinhloko yezabathengi kwa-Outsurance utshele iBusiness Report ukuthi bayawakhokhela amakhasimende abo ngokwebiwa kwezinwele.Uthe babone kunesidingo sokuthi nezinwele zibe nomshwalense ngoba ziyabiza futhi ziyebiwa.Sibe sematheni nesigameko sokwebiwa kwezinwele zikaSbahle Mpisane osanda kulimala engozini yemoto. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi ingozi isanda kwenziwa kukhona owangena emotweni wadonsa izinwele wabaleka nazo.UNksz Thobile Ndlovu ongumnikazi we-Ethnic Hair eThekwini, uyavuma ukuthi ziyabiza izinwele. Uveze ukuthi ngenhlanhla ubengakavelelwa umshophi wokuntshontshelwa izinwele.“Abantu bayazi ukuthi izinwele ziyabiza yingakho sezebiwa kangaka. Elinye ikhasimende lami lisanda kuhlwithwa izinwele ezibiza kakhulu. Beliphethe isikhwama kodwa abafana basiyeka bahlwitha izinwele kuphela.”Phezu kwalokhu kwebiwa kwalezi zinwele, uNksz Ndlovu uthe abesifazane abapheli mandla. “Abesifazane abanqeni ukukhipha noma imalini ngezinwele. Ezibiza kancane kunazo zonke zinguR2 400 futhi zimfishane.”Uthe okwenza abesifazane bathande lezi zinwele ukuthi kulula ukuzifaka futhi zihlala isikhathi eside.Idumela lokudayiswa kwezinwele selibonakala nangokuthi babe baningi abazithungela emgwaqweni emadolobheni, bazidayisele abadlulayo.UNkk Getrude Uche ongumcwali wezinwele uthe usedla kakhulu ngokuthunga izinwele ngoba amakhasimende amaningi asefuna zona. Akuqali ukuthi kube nomkhuba wokwebiwa kwezinwele kuleli. Ngesikhathi kusadume ukuluka ama-dreadlocks, izigebengu bezibagunda abanawo, ziwadayise.

BASAZOBOSHWA abazotholakala nensangu emakhaya abo yize kuleli sonto kube nenhlokomo kwabaningi bejabulela isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ethe ngeke kusaba yicala ukutholakala nensangu ekhaya, inqobo nje uma ungayidayisi.Yize abantu bakuleli becabanga ukuthi selokhu kuphume isinqumo, sebengenza noma yini ngensangu ekhaya, izazi zithi inkantolo ikubeke kwacaca ukuthi umthetho ovuna insangu uyoze usebenze eminyakeni emibili ezayo.Njengamanje uhulumeni usanikwe isikhathi sokuthi uqhamuke nomhlahlandlela oqondile ngalokhu. Abenkolo yamaRasta eThekwini batshele leli phephandaba ukuthi banokudideka ngalo mthetho njengoba bona khona kuleli sonto, beshaywe ngamaphoyisa abathole nensangu besekhaya.Bakhala nangokuthi selokhu kuphume isinqumo, amaphoyisa anabo shaqa ngensangu, abasaqondi ukuthi kanti lesi sinqumo besithini.UMnuz Shaun Sprinks (32) waseMbilo uthi: “Sifuna ukukhululeka sibheme njengabo bonke abantu ababhema iluzi. Izolo nakuthangi amaphoyisa afike asisesha asiphatha kabi."Kukhona abafowethu abashayiwe ngoba baficwe bebhema ngemuva kwelinye ibhilidi elingasebenzi."Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi lo mthetho uphasiselweni ngoba awusisizi ngalutho thina."UMnuz Quinton Ndondo (27) uthi bakhathele ukubhema ngokuntshontsha ekubeni nohulumeni useyabona ukuthi ayikho ingozi ehambisana nensangu.“Angazi kungani ezitolo ufica lezi zinhlobo sikagwayi abahlala bekhala ngazo odokotela ukuthi ziyagulisa."Mina yangisiza insangu ngigula ngikhwehlela kubuhlungu nesifuba. Ngaqala ukuyibhema, kwaphela amasonto amabili wangiyeka umkhuhlane ngangabe ngisakhwehlela,” kusho uNdondo.UMnuz Shaun Magoranga (28) ohlala eChatsworth uthi kuyabajabulisa ukuthi nohulumeni useyasibona isidingo sensangu kodwa kumele abakhulule ngokugcwele.“Insangu iyikhambi. Kuningi abantu abangasizakala ngakho ensangwini.Kodwa asifuni ukulokhu siyibhema ngokuyintshontsha kanje ngoba seyiphasisiwe."Ayifane nabanye ogwayi itholakale nasezitolo,” kusho uMagoranga.Yize la marasta ecabanga ukuthi lo wumthetho ophasiswe wuhulumeni, kodwa uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa kuleli uMnuz Bheki Cele, kuleli sonto uthe yena ukube bekufunwe uvo lwakhe ngensangu, ubezothi ayingalinge nje ibe semthethweni.Nokho akusekho ezandleni zikaCele njengoba inkantolo isikhulumile.Osekusele wukuthi uhulumeni aqhamuke nento eqondile ngokuthi yinsangu engakanani umuntu angeke aboshwe uma itholakalakuye.

KUKHISHWE incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kukaBonang Matheba enkantolo ebhekene namacala athinta imali eGoli ngemuva kokuthi lo saziwayo ehlulekile ukuvela kuyo ngecala lokukhwabanisa izolo.UBonang akekho kuleli njengoba eseNew York lapho kuqhubeka khona umhlangano weNhlangano yeZizwe. Ubephethe uhlelo lwengxoxo ebizwa nge Leave No Girl Behind, obekudingidwa udaba lokuthuthukisa abesifazane emhlabeni.Kusasa uzobe ethamele ikhonsathi iGlobal Citizen Festival khona eNew York, okuyikhonsathi azophatha uhlelo lwayo uma isikuleli ngoDisemba 2.Umshushisi, uDuduzile Robertse, uthe waziswa ngecala ngoSepthemba 10 futhi isimemo sokuya e-United States wasithola ngoSepthemba 17.Uthe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwakhe izosetshenziswa ngo-Okthoba 4, okusho ukuthi uma uBonang ehluleka ukuvela enkantolo ngalelo langa, uzoboshwa.UBonang uthweswe icala lokungayikhokhi intela yakhe phakathi kuka-2008 no-2017 neyebhizinisi phakathi kuka-2014 no-2017. Imali ayikweletayo ayidalulwanga.Abazali bakaBonang bebekhona enkantolo.Ummeli wakhe uCharl Coetzee, uthe uBonang useNew York kwiNhlangano yeZizwe futhi uzothamela ikhonsathi ngoMgqibelo.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi nakanjani uBonang uzobe ekhona enkantolo ngo-Okthoba 4.Uthe ngesikhathi ethunyelelwa amasamanisi ngoSepthemba 10 wayeseNew York emcimbini iNew York Fashion Week.Okhulumela uphiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi, uPhindi Mjonondwane, uthe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa isho ukuthi izobanjwa kuze kube wu-Okthoba 4 ngenxa yokuthi amasamanisi awanikezwanga uBonang siqu sakhe.“Uma ehluleka ukuvela ngomhlaka-4, izobe isisebenza. Ufana nawo wonke umuntu futhi ngeke aphathwe ngendlela ekhethekile,” kusho uMjonondwane.NgoLwesithathu umlingisi weGenerations: The Legacy, uRapulana Seiphemo, naye ubevele enkantolo efanayo ngamacala athinta ukungayikhokhi intela.African News Agency

MHLELI: Kwelakho eliwela umfula ugcwele ake ngibonge umfo kaNgobe esaphila. Uyisibonelo esihle uTshatha Ngobe kwabasakhula nakubasakazi boKhozi FM. Umfo kaNgobe uyasazisa isiZulu futhi ungomunye wabantu ongancela ulwazi oluningi kuyena ngezithinta izindaba zakwaZulu noma ezazenzeka kudala.Lo msakazi angakushayela izibongo zamakhosi ake aphatha kwaZulu kube sengathi uzifunda phansi. Kwesinye isikhathi kuke kuthi uma exoxa ngomlando wakwaZulu nangezimpi zakudala kuvele kube sengathi wayekhona kwenzeka lokho.Ukuzwa umuntu osemsakazweni ezazi ukuthi uphuma kuphi kwenza nabanye abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme bawuhalele umlando wakithi ngoba phela cha wona umnandi. Yize-ke okhokho nomkhulu baphangalala ngaleso sikhathi kodwa uma uxoxwa kuvuka uhlevane uzizwe ungumZulu wangempela. Isizukulwane sanamuhla sazi ukuthi uma saze nje ukuthi ubani uyise, mhlawumbe-ke nomkhulu, kuphelile kanti cha bakwethu ayikho into emnandi njengokusho uyihlo okuzalayo uma uqeda ngaye uye kumkhulu wakho uqhubeke njalonjalo nokubabongela kuze kufike kokhokho ongenalo ulwazi oluningi ngabo.Njengoba kuyinyanga yamagugu, intsha esakhula njengathi kuningi engakuncela kumfo kaNgobe uma engase ageqe amagula ngezindaba zakithi. Okunye ngaye, nakuba ngingakaze ngihlangane naye kodwa uzwakala engumuntu ongazithwele nobazisayo abanye abantu. Angizogxila-ke kakhulu lapho ngoba ngike ngasho ukuthi angikaze ngimbone ngamehlo.Sengiphetha, kuhle sikubone ukubaluleka komuntu esaphila kungathi uma eseshonile usizwe sesikhala kakhulu sithi “hheyi wayewazisa umlando wakwaZulu uTshatha”.Ukwazi ngomlando wakithi ngeke kwasusa ubuchule kumuntu futhi ngeke kumphazamise kwenze ukuthi angabe esalukhuluma ulimi lwesiNgisi abanye abalukhonze kakhulu.Jabulani Pho MadlalaEGreytown

BAHLALELE ovalweni othisha baseWiggins Secondary, eMayville, ngemuva kokushiswa kwamahhovisi abo, kwasha izincwadi nempahla yesikole kwanqanyulwa namapayipi amanzi okusolwa abantu abafuna ukudla umhlaba wesikole okungakhiwe kuwona.Lokhu sekwenze isikole sacela amaphoyisa ukuthi azulazule ngaphandle kwaso njengoba kuthiwa kunabasabisile ngokuthi bazobuya bazongqongqisa nezimoto zothisha ngoba banenkani bagweve nendawo.Kuthiwa kufike abantu ababalelwa ku-50 izolo ezintatha kukhona onogada ababili bafike baphihliza ihhovisi lothisha bashisa izincwadi basuka bahamba.Uthishanhloko uNkk Mamotsau Sithole, uthe uphuthume esikoleni khona ezintatha ngemuva kokubikelwa ukuthi kuyasha.Uthe ufike kushiswe ihhovisi lothisha, kwasha izincwadi nomsebenzi wabafundi nowothisha.“Amanzi asinawo nje, basike amapayipi, amathoyilethi awasebenzi. Kushe nokudla obekuthengiwe, izihlalo namatafula okusha sha. Othisha bayasaba ngoba kunabantu abasonga ngokuthi bazobuya bazoshisa izimoto,” kusho uNkk Sithole.Uthe okubuhlungu wukusha komsebenzi wabafundi okumele baqale phansi bawuqoqe.“Sizoncenga abafundi ukuthi baphinde babhale. Kushe umsebenzi wonyaka wonke wezingane. Nanyakenye kwantshontshwa amakhompyutha kwadingeka siqale phansi umsebenzi. umonakalo owenzekile ungaphezulu kukaR50 000.”Uthe amapayipi amanzi bebesanda kuwalungisa kuleli sonto bekade befike esikiwe.Uqhube wathi bancenge abafundi ukuthi babhale izivivinyo ezandulela ezokugcina njengoba izolo bekubhalwa i-English.Lesi sikole singesinye sezikole ezenza kahle njengoba nyakenye sithole u-99% kwa-matric.“Kulo nyaka besifuna u-100% asazi uma sekwenzeke kanje ukuthi kusazokwenzeka yini. Asibazi laba bantu abenza nje ngoba abakaze beze kuthina.”Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe umphakathi akumele udubele ezikoleni uma ufuna izidingo.“Asisazakhi izikole ezishiswe wumphakathi. Umphakathi uzozibonela ukuthi uzosakha kanjani ngoba siyisidingongqangi. Siyasigxeka lesi senzo ngoba senzeke sekusele inyanga ngaphambi kokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-matric,” kusho uMthethwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuphenywa icala lokucekela phansi impahla elivulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa iCato Manor.Uthe ezintatha zayizolo amalungu omphakathi avale umgwaqo iDunbar ekhala ngokushoda kwezidingo.“Abe eseya esikoleni iWiggins Secondary afike aphihliza amawindi, akukaboshwa muntu.”
