LUYASHUBA udaba lokushona kwesiguli emtholampilo eMzinto, njengoba kuthiwa unesi osolwa ngokungasinaki usenxuswe ukuba asule emsebenzini.Isolezwe lithole ngenhlangano iNurses Forum ukuthi ucelwe ngabaphathi bakhe ukuthi asule unesi wasePhungashe Clinic osolwa ngokuba budedengu okuholele ekushoneni kukaNksz Thobile Phungula (26). Lesi sigameko esenzeke ngoSepthemba 6 sithukuthelise umndeni kamufi, osola ubudedengu ngaso. Kuthiwa umufi wayelethwe emtholampilo ngo-2 ntambama, washona ngabo 10 ebusuku elinde i-ambulensi.UMnuz Bhekithemba Gumbi onguSihlalo weNurses Forum, uthe ngeke bavume ukuthi asule emsebenzini lo nesi ngoba akanacala.“Isiguli sasingaxinekile kodwa ukugula bekuhlasela iziqubu. Unesi wakwenza okwakufanele, kwashaya isikhathi sokuvala umtholampilo ntambama, wagoduka. Wabuyela emtholampilo ukuzobheka isiguli, waphinde washayela ucingo i-ambulensi. Lezi zindaba ezinjena ziqhatha onesi nomphakathi ekubeni kumele kugxekwe ukuphuza kokufika kwe-ambulensi,” echaza.Uthe sebezwile ukuthi uMnyango wezeMpilo uyaphenya, yingakho nabaphathi bamanesi bethe akasule ngoba udaba lwakhe lubucayi. UGumbi uthe bazomeseka unesi futhi bazoluhlonipha uphenyo. Ugxeke uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango onguMholi weDA esifundazweni obekhona emngcwabeni kaNksz Phungula, ogxeke onesi ngesenzo sabo.“Ngeke siphike ukuthi kunezinkinga emnyangweni ngoba onesi bayashoda. Abaholi abanjengoMncwango akumele bagxeke abasebenzi kodwa kumele baqinise ekutheni kulungiswe isimo emnyangweni, bezwe nezinkinga zabasebenzi,” kusho uGumbi.UNobhala wenyunyana yonesi iDenosa eKZN uMnuz Mandla Shabangu, uthe sebekhulumile nonesi. Uthe ngeke baqophisane nosopolitiki kodwa bazolinda umnyango, bayomela unesi.Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana onesi abaningi bagxeke uMncwango ngokugxambukela, basabisa nangokumashela emahhovisi eDA.UMncwango uthe uzwile ngokugxekwa kwakhe kodwa usamile ekutheni kumele baphenywe abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi ekubeni bephethe impilo yabantu. Uthe ulwethulile udaba kuNgqongqoshe uDkt Sbongiseni Dhlomo nasesiShayamthetho.UNksz Ncumisa Mafunda okhulumela umnyango uthe sebeqalile ukucubungula lolu daba futhi bazothatha izinyathelo ezifanele.Uyise kamufi uMnuz Mthethiswa Phungula uthe bathole ucingo kwabomnyango bebatshela ukuthi bayaphenya. Uthe kuke kwafika kabili abaphathi basemtholampilo bezobasayinisa kodwa wanqaba ngoba usola ukuthi bafuna ukushintsha isitatimende.UPhungula uthe umufi owayenenkinga yokuphefumula, washona emgade nonogada, onesi bengamnakile bekwelinye igumbi.

NJENGOBA namhlanje kuqala inyanga yokuqhakambisa amagugu eNingizimu Afrika, ongoti bathi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu bakuleli abagcina amasiko athile bawenze ngendlela efanele, basiyeke kancane isilungu esesidla lubi uma kwenziwa le micimbi.Bathi kuningi nokubhimbiswa kwezinto osekubonakala, okwenza ukuthi abasuke begcinelwa leyo midanti babe nezinkinga ngoba isiko lingagcinwanga kahle.Ungoti wamasiko KwaZulu-Natal, uDkt Nomagugu Ngobese, uthe abantu ake bayeke ukusebenzisa imali eningi benza imicimbi yesintu bayihlanganise nesilungu.“Imicimbi yesintu akumele yenziwe njengeyesilungu ngoba abantu bedlalisa imali. Kunemcimbi okungamele intombazane ize ikhule ingenzelwanga yona ekhaya.Umhlonyane, umemulo, umkhehlo nokugcagca ngezinye zezinto okumele zenziwe ngendlela ukuze izinto zilunge.Nokho le eqondene nomendo bangeke benzele wonke amantombazane ekhaya ngoba awagani wonke,”kusho uDkt Ngobese.Eqhuba uthe kuyihlazo ukuthi kunemizi egcina ixuba umemulo nephathi. Lezi zinto uthe azihlangani nhlobo.“Kuyenzeka eminye imizi ithenge notshwala, umuntu anikezwe nokhiye kade emula emini.“Ihlazo lelo. Iphathi nokhiye yisiko labelungu. Akumele lihlanganiswe nomemulo. Uma umzali ethanda nokwenza iphathi akakhethe olunye usuku,”kusho uDkt Nomagugu.Nazi ezinye izinto uDkt Ngobese athi abantu kumele bazenze ngendlela okuyiyo:Umhlonyana:-Lesi yisigaba sokuqala ngqa sengane yentombazane esuke isithombile.Ihlatshelwa imbuzo, igongqe uma iqala ukuya esikhathini.Kulowo mgongqo isuke inikwa iziyalo ngoshintsho olusuke luzoba khona ngomzimba wayo njengoba isithombile nje.Ngenxa yokuthi yonke into idinga imali, kuyenzeka ukuthi abazali bangakwazi ukuyenzela ngaleso sikhathi ikade iqala ukuya esikhathini.Uma sekwenziwa umcimbi, intombazane ihlala nontanga bayo begcobe ibomvu, okuwuphawu lokugongqa. Abafana abavunyelwe ukusondela kulowo mgongqo.Umemulo:-Umemulo kusuke sekuyisigaba sesibili lapho ingane yentombazane seyikhulile yahamba phezu kweziyalo eyazinikwa ngabazali ngesikhathi yenzelwe umhlonyane.Uyise wayo usuke esebonga ukuziphatha kahle kwayo eyikhulisa phambi kwabantu.Endulo ngenxa yokuthi bekungafundwa kungasetshenzwa, owesifazane ubethi uma enzelwa lo mcimbi kube yindlela yokumnika imvume yokuthi usengakhethwa yinsizwa ayiqome noma agane.Umkhehlo:-Intombi isuke seyidlulile kulezi zigaba ezingenhla yaze yaqoma yagana. Uyise usuke eseyikhehlisa ngoba isuke isilungela ukuyogana komunye umuzi.Endulo lokhu bekwenziwa nangokuthi owesifazane enziwe uhlobo oluthile lwesitayela sasekhanda, esihlobe ngezinto ezahlukene.Lo mhlobiso wasekhanda ubuwenziwa abesifazane ababizwa ngokuthi yizinyanga zekhanda ebezikwazi ukwenza isitayela sasekhanda esihlukanisa owesifazane oseganile ezintombini.Esikhathini samanje lokhu sekwenziwa ngezicholo zesimanje ezihlobe ngezimpaphe, ubuhlalu nezinkinobho.Umgcagco-Usuke usulandela konke lokhu okungenhla, lapho intombi isuke isiphuma ekhaya seyiyohlala emzini ngokusemthethweni.Esikhathini samanje kwenziwa ngendlela ehlukile neyakudala njengoba sekuthengwa nezimpahla zasendlini nezitsha nemiswenko ngenxa yezinga lempilo esiphilwa.

OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezokuXhumana, uNksz Faith Muthambi usole ibamba likaMqondisi Jikelele eMnyangweni wezokuXhumana, uNkk Phumla Williams, ngokuhubhuza amanga aluhlaza ngaye ngesikhathi lifakaza kwiKhomishini ephenya ngokugwamandwa kwamandla ombuso ngoMsombuluko.KuleKhomishini ephethwe iphini likaMengameli wamaJaji uRaymond Zondo, uNkk Williams ukhulume ngobuhlungu ayebuzwa ngaphansi kobuholi bukaNksz Muthambi, nokwaholela ekutheni abe nokhwantalala.Uthe impatho kaNksz Muthambi yamkhumbuza ukuhlukumezeka adlula kukho ngesikhathi eyisishoshovu se-ANC ngeminyaka yobandlululo kuleli.Uthe okwamphatha kabi kakhulu ngalokhu ukuthi uZuma wayazi ngendlela uMuthambi ayemphatha ngayo kodwa wangamthathela izinyathelo.Kwisitatimende asikhiphe ngoLwesibili ekuseni uNksz Muthambi uthe, uNksz Williams uhubhuza amanga ngabekusho efakaza phambi kweKhomishini.“Ngisalulekwa abammeli bami ngamampunge abethulwa uNksz Williams phambi kwekhomishini. Kuzovela elinye iqiniso futhi uzombuleka izinqe kubuka wonke umuntu,” kusho uNksz Muthambi esitatimendeni.FUNDA:Usole uZuma ngokuvikela uMuthambiUqhube wathi inkulumo kaNkk Williams ifake ungabazane ngobuqiniso beKhomishini eqhubekayo.“UNksz Phumla Williams uwumuntu onamanga kunabo bonke abantu esengike ngabazi,” kusho uNksz Muthambi.UNkk Williams ngoMsombuluko usole uNksz Muthambi ngokungena emnyangweni wezokuxhumana ngezinhloso zokuzokhwabanisa futhi wayevikelwa uZuma.“Ngicabanga ukuthi uZuma wayemvikela uNksz Muthambi, angazi ukuthi kungani ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona imisebeni abayisusa kumina, bebezenzela umathanda lapha, bayazi ukuthi bengingeke ngiyivume lento abebeyenza yingakho banginqinda amandla," kusho uNkk Williams.

BAVEZE imibono eyehlukene abahlaziyi bezepolitiki mayelana nomhlangano wabaholi abathile be-ANC okubalwa nobengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma lapho kuthiwa bekuboshwa kuwo uzungu lokuketula uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Iphephandaba lesiNgisi langeSonto libike ukuthi uZuma, uNobhala-jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Ace Magashule, obenguNdunankulu aphinde abe nguSihlalo we-ANC eNorth West, uMnuz Supra Mahumapelo, uNobhala we-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, noNkk Meokgo Matuba we-ANCWL nabanye bahlangane eMaharani Hotel, eThekwini. Iphephandaba lize laveza nesithombe esikhombisa laba baholi bekuleli hotela.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Ralph Mathekga, uthe izinsolo ziyinto ekhona. Lokhu kufakazelwa wukuthi i-ANC ikhiphe izincazelo eziningi ezehlukene ngazo.“Ukuthi umhlangano waba khona noma cha kukhombisa ukuthi ngaphakathi kwi-ANC bakhona abahlela ukuketula umengameli,” kusho uMathekga.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Xolani Dube, ongumcwaningi kwisikhungo iXubera Institute uthe akekho ozokwazi ukuthi bekukhulunywani emhlanganweni kuze kube omunye wabo uphula umgomo wokugcina imfihlo uphumela obala uyasho ukuthi bekukhulunywa ngani.“Iqiniso wukuthi umhlangano ube khona kodwa akekho owaziyo ukuthi bekukhulunywa ngani kuwo,” kusho uDube.Uthe yena akaboni ukuthi le ndaba yomhlangano ingaze isuse umsindo.Ugxeke uSabelo ngokuphumela obala azame ukuziqhelelanisa nezinsolo.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe okwamanje kunzima ukusho ukuthi izinsolo ziyinto ekhona yini noma engekho. “NgesiZulu kuyaye kuthiwe ungayibambi isavele ngekhanda kodwa okukhulu kunakho konke wukuthi kwi-ANC akukho ukuthembana. Imihlangano ingenye yezindlela zepolitiki kodwa ngenxa yokuthi akukho ukwethembana sekuvela izinsolo ezifana nalezi,” kusho uKhumalo.Ebuzwa ukuthi ngakube izinsolo aziwulimazi yini umkhankaso kaSabelo ogaqele isikhundla sokuba ngumengameli we-ANCYL, uKhumalo uthe ziwushaye phansi ikakhulukazi njengoba imiphumela yezingqungquthela kwi-ANC igqugquzelwa yizimbangi.“Naye uyabona ukuthi izinsolo ziyamlimaza yingakho komunye umthombo wezindaba ethe ufisa kwenziwe uphenyo ukuze kuvele iqiniso,” kusho uKhumalo.Ilungu lesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC, uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, lithe abazi lutho ngomhlangano ngoba kwakungesiwo owe-ANC.“i-ANC ayikaze ibe nomhlangano, kukubona abantu okuthiwa babesemhlanganweni ukuthi basho ukuthi babekhuluma ngani,” kusho uKodwa.Ushaye phansi ngonyawo wathi akekho umuntu ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwi-ANC ongaguqula izinqumo ezathathwa eNasrec.

KUMISWE umsakazi wesiteshi somphakathi sasoLundi, iNguna 89.0 FM, kulandela ukuthengela ozakwabo besifazane ikhekhe ngo-Agasti 9. U-Agreement Zulu, owenza uhlelo lwasekuseni iSesifikile Breakfast Show nolukamaskandi ngoMgqibelo, kuthiwa wahlanganisa abasakazi besifazane wabathengela ikhekhe.Umthombo uthe okwadina abaphathi wukuthi abasakazi babemncoma emoyeni. Ebuzwa i-Agreement uphikile ukuthi umisiwe.“Ngizobuyela noma yinini emoyeni uma sengithanda.”Uthi usazogeqa amagula ngalolu daba. Umphathisiteshi uMfu Hebert Mncube uthe umisiwe uZulu kodwa wacela kuthintwe umphathi wezinhlelo kulesi siteshi, uMandla ‘Big Show’ Dumakude.UDumakude uphikile ukuthi uZulu umiselwe ukuthengela abasakazi ikhekhe. Uthe nalokho kuyingxenye yamaphutha.Uthe bese kungokwesibili uZulu ephambana nemigomo yesiteshi.“Saqala samkhuza ehlela i-gala dinner ngaphandle kokwazisa abaphathi. Waphinda wenza umcimbi wabesifazane, basebenzisa nomoya bengagunyaziwe. Sezwa sekunomsindo emoyeni, kukhuluma noma wubani.Waya eThekwini, wathi uhambisa ingane akazobakhona, ngathi uma ngibuza ukuthi uhlelile yini nomuntu ozombambela, wavele wavala ucingo.”Uthe wathi ebona kungafiki muntu ozombambela wafaka umuntu ozombambela ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo sokummisa uZulu.“Sathi sisammisile sashayelwa ucingo inyanga yaseHluhluwe okuthiwa uDlamini, ikhala ngokuthi yathenga isikhathi ohlelweni lukamaskandi kodwa iyathuka engasazwakali emoyeni uZulu. UDlamini wathi wakhokha uR2 000 kuZulu ukuze akhangise ngemithi yakhe. Ngabuza umphathisiteshi nowezikhangiso ukuthi kukhona yini isivumelwano abasaziyo esenziwa noDlamini.”UDumakude uthe uyakhumbula ezwa uDlamini ekhuluma emoyeni kodwa wazitshela ukuthi umculi kamaskandi kanti akunjalo.“Ngathi uma ngimtshela ngalokhu uZulu, wangigibela ngenhlamba, wangibiza ngenkabi engumantindane kaMncube. Wathi kukhona azongenza khona.”UDumakude uthe uxhumene namaphoyisa ngezinsongo zikaZulu kodwa uZulu uyaphika. Kunabalaleli azwakalise ukungenami ngokumiswa kukaZulu.

source: uza kahle umkhankaso we ifp wensangu
text: UBUKEKA uthela izithelo ezinhle umkhankaso we-IFP wokuthi uhulumeni avume ukutshalwa kwensangu ezosetshenziselwa ukulapha abantu.NgoLwesithathu, uSotswebhu we-IFP ePhalamende, uMnuz Narend Singh, ubuze uNgqongqoshe wezoLimo, amaHlathi nokuDoba, uMnuz Senzeni Zokwana, ukuthi ngabe useyithintile yini iminyango efanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uphasisa ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukulapha izifo ezithile.UZokwana uthe bamatasa nezingxoxo ezizoqinisekisa ukutshalwa kwensangu ukuze ilaphe izifo ezithile kulandelwa umthetho.“Umthetho othinta ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukulapha izifo ubhekelelwe nguMnyango wezeMpilo nowezoBulungiswa ngokomthetho wemithi wango-1965. Siyithintile le minyango nowezoHwebo neziMboni namaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutshalwa kwensangu ngeke kuphule imithetho ethile,” kusho uZokwana.Uthe ucwaningo olwenziwayo lokuthi izokwazi yini ukusebenziseka njengomuthi nokuthi izothengwa ngabantu abangaki luhamba kahle.“Njengamanje umnyango wethu nowezempilo umatasa ubheka imithetho yokulawula ukutshalwa kwensangu nemikhiqizo ezokwenziwa ngayo,” kusho uZokwana.Uthe bayitshelile iminyango ethintekayo ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi insangu ibhekwe ngeso lokwelapha. Basalinde izimpendulo.USingh uthe bazolinda izimpendulo zeminyango ethintekayo njengoba kusathuthukiswa umthetho ozosebenza uma sekudayiswa insangu ezosetshenziselwa ukwelapha.“Sikholwa wukuthi insangu ezosetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo ezithile ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nasekudaleni amathuba omsebenzi. Ucwaningo lwethu luveza ukuthi umnotho uzohlomula kakhulu ngalolu hlelo. Kufanele iminyango ethintekayo iluphuthume lolu hlelo ngoba luza nenqwaba yamathuba omsebenzi nempilo engcono kubantu,” kusho uSingh.I-IFP ifake lesi sicelo ngoba iqhubeka ezinyathelweni zelungu layo eselashona uMnuz Mario Ambrosini owaphakamise ukuthi uhulumeni avumele ukusetshenziswa kwensangu ukuthi ilaphe ezinye izifo. U-Ambrosini owazibulala wayenomdlavuza.kanti waphoqeleka ukuthi aye phesheya lapho babemnika amakhambi enziwe ngensangu ayepholisa izinhlungu. U-Ambrosini waphetha ngokuzibulala emzini wakhe oseWestern Cape.

KUQALILE ukusebenza ngoMsombuluko la kuqoshwa khona umdlalo Uzalo, njengoba kuvela izindaba zokuthi ithimba labaqophi nabalingisi akade bengakhokheliwe beyitholile imali yabo ngoMgqibelo.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi kume nse ukuqopha kwalo mdlalo ngoMsombuluko odlule ngemuva kokuthi ithimba eliqopha lo mdlalo livuke umbhejazane lathi liwabeka phansi amathuluzi njengoba lingaholile.Kulo mdlalo bekunezinkinga zezimali njengoba inkampani eqopha lo mdlalo iStained Glass, ibingenye yezinkampani ebezingakhokheliwe uSABC.UKoketso Phala okhulumela lo mdlalo uthe ngemuva kokuthi akade bengaholile bethole imiholo yabo baphindelile emsebenzini bayoqhubeka la begcine khona."Kuqalile namhlanje ukusebenza wonke umuntu ukhona emsebenzini. Imiholo ingenile ngoMgqibelo bonke base bazizwa ukuthi kusukela izolo sebengaqala kuzoqhutshekwa nomsebenzi," kuchaza yena.Abaqophi yibona abafike bamisa yonke into njengoba baveza ukuthi imali yabo ayingenile ngakho ngeke bakwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi.UNeo Momodu okhulumela iSABC, uthe basabhekene nezinkinga zezimali kodwa lokho abafuni kuphazamiseke abasebenzi babo nezinkampani abasebenza nazo."Ngeke sisho ukuthi ukukhokhelana kwezinkampani esisebenza nazo kuhamba kugcinephi uma sesikhokhelana lokho kuphakathi kwethu. Izinkinga zezimali zikhona futhi sisaqhubeka nokuxoxisana nezinye izinkampani ezingaphansi kwethu," kusho uNeo.Ithimba lalo mdlalo liphinde laveza ukuthi bese kusabalale amahebenzi okuthi kuzoba nenhlolokhono yokuthungatha abalingisi abasha nokuyinto engelona iqiniso.UMmamitse Thibedi onguphrojusa walo mdlalo uthe, inhlolokhono obekuthiwa ingoSepthemba 2, abayazi bona.“Uma kukhona esifuna ukukumemezela emphakathini okuthinta inhlolokhono noma yini sisebenzisa izinkundla zethu zokuxhumana bese sikhangisa naseziteshini zakwaSABC. Siyanxusa ukuthi abantu baqaphele uma kunezikhangiso ezifana nalezi," kuchaza yena.

source: akalali owabona kubulawa intombi yomzala wakhe
text: UBHEKENE nengcindezi umfundi kaGrade 11 waseBilanyoni, eDumbe owabona kubulawa intombi yomzala wakhe okuthiwa ukhala ngokuthi ubuthongo abusafiki ngenxa yesithombe sokugwazwa kwayo.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi umndeni namaphoyisa bedidekile ngokuthi kwenzekani ngesidumbu sikaNksz Makhosi Ndlangamandla (25) ngoba umphakathi uyamba lapho kuthiwa wagqitshwa khona kodwa akuveli lutho kuqhuma amanzi kuphela.UMnuz Sfiso Ndlangamandla, ongumfowabo kaNksz Ndlangamandla, uthe umfana eligodliwe igama lakhe, uyabalisa uthi le nto ayimniki ukuphumula ukhumbula konke okwenzeka.Uthe ingane kadadewabo eneminyaka engu-8 sebeyithathile bayoyifihla ngoba basaba ukuthi ingagcina isithola ukuthi unina wabulawa kanti basayifihlele.Uveze nokuthi besaba nokuthi uyise uma kwenzeka ephuma angayithatha.“Namanje asazi ukuthi yini lena amaphoyisa ewahlulayo ukuba athole iqiniso ngoba umfana uyazikhulumela. Ungichazelile nami ukuthi ubuthongo abusafiki. Lo mfana usekhuluma ngisho kubangani bakhe ngakho konke okwenzeka mhla kubulawa uMakhosi. Siphatheke kabi singumndeni ngoba kade sifika nomphakathi sizomba kodwa akuveli lutho, kunalokho kuqhuma amanzi,” kusho uNdlangamandla.Uveze nokuthi amaphoyisa asebatshela ukuthi izinja zomkhondo ngeke bazithole ngoba lo muntu kade anyamalala.Uthe okubi wukuthi uyise womfana uthi akuhlukanwe nengane yakhe ngoba kuzolimala ikusasa layo.Amaphoyisa nawo athi abhekene nobunzima ngaleli cala.“Ngesikhathi umsolwa evuma ukuthi wayibulala intombazane saba nethemba lokuthi konke kuzoshesha. Kodwa osekuyinkinga wukuthi kuthe uma eseya enkantolo washaya ungqimphothwe esethi noma angabhekwa kodwa ngeke atholakale ngoba wamshisa. Uphinde athi icala lokudlwengula umzala wakhe oneminyaka engu-15 akalazi kodwa into angayikhuluma eyokubulala intombi yakhe. Sesivele sathatha isinqumo sokumvulela icala lokubulala,” kusho iphoyisa elicele kugodlwe igama lalo.IMeya uMnuz Majuba Mavuso ebihambisana nomndeni beyobheka kule ndawo, ithe kuyabethusa ukuzwa ukuthi akucaci ngecala nokuthi amaphoyisa bezwa kuthiwa athi izinja ngeke zilethwe ngoba kade anyamalala uNksz Ndlangamandla.Uthe kuyiphutha lokho ngoba amaphoyisa ayakwazi ukuthola amathambo abantu abashona eminyakeni engaphezulu kuka-20 kodwa ayakhononda kumuntu onyamalale eminyakeni emithathu.Uthe kungcono udaba ludluliselwe emaphoyiseni asezingeni lesifundazwe.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe lolu daba lubucayi futhi amaphoyisa asaphenya ngakho abakwazi ukuphawula okwamanje.

KUQWASHISWE abesifazane ukuthi basheshe bazibheke izimpawu zokhwantalala ezinganeni, ezingagcina ziholele ekutheni zizibulale.Lokhu kushiwo nguSolwazi Sma Magwaza oyiClinical Psychologist e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, obekhuluma izolo emcimbini ohlelwe Imbokodo YeTheku. USolwazi Magwaza uthe ukhwantalala seluyisifo esiyinkinga kakhulu kuleli futhi uma singanakiwe baningi abazophazamiseka ngokomqondo ngenxa yalo. Uveze ukuthi izifo ezithinta umqondo azinakwa kuleli, sekuyinto ejwayelekile ukubona ophazamiseke ngokomqondo emgwaqweni engasizwa.“Ingane ingashaywa esikoleni kuthiwa ayizwa kanti inokhwantalala. Yingakho kumele kunakwe izinguquko emizweni yomuntu nasemicabangweni yakhe. Uma umuntu eseqala ukungathandi lutho, azibone engelutho kusuke sekuyinkinga. Komunye kusuke sekuwumsebenzi omkhulu ngisho ukuvuka nje abhekane nosuku,” echaza.Ugcizelele ukuthi izingane kumele zifundiswe zisencane ukuxazulula izinkinga ukuze zingaboni ukuzibulala kuyisisombululo. Uveze nokuthi ukwanda kwezigameko zokuzibulala kwezingane kwenziwa ukuthi zibona kuyinto enhle ngoba kuvezwa nakwabezindaba. Uthe ezinye zisebenzisa izidakamizwa ngoba ziziba ukhwantalala.Uthe ukugula ngomqondo okubizwa ngeBipolar kuqala ngokhwantalala olunganakiwe. Uveze nokuthi abesifazane bahlaselwa nawukhwantalala emuva kokubeletha, athe luphatha oyedwa kwabathathu.Unxuse ukuthi bangahlulelwa abantu abanokhwantalala ngoba bangagcina bezibulala.“Sibhekene nenkinga kuleli ngoba bangu-23 abazibulala ngosuku okwenza babe * -8 000 ngonyaka. Abangu-17.6% sebeke bacabanga ukuzibulala. Uma umuntu eseke wazama ukuzibulala kumele asheshe asizwe ngoba usengaphinda azame. Inkinga ukuthi siyamehlulela uma ekade ezama ukuzibulala bese ebona ukuthi akekho oqonda isimo sakhe,” kuchaza uSolwazi Magwaza.UMfundisi Ntebo Mohoto obengomunye wezikhulumi, ugxeke umkhuba wokwenzelana phansi kwabesifazane. Uthe ukuhleba nokugxekana akuhambelani nobuntu.Uveze ukuthi kunabesifazane abangazethembi, abajatshuliswa ukudicilela phansi isithunzi somunye.Inhloso yalo mcimbi bekuwukukhulisana kwabesifazane nokukhumbuzana ngokungamagugu njengoba kuyinyanga yawo.

source: imibono sizowenzani umhlaba sisahlulwa yilo omncane
text: MHLELI: Abantu bafuna umhlaba wabo. Umbuzo wami-ke uthi bazowenzani njengoba besahlulwa yilo omncane abanawo? Ukube kuya ngami ngabe siyabambisana nabamhlophe, bakhokhe kithi inyanga nenyanga.Ngeke sakufihla ukuthi abamhlophe bayawusebenzisa umhlaba. Futhi ngendlela egculisayo banazo zonke izinto zokuwusebenzisa. Thina sifuna umhlaba nje khona abangenawo ngisho ugandaganda lo.Uthi ufuna umhlaba kumnandi nje ukuthi nginendawo yami yona le engenziwa lutho, kwephucwe abantu abebesebenzisa umhlaba. Bengingafisa ukuthi sike sivule amehlo ke sicabange ngenye indlela.Angisho ukuthi amabhunu enza kahle athatha umhlaba wethu ngenkani kodwa ngithi ake sibuke ngenye indlela. Kungcono abamhlophe bakhokhe inyanga nenyanga kungenjalo sobulawa yindlala lapho engasekho lokhu kwangempela-ke amathuba emisebenzi.BuzokwakheeMelmoth

KUNINGI osekushiwo ngobubi bokukipita. Ungoti uthi iningi labakipitayo ligcina lingashadile, lixabana kubangwa nokuthi abathandanayo badidekile.Owesifazane ugcina engazazi noma uyinkosikazi endodeni akipite nayo, nowesilisa engazazi ukuthi ungumyeni noma isoka kwakipite naye.Kukubi kunjalo, ungoti wezamasiko uthi kukhona okuhlale kweqiwa uma kukhulunywa ngomkhuba abathi mubi wokukipita.Uthi izithandani ezikipita zizale izingane zize zikhule kulowo mnyama, zibanga ezinkulu izinkinga.“Nihleli ndawonye nakha umndeni nomuzi kodwa anihlangene ngokwezibongo. Nihleli nikhulisa izingane ekubeni nibiza izibongo ezihlukene.“Namadlozi enu awaqondi ukuthi niyisima kanjani,” kusho uDkt Nomagugu Ngobese ungoti kwezamasiko.Uthi iningi lezingane ezikhula emkipitweni zigcina zingenzelwanga izimfanelo zesiko ezifana nembeleko nokunye.“Yonke leyo nto igcina iphithanisa izinto. Kuba nzima kakhulu ke uma kwenzeka kuba khona odlulayo emhlabeni kulabo bazali abakipite iminyaka baze bazala inqwaba yezingane,” kusho ungoti.Uthi ilula le nto, abathandanayo uma sebebonile ukuthi bayathandana futhi bathanda ukuchitha isikhathi ndawonye, mabashade.“Inkinga wukuthi abantu kulezi zinsuku basuke bafune ukwenza zonke izinto ezingenamsebenzi ezigcina zingenamthelela esikweni nasendleleni okumele kwenziwe ngayo ngokwesintu”.Ukholwa wukuthi uma abathandanayo bangaqondana ngqo nelobolo nokushada ngokwesintu, bayeke ubukhazikhazi bemishado emhlophe nezingxenye okuthiwa ezokulobola ezingenamsebenzi esikweni, singancipha isibalo sezingane ezigcina zingazazi ukuthi ziyiliphi, ezingazi nokuthi uma zikhomba emakubo zizothi izibongo zakhona kukwabani.UDkt Ngobese ukhuze nomkhuba walabo okuthi ngoba sebeziqalile izinhlelo zokulobolana, bavele bakhethe ukukipita.Nalabo abashade umshado omhlophe kodwa bengachanguzanga ngokwesintu, uthi noma bangagqoka amaringi abiza kangakanani, kodwa nabo bafana nse nabantu abakipitile.“Uma ungakaze ukhishwe ngenyongo kubikelwe idlozi ukuthi usuyogana, kusho ukuthi awushadile. Abantu abayeke ukuholwa yinkanuko. Yinkanuko phela eyenza abantu abaningi baze bahlale ndawonye bengashadile.“Abesifazane nabo abake basukume bawuqede lo mkhuba. Uma kungaqina ngakubona, izinto zingaba ngcono."Uthi abathandanayo abayeke ukuzicabangela bona, abacabangele izingane.Ephetha uthe abazali abangakwazanga ukwenza lolu hlobo lomshado wesintu, abasilungise lesi simo kungakonakali.

ISIKHULU esiphezulu saseNedbank, uMnuz Mike Brown, siveze ukuthi owayengungqongqoshe wezokuMbiwaphansi, uMnuz Mosebenzi Zwane, wayecindeza ibhange ukuthi lithathe ama-akhawunti omndeni wakwaGupta ukuze kuvikelwe imisebenzi.UBrown utshele ikhomishini yeJaji Raymond Zondo izolo ukuthi uZwane wacela umhlangano nezikhulu zakwaNedbank ukuze kuxoxwe ngodaba lokuhlengwa kwemisebenzi yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngoMeyi ka-2016.Uthe ngesikhathi uZwane eqala umhlangano wathi amanye amabhange anqabile ukuhlangana nekomiti longqongqoshe waphinde wasabisa ngokuthi ikomiti linamandla amakhulu.“Ngamtshela uZwane ukuthi ngeke sikhulume ngezindaba zamakhasimende ebhange kodwa yena wayelokhu efuna ukukhuluma ngodaba lwabantu bakwaGupta. Wasicela ukuthi sisebenzisane nabakwaGupta emuva kokuthi amanye amabhange evale ama-akhawunti amabhizinisi abo. Yize sasitshelwe ukuthi sizohlangana nongqongqoshe abahlukene kodwa sagcina sesibonana noZwane kuphela,” kusho uBrown.Uthe bavala ama-akhawunti omndeni wakwaGupta nezinkampani zawo, okubalwa kuzo i-Oakbay Investments, Islandsite, Confident Concept, Sahara Computers neVR Lazer emuva kokusola ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi.“Sahlangana ngo-Ephreli 6 siyikomiti lasebhange eNedbank, sasifunde imibiko yokuthi iFNB ne-Absa isiwavalile ama-akhawunti akwaGupta. Sabona ukuthi sisengozini uma singawavali ngoba sasibonile ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi kuwo. Sinelungelo lokuqeda ubudlelwane bethu nezaphula mthetho,” kusho uBrown.Uthe banikeza abakwaGupta izinsuku eziwu-30 bebazisa ukuthi bazovala ama-akhawunti abo.Njengoba izikhulu zakwamanye amabhange ziveze ukuthi zabizwa emhlanganweni oseLuthuli House, uBrown uthe neNedbank nayo yabizelwa kulo mhlangano.“Kwakukhona owayenguNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, uNkk Jessie Duarte, owayeyiPhini lakhe noMnuz Enock Godogwana, obhekelele ezomnotho kwi-ANC. Abazange basisabise kodwa bathi bafuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani amabhange ekhethe ukuvala amabhange omndeni wakwaGupta nokuthi lesi sinyathelo sizoba namthelela muni kubatshalizimali,” kusho uBrown.Uthe bachazela amalungu e-ANC ngemithetho yokusebenza kwamabhange nomthelela oba khona uma kunabaphula imithetho yezezimali.Ibhange i-Absa lithi lona lasatshiswa ngokuthi izonqanyulwa inkontileka yalo uma liqhubeka nokuvala ama-akhawunti womndeni wakwaGupta.

UDLAME lwasezikoleni lufinyelele kwelinye izinga ngenkathi umfundi ona-17 egwaza ephindelela uthisha wakhe ngommese wambulala.Lo mfundi owenza uGrade 10 eRamotshere Moiloa High School, eDinokana Village eduze kwaseZeerust, eNorth West, kuthiwa uboshwe amaphoyisa ngezinsolo zokugwaza ngokubulala uMnuz Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate onguthisha wakhe obebhekele ukubhalwa kwesifundo iGeography abafundi abenza uGrade 10 ngoLwesine.Okhulumela uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, uzwakalise ukuthuka ngalesi senzo okuthiwa senziwe yilo mfundi.NgokukaMhlanga, akumele othisha baphile impilo yokuhlala ngokwesaba ngaso sonke isikhathi.Uthe udaba luqale emva kokuthi lo mfundi exwayiswe ngokuthi angangeneli ngenkathi kuphakwa kulesi sikole ngoLwesithathu.UMhlanga uthe kusolakala ukuthi luye kwamcasula umfundi ukukhuzwa kwakhe ngoba ngosuku olandelayo ufike esikoleni esehlome ngesikhali.“Akazange afike esikoleni ngesikhathi esifanele ngoLwesine,” kusho uMhlanga.Uthe lo mfundi ufike ngo-11 ekuseni waqonda ngqo emagumbini okufundela lapho abanye abafundi bebebhala khona izivivinyo zabo.UMhlanga uthe ngaleso sikhathi bekukhona othisha ababili abebegade izingane njengoba bezibhala izivivinyo zazo.“Uqonde kuthisha obemkhuze ukuthi angangeneli ngenkathi kade kuphakwa ukudla esikoleni (uMokolobate), wamgwaza esifubeni ephindelela,” kugcizelela uMhlanga.Kubikwa ukuthiemva kokwenza lesi senzo, lo mfundi ubalekile kodwa kwasiza onogada nabanye abafundi bambamba.Ngokwemininingwane yoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, lo mfundi uke wexwayiswa ngoMashi emva kokuthi eze esikoleni ephethe insangu.Amaphoyisa akuqinisekisile ukuthi lo mfundi uvalelwe esitokisini, nokuthi usolwa ngecala lokubulala.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uCaptain Sam Tselanyane, uthe lo mfundi ululekwe abezenhlalakahle, nokuthi uzobekwa icala lokubulala.Kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eLehurutshe kule ndawo.Kubikwa ukuthi uMokolobate ubeneminyaka engu-24.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, UMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo eGauteng ubusadidekile yisenzo somunye wabafundi okuthiwa uvele wakhipha isibhamu ngoLwesithathu wasabisa ngokudubula omunye wothisha e-Eldorado Park Secondary.Kubikwa ukuthi uthisha obesatshiswa ukwazile ukuphuca lo mfundi isibhamu wasihambisa emaphoyiseni.Umnyango usigxeke kakhulu lesi senzo kulesi sikole esidume ngokuthi yiBlue School.UMnuz Panyaza Lesufi onguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo eGauteng, uthe:“Sicela abafundi bangaziphathi ngendlela engamukelekile ezikoleni,”Unxuse isigungu esibhekele ukusebenza kwesikole ukuthi kube nesinyathelo esisithathayo ngalesi senzo.Uthe umnyango ngeke uzibekezelele izenzo ezifana nalezi.Uthe nanoma ngubani oyotholakala ephambana nomthetho wokuziphatha ezikoleni, kuyobhekanwa naye ngokulandela umthetho olawula ukuziphatha ezikoleni eNingizimu Afrika.* Funda omunye umbiko ngokungaphephi kothisa ekhasini 14.

KUGWAZWE kwabulawa isitshudeni saseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal ophikweni lwaseWestville ngemuva kwendumezulu yomcimbi wezitshudeni, iMother of All Bashes ezintatha zayizolo.Lo mcimbi obekumenywe kuwo izintandokazi zeGagasi FM, uSphectacula noDJ Naves, uphele kabi. Isitshudeni esina-22 igama laso eligodliwe ngoba singekho isiqiniseko sokuthi umndeni waso usuyazi ngokushona kwaso, kuthiwa sigwazwe ngemuva kwengxabano esuke phakathi kwaso nezinye izitshudeni ezintathu.Umengameli weSRC eWestville, uFulufhelo Mulidzwi uthe: “Ubulawe ezintatha ngaphakathi enyuvesi ngemuvakomcimbi. Kuthiwa uxabane nezinye izitshudeni azaziyo, omunye wazo wamgwaza washona. Anginayo imininingwane eminingi okwamanje."UFulufhelo uqhube wathi basazohlangana nezikhulu zenyuvesi ukubheka ukuthi bangaziqinisa kanjani ezokuphepha ngemuva kwalesi sigameko esibashiye beshaqekile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe amaphoyisa aseWestville aphenya icala lokubulala, akukaboshwa muntu.“Ngo-4:30 ezintatha kugwazwe kwabulawa isitshudeni ngesikhathi kusuka ingxabano emcimbini wezitshudeni. Lesi sitshudeni sitholwe sinoxhaxha lwamanxeba okugwazwa emzimbeni ngenhla. Kuthiwa sigwazwe abasolwa abathathu, abasagcwele amathafa,” kusho uCol Mbele.

source: imibono sidangele ngomonakalo owenziwe ngumsholozi kubantu
text: MHLELI: Izinyembezi emehlweni ami zehliswa wumcabango wokuthi kanti ngempela sasizabalazela ini uma kuzofika abafana baseNdiya bazosikhethela ongqongqoshe ezweni lethu sibe thina sasivotele amaqabane ukuthi asebenzele umphakathi ontulayo. Inhlangano yethu uKhongolose yaphenduka yaba silwane sini ngesikhathi sikaJacob Zuma? Amaqabane asala enkundleni ayefela ukuthi sibe yinhlekisa ezweni nasemhlabeni wonkana na.Eqinisweni sonke sasimkhonzile uMsholozi ngoba sithi ungumuntu olwaziyo usizi lomuntu omnyama okuyothi uma esengumengameli azi okuyikonakona okufanele akwenze. Sidangele kakhulu futhi sididekile ngomonakalo ikakhulu esizweni esinsundu esidonsa kanzima wububha.Imibhikisho eminingi enodlame ezindaweni ezehlukene ezweni iwumphumela wokweba imali kahulumeni okumele isize bona kanye ababhikishi. source: ezempilo ingcuphe yesifo senhliziyo kobaba abahlala ekhaya
text: ISIFO senhliziyo sidlangile kubantu besilisa ikakhulu labo abangobaba abahlala emakhaya. Balinganiselwa ku- 25 961 abantu besilisa abashona ngenxa yalesi sifo.UNksz Nicole Jennings, okhulumela inkampani yemithi egxile ezifweni ezithikameza ukusebenza kwenhliziyo iPharma Dynamics, uthe abantu besilisa abaningi bafisa ukuba nempilo elula yokuhlala ekhaya kodwa abacwaningi bathi ukushintshela ekubeni wubaba ohlala ekhaya kunganomthelela ongemuhle enhliziyweni.Uthe lokhu bakuthathela ocwaningweni olwenzelwe i-US National Institutes for Health obelubheka ukuthi imisebenzi eyenziwa abantu inamthelela muni esimeni sabo sempilo.“Ucwaningo lwalubheka abantu besilisa nabesifazane abangu-3 600 esikhathini esingangeminyaka engu-10 sathola ukuthi abesilisa ababengabayeni abahlala emakhaya esikhathini eside ebudaleni babo bebesemathubeni angu-82% okufa ngenxa yesifo senhliziyo uma beqhathaniswa nabesilisa abasebenza bengekho emakhaya,” kusho uNksz Jennings.Imiphumela etholakele ihambisane nolunye ucwaningo olwenziwe yiNyuvesi iRutgers e-USA eveze ukuthi kubantu abashadile abangu-1 095 ababhekwe iminyaka engu-30 luthole ukuthi abesilisa abahlala emakhaya lapho kungomama abondlayo bebevame ukuthi babe nezinkinga zezempilo okubalwa kuzo izilonda esiswini nesifo senhliziyo nezinye.Uthe okuholela ekutheni abantu besilisa abahlala emakhaya babe nalezi zinkinga kungenxa yokuhluleka ukwamukela ukuthi akusebona abanamandla okondla imindeni yabo.UNksz Jennings uthe obaba abahlala emakhaya kungenzeka bagcine sebebhema kakhulu, bephuza noma bedla ngendlela okungesiyo ngoba bezama ukumelana nesimo sabo sokuzizwa bengasewona amadoda ngenxa yokungakwazi ukondla imindeni yabo. Lokhu kugcina kuholele ekutheni bagcine sebenezifo okubalwa kuzo esenhliziyo, esikashukela nezinye.Uthe yize sekunoshintsho olukhulu olwenza ukuthi abantu besifazane bagcine besebenza, bondla imindeni, abesilisa abaningi basazibona kuyibona abafanele ukondla imindeni yabo. Lokhu kubenza bazizwe behlelwa yisithunzi uma amakhosikazi abo nophathina babo kuyibona abondla imindeni yabo.

KUBATSHAZWA isihluku somlisa (28) waseNgwavuma okuthiwa uhlahlele unina okwembuzi emuva kokuthi ezame ukumlamula eshaya unina wengane yakhe.Lo mlisa wasOnaleni, eNgwavuma, ongumakhi, kuthiwa uhlahlele unina, uNkk Maponyane Timbane (56) ngocelemba ngoMsombuluko ntambama, emva kokuthi emlamule enengxabano nonina wengane yakhe abesehlale naye iminyaka emzini wakhe.Induna yendawo, uMnuz Ephraim Ndlazi, ithe basashaqekile ngenxa yesehlo esenzeke endaweni. Uthe uthole ucingo ngehora lesithupha ntambama lumbikela ngokubulawa kukaNkk Timbane.“Ngesikhathi ngibikelwa ukuthi u... (emgagula ngegama) useklabhe unina ngocelemba, ngizitshele ukuthi kuthiwa angiphuthume ngizolanda umuntu obedinga ukuyiswa emtholampilo. Ngishaqekile uma ngifika. Ubemhlahlele ngocelemba umzimba wonke kuhle okwembuzi. Bekuyinto obuyibuka kanye kube sengathi ungangaphinde ubuke,” kusho uNdlazi.Uyise omdala kamsolwa uMnuz Zifo Ntimbane oveze ukuthi ubizwe yinduna emuva kokuthi sekwenzeke isigameko uthe umsolwa ubevame ukumsabisa unina abuye amsole nangokuthakatha.“Unina bekungabonakali nokuthi ngabe ubenawo yini amehlo nokuthi ayengakuphi. Nasezingalweni ubemgencile. Bekuyinto engabhekeki,” kusho uNtimbane.UNdlazi uthole ukuthi uNkk Timbane ubehleli nonina wengane kamsolwa ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sigameko. Uchaze ukuthi unina wengane kamsolwa ubezobika ukuthi uyamshaya kanti umsolwa uzotheleka egcekeni esephethe ucelemba esuka kwakhe lapho behlala khona.“Ubuze unina ukuthi uyazi yini ukuthi babangani njengoba bexabana nonina wengane. Ngesikhathi eseqala exabana nonina, unina wengane ubaleke wathatha ingane. Kuyacaca ukuthi ukube akazange abaleke naye ngabe umenze okufanayo,” kusho uNdlazi. Kulesi sigameko kuthiwa ulimaze nomfowabo omncane obezama ukumvimba ngesikhathi ehlasela unina.Amaphoyisa kuthiwa agasele endlini kamsolwa ngoMsombuluko ebusuku amfica elele esekhumule nezingubo ezinegazi abezigqokile ngesikhathi ehlahlela unina.Kuthiwa ubenegazi ezandleni kodwa ephika ukuthi ukwenzile lokhu, ethi ubexabana impela nonina kodwa ubengeke ambulale. Umsolwa kuvele ukuthi ungumuntu obevamile ukuthi ahluphe novame ukuphuza utshwala.UNdlazi uthe namanje umphakathi wonkana uhlukumezekile ngokwenzekile okungangokuthi akazi ukuthi ungamenzani uma kungathiwa uyaphuma njengoba eboshiwe. Uthe umphakathi uthukile ngoba kuyaqala ukuthi kwenzeke isehlo esifana nalesi endaweni, futhi bafisa engathi kungaba ngesokugcina. UNtimbane uthe ufisa ukubona umthetho udlala indawo yawo, aboshwe angadedelwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane ukuqinisekisile ukuthi umsolwa uboshiwe nokuthi ubhekene necala lokubulala. Uthe bekulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo izolo.

UBUHLE bamasiko esiZulu yibona obamheha wagcina esephila njengawo amaZulu usomabhizinisi ongowoMdabu waseNdiya uMnuz Ishwar Ramlutchman osaziwa ngoMabheka Zulu odabuka KwaDukuza.Lo somabhizinisi ungumsunguli wenhlangano iSivananda World Peace Foundation. Inyanga yonke kaSepthemba kuzobe kuqhakanjiswa amasiko ezinhlanga ezahlukene. URamlutchman uthi uqale ukuzifela ngamasiko akwaZulu esemncane ngesikhathi ehambele Umkhosi weLembe KwaDukuza nalapho ayefike abone khona amabutho neSilo samaBandla bevunule kahle.Uthe empeleni amasiko alezi zizwe zombili ayefana ngoba zombili zishumayela inhlonipho nobumbano nokugcinwa kwamasiko."Ngithe sengiqedile isikole ngahlangana neSilo ngazethula kuso saxoxa ngasitshela ukuthi ngiyathanda ukuba yingxenye yamaZulu. Sangemukela kahle, iSilo singumuntu olungile ohlala efisa nokusiza abantu ikakhuluakazi abahlwempu," kusho uRamlutchman.Uthe uma esevunule econsa ngebheshu lakhe esegushe ngesihlangu sakhe, uvele azizwe engumZulu woqobo."ISilo saze sangihlonipha ngokungifaka ebuthweni Izinyosi nokungelinye lamabutho aseNdlunkunlu kaZulu. Ngajabula kakhulu ngoba ngabona ukuthi sengingaphansi kweSilo, sesifana nobaba kimi."Uthe lobu budlelwano bakhe neMbube ububona bubalulekile ngoba kugqugquzela ukuzwana phakathi kwabantu bezinhlanga ezahlukene abahlala KwaZulu-Natal. Uthe ukucwasana ngokwebala ukuzonda kabi futhi enye yezinto azikhuzayo uma ehambela imiphakathi eyahlukene. Uveze ukuthi basekhona abantu abambuka bemnyonkoloza uma bembona ephansi phezulu namasiko amaZulu ebe engowoMdabu waseNdiya. Abanye baze bangamkhulumisi uma ebabingelela ngesiZulu.UHLALA eseduze neSilo uMnuz Ishwar Ramlutchman odume ngelikaMabheka Zulu ebuthweni Izinyosi“Ngike ngibingelele abantu ngesiZulu ngibone nje ukuthi bayachiza bayaxakeka ukuthi leli Ndiya liluthathaphi ulimi lwethu. Abaningi kodwa bayajabula baya-ngemukela, ngiphile nabo ngoba ngingumuntu osiza kakhulu abantu abahlwempu.’’Uthe ubambisana neSilo ezinhlelweni ezahlukene uma kudingeka iminikelo yokutakula abantu abasezimeni ezinzima zempilo. Uthe kunabantu abaningi abahlwempu abakhele izindlu enikela nakwezinye izihlelo ezehlukene zokufukula abahlwempu.

source: amaphoyisa enza umsebenzi oncomekayo kwelikameyiwa chicco twala
text: INKAKHA yomculi wakuleli uChicco Twala onguyise kaLongwe Twala ongomunye wababekhona ngesikhathi kudutshulwa lowo owayengunozinti we-Orlando Pirates uSenzo Meyiwa usephumele obala wazwakalisa ukugculiseka ngokuqhubeka kophenyo lwamaphoyisa.Ngokombiko weTimesLIVE, uChicco ukuphikile ukuthi indodana yakhe iyathintekla ekubulaweni kukaSenzo. Uthe ukuba indodana yakhe ibithinteka ekubulaweni kukaSenzo ubezoba ngowokuqala ukuyinikela emaphoyiseni."Amaphoyisa enza umsebenzi oncomekayo ngokuphenya udaba. Kuphela nje ukuthi abantu bashicilela umbhedo nje. Abantu kumele bayekele amaphoyisa enze umsebenzi wawo ukuze abambe isigilamkhuba. Izindaba ezingamanga. Angeke ngikholwe yilutho amaphoyisa engakaluphothuli uphenyo," kusho uChicco.Ukuphawula kukaChicco kulandela udaba olushicilelwe iphephandaba elinguzakwabo weSolezwe, iSunday Independent neSolezwe ngeSonto obeluveza itulo lokufihla ukuthi ngubani owabulala uSenzo. Kulolu daba kuvela ukuthi uSenzo wadutshulwa ngumuntu owayengaphakathi endlini ngesikhathi ezama ukuhlukanisa udadewabo kaKelly, uZandi nesoka lakhe uLongwe ngesikhathi bexabana.ULONGWE TwalaNgoLwesibili UKelly usole leliphephandaba ngokusenga ezimithiyo ngalolu daba."Leli phephandaba lase-Independent likwenza kanjani ukuthi lishicilele udaba olungamanga? Engizonitshela kona ukuthi ngelinye ilanga niyohlangabezana nembibizane. Mina noNkulunkulu siyalazi iqiniso," kusho yena.UKelly uthe akasoze wavikela umuntu obulale uyise wendodakazi yakhe."Engingasoze ngakwenza ukuvikela umbulali woyise wendodakazi yami. Bangakholwa noma yini abayithandayo kodwa ekugcineni uNkulunkulu akehlulwa yilutho," kuphetha uKelly.NoZandi ushicilele esakhe isitatimende ngoLwesithathu lapho aveze khona ukuthi usawuzwela umndeni wakwaMeyiwa futhi uyafisa atholwe umbulali kodwa wathi akawukweleti lutho umndeni wakwaMeyiwa. Uzikhahlelel ngazo zombili izinsolo zokuthi wadubuleka ngephutha ezama ukulamula ingxabano eyayiphakathi kwakhe nowayeyisoka lakhe uLangwe.Akukaboshwa muntu ngokubulawa kukaMeyiwa.

LUYINZUKAZIKEYI olwabashadile baseMbazwana abaneminyaka ewu-21 beshadile kodwa isitifiketi somshado sabo sikhomba ukuthi umama uzishadile.UNkk Phikiwe Thandazile Ngobese (Mangeni) ushade noMnuz Bernard Mxoshwa Ngobese kodwa isitifiketi somshado abasinikwa uMnyango wezaseKhaya siveza ukuthi uNkk Ngobese uzishade yena, esikhaleni okufanele ngabe kubhalwe kuso umyeni kubhalwe igama nesibongo sakhe nasesikhaleni sikankosikazi kubhalwe yena.UNgobese uthe bashada ngo-1998 esontweni wathatha incwadi yomshado yasesontweni wayihambisa eMnyangweni wezaseKhaya eMngeni ukuze kuphume isitifiketi, kulapho kwaphambana khona izinkomishi.“Bengilokhu ngitshelwa ukuthi angilinde udaba lwami luyalungiswa. Ngigcine sengibona ukuthi ayikho lento kudlalwa ngami ngoba akukho okugcwaliswayo kusuke kwenzelwa ukuthi ngihambe. Ngabuza ukuthi kwenziwa yini kuphele iminyaka ngephutha elenzeka khona ngoba phela kumele kube lula ukulilungisa ngoba incwadi yomshado isekhona kimi. Kule nyanga bangitshele ukuthi angikhohlwe ngoba leli phutha ngeke lilungiseke, ePitoli bathe ngeke lilungiseke leli phutha. Kuzo zonke izindawo okufuneka kuzo incwadi yomshado siphindiselwa emuva kuthiwe leli phepha esinalo ngeke lisebenza ngoba likhomba ukuthi unkosikazi uzishade yena,” echaza.Uthe uma kudingeka ukuthi abhale unkosikazi wakhe emaphepheni akhe abalulekile akakwazi ukumbala njengonkosikazi umbala njengomama wezingane.“Ngokwalo mnyango mina angishadile. Lento iyasikhathaza ngoba iminyaka iyahamba. Ngiyabona ukuthi ngeke sisizakale njengoba kuthiwa ePitoli bathe ngeke leli phutha lilungiseke,” kusho yenaUMnuz Siyabulela Qoza, okhulumela uMnyango wezaseKhaya kuleli, uthe ngokwazi kwakhe wonke amaphutha ayalungiseka kodwa ngeke akwazi ukuphawula ngokugcwele ukuthi kulolu daba kwenzekeni ngoba uyaqala ukuzwa ngalo. Wacela ukuthi athunyelelwe imininingwane yalo ukuze aluthumele ophikweni olufanele.

KUVELE ukuthi sabulawa ngokushaywa ngesando ekhanda emagcekeni esikhungo saseDurban University of Technology (DUT) isitshudeni uSandile Ndlovu oshonele esibhedlela ngoSepthemba ngemuva kokulimala kanzima ekhanda.Umsolwa ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu (18) uMsizi Mbutho (29), uboshwe ngeledlule kanti uvele okwesibili enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngoLwesithathu. Ngokwamaphepha asenkantolo, umsolwa ubhekene namacala amabili, elokubulala nelokubamba inkunzi.UMbutho akakayazisi inkantolo ukuthi uyawavuma noma uyawaphika amacala abekwe wona kanti futhi akasifakanga nesicelo sebheyili. Ngesikhathi esenkantolo kuvele ukuthi uNdlovu, obefundela iziqu ze-Industrial Engineering, wabulawa ngokushaywa kanzima ekhanda.Phambilini bekubikwa ukuthi uNdlovu wabulawa ngokugwazwa.  Bekungokokuqala abashushisi beveza ukuthi uNdlovu wabulawa “ngokushaywa ekhanda ngesando, okwaholela ekufeni kwakhe.”Sandile NdlovuAbashushisi basola uMbutho ngokweba izinto zikaNdlovu okubalwa kuzo iselula etholwe kuyena ngemuva kokumhlasela ngesando ngoSepthemba 9. Ushonele esibhedlela ngoSepthemba 21 esephefumula ngemishini.Abashushisi bathe bafuna uMbutho abhekane nesigwebo esinzima kunazo zonke esigabeni samacala asolwa ngawo.UMbutho kuvela ukuthi akazimisele ngokufaka isicelo sebheyili. Icala lihlehlisiwe njengoba kusalindelwe umbiko wokuhlolwa kwesidumbu sikaNdlovu. Inkantolo isazonquma ukuthi leli cala lizoqhubeka eNkantolo yeMantshi noma lizodluliselwa eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini.

OWAYENGUKHOMISHANA wakwaSars, uMnuz Tom Moyane, uzothola ithuba lokuphonsa ngemibuzo uNgqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, kwiKhomishini ephenya ngokuLawulwa koMbuso yiDlanzana, ngodaba lokwethweswa amacala ngo-2016 ngokusungula uphiko labaphenyi olungekho emthethweni kwaSARS.Sibe yimpumelelo isicelo sikaMoyane sokuphonsa imibuzo uGordhan, njengoba kumemezele izolo uSihlalo wale Khomishini, iJaji uRaymond Zondo.Ummeli kaMoyane, uMnuz Eric Mabuza, uthe umuntu ammele uyajabula ukuthi uzoke athole ubulungiswa.“Ingalo yomthetho ihambe ihambe ithole noma ubani. Sikubheke ngabomvu ukuba uGordhan akwazi ukubhekana nemibuzo. Sizoyalela ummeli omkhulu ukuba aqale alungiselele ukumphonsa ngemibuzo. Ngiyathemba ikhomishini izosheshe ilungise usuku lapho sizokwazi khona ukumphonsa imibuzo. Sekuphele unyaka manje uGordhan afakaza. Ukuhlehliswa kokuba uthole ubulungiswa kufana nokuthi uyancishwa ithuba lokuba uthole ubulungiswa,” kusho uMabuza kwisitatimende.Uqhube wathi: “Ngokwethu ukuvula icala kukaMoyane, kwakungenziwa yinoma imuphi umuntu ongukhomishana yakwaSars, uma ebhekene nezinsolo zokusungula uphiko lwabaphenyi abangekho emthethweni.”UGordhan wethula ubufakazi kwikhomishini ngonyaka odlule nokuyilapho asola khona uMoyane ngokuthi isenzo sakhe sokuba amvulele icala lobugebengu ngokusungula uphiko lwabaphenyi abangekho emthethweni kwaSars, kwakumayelana nokuba avumele ukuba kube khona abathize abavumela ukulawulwa kombuso yindlazana.Ikhomishini iyaqhubeka nokulalela ubufakazi.

UTHUKUTHELE uyaveva uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha nokuPhepha KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Ntuli, emuva kwesigameko sokubulawa kwephoyisa, elinye lalimala ngesikhathi kade eyofuna izigebengu ezithinteka emacaleni okubulawa kosomatekisi eNsuze.Amaphoyisa amabili asebenza ophikweni lwezobuNhloli KwaZulu-Natal, uwarrant officer no-captain, abelandela umkhondo ethungatha abantu abasembonini yama-metered taxis abathinteka emacaleni okubulawa kosomatekisi endaweni ngesikhathi edutshulwa kade elalelwe unyedle yiqulu labantu ebelihlomile.Isolezwe selibike kaningana mayelana nombango osudlule nemiphefumulo oqhubeka phakathi kwabantu bama-metered taxi nosomatekisi kule ndawo njengoba kubangwa indaba yokuthutha abagibeli.Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba izolo, uNtuli uzwakalise ilaka nokuphoxeka emuva kokuhlaselwa kwalawa maphoyisa ephenya ngodlame embonini yamatekisi esifundazweni.“Ukubulawa kwamaphoyisa ngeke kuze kubekezelelwe. Lesi senzo sikhombisa uhlobo lwezigebengu ezithinteka embangweni yamatekisi esifundazweni.“Sesikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi amaphoyisa azivikele uma ethungatha izigebengu eziyingozi uma kwenzeka ziwahlasela, noma ukuphi ukuhlasela okubhekiswa emaphoyiseni kumele kuthathwe njengokuhlasela okubhekiswe kumbuso,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe bayathemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azobabamba khona maduze abasolwa abathinteka kuleli cala lokuhlaselwa kwawo.UNtuli uthe sebejube ithimba elivela emnyangweni wakhe ukuba liyohlola isimo endaweni lenze nesiqiniseko sokuthi isimo sibuyiselwa kwesijwayelekile.Uthe sebeqinise namathimba abo amaphoyisa ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abasolwa abathinteka emacaleni okubulawa kwabantu eNsuze bayaboshwa.“Abantu ababulala amaphoyisa abanandawo emphakathini, siyayinxusa imiphakathi ukuba iwavikele amaphoyisa,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe ngeke baze baphumule abahlaseli bamaphoyisa bengakabanjwa.UNtuli uphinde wadlulisa namazwi enduduzo emndenini wephoyisa elishonile.

source: umphakathi utitinye obebonisa izingane ama video ocansi
text: UTHELEKELWE wumphakathi ngamabhodlela nangezibhakela owesilisa waseMachobeni ngaseLindelani, ngemuva kokuvela kokuthi uvezele izingane ezisencane izithombe zocansi.Lo wesilisa esingeke silidalule igama lakhe njengoba engakasho ukuthi uyalivuma noma uyaliphika icala, kuthiwa ubebiza izingane zamantombazane ezingomakhelwane athi uyazithuma, agcine ngokuzivalela endlini ezibukisa izithombe zocansi, esebenzisa i-lap top yakhe.Indaba idalulwe yintombazane eneminyaka ewu-13, evele yasho ngengila kwaphuma omakhelwane.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba, umphakathi uphimile kwahlatshwa umkhosi, watitinywa owesilisa ngaphambi kokubizelwa amaphoyisa.Unina wentombazane esho ngengila, uthe indodakazi yakhe imtshele ukuthi into eyimemezisile wukubona into engakaze iyibone.“Udinga ukwelulekwa ngokomqondo ngoba bekumele ayobhala namhlanje esikoleni, sahamba sayokhuluma nothisha ukuthi sibona engakulungele selokhu kwenzeke le nto kuyena,” kusho unina wale wentombazanyana eyenza uGrade 7 kwesinye sezikole eLindelani.Unina ucele ukuba indodakazi yakhe izikhulumele ngokwenzekile.“Bengikha amapentshisi kwesinye sezihlahla...uphumile endlini wangitshela ukuthi nguyena ogade abantshontsha amapetshisi.Ngixolisile mina, wabe esethi angingene endlini yakhe. Ngingene wabe esevala umnyango, wathi angizobuka kwi-lap top yakhe. Kuvele abantu abebenza ucansi,” kusho intombazanyana.Iqhube ithe umsolwa uyibuze iminyaka yayo yobudala, okuthe uma imtshela, wayesethi kuhle-ke ngoba isikhulile.Ngemuva kwalesi sehlakalo, kuvele nezinye izingane ezimbili nazo ezitshele abaphenyi becala ukuthi zike zabukiswa izithombe zocansi nguyena umsolwa.Owesilisa osolwayo kuthiwa uhlala nengane yentombazane eneminyaka emibili. Ngokwelinye ilungu lomphakathi, kuthe uma bembuza ukuthi uphi unina wengane, wabatshela ukuthi uyobeletha esibhedlela.Unina wengane okukhulunywe naye, uthe ubonga uNkulunkulu ngokuthi indodakazi yakhe ayidlwengulwanga.“Siyile kodokotela bafike baqinisekisa ukuthi akakaze adlwengulwe,” kusho unina wentombazanyana.Kunezinsolo zokuthi ziningi nezinye izingane okungenzeka ukuthi zike zabukiswa izithombe zocansi.“Siyasola nokuthi nale ngane yakhe ahlala nayo hleze nayo uyihlukumeza ngokocansi,” kusho umzali ophumele obala.Ugogo wengane ebihlala nowesilisa kuthiwa ufikile khona izolo wazoyilanda.Amanye amalungu omphakathi athe afuna kungenele nenkosi yendawo ukuze umlisa adingiswe nasendaweni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe amaphoyisa aseNanda abophe owesilisa (33) ngecala lokukhombisa izingane izithombe zocansi.Uthe owesilisa osolwayo uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eNtuzuma izolo, bekungakacaci ukuthi uyitholile yini ibheyili.“Kuthiwa ngoNovemba 6 umsolwa udobele endlini yakhe owesifazane oneminyaka engu-13 lapho afike khona wamdlalela ama- video ocansi, wamphoqa ukuthi akawabuke,” kusho uCol Thembeka Mbele.

UHLALELE ovalweni umndeni womfana ona-9 okuthiwa uvinjezelwe ngamalungu omphakathi waseSavannah Park eMariannhill ngoLwesithathu ngeledlule, emsola ngokuthakatha.Uyise womfana (igama lakhe elingeke lidalulwe ukuvikelwe umfana) uthi uthuke kwaphela nasozwaneni ngesikhathi ehla esitobhini ntambama ngoLwesithathu ephuma emsebenzini, elinye ilungu lomphakathi limcela ukuba behlisane baye emzini ongumakhelwane lapho kugcinwe khona indodana yakhe okuthiwa ibanjwe kulo muzi igibele imfene, ekuseni ngabo 9.Uthe ngesikhathi esondela, ugxavunwe kabuhlungu ngamanye amalungu omphakathi abesola yena nonina (uninakhulu womfana) ngokusebenzisa ingane ezenzweni zokuthakatha.“Ngisindele abebengikhuzela ngenkathi abafana bakulo muzi besho ukungiqeda. Kuze kwafika amaphoyisa okuyiwona agcine ekhulume nesixuku ebesingezwa mshini,” kusho yena.Uthi utshelwe ukuthi indodana yakhe ibanjwe bukhoma kulo muzi igibele imfene, imfene yabaleka yangena ehlathini. Uthi amalungu omphakathi abesho ukungena kulo muzi efuna imfene okuthiwa ifuywe nguninakhulu womfana.“Vele lo mndeni okuthiwa indodana yami beyithakatha kuwona, asizwani kahle,” kuqhuba uyise womfana .Uthe sebethuka izanya besaba ukuthi bangase bahlaselwe. Uthe namuhla uya enkantolo ukuyofaka isicelo sencwadi yokuvikelwa komakhelwane.Uthe akusikhona okokuqala indodana yakhe isolwa ngokuthakatha, nyakenye kusatshalaliswe izithombe zayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa ibanjwe nomuthi ebiyowufaka komunye umuzi nawo oyibangana ukusuka kulona okuthiwa ibanjwe kuwo ngoLwesithathu.Kuthiwa amalungu omphakathi abengena kulo muzi ukuzozibonela ‘umthakathi omncane.’ Kuvele ukuthi umzimba womfana ugcatshwe izinhlanga, uyise uthe yizinhlanga ezigcatshwe wonke umuntu kubo ngenhloso yokubaqinisa uma kugasela izulu.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi lakule ndawo elixoxe neSolezwe elingathandanga ukudalulwa lithe ngesikhathi umfana eboshwele endlini kulo muzi okuthiwa ubanjwe kuwo, kuthiwa uthe ngayizolo ubeye komunye umuzi eyogqiba umuthi.Leli lungu lomphakathi lithe banokwesaba ukuthi amalungu alo mndeni azogcina enzakalisiwe.Ikhansela uMnuz Sibusiso Khwela lithe lizoba nomhlangano nomphakathi ngoMgqibelo ukudingida ngalolu daba.

UNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThutha, ukuPhepha nokuXhumanisa uMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Ntuli uthi kuzobe kuqhaqhazela utsotsi ngendlela ezizobe ziqiniswe ngayo ezokuphepha KwaZulu-Natal ngala maholidi kaKhisimusi.Ukusho lokhu emhlanganweni obuyizolo ejele iWestville obekubhungwa ngamasu okuqinisa ezokuphepha ngesikhathi samaholidi kaKhisimusi futhi kwethulwa nesiqubulo esizobe sisetsheniswa esithi: Repositioning KwaZulu-Natal as a Zero Tolerance province.UNtuli uthe bajube amaphoyisa ukuthi avale zonke izindawo ezidayisa utshwala ezingekho emthethweni futhi kuhlolwe nalezo ezinamalayisensi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihweba ngendlela esemthethweni.“Kuyasikhathaza ukwanda kwezindawo zokucima ukoma ikakhulukazi lezo ezivulwa eduze kwezikole nasemasontweni. Siyajabula ukusho ukuthi abeLicence Liquor Board sebenalo uhlu lwawo wonke ama-tarven aseduze kwezikole namasonto. Okunye okukhathazayo wukuthi izigameko eziningi zobugebengu zenzeka ebusuku nangezimpelasonto. Abantu banesibindi esixakile futhi abanendaba nempilo yomunye umuntu okuyinto ephambene noMthethosisekelo wezwe,” kusho uNtuli.UNtuli ufuna amaphoyisa avale nemibhiyozo yabafundi abaqeda ukubhala izivivinyo eyaziwa ngama-pens down ngoba uma ingaqashiwe kugcina sekubulawa abantu iningi labo elisuke ligwaziwe.“Siyakhathaza isibalo esiphezulu sokubulawa kwabantu emalokishini ngakho kumele kube khona okwenziwayo ngokushesha. Eminyakeni embalwa edlule iziteshi zethu zamaphoyisa bezilokhu zizihola phezulu ohlwini lukazwelonke. Inanda, KwaMashu, eMlaza nePlessislair ezinye zazo. Asiwasusile amehlo ethu emahostela aseThekwini ikakhlukazi iGlebelands naKwaMashu. Sizophinde siqinise ezokuphepha eMthunzini, eMpangeni, Pinetown naseHillcrest enezigameko eziningi zokugqekezwa kwemizi, kuphangwe amabhizinisi nokudunwa kwezimoto,” kusho uNtuli.Bekukhona noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt-General Khombinkosi Jula nenhloko yomnyango kaNtuli uMnuz Themba Mavundla.UNtuli uthe kuyaziwa ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka ukuthi KwaZulu-Natal samukela izinkumbi zabavakashi ngakho izinhlaka zezomthetho kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana ukulwa nobugebengu nezingozi zomgwaqo eKZN.“Ubugebengu nezingozi zomgwaqo kumele sikuthathe njengesitha sethu okumele silwe naso ngokubambisana. Inkinga yezokuphepha emiphakathini nasemigwaqweni iletha inselelo edinga ukuba siphendule isimo esibhekene naso njengamanje,” kusho uNtuli.Unxenxe abezomthetho ukuba benze umsebenzi wabo ngobuqotho futhi banikele isikhathi sabo ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokuvikela umphakathi.Uthe bahlele izivimbamgwaqo ezibalelwa ku-2 040 KwaZulu-Natal njengoba bezojuba inhlanganisela yamaphoyisa angu-24 325 azoqinisa ezokuphepha ngesikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka nangemumva kwawo.

source: i ifp ifuna iqiniso kosolwa ngokubulala ikhansela
text: I-IFP KwaZulu-Natal ifuna amaphoyisa ampintshele ekhoneni, aze agonyuluke iqiniso umlisa oboshwe ngelezinsolo zokubulawa kwekhansela layo, uMnuz Mthembeni Majola (39). Ikhansela uMajola belisebenzela uMasipala iNkosi Langalibalele eMtshezi, lithelwe othulini ngo-Agasti ngesikhathi lihamba ngemoto yalo nomunye owasinda.UMnuz Ayanda Siyanda Mshengu Mvelase (26) uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMtshezi emuva kokuthelekelwa ezakwadalawane zamfaka ozankosi.Kukholakala ukuthi umsolwa oboshiwe, yiyona nkabi eyathela uMajola ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu yamshiya esethule. Ubhekene necala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala njengoba kukhona owasinda ehamba noMajola.I-IFP ikholwa wukuthi ukhona owayeqashe inkabi okufanele imcebe naye aboshwe.Uboshwa nje kuthiwa uhamba elinye icala eGoli lapho ezobuyela khona enkantolo ngoLwesibili.Kwelokubulala uMajola uzobuyela enkantolo ngoLwesibili oluzayo.USihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli uthe bafuna iqiniso lonke ukuthi bekusukelephi kuze kubulawe uMajola. Uncome umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ngokubamba umsolwa kodwa wathi usemningi umsebenzi.“Kuyigxathu elihle ukuthi kuboshwe umsolwa. Kodwa sifuna umsuka wendaba nabo bonke ababehleli behlela yonke le nto.Ukubulawa kosopolitiki kuyinkinga kabi kulesi sifundazwe, akufanele sikuthathe kancane nje,’’ kuchaza uNtuli.Uthe amaphoyisa kufanele azihluphe ngokuthola obhongoza abaqasha izinkabi ukuze kuphele ukubulalana.UMajola ubulawa nje naye ubehamba icala ngezinsolo zokuzama ukubulala owayengusomlomo kaMasipala waseNdumeni, uNkk Winfreda Mbatha-Makhathini.UMajola kuleli cala ubeboshwe noMnuz Siboniso Mbatha, oke waba yimeya eNdumeni. Ukuboshwa kwabo kwashiya abaningi bekhexile ngoba bonke laba baseqenji elilodwa. UNkk Makhathini ube esefudukela kwi-ANC emuva kwesigameko.

ISATHUTHUMELA intombazane yaseKhula Village, eMtubatuba, okuthiwa ibhunyelwe ngamanzi abilayo ngumama wakwamakhelwane ocasulwe wukuthi iphekele iphalishi kwakhe engekho.Uyaveva uyise kaNomcebo Madlopha (19) ovuke esibhedlela emuva kokubhunyelwa ngamanzi ngoMgqibelo odlule. Elandisa Isolezwe uMnuz Caleb Madlopha, uthe akahlali nendodakazi yakhe ekhaya ngenxa yomsebenzi. Wathola ukuthi ishiswe ngamanzi ngumakhelwane ngoba iye kwakhe engekho yayopheka iphalishi.“Kuthiwa wawungekho ugesi ekhaya uNomcebo waya kwamakhelwane wacela ukwenzela ingane yakhe iphalishi. Wafica izingane zakwamakhelwane zamvumela wenza iphalishi wahamba. Kuthe esesekhaya kwafika umama wakwamakhelwane ezombhunyela ngamanzi abilayo,” kuchaza yena.Uthe uNomcebo wangena esibhedlela ngoMgqibelo waphuma ngoLwesibili. Uveze ukuthi indlela ashe ngayo namanje usagqigqa emtholampilo eshintshwa amabhandishi. UNomcebo, onengane enezinyanga eziyisikhombisa encelayo, kuthiwa akasakwazi nokuyincelisa ngenxa yokusha.UMadlopha uthe indodakazi yakhe ibingesona isitha nomakhelwane kodwa bake baxabana (indodakazi nomakhelwane). Uthe uzwile ukuthi umsolwa usagqunywe esitokisini kodwa akakwazanga ukulandela imininingwane yecala ngoba ukude.USEHLULEKA nokuncelisa uNomcebo Madlopha okuthiwa ushiswe umama wakamakhelwane ngoba epheke iphalishi kwakhe engekho Izithombe: ZITHUNYELWEUNomcebo uthe umakhelwane uke wamsola ngokufihla indodana yakhe ngoba yahamba ekhaya yangabuya.“Izingane zakhe zijwayele ukungivakashela. Kuzona kukhona neyomfana eneminyaka engu-13. Yahamba kubo iyodlala kwathi ngakusasa yazolala ekhaya. Unina wasola mina ngokuyifihla wabikela nobaba,” kusho yena.Echaza ngosuku lwesigameko uthe umsolwa wangena kubo ephethe ujeke uvaliwe.“Ungibhunyele ngawo emzimbeni ebuza ukuthi bengifunani kwakhe. Akazisolanga ngisho sengishile kunalokho ungishayile washaya nengane yami endala. Kuhluleke ngisho indoda yakhe izama ukulamula engasabambeki. Ngesikhathi engishaya kwadabuka ingubo yakhe wathi ibiza kabi kumele ngiyithenge. Ungisabise ngokuthi uzongidubula ngoba akudlalelwa kuyena,” kuchaza uNomcebo.Uthe ushe emabeleni, ethangeni, engalweni ngasemlenzeni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-34 uboshelwe icala lokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Uthe uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMtubatuba ngoLwesithathu, icala lahlehliselwa uMsombuluko ozayo.

KUBHUNTSHE umngcwabo abamakhaza begoloza nesidumbu befuna imali okuthiwa bebengavumelananga ngayo nomndeni kamufi.Umndeni wakwaMohlakwana eMzongwane, eMatatiele, ukhala ezimathonsi ngezindleko othi ufakwe kuzo yinkampani yabangcwabi iHambakahle Funeral Parlour ekwaV eMlaza, kulandela ukunqaba nesidumbu sikaNksz Buhle Mohlakwana (35) okuthiwa ushonele esibhedlela iKing George eThekwini ngesonto eledlule.Isidumbu bekulindeleke ukuthi sifike eMatatiele ngoLwesihlanu. Kuthiwa bese kwenziwe zonke izinhlelo zokuthi afihlwe ngoMgqibelo.UNkk Mavundle Khoza waseMatatiele ethintwa yiSolezwe uthe bezwe ubuhlungu obukhulu ngesikhathi bethintwa ngocingo wudadewabo kamufi uNksz Busisiwe Mohlakwana, ebazisa ukuthi abamakhaza abebeke kuwo udadewabo, bayanqaba nesidumbu.“Sihlale kwaze kwasa silindile ukuthi isidumbu kuzothiwa siyeza, hleze abamakhaza bashintshe umqondo kodwa lutho. Omakhelwane abebezosikhalisa kudingeke ukuthi babuyele emakhaya. Sifile ngezindleko esingene kuzo kulungiselelwa umngcwabo ebesazi ukuthi uzoba ngoMgqibelo,” kusho uNkk Khoza.UNksz Mohlakwana uthe usola ambize ngomnikazi wenkampani yabangcwabi uMnuz Ndabezinhle Manzi ngokubalutha ethi uzobagcinela isidumbu emakhazeni ngemali encane okuthe uma sebesayinile washayela ucingo amalungu omndeni wafuna imali enkulu.“Ngesikhathi ngithola ucingo lokuthi udadewethu ushonile, ngiphuthume esibhedlela. Osebenza emakhazeni kahulumeni othe ungowakwaKhanyile, usitshele ukuthi kubiza kakhulu ukugcina umuntu emakhazeni kahulumeni ngakho kungakuhle sithole awethu amakhaza lapha sizomgcina khona,” kusho uNksz Mohlakwana.Uthe bacele umsebenzi ukuthi abaxhumanise nenkampani yabangcwabi engabasiza njengoba bengenayo imali eyisamba yokukhokhela amakhaza, wabe esebaxhumanisa noManzi.Uthe ufike kubo wathembisa ukuthi uzobenzela konke bese bona bemkhokhela imali abanayo ngohlelo lwesitolimende.Uveze ukuthi bavumelane ngoR11 000 kuhlanganisa ibhokisi nemali yokuhambisa isidumbu eMatatiele.“Sekumele kuthathwe isidumbu, uManzi ufune uR17 000, wasinqabela nokuthi sibone isidumbu ethi sikhona emakhazeni kodwa sizosibona uma sesikhokhile.”Kuthintwa uManzi, uthe umndeni yiwona ozikhethele uhlobo lokungcwaba olubiza uR17 000.“Bakhethe ibhokisi oluwuhlobo olubizayo ngoba udadewabo kamufi ubethenjiswe abaqashi bakhe ukuthi bazomnika imali enguR10 000. Uthe omunye uR10 000 uzowuthola kusonhlalakahle obelandela udaba lokugula kukamufi,” kusho uManzi.Ukhale ngezindleko athe ungene kuzo eya ezihlotsheni zikamufi, ehla enyuka ngemoto yomsebenzi eyobanxusa ukuthi bakhokhe ngenxa yokuthi bebengasamthinti kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezintathu kungaxhunyanwa.Emuva kokungenelela kweSolezwe namaphoyisa asesiteshini saseMlaza umndeni ogcine ubike kuwo, uManzi uthe bavumelene nomndeni ngokuthi isidumbu uzosihambisa namuhla.UNksz Mohlokwana ukuqinisekisile ukuthi bavumelene noManzi, ngokukhokha imali enguR7 500.Uthe babikele amaphoyisa aseMlaza agcine esebaphelezela ukuyoxoxa noManzi.

KUSIZE ukungenelela koNyazilwezulu kuhoxa isinqumo sokuxoshwa kwabagcotshwa abangu-23 baseBuhleni, kwaShembe, okuphume incwadi yokuthi kabasavumelekile ukuhlangana namakholwa, besolwa ngokuqambela amanga umholi walolu hlangothi.Ngeledlule iSolezwe ngeSonto libike ngokuchithwa kwabagcotshwa basemathempelini ehlukene oPhongolo, obekuthiwa amakholwa kumele ashiye amathempeli uma bengena kuwona ngoba kabasavunyelwe ukuhlangana namalungu ebandla.Omunye wabaholi othintekayo kulolu daba, elingatholakalanga igama lakhe ozibize ngoBiyela, uthe kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi kube nomhlangano wokuxazulula le nkinga ngemuva kokungenela koNyazilwezulu.“UNyazilwezulu lusibizile, lwasitshela ukuthi kaluhambisani nesinqumo sokuxoshwa kwabagcotshwa abaningi kangaka.“Luthe lucela ukuthi sihlele umhlangano, sixoxe ukuxazulula le nkinga.“Nathi besivele sifisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi lolu daba luyaxazululeka ngoba bese kusele isithombe esingesihle, sokuthi kuxoshwe abagcotshwa abaningi ngalolu hlobo.“Noma singakalunqumi usuku esizohlangana ngalo kodwa bonke abagcotshwa obekuthiwa sebexoshiwe ebandleni, babuyele bayakhonza njengenjwayelo,” kusho uBiyela.Okhulumela abaseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe uthe kuyabajabulisa ukuthi lolu daba luyaxazululeka. Uveze ukuthi kuhamba phezu kwamagama ayewashilo, ukuthi uNyazilwezulu ngeke luvume kuxoshwe abantu ngalolu hlobo ebandleni.

SEKUBHALISWE u-93% weziguli ezisebenzisa izikhungo zezempilo ezingaphansi kukaMasipala uBuhlebezwe, eHarry Gwala, okuyingxenye yokulungiselela umshwalense wezempilo kahulumeni iNational Health Insurance (NHI).Lokhu kuvezwe uNkk Siphiwe Maseko oyisikhulu esiphezulu esibhedlela iChrist the King, izolo ngesikhathi echazela uNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kuleli uDkt Zweli Mkhize nozakwabo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu, abebehambele kulo masipala bezobheka ibanga eselihanjiwe ukulungiselela iNHI.UNkk Maseko uthe u-93% weziguli ezisebenzisa imitholampilo engaphansi kwalo masipala sezibhalisiwe.Uthe imitholampilo iGcinokuhle, iHlokozi ne-Ixopo ihamba phambili ngokulungiselela kahle iNHI.Yize kulo masipala kuvela ukuthi wenza kahle ekubhalisweni kweziguli, uNkk Maseko uveze ukuthi isibhedlela sidala futhi ingqalasizinda yaso isigugile kanti sithola iziguli eziningi ezivela kwabanye omasipala eziza kuso ngenxa yokuthi kulula ukufinyelela kuso uma usebenzisa ezokuthutha zomphakathi.“Isibhedlela sakhiwa ngo-1938, ukukhula kwesibalo seziguli ezihambela kuso kwenza ukuthi sisebenze kanzima ngoba ingqalasizinda yethu incane, ikhemisi lethu lincane, indawo yokwamukela iziguli incane, indawo esilahla kuyo udoti incane. Kunezikhala zemisebenzi ezingagcwalisiwe okusifakela ingcindezi. Sike sazama ukuthola umhlaba kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya ngoba umhlaba oseduze kwethu kutholakale ukuthi awukulungele ukwakha,” kusho yena.UMkhize uthe izinkinga ezikhona manje zeziguli ezima kolayini abade ezikhungweni zezempilo, ukushoda kwemithi nabasebenzi ngeke kuvimbe ukuqala kweNHI.UMnuz Ntokozo Mkhize, onguSihlalo webhodi lalesi sibhedlela, uthe ukushoda kwabasebenzi abalungisa izinto ezifile esibhedlela kuyinkinga ekubeni iNHI ibalula ukuthi okungenani kumele kube nabasebenzi abangu-60% ukuze isebenze kahle.Inkosi uPhathisizwe Chiliza ithe iNHI bengamakhosi bayayeseka ngoba bakholwa wukuthi kuzosizakala abantu abahluphekayo ebebengeke basizakale ezibhedlela ezizimele.IMeya yaseHarry Gwala, uMnuz Zamo Nxumalo, ithe ukhona umhlaba kamasipala ongasetshenziswa uma umnyango unezinhlelo zokusinweba lesi sibhedlela ngoba ukwakha amabhilidi amade kubukeka kungabiza kakhulu.

UZILENGISILE umfundi wesilisa okuthiwa ubezama ukuqabula omunye umfundi wesifazane abafunda naye ekilasini, wazama nokumdlwengula.Kubikwa ukuthi uNkosinathi Thusi (17) obekade enza uGrade 9 e-Allenridge Secondary eTembisa, uzame ukuqabula omunye umfundi wesifazane abafunda naye, umphathi wesikole wamsola ngokuthi udlwengulile, okuyinto okubikwa ukuthi iholele ekutheni umfundi osolwayo agcine esezibulele.Uyise walo mfundi ufuna izimpendulo ngokuzilengisa kwengane yakhe njengoba ethi isikole asifuni ukuphumela obala ngokwenzekile.Ngokusho kukayise kaNkosinathi, uMnuz Richard Thusi, indodana yakhe izilengisele kwenye indlu kwakhe ngentambo eyibophele emapulangweni asophahleni lwendlu ebingakaqedwa ukufulelwa.Ngokusho kukaThusi, bathole emuva kokuzilengisa kwendodana yakhe ukuthi kunencwadi eyayiyinikezwe esikoleni, yokuthi ibuye nomzali njengoba isolwa ngokuqabula omunye umfundi nangokumdlwengula.Kule ncwadi ebukeka eyifomu, kubhalwe ukuthi ‘ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi’, nokuthi ‘ukudlwengula’.Kuphinde kwabhalwa ukuthi lo mfundi uzame ukuphoqa ukuthi agibele phezu kwalo mfundi, okuyinto okuthiwa ubeseyenza okwesibili.UThusi uthe bathole le mininingwane emuva kokuthi indodana yakhe isizilengisile, ukuthi kunencwadi ebinikezwe yona nguthishanhloko walesi sikole, echaza ngesenzo okuthiwa isenzile.Ngaphandle kwencwadi ebivela esikoleni etholakale ezincwadini zendodana yakhe, uthe uphinde wathola enye incwadi ebhalwe yashiywa yindodana yakhe ngokuzibulala kwayo.“Uthishanhloko uvumile ukuthi nguyena owanika uNkosinathi incwadi. Okungixakayo wukuthi ayisayiniwe futhi ayinaso isigxivizo sesikole,” kusho uThusi.Uthe uma ebuza uthishanhloko ngalokhu akayitholi impendulo ecacile.“Ngiphinde ngabuza omunye wothisha, wangitshela ukuthi akaboni ukuthi wayengakwenza kanjani ukuzama ukuqabula omunye umfundi aphinde agibele phezu kwakhe ekubeni yena wayekhona ekilasini,” kuchaza uThusi.NgokukaThusi, akekho okhuluma into ezwakalayo nebambekayo kulesi sikole uma ebuza ngalolu daba.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng uMnuz Steve Mabona, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi lolu daba bayalwazi.“Abahloli yibona abaphenya lolu daba futhi bayaxhumana nomndeni kamufi ukuze kucace ngokwenzekile,” kusho uMabona.Uthe umphumela wophenyo yiwona ozokusho ukuthi yisiphi isinyathelo okumele basithathe, wakucacisa ukuthi ophule inqubomgomo yokusebenza komthetho olawula ezemfundo, bazobhekana naye ngqo.“Ngeke sikubekezelele ukungaziphathi kahle ezikoleni”.Uthe bayazwelana nomndeni ngokwenzekile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseGauteng, uCaptain Mavela Masondo, uthe amaphoyisa akule ndawo aphenya ngokufa komfundi.“Sisazolindela kuqala umphumela wokuhlinzwa kwesidumbu ukuze sithole ukuthi ngempela kwenzekeni,” kusho uMasondo.

OWAYENGUNGQONGQOSHE wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, uNksz Bathabile Dlamini uthi akanandaba nabamgxekayo bemenza idimoni kodwa ujabulela ukuphinda athole ithuba lokusebenzela abantu ngoba yilokho akwazi kangcono.UNksz Dlamini onguMengameli we-ANCWL, ubephawula emuva kokuqokelwa esikhundleni sokuba nguSihlalo weBhodi elingaphansi koMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwabantu, elibizwa ngeSocial Housing Regulatory Authority (SHRA). Uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango uNkk Lindiwe Sisulu ukuba ahole lolu phiko olungaphansi komnyango wakhe.UNksz Dlamini uqokelwe kulesi sikhundla emuva kokuhlala ekhaya isikhashana engabuyiselwanga kwiKhabhinethi.Uke waba sematheni ngezindaba eziningi kukhalwa kakhulu ngendlela asebenza ngayo.Wesula nasesikhundleni sokuba yilungu lePhalamende emuva kokushawa ngesithende ngesikhathi uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ebophela isikimu esisha.“Ngibonga usisi Lindiwe Sisulu ngokwethembela kimi. Kwakunomkhankaso wokungcolisa igama lami kube ngathi ngiyidimoni. Ngizimisele ngokubeka abantu phambili ngaso sonke isikhathi ngoba ngiyathanda ukusebenzela abahlwempu,’’ kuchaza uNksz Dlamini.Echaza ngezivuvaba ake abhekana nazo esengungqongqoshe, uthe yisimo esamhlukumeza kakhulu yena nomndeni wakhe nabazali bakhe asebebadala kakhulu."Angithi abazali bami basekhona futhi baneminyaka engu-84, manje bebehlukumezeka kakhulu uma ngihlunyezwa nami. Izingane zami zathwala kanzima ngaleso sikhathi. Kungcono manje sengizihlalele ekhaya ngiyakwazi nokunakekela izingane. Lo msebenzi enginikwe wona manje akuwona owansuku zonke,’’Ebuzwa ngeKhabhinethi, uthe impilo yakhe kayincikile ekungeneni kwiKhabhinethi kodwa incike ekusebenzeleni abantu ngezindlela ezehlukene noma engekho kwiKhabhinethi.Kulindeleke ukuthi aqale maduze emsebenzini omusha njengoba eveze ukuthi useke wavela ehhovisi, kwalungiswa konke okuyimicikilisho watshelwa kabanzi nangomsebenzi wakhe.

BASHAQEKILE onogada kutholwa izidumbu zozakwabo abayizithandani okusolwa ukuthi bazibulale omunye wazilengisa endaweni abasebenzela kuyo.Kuthiwa isidumbu sikaMnuz Siphelele "Ntezimnand" Ngobese waseHluhluwe sitholwe silenga endlini okuhlala kuyo onogada uma begadile enkundleni yezemidlalo eCongela, eThekwini, ngoLwesibili ebusuku kwathi esentombi yakhe ebizithwele, uNksz Boni "Ntezimnandikaz" Myeni waseNanda, satholwa sidindilize eceleni kwesesoka lakhe sinentambo entanyeni.Kuthiwa bebesebenzela inkampani eyodwa yonogada iVusa Isizwe Security esebenzela eThekwini.UMnuz Mboniseni Mdletshe, ongumphathi kule nkampani yonogada elandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzekile, uthe babikelwe ngalesi sigameko omunye unogada obecelwe uNgobese ukuthi ambambele emsebenzini ngoba kukhona okuthile amatasa ngakho.“Lo nogada uthe ngesikhathi esendlini egadile uzwe okuthile okuwayo emnyango okuthe uma ephuma eqalaza wabona izithandani zimi eceleni komnyango. Uthe zithe bezimthusa zifuna ukubona ukuthi uzokwenzenjani zabe sezimnika imali zicela ukuthi ayozithengela i-drink,” kuchaza uMdletshe.Uthe unogada ubatshele ukuthi ngesikhathi esendleleni ubuye washintsha umqondo wajika ngoba esola ukuthi hleze bamthuma nje bafuna ukuya ocansini besendaweni yokusebenzela. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi esebuyela emuva ufice isicabha sesikhiyiwe wangqongqoza kwangaphendula muntu.Unogada uthe kuze kwaphoqeleka ukuthi akhahlele isicabha okuthe uma sivuleka wazithela phezu kwesidumbu sikazakwabo wesilisa silenga, esowesifazane sidindilize eduze nesihlalo okukholakala ukuthi ugibele kusona ngesikhathi ezilengisa.UMdletshe uthe emuva kokuthola umbiko uphuthume endaweni yesehlakalo.“Ngesikhathi ngifika bekunencwadi engisola ukuthi ibhalwe owesilisa ebithi : 'Ngicela ukuxolisa ngesinqumo engisithathile kodwa ngibuye ngingaxolisi ngoba kukhona abanye abafowethu abazokhululeka ngami',” kusho uMdletshe.Uthe uphinde wabona incwadi asola ukuthi ibhalwe ngowesifazane ebithi: 'Ngicela ukuxolisa ngesinqumo engisithathile ngicela nisale ningigadele izingane zami kodwa vele nizokhululeka ngoba beningangidingi.'"Isolezwe libuye labona enye incwadi okuthiwa ibhalwe uNgobese enxusa ozakwabo ethi uma sebeza emngcwabeni wakhe abagqoke izikibha ezinobuso bakhe.UNkk Nomandla Nyawo, ongunina kaNksz Myeni, uthe bebengalazi isoka lendodakazi yakhe futhi nokuthi izithwele ukuzwe sekwenzeke lesi sehlo. Uthe indodakazi yakhe ishiye ezinye izingane ezimbili, eneminyaka emihlanu neneminyaka emithathu.“Okwenzekile kusishaqise kakhulu kodwa siyasamukela isimo. Nathi sitshelwe ukuthi uzibulele kodwa sizolinda uphenyo lwamaphoyisa,” kusho uNkk Nyawo.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni kaNgobese ayiphumelelanga ngenxa yokuthi inombolo Isolezwe ebelinayo ibingangeni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCol Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuyaphenywa ngokutholwa kwesidumbu sowesilisa oneminyaka engu-23 silenga nesowesifazane oneminyaka engu-24.

BASHAQEKILE abasebenzi bakaMasipala wasoLundi emuva kokuthi indoda eqapha izikhulu zomkhandlu idubule uzakwabo obesebenza kwizicishamlilo wafa endaweni yokucima ukoma ngeSonto.Indoda (35), engeke ize idalulwe ngoba ayikabuzwa ukuthi iyalivuma noma iyaliphika yini icala, izolo bekulindeleke ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoLundi mayelana necala lokubulala uMnuz Phakamani Bukhosini (27).Kuthiwa kube nokulizisana phakathi kokuthiwa udubulile nomufi endaweni yokucima ukoma. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni adonse isibhamu adubule umufi kaningana.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ukuthi umufi uqale wadutshulwa onyaweni, wabe eseyaxolisa, ecela ukuthi angabulawa.Kuthiwa ilapho emdubule khona amahlandla amaningi, waze wasondela eduze ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi usefile.Omunye umthombo ongaphakathi kumasipala uthe umdubuli ubengasasiphathi isibhamu somsebenzi ngenxa yokuba nodlame ekhaya.“Usebenzise isibhamu sakhe okungesona esomsebenzi. Ubaziwa ukuthi unesandla esilula, uma eke waxabana nomuntu uvele asikhiphe, noma adubule.“Unolaka olumangalisayo. Yingakho ubengasanikezwa isibhamu somsebenzi,” kusho umthombo ocele ukungadalulwa.Imenenja yoMkhandlu wasoLundi, uMntwana Nkosenye Zulu, uthe abasebenzi bashaqekile ngokwenzekile.“Sikhungathekile njengomkhandlu nabasebenzi emveni kokuthi sithole izindaba ezithi omunye wabasebenzi bethu ongumqaphi udubule omunye umsebenzi wethu obesebenza kwizicishamlilo wambulala,” kusho uZulu.Uthe bezwe kuthiwa kube nokuhilizisana okuthile phakathi kwabasenzi babo nokugcine ngokuthi kudutshulwe.“Umufi obesebenza kwizicishamlilo ubelindele ukubizwa emsebenzini noma yinini. Umsolwa ubengasebenzi besendaweni yokuzithokozisa babe sebeyaxabana. Asazi ukuthi kubangweni kwagcina ngokuthi lona ongumqaphi adubule abulale lona obeyisicishamlilo,” kusho uZulu.Uthe namhlanje (izolo) bekungasebenzeki kubasebenzi baze babiza izinceku ukuba zizokhuleka.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uBrigader Jay Naicker, uthe indoda (35) ivele eNkantolo yeMantshi yasoLundi namhlanje (izolo) mayelana necala lokubulala.“Kuyasoleka ukuthi ngoNovemba 3, indoda (27) idutshulwe yashona emgwaqweni uBhambatha e-Unit B oLundi. Umufi ubenamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa, kuvulwe icala lokubulala esiteshini samaphoyisa oLundi ukuze kuphenywe,” kusho uNaicker.

source: usizi ngesimo somndeni osuhlale ehlathini iminyaka
text: WAFIKA eThekwini ezonakekela indodakazi eyashayiswa yimoto owesifazane osehlala nomndeni wakhe ehlathini eWestville, eThekwini.Sekuphele iminyaka emithathu uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini ehlala ehlathini nezingane eziyisihlanu. Kulezi zingane kukhona indodana uThulebona Dlamini (17) indodana kamfowabo u-Andile Zulu (26), ekamzala wakhe uMbulelo Mdledle, indodakazi uDineo (10) nomzukulu uPrincess (5). Amadodana kaNksz Dlamini okunguSphiwe Dlamini (30) noZamani Dlamini (23) abhadla ejele ngamacala ahlukene, nawo abehlala kuleli hlathi. Umzukulu okuthiwa walaxazwa ngunina, uzalwa ngenye yamadodana asejele.Indlela eya kulo mjondolo osehlathini idlula ezihlahleni eziminyene. Weqa ibhuloho elakhiwe ngezigxobo njengoba kunomfula ngaphansi. Elandisa Isolezwe uNksz Dlamini, uthe wasuka eXobho indodakazi yakhe uSne ishayiswe yimoto.USne owashona ngo-2016 eneminyaka engu-25, kuthiwa wayehlala emjondolo eSydenham eThekwini.“Ngafica isimo sakhe sisibi esibhedlela, onesi bathi akumele ngibe kude naye. Ngaquba isikhashana komunye umjondolo eSydenham ngabuye ngaxoshwa. Kuthe ngizihambela ngabona leli hlathi, ngazobeka umjondolo sahlala sonke nezingane. Bengiya zonke izinsuku esibhedlela futhi yayingekho enye indlela ngaphande kokufuna umjondolo ukusondelela.” Uthe indodakazi yakhe yagcina ishonile njengoba ibigula ehlala nayo kuleli hlathi.Kwahlanganisa ikhansela ukuze ingcwabeke.AKAFUNI ukubalisa ngosizi lwakhe uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini ohlala ehlathini nomndeni wakhe, othathwe nendodana kamfowabo ahlala nayo u-Andile ZuluKwehla izinyembezi uma exoxa ngokushona kwendodakazi yakhe, athe kwamhlukumeza kakhulu. Okwamhlukumeza wukuthi bekungasekho nokuphindela ekhaya njengoba athola ukuthi umuzi wakhe washa. Uveze nokuthi bekuvele kungabhekwana emndenini, namanje akukho sihlobo axhumana naso.UNksz Dlamini ongathandi ukugqamisa usizi lwakhe, uziphilisa ngokudayisa amakhalibhothi awaqoqa emgwaqweni.Uphinde abe netafula lokudayisa izithelo eduze kwegaraji ngaseWestwood Mall. Yindodakazi yakhe kuphela ehola isibonelelo sikahulumeni njengoba umzukulu ethe usaholelwa ngunina yize amlaxaza.“Uma ngiyodayisa ngihamba nazo izingane zamantombazane ngoba akuphephile ehlathini. Izingubo nokudla siphiwa ngabantu, nakho kubuye kwebiwe yizigebengu.”UMJONDOLO osehlathini eWestville okuhlala kuwo uNksz Bonisiwe Dlamini nomndeni onezingane eziyisihlanu. Isithombe:Isolezwe lifike izingane zibase phansi zipheka ngamathini amnyama. Lo mndeni ugeza emfuleni oseduze, ubuye ucele amanzi egaraji.UMfundisi Bheki Nxumalo ofundisa eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe uqale ngePhasika ukubona uNksz Dlamini obehlala eqhamuka ehlathini nezingane.“Ngathatha inombolo yakhe yocingo ngayobona nalapho ehlala khona. Angikholwanga ukuthi kunabantu abaphila le mpilo,” kusho uNxumalo.UMnuz Warren Burne oyikhansela kule ndawo okuthiwe uyazi ngodaba, akatholakalanga ocingweni, wathunyelelwa iSMS engaphendulwanga.

source: uthole ibheyili owe anc odabeni lwesibhamu
text: LIGWEME ihlazo lokulandwa yiveni lakhetha ukuzinikela emaphoyiseni ilungu eliqavile le-ANC, elibhekene necala lokukhomba uzakwabo ngesibhamu ngesikhathi betholana phezulu emhlanganweni.UMnuz Arthur Zwane, uzinikele emaphoyiseni kuleli sonto mayelana nezinsolo zokukhomba uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka ngesibhamu ngesikhathi bexabana. UHlomuka uyiPhini likaNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, uphethe nesokuba nguNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba Zomdabu.Kuthiwa uZwane wangena nezicabha emhlanganweni ongena njalo ngoMsombululo, wacela uHlomuka esitikini batholana phezulu phambi kwabaholi baze balanyulwa.Kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi ancengwe uZwane abeke phansi isibhamu ngoba wayengezwa lutho, esho ukumqeda uHlomuka.UZwane uke waba sesigungwini esiphezulu se-ANC KwaZulu-Natal waphatha nesikhundla sikaSihlalo we-ANC eMalahleni.Kuthiwa uzinikele emaphoyiseni eDurban Central, ehamba nommeli wakhe wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini wadedelwa ngebheyili kaR10 000. Kulindeleke ukuthi abuyele eNkantolo ngoFebhuwari 18 wonyaka ozayo.Imithombo ithi uZwane ubonile ukuthi uzohlazeka uma elinda amaphoyisa ukuthi azomgaxa ozankosi, wavela waziyela yena.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ricardo Mthembu uthe ngeke aphawule ngokuzinikela kukaZwane emaphoyiseni ngoba akanayo into ephathekayo kodwa usazothola kahle uma sekunomhlangano.“Umhlangano wethu ojwayelekile uzoba ngoMsombuluko, sizozwa kahle umbiko ophelele ngalolo daba ngoba angazi kahle ngike ngezwa ngenye intatheli ingibuza,’’ kuchaza uMthembu.Uke wacashunwa phambilini ethi indaba kaZwane noHlomuka isetshenzwa wubuholi obuphezulu obuzama ukuthi ixoxwe, kuthelelwane amanzi. Kuthiwa kuke kwaba nomhlangano kwelinye lamahhotela kuxoxwa ngayo le ndaba.
