KUNXUSWA abafundi bakamatric ukuthi bangayoni inyufomu yabo uma beqeda ukubhala iphepha lokugcina kodwa banikele ngayo ukuze isize abanye.Inhlangano yentsha i-Rise Black Child Enterprise ezinze eThekwini igqugquzela uhlelo i-Gqoka School Mate okuzoqoqwa ngalo inyufomu nezincwadi zokufunda kubafundi abazobe bebhala iphepha labo lokugcina kuleli sonto.Iningi labafundi liphothula izivivinyo zikamatric namhlanje ngephepha lesiNgisi kanti ngoLwesihlanu lezi zivivinyo zisongwa nge-Agricultural Technology.UMnuz Sazi “Buso” Gumede ongumsunguli inhlangano, uthe uhlelo lokuqoqwa kwenyufomu balugxilise kakhulu ezikoleni eziseNdwedwe naseVerulam lapho inhlangano izinze khona kodwa wathi bayayimukela iminikelo evela kubafundi bakuzo zonke izikole ukuze kusizakale abafundi abavela emindenini entulayo.“Inyufomu sizoyiqoqa siyithunge uma kunesidingo bese siyihambisa elondolo ngaphambi kokuthi siyidlulisele kwabanye abafundi abayidingayo abavela emakhaya ahluphekayo basezikoleni ezehlukene zaseNdwedwe naseVerulam,” kusho uGumede.Uthe uhlelo lokuqoqwa kwenyufomo bazolwenza ngoLwesine noLwesihlanu, wacela abafundi ukuthi bahambise inyufomu ezikhungweni abebebhalela kuzo, erenke yamabhasi eVerulam nasesitolo sokudla iBoxer eNdwedwe.Inhlangano yabafundi iCongress of South African Students (COSAS) nayo icele abafundi ukuthi bangayoni inyufomu.UNobhala jikelele weCOSAS, uTebogo Mogafane, uthe abafundi kumele bangasheshi bagajwe yinjabulo yokuqeda ukubhala ngoba imiphumela ayikaphumi.“Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu. Sinxusa abafundi ukuthi badlulisele inyufomu kwabanye uma bengesezukuyisebenzisa. Kuyisiko lethu njengama-Afrika ukulula isandla sisize abanye abantu abayidingayo,” kusho uMogafane.

SEKUSHONE abantu abangu-14 KwaZulu-Natal ngenxa yemvula enamandla okusaminciwe njengoba kuxwayiswe ngokuthi izoqhubeka namuhla nakusasa. Kushone ababili, kwadilika izindlu, kwasiphuka nezihlahla. Isiphepho esihlasele sashiya kukhalwa eMpolweni kuMasipala uMshwathi ngoLwesibili ntambama.Kulimale abantu abangaphezu kuka-20, othayela bemizi eminingi basale beyimifunzane phansi abanye begaxele ezintanjeni zikagesi. Kukhahlamezeke imizi ewu-798.Abashonile bacindezelwe yizindonga nophahla lwezindlu oludilikele kubona.Kwenzeka lesi sehlo eMpolweni nje ngoMsombuluko ebusuku kushone uMnuz Simangaliso Zondo (68) noNksz Nomathemba Nyangule (55) ngenxa yemvula enamandla eMaoti, eNanda. NgeSonto kushone uNksz Sthembile Nothile Zimba (24) oshaywe wumbani kuMasipala uKhahlamba.KUSALE kumapeketwane eMpolweni ngemuva kwesiphepho esisiphule izihlala sadiliz imizi sacekela phansi ingqalasizinda kagesi. Isithombe: Leon Lestrade/ANAUNkk Nonhlanhla Buthelezi (44) wasesigodini iThokozani, eMpolweni, ushone ngesikhathi kusiphuka isihlahla esikhulu ebesisegcekeni lakwakhe siwele phezu kwendlu yodaka yamcindezela.Kuthiwa omakhelwane bazamile ukumtakula washona sekufika i-ambulensi.Indodakazi yakhe uNksz Noluthando Buthelezi (19) ithe unina umyalele ukuthi mabayoquba kwamakhelwane nezingane zakwabo ezincane ezimbili ngesikhathi sekuqala isiphepho.“Sithe sesikamakhelwane ngathi uma ngibuka ekhaya ngabona kungasekho lutho. Ngitshele ebengihlezi nabo ukuthi umama usele endlini abasilekelele siyombheka hleze ucindezelekile,” kusho uNksz Buthelezi ngosizi.UNKSZ Velephi Mncube olimale ebusweni kuhlasela isiphepho eMpolweni. Isithombe: Leon Lestrade/ANAUthe balale komakhelwane kanti abazi bazokwenza njani ngoba kuwe insika yekhaya.“Umama ubengasebenzi, esizamela ngoba besingalali singadlile. Ubenza ngakho konke okusemandleni ukusiphilisa siyizingane zakhe,” kusho uNksz Buthelezi othe usale nakugqokile emuva kwesiphepho.Bude buduze nalo mndeni esigodini eMvundweni kushone uMnuz Siphelele Ndlovu (40).Ngokusho kukanina, uNkk Thunyeliwe Ndlovu (63) bebehleIi bebathathu endlini ngesikhathi bezwa umoya omkhulu uhambisana nemvula enamandla.“Ngisukume ngaqonda ekamelweni ngiyogqoka ijezi. Sengisekamelweni ngizwe umsindo omkhulu wento ewayo obuqhamuka egunjini ebengisuka kulona. Ngibuye ngokushesha ngiyobheka ngafica uphahla nodonga lwendlu sekuwile kwacindezela uSphe kwalimala onyaweni umakhelwane ebesihleli naye,” kusho uNkk Ndlovu.Uthe bazamile ukususa izitini nothayela obekumcindezele umufi kwasho khona ukuthi amandla akanawo walinda isiphepho sadlula wabe eseyocela usizo komakhelwane.Wonke umuzi wakwaNdlovu ongamagumbi amahlanu udilikile. Izolo bebepequlula ezaleni abasengakwazi ukukusebenzisa.UNkk Velephi Mncube ulimale ebusweni ngemuva kokuwelwa yindlu abehleli kuyona nomyeni wakhe uMnuz Velaphi Mncube ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo.“Indlu iwe siphakathi. Ngishaywe yinto engingabonanga ukuthi yini ngabona sengopha. Ngiye esibhedlela ngayothungwa ebusweni. Wonke umuzi wethu wamagumbi amathathu uwile. Silale komakhelwane isimo singesihle neze. Asazi sothathani sihlanganise nani ngoba asisenalutho,” kubalisa uNkk Mncube.Kamakhelwane kwaMncube kudilike umuzi wonke obungamagumbi amathathu.UMnuz Andile Ntuli uthe kuqhamuke ifu elikhulu elimnyama lihambisana nomoya onamandla nemvula.Uthe babaleke bangena endlini eyakhiwe ngezitini sekuqala isiphepho.“Sicashe ngetafula kukubi. Sizwe kuqhuma umsindo omkhulu emuva kwalokho kwacima ugesi. Njengamanje asinalutho,” kusho uNtuli.Izolo uNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka nowezeziMali uMnuz Ravi Pillay bahambele le ndawo beyohlola umonakalo odalekile bekhalisana nemindeni eshonelwe nelinyalelwe yizihlobo zayo.Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana, abathintekayo bathuthelwe emahholo nakwezinye izakhiwo zomphakathi okubalwa kuzo namasonto kanti kunamathimba eminyango ehlukene ahlola umonakalo alekelela nabakhahlamezekile.Esitatimendeni abakwa-Eskom baveze ukuthi bangu-3 906 abantu abasale bengenawo ugesi eMpolweni ngemuva kwesiphepho.Bathe basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukulungisa ingqalasizinda ehlinzeka lezi zindawo ugesi ecekeleke phansi.Uthe lokhu kuzothatha isikhashana ngoba bafuna ukwenza isiqiniseko ukuthi izintambo eziphakela ugesi ziphephile ngaphambi kokuthi bawukhanyise.

OWAYEYISIKHULU kwezokuxhumana kuhulumeni kwiGCIS uMnuz Themba Maseko, useveze okushayisanayo nobufakazi obathulwa owayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngokuthi kungani asuswa esikhundleni sakhe wanikezwa omunye umsebenzi kuhulumeni.UMaseko obesebuya isibili kwikhomishini ephenya ukulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana, watshela ikhomishini nyakenye ukuthi wasuswa esikhundleni ngoba wanqaba ukusiza umndeni wakwaGupta ukuthola ingxenye yemali eyayinguR600 million.Uthi washayelwa ucingo nguZuma ngaphambi kokuba ahlangane noGupta owamnxusa ukusiza lo mndeni.UZuma evela kule khomishini ngoJulayi wakuchitha ukuthi watshela uMnuz Collins Chabane, owayengungqongqoshe wezisebenzi zikahulumeni ukuba axoshe uMaseko. Uthe kungenzeka nje ukuthi uChabane noMaseko babengazwananga kahle okungenzeka ukuthi kwaholela ukuba amxoshe.“Ngicabanga ukuthi owayengumengameli ubufakazi bakhe abulona iqiniso. Akukaze kube nenkinga phakathi kwami noChabane. Sasinobudlelwane obuqinile futhi indlela adlulisa ngayo umyalezo wayeveza ukuthi ushaqekile ngezinto ezenzeka,” kusho uMaseko.UMaseko wasuswa esikhundleni sakhe wayiswa emnyangweni wezaBasebenzi bakaHulumeni nokuPhatha.Wahlala izinyanga ezintathu kuphela kulo msebenzi.

OWAYEYILUNGU lePhalamende eBritain uLord Peter Hain, ugxeke izinhlangano zemali ngokuvumela abomndeni wakwaGupta ukuba bafake imali engekho emthethweni emazweni ahlukene okwenza kwaba lula ukulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.Efakaza ngoMsombuluko uHain utshele iKhomishini kaZondo ukuthi ngeke kwagxekwa uhlangothi olulodwa ngoba amabhange nezinkampani zokuxhumanisa umphakathi ezaba nesandla ekutheni umndeni wakwaGupta uthumele imali yawo ezindaweni ezehlukeni ezweni jikelele.“Ukuze kube yimpumelelo ukulawulwa kombuso yindlanzana, kwahlangana izinkampani ezisemazweni ahlukene zezimali nezinye izinhlangano nabanye bohulumeni bamazwe.”Ukugqamisile ukuthi amabhange amazwe angaphandle njengelaseBritain iHSBC neStandard Chartered, asetshenziswa kakhulu oGupta ukusabalalisa imali.UHain akabashiyanga ngaphandle abameli, abacwaningi mabhuku nabadayisa izindlu athi babasiza abakwaGupta ukuba bayigeze imali eyayingekho emthethweni.Wenze isibonelo ngenkampani yabacwaningi mabhuku iKPMG athi yayicwaninga amabhuku akwaGupta.Umshado wakaGupta ongundabuzekwayo owawuse-Sun City ngo-2012, uvela emabhukwini ezimali zalo mndeni ukuthi kwakungumsebenzi webhizinisi ekubeni lokho kwakungelona iqiniso.Uthe umndeni wakwaGupta wasebenzisa imali eyayitholakale ohlelweni lweVrede Dairy Farm ukwenza isiphihli somshadoIzinhlangano ezithintekayo zazingasheshe zikubambe ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi ngendlela okwakungena ngayo nokuphuma kwemali kodwa zathula.

KUSUKELA eminyakeni edlule kuze kube yimanje kuvela abaculi bekhala ngokuthi umculi othile untshontshe ingoma yakhe.Muva nje, kwiSolezwe kubhalwe ngoMalibongwe Mhlauli osola uMlindo The Vocalist ngokweba ingoma yakhe ethi Usukulude. Lolu daba seluphenduke inkombankombane njengoba uMalibongwe ethi wabhala ingoma esaphethe iqembu loMlindo iWhite Bread. Ngakolunye uhlangothi uMlindo uthi ingoma eyakhe inkinga ukuthi izingoma akazibhali, ngakho kungaqhamuka noma wubani athi umculo wakhe ngowakhe. Kumanje udaba lusezithebeni zabameli kwazise uMalibongwe ufuna uR500 000.Olunye kube wudaba lomculi wegqom’ osafufusa uNolwazi “Lwazi M” Mdluli nomculi wekwaito uTipcee.ULwazi M usola uTipcee ngokuthatha izinhlamvu zengoma yakhe azifake kweyakhe.ULwazi M usola ukuthi uTipcee izinhlamvu wazithatha benandisa emcimbini ndawonye oPhongolo.“Kulo mcimbi esasiqashwe kuwo uTipcee wangena kuqala mina ngalandela ngemuva kwakhe. Ngiyasola ukuthi wachazeka ngengoma yami wabe esentshontsha ulayini othi bayale bayale nangu uLwazi M. Engomeni yakhe ayiphushayo ezophuma kwi-albhamu yakhe, iThe Snyper ayikhiphe ngoNovemba 1, uthi yena ngiyale ngiyale nanguTipcee girl,” ucashunwe esho kanje.Ethintwa uTipcee uziphikile lezi zinsolo usole uLwazi M ngokufuna ukuduma ngaye.“Angimazi nokuthi ungubani lo sisi nokuthi ucula muphi umculo. Ufuna ukuduma ngegama lami. Emcimbini wasoPhongolo ngazifikela ekuseni sengizovala umcimbi, angikhumbuli ngimbona,” kusho uTipcee.Uthe lo mcimbi ufike esakade aqeda ukuqopha i-albhamu yakhe, ngakho akukho okuzophazamisa ukuphuma kwayo ngo-Novemba 1.Imenenja jikelele yakwaSamro, uJacqui Mabuza, ithe kubalulekile ukuthi abaculi babhalise umsebenzi wabo nabo ukuze bezolandelela ukusebenza kwazo ezindaweni ezinjengasemsakazweni nakwithelevishini futhi benze isiqiniseko sokuthi bayakhokha, imali bayidlulisa kumaciko.Uthe uma kunombango bayakwazi ukungenelela ngokuthi bamise inkokhelo ebitholwa wumculi osolwayo.“Sigqugquzela ukuthi kuxoxiswane,” kusho uJacqui.Uthe uma lokho kuhluleka bamema bonke abathintekayo ukuthi babe nomhlangano nemenenja yabo ngenhloso yokuthola isisombululo.“Uma kuhluleka kuba nesigcawu esihlelwa yiSamro nomxazululi ongummeli ogxile kwi-intellectual property ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo.”Uthe iSamro ibe isiyenza okunqunywe ngumxazululi.UJacqui uthe ababhali bezingoma nabaqambi bazo kumele babhalise mahhala kubo. Amafomu akwi-website yabo noma emahhovisi aseThekwini, eGoli naseKapa.“Kumahhala kodwa iSamro ikhona imali eyithathayo uma usuqalile ukuthola inkokhelo ngomsebenzi esiwubhekelele.”Umengameli womfelandawonye wezinyunyana zamaciko, iCultural and Creative Industries Federation of South Africa, uJoy Mbewana, uthe abaculi abayeke ukuhamba benikeza abanye izingoma bengazibhalisile.“Ubezwa bethi ngicela ungilalele, ungifake. Bhalisa ingoma kuqala ukuze ingantshontshwa. Isikhathi esiningi kuba yiciko elingaziwa okugcina kuba sengathi linamanga,” kusho uJoy.Uthe amaciko kumele azinike isikhathi afunde kabanzi ngomkhakha angena kuwo.“Kukhona abantu abanjengoKwaZulu-Natal United Music Industry Association abahlela izigcawu zokucobelelana ngolwazi futhi amaciko awajoyine izinyunyana ngoba kubalulekile ukuba nekhaya,” kuphetha uJoy.

WAYEFISA ukuba wunjiniyela uthishanhloko ochonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala ngokuba wuthishanhloko obadlula bonke ngokuphatha isikole samabanga aphezulu KwaZulu-Natal.UMnuz Philani Innocent Mathenjwa uthishanhloko waseNtulabakayise Secondary, KwaNibela, eHluhluwe, uchonywe uphaphe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, ngesikhathi ebonga futhi ekhuthaza othisha ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile emcimbini owaziwa ngeKwaZulu-Natal National Teaching Awards (NTA) obungoLwesihlanu.UMathenjwa uwine emunxeni we-Excellence in Secondary School Leadership.Uthe ukuba wuthisha kwakungewona umsebenzi ayewuthanda kunayo yonke kodwa wathola ithuba lokuthi awufundele emuva kokuthi ephuthwe yithuba lokuthi afundele iCivil Engineering.Uthe kwakuxhunywana ngokuthi kushayelwe ucingo isitolo esisendaweni bese kushiywa umyalezo wokuthi kumele aye enyuvesi. Ngenxa yokuthi kwakukude nakubo baze bamtshela sesidlulile isikhathi esasibekiwe. Wabe eseyofundela ubuthisha.UMathenjwa uneminyaka ewu-14 enguthisha. Uqale ukuba nguthishanhloko waseNtulabakayise ngo-2016 ngesikhathi lesi sikole sivulwa.Yize enguthishanhloko naye unalo ikilasi alifundisayo njengoba efundisa iMathematics kwaGrade 11 noGrade 12.“Ngiwuthisha weSayensi kodwa ngo-2017 ngiqale ukufundisa iMaths ngoba ngifuna ukubona ukuthi yini le ehlula othisha ekufundiseni iMaths.“Ngaphakathi kimi bekunokuthi uma ngikwazi ukwenza umfundi athande iSayensi, ayiqonde futhi ayiphase kahle yini engangehlula ukuthi nakwiMaths kwenziwe okufanayo.“Ngaqala ngokufundisa uGrade 11 ngaqhubeka nabo ngaya kwaGrade 12 ngoba ngifuna ukuthi uma sengichazela abahloli ngezinselelo engibe nazo ngikhulume ngento nami engiyaziyo.”Lesi sikole siphase ngo-100% nyakenye, kuwo * -60% wamaBachelor, amaDiploma angu-30% no-10% ophase ngeCertificate.UMathenjwa uthe uyena ofika kuqala esikoleni ngo-6.30 aphume ekugcineni ngo-11 ebusuku zonke izinsuku.Uthe unekilasi lokubuyekeza alisizayo elingena ngo-8 kuya ku-10 ebusuku. Abafundi bakwaGrade10, 11 no-12 bavula ngaphambi kokuthi kuvule amanye amabanga ngoba uthi usuke efuna ukuthi babe nesikhathi esanele sokubuyekeza umsebenzi wesikole ngoba isilabhasi bayiqeda ngoJuni.“Uma kuphuma isikole angihambi ngiyahlala ngenze umsebenzi wami ngibe ngizilungiselela isikhathi sokusiza abafundi abangabambi ngokushesha ekilasini. Ngenxa yokuzimisela kwami nabanye othisha sebeze bangijoyina.”Uthe uqale waqhathwa nabanye ozakwabo endaweni, waya esifundeni ngaphambi kokuthi azoqhathwa nabesifundazwe. Kuzwelonke nguye omele iKZN.“Ngijabule kakhulu ngokuchonywa uphaphe ngokwenza kahle. Le ndondo akuyona eyami kuphela kodwa ngeyothisha bonke engibambisane nabo. Thina besisebenza nje singazi nokuthi kuneso elisibhekile,” kuphetha uMathenjwa.UMshengu uthe ukuhlonishwa kwalabo thisha ukubakhuthaza nokubabonga ngomsebenzi omuhle abawenzile kulo nyaka.Uthe uyazi ukuthi abathole izindodo bazoqala unyaka ka-2020 benomfutho ngenxa yezindondo.

UMNYANGO wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nobuHoli bezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uthi usuzimisele ukwelekelela osomabhizinisi abasebancane abafuna ukwenza imikhiqizo yensangu kuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe ngungqongqoshe uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube ngesikhathi ekhuluma kwingqungquthela yensangu, iCannabis Investment Protocol, ebiseNkosi Albert Luthuli International Converntion Centre, eThekwini ngoLwesithathu. Ethula inkulumo yakhe phambi kwezihambeli zalo mcimbi uthe, ngesikhathi benesidlo sasekuseni iKZN Growth Coalition ngo-Agasti bahlongoza ukuthi bewuhulumeni bahlose ukulekelela abalimi abancane njengendlela yokulwa nokwentuleka kwemisebenzi."Sikholelwa wukuthi, maningi amathuba okusebenzisa insangu ukuze ithuthukise imboni yezolimo neminye imikhakha. Imininingwane ekhona iveza ukuthi imboni yensangu ingenza inzuzo engu-R100 billion. I-United Nations ikholwa ngukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza u-2,300 tons wensangu ngonyaka okuyenza ilale isithathu emazweni akhiqiza insangu eningi e-Afrika," kusho uDube-Ncube.Uthe iKwaZulu-Natal isona sifundazwe esisethubeni lokukhiqiza insangu eningi ngenxa yesimo sezulu kulesi sifundazwe esivuna ukukhula kwensangu kalula uma siqhathaniswa nezinye kanye namanye amazwe aphesheya, ikakhulukazi e-Europe."Siwuhulumeni asifuni ukuthi bantu basemiphakathini yethu abebevele beyitshala insangu bavaleleke ngaphandle. Siwuhulumeni sizogxila ezindaweni ezisemakhaya ngoba zinomlando omude wokutshala nokusebenzisa insangu yize bebekwenza ngokungemthetho. Njengoba uhulumeni esevula amathuba, asifuni ukuthi abantu basale ngaphandle," kusho yena.Umnyango kaDube uphinde waveza ukuthi uyazi kunezinhlangano ezikhokhisa abantu ukuze zisabalalise ulwazi ngemboni yensangu. Uthe bewumnyango basazoqhubeka nezinhlelo zamahhala zokusabalalisa ulwazi ngale mboni.

SEBEXABANE baze bafakana enkantolo abomndeni wowayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma kubangwa imali yethenda yomshini ophakela amanzi, abayifaka eNkandla. UMnuz Zobaphi Zuma, ozalwa ngumfowabo wobengumengameli noNksz Nompumelelo Mhlongo, oyisihlobo esiqavile basembangweni oshubile wemali.UZuma (Zobaphi) ukhala ngoNksz Mhlongo ngokugweva nemali athi babeyithole emuva kokuthola ithenda yokufaka injini yamanzi. UZuma uthi empeleni bebesebenzisana ngaphansi kwenkampani, Ubucebo General Trading. Uthi ngokwazi kwakhe, kufanele ngabe wathola R500 000 ngomsebenzi abawenza kodwa akatholanga ngisho isente. Useze wakhetha ukulufaka enkantolo udaba ngoba usekhathele wukukhuluma nesihlobo sakhe esingafuni nemali."Ngiqale ngalubika kubaba, umndeni wazama ukumbiza wakhuluma naye. Kodwa kwacaca ukuthi naye uyehluleka. Uthe esuka wathi angithathe noma yisiphi isinyathelo engisifunayo ngoba naye ukhulumile wehluleka. Ngiyayifuna imali yami, kayikho enye indlela engingayikhuluma ngayo le ndaba,’’ kuchaza uZumaUsole uNksz Mhlongo ngokungabi nalo iqiniso njengoba ethi akasamshayeli ngisho ucingo ngalolu daba, sebegcina ngokubonana uma kunemicimbi emndenini, babingelelane kuphele kanjalo.UNksz Mhlongo ethintwa, ukhuze wababaza uma ezwa ukuthi udaba selusenkantolo, wathi ubengakwazi lokho yena ngoba wakhuluma noZuma wamchazela."Inkinga esahlangabezana nayo wukuthi kasitholanga imali esasilindele ukuyithola ngomsebenzi esawenza ngoba kwaphoqa ukuthi siholele abasebenzi imali elinganayo. Ngiyasola ukuthi uZobaphi wazitshela ukuthi usizi lwakhe seluphelile, uma sithola ithenda kanti sizoba nale nkinga. Kasiyenzanga inzuzo, ngigcine sengingena ezikweletini ngalolu daba,’’ kuchaza uNksz Mhlongo.

BAKHALA ngezimoto zamanzi okuphela amasonto zingafiki emphakathini wakwaLembe ngaphansi kukaMasipala uMdoni, okuthiwa umphakathi usukha emfuleni oshiswe yisomiso. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kusukela ngoJuni inkinga yamanzi ibisivele iqalile kule ndawo, obuthembela ezimotweni ezilethwa wuMasipala Ugu.UNkk Nokuthula Mdlalose oyilungu lomphakathi, uthe selokhu kwathi nhlo bakha emfuleni iMandlalathi. Uthe inkinga yamanzi iqale ngesikhathi kusha umfula, okudalwe yisomiso.“Izimoto zikamasipala bezisilethela amathangi amanzi kube ngconywana. Inkinga manje sekuphela amasonto noma inyanga izimoto zingafiki. Kumanje sagcina ngenyanga edlule ukulethelwa amanzi. Uma sishaya ucingo siwacela, sitshelwa ukuthi kunenkinga yokushoda kwezimoto kumasipala,” kuchaza yena.Uthe sebesaba nokuthi bazogula ngoba akuphephile ukusebenzisa amanzi kulo mfula.UNkk Mdlalose uthe uma bezosebenzisa amanzi bayawabilisa.“Okuyinkinga kakhulu ukuwasha ngawo ngoba izimpahla ziyagqwala. Kuba ngcono uma kufike imoto yamanzi ngoba siyacabangelana. Siye sihlukaniselane izigubhu ngasikhombisa emzini ngamunye,” echaza.UMnuz Zakhele Hlongwa oyikhansela, uthe ibaxakile impela inkinga yamanzi futhi ingaphezu kwamandla. Uvumile ukuthi uma izimoto zingafikanga, umphakathi awunalo elinye isu lokuthola amanzi.“Ngicabanga ukuthi izimoto zamanzi zagcina ukufika emasontweni amabili edlule kuleya ndawo. Nokho kuyenzeka kuphele ngisho inyanga zingafikanga. Sithole ukuthi kunenkinga yokushoda kwezimoto kuMasipala Ugu,” kusho uHlongwa.Uthe wahlangana nezikhulu zikamasipala ukudlulisa izikhalo. Uveze ukuthi nomphakathi bawuchazelile inkinga ababhekene nayo.AKUGCWALI ngisho isigubhu samanzi uma kukhiwa emfuleni osekuthembelwe kuwo emphakathini wakwaLembeUHlongwa uthe sebefake isicelo sokuthi umphakathi ufakelwe ompompi kodwa angazi ukuthi kuzokwenzeka nini ngoba umasipala ukhale ngezinkinga zemali.Uthe kuba ngcono uma linile ngoba umphakathi ukhongozela amanzi emvuleni.Okhulumela uMasipala Ugu uMnuz Frans Nzama, uthe kubekwe ikomiti okuyilona elilawula indaba yokulethwa kwamanzi.Uthe ngenxa yokuthi ziningi izindawo eziswele amanzi, izimoto azikwazi ukufika nsuku zonke kodwa ziyawaletha amanzi.UNzama uthe kunohlelo olubhalwe phansi okuyilona olulawula ukuthi izimoto ziwayise kuphi amanzi.

ITHOLAKALE ibulewe yaphonswa esimobeni esiseduze kwasemzini wayo ingoduso ebihlale ihlukunyezwa umnyeni wayo. UNksz Nompumelelo Shangase (46) waseMontebello eNdwedwe ogane eGqugquma, KwaSwayimane utholakale ngeSonto eshonile esimobeni esiseduze komuzi wakhe engenalo inxeba kodwa evuvukele ebusweni, kubonakala sengathi ubeshaywa.Uyise kamufi, uMnuz Nicholas Shangase uthe, washayelwa ucingo umkhwenyana wakwakhe ngeSonto ekuseni ebuza ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ayikaze ifike yini kubo ngoba iduke ngayizolo?“Uthe ushiye amagwinya emafutheni waphuma akamazi ukuthi uyephi usebheke waze wadela, akamtholi. Akuphelanga isikhathi eside wasishayela, wathi utholakale esimobeni esisekupheleni kwegceke emzini wakubo abahlala kuwo,” kusho uShangase.Uthe bafike isidumbu singakathathwa babona ukuthi uma usegcekeni izinyawo zikamufi ziyabonakala emobeni neduku lakhe lasekhanda beliwele khona.“Iyangixaka le nto, kwenziwe yini ukuthi abasemzini womntanami bangamboni umuntu obesobala kangaka? Isidumbu sakhe kubonakala sengathi uqale washaywa, wase waklinywa futhi kubonakala sengathi uphonswe esimobeni eseshonile ngoba akukho okukhombisa ukuthi kuke kwashuduziswana.”Uthe indodakazi yakhe nyakenye ike yalimala kanzima ishaywe umkhwenyana wayo. “Ubehlale eshaywa nguye umyeni wakhe kodwa ebekezele. Incazelo engitshelwa yona ngabasemzini nayo ayingenelisi. Bathi wayepheke amagwinya ngoMgqibelo ebusuku waphuma, wangasho ukuthi uyaphi wangabe esabuya. Bathi akekho ayexabene naye futhi akuzange kube khona ukuhilizisana noma ukulwa nomkhwenyana wakhe. Kuyangixaka lokhu, umuntu onjani ongashiya ibhodwe linamagwinya angasho lutho kumuntu ahleli naye ekubeni amagwinywa kuyinto esheshe ivuthwe noma ngabe ubeya ethoyilethi? Nakuba engeke esavuka umntanami kodwa ngiyafisa ukwazi ukuthi ubulelwe ngubani?" kusho uShangase.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nonhlanhla Khoza, ukhathazekile ngokubulawa komunye umuntu wesifazane.Uqhube wathi: "Nakuba kungakatholakali ukuthi uNksz Shangase ubulewe ngubani kodwa siyazi ukuthi izigameko ezinjengalezi kujwayelekile ukuthi zenziwe ngabantu abasuke bethenjwa kakhulu ngabashonile. Siyethemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azombopha umenzi noma abenzi bokubi masinyane.”UCaptain Nqobile Gwala, okhulumela amaphoyisa, uthe amaphoyisa aseHarburg aphenya icala ngesidumbu sowesifazane esitholakale esimobeni kwaGqugquma, KwaSwayimane ngeSonto. Uthe kusolwa ukuthi lo wesifazane uklinyiwe wabulawa.

SIDUVE emakhazeni phesheya kwezilwandle eGreece isidumbu sikaNksz Sarah Masango, waKwaNdebele, eMpumalanga, oshonele esibhedlela ngoNovemba 14 nonyaka, enesifo sofuba. Umndeni wakhe kumele ukhokhe R71 000, ukuze isidumbu sakhe sibuyiswe kuleli.UMnyango wezangaPhandle uthe ngeke ukwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zamakhaza nokumbuyisa kuleli umufi ngoba ubengeyena umsebenzi kahulumeni.Izindleko zamakhaza ziyenyuka njengoba isidumbu sakhe sisemakhazeni.Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Gilbert Masango, uthe: “Udadewethu wayehlala eSunnyside, ePitoli, ngaphambi kokuya eGreece nesoka lakhe ngo-2014.”Uthe bashaqekile bewumndeni bethola ngokushona kukadadewabo.“Sithole ulwazi ehhovisi lenxusa lakuleli eGreece ngokushona kwakhe. Asikholwanga. Okwenza isimo saba muncu kakhulu wukuthi kumele sizikhokhele thina izindleko zokubuyisa isidumbu sakhe kuleli,” kusho uMasango.Ihhovisi lenxusa lazisa umndeni ukuthi umufi walaliswa esibhedlela ngo-Okthoba 28, wagcina ngokushona.UMasango uthe akukho lapho engayanga khona ecela usizo, ngisho neminyango eyahlukene kahulumeni.Izindleko zokubuyisa isidumbu kuleli zibalwa ngama-euro, kulezo zindleko kubalwa ukusithutha isidumbu, amakhaza izimpahla zokusigqokisa, i-container yokusithwala nokunye.Umndeni uthe bebengajwayele ukushayelana izingcingo bebethumelana imiqhafazo.Incwadi ebhalwe yisikhulu somnyango eya emndenini kamufi iveza uzwelo ngokubehlele bese ithi bangaxhumana nomnyango uma bedinga usizo.Okhulumela lo mnyango uMnuz Lunga Ngqengelele, uthe, “Ngeshwa kuwumthetho ukuthi asiyisizi ngemali imindeni esuke ishonelwe ngamalungu ayo ngaphandle kwakuleli,” kusho uNgqengelele.Unxuse imindeni ivakashele iwebsite yabo ukuze ibona ukuthi yini okumele yenziwe uma ilungu layo lishonele ngaphandle kwakuleli.

I-DA kuMasipala weTheku ifuna izimpendulo ukuthi kungani engezi emsebenzini izinyanga ezintathu obeyimeya yomkhandlu uNkk Zandile Gumede, yize eqhubeka nokuhola imali yokuba ikhansela?Emhlanganweni wamakhansela e-ICC zolo, usotswebhu we-DA eThekwini, uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, uthe uNkk Gumede bamgcine ngoSepthemba efika emuva kwesikhathi emcimbini wokugcotshwa kongene ezicathulweni zakhe, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda.“Ucwaningo esilwenzile luveza ukuthi uNkk Gumede akalona ilungu lekomiti kwakhona emkhandlwini futhi akayethameli imihlangano yamakhansela. Uyaqhubeka nokuhola imali yabakhokhi bentela ngaphandle kokwenza umsebenzi wobukhansela njengoba ebhekene namacala enkohlakalo,” kusho uMthethwa.UMthethwa uvuke umbhejazane emuva kokuthi imenenja yomkhandlu, uMnuz Sipho Nzuza, iqeda ukufunda uhlu lwamakhansela angekho emhlanganweni ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene.Usihlalo wekomiti lezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu nokuThuthukiswa kweNgqalasizinda kuMasipala, uMnuz Thanduxolo Sabelo, ukhale nge-DA wathi ichitha isikhathi ngoba uhlelo lokukhishwa kwemvumo yomhlabakhefu wamakhansela iphuma ngemenenja kamasipala.Umholi wekhokhasi we-IFP uMnuz Mdu Nkosi uthe bahambe ne-DA ukuthi kumele ludingidwe udaba lokuthi kungani uNkk Gumede namakhansela engezi emsebenzini isikhathi eside? UNkk Gumede, amakhansela amane aboshwe ngoLwesithathu oKlebe nosonkontileka abathathu bathinteka ecaleni lethenda ka-R208 million yokuqoqwa kukadoti eThekwini.I-DA ifuna kuxoshwe emkhandlwini wonke amakhansela angu-62 ethe ayathinteka ecaleni lenkohlakalo ekukhishweni kwethenda kadoti.

ULINGANISELWA kuR560 million umonakalo odalwe yizimvula ebezihambisana nomoya onamandla ezihlasele KwaZulu-Natal zashiya inqwaba yemizi, izikole nengqalasizinda kucekeleke phansi.Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Zikalala uthe bafisa ukubonga uhulumeni wesifundazwe ngendlela osukume ngayo emuva kwesimo esiphuthumayo esidalwe yisimo sezulu ebesingesihle esisanda kubakhona.“Sibonile ukuthi ngoNovemba, isifundazwe sethu sihlaselwe yizishingishane ezine kwashayeka umasipala waseMshwathi, kwathi ngoNovemba 14 kwashayeka uKhahlamba, sisababaza indaba yaseMshwathi nasoKhahlamba kwashayeka eMahlangeni, uLundi nakwaNongoma,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe bangu-31, abantu okubikwe ukuthi bashonile ngenxa yalezi zimvula kwathi abangu-135 balimala.“Imizi elinganiselwa ku-3 072 icekeleke phansi kwathi abantu abangu-15 540, bakhahlamezeka.”Uthe uR560 million wumonakalo wamanje abasawucwaningile, wengeza ngokuthi kusengenzeka imali inyuke njengoba besaqhubeka nokuhlola umokakalo.“Uhulumeni ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezizimele basukumele phezulu besiza abantu abathikamezekile ngenxa yalezi zimvula, kumanje sesiqede ukuhlanganisa uhlu lwabantu okumele bathole usizo kanti iminyango ethintekayo ingenelela ngendlela,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe uMnyango wezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal usuqoke osonkontileka abami ngomumo ukuthi basize ngezimpahla zokwakha nokuthi bavuse imizi ecekeleke phansi.“Umonakalo sisawuhlola kodwa akekho umuntu ongazi ukuthi umonakalo mkhulu njengoba kucekeleke phansi imizi, yizikole nengqalasizinda. Labo abalahlekelwe yizinto zabo ezibalulekile bayasizwa wuMnyango wezaseKhaya neSassa,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe bafuna ukubonga uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu ngokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi labo abakhahlamezekile bayaluthola usizo.UZikalala unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uzilalele izexwayiso ezenziwayo mayelana nesimo sezulu.“Isimo sezulu esibhekene naso esihlale siguquka senza ukuthi sihlale siqaphile, siphinde sifundise abantu bakithi ngokukwazi ukuphatha imvelo ngendlela eyiyo,” kusho uZikalala.

Abafundi baseGratton High, babuye nendondo emncintiswaneni ohlelwa ngabakwa-Eskom ne-Education With Enterprise Trust (EWIT) eGoli. Abaphume isibili ezikoleni ezintathu ebezingenele KwaZulu-Natal, bebeyokwethula iSnempilo Jam, okuwujamu abazenzele wona.Lesi sikole besimelwe wuMinenhle Morris noNoxolo Mthethwa abafunda uGrade 11, abenza iBusiness Studies. Uthisha wabo obebaphelezele, uNksz Busi Dlamini, ofundisa zona lezi zifundo, uthe bavele banenhlangano abazisungulele yona esikoleni, enabafundi abangu-16.Inhlangano yabo yakhetha iKing Dinuzulu Pre-School, ukulekelela izingane zakhona ngezidingo.“Isu lokwenza ujamu laqala ngokuthi abafundi bami bebevakashela le nkulisa abayisizayo, bebheka nomphako wezingane. Bathole ukuthi izingane eziningi ziphatha umphako ongenayo impilo ngenxa yokuthi abazali kabanayo imali. Izingane eziningi ziphatha ujamu, ongalungile ngenxa yoshukela omningi,” kuchaza uNksz Dlamini.Uthe baqale ukungenela umncintiswano ekuqaleni konyaka, baphuma isibili ezikoleni zesifundazwe. Emncintiswaneni bekudingeka bakhombise amakhono amabhizinisi ngokuthi benze umkhiqizo ongavula amathuba kulo mkhakha, udale namathuba omsebenzi. UNksz Dlamini uthe bakhethe ukwenza lo jamu abawuxube nenhlaba ne-cucumber. Okwenza uhluke ukuthi wenziwe ngezithako zemvelo futhi kawunawo ushukela omningi.Uthe abafundi yibona abaqhamuke nombono kodwa basizwa ngabanye abantu ngaphandle kwesikole njengoba bekudingeka nolwazi lwezolimo.UNksz Dlamini uthe isikole sakhiwe eduze kwezindlu zomxhaso lapho kunomphakathi oswele.“Asifuni ukuthi sigcine ngokuwina kulo mncintiswano. Isifiso esikhulu wukuthola uxhaso ukuze sibe nefemu yokukhiqiza ujamu wethu, kudaleke namathuba omsebezi emphakathini,” kuchaza uNksz Dlamini.Mayelana nomsebenzi owenziwa ngabafundi abazisungulele inhlangano esikoleni, uthe kule nkulisa abayikhethile bavakashela izingane bazisize ngomsebezi wesikole. Babuye bazenzele amasemishi anempillo, bazihambisele.Umncintiswano uqale ngoDisemba 3 eGoli, abafundi babuya ngoLwesine olwedlule. UNksz Dlamini uncome ukuzikhandla nobuhlakani kubafundi bakhe, athe bakhombisa nogqozi lokuba ngosomabhizinisi.

INHLANGANO ebhekela abanesifo sokuhanjelwa wumqondo esibizwa nge-dementia, ifuna uhulumeni asifake ngaphansi kwezifo zokukhubazeka ukuze kusizakale abanaso.I-Bessie Makatini Foundation (BMF), iveze lokhu izolo esithangamini sokuqwashisa ngalesi sifo eThekwini. UMnuz Stan Chidavanzi ongomunye wabagqugquzeli bale nhlangano ozinze e-England, uthe kusenzima ukusiza abanalesi sifo ngoba nohulumeni akabaxhasi. Uthe ngisho izinhlangano ezisiza abaneDementia azilutholi uxhaso. Uveze ukuthi lesi sifo sesibulala abesifazane ukwedlula ezinye izifo e-England.“Silwela ukuthi uhulumeni asithathe njengokukhubazeka lesi sifo ngoba sibucayi kakhulu. Inkinga esibhekene nayo wukuthi abantu abayazi i-dementia, abayiqondi futhi abafundisekile kahle ngayo. Kusanezinkolelo zokuthi onalesi sifo uyathakatha noma uthakathiwe.”Enaba ngalesi sifo uthe kusuke kufe ama-brain cells.Uveze ukuthi onaso akawuboni umehluko phakathi kobusuku nemini, yingakho abanye bebanjwa bentwayiza emgwaqweni ngisho ebusuku. Ukhale ngokuthi lesi sifo aselapheki kodwa kunemishanguzo edambisa kuphela ukukhohlwa okwesikhashana. Yize lesi sifo kuthiwa sihlasela kakhulu izalukazi, uChidavanzi uthe siyenzeka nakulabo abasebasha. Uthe izidakamizwa nazo zinomthelela kulokhu.UNkk Madanda Mabizela ongumnakekeli wabanalesi sifo, uthe unina ongasekho wayenaso. Uthe uma unalesi sifo udinga ukugadwa ubusuku nemini. Ulinganise ngonina athe wake wazama ukuphuza upharafini.“Kumele bahlale benakiwe, bangasitholi isikhathi eside sokuba bodwa. Kumele kungapheli amahora amabili onalesi sifo engakaze anyakaze. Kufanele bazivocavoce, ngisho elele umuntu ujwayele ukumelula umzimba.”Uthe ukulala isikhathi eside kudala izilonda, ezingakubulala uma zinganakiwe.UNksz Shanice Moodley oyiSpeech Therapist, uthe abanalesi sifo kumele bakhunjuzwe njalo izikhathi osukwini. Uthe lokhu kubalekelela ekutheni kubuye umqondo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Ulinganise ngokuthi bakhonjiswe ikhalenda, bakhunjuzwe ngezinsuku ezibalulekile. Uthe kuyasiza nokuthi ubakhombise izinto kunokubatshela ngomlomo ngoba bayakhohlwa. Kuvele ukuthi uma umuntu esesitejini sokugcina seDementia, akube kusasebenza lutho emzimbeni.Ababethamele lesi sithangami bakhale ngokuthi kudingeke bayeke ngisho umsebenzi ukuze bagade abanalesi sifo emakhaya. Kuvele ukuthi uma sebehanjelwe wumqondo bakhohlwa ngisho amagama abo. I-BMF yasungulwa nguNksz Bessie Makatini waseLamontville osezinze eLondon ngokusebenza. Naye washonelwa ngunina ngenxa yalesi sifo.

BATHUKA izanya abantu abahlala kolindela baseMathinini, eRigdeview, eThekwini, njengoba bekhala ngohalakasha lwenyoka abathi luyacanasa endaweni abahlala kuyona, sebesaba nokuhamba.Izindlu abahlala kuzona babekwa ngenhloso yokuthi balindele izindlu zomxhaso. Ithimba leSolezwe ngeSonto linikele khona kule ndawo emuva kwezikhalo zabantu bakhona. Yindawo esehlathini elinezihlahla ezizungeze izindlu.Kuhlalwa khona nezingane ezisencane ezizidlalela zize zifike eduze kwezihlahla okuthiwa kuhlala khona uhalakasha lwenhlwathi.Abahlala khona bathi ihlala ibonakala icanasa kuthiwa inkulu ngendlela eyesabekayo.Omunye wabahlali bakhona uMnuz Thabiso Msezane uthe, inkinga enkulu izindlu zangasese zincane futhi ziyangcola abanye baze bafune ukuyozikhulula ehlathini lapho kuhlala khona le nyoka.“Ihlala ivela nje, abaningi bayayibona ngenhlanhla ayikalimazi muntu kodwa siyesaba ngoba kukhona nezingane la esihleli khona. Kubuye kungangeneki ezindlini zangasese kodwa manje asisakwazi nokuya ehlathini ngoba iyagwinyana ihlwathi,’’ kuchaza uMsezane. Uthe omunye umndeni obuhlala nabo ugcine uthuthile wabaleka emuva kokuthi inyoka yangena yabavimbezela endlini baphuma ngesamagundane bashiya nezimpahla.Uthe bafuna noma yiluphi usizo lokuba isuswe endaweni ngoba bayesaba ukuyisukela bona ingase ibenze isilo sengubo.Enye insizwa ehlala khona uMnuz Phakamani “PK’’ Mbele, ifakaze ngokuthi izinyoka kukubo kwazo lapha ngoba kusehlathini bajwayele ukushaya izimamba nezimfezi kodwa okwenhlwathi kubahlalise lubhojozi impela.UMnuz Nick Evans weReptiles Unlimited ebhekene nokususwa kwezinyoka eThekwini, uthe uyayazi indawo okukhulunywa ngayo kodwa ubengakaze ezwe ngenyoka yakhona.“Kuyamangaza ukuthi kunenhlwathi lapho, ngike ngiye ngakhona. Ngicela ubanike inombolo yami bangithinte uma beyibona ngoba ngeke ngivele ngiyozingela inyoka engingazi ukuthi ikuphi. Uma beyibona ngiyofika ngibasize noma kanjani,’’ kuchaza * -Evans.

INHLANGANO ebusayo i-ANC ifuna amakhansela aseThekwini athweswe amacala enkohlakalo ayiswe ekomitini layo elimele ukuqondisa ubugwegwe.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi oKlebe bebophe amakhansela amane ngoLwesithathu ngecala lokukhwatshaniswa kwemali yethenda yokuqoqa udoti kaR208 million. Amakhansela athintekayo nasevelile enkantolo yamacala athinta imali eThekwini akhululwa ngebheyili kaR5 000 umuntu emunye ngoNomthandazo Shabalala, Nomusa Mthembu, Sthenjwa Nyawose noThembelihle de Lange.Bathweswe amacala okuhlomula ngokungemthetho, awenkohlakalo, ukushushumbisa imali, ukuphula umthetho wokusetshenziswa kwemali kamasipala nawokusebenza kukamasipala uqobo.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Ricardo Mthembu, uthe ukuboshwa kwala makhansela kuyithele ngehlazo inhlangano.“I-ANC izokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bayaziphendulela ngala macala obugebengu abathweswe wona. I-ANC ifuna baqale baziphendulele ngaphambi kokuba ithathe isinqumo sokuthi ibhekana kanjani nalolu daba,” kusho uMthembu.Ikomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe uthe yilona elizoba nezincomo ngezinyathelo okumele zithathwe wubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngawo.UMthembu uthe i-ANC ithukile futhi yaphoxeka ukuthola ukuthi abaholi abathunywe yiyona baphambane nomthetho wokusebenza kukahulumeni.“Lezi zinsolo zibucayi kakhulu futhi siyaweseka amaphoyisa ngokwenza umsebenzi wawo wokuphenya kanzulu futhi uma kukhona ophambane nomthetho kumele aziphendulele enkantolo.”Ukuboshwa kwala makhansela amane kusho ukuthi asengu-22 aseboshiwe ngezinsolo ezithinta ukukhwabanisa imali yethenda yokuqoqa udoti.Owayeyimeya yeTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede waboshwa ngoMeyi nonyaka namakhansela angu-16 nabasebenzi bakamasipala. Badedelwa ngebheyili kaR50 000 umuntu ngamunye. Ngemuva kokuthweswa amacala uNkk Gumede ususiwe esikhundleni sakhe sokuba yimeya kukhalwa ngokuthi akasebenzanga ngendlela obekulindeleke ngayo njengemeya kodwa wagcina eseyikhansela.UMthembu uthe bonke abathweswe amacala obugebengu sebedluliselwe ekomitini eliqondisa ubugwegwe. Uthe leli komiti lisebenza ngokushesha ikakhulukazi uma umuntu esetholakale enecala enkantolo. Okwamanje uNkk Gumede akakatholakali enecala.

BAGWETSHWE iminyakaewu-15 umuntu emunye abesifazane ababili ababengabasebenzi boMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal ngokukhwabanisa * -R7.5 million.Inkantolo ephenya amacala athinta izimali eThekwini izolo igwebe uHlengiwe Hlela (35) noPatricia Chule (33) iminyakaewu-15 ngokukhwabanisa yengeza eminye iminyaka ewu-10 ngokuphula isigaba somthetho olwa nezenzo zobugebengu obuhleliwe.Imantshi * -G Davis ithe bazozidonsa kanyekanye izigwebo zabo.UNgqongqoshe obambile walo mnyango, uNkk Peggy Nkonyeni, uthe: “Izigwebo ezinde ezitholwe ababengabasebenzi bomnyango zithumela umyalezo oshubile ukuthi ngeke zibekezelwe izenzo zokukhwabaniswa kwemali kahulumeni.Abasebenzi babesophikweni olubhekelele ukukhishwa kwamathenda emnyangweni. Inkantolo yayikade ibalahle ngamacala ngo-Okthoba.Ukugwetshwa kwabo kulandela okukaMex Dladla ogwetshwe iminyaka ewu-12 ebhadla ejele ngecala elifanayo.UDladla wayewungqondongqondo ekukhwabaniseni okwenziwa ngabesifazane abagwetshiwe ngobugebengu obenzeka ngo-2015.“Izigwebo zisiza ukwakha uhulumeni ongenayo inkohlakalo ngokuthi kuqedwe ukukhwabanisa ezikhulwini zikahulumeni. Ukukhwabanisa ngenye yezingqinamba ezidala ukuthi igqoze intuthuko eyiswa kubantuo. Lolu (esho izolo) wusuku oluhle kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Siyethemba bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni bazofunda isifundo kokwenzekile,” kusho uNkk Nkonyeni.Emuva kwesigwebo uNkk Nkonyeni uthe baqinisa izinhlelo zangaphakathi zokukhokhela izinkampani ezenzela uhulumeni umsebenzi ukuvikela izenzo zenkohlakalo kubasebenzi.

source: ufuna ukuzwana kwi ifp ne anc
text: UMENGAMELI ngokuhlonishwa we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi uthi kuyomphatha kabi uma eze washona lungaqediwe uhlelo lokubuyisana phakathi kweNkatha ne-ANC.Ekhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa ngokusemthethweni kwesikhwama sakhe nomngani wakhe ongusomabhizinisi ohlonishwayo, uMnuz Harry Oppenheimer esikhumulweni sezindiza esidala ngaseSiphingo izolo, uButhelezi uthe inhliziyo yakhe kayikutholi ukuphumula ngokuthi lolu hlelo kalukaqedwa.“Kuyongiphatha kabi uma ngivala amehlo ami ngishona kodwa kusenezilonda ezingakalashwa phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe uyajabula ukuthi umholi ohlonishwayo we-ANC, uMnuz Meshack Radebe ukhona emcimbini wakhe.“Kuyintokozo ukuba khona kukaRadebe lapha owaziwa kakhulu ngamagalelo akhe okudala uxolo phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC eHammarsdale ebambisene noDkt Sipho Mlaba ongasekho. Ngisho nangesikhathi uRadebe enze umcimbi wokugubha ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-70, wangimema kwakhe eMaqongqo ngaya ngoba ngangazi ukuthi ukungimema kwakhe kwakugqugquzelwa yintshisekelo yakhe yokubona sibuyisana,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe kade kwasa ethukwa, ebizwa ngawo wonke amagama ngabaholi be-ANC, abanye baze bambize ngomdayisi nangencelebane yabamhlophe.“Noma ngangihlaselwa ngayo yonke indlela kodwa bekungiqinisa kungenze ngime kulokhu engikholelwa kukho ngenxa yokwesekwa enganginikukwa ngumngani wami * -Oppenheimer, wangiseka futhi nangesikhathi ngithatha isinqumo sokunqaba ukuthi isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibe nguzimele geqe njengoba ezinye izifundazwe ezine zase zivumile,” kusho uButhelezi.Uthe ngenxa yozimele geqe, abantu abamnyama babenziwa abantu bokufika ezweni labo.“Njengoba ngilapha namhlanje emcimbini wokwethulwa kwalesi sikhwama sami nomngani wami ngizizwa sengathi ngisemngcwabeni wami uqobo,” kusho uButhelezi.Isikhulumi sosuku emcimbini, uMnuz John Kane-Berman, sigeqe amagula sichaza umlando kaButhelezi namagalelo akhe emzabalazweni.“Kuyiqiniso elifihliwe ukuthi uButhelezi nguyena owayephoqa uhulumeni wobandlululo ukuthi akhulule uMengameli wokuqala wentando yeningi kuleli uDkt Nelson Mandela ejele, uButhelezi waze wasabisa ngokuthi ngeke alungenele ukhetho uma uMandela engakhululwa, kuningi akwenza ukuze abamnyama bakhululeke kodwa kufihliwe,” kushouKane-Berman.Umeluleki kaNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Linda Zama, uthe umlando wakuleli kawuphelele ngaphandle kukaButhelezi no-Oppenheimer.UNksz Zama uchaze uButhelezi njengomholi osezingeni lomhlaba ngenxa yamagalelo akhe emzabalazweni“Kakusilo ihaba ukuthi sithi uMntwana waKwaPhindangene uyingqalabutho yomholi wakuleli, osebenze cishe nabo bonke abaholi abahlonishwayo nabadumile hhayi lapha eNingizimu Afrika nasezwenikazi kodwa nasemhlabeni wonke uqobo,” kusho uNksz Zama.

UMMANGALELWA ecaleni lokubulawa kwesitshudeni saseMangosuthu University of Technology uthi isibhamu abulala ngaso lesi sitshudeni kwakungesaso isitshudeni.UMnuz Thabani Mzolo ubhekene necala lokubulala uNksz Zolile Khumalo isidumbu sakhe esatholwa endaweni ehlala izitshudeni eLonsdale ngoMeyi 1 kulo nyaka. Ummangalelwa waboshwa esendaweni yesigameko, wagcinwa esitokisini njengoba enqatshelwe ibheyili.Inkantolo isola ukuthi ummangalelzwa wayecasulwe ukwaliwa njengoba kuvela ukuthi ubeke amsabise.UMzolo uveza ukuthi isibhamu esikamufi futhi phambilini umufi ubeke wamkhomba ngaso.Ufakazi kuleli cala uNksz Nosipho Bengu noMnuz Simiso Buthelezi abebesendlini ngesikhathi kwenzeka lesi sehlakalo, bathi ummangalelwa wakhipha isibhamu wadubula umufi.Ummangalelwa uyakugcizelela ukuthi wayengahlomile ngesikhathi engena endlini ngalobo busuku, uthi umufi wayehleli esihlalweni isibhamu esibeke phakathi kwamathanga akhe.Uthe kwakungasikhona okokuqala ebona umufi ephethe isibhamu.“Ngesikhathi ngibona isibhamu zimbili izinto ezafika emqondweni wami ngaphambi kokuthi kufike ukuthi ngizame ukumphuca sona,” kusho uMzolo.Uthe ubeseke wambona ephethe isibhamu esifanayo ngesikhathi beseMhlanga emzini kadokotela nomkakhe, okuyilapho ummangalelwa abejwayele ukuvakashela khona obekuthi uma laba bashadikazi bengekho umufi afike amvakashele.Ummangalelwa uthi ngesikhathi egijima ezilolonga khona eMhlanga, wabona owesifazane owayemi ngasesangweni lomuzi walapho yena owayevakashele khona, wamtshela ukuthi ufuna umsebenzi.“Ngamtshela ukuthi abanikazi bomuzi abekho ngase ngithi akashiye inombolo ukuze bamthinte uma kwenzeka bedinga isisebenzi sasendlini. Ngesikhathi ngizama ukufaka inamba yalona wesifazane kwiselula, ngabona uZolile (umufi) engikhombe ngesibhamu engisola ngokuthi ngimkhulelisile kodwa ngikhuluma nomuntu wesifazane phambi kwakhe,” kusho uMzolo.Uthe wagxuma wamphuca isibhamu.Uthe bese kungokwesibili ngesikhathi ebona umufi efake isithombe sakhe kwiWhatsApp ephethe isibhamu. Ngesikhathi umshushisi * -Advocate Nadira Moosa embuza ukuthi ngesikhathi ehlwitha umufi isibhamu eMhlanga sabe sinazo izinhlamvu? Ummangalelwa uthe sabe singenalutho.“Ngambuyisela ngoba kwabe kuyisibhamu sakhe. Impilo yabuyela esimeni esejwayelekile emuva kokuthi sesikhulumile ngokwenzekile,” kusho uMzolo.Uthe akazi noma umufi wayenayo yini imvume yokuphatha isibhamu?Umshushisi uthe akukho lula ukuthi umuntu abuyisele isibhamu kumuntu obezama ukumdubula.Icala liyaqhubeka.

source: bafuna kushintshwe umphenyi wecala lowe ancyl
text: SEKUVELE isiphakamiso sokuba kushintshwe umphenyi wecala lokubulawa kwelungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANCYL KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Sindisiwe Beauty Ndlovu (34) okusolwa ukuthi udutshulwe yisoka. Umzala kamufi, uNksz Slo Khuzwayo, wenze lesi siphakamiso enkonzweni yomngcwabo enkundleni yezemidlalo eThokozani ngoMgqibelo.UNksz Khuzwayo uyiphoyisa naye njengoba nomufi kusolwa ukuthi ubulawe yisoka eliyiphoyisa okuthiwa limhlabe ngenhlamvu esifubeni washona. UNksz Khuzwayo uthe balibheke ngabomvu icala futhi abeneme ngomphenyi wecala.“Siyezwa ngomuntu ophenya icala sengathi akalungile kahle, yingakho sicela iziphathimandla ukuba ashintshwe uma kungenzeka. Umsolwa (emgagula ngegama) akafanele ukuba semphakathini emuva kwesenzo sakhe,’’ kusho uNksz Khuzwayo ebamba izinyembezi.Uthe akasiboni isizathu sokuthi iphoyisa livele liqhulule umuntu ngenhlamvu ngoba bayadonswa ngendlebe ngendaba yesibhamu nokuziphatha uma beqeqeshwa ekolishi lamaphoyisa.Ukhale nangokuthi amaphoyisa ambalwa abulala abantu athunaza isithunzi sombutho wonke njengoba sebedume kabi nje.Uthe into abeyenziwe wusibali wabo ngeke bayikhohlwe ebulala umzala wabo ngesihluku ekubeni kade ezilungele, engakaze aphoxe muntu.Ugcizelela ukuthi isibhamu asiyona inkinga kodwa kuba wumuntu osiphethe oba yinkinga uma engasiphathanga ngendlela efanele. Umzala kamufi uqede ukukhuluma wehla esiteji wajikela emuva kwetende wakhala kakhulu waze wabhuquza phansi kwasuka ithimba layomsingatha, limphathele amanzi kodwa elokhu eshilo ngesililo.Umnewabo kamufi uMbishobhi Bhekizitha Ndlovu, uthe ufisa ukuthi kuvele kuzwakale ukuthi umsolwa uzibulele ejele ngoba ubashiye nesilonda esingeke siphinde selapheke. Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi abuyele enkantolo kuleli sonto azofaka isicelo sebheyili.

KUKHUNJULWE iqhaza elabanjwa yinkosi yesizwe sakwaMdunge inkosi Faku Mdunge ukumela abantu besizwe ngezikhathi zikahulumeni wobandlululo emcimbini wokwembulwa kwetshe lesikhumbuzo sayo obusenkantolo yesizwe eBomvini izolo.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezamaCiko, amaSiko, iMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka, uNksz Hllengiwe Mavimbela, uthe inkosi yakwaMdunge ingenye yamakhosi ayebusa ngesikhathi sobandlululo ayelwela ukuthi abantu bayo bangaxhashazwa wuhulumeni wangaleso sikhathi owawucindezela abantu abamnyama.“Inkosi uFaku yenqaba nabantu besizwe sayo ukuthi basebenze ezimayini babe yizigqila zabamhlophe okwaholela ekutheni uhulumeni wangaleso sikhathi ukhiphe isinqumo sokuthi iboshelwe ekhaya,” kusho uNksz Mavimbela.UNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala, uthe kubalulekile ukulondolozwa komlando ukuze isizukulwane esizayo silazi iqhaza elabanjwa abaholi abafana nenkosi yakwaMdunge.“Indlela yenkululeko yezwe lethu ngeke ipheleliswe uma kungukuthi amaqhawe afana nenkosi uFaku, umlando wawo awuphelelisangwa ngokuthi kube namatshe esikhumbuzo afana nalawa bese umlando wabo ubhalwa phansi,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe uma umlando wamakhosi, abaholi bezenkolo, nabamabhizinisi ababamba iqhaza ekukhululweni kwezwe ungaqoshwa phansi, abalandelayo ngeke bakwazi ukunotha komlando wezwe.UZikalala uthe bonke omasipala kumele babe nazo izindawo zokugcina umlando oyigugu.

UMSOLWA obhekene necala lokubulala isitshudeni saseMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT) esasihlala ezindlini zezitshudeni enkabeni yeTheku uqale ukwethula ubufakazi bakhe ngokutshela iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngothando ayenalo ngomufi.UThabani Mzolo obhekene necala lokubulala uZolile Khumalo, utshele inkantolo ukuthi babengamathe nolimu futhi babezitshela ukuthi bothandana baze bahlukaniswe ukufa.Uthe wayemthanda ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke umufi, naye ngokunjalo wayemtshela ukuthi umthanda okudlula abazali bakhe. UZolile wadutshulwa wabulawa endlini yakhe eLonsdale ngoMeyi 1 nyakenye.UMzolo waboshwa endaweni yesigameko ezintatha ngosuku olulandelayo. Elandisa inkantolo uveze nokuthi ubudlelwano bothando lwabo lwaqala ekuqaleni kuka-2017.  “Sasithandana kakhulu. Uthando lwethu lwaluvuseleleka usuku nosuku ngizizwa ngimthanda kabusha. Wayengitshela nokuthi ungithanda okudlula abazali bakhe,” kusho uMzolo.Echaza ngosuku lwesigameko, uthe wanikela endlini yakhe ngoba engamtholi ocingweni. Uveze nokuthi babevele behlele ukubonana, wathi esemshayela ucingo ngenhloso yokumazisa ukuthi useyeza wangatholakala ocingweni uZolile. Yilapho anquma ukunikela endlini yakhe.“Sangqongqoza, uZolile wasivulela. Ngangena endlini ngahlala etafuleni, yena wahlala esihlalweni. Wathi naba abantu ebesingalindele ukuthi singababona. Wangibiza ngo-baby, wangibuza nokuthi nginjani. Ngamphendula ngokuthi angangibizi ngo-baby mina. Ngambuza ukuthi kungani engangishayeli ucingo,” kusho uMzolo.Eqhuba uthe incazelo kaZolile mayelana nokungazibambi izingcingo zakhe wathi wayesaphumile enza umsebenzi wesikole okwasekusondele isikhathi sokuthi awuthumele, neselula wayeyishiye endlini.UMzolo uthe uZolile wathi umthumele umyalezo kwiWhatsapp emazisa ukuthi ukephi.“Ngathi kuye sihlala sithi sohlukaniswa ukufa. Ngeke kodwa kusenzeka ngoba ubudlelwane bethu base buphela ngenxa yesenzo sakhe sokungaziphenduli izingcingo zami,” kusho uMzolo.Uveze ukuthi emuva kwala mazwi wathi uma embuka emehlweni uZolile wambona ukuthi sekunesibhamu phakathi kwamathanga esihlalweni ayehleli kuso. Leli cala liyaqhubeka enkantolo.

KUZOHLOMULA nentsha efuna ukuqala amabhizinisi ohlelweni loxhaso, olwenziwa yinhlangano kaNgqongqoshe woMnyango weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha uMnuz Senzo Mchunu ayisungule nomkakhe.Bangaphezu kuka-60 osomabhizinisi abebeyingxenye yomdlalo wegalofu eMount Edgecombe eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu, obuhlelwe yinhlangano iSenzo & Thembeka Mchunu Foundation. Inhloso yalo mdlalo ukuqokelela isikhwama esizosiza intsha eswele efuna ukuqhubeka nezifundo.UMchunu oke waba ngundunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal nongqongqoshe wezemfundo, uthe ngesikhathi ekulezi zikhundla wabona indlela intsha ethwele kanzima ngayo ngenxa yemali.Wabonisana nomkakhe babona kungcono basungule le nhlangano ukuze bafake isandla ekusizeni intsha, ikakhulukazi kwezemfundo.“Ngesikhathi ngiwungqongqoshe wezemfundo ngaba nethuba lokubona izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Nangesikhathi ngingundunankulu kwakunophiko iYouth Desk, olwangenza ngabona ukuthi intsha iyazimisela uma inikwe ithuba. Ngifundile nokuthi ukuxhasa akudingi ube ngusomabhizinisi kodwa noma ngubani angalwenza ushintsho, yingakho nami ngisungule le nhlangano,” kuchaza uMchunu.Uthe ngesikhathi ekwezemfundo bekumphatha kabi ukubona izingane ziphasa ngamalengiso kodwa ziswele imali yokufunda.Uveze ukuthi ubenxenxa osomabhizinisi nezinkampani ezizimele ukuthi zibaxhase.“Sihlale phansi nomkami ngoba sobabili sasingothisha, sabheka ukuthi singasiza kanjani,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe kule nhlangano abazokhetha intsha yalesi sifundazwe kuphela kodwa nakuzwelonke.UMchunu uthe kunebhodi lenhlangano okuyilona elizokhetha intsha edinga usizo.Uthe uzobheka nalabo asebeyeke ukufunda ngoba beswele imali nentsha efuna ukuqala amabhizinisi.Kulo mdlalo uMchunu ubehamba nomkakhe naye obedlala igalofu. UMchunu utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akakabi ngungoti osezingeni likaTiger Woods kulo mdlalo, uthe uyathanda ukudlala igalofu uma engekho emsebenzini. Uhlabe ikhwelo kubo bonke osomabhizinisi ukuthi basize noma yikuphi lapho bengalekelela khona ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile entsheni.Emuva komdlalo uMchunu nosomabhizinisi babe nesidlo, naso ebesiyingxenye yokuqokelela imali yokusiza intsha.Inhlangano wayisungula ngo-2014 kodwa ike yangasebenza kahle njengoba isiqala izinhlelo zokusiza abafundi.

UKHALA ngokuhamba kancane kophenyo lwamaphoyisa umndeni wowesilisa waKwaCaluza, eMgungundlovu, ogwazwe washona eGeorgedale eHammarsdale yibhungu okuthiwa lamdidanisa nomunye wesilisa elalixabene naye.UMnuz Njabulo Ngcongo (29) kuthiwa ufe emuva kokugwazwa amanxeba amathathu emhlane umsolwa okuvela ukuthi uneminyaka engu-17, endaweni yokucima ukoma. UNgcongo ungcwatshwe ngoMgqibelo emathuneni aseMountain Rise eMgungundlovu. Elandisa Isolezwe ngokwenzeka, uNksz Nqobile Mbambo, ongumzala kamufi, uthe uNgcongo ufele ubala emuva kokudidaniswa nomunye umuntu.UNksz Mbambo uthe babikelwe womama bendawo ukuthi uNgcongo wagwazwa umfana wendawo owayemdidanisa nowesilisa ayekade exabene naye ngoMgqibelo kaNovemba 30.“Sibikelwe ukuthi uNjabulo nomngani wakhe babemile belinde ukuthenga utshwala endaweni edayisa ngotshwala kanti uzoqhanyukelwa ngemuva ombulele wamgwaza amanxeba amathathu emhlane. Waphenduka wabuza owayemgwaza ukuthi umgwazelani, waphendula ngokuthi, ‘Awu! Ngamgwaza umuntu o-wrong,’ maqede wabaleka. Omama bendawo bambizela imoto eyamphuthisa emtholampilo iHlengisizwe ngeshwa washona,” kuchaza uNksz Mbambo.UNksz Mbambo uthe banengwa incazelo yamaphoyisa uma befuna ukwazi kuqhubekani ngopheyo lwecala futhi kungani engakaboshwa umsolwa ngoba uyaziwa futhi uyazichanasela.“Iphoyisa esalibuza lasitshela ukuthi vele kuyabulawana eGeorgedale, umufi ubefunani khona? Kusiphatha kabi lokhu ekubeni uNjabulo ufe ngephutha efela into engekho,” kusho uNksz Mbambo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe: “NgoNovemba 30, ngo-11, kwagwazwa owesilisa oneminyaka engu-29 ethaveni eseGeorgedale owesilisa ongaziwa. Wayenamanxeba okugwazwa emqaleni nasengalweni. Waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela lapho afike ashona khona ngesikhathi efika. Kwavulwa icala lokubulala eliphenywa esiteshini samaphoyisa saseMpumalanga.”

UKUHLUKUMEZEKA kwabesifazane nezingane kulokhu kuqhubeka kuleli njengoba owesifazane nengane yakhe eneminyaka engu-13 behlalele ovalweni ngenxa yokuchanasa kukayise oyizalayo osolwa ngecala lokuyidlwengula.Le ntombazane yaseMtubatuba, kusukela ngoMashi nonyaka uyise oyizalayo usolwa ngokuyidlwengula ephindelela. Kuthiwa ubeyithuma ukudla namanzi okugeza ukuba imlethele bese ethola ithuba lokuyihlukumeza. Le ntombazanyana yayisatshiswa uyise ukuthi uzoyibulala uma ike yabhoboka ngale ndaba.Ithumba lize laqhunjuzwa ngoJuni nonyaka, isixoxela unina ngokwenzekayo. Unina wale ngane ubehlala kwenye indawo, yona ikhuliswa uyise. Isolezwe likhulume nonina okhale ngobunzima abhekene nabo selokhu kwavulwa leli cala.“Okokuqala asazi noma siphephile yini njengoba uyise wengane engaboshiwe? Satshelwa ukuthi icala labikwa sekunesikhathi lenzeka, yingakho engaboshiwe,” kusho unina wengane ongeke avezwe ukuyivikela.Elandisa Isolezwe, uthe emuva kokwenzeka kwesigameko, indodakazi yakhe yathathwa abezenhlalakahle.“Kwangiphatha kabi lokho ngoba ingane ngangifisa ihlale nami. Owayephethe icala wathi ngeke ngikwazi ukuhlala nengane yami emqashweni, kumele ngithole ikhaya. Angisebenzi kahle, ngibamba amatoho. Ngaphoqeleka ukuba ngithole umuzi. Ingane ihlale esikhungweni sabezenhlalakahle izinyanga ezintathu. Nalapho kube khona izinto eziningi ebe isizifunda. Bekunzima ukuhlala ngaphandle kwengane yami ngibe ngazi ukuthi ihlukumezekile, idinga unina,” kusho lo wesifazane. Uthe impilo ayisafazani kwindodakazi yakhe selokhu kwenzeka lesi sigameko njengoba ihlala ngokusaba.“Usizwa ukuthi uhlala nami ngakho ngiyakwazi ukuxoxa naye. Akathandi kulokhu kukhulunywa ngalolu daba ngoba lokhu kuyamhlukumeza,” kusho unina wengane. Uthe esikoleni indodakazi yakhe isenza kangcono uma kuqhathaniswa ngesikhathi isahlukunyezwa uyise. Uqhube wathi abangakujabulela ukukubona kwenziwa ubulungiswa icala liye enkantolo, liqulwe bese kugwetshwa umsolwa.“Sihlukumezekile kakhulu nendodakazi yami ngenxa yalesi sigameko, siyaqhubeka ukuhlukumezeka njengoba isimo sinjena. Bengike ngashaya ucingo esiteshini samaphoyisa ngizama ukuthola ukuthi kwenzekani ngecala,” kusho lo wesifazane. Kwenzeka lokhu nje kunomkhankaso wokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kuleli. Lo mkhankaso ushumayela ivangeli elithi abesifazane nezingane abangahlukunyezwa. Unina wale ngane akawuboni ubalekelela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembela Mbele uthe: “Kunezinsolo ukuthi intombazane eneminyaka engu-13 yadlwengulwa kaningi kusukela ngoMashi 3 nonyaka, umsolwa emaziyo. Icala lavulwa KwaMsane esiteshini samaphoyisa. Labe selidluliselwa ophikweni oluphenya amacala omndeni, awocansi nathinta izingane KwaMsane. Idokodo lisathunyelwe kumshushisi omkhulu ukuze enze isinqumo ngecala.”Inkantolo iyona ezonquma ngokuthi aboshwe bese eshushiswa umsolwa.Emacaleni afuze lawa, asuke engenabo ubufakazi bolibofuzo ngenxa yokuthi asuke ekade enzeka noma enesikhathi eside enzeka kodwa engabikwa. Kuqoqwa ubufakazi abaphenyi, buthunyelwe kubashushisi bese benza isinqumo ngecala.UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa muva nje uvakashele umndeni wesitshudeni esabulawa ngesihluku sigwazwa ngaphezu kuka-50 wamanxeba, eLimpopo uPrecious Ramabulana. Kuboshwe * -Aubrey Manaka ngaleli cala.Unina wale ntombazanyana eyadlwengulwa uthe ufisa umthetho udlale indima yawo kuleli cala ukuze ezozizwa ephephile nendodakazi yakhe, ngokuthi kuboshwe uyise ajeze ngesenzo sakhe.Funda umbono wephephandaba ekhasini 12

KUSUKE umsindo phakathi kwamaqembu aphikisayo nezikhulu zikaMasipala weTheku mayelana nesinqumo sokususwa kukaR3.5 million, ezinhlelweni zokukhumbula owayengumengameli wokuqala wentando yabantu kuleli uMnuz Nelson Mandela wayiswa emkhankasweni wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane ngaphandle kokugunyazwa umasipala.Ikhansela le-IFP uMnuz Mdu Nkosi lithe alingabazi ukuthi le mali isetshenziswe ngaphandle kokugunyazwa umkhandlu.“Ngifisa ukuthola incazelo ukuthi kwenzeke kanjani uR3.5 million, owawabelwe izinhlelo zokukhunjulwa kukaMandela wayiswa kolunye uhlelo ngaphandle kokugunyazwa ngumkhandlu. Uma siqhubeka nokwenza ngeke iphele le nto yokuthi kuthiwe kunezigidi zemali ezisetshenziswe budedengu,” kusho uNkosi.Ikhansela leDA uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa, lithe bafuna umuntu othathe lesi sinqumo athathelwe izinyathelo ngoba lokhu akwenzile kuphambene nomthetho wokusetshenziswa kwemali kamasipala.NePhini leMeya uNkk Belinda Scott lithe liyahambisana nesikhalo samaqembu aphikisayo, lengeza ngokuthi kuzomele ajeze umuntu othathe lesi sinqumo.“Kumele siqale sithole ukuthi kuphambene nomthetho yini ukususa imali kolunye uhlelo uyifake kolunye uhlelo, ngolwazi lwami enginalo lokusetshenziswa kwemali kahulumeni kumele kwenziwe isicelo bese kuyagunyazwa,” kusho uNkk Scott.Uthe kumele iphele nya le nto yokusetshenziswa kwemali budedengu.“Umuntu ozotholakala enecala lapho, kuzomele ajeze,” kusho uNkk Scott.IPhini leMenenja oPhikweni lwezoMphakathi nezimo eziphuthumayo uMnuz Vusi Mazibuko okuwuphiko lwakhe oluthathe lesi sinqumo, lithe imali okukhulunywa ngayo ibingakasetshenziswa.UNkk Scott uthe akayikholwa le nto eshiwo nguMazibuko ngoba umkhankaso wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlaselwa kwabesifazane nezingane uqale ngoNovemba 25, uphele ngoDisemba 10.“Akukwazi ukuthi le mali ayikasebenzi ngoba phela uhlelo seluqalile, sizolindela ukuthi sithole umbiko ogcwele emhlanganweni ozayo ukuthi kwenzakalani ngale mali. Embikweni esiwulindeke sifuna le mali icazwe ukuthi izosebenza kanjani,” kusho uNkk Scott.UMgcinimafa eMkhandlwini weTheku uMnuz Krish Kumar, uthe kungenzeka ukuba le mali yasuswa ezinhlelweni zokukhumbula uMandela yayiswa emkhankasweni wokulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane kusetshenziswa isigaba somthetho uRule order 28.URule order 28, ilapho imeya nemenenja bethatha isinqumo ngaphandle komkhandlu ngoba bethi kuyaphuthuma.UNkosi uyichithile indaba kaRule order 28, wathi ayikho ngoba akekho umuntu ongathi bekuphuthuma futhi umkhandlu uhleli awukho ekhefini.

UKUNGABOSHWA kwabasolwa ngokubulala amalungu omndeni ayisithupha, adutshulwa abulawa ebuka ithelevishini ngeledlule eMpumalanga, eHammarsdale, kufaka ingebhe kwabasinda kule sisigameko.UMnuz Ndodo Msomi, umfowabo kaMnuz Mvumo Msomi (55) owabulawa nezingane zakhe uMnuz Dumisani Msomi (25), Nksz Philisiwe Msomi (27), Andiswa Msomi (13) umshana wakhe uMnuz Dumisani Ntuli (29), nomakhelwane wakhe uMnuz Bongani Ndlovu (42), uthe abasinda ngesikhathi kudutshulwa laba bayesaba ukuthi kungenzeka ababulali babuye.“Indaba yokubulawa kukamfowethu nezingane isifakela itwetwe ngoba asazi ukuthi ababulalali babeqondeni.“Usuku nosuku oludlulayo bengaboshwa ababulali thina siyesaba ngoba asazi ukuthi ubani olandelayo ngoba nathi sisewumndeni wakhe umfowethu? Kunjalo nje asitholi ukuthi baze babulawe nje benzeni ngoba kuyacaca ukuthi umbulali wayefuna ukuqeda ngomndeni kamfowethu.Asazi noma uma eseqede wona uzoqhubeka abulale nathi ngoba nathi sisewumndeni wakhe.ASEHLALELE ovalweni amalungu omndeni kulandela ukudutshulwa kwabayisithupha behleli ngeledlule eMpumalanga, eHammarsdale. Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/ANAUnina nezingane ezasinda bethuke kakhulu, kusengcono njengoba kusekhona abantu abasaphithizela njengoba kungakangcwatshwa nje, uma sebehambile angazi ukuthi bazohlala kanjani,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi abashona kulesi sigameko bazongcwatshwa ngeSonto.UKUNGABOSHWA kwabasolwa ngokubulala amalungu omndeni ayisithupha, adutshulwa abulawa ebuka ithelevishini ngeledlule eMpumalanga, eHammarsdale, kufaka ingebhe kwabasinda kule sisigameko. Isithombe: Doctor Ngcobo/ANA“Umlindelo uzoba sekhaya kodwa inkonzo yomngcwabo izoba sehholo. Okwamanje asikazi ukuthi iliphi ihholo, kodwa siyazi ukuthi ngeke ibe sekhaya,” kusho yena.UCol Thembeka Mbele uthe okwamanje akukaboshwa muntu ngalesi sigameko, amaphoyisa asaphenya.

KUNXUSWE othishanhloko bamakolishi amakhono amaTVET ukuthi basebenzisane nabezimboni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshudeni ziyathathwa ezimbonini ukuphucula amakhono azo emuva kokuqeqeshwa kulezi zikhungo.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqeshwa, iSayensi nobuChwepheshe uDkt Blade Nzimande ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi evula ngokusemthethweni ingqungquthela yezinsuku ezimbili iNational Artisan Development eqale izolo, eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre, eThekwini.“Othishanhloko kumele bazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awumuhle uma bengakhi ubudlelwane obuqinile nabezimboni ukuze izitshudeni zithole amathuba okuphucula amakhono azo,” kusho uNzimande.Uthe umsebenzi wabo uzokalwa ngokuthi zingaki izimboni othishanhloko abasebenzisana nazo ezizibophezele ukuthatha izitshudeni.“Uma unguthishanhloko ohlulekayo ukwenza umsebenzi wokunxenxa izimboni kusho ukuthi ulahlekile, akumele ngabe usesikhundleni okuso,” kuqhuba uNzimande.Unxuse abakwaSeta ukuthi baqhamuke nohlelo lokugcina ulwazi lwesitshudeni ngasinye okungenani esenza iziqu zobunjiniyela kuwona wonke amaTVET athe lolo lwazi lungasiza ekwazini isibalo esiqondile sezitshudeni ezidinga ukufakwa ezindaweni zokusebenza ukuze isitshudeni sithole isipiliyoni emkhakheni esiwufundele.UNzimande ugxeke izitshudeni ezingama-artisan ezihleli emakhaya ngoba zikhala ngokuthi aziwutholi umsebenzi noma aziqasheki.“Angiqondi ukuthi kungani kukhona umuntu oyi-artisan othi akaqashiwe ekubeni enekhono lokuzisebenza,” kusho uNzimande.Le ngqungquthela ihanjelwe nayizithunywa ezivela kwamanye amazwe neziphathimandla ezikhungweni zezemfundo ezehlukene.Ibamba likaNdunankulu uMnuz Ravi Pillay lamukele abathamele le ngqungquthela.

KUPHAZAMISEKE umhlangano womkhandlu, kwavalwa amabhuku ngesikhathi kuboshwa uSomlomo kaMasipala waseBaqulusini, eVryheid uMnuz Mkhonyovu Khumalo obhekene necala lokweba i-generator.UKhumalo uthelekelwe ngezakwadalawane ngoLwesine emahhovisi omkhandlu, waboshwa phambi kwamakhansela ethe shaye, ethamele umhlangano asala kanjalo emangele. Umasipala we-IFP ungaphansi komlawuli njengoba uhlaselwe yizinkinga zokuphatha, manje sekuboshwa usomlomo wawo.UKhumalo uboshwe nomunye umlisa, elingatholakalanga igama lakhe okukholakala ukuthi uyathinteka ekwebiweni kwempahla yomkhandlu.Kuthiwa bobabili abasolwa bavelile eNkantolo yeMantshi eVryheid ngecala lokweba.Isolezwe ngeSonto lithole ukuthi kunophenyo obeluqhubeka emuva kokuduka kwe-generator. Lihabule nokuthi yatholwa emzini womunye wabasolwa kodwa kungaqondakali ukuthi ifike kanjani.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCol Thembeka Mbele uqinisekise ukuboshwa kukaKhumalo nomunye umsolwaUSihlalo we-IFP, uMnuz Blessed Gwala uthe kukhona okushaya amanzi ngokuboshwa kukaKhumalo, kabaneme ngendlela izinto ezenzeke ngayo, sengathi kunetulo lokumthela ngehlazo.“Uma isela lebile, kufanele liboshwe kodwa lokhu abakwenze kuKhumalo kuyaxaka ngoba bayawazi umuzi wakhe. Pho yini aboshwe esemahhovisi omkhandlu? Kuze kuphazanyiswe umhlangano impela ngoba kwenzenjani? Yitulo elidala nje leli lokuhlambalaza konke ne-IFP. Yinto eyenziwa yizimbangi zethu,’’ kusho uGwala.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezindaba zoMdabu eKZN, uMnuz Senzelwe Mzila uthumele isitatimende esikhuluma ngokuboshwa kukaKhumalo.Uthe umnyango ubeka phambili umgomo wokuthi umuntu umsulwa uma engakalahlwa ayicala. Unxuse bonke abasebenzi ukuba babambisane namaphoyisa ophenyweni.

KUVALWE izitolo eziyisishagalolunye ezidayisa utshwala ngokungemthetho eMatikwe, eNanda, izolo ngenhloso yokunciphisa amacala okuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane enzeka kakhulu kule ndawo.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha noKongiwa kweMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, obehambisana nethimba lamaphoyisa nophiko olulawula ukukhishwa kwezimvume zokudayisa utshwala, bagasele ezindaweni ezidayisa utshwala kule ndawo. Bebehlola ukuthi izindawo ezidayisa utshwala ziyayilandela yini imigomo ebekiwe yokudayisa utshwala efana nokuthi kumele umdayisi abe nemvume, indawo yakhe iphinde ibe sesimeni esihle, kubuye kube nendawo yokupaka amakhasimende akhe.Ziyishagalololunye izindawo ezivaliwe izolo okutholakala ukuthi azinazo izimvume zokudayisa utshwala, izitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi lezi zindawo ziphephile.UNkk Dube-Ncube uthe ukuvalwa kwalezi zindawo kuyingxenye yohlelo lwalo mnyango lokuzama ukwehlisa isibalo samacala odlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane njengoba indawo yaseNanda ihamba phambili ngamacala odlame lobulili.“Kuyavela ukuthi amacala amaningi odlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane kakhulukazi awokudlwengulwa enzeka emuva kokuthi kuphuzwe utshwala. Yingakho sithe sizoqala ngokuthi sivale izindawo ezingekho emthethweni ezidayisa utshwala ukuze sinciphise izinto ezingaba umthethelela ekutheni kwenzeke la macala.”Ezinye zalezi zindawo ezivaliwe kutholakale ukuthi zidayisa ukudla, utshwala kuphinde kulalwe kuzo kanti nabanikazi bezitolo abanazo izimvume zokuba kuleli. Uthe umnyango wakhe ubeke eceleni imali enguR13 million ezosetshenziselwa izinhlelo zokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kule ndawo. Phakathi kwezinto ezizokwenziwa ngale mali, uthe kuzofakwa amakhamera ezindaweni zokuphuza ezinezimvume nasemigwaqweni.

AWUKAZI ukuthi uzongcwaba ngani umndeni wengoduso okusolwa ukuthi ibulawe umkhwenyana wayo eMgababa ngeSonto.Umndeni kaNksz Zothile Mthethwa (33) waseMashiwase, eMgababa, ngaphezu kobuhlungu bokuthi uvuke ngeSonto watshelwa ngomuntu olele endleleni eduze komuzi wakhona okuthe uma usufika khona wathola ukuthi ilungu lawo libulewe, usuzwa obunye ubuhlungu bokuthi awazi umufi uzofihlwa ngani. Lo mndeni uphinde washaqeka uma usekuboshwa umkhwenyana kamufi osolwa ngokuthi umklinye wambulala. Umndeni usubhekene nenkinga yokuthi awazi ukuthi uzongcwatshwa kanjani umufi njengoba umkhwenyana wakhe okunguyena obemeseka ngemali esengumsolwa.Umfowabo kamufi uMnuz Banele Mthethwa, uthe uhlukane nodadewabo ngoMgqibelo ntambama bephuma emcimbini wakwamakhelwane. Uthe udadewabo uphume wathatha indlela eya kubo yena ubesafuna ukuya kwenye indawo. Ekuseni akazange anake uma engamboni ngoba ubezitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe ukumkhwenyana wakhe.“Izingane ezingabashana balapha ekhaya ebezihamba endleleni zibone umuntu ebezithi ulele zamemeza. Sisheshe saphuma ngoba kuseduze nasekhaya. Sishaqeke kabi uma sithola ukuthi udadewethu futhi ushonile, emzimbeni ubengenalo inxeba. Sibize omakhelwane nomkhwenyana bafika badangala bebona lesi simo, umuntu okhulelwe eshonile kungaziwa ukuthi ubulelwe yini. Umkhwenyana ubeyingxenye yabantu ebethukile kodwa akuphelanga isikhathi eside amaphoyisa athola intambo ebifakwe udadewethu esinqeni ikuye, waboshwa ngoba kusolwa ukuthi umklinye ngayo.”Uthe ngokwazi kwakhe udadewabo nosbari wakhe odabuka eMalawi bebengenazo izinkinga bebexabana njengabo bonke abantu abathandanayo.“Isigameko senzeka ngeSonto kuze kube manje siyaphuma siyangena sicela usizo lokungcwatshwelwa, akulungi. La ekhaya akekho umuntu osebenzayo naye usisi ubengasebenzi.”Lo mndeni onabantu abadala abane, uphila ngemali yesibonelelo yezingane ezintathu, ezimbili ezikamufi neyodwa eyomunye udadewabo.UMnuz Lungani Mkhathini wophiko lwentsha lwe-ANC kule ndawo, uthe bengabantu abasha bashaqekile ngalesi sigameko esenzeke ngesikhathi lapho kukhuzwa ukubulawa kwabantu besifazane nezingane.“Siyazama ukusiza lo mndeni ngokuwutholela abantu abangawusiza okwamanje akekho osaqhamukile.”Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kutholakale isidumbu sowesifazane endleleni, eMashiwase, eMgababa, ngeSonto. Uthe kusolwa ukuthi lo wesifazane uklinywe waze washona.“Icala lokubulala livulwe esiteshini samaphoyisa eManzimtoti. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luholele ekutheni kuboshwe indoda eneminyaka engu-36 ngecala lokubulala. Le ndoda ivele enkantolo ngecala lokubulala namahlanje (izolo).”

UGWETSHWE udilikajele eNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu owesilisa ona-29 owayefunda eDurban University of Technology (DUT) owashiya izifundo wayoba yisigebengu.UMsizi Mbutho ugwetshwe ngecala lokubulala isitshudeni uSandile Ndhlovu (18), obenza unyaka wokuqala kwi-Industrial Engineering kusona lesi sikhungo. Umufi wayefunda ophikweni lwaseSteve Biko, eThekwini ngoSepthemba 9, lapho ashaywa khona ekhanda ngesando ngaphambi kokuthi abanjwe inkunzi.Likhipha isigwebo, iJaji uKhosi Hadebe, lithe akusaphephile kunoma yisiphi isikhungo semfundo “kusuka esikoleni samabanga aphansi kuze kufike emanyuvesi”.Ekhuluma ngaphandle kwenkantolo sekukhishwe isigwebo, uyise kamufi, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndhlovu (45) uthe bachitha izinsuku ezingu-10 eceleni kombhede kaSandile e-ICU bethandazela isimangaliso.“Satshelwa ngoSepthemba 10, ukuthi ingqondo yakhe ngeke isaphinde isebenze futhi salulekwa ukuba simkhiphe emishinini emgcine ephila. Sacela isikhathi esengeziwe futhi sathandazela ukuthi alulame ekulimaleni ekhanda. Ngangingakholwa ukuthi ukuphela kwengane esasinayo ayisekho. Manje ngibona sengathi akukho okungikhuthaza ukuthi ngiye emsebenzini ngoba ngisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ikusasa eliqhakazile kuye,” kusho uNdhlovu.Into eyayinzima kakhulu kuye kwakuyilapho indodana yakhe ingasabizwa ngegama layo kodwa ikhonjwa ngenombolo, idluliswa isuka kwamanye amakhaza iyiswa kwamanye.“Usuku lo mame, usuku lobaba noKhisimusi ngeke kusaphinde kufane ngaphandle kwakhe.”Lo mndeni, odabuka eMpumalanga, kaweneme ngalesi sigwebo, ngoba uthi ngeke siyibuyise indodana. Yize kunjalo kodwa ukhululekile ngokuthi icala lifinyelele emaphethelweni.UMbutho, odabuka eClermont, obephume ngoshwele ejele ngamacala okugqekeza izindlu ngo-2014, waya eDUT wahlasela umufi kabili ngesando weba iselula yakhe ne-laptop.Inkantolo izwe ukuthi wake waba ngumfundi oqavile, owaqeda * -matric ngamalengiso, waya eDUT ukuyokwenza izifundo zeSocial Science kodwa wazishiya ngemuva kokuba sengozini yemoto lapho aphuka imilenze yomibili. Walulama ngokuphelele, yilapho-ke aqala khona ubugebenguNgeledlule uMbutho uvume icala lokubulala uSandile. Encwadini yokuvuma icala, efundwe ngummeli wakhe * -Irshad Khan, uMbutho uthe waya eDUT eyontshontsha “noma yiziphi izinto ezikhala kahle”.“Ngikwenze lokhu ngenxa yokuphelelwa yithemba ngoba ngingasebenzi, ngingenamali futhi ngingenamathemba omsebenzi ongangingenisela imali,” kusho incwadi yakhe.UKhan ucele inkantolo icubungule isimo sikaMbutho, ibheke ukushonelwa uyise esafunda kanti unina washona ngonyaka wakhe wokuqala efunda eDUT.Ummeli woMbuso, uMnuz Bonginkosi Mbokazi, ukuchithile lokhu wathi uMbutho wanikezwa ithuba lesibili empilweni ngenkathi enikwa ushwele emuva kokugwetshwa ngaphambilini.“Uneminyaka engu-29, ufundile futhi uhlakaniphile. Kwakufanele azi kangcono.Irekhodi lakhe lezemfundo likhombisa ukuthi uhlakaniphile ngokwanele ukuthi azi ukuthi lokho akwenzile bekungalungile.”Uthe isenzo sikaMbutho asithetheleleki futhi akekho umzali okufanele adlule kulokhu abazali bakaSandile abadlule kukho.UMnuz Alan Khan, okhulumela iDUT, uthe bakhululekile ukuthi ubulungiswa benziwe nokuthi uMbutho utholwe enecala lokuhlasela okunobudlova ngakwenza kuSandile.“Yize sazi ukuthi lokhu ngeke kumbuyise uSandile, siyethemba ukuthi umndeni wakhe, abangani nalabo abefunda nabo bazoduduzwa wulwazi lokuthi umsolwa ubanjiwe, wagwetshwa ngempumelelo futhi wagwetshwa ngokufanele ngokuhlasela okunonya. Sengathi umphefumulo kaSandile ungaphumula ngokuthula,” kusho uKhan.

KULINDELE imvula ephelezelwa ukuduma kwezulu ezoqhubeka kulo lonke leli sonto likaKhisimusi KwaZulu-Natal.Isangoma sezulu kwaSA Weather Service, uMnuz Mkhushulwa Msimang ngesikhathi ekhuluma naleli phephandaba, uthe yize kuzoba nezimvula kusona sonke isifundazwe ikakhulu ngezikhathi zantambama kusukela namuhla, kodwa asikho isexwayiso sesimo sezulu esinobungozi esikhishiwe okwamanje.“Abantu bangakhululeka ngezikhathi zasemini benze imisebenzi yabo isimo sezulu ngeke siphazamise. Azoba khona amathuba emvula ahambisana nokuduma njalo ngezikhathi zantambama,” kusho uMsimang.Emasontweni amabili adlule izulu ebeliyidliva isonto lonke ezingxenyeni zakulesi sifundazwe, ligcine liletha itwetwe emphakathini njengoba ligcine lidlula nemiphefumulo yabantu abathathu kwalimala abayisithupha eNanda, eThekwini, okukhona phakathi kwabo nomfundi ona-11 oshone ngesikhathi udonga lwendlu yakubo ludilikela kuye. Umndeni ubuqoqene ndawonye ubuka uhlelo kwithelevishini.

UHLALELE ovalweni umndeni wowesilisa waseRedcliffe, eVerulam, okuthiwa udutshulwe wabulawa ngomunye wesilisa wakule ndawo obemsola ngokuthi uyishende le ntombi yakhe ngoMgqibelo.Umndeni kaMnuz Sibusiso Ncanana (34) uthe uzizwa ungaphephile njengoba owesilisa odubule umufi engakaboshwa ekubeni kuthiwa uke wabonakala kule ndawo ebusuku yize ebalekile emini ngoMgqibelo ngesikhathi efunwa ngamaphoyisa.UNkk Happy Ncanana, udadewabo kamufi uthe akazi ukuthi yini eyenze ukuthi le ndoda eyisoka lowesifazane owaziwayo kule ndawo ukuthi ikhombe umfowabo ithi nguye ojola nentombi yalo ngoba ngoLwesihlanu kuthiwa yabona ukuthi ubani le ndoda ejola nentombi yayo eyayifica ihleli nayo.“Ngesikhathi efika lapha ekhaya ufice umfowethu ehleli nomngani, ubuzile ukuthi ukhona uS’bu, umfowethu wavela. Wayisho le nsumansumane yakhe, umfowethu nomngani wakhe bamtshela ukuthi ayikho leyonto wathi akuyiwe entombini yakhe. Abazange banqabe ngoba babazi akulona iqiniso.Ngokuzwa kwami indaba yonakale uma sekufanele bangene kubo kantombi esethi akuyiwe ehlathini engasayingeni eyokuya kubo kwantombi.Yilapho bebuze khonaukuthi wangabe esakwenzi obekuvunyelwene ngakho wasedubula umfowethu. Ingane yakithi ifele into engekho ngoba intombi ithi ayimazi umuntu okuthiwa uS’bu, isoka eyayihleli nalo ngalelo langa liyayisho.”Uthe okubenza babe novalo ukuthi abalibonile leli soka ngesikhathi lihamba libalekela amaphoyisa bathi lithe liyabuya, akwaziwa ukuthi njengoba libuya nje libuyela bani.“Sonke siyesaba futhi sizwile ukuthi like labonakala ebusuku ngawo uMgqibelo.”UMnuz Prem Balram weReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), uthe onogada beRUSA bahambe namaphoyisa beyofuna intombi obekusolwa ukuthi ineshende ngenhloso yokuthi iyokhomba lapho kuhlala khona isoka layo, bafike itshe selome inhlama, isoka kuthiwa libonakale liphethe isikhwama lihamba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-34 udutshulwe washona ngumuntu owaziwayo endaweni ngoMgqibelo.Uthe umufi uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela washonela khona ngoba ubelimele ekhanda emuva kokudutshulwa.“Imbangela yokudutshulwa kwakhe ayaziwa, amaphoyisa asezithendeni zakhe umsolwa,"  kusho uCaptain Gwala

BAFUNA kuboshwe umshayeli wetekisi abamsola ngokudala ingozi abomndeni obhubhe ngesikhathi imoto yawo ishayisana netekisi eBhamshela ngempelasonto.Kule ngozi eyenzeke ngoMgqibelo ebusuku kushone uMnuz Sphamandla Madlala, ingoduso yakhe uNksz Banothile Jili nendodana yabo uWandile Madlala, obefunda uGrade 5 nengane yakwamakhelwane eneminyaka emine. Bonke laba ngabaseTrustfeed.Kuthiwa bebephuma ekhweni likaMadlala, beyoshiya izimpahla zesikole zengane yabo ehlala koninalume, bese bebuyela emzini wabo eTrustfeed ngesikhathi kwenzeka le ngozi.UMadlala ubeshayela imoto encane abebehamba ngayo kanti kuthe sebeseBhamshela bashayisana netekisi. Umshayeli wetekisi uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela esesimeni esibi.Ngokusho kukamfowabo kaMadlala omdala uMnuz Thulani “Thu” Madlala, bafuna umshayeli wetekisi eshayisane nemoto kamfowabo aboshwe.“Abafowethu abashayela amatekisi kumele baqikelele emgwaqweni njengoba sithole ukuthi umshayeli wetekisi ubesika endaweni engafanele, ehamba nangesivinini esiphezulu wazithela phezu kwemoto kamfowethu, washona wonke umndeni kamfowethu nengane yakwamakhelwane abebehamba nayo. Njengomndeni sifuna ubulungiswa kuleli cala, sifuna umshayeli wetekisi aboshwe ngokushona kwalaba bantu abane,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe umfowabo naye oshayela amatekisi eVerulam ubewukhonzile kakhulu umndeni wakhe njengoba bebephuma kohambisela enye ingane yakhe yomfana efunda esikoleni esiseduze koninalume izimpahla zesikole.“Sishayelwe ucingo sesitshelwa ukuthi balimale engozini. Bebesanda kusuka ekhweni likamfowethu, kutshelwe bona kuqala ngale ngozi nathi sabe sesibikelwa. Namanje kusenzima ukwamukela ukuthi umfowethu uhambe kabuhlungu kangaka nomndeni wakhe ngosuku olulodwa,” kusho uMadlala.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe kuvulwe amacala amane okubulala ngokungenhloso. “Kushayisane imoto encane netekisi ngabo-8 ebusuku, kwashona abane. Umshayeli wetekisi ulimalile wabe esephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. Amaphoyisa aseNsuze aphenya amacala okubulala ngokungenhloso. Imbangela yale ngozi ayaziwa, kusaphenywa,” kusho uCol. Mbele.Khonamanjalo eCrammond ngaphandle kwaseMgungundlovu kulimale abantu abathathu kulandela ukushayisana kwemoto encane neveni. Le ngozi yenzeke emgwaqweni uR33. Abezimo eziphuthumayo baka-ER24 bathe bafike endaweni yesigameko izimoto zisaphazekile zagcwala umgwaqo. Owesilisa oneminyaka engu-50 kuthiwa kade evalelekile emotweni yakhe. Kusetshenziswe izindlawu ukutakula.Abalimele balashiwe, baphuthunyiswa ezibhedlela eziseduze.

source: lihlehlile icala lamalungu e anc angeneme
text: INKANTOLO eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu ikuhlehlisele inyanga ezayo ukulalelwa kwesicelo samalungu e-ANC angeneme esifundeni iMoses Mabhida Region abefuna kuhlakazwe isigungu sesikhashana salesi sifunda ngoba ethi sesiphelelwe yisikhathi.Le nkantolo ifuna ukuthi leli cala lilalelwe kanye namanye kanti alukho uzinzo kulesi sifunda njengoba kukhona amalungu afuna kuhlaliswe ingqungquthela ezokhetha ubuholi.Abefake lesi sicelo nje namhlanje i-ANC ithula umqulu wokukhankasela ukhetho kanjalo igubha neminyaka engu-107 kwabunjwa le nhlangano.UNobhala jikelele wale nhlangano, uMnuz Ace Magashule, ephawula ngokuhlehliswa kwalesi sicelo, uthe sebekwenze konke kwangaphakathi ukuzama ukuxazulula isimo kulesi sifunda.Uthe bahlale benxenxa amalungu enhlangano ukuthi angayi ezinkantolo uma efuna ukuxazulula izinto.“Akusona kuphela lesi sifunda esingabanga nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi, ziningi nezinye ezweni lonke. E-Eastern Cape, Western Cape, Free State nakwezinye izifundazwe zikhona izifunda ezagcina ngokungazihlalisi izingqungquthela.”Uthe umnqamulajuqu wokuhlalisa izingqungquthela wawungo-Agasti 31 nyakenye wathi isigungu esiphezulu sale nhlangano esanquma ukuthi zingabe zisahlala izingqungquthelaokudlule lesi sikhathi zingahlalile.Lesi sigungu sanquma ukuthi izingqungquthela kumele zihlale ngemuva kokhetho lukazwelonke okulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoMeyi nonyaka.“Ubuholi base-KZN baze bacela ukuthi kuvunyelwe iMoses Mabhidaukuthi ihlalise ingqungquthela.“Asikwazi ukuvumela abanye ukuthi benze okunye abanye singabavumeli ngakho isinqumo esathathwa sifaka wonke umuntu, abekho abantu ababezovunyelwa ukuthi babe nengqungquthela ekubeni abanye benqatshelwe,” kusho uMagashule.Uthe bazoqhubeka bayilungise ngaphakathi indaba yaseMoses Mabhida.“Kukhona abantu abangeneme namanje.
