Indaba yobumbano sisayisebenza enhlanganweni.“USihle Zikalala (uSihlalo wesifundazwe we-ANC) noMike Mabuyakhulu (iPhini likaSihlalo we-ANC esifundazweni) babenemibono engefani kodwa buka manje basebenza kahle kanjani ngenxa yobumbano. Bakwazile ukubumba isifundazwe saya phambili,” kusho uMagashule.

IMANQIKANQIKA ukuvota intsha ezobe ivota okokuqala okhethweni lukazwelonke kulo nyaka ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngokufakwa kakhulu kwasebekhulile ezinhlakeni zobuholi.Intsha okukhulunywe nayo ithe ifuna ukubona ushintsho ebuholini bezepolitiki, kufakwe abaholi abazoqonda izidingo zayo. Njengoba ngempelasonto ezayo kulindeleke kubhaliselwe ukuvota okokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho oluzoba ngoMeyi, enye intsha ayikaqinisekisi ukuthi izobhalisa.UMsawenkosi Dlamini (23), ofunda e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, uthe yayisimvumela iminyaka yokuthi avote okhethweni loHulumeni baseKhaya ngo-2016 kodwa wangavota.“Ngathola sekuzovotwa ukuthi kwakufanele ngibhalisele ukuvota eThekwini lapho sengihlala khona uma ngifunda. Nokho angizisolanga ngokungavoti ngoba akukho obekungigqugquzela. Namanje akukho okungenza ngilangazelele ukuvota ngoba akekho nosigqugquzelayo emanyuvesi,” echaza.Uthe uzoya kobhalisela ukuvota ngesonto elizayo kodwa usazibuza ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elifanelwe yivoti lakhe. Ukhala ngokuthi amaqembu akhona awagculisi futhi alikho iqiniso.“Ngibona sengathi uma ngivota ngizobe ngifaka imali ephaketheni lomuntu. Sishoda ngabaholi abakhathalele abantu ngokweqiniso. Abanye bayathembisa kodwa bangazifezi izidingo zomphakathi. Neqembu elibonakala linentsha eningi lihlushwa wukuthi abaholi balo abavuthiwe ngokomqondo,” kusho uDlamini.Ukhale nangokuthi akayiboni intsha ebuholini bamaqembu ngisho ePhalamende kugcwele kakhulu abadala okwenza intsha ibone singekho isidingo sokubavotela.UZanele Khambule (19) waKwaMashu uthe wakubhalisela ngonyaka odlule ukuvota futhi uzimisele ukuvota.“Ngibona kungifanele ukuvota ngoba ivoti lami lizoletha ushintsho. Ikusasa lezwe lincike evotini lami,” kusho uZanele.Yize ethe ngeke adalule ukuthi uzovotela liphi iqembu, uthe alikhethile ulibona likhathalele imfundo yabamnyama.UZama Khumalo (19), oyokwenza unyaka wokuqala eDurban University of Technology, uthe akanawo umfutho wokuvota futhi akakabhalisi. Uthe ubengazi nokuthi kuyabhaliswa ngesonto elizayo.Uveze ukuthi abazali bakhe abamkhuthaza ukuthi avote ngoba bamtshela ngesimo abaphuma kuso ngezikhathi zobandlululo.“Kunzima kithina esingazazi lezo zikhathi ngoba esikubona manje yinkohlakalo kuphela. Baningi abantu esibabona besahlupheka nezingane zifunda kanzima kodwa sitshelwa ukuthi sikhululekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki kusamele aqinise ekushintsheni imiqondo yethu ukuthi yiluphi ushintsho esizolubona uma sivota. Kungasiza nokubona intsha inikwa amathuba ebuholini.”Umbiko wocwaningo lwe-Institute for Security Studies, waveza ukuthi intsha isemanqika ukuvota. Ngo-2014 yayingu-33% intsha eneminyaka ewu-18 no-19 eyavota okhethweni luka­zwelonke. Egqugquzela iqembu lakhe ukuthi livote eThekwini, uMntwana wakwaPhindangene, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ukuphawulile lokhu kungabi nkamunkamu kwentsha ekuvoteni. I-IEC imemezele ukuthi ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto elizayo kuzobhaliselwa ukuvota kuzo zonke izikhungo.

UBUMBANO, ezemfundo, ukubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo, ezempilo, ukufukula ezomnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ngezinye zezinto okulindeleke ukuthi zibe seqhulwini enkulumeni yaminyaka yonke ye-ANC ezothulwa nguMengameli wale nhlangano, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Le nkulumo ibhekwe ngabomvu, ikakhulu kulo nyaka wokhetho, njengoba le nhlangano izobe ikhankasela ukuwina ukhetho ukuze igcine amandla okuhola uhulumeni kuleli ngaphandle kwaseWestern Cape lapho kuphethe iDA.Umgubho iJanuwari 8, uzoba senkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida eThekwini kusasa. Le nhlangano imemezele ukuthi ilindele ukugcwalisa le nkundla emumatha abantu abangu-87 000.Abahlaziyi bezombusazwe abakhulume neSolezwe, bathe lezi zinto ezibalwe ngenhla yizona ezizobe zihamba phambili enkulumeni kaRamaphosa.Umhlaziyi, uMnuz Protas Madlala, uthe ucabanga ukuthi inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu odabeni lokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula ezomnotho.“Angingabazi ukuthi uRamaphosa imkhathaza kakhulu indaba yomnotho wezwe osuhlale isikhathi eside ungasimami yingakho enza konke okusemandleni ukuba kuguqulwe isimo somnotho wezwe,” kusho uMadlala.Uthe ngeke ayishiye ngaphandle indaba yobumbano ikakhulukazi njengoba uhlangothi obeluhamba noDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, ngesikhathi kuyiwa eNasrec, kade lungamfuni.“Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyikhuza, isihlava sokubulalana kosopolitiki esenzeka kakhulu lapha KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uMadlala.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Bukani Mngoma, naye uhambe emazwini kaMadlala wathi ubona inkulumo kamengameli izogxila kakhulu ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nokufukula umnotho.“Udaba lwamathuba emisebenzi nezomnotho kuyahambisana. Enye into engicabanga ukuthi uzoyithinta, wudaba lwezemfundo nodaba lokubuyiswa komhlaba ngaphandle kwezinxephezelo,” kusho uMngoma.Uthe ezemfundo zibalulekile ngoba ziyisikhali sezwe.Naye uRamaphosa ekhuluma kuleli sonto emgubheni weminyaka engu-107 kwabunjwa i-ANC oHlange, eNanda, ubalule ibanga eselihanjiwe kwezemfundo kuleli.Ubale ukunyuka kwemiphumela ka-matric unyaka nonyaka, isibalo esiphezulu sabafundi ababhala leli banga, ukudla ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa kwabafundi njengezinye zezinto le nhlangano ezenze ngempumelelo selokhu yathatha amandla ombuso.Ukhale ngabafundi abaqala isikole kodwa bangafinyeleli kwa-matric, wathi lokhu kuyabakhathaza.Ubalule nokuthi uhulumeni wandise isibalo sabantu abasebenzayo kuleli.“Sathatha izintambo abantu abangu-8 million ababesebenza kuleli, sengeze ngabanye abangu-7 million asebesebenza manje selokhu sathatha izintambo.“Umhlaba sizowuthatha ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo. Sizobhekana nokwahlukana, sizobumbana,” kusho uRamaphosa ngamafuphi eNanda.Kuleli sonto, abaholi abahlukene abaphezulu bale nhlangano bankanise isifundazwe sonke benxenxa abantu ukuthi bathamele le nkulumo eMabhida.UMnuz Zizi Kodwa, obhekele ezokuxhumana ehhovisi likaRamaphosa kwi-ANC, uthe abantu bazogcwala nakwenye indawo abazobe behlelelwe kuyona uma sekugcwele eMabhida.“Zintathu kuphela izinhlangano ezikwazi ukugcwalisa izinkundla kuleli. I-ANC, iChiefs uma idlala nePirates nebandla iZCC. Sizoyigcwalisa iMabhida,” kusho uKodwa.Le nhlangano ithe yonke into isimi ngomumo ngalo mgubho.

SIKHUZA ukuzibulala kubafundi abangaphasanga u-matric isitshudeni sase-University of KwaZulu-Natal (UKZN), esawuphinda kabili u-matric.UMnuz Sanele Gamede oyisikhulu esiphezulu se-Ilada Holdings owenza ePhd kwiSocial Science, wawaphinda kabili amakilasi kaGrade 10, 11 no-12 kodwa wangaphela amandla. UGamede ongumbhali wencwadi ethi ‘The Graduate Pack’, uqale umkhankaso wokweseka abafundi abaqede * -matric nokukhuthaza imindeni yabo ukuthi ibaseke.“Baningi abafundi abagcina bezibulala abanye baphathwe ukhwantalala ngenxa yengcindezi abayithola emuva kwemiphumela ka-matric. Njengomuntu osebenza kakhulu nentsha ukuthuthukisa ezemfundo, nginxusa ukuthi sonke sibambe iqhaza ekwesekeni izingane ezingenzanga kahle ku-matric,” echaza.Uthe yize ayefeyiliswa ukuhlupha esafunda, kwamphaphamisa ukungaphasi u-matric ngoba wayebona ukuthi ngeke akwazi ukulungisa isimo sasekhaya ebesibheda. Echaza ngalo mkhankaso #MatricUngazibulali, uthe uwushumayela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nasemisakazweni. Uvule nenombolo athe angathintwa kuyo abazali nezingane ezifeyile* -matric ezidinga ukwelukelwa nolunye usizo. Kulo mkhankaso uphinde axwayise nangezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezingombombayi nangokukhetha imikhakha efanele emanyuvesi.UGamede ubuye asebenzisane ne-UKZN ukusiza izitshudeni esezithweswe iziqu, ukuzichushisa ngendlela yokuthola umsebenzi nokufaka izicelo. Njengoba sekuzovulwa nasemanyuvesi uthe usebenza nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukusiza abafundi abafuna ulwazi ngezinye izikhungo nemfundo ephakeme.UGamede ophinde afundise iSmall Medium and Micro Enterprises ejele eWestville eThekwini, ngo-2016 wahlonishwa ngeKZN Young Achievers Awards. Ngonyaka odlule watheswa iziqu zeMasters kwiCultural and Media Studies e-UKZN. Inombolo yokweluleka abafeyile * -matric ithi: 072 806 9092.

ABANTU abaningi bayakujabulela ukubizwa ngamagama amahle ahambisana nezikhundla abaziphethe emsebenzini, ikakhulukazi uma beqashwe yizinkampani ezinkulu kodwa owesifazane waseNgwelezane washiya umsebenzi wokuba wumabhalane wakhetha ukuqoqa udoti emigwaqweni.UNkk Nokubonga Mnyango abanye abambiza ngoBabes Kadoti, uthi akumkhathazi lokhu ngoba vele udoti uyawuthanda futhi akaligqizi qakala iphunga elibi elithaphuka kuwo.UNkk Mnyango ungumsunguli wenkampani uThando Recyclers, le nkampani uthi ikhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi ungawulahli budedengu udoti, iphinde ukhuthaze wona umphakathi ukuthi uzenzele imali ngokuqoqa udoti osengabuye usetshenziswe ngokuthi uwudayise.Le nkampani uthi uyisungule ngemuva kokuthi ebone ukuthi kanti udoti uyimali. Lokhu uthi wakubona ngesikhathi ethunywe enkampanini abeyisebenzela ukuthi ayodayisa amaplastiki asesebenzile asetshenziswa yile nkampani ukuhlola ukuthi izingodo ezidayisayo ziswakeme kangakanani, ngo-2014“Bekungakhethwa ukuthi ngubani othunywa ukuthi ayodayisa oplastiki, ngo-2014 kwathunywa mina, ngathatheka uma ngibona ukuthi kanti udoti unemali ngabuye ngabuza nokuthi kungani bewuthenga bangitshela ukuthi bakwenzela ukuthi kongiwe imvelo.“Uthando lwami lokonga imvelo lwaqala lapho, angibange ngisachitha sikhathi ngaqala ngaqoqa udoti ngawubeka egcekeni lami ngaphambi kokuthi ngiye emsebenzini. Kwabaningi ukuqoqa izigubhu, amabhodlela, amathini namaphepha kwakubukeka njengokuhlanya,” kusho yena.Lo mcabango womakhelwane uthe waqina kakhulu ngesikhathi eseyeka umsebenzi enza lo msebenzi ngokugcwele ngo-2015. Imali ayithola emsebenzini uthe wathenga iveni elidala waliqamba ngokuthi “money maker”.Ngawo lowo nyaka wangenela umncintiswano owawuhlelwe uMkhandlu uMhlathuze, iResponsible Tourism Challenge, emunxeni oqondene nokuqoqwa kukadoti. Wawina isikali asisebenzisela ukukala udoti, okwamsiza ukuthi avule isikhungo esizothenga amabhodlela, izigubhu namaphepha emphakathini.“Ngo-2017 kwavuleka elinye ithuba ngangena ngaphansi kohlelo lwakaCoca-Cola Beverages SA (CCBSA) olukhuthaza ukuthi abafundi baqoqe udoti ikakhulukazi izigubhu, amabhodlela namaphepha. Ngathola izikole ezingu-14 engazifaka kulolu hlelo, zenza umsebenzi oncomekayo okwaholela ekutheni ngichonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala, emncintiswaneni iBusiness Women of the Year ohlelwa yiyo iCCBSA,” kusho yena.

MHLELI: Ngithi ake ngizikhalele kade ngibekezela kodwa manje sengiyahluleka sekufike la ngidinwa khona abantu badelela isibongo sasekhaya (Mkhize) ezinkundleni zokuxhuma.Le nto yaqala ngokweyiswa kwendawo engeke ngikwazi ukubiza igama layo. Manje sebengenele esibongweni sakaMkhize. Yonke into engasile isikhonjwa kaMkhize, umuntu wenza into ebhedayo usengowakaMkhize ngisho noSathane imbala sekuthiwa owakaMkhize.Kukhona nalesi siphuzo esibhalwa izibongo. Uzwa esethi umuntu ngiphuze ebesibhalwe ukuthi Mkhize ngavele ngaphathwa yikhanda, udideke ukuthi ubusithengelani esibhalwa uMkhize kwakhona ekuqaleni uma enenkinga noMkhize.Lesi sibongo sikhulu kabi, siyahlonishwa umhlaba wonke futhi siyathandwa kakhulu. Kukhona ngisho namaNdiya, abantu abasuka kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika ubezwa sebezibiza ngoMkhize ngoba kuyisibongo esithandekayo. Noma yikuphi lapho uhamba khona uma uke wathi ungowakaMkhize abantu bavele bakujabulele ngoba bayathandwa kakhulu abantu bakaMkhize. Yisibongo samaqhawe lesi sihlonipheni ngiyanincenga.Ngiphakamisa izandla zombili ngiyanincenga hlukanani nesibongo sakaMkhize akusona esokudlala. Ngithemba ukuthi kuzwakele nizongilalela.Stete MkhizeEsinyonyane

ITHOLAKALE izolo isicekelwe phansi itekisi yeDA, ebintshontshwe eMorningside eThekwini ngoMgqibelo. Itekisi esetshenziselwa ukukhankasela ukhetho inemibala yeqembu nobuso bukaMnuz Zwakele Mncwango okufoloswe ngaye ukuba nguNdunankulu KwaZulu-Natal.UMncwango, obhale nakuFacebook ngokwebiwa kwetekisi, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi ibigcine ukubonakala ngezithuba zabo 12 ebusuku. Uthe yebiwe lapho kuhlala khona umshayeli wayo eMorningside.“Siyacabangela ukuthi yebiwe entathakusa ngoba umshayeli ubeyibonile isegcekeni ngabo 12 ebusuku. Sisizwe ukufaka udaba kuFacebook ukuze isheshe itholakale,” kuchaza yena.Uthe bathintwe ngowesilisa izolo obatshele ukuthi imoto uyibone ipake emagcekeni amanye amafulethi eNewlands.“Sithinte amaphoyisa siwatshela ukuthi imoto ibonakele eNewlands kodwa asichitha athi kungenzeka ukuthi siyaluthwa. Kudingeke siziyele mathupha sahlangana egaraji nowesifazane osikhombise lapho eyibone khona. Siyithole isicekelwe phansi bakhipha i-tracker,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe ngeke asho ukuthi kukhona abakusolayo ngokwebiwa kwale moto kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi ubugebengu obujwayelekile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi livuliwe icala lokwebiwa kwemoto kodwa yatholakala izolo.

ZIDLULE nabantu abangu-1612 izingozi ezenzeke emgwaqeni yakuleli ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba nyakenye.Lokhu kudalulwe uNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha uMnuz Blade Nzimande ngesikhathi ethula umbiko ngezokuphepha emgwaqeni ngoLwesithathu.Ngokwalo mbiko obheka izingozi ezenzeke kusukela ngoDisemba 1 kuya kuJanuwari 8, iKwaZulu-Natal ihambe phambili ngesibalo sabantu abafe ezingozini njengoba kudlule abawu-328 kulesi sifundazwe.Ngemuva kwayo kulandele i-Eastern Cape (238) Gauteng (219), Limpopo (178), Mpumalanga (162), Free State (159), Western Cape (149), North West (125) ne-Northern Cape (54).Zimbili kuphela izifundazwe okwehle izinga lokufa ngezingozi kuzo. EGauteng izinga lehle ngo-19%, eNothern Cape lehla ngo-2%.ENorthern Cape izinga linyuke ngo-80% noma isibalo sabafe emigwaqeni sisaphansi kulesi sifundazwe.Kulezi zingozi u-36% wabantu abafa ababengabagibeli, abahamba ngezinyawo (35%) abashayeli (27%) kanye no-2% wababehamba ngamabhayisikili.Lo mbiko ngezinhlekelele ezidlule nabaningi emgwaqeni uphuma nje bekubikwe ukuthi sinyusiwe isibalo samaphoyisa agcwele emgwaqeni kanti nongqongqoshe uphinde waveza ukuthi kuba nama-roablock awu-775.Kulokhu kuboshwe izimoto eziwu-4016, abantu abawu-8057 kwashicilelwa amathikithi awu-765 009 emiqwaqeni yakuleli ngesikhathi samaholidi.UNzimande usole uphuzo oludakayo, ukushayela budedengu, ukukhathala kanye nezimoto ezingekho emthethweni njengomnyombo wezingozi ezenzeka nsuku zonke emgwaqeni yakuleli. Uthe uma lungabonakali uguquko kubashayeli bakuleli iNingizimu Afrika isazoqhubeka ibe nemigwaqo eyingozi.

PHEZU kokuba abahlaziyi bezepolitiki bethi i-ANC izophinde iwudle umhlanganiso okhethweni lukazwelonke okulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoMeyi nonyaka kodwa bathi akukho okusha okuvele kumhlahlandlela wokhetho othulwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.URamaphosa uthule umqulu obugxile emfundweni yamahhala, ezempilo, ukufukula umnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukubuyiswa komhlaba, ukulwa nobugebengu, ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane nabakhubazekile, ukwehliswa kokubiza kwe-data, ukwakha izindlu, izikole, amadamu nezinye izethembiso.UMnuz Lukhona Mnguni waseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, uthe akukho okusha okwethulwe kulo mqulu wokukhankasela ukhetho othulwe yi-ANC enkundleni yemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini.Uthe ugxile ezintweni ebezivele zilindelwe okubalwa umhlaba, ezemfundo nezinye izethembiso.“Yizinto ezifanayo ezindala ezivele zikhona ngoba nasekufukulweni komnotho kubalwa indaba yeBhange loMbuso okuyinto esike yavela phambilini. Kwezomhlaba noma engalibekanga ngembaba elokuthi bazolusebenzisa uhlelo lokuthi umuntu adayise umhlaba ngoba ethanda kodwa bazolusebenzisa nakuba kuzochitshiyelwa isigatshana * -25 soMthethosisekelo ukuze kuthathwe umhlaba ngaphandle kwesinxephezelo,” kusho uMnguni.Uthe nendaba yokuthi kumele kusungulwe isikhungo soMbuso esikhiqiza amaphilisi nemithi akuyona into entsha ngoba nangesikhathi kuyiwa okhethweni lukazwelonke lwango-2014 ngenye yezinto eyayiseqhulwini.“Mayelana nendaba yemisebenzi siyehla isibalo semisebenzi abayithembisile njengoba ngonyaka uRamaphosa ethe kuzokwakhiwa engu-275 000 ngonyaka ekubeni owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma wayethembise engu-500 000 ngonyaka. Kukhulunywa nendaba yokuthi izitshudeni zithole ukuqeqeshwa kanjalo nokuthi singabe sisadingeka isipiliyoni kwizitshudeni ezisuke ziqede iziqu zizongena emazingeni aphansi eminyangweni kahulumeni.”Uthe njengoba i-ANC isiphathe iminyaka engu-25 kuhulumeni abantu abasabheki izethembiso basuke befuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani izethembiso ezindala zingafezwanga.“Kunongqongqoshe asebehlale iminyaka engu-20 kuhulumeni abantu bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani ezinye zezinto zingafezwanga. Yona i-ANC izoluwina ukhetho cishe ngaphezulu kuka-60% ngoba kukhona abantu abakholelwa kuRamaphosa siqu sakhe ukuthi angalihola izwe,” kusho uMnguni.USolwazi Bheki Mngomezulu, osophikweni lwezifundo zezepolitiki eNyuvesi yaseWestern Cape, uthe akukho okusha ngoba uMengameli ukhulume ngezinto ebezivele zilindelekile okubalwa umhlaba, amathuba emisebenzi, umnotho nomhlaba.Uthe ugxile kakhulu ekutheni intsha ithuthukiswa kanjani kanjalo nasemabhizinisni amancane.“Zona zizodwa angicabangi ukuthi zingabuyisa uzinzo eqenjni. Uma ubheka i-ANC isenhlanhleni ngoba amaqembu aphikisayo awaqinile kakhulu ukumisa kabi i-ANC,” kusho uMngomezulu.Uthe izokwazi ukuphinde idle umhlanganiso wathi akacabangi ukuthi ingawina ngamalengiso.

KUVALWE ngehlahla kubhubha amalungu omndeni waseMlaza ayisikhombisa, abebuya emngcwabeni eMandeni ngoMgqibelo.Engozini eyenzeke emgwaqweni uN2, kushayisane iHilux neToyota Etios kuyo obekunomndeni wakwaNtshingila. Kuthiwa umndeni ububuya ukuyongcwaba ekhweni. Kwabashonile kubalwa uMnuz Siyabonga Khangelani Ntshingila (33) okuthiwa ubephelezelwe eyongcwaba ekhweni. Ushone nendodana yakhe uSphelele (2). Kushone nonina uNkk Ntombifikile Angel Ntshingila iminyaka yakhe engatholakalanga, uNksz Sithembile Ntshingila (30), uNksz Samkelisiwe Ntshingila (27), uMnuz Luyanda Ntshingila (35) noNksz Londiwe Ntshingila.UMnuz Bongani Ntshingila okhulumela umndeni uthe abashonile bebehambe ngemoto eyodwa bephelezele uSiyabonga obeyongcwaba ekhweni.“Nathi sizwe sesishayelwa ucingo ntambama sitshelwa ukuthi behlelwe yingozi sebebuya emngcwabeni. Kumanje sisadidekile kodwa sinesiqiniseko sokuthi kuzomele bangcwatshwe ndawonye ngoba umndeni owodwa. Kumanje siphuma emakhazeni eMandeni ukuyokhomba izidumbu. Balimele kakhulu ezinye izicubu zabo bezicoshwa phansi,” kusho uNtshingila.Ngokwesitatimende sabezimo eziphuthumayo i-IPSS Medical Rescue, kuthiwa izimoto ezimbili zishayisane mahlanze kwashona abayisikhombisa endaweni yesigameko. Kuthiwa ingozi yenzeke ngasebhulohweni lasoThukela. Abezimo eziphuthumayo iPhilamed Ambulance Services abafike endaweni yesigameko, bathe izidumbu bezisakazeke emgwaqweni.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi uMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa uthe bajube ithimba elizophenya ngengozi, lixhumane nemindeni.Kwenye ingozi eyenzeke ngoMgqibelo kushone owesilisa oneminyaka engu-47 oshayiswe imoto kuN3 ngaseMkondeni eMgungundlovu.Okhulumela abezimo eziphuthumayo kwa-ER24 uNksz Ineke van Huyssteen, uthe bafike owesilisa ephakathi nomgwaqo eseshonile.

source: uzobuyela enkantolo ngelizayo obulale izingane zakhe
text: UZOLINDA elinye isonto ngaphambi kokuthi akwazi ukufaka isicelo sebheyili owesifazane waseKlarinet, eMpumalanga, osolwa ngokubulala izingane zakhe ezine ngamaholidi kaKhisimuzi.UNksz Zemhle Zinhle Maditla (24) uvele eNkantolo yesiFunda eWitbank ngoMsombuluko lapho ebhekene khona namacala amane okubulala. Kubikwa ukuthi ngosuku ‘abulala’ ngalo izingane zakhe naye wayazama ukuzibulala kodwa wangaphumelela.Ubegcinwe esibhedlela ngaphambi kokuthi avele enkantolo kanti icala lihlehliselwe isonto elizayo njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo.Izingane zikaNksz Maditla ezatholwa zigoqwe ngoblankethi endlini, zagcina ukubonakala emphakathini ngoDisemba 26.Umsolwa kuthiwa wafonela umndeni wawushiyela umyalezo othi ubashiyele isipho sikaKhisimuzi egunjini lakhe lokulala ngoDisemba 30.Ekhasini likaNksz Maditla kuFacebook abangani bakhe bebelokhe bebuze njalo ukuthi kungani ‘ebulale’ izingane zakhe.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoJanuwari 14.

source: izongenisa  bn imigubho ye anc kwazulu natal
text: IZONGENISA uR2 billion imigubho ye-ANC emnothweni waKwaZulu-Natal njengoba kutheleke abantu abangaphezu kuka-100 000 kuleli sonto.Lezi zindaba zivezwe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho, ezokuVakasha neMvelo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala osho lokhu emuva kokuthi iPhini leMenenja kaMasipala weTheku uMnuz Phillip Sithole lithe wonke amahhotela amakhulu nagudle ulwandle agcwele njengoba kunemicimbi yemigubho yeminyaka ewu-107 yokusungulwa kwe-ANC.USithole uthe abafuna izindawo zokulala kufanele babheke amaBed and Breakfasts nezinye izindawo ezihlala izivakashi.UZikalala uthe njengoba i-ANC izoba nomgubho omkhulu kusasa eMoses Mabhida izinkampani zokuvakasha zithe konke kuhamba kahle futhi kuhlomule izindawo ezihlukene ezilala izivakashi KwaZulu-Natal ngoba abaholi be-ANC bebethe chithisaka kwisifundazwe sonke. “Siwuqala kahle unyaka ngoba nomkhankaso wethu wokwandisa izivakashi uthela izithelo ezinhle ngoba ucwaningo luveza ukuthi kufike izivakashi eziwu-2 000 zakwamanye amazwe angaphandle ezinyangeni zokuqala ezintathu zika-2018. Sifuna nokunyusa isibalo sezivakashi zangaphakathi, sikhulise nemali engenayo ibe phakathi kukaR65 billion noR98 billion kule minyaka emibili ezayo,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi bayafinyelela ohlelweni lwabo lokwakha amathuba omsebenzi awu-183 000 kwezokuvakasha kule minyaka emibili ezayo bahehe nezivakashi eziwu-3.4 million zakwamanye amazwe ngo-2030.

source: ingane ishaywe wugesi yafa iyothenga uswidi
text: USADIDEKILE unina wengane eneminyaka emine yasemijondolo, iShiyabazali, eseLotus Park, eSiphingo okusolwa ukuthi ishaywe ugesi wezinyokanyoka onqamula endleleni ebihamba ngayo, ngoLwesibili, yashona.UFikile Lusanda Dlamini kuthiwa uphume ekhaya eyothenga uswidi owaziwa ngo-Ice Cream, esitolo esiseduze kwakubo, kusolwa ukuthi uthe uma engawutholi lo swidi waqhubeka waya kwesinye isitolo engasamazisanga unina.UNksz Bongiwe Dlamini unina kamufi uficwe yileli phephandaba esendleleni eya kubo eMkhomazi, lapho eyofihla khona indodakazi yakhe, uthe umufi uphume eyothenga uswidi esitolo esiseduze, wangawutholi wabuya, wacela ukudlulela kwesilandelayo wamvumela kodwa ushone esendleleni ebheke esitolo sesithathu esibuqamama nasekhaya.“Ngisola ukuthi kuthe uma engawutholi lo swidi esitolo sesibili wabona ukuthi uma ebuyela kimi ezocela ngeke ngivume ngoba sibuqamama, waqhubeka wazihambela kanti ngeke esafika kuso. Ngimfice esethule eduze kwayo intambo kagesi ebinqamula endleleni yezinyawo abehamba ngayo,” kusho uNksz Dlamini.Uqhube wathi akazi ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ididwe yini ngoba ugesi ibiwazi ukuthi uyingozi akumele iwunyathele.“Mhlawumbe uthe uyayeqa intambo wakhubeka wawela kuyo, angiboni ukuthi ubengayinyathela ngoba uyazazi izintambo zikagesi. Siyazi ukuthi lezi zintambo ziyingozi futhi kujwayelekile ukuthi abantu zibalimaze kodwa kuyaqala ukuthi kube nomuntu oshonayo,” usho kanje.UMnuz Thapelo Mohapi wenhlangano elwela abahlala emijondolo, Abahlali baseMjondolo, uthe kuyishwa ukuthi uMasipala weTheku wagunyaza ukufakwa kukagesi emijondolo eminyakeni emibili eyedlule kodwa lolu hlelo luhamba kancane ngenxa yosopolitiki abanomhobholo.“Uphiko lukamasipala luzivulile izandla lulindele ukusifakela ugesi inkinga idalwa ngamakhansela afuna ukukhetha osonkontileka abazowanika iqatha. Ngesikhathi kusadlalwa lo mdlalo wemali abantu abahluphekayo bayashona. Esikhathini samanje akulula ukuthi uphile ugesi ungekho, yingakho abantu bebeka impilo yabo engcupheni ngokuzifakela lo gesi wezinyokanyoka,” kusho yena.UCol Thembeka Mbele okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uthe amaphoyisa aseSiphingo avule idokodo lophenyo ngemuva kokuthi kutholakale isidumbu sentombazane eneminyaka emine okusolakala ukuthi inyathele intambo kagesi.

KUSOLWA ukuthi uzikhunge ngenxa yokhwantalala oludalwe ukubanjwa inkunzi nokuthunjwa owesilisa waseZimbabwe otholakale elenga emgwaqweni omkhulu eVerulam ngeSonto.UMnuz Michael Chikura (24) kuthiwa bekusaphele isonto esinde esehlakalweni sokuthunjwa, waphucwa noR600 ngamadoda angaziwa. Isitatimende esithunyelwe yinkampani yabezimo eziphuthumayo, iReaction Unit South Africa (RUSA), siveza ukuthi uChikura obehlala eWaterloo, watholakala elenga esihlahleni emgwaqweni uR102 eduze kwebhuloho eVerulam.Ngokusho kukamfowabo, uChikura ubeseneminyaka emithathu ehlala kuleli. Uthe ngoNcibijane umufi wathathwa ngamadoda angaziwa amshaya, amfaka ebhuthini yemoto aze ayombeka eNorth Beach. Kuthiwa washaywa amahora ayisihlanu, abahlaseli bamshiya becabanga ukuthi useshonile. Kuvela ukuthi waphucwa iPassport nemali.“Watholwa amaphoyisa wayiswa esibhedlela kwavulwa necala lokuthunjwa nokuzama ukubulala. Kusukela kwenzeke lesi sehlakalo akazange aphinde abe sesimeni esikahle ngoba ubesaba ukuthi abahlaseli bangabuya bazomqedela. Kungenzeka ukuthi yikona lokhu okudale ukuthi azilengise,” kusho isitatimende.Umndeni ucela noma ubani onolwazi ngokuthunjwa kukamufi ukuthi axhumane namaphoyisa noma iRUSA ku-086 1234 333. Imizamo yokuthola umndeni wakhe yephunzile njengoba kuthiwe usuyolungiselela umngcwabo eZimbabwe.Isidumbu siChikura sabonwa amalungu omphakathi ayedlula emgwaqweni ngezithuba zabo-6 ekuseni. Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe kuvulwe idokodo lokufa komuntu eliphenywa amaphoyisa aseVerulam. Uthe amaphoyisa ayaphenya.

INHLANGANO ezibiza ngeDagga Party of South Africa, ithi uma ingakwazi ukuthola uR200 000 ofunwa yinhlangano eyengamele ukhetho kuleli ukuze iqembu lezepolitiki likwazi ukungenela ukhetho, kuyobe kuphenduleke imithandazo yabo bonke abantu bakuleli abafisa ukusebenzisa insangu ngokukhululeka.Le nhlangano ithi isikwenze konke okudingekayo njengokubhalisa isiqubulo seqembu nelogo, kodwa njengamanje isasenkingeni yokuhlanganisa imali yokubhalisa.“Ngicela ukuthi ngosuku lokuvota, nizilungiselele ukubungaza isihlahla sensangu,” kusho umholi waleli qembu, uMnuz Jeremy Acton njengoba iqembu lakhe ethi lifuna ukuba yingxenye yabathatha izinqumo ePhalamende ukuthi insangu isetshenziswe kahle ngokukhululeka eNingizimu Afrika.Leli qembu eliphinde laziwe ngokuthi Iqela Lentsango, lithi yize kukhona imithetho esishayiwe ehambisana nensangu, kodwa kuningi okusadinga ukusetshenzwa okumayelana nayo insangu nokuvumeleka kwayo kuleli.Ngonyaka odlule iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanquma ukuthi kube semthethweni ukusetshenziswa kwensangu, kuphela uma isetshenziswa emakhaya noma itshalwe khona.Njengamanje kuseyicala ukutholakala uyibhema emphakathini, okuyinto abasebenzisi bayo abangayizwa kahle.Leli qembu lithi like lazama ukungenela ukhetho ngo-2014, kodwa imali ekhokhwayo ukuze iqembu libe sohlwini lwamaqembu azovotelwa, yaba ngumqansa.Inkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanikeza uhulumeni iminyaka emibili ukuthi alungise kahle imithetho okuzohanjwa phezu kwayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwensangu kuleli.Umholi waleli qembu nozakwabo uMnuz Gareth Prince yibona abaqala ukusukumela udaba lokusetshenziswa kwensangu ngokukhululeka njengoba baya enkantolo enkulu yaseWestern Cape bephonsela inselelo imithetho evimba lokhu.Babefuna nokuthi kube semthethweni ukuthi insangu isetshenziswe njengomuthi owelapha ezinye izifo futhi abantu bakwazi ukuhweba nangayo baziphilise.Ekhasini lakhe likaFacebook, * -Acton unxenxe bonke abantu bakuleli abahambisana nokusetshenziswa kwensangu ukuthi basize leli qembu likwazi ukumeleleka ePhalamende ukuze libe yizwi labantu abahambisana nokusetshenziswa kwensangu kuleli.Usesungule ne #SmokeThemOut #HotboxTheHouse #DaggaParty, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana athi uhlose ngayo ukunxenxa abantu ukuthi balule isandla futhi basebenzise ilungelo labo ukuphumelelisa ukusetshenziswa kwensangu.Kulindeleke ukuthi inhlangano ebhekelele ukhetho kuleli i-IEC, imemezele ukuthi ukubhaliswa kwamaqembu azoba sohlwini lwamaqembu azoba kwi-ballot paper kuzovalwa nini.U-Acton uthi leli qembu selibhalisile ezingeni likazwelonke kodwa kusamelelikwazi nokubhalisela ukuthi libe khona nasohlwini olusezingeni lezifundazwe.UMengameli wakuleli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa kusalindeleke ukuthi amemezele usuku okuzovotwa ngalo kuleli lizwe. Kodwa useke wacashunwa kweminye imithombo yabezindaba ethi lolu suku luzoba ngaphambi kokuthi kuphele uMeyi nonyaka.

source: uramaphosa uyawavuma amaphutha enziwe yi anc
text: UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa uvumile ukuthi inhlangano yakhe i-ANC yenze inqwaba yamaphutha kule minyaka edlule futhi izimisele ngokuzehlisa phambi kwabantu iwalungise ukuze babuyelwe yithemba kuyona.URamaphosa usho lokhu ngesikhathi ephakathi nenkulumo yakhe emcimbini wokwethula komhlahlandlela wokhetho obusenkundleni iMoses Mabhida eThekwini ebigcwele phama kungekho nendawo yokubeka unyawo.URamaphosa uthi kubalulekile ukuthi bangazikhukhumezi bavume umonakalo bese beqala-ke ukulungisa.“Simatasa sizinuka amakhwapha thina njengenhlangano.Asiphiki ukuthi sishayisile ezintweni eziningi kodwa siyalungisa, wonke umuntu uyakubona lokhu. Sinikeni-ke ithuba sibuyisele izinto ngononina sisebenze siye phambili,” kunxusa uRamaphosa eshela abavoti.Uthe isinyathelo sokuqala ukuthi abavoti baqome uKhongolose okhethweni oluzayo lukazwelonke, bese behlala bethule babuke balindeukuthi kuye ngamagama enkehli.Uthe abantu abangakhohlwa ukuthi i-ANC isuka kude nabo, ngakho-ke abangayihlinzeli ezibini ngamaphutha ayo.“Sifuna ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi esayiqala ngo-1994 kuze kube yimanje. Sizoyilungisa indaba yamathuba emisebenzi ngoba siyazi sikhulu isililo ngayo.“Umnotho kufanele siwukhulise ngoba yiwona ozolekelela ukudaleka kwemisebenzi," kunxusa uRamaphosa.

KULINDELEKE siphume namhlanje isinqumo ngesicelo sebheyili sekhansela le-ANC elisolwa ngokubulala elinye okusolwa kukho umbango wesikhundla eMlaza. Izolo eNkantolo kaMantshi eMlaza abameli babasolwa baveze izethulo zabo.UMbuso nawo waqala ukuveza ezawo ngesicelo sebheyili. Kulindeleke imantshi, uMnuz Thulani Mbuyazi, ukuba ihlaziye okubekwe wuMbuso nabameli, bese ikhipha isinqumo. Izolo leli cala belithanyelwe uMengameli we-ANCYL kuzwelonke, uMnuz Colleen Maine. Ufike icala seliphakathi.Ikhansela laku-ward 80, uMnuz Mthokozisi Nojiyeza, lisolwa ngetulo lokubulala ikhansela laku-ward 88 uMnuz Sibusiso “Bhabhane” Maphumulo, ngo-Okthoba nyakenye. UNojiyeza usolwa noMnuz Phumlani Nojiyeza noNkosinathi Mbambo ngaleli cala.Ummeli wekhansela, * -Advocate Simphiwe Mlotshwa, okhulume cishe amahora amathathu, enxenxa inkantolo ukuba inikeze uNojiyeza ibheyili, uthe ngokwakhe alikho leli cala ngoba alinabufakazi futhi umphenyi wecala uchemile.“Okokuqala nje umuntu uma esola omunye ngecala kumele akwazi ukuletha ubufakazi ngalezo zinsolo kodwa lapha asikuboni lokho. Bengiqala ngqa empilweni yami ukuzwa umphenyi ethi ngendlela ababaningi ngayo abantu aseke ababopha, wabapheka ngemibuzo ngaleli cala, kwayena uyahluleka nokubabala.Lokhu kwenza ngibone ukuthi umane uzingela ikati elimnyama elingekho, uyazidobela nje ukuze abone ukuthi yini angayibamba ngaleli cala. Akukho okubambekayo okuthinta umsolwa wesibili (Nojiyeza) kuleli cala,” kusho uMlotshwa.Uphinde wathi kwaphulwa umthetho, angalandelwa amalungelo kamsolwa ngesikhathi eboshwa njengoba washaywa, wanqatshelwa nokutshela umndeni wakhe ukuthi ukephi ngesikhathi eseboshiwe.Imantshi ibuze uMlotshwa ukuthi yibuphi ubufakazi anabo bokuthi leli khansela lashaywa amaphoyisa.“UMbuso yiwona obekumele ulethe ubufakazi ngoba yiwona obopha umuntu, umgcine ezitokisini.“Umsolwa uvezile amanxeba abesephola lapho asho khona ukuthi ulinyazwe amaphoyisa kade emshaya. UMbuso uhlulekile ukuphikisa ukuthi umsolwa washaywa,” kusho uMlotshwa.

UZITHINTELE kubantu umsiki wengqephu waseNgwelezane, eMpangeni ngemuva ngokuhlambalaza amadodakazi akhe amathathu ngokuwamodelisa namaphepha anemibhalo ewathukayo enxanxatheleni yezitolo iSanlam Centre, eMpangeni ngempelasonto edlule.Uyise wezingane esingeke simdalule ngenxa yokuvikela zona, kuthiwa uqhube amadodakazi akhe aneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-13 kuya ku-15 ewanamathisele amaphepha ezifubeni abhalwe ngemibhalo emikhulu egqamile ethi awanaso isimilo, athandana nenqwaba yamadoda, alala nawo.Isenzo salo somabhizinisi owaziwayo endaweni, kuthiwa sibacasulile abantu abebekule ndawo.“Lezi zingane bezigqoke ama-jean nezikibha ezincane zihamba ngezinyawo. Bezibukeka zingcolile sengathi bezingalalanga nasekhaya.“Sithukile ngoba lo somabhinisi ungumuntu owaziwayo endaweni, besingalindele ukuthi angenza into efana nalena.“Amadodakazi akhe abengabukeki eshayiwe kodwa bekubonakala ukuthi ayamesaba ngoba abelokhu ethithibele eduze kwakhe,” kusho umthombo.Uthe abantu basola uyise wamantombazane ngokuba yisahluleki somzali ngesenzo sakhe.“Kukhona ababikele abaphathi balezi zitolo, kwabizwa nonogada ukuthi bamnqande.“Ugcine esexoshwa kwathiwa akakwazi ukuzokwenza into efana nalena ezitolo.“Amaphoyisa afoneliwe kodwa afike ngemuva kwesikhathi esehambile nezingane zakhe,” kusho umthombo.Ethintwa lo somabhizinisi usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko, wathi wayeyothenga kwesinye sezitolo ehamba namadodakazi akhe ayenecala alenzile. Uthe onogada bamvimba namadodakazi akhe bathi abaphume ngoba lokhu abakwenzayo akuvumelekile.“Angikweleti muntu ukuthi ngichaze ukuthi kwakwenzenjani. Sekuyicala yini, ngibe ngingazibulalanga izingane zami.“Abantu abanenkinga nesenzo sami ngiyacabanga ukuthi bayayazi imigudu efanele okumele bayilandele.“Mina ngizophendula kubantu abanegunya lokungihlohla imibuzo,” kusho uyise wamantombazane.Ubhoke ngolaka uma Isolezwe ngeSonto limbuza ukuthi inhloso yakhe kwakuyini ngesenzo sakhe.“Ngiyibhinca mina ngeke ngilokhu ngigijima ezinkantolo ngaloludaba kodwa ngizokuthungatha ngize ngikuthole ngibhekane nawe ngqo,” esabisa intatheli uyise wamantombazane.Okhulumela iSanlam Centre, uNkk Lindiwe Dube usiqinisekisile lesi sigameko, wathi bayalele onogada ukuthi bakhiphele ngaphandle umlisa obehamba nomndeni wakhe enza into ebiphazamisa abathengi nabaninizitolo.Uthe abahambisani nendlela lo mlisa abezama ukuxazulula ngayo inkinga yomndeni wakhe endaweni yabo.

KUVALWE ngehlahla kubhubha amalungu omndeni waseMlaza ayisikhombisa, abebuya emngcwabeni eMandeni ngoMgqibelo.Engozini eyenzeke emgwaqweni uN2, kushayisane iHilux neToyota Etios kuyo obekunomndeni wakwaNtshingila. Kuthiwa umndeni ububuya ukuyongcwaba ekhweni. Kwabashonile kubalwa uMnuz Siyabonga Khangelani Ntshingila (33) okuthiwa ubephelezelwe eyongcwaba ekhweni. Ushone nendodana yakhe uSphelele (2). Kushone nonina uNkk Ntombifikile Angel Ntshingila iminyaka yakhe engatholakalanga, uNksz Sithembile Ntshingila (30), uNksz Samkelisiwe Ntshingila (27), uMnuz Luyanda Ntshingila (35) noNksz Londiwe Ntshingila.UMnuz Bongani Ntshingila okhulumela umndeni uthe abashonile bebehambe ngemoto eyodwa bephelezele uSiyabonga obeyongcwaba ekhweni.“Nathi sizwe sesishayelwa ucingo ntambama sitshelwa ukuthi behlelwe yingozi sebebuya emngcwabeni. Kumanje sisadidekile kodwa sinesiqiniseko sokuthi kuzomele bangcwatshwe ndawonye ngoba umndeni owodwa. Kumanje siphuma emakhazeni eMandeni ukuyokhomba izidumbu. Balimele kakhulu ezinye izicubu zabo bezicoshwa phansi,” kusho uNtshingila.Ngokwesitatimende sabezimo eziphuthumayo i-IPSS Medical Rescue, kuthiwa izimoto ezimbili zishayisane mahlanze kwashona abayisikhombisa endaweni yesigameko. Kuthiwa ingozi yenzeke ngasebhulohweni lasoThukela. Abezimo eziphuthumayo iPhilamed Ambulance Services abafike endaweni yesigameko, bathe izidumbu bezisakazeke emgwaqweni.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThutha nokuPhepha koMphakathi uMnuz Mluleki Mntungwa uthe bajube ithimba elizophenya ngengozi, lixhumane nemindeni.Kwenye ingozi eyenzeke ngoMgqibelo kushone owesilisa oneminyaka engu-47 oshayiswe imoto kuN3 ngaseMkondeni eMgungundlovu.Okhulumela abezimo eziphuthumayo kwa-ER24 uNksz Ineke van Huyssteen, uthe bafike owesilisa ephakathi nomgwaqo eseshonile.

IMEYA yaseMgungundlovu, uMnuz Themba Njilo, ithi babonga uNkulunkulu ngokuvikela umsakazi woKhozi FM olimale kabi esigamekweni okusolwa kuso ukuthi ubedunwa imoto.Kushaqise abaningi ukuvela kwezindaba zokuthi uSbu Buthelezi wohlelo lwasemini Indiza Nathi ngo-12 kuya ku-3 ntambama phakathi nezinsuku udutshulwe amahlandla amaningana ngeSonto ebusuku eMbali, eMgungundlovu.UNjilo uthe kubuhlungu okuvelele lo msakazi.“Ngiphuma kuye nje (esho izolo emini), isimo sakhe siyagculisa kakhulu. Siyambonga uNkulunkulu. Uyakhuluma konke kuhamba kahle siyabonga asiqedi,” kuchaza uNjilo ngamafuphi.Umthombo okhulume naleli phephandaba uveze ukuthi uSbu ubekwenye yezindawo afuna ukuqala kuzo ibhizinisi eMgungundlovu.“Kuthiwa ubemile ngaphandle kule ndawo ngesikhathi kuqhamuka abalisa okungaziwa ukuthi bangaki abavele bavulela ngenhlamvu. Isicabha sakhe ungasibona ukuthi silimele kanjani njengoba kwanaye edubuleke esifubeni,” kuchaza umthombo.Uveze ukuthi lo msakazi kuthe ngesikhathi esedubulekile wangena emotweni wahamba wayofuna usizo.“Kuvela ukuthi ungene egaraji nala engalutholanga khona usizo njengoba abantu bevele bathuka babaleka ngisho nabasebenzi. Uphinde waqhubeka wazishayelela nokuthe endleleni waluthola wase ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela,” kuchaza umthombo.LESI ngesinye sezithombe ezilethe ithemba kwabaningi ukuthi uyalulama umsakazi woKhozi FM, uSbu Buthelezi, ngemuva kokuvela kwezindaba zokuthi udutshulwe esigamekweni okusolwa ukuthi ubebanjwa kuso inkunzi eMgungundlovu ngeSonto ebusuku. USbu kulesi sithombe ubehanjelwe umculi wokholo uThobekile Mkhwanazi nabanye ozakwaboUveze ukuthi esibhedlela ukwazile ukulandisa abafike kuqala konke okwenzekile kodwa isimo sakhe sase siba sibana nokugcine esengeniswa egunjini labagula kakhulu.Abantu abaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bazwelane kakhulu noSbu ngokumehlele.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe kuvulwe icala lokuzama ukubulala ngemuva kwalesi sigameko.Uthe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-47 uhlaselwe ngabesilisa abangaziwa abavele bavulela ngenhlamvu ekhoneni lomgwaqo u-Archie Gumede noMoses Mabhida.UMbele uthe lona wesilisa ulimale esifubeni nasengalweni.Umculi wokholo uThobekile Mkhwanazi wehlise amaphaphu abaningi ngemuva kokuthi efake isithombe enaye lo msakazi esibhedlela.Okhulumela iSABC, uNeo Momodu, uthe abaphathi bakwaSABC nabasebenzi bonke bamfisela ukushesha alulame uSbu ngemuva kwesigameko esimehlele.Uthe lo msakazi uyalulama futhi isimo sakhe sempilo sihle kakhulu.

UMSAKAZI weMetro FM, uMo Flava usaqhubeka nakulo nyaka ukufukula imfundo yakuleli ngokutakula ngemifundaze abafundi abaphuma emindenini edla imbuya ngothi.Lo msakazi owethula ngokuhlanganyela uhlelo lwantambama noMasechaba Ndlovu oluthi The Drive, ukhipha le mifundaze ngokubambisana nesikhungo semfundo ephakeme iBoston Media House. Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uMo Flava uthe umkhankaso wakhe wokunikezela ngemifundaze uzoqala ophikweni lalesi sikhungo oluseThekwini ngoMgqibelo.Echaza ngokusungula lo mfundaze, lo msakazi uthe ukhuthazwe ukukhula kanzima.“Nami ngafunda khona eBoston, kungekho lula ngenxa yokuthi imali beyingekho. Okwacishe ngangiphoqa ukuthi ngishiye phansi. Nangesikhathi sengisebenza bengihlangabezana nentsha engibuza ngokuthi ingenza njani ukuze yenze lo msebenzi engiwenzayo. Bengithi uma ngiyitshela ukuthi kufanele iyofunda, ikhale ngokweswela imali. Yingakho-ke ngathi angisungule lo mfundaze ukuze ngiyisize ifeze amaphupho ayo.”Uthe abantu abahlinzeka ngalo mfundaze yilabo abathole imiphumela emihle nyakenye noma ngo 2017 futhi abaphuma emindenini engamile kahle ngasemnothweni.“Umuntu ofuna lo mfundaze ungithumelela imiphumela yakhe ka-matric kuWhatsApp (0812687518). Ngibe sengimfonela ngimbuza ukuthi uphuma emndenini onjani futhi sengimazisa nokuthi sizohlangana kuphi naye.”UMo Flava uthe uzoqala eDurban Campus ngoJanuwari 19, adlulele eSandton Campus ngoJanuwari 26 bese egcina ePretoria Campus ngoFebhuwari 2.Ucele abafundi ukuba baqale bazi ukuthi bafuna ukwenza muphi umsebenzi uma sebephothule izifundo zabo.“Akuve kungiphatha kabuhlungu ukuzwa umfundi esethi uyahluleka ukwenza izifundo azikhethile, manje usefuna ukuzishintsha. Abanye bafunde baqede kodwa bahlulwe yimisebenzi abayikhethile. Umuntu ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somfundaze akenze isiqiniseko sokuthi useyazi ukuthi ufuna ukufundela muphi umsebenzi,” kusho uMo Flava.Uthe kudingeka abafundi abazimisele ngokwenza izifundo eziphathele nomsakazo, ukukhiqizwa komculo, ukudijeya, Animation neGraphic Design.Sekungunyaka wesishiyagalolunye uMo Flava efundisa intsha mahhala.

IKHALELWE ngamasongo kaSigonyela inyanga yaseMasosheni, eGreytown, okuthiwa ibidlwengula abantu besifazane abakhendla kuyona ibalutha ngokuthi umphambili wayo yilona khubalo eyelapha ngalo, othole wona ngeke aphinde ahlupheke.Inyanga eneminyaka engu-26 esingeke sikwazi ukuyidalula ngoba ayikaveli enkantolo, iboshwe ngoLwesine ekuseni isekhaya layo. Leli phephandaba lihabule ngemithombo yalo ukuthi inyanga ibimatasa ithaka amakhathakhatha ayo ngesikhathi ezakwadalwane zitheleka yathuka, yajuluka yamanzi te bayigaxa izinsimbi bachitheka nayo.Kuthiwa imikhuba yayo isabalele endaweni. Kuyaziwa ukuthi yelapha kakhulu isifazane esitshela ukuthi induku yayo ikhipha amashwa, izinto zaso zikhanye. Kuvele nokuthi uyabagqugquzela ukuthi bazohlalela ngasekhaya lakhe kanti ufuna ukuzitika ngabo ehleli nabo. Umthombo uthi inyanga iboshwa nje sekunabesifazane abebehlala kuyo le nyanga, belashwa besuka esigodini eShana, eGreytown. Kuvela nokuthi laba besifazane bebeze ngosizi lwabo, bengazi ukuthi lo mlisa ubaconsela amathe njengoba behlala naye.Kuthiwa omunye wabo uvule icala lokudlwengulwa njengoba inyanga ligcine liyishonele nje. Akuqondakali ukuthi lo wesifazane ukhuleliswe yiyo yini inyanga noma ukhulelwe kwenye indawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, ukuqinisekisile ukuboshwa kwalo mlisa.Uthe umgilwa ubikele amaphoyisa ukuthi wabhozonyelwa yile nyanga yamdlwengula. Uthe kwavulwa icala eKranskop ladluliselwa ophikweni olubhekene nobugebengu obuhambisana nocansi njengoba ethelekelwe ezakwadalawane, waboshwa."Kulindeleke ukuthi umsolwa avele eNkantolo yeMantshi eKranskop kusasa ebhekene necala lokunukubeza ngokocansi owesifazane oneminyaka engu-25,’’ kusho uColonel Mbele.

text: MHLELI: Ngokwejwayelekile ukuqala konyaka omusha kuletha ithemba ebantwini abehlukene kodwa akunjalo ezinganeni eziphothule iziqu zobuthishela emanyuvesi. Ezinye zalezi zingane sezineminyaka emithathu zaphothula imfundo ephakeme kodwa lutho ukuthola umsebenzi. Okubuhlungu kakhulu wukuthi bafunde kanzima abazali beboleka imali ngethemba lokuthi uma sebephothulile kuyoba lula ukuyibuyisela kulabo abatshelekisayo.Kunoxhaso okuthiwa yiFunza Lushaka. Abantwana bathi iyisiqalekiso impilweni yalabo abafunde kanzima abazali beqhwanda ukuze baphumelele. Ngesikhathi besafunda bathi bazifaka izicelo kulo Funza kodwa zangaphumelela. Uma sebezizamele baphumelela batshelwa ukuthi kuzobhekwa kuqala abafunde ngalo Fundza Lushaka. Ngabe bukhona ubuntu uma ziphathwa kanje izingane zethu ezifunde kanzima zingaxhaswe muntu?Kumele ngabe kuqalwa ngazo uma kuvuleka amathuba ngoba abazali bazo bayagula ngenxa yezikweletu abangene bacwila kuzo ngesikhathi abakaFundza bebhukuda emafutheni. Alikho iqiniso emhlabeni.Uthini uNgqongqoshe woMnyango nalabo abaphathiswe uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uma kubandlululwa izingane zabantu ezihluphekile?Kusobala lezi zingane azisoze zaqashwa ngoba idimoni eliwuFundza Lushaka liyaqhubeka nokuxhasa abafundi abasha. Lokho kusho ukuthi abahleli emakhaya bayohlala kuze kuphele lo Fundza oyisiqalekiso kubona ngaphambi kokuba babhekelelwe nabo. Ngicela uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane aphumele obala asitshele izwe ukuthi kulungile yini lokhu okwenzekayo.Mbhishobhi Themba ChoncoEMtubatuba

source: zingase zivalwe izikoleezithole u  ku matric
text: ZINGASE zivalwe ezinye zezikole okuvalwe ngehlahla kwangaphasa ngisho umfundi oyedwa ku-matric KwaZulu-Natal ngo-2018 ngoba ezinye zazo bezinomfundi oyedwa obhalile.UMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni uzobizela esigcawini othishanhloko balezi zikole ukuthi bazochaza ngemiphumela engemihle abayitholile. Sinyukile isibalo sezikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018 njengoba ziyisishiyagalolunye zisuka kwezintathu ngo-2017.Okhulumela umnyango uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa, uthe bazobiza nothishanhloko bezikole ezithole ngaphansi kuka-60% ukuze kucutshungulwe imiphumela yalezi zikole. Uthe kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezithole u-0% asikho esango-2017 okwakungaphasanga muntu kusona, yizikole ezintsha.“Lezi ezintathu ezazithole u-0% azikho kulezi eziyisishiyagalolunye zangonyaka odlule okungaphasanga muntu kuzona. Ezinye zalezi ezithole u-0% bezinesibalo esincane sabafundi ababhalile njengoba kwesinye ubeyedwa kwesinye bebane. Abazali kumele babambisane nathi uma sifuna ukuvala isikole ngoba ezinye zezingqinamba uma sifuna ukuhlanganisa izikole noma sivale ezinye ngukuthi abazali bayanqaba,” kusho uMlotshwa. Uthe basuke befuna ukuzivala ngoba basuke sebenze ucwaningo olunzulu wathi abamane nje bavuke sebevala isikole.“Nakulezi kukhona okubonakalayo ukuthi azisebenzi ngakho kudingeka ukuthi zivalwe, zihlanganiswe nezinye kodwa sizoxoxa nemiphakathi ethintekayo. Sizokwakha uhlelo lokuphucula imiphumela yalezi zikole ngoba sifuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola ngaphansi kuka-0%.”UNgqongqoshe walo mnyango, uMnuz Mthandeni Dlungwane, wayethe ufuna ukuqeda ngezikole ezithola u-0% kulesi sifundazwe. Zingu-12 ezweni lonke izikole okungaphasanga muntu kuzona ngo-2018.Esinye sazo yiMpikayizekanye Secondary ebinabafundi abangu-18. Lesi sikole sike sangena ehlazweni lokukopela kwabafundi ngo-2014. Umnyango waqinisa kakhulu ezikoleni ezathinteka ekukopeleni kwabafundi ngokuthi kube nabantu abazozinza kuzona kuze kuqala ukubhala kwezivivinyo zize ziphothulwe.Ezinye zezikole ezithinteka ekukopeleni kubalwa iMaweni High, Mzoniwe High okubhale kuyo abayisishiyagalombili, Ncwecwe Secondary okubhale abafundi ababili, Nende Secondary okubhale abafundi abangu-10, Sbonginhlanhla Secondary okubhale umfundi oyedwa, Groenvlei Combined okubhale abafundi abayisishiyagalombili, Vuleka School for the Deaf okubhale abane naKwaMpunzi Combined okubhale abafundi abayisikhombisa.

IHHOVISI likaNgqongqoshe wezeMvelo uNkk Nomvula Mokonyane lithi lo ngqongqoshe akakazophawula okwamanje ngezinsolo abekwa zona kwikhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana eholwa yiJaji uRaymond Zondo.Izolo owayeyisikhulu saseBosasa, uMnuz Angelo Agrizzi, uveze ukuthi babegwazela uNkk Mokonyane ngoR50 000 njalo ngenyanga baphinde bamthengele inyama, utshwala obuphambili baphinde bamngcwabele nezihlobo.UMnuz Mlimandlela Ndamase, okhulumela uNkk Mokonyane, uthe ngeke aphawule ungqongqoshe ngezinsolo zeKhomishini kaZondo.Ukhuluma kanjena nje uNdamase izolo ntambama i-eNCA ibike ukuthi abameli bakhe babhalele iKhomishini kaZondo bekhala ngokungahlonishwa kwamalungelo akhe nokuputshuzwa kwemibiko engakaveli kwikhomishini emaphephandabeni angeSonto.U-Agrizzi uthe uNkk Mokonyane waze wacela ukuthi kuqashelwe indodakazi yakhe imoto izinyanga ezintathu ngesikhathi ibuya eChina.“UNkk Mokonyane wayenobudlelwano nesikhulu esiphezulu saseBosasa futhi wayenguMqondisi enamasheya kwiDyambu okwakuyigama leBosasa ngama-2000’s. Kusukela esenguNgqongqoshe wezokuPhepha eGauteng sasimkhokhela imali. Sasithenga nokudla okuzodliwa kuma-rally eSiyanqoba, sifonelwa nasebusuku ukuthi silekelele abalandeli be-ANC,” kusho u-Agrizzi.Uthe bacelwa ukuthi benze ucwaningo lwezokuphepha ezibhedlela zaseGauteng okwakuzodla uR2 million kodwa umbiko walolu cwaningo wanikezwa uMnuz Reggie Nkabinde onguMgcinimafa we-ANC Youth League ukuze athole ithenda.Uphinde waveza ukuthi ngesikhathi uNkk Mokonyane enguNgqongqoshe wezaManzi wacela iBosasa ukuthi yenze ucwaningo ngokuphepha kwamadamu olwadla uR1.3 million.“UNkk Mokonyane kwakufanele akhulume nowayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi asishushiswa ngamacala enkohlakalo. Sasihlala simnika imali njalo ngoba wayenamandla,” kusho u-Agrizzi.Uthe babegwazela noMnuz Vincent Smith owayenguSihlalo wekomidi lezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo ukuze azibe imibuzo yalabo abafuna ukwazi ngezinkontileka zeBosasa nohulumeni.Ngaleso sikhathi u-Agrizzi uthe iBosasa yayinenkontileka noMnyango wezoBulungiswa, ukuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekeko nezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo njengoba yayibhekelele ezokuphepha yenza namabhande alawula ukuhamba kweziboshwa.“Kwathathwa isinqumo ukuthi uSmith, uVincent Magagula noWinnie Ngwenya bazokhokhelwa njalo ngenyanga ukuze banyathele imibuzo ngezinkontileka zeBosasa eyayivela kwabezindaba. USmith wayekhokhelwa uR45 000, uVincent ethola uR30 000 bese uWinnie athole uR20 000,” kusho u-Agrizzi.UMnuz Zizi Kodwa uthe i-ANC iyaziqhelelanisa nemibiko yokuthi ababegwazelwa eBosasa babesebenzisa leyo mali ukuhlomulisa i-ANC esho nokuthi akuyona i-ANC eyayibathumile kodwa babezenzela lokho siqu sabo.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi izinga lomnotho KwaZulu-Natal linyuke nabantu abawu-235 bathole umsebenzi uma sekwakhiwe inxanxathela yezitolo eBhamshela, eNdwedwe.Sijabulise umphakathi waseNdwedwe isimemezelo esethulwe izolo uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho nezokuVakasha, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala. Ungqongqoshe uthe ukwakhiwa kwenxanxathela kuzokwenza ukuthi umphakathi ungabe usaya kude uma uyothenga njengoba kuzoba khona izitolo ezinkulu. Ukwakhiwa kwezitolo kwenziwe wuhlaka lukahulumeni wesifundazwe, iKZN Growth Fund.UZikalala izolo uhlabe isoyi lokwakhiwa kwenxanxathela yezitolo ezodla uR61.4 million.Kuvele ukuthi likhulu isasasa kosomabhizinisi asebefake izicelo zokusebenza enxanxatheleni.Izolo ungqongqoshe uvakashele inkulisa iZizameleni Pre-School ehambisana neMeya yakwaDukuza, uMnuz Ricardo Mthembu. Be­beyonikela ngamakhompyutha namapeni enkulisa. Bobabili bebeyofeza isethembiso ababe­senze ngonyaka odlule besekwiKhabhinethi benomkhankaso iSukuma Sakhe emphakathini waseMdlebeni KwaDukuza.Ungqongqoshe uxolisile ngokuthi baphuze ukubuyela ukuzofeza isithembiso.

UFASIMBA luthi uhulumeni akavikele abampofu ayeke ukubadayisa kwabacebile abafuna ukumba amagugu emhlabeni wabo kulandela umsindo osuke eXolobeni, eMbizana, e-Eastern Cape.UMnuz Molaodi Wa Sekake okhulumela uFasimba kuzwelonke uthe baphoxekile ngesitatimende sikaNgqongqoshe wokuMbiwayo uMnuz Gwede Mantashe othe kuzoba nenhlolovo ezobheka ukuthi umphakathi uyahambisana yini nokuthi kube nemayini noma cha.UWa Sekake uthe bewuFasimba abahambisani nokuthi kube nenhlolovo kodwa abantu kufanele bavikelwe wuhulumeni emhlabeni wabo.“Kuyaphoxa ukuthi osopolitiki nabaholi bomdabu bahambisana nosomabhizinisi abafuna ukuvula izimayini emhlabeni wabantu bakithi. Kade abampofu bathwala kanzima ngenxa yabaholi abahambisana nosomabhizinisi abaxhaphaza abantu bakithi. Kuyaphoxa ukuthi uMantashe ufuna kube nenhlolovo “ezimele” yize umphakathi unqobile eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo,” kusho uWa Sekake.Uthe uhulumeni kufanele anike abantu ubunikazi bomhlaba ukuze kungabi lula ukuthi baphucwe njengoba ezama ukwenza kubantu baseXolobeni.Sicela ongqongqoshe bame nabantu hhayi nezimayini ezingawulandeli umthetho futhi ezingabahloniphi abampofu,” kusho uWa Sekake.Esitatimendeni esikwi-website yoMnyango wezokuMbiwayo uMantashe uthe inhlolovo ihambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ethe kufanele kuxoxwe nabantu. Uthe yimiphumela yenhlolovo ezohlahla indlela.“Uma umphakathi uthi awuhambisani nokuthi kube nemayini ngeke ibe khona. Uma umphakathi uthi uyayifuna imayini izoba khona. Uma imayini iqhubeka kufanele ihambisane nezolimo, ezokuvakasha nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umuntu ozonikwa ilayisensi kufanele alandele imithetho yezokumbiwayo. Inhlolovo izoqala emasontweni ambalwa ezayo,” kusho uMantashe.

AMABHIZINISI amancane ayaqhubeka nokuba wumgogodla womnotho yize amaningi ewa kungakapheli iminyaka emithathu esunguliwe.Isikhulu esiphezulu senkampani exhasa osomabhizinisi abancane iFinfind, uNkk Darlene Menzies, sithe kubalulekile ukuthi kusungulwe amabhizinisi ngoba kuzodilizwa abantu eminyakeni emithathu ezayo futhi nasezinkampanini ezizimele wu-22% kuphela wezikhulu eziphezulu othi izinkampani zizokhula kulezi zinyanga eziwu-12 ezizayo.UNkk Menzies uthe osomabhizinisi abaningi abanawo amakhono okubheka izinkampani ezixhasana ngemali futhi abakwazi nokuchaza izinhlelo zabo zebhizinisi uma sebenikwe ithuba.“Izicelo eziningi zoxhaso ziyachithwa ngenxa yokuthi osomabhizinisi abanalo ikhono lokuphatha imali futhi abakwazi ukuchaza kahle ukuthi imali bazoyenzani,” kusho uNkk Menzies.Uthe osomabhizinisi kufanele bahlome ngamakhono azoheha abatshalizimali okubalwa kuwo;- Ikhono lokuphatha imali, elokwazi kabanzi ukuchaza ngebhizinisi, elokuchaza ukuthi imali uyidingelani nomlando wokuthi ibhizinisi lizothuthuka kanjani uma lithola uxhaso.UNkk Menzies uthe abatshalimali bafuna ukwazi ukuthi bazofaka imali yabo ebhizinisini elizophumelela ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi ibuye imali abayitshalile.“Kubalulekile ukuthi usomabhizinisi omncane uma efuna uxhaso acacise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lizokhula kanjani nokuthi uma ebolekwa imali ibhizinisi lakhe lizokwazi ukwenza inzuzo ukuze akhokhele isikweletu. Kufanele abe nemininingwane yakhe yemali, izitatimende zasebhange nezeVAT. Ngebhadi osomabhizinisi abaningi abakwazi ukuza nale mininingwane uma beyocela uxhaso ngoba abakwazi ukuziphathela amabhuku nemali. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni bangalutholi uxhaso,” kusho uNkk Menzies.Ube esenika osomabhizinisi abafuna uxhaso lawa masu ambalwa athe azobasiza uma beyofuna uxhaso-Yiba nohlelo lwebhizinisi olucacisayo ukuthi imali liyingenisa kanjani.- Zazi isimo sakho sezikweletu ukuze uma kukhona obakweletayo usheshe ubakhokhele ngaphambi kokuyocela uxhaso lwemali.- Khokhela izikweletu zakho nyanga zonke ngoba abaxhasa ngemali bayabheka ukuthi unegama elinjani kwezezikweletu.- Bhala yonke imininingwane yebhizinisi, imali engenayo nephumayo ngoba lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi uzokwazi ukuphatha imali. Yazi isimo sakho sezimali ukuze ufake isicelo soxhaso lwemali kusasele izinyanga ngaphambi kokuthi uludinge, ungaceli uxhaso ngoba ungasenalutho kwi-akhawunti yakho yebhizinisi.- Zichaze zicace izizathu ezenza udinge uxhaso lwemali, ukhombise nokuthi inkampani yakho ibihweba kahle ngaphambi kokuthi ubone isidingo sokucela uxhaso lwemali.- Cela usizo kungoti ozokusiza ukukwenzela amabhuku, akululeke ngolwazi lwemali nolwentela.UNkk Menzies uthe zingaphezu kuka-200 izinkampani ezixhasana ngemali ezinemikhiqizo engaphezu kuka-500 eyenzelwe osomabhizinisi abancane.Ukuthola abaxhasi, osomabhizinisi abancane bangavakashela ku-www.finfind.co.za

AYAVEVA amalungu omndeni wabantu abashona emuva kokuthuthwa esibhedlela sabagula ngengqondo iLife Esidimeni emuva kokuthi iDA ibhale amagama abo oqwembeni lokukhankasela ukhetho ngaphandle kwemvumo yemindeni.Izolo lolu qwembe olungaseBraamfontein, eGoli, olunemibhalo emikhulu ethi, ANC Is Killling Us luhleshuliwe ngabantu okuthiwa ngamalungu omndeni wabafa emuva kokukhishwa eLife Esidimeni.Kulolu qwembe kukhona namagama abavukuzi abafa esibhicongweni saseMarikana nawezingane ezife emuva kokuwela emathoyilethi omgodi.UNkk Christine Nxumalo owashonelwa yilungu lomndeni elakhishwa eLife Esidimeni ubhale ekhasini lakhe le-twitter ukuthi “Ngidinwe kabi ukuthi uMmusi Maimane uvule isikhangiso esinamagama amalungu ethu omndeni ngaphandle kokucela imvume yethu. Imbi lento ayenzile ngoba efuna amavoti. IDA ayinalo ilungelo lokusebenzisa le nhlekelele nobuhlungu bethu ukuze ithole amavoti,”UMnuz Solly Malatsi okhulumela iDA uthe ukuklejulwa koqwembe lwabo kungcolisa umlando walabo abashone ngaphansi kukahulumeni we-ANC.“Yize singaqondi ukuthi wubani oklebhule uqwembe lwethu kodwa akukhona okokuqala simoshelwa uqwembe olukhuluma iqiniso ngohulumeni we-ANC. Lesi senzo singcolisa umlando walabo abashonile ngoba ukufa kwabantu Esidimeni, Marikana nezingane eziphoseka emathoyilethe omgodi bekungavinjwa ukube uhulumeni ka-ANC uyasebenza,” kusho uMalatsi.UMnuz Zizi Kodwa okhulumela i-ANC uthe iDA ayibuqondi ubuhlungu babantu abashonelwa ngamalungu omndeni Esidimeni, eMarikana nakumathoyilethi omgodi futhi uMalatsi neDA kufanele baxolise ebantwini ngalesi senzo.Umhlaziyi wepolitiki uMnuz Ralph Mathekga uthe iDA inawo umlando wokukhankasa ngokugxibha amanye amaqembu epolitiki okuyinto enganambithisiseki kahle kubavoti baseNingizimu Afrika.“IDA ivamise ukukopela izinto ezenziwa e-United States naseBritain zokukhankasa ngokugxibha abanye abaholi. Lo mkhuba uyasebenza kwamanye amazwe hhayi eNingizimu Afrika,” kusho uMathekga.Uthe lesi sikhangiso sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi iDA ayibaqondi kahle abantu abamnyama ngokosiko, ngokwendlela yokuphila nangokuthi abahlekisi ngokufa.“IDA ayikakabaqondi abantu abamnyama lokhu kuzoyilahlekisela ngabavoti. Kuyakhombisa ukuthi izinto eziningi zisenziwa ngabamhlophe. Kufanele iDA iqaphele ukuthi ukugxibha i-ANC akuyakheli igama elibi kwabamnyama ngoba kufanele ihloniphe namasiko abo ngesikhathi igxeka,” kusho uMathekga.

Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni nasekusimameni kwe-ANC. Lo mlando wacishe washabalala ngeminyaka yawo-1990 lapho khona osomathuba bakha isithombe okungesona bethi i-ANC ngeyamaXhosa, i-IFP ngeyamaZulu.Isinqumo sobuholi be-ANC sokubamba ingqungquthela yohlu lwabazongena ephalamende likazwelonke nawezifundazwe, inkulumo yaminyaka yonke eyaziwa ngeJanuary 8 Statement nokwethulwa kwemigomo yokhetho yeqembu eThekwini sikhumbuza iNingizimu Afrika ngokubaluleka kwalesi sifundazwe kwi-ANC.Kungani iKwaZulu-Natal ibalulekile kwi-ANC? Lapha ngizobalula izizathu ezimbalwa.Esokuqala ukuthi umholi wokuqala we-ANC owakhethwa engekho kwingqungquthela eyabanjelwa eBloemfontein kwaba nguDkt John Langalibalele Mafukuzela Dube. Abanye abahola i-ANC besuka kulesi sifundazwe singabala uMnuz JT Gumede, uDkt Pixley kaSeme, iNkosi Albert Luthuli noMnuz Jacob Zuma. INkosi uLuthuli yaqokwa ngo-1952 ukuthi ihole i-ANC ezikhathini ezinzima kulandela ukwamukelwa kwe-Apartheid njengohlelo lukahulumeni kaDkt DF Malan. Wasebenza ngokuzikhandla waze wazuza indondo yokuthula, iNobel Peace Prize, ngoDisemba wonyaka ka-1961.Isizathu sesibili ukuthi uDkt Nelson Mandela wethula inkulumo yakhe yokugcina KwaZulu-Natal. Waphinde waboshelwa khona (eHowick) eqhuba umsebenzi wakhe njengomholi we-ANC. Ekuphumeni kwakhe ejele emva kweminyaka engu-27 wabuyela KwaZulu-Natal eyobikela abaholi bakhe abafana noDube ukuthi inkululeko ababeyilwela yabe isisemnyango ngoba izwe labe selilungisela ukhetho lokuqala lwentando yeningi. Okubaluleke kakhulu futhi ukuthi uMandela wavotela kusona lesi sifundazwe, hhayi eMthatha lapho ayedabuka khona.Isizathu sesithathu ukuthi i-KZN yisifundazwe esikhulu kunazo zonke ngokwezibalo zamalungu e-ANC. Muva nje i-Eastern Cape isuswe yiMpumalanga endaweni yesibili kodwa iKZN yalokhu imile izihola phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iKZN iwumgogodla we-ANC.Isizathu sesine ukuthi kube neziwombe ezinzima kwi-ANC nombimbi lapho esibone khona kuchitheka igazi umkhonto ugwaza ekhaya. Lokhu kwenze lwangabikho uzinzo kwi-ANC nombimbi. I-SACP ize yesabisa ngokuthi izongenela ukhetho ngokuzimela. Lesi yisimo esafaka amanzi emadolweni esizweni sonkana. Ngenhlanhla iSACP igcine isishintshile lesinqumo sayo.Isizathu sesihlanu nokungesokugcina ukuthi udaba lukaZuma obengumengameli we-ANC nowezwe alusingathwanga ngobunono. Kunalokho ubuholi beqembu namanye amalungu e-ANC asebenzisa imizwa, inzondo nokuba ngosomathuba angasicabangela isithunzi seqembu nekusasa lezwe. Lobu budedengu badala isimo esimanzonzo i-ANC yahlukana phakathi. Ukungenzi kahle kweqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2016 lwenza isimo saba sibi kakhulu. Isipikili sokugcina kwaba ukuphoqwa kukaZuma wubuholi beqembu ukuba esule njengomengameli wezwe. Lesi sinqumo sanyakazisa izwe lonke kodwa ikakhulu isifundazwe iKZN.Ngenxa yalezi zizathu bekufanele ukuthi ubuholi be-ANC bucabange bujule ngeqhaza le KZN bese buthatha izinqumo eziphusile. Ukubanjwa kwale micimbi esengiyibalile eKZN kuzuze izinto eziningi. Phakathi kokunye singabala ukubhula umlilo odalwe yizinqumo ezinobudedengu ezathathwa ubuholi beqembu. Okwesibili nokufanele kushayelwe ihlombe ukukhumbuza isizwe ngokubaluleka kweKZN emlandweni we-ANC. Okokugcina ukuqinisa amathuba e-ANC okuthi iphumelele ukhetho luka zwelonke oluzayo. IKZN iyinsika ye-ANC.* USolwazi Bheki Mngomezulu usuphikweni lwezifundo zezepolitiki e-University of Western Cape. Ungumhlaziyi ozimele.

UMENGAMELI we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ugqugquzele abantu basePort Shepstone nezindawo ezakhele leli dolobha ukuthi bagcwalise iMoses Mabhida Stadium lapho ezothula khona umyalezo wakhe weJanuary 8 ngoMgqibelo aphinde athule nomhlahlandela weqembu wokuheha abavoti njengoba kuyiwa okhethweni.URamaphosa ehambisana nabanye abaholi be-ANC esifundazweni uhambele kule ndawo izolo enxenxa abantu ukuthi batheleke ngobuningi kulo mgubho weqembu. Uphinde wathembisa ukuthi uzothula uhlelo lwakhe lokuthuthukisa izwe.“Kulo nyaka sizokwakha amathuba omsebenzi ngoba sifuna ukukhulisa umnotho wezwe, sithuthukise imfundo yezingane zethu, silethe nezidingo ezizothuthukisa abantu bakithi,” kusho uRamaphosa.Uthe namhlanje uzosika ikhekhe lokugubha iminyaka ewu-107 ye-ANC Ohlange ekhaya likaMengameli wokuqala we-ANC.“Abantu bayayibona imisebenzi ye-ANC futhi lesi sifunda senze okuningi uma kukhuluywa ngokwakhela abantu izindlu size sazuza nezindondo. Kwakhiwe izindlu eziwu-129 futhi kuzokwakhiwa ezinye eziwu-800Uthe i-ANC yenze isiqiniseko sokuthi isifundazwe sisebenza kahle ngisho emiphumeleni ka-matric.“Ngiyaziqhenya ngomsebenzi omuhle owenziwa wothisha, abazali nezingane KwaZulu-Natal wokuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela ka-matric. Ilokhu ithuthukile njengoba nezinga lokuphasa linyukile. Uma kubhekwa imiphumela ka-matric isifundazwe silale isibili, KwaZulu-Natal nenze kahle kakhulu,” kusho uRamaphosa.

UZOVELA enkantolo kuleli sonto owesilisa oneminyaka engu-22 obhekene namacala okukhona kuwo elokubulala ngokungenhloso emuva kokushona kwephoyisa likaMasipala weTheku u-Inspector Johan Deysel (59) oshayiswe yitekisi ezama ukuyimisa emgwaqweni oseManzimtoti ngempelasonto.I-video kaDeysel eshayiswa yitekisi ebisabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kukhona abakugxekayo ukuvezwa kwayo abanye bazwelana nomndeni wakhe.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uthe kuphenywa icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso emuva kokushona kwephoyisa likaMasipala elishayiswe ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku.USupt Glen Ndlovu obhekelele ezokuxhumana emaphoyiseni kaMasipala ucele abantu ukuthi bayeke ukuphawula ngendlela elumelayo kulolu daba ngoba uDeysel ushone enza umsebenzi wakhe.Uthe umasipala utshale amaphoyisa kuleya ndawo emuva kokucelwa yikhansela ebelithole izikhalo ngokushayiswa kwabantu eduze kwenxanxathela yezitolo iGalleria.“Siyacela abantu bayeke ukuphawula budedengu ngalolu daba ngoba kunezimpawu eziyalela izimoto ukuba zime kodwa le tekisi ayimanga kuzo yayoshayisa uDeysel. Bekusebusuku emuva kuka-8. Umshayeli wetekisi bekufanele ame njengabanye abashayeli kodwa wazama ukugudla eceleni wagcina eshayise iphoyisa. Kuyacaca ukuthi ubefuna ukubaleka,” kusho uNdlovu.Uthe umshayeli wetekisi ubhekene necala lokushayela budedengu, elokuzama ukubulala, elokubulala ngokungenhloso nelokuzama ukubaleka endaweni yesigameko.UDeysel ubesesebenze iminyaka ewu-35 emaphoyiseni.A@eThekwiniMMetro Police officer was knocked over by a taxi near Amanzimtoti last night.
