UNGQONGQOSHE weziSebenzi zikaHulumeni nokuPhatha, uNksz Ayanda Dlodlo uthe uhlelo lokunxenxa abantu abadala ukuthi basheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi balwenza ukuze behlise isabelo sezimali esiphezulu esikhokhelwa abasebenzi.UNgqongqoshe wezeziMali, uMnuz Tito Mboweni umemezele ukuthi kunohlelo lokuzama ukwehlisa isabelo ngokuthi bagqugquzele abantu abadala ukuthi basheshe bathathe umhlalaphansi, ikakhulu abaneminyaka engu-55 kuya ku-59.I-SA Gov News ifake i-video kwiTwitter kaNksz Dlodlo, lapho ebechaza kafuphi ngohlelo lokwehlisa isabelo.Uthe imali kumele iye kwezemfundo nakwezempilo njengoba isabelo sezimali sabasebenzi bakahulumeni singesibili ezintweni uhulumeni achitha imali enkulu kuzona.Ngemuva kwesimemezelo sikaMboweni abantu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bakhuluma ngaso, ikakhulu abasebenza kuhulumeni.Omunye wabo othe wake walubona lolu hlelo oluzokwenziwa, uthe iSars ngeke iyibambe imali yentela ejwayele ukubanjwa uma umuntu esethatha umhlalaphansi.Uthe lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi asebezothatha umhlalaphansi basheshe bazishiyele.Okunye ngukuthi uma kuhamba umuntu omdala kuzoqashwa umuntu omncane esikhaleni sakhe.Umuntu uthatha umhlalaphansi uma eseneminyaka engu-60 kodwa uvunyelwe ukushesha ayithathe uma eneminyaka engu-55.Uthisha oseneminyaka engu-53, obelinde ngabomvu umhlalaphansi, uthe ubehlaliswe ukuthi iSars itapa imali enkulu uma usheshe wathatha umhlalaphansi.“Kuzosisiza kakhulu ukungathathi imali yethu ngoba kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi ngishiye ngingalokhu ngilula isikhathi ekubeni amandla okusebenza engasekho.”

UBHODLA umlilo unina womfundi oneminyaka ewu-12 wase-Edgerton Primary, eNtsikeni, eMzimkhulu, okuthiwa ubhaxabulwe wuthisha ekilasini, ngoLwesine.Unina womfana ofunda uGrade 5 uthe kuthiwa indodana yakhe nabangani bayo ababili babefunda iphepha behleka ekilasini ngesikhathi kungena uthisha wababiza wabanciza izindlebe. Ababili wabancinza izindlebe wabayeka kodwa indodana yakhe wayincinza indlebe wayishaya ngenduku nangempama kwaze kwakhuza omunye uthisha.“Ingane ibuye imidwayidwa emhlane ihuzukile nasesiphongweni. Anginankinga nokuthi ingane ijeziswe uma yonile okungiphatha kabi ukuthi uthisha ayishaye ize ilimale,” kusho unina wengane.NgoLwesihlanu uthe uyile esikoleni ethi uyobikela uthishanhloko ngalolu daba wafika engekho. Uthisha osolwa ngokubhaxabula umfundi uthe uvele waba nolaka ngoba umfundi ubelubamba uswazi engafuni ukushaywa.Uthisha nomzali, abaganele ndawonye, kuthiwa ababhekani emva kwengxabano yomndeni.“Kuyiqiniso ukuthi asikhulumisani futhi asingenelani. Angazi noma ulaka akhuluma ngalo luvuswe wukuthi ingane izalwa yizitha zakhe yini ngoba phela ezinye izingane ebezihleka neyami azishaywanga ngenduku, zincinzwe izindlebe kuphela,” kusho yena.Umzali uthe ngempelasonto kufike amanye amalungu esigungu sesikole ethi azoxolisela uthisha.“Bathe uthisha uyaxolisa, uma ngiqhubeka nokubika lolu daba kwabaphethe ngizobe ngibeka umsebenzi kathishanhloko engcupheni. Angimangalelanga uthishanhloko mina, ngimangalele uthisha oshaye ingane yami,” kusho yena.UNkk Alberta Tuswa, oyilungu lesigungu, uzihlangulile kulolu daba wathi umzali akakaze ababikele ngalo futhi abakaze baludingide.“Akukho esingakuphawula ngoba umzali ubone singabalulekile wayovula icala emaphoyiseni waya nakodokotela. Manje sesishayelwa ucingo ngabezindaba angiboni ukuthi kukhona esisengakwenza,” usho kanje.UMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayadumala ukuthi kusekhona othisha abashaya izingane yize bebona ukuthi ozakwabo abenza lokhu bajeziswa kanjani.“Siyajabula ngoba umzali uvule icala kodwa nathi sizokwenza olwethu uphenyo bese sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele,” kusho yena.ULt Col Thulani Zwane okhulumela amaphoyisa uthe kuvulwe icala lokushaywa komfundi okuthiwa kwenziwe uthisha ekilasini. Uthe icala liphenywa ngamaphoyisa aseNtsikeni, akukaboshwa muntu.

source: buka umalema uchaza ngokungaphazanyiswa kukaramaphosa ephalamende
text: IQEMBU eselizakhele udumo ngokushubisa izinto ePhalamende, i-EFF, lithuse abaningi izolo lingaphazamisi inkulumo ebhekiswe esizweni kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoLwesine.I-EFF yafunga yagomela ukuthi kuzoba ncane indawo ePhalamende uma kuphela uJanuwari nonyaka uRamaphosa engacacisile ngodaba lwemali ebalelwa kuR500 000 okuthiwa wayinikelelwa yinkampani iBosasa ngesikhathi ekhankasela ukuba umengameli we-ANC.Ngemuva kwenkulumo kaRamaphosa umholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uthe bagculisekile ngendlela umengameli aphendule ngayo izinsolo abekwe zona.“Umengameli waya kuMvikeli woMphakathi, ngaphezu kwalokho waphinde wethula umbiko wakhe (ngomnikelo weBosasa) kwi-eNCA, wathumela nesitatimende kwabezindaba. Esikufunayo nje ukuthi umengameli akwazi ukuphendula uma kukhona asolwa ngakho,” kuchaza uMalema.Video: Sandisiwe Ntlemeza/African News Agency (ANA)Video: Sandisiwe Ntlemeza/African News Agency (ANA)Video: Sandisiwe Ntlemeza/African News Agency (ANA)URamaphosa uvule inkulumo yakhe ngamancoko ngesikhathi esandlalela eveza ukuthi bavumelene noMalema ukuthi uzocula iculo elithi ‘Thuma Mina’ uma lo mholi we-EFF eba ngumengameli wezwe ngemuva kokhetho.USotswebhu omkhulu we-EFF uFloyd Shivambu uthe bekungokokugcina uRamaphosa ethula enkulumo yesizwa. Uthe i-ANC izohlulwa okhethweni ngoMeyi.- Political Bureau and African News Agency

source: omakhelwane baphawula ngokufa kwabathathu eflethini ethekwini
text: USIZWE wukuphuma ngewindi owesilisa osindile esigamekweni okushone kuso abantu abathathu, abahlanu balimala kanzima efulethini elisenkabeni yedolobha iTheku emgwaqweni uBurger izolo emini.Lona wesilisa osindile kuthiwa uthole imihuzukwana okukholakala ukuthi idalwe ukuwa esuka esitezi sokuqala phezulu ewela phansi kuleli fulethi eliseduze neNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngaseMtateni.Abathathu abashonile kuthiwa bashonele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi labo abalimele baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela isimo sabo sisibi.Amaphoyisa athi asola ingxabano njengembangela eholele kulesisehlakalo.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi omunye wabantu abayisishiyagalolunye, abebekhona endlini uyiphoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku.Kodwa okwamanje akucaci ukuthi umsolwa ngubani kuleli cala.Ngesikhathi ithimba leSolezwe lifika kule ndawo emini, abantu bebemi izixongololo kugcwele namaphoyisa, indawo yesehlakalo isihenqwe ngentambo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa oMkhandlu weTheku, uSenior Superintendent Parbhoo Sewpersad uthe amaphoyisa omkhandlu abikelwe ngalesi sigameko, kwathiwa kunokuqhuma kwezibhamu efulethini elisemgwaqweni uYusufDadoo.“Uma amaphoyisa efika kuleli fulethi athole ukuthi bekunabantu abayisishiyagalolunye endlini, abathathu bashonile, abahlanu balimele, oyedwa usindile,” kusho uSewpersad.FUNDA:Kufe abathathu kuxabana abangani eflethini eThekwiniUthe okwamanje imbangela yalokhu kudubula ibingakaziwa kodwa bakholwa ukuthi ingxabano eholele kulesi sehlakalo.“Amalungu omphakathi abekwenye indlu asitshele ukuthi kube nengxabano kule ndlu okwenzeke kuyo isigameko, abe esezwa ukuqhuma kwesibhamu,” kusho uSewpersad.Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi omunye wabantu abebephakathi kule ndlu uyiphoyisa lomkhandlu weTheku.“Omunye wabantu abebekhona endlini bekuyiphoyisa ebelingekho emsebenzini,” kusho uSewpersad.Uthe okwamanje ngeke baze bakuqinisekise ukuthi ngubani umsolwa kuleli cala.Kodwa amalungu omphakathi akhulume neSolezwe nacele ukuthi angadalulwa athe, ezwe kuthiwa umuntu odubule abantu uyiphoyisa.“Engathi leli phoyisa lixabane nowesifazane labe selidubula abantu abebesendlini, nalo labe seliyazidubula,” kusho ilungu lo mphakathi.Lithe ukhona owesilisa osindile kulesi sehlakalo.“Sizwe kuthiwa isibhamu okusolakala ukuthi isona esisetshenziswe kulesi sehlakalo sitholakale emagcekeni aseNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini lapho kupakwa khona izimoto, silahlwe khona,” kuqhuba leli lungu lo mphakathi.Elinye ilungu lo mphakathi nalo elicele ukuthi lingadalulwa lithe, lizwe kuthiwa omunye wesilisa olimele, udubuleke emqaleni.“Uma sizwa kuthiwa bekuphuzwa lapha endlini kwabe sekuyaxatshanwa nokuholele ekutheni kugcine sekuqhuma isibhamu,” kusho leli lungu lomphakathi.Umakhelwane uthe leli phoyisa belithanda ukuvakashelwa endlini yalo liphuzise abantu utshwala.“Kodwa belinenhliziyo encane uma selidakiwe,” kusho umakhelwane.Khonamanjalo, kubikwa ukuthi oyedwa wabadutshuliwe kugcine kumenele ngoNgoLwesibili. Udaba oluphelele ephephandabeni lakho ngoLwesithathu.

USHAQEKILE umndeni noMkhandlu waseMshwathi ngokudlula emhlabeni ngokuzuma kwemeya uNkk Siphindile “Maphindi” Zondi-Mbhele.UNkk Zondi-Mbhele (44), waseMtulwa, obeyiMeya yaseMshwathi ushone ngeSonto ebusuku kulandela ukugula isikhashana. Ngokusho kokhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Mandla Zondi, iMeya yaya kudokotela ngoLwesihlanu iyobheka isimo sempilo yayo yabe isilaliswa emuva kokuthi udokotela engaboni kahle okuthile ngempilo kamufi.“Udokotela wamlalisa ewumuntu ozohlolwa. Abamvakashela ngoMgqibelo bafike engenankinga, ezikhulumela.NgeSonto ebusuku sithole umyalezo esibhedlela othi umndeni uphuthume njengoba ubengasaphefumuli kahle sengathi uvukwa i-astma obekuyisifo angenaso. Kumenele ngalo iSonto.Kusishaqisile lokhu njengoba ebengaxiniwe ukugula, yize ebengumuntu vele ohlala ngokugula kodwa ubengaxinekile. Silahlekelwe njengoba ubewusizo olukhulu ekhaya, ubengeyona iMeya nje kuphela, ubeyilungu lomndeni eliwukhathelele kakhulu,” kusho uZondi.Iphini leMeya uMnuz Promise “Pro” Dlamini, lithe bewumkhandlu bafe olwembiza ngokuhamba kwalo mholi obenamava.“Ubona nje asazi ukuthi sizamukele kanjani lezi zindaba ngoba besingalindele ukuthi adlule emhlabeni, ubengaguli.NgoLwesine nje sasisonke emsebenzini, usuku lwaze lwaphela. Kuthe ngoLwesihlanu wathi uya kudokotela, wabe eselaliswa. NangoMgqibelo besithumelana imiyalezo emafonini, engumuntu ozophuma noma inini esibhedlela. Ngithukile ngitshelwa umndeni ukuthi akasekho.Silahlekelwe umuntu obewuthanda umphakathi futhi ewusizo olukhulu,” kusho uDlamini.UNkk Zondi-Mbhele ngaphambi kokuba aqokwe ukuba imeya emuva kokhetho luka-2016, ubeyiphini lemeya eMshwathi, amahlandla amabili.Uyaziwa ngabaningi njengomholi we-ANC. UNkk Zondi-Mbhele, umndeni wakhe uthe ubengenabo abantwana.

MHLELI: Ngithi angicele isikhala ngiphawule ngomyalezo wemenenja yoMkhandlu weTheku kwiSolezwe langoFebhuwari 14 mayelana nokwakhiwa kwemijondolo emhlabeni kaMasipala weTheku.UMnuz Nzuza ngiyavumelana naye uma ethi kusuka ngo-1994 umkhandlu sewakhe izindlu eziningi eThekwini noma ke ngingeqinise ngesibalo asishoyo sezindlu asebezakhile kodwa kukhona lapho engidideka khona. Angiqondi kahle uma ethi kunezinhlangano zomphakathi nezepolitiki ezibhebhezela abantu ukuthi badle umhlaba kamasipala.Empeleni imenenja ithi kunomthetho i-Occupation of Land Act 19 ka1998 ovimba ukudliwa komhlaba kamasipala ngokungemthetho. Nginenkinga yokuthi lo mthetho usebenza nini, kobani futhi kanjani?Lapha nje eLamontville sibone ngaphesheya komfula uMlazi kuvumbuka imijondolo yaqanjwa negama kwathiwa yiMegavillage. Ilapha ku-Ward 74. Sithe sisabheke labo nogada bakhe ukuthi bazofika badilize njengoba esho sabona wona belu umkhandlu usubafakela amanzi nogesi. Saxakeka sikhumbula lo mthetho akhuluma ngawo. Baba uNzuza ngabe bona babebhebhezelwa wubani?Yebo umthetho niyawuqinisa akuphikiwe. Kodwa umbuzo uthi la madoda eqembu elibusayo adla izindlu esezakhiwe zomxhaso niwabopha nini njengoba usipha izibalo zesenibabophele ukudla umhlaba kamasipala? Ungasisiza usiphe leso sibalo senibabophile noma ke asebevele besezikhindini njengoba kade la madoda awuqala lo mkhuba? Ngabe isandla somkhandlu wakho siqine nganxanye, kukhona abavunyelwa ukuphula umthetho?Okunye futhi kunabantu abaningi abahlala emijondolo engemuva kwezindlu zasemakubo emalokishini umkhandlu wakho ongenandaba nabo noma bekhala kangakanani. Bona bakhelwa nini izindlu?ELamontville

UKUNGENELISEKI ngeholo athi ubengakwazi ukwenza zonke izidingo zakhe kuholele ekutheni owesifazane waseMlaza athathe isinqumo sokuvula elakhe ibhizinisi.UNksz Zinhle Mshengu ongumsunguli wenkampani ekhiqizela izinkampani imifaniswano nezimpahla ezigqokelwa ukuphepha emsebenzini, Ikhethelo Clothing and Textile eseMlaza, uthe ngesikhathi evula inkampani wayefuna ukuthola imali engcono kunaleyo ayeyihola emsebenzini.UNksz Mshengu owasebenza ehhovisi kwamasipala uthe, wabona ukuthi angakwazi ukwenza into ezomphonsela inselelo kunokwenza umsebenzi wasehhovisi ayewuqashelwe owawungamanelisi ngeholo.“Bengehluleka ukukhokhela zonke izikweletu zami uma kuphele inyanga, ngaphezu kwalokho kumele ngiphe abazali bami imali. Lokhu kukhathazeka kwenza ukuthi ngizihlole ukuthi ayikho yini indlela engingaphuma ngayo. Isu elaqhamuka elokuthi ngivule inkampani yami. Ucwaningo engalwenza lwangikhombisa ukuthi uma ngingqongqoza eminyangweni efanele ngizoluthola uxhaso, ekupheleni kwenyanga ngithole imali engcono. Ngaqala ngokuthi ngingene emkhakheni wamathenda,” kusho yena.Ngo-2012 kuya ku-2014 uthe ungene emkhakheni wamathenda wathola umsebenzi wokuthi athengele izibhedlela zaseMpumalanga izingubo zokulala nezingubo ezigqokwa yiziguli.Uqhube wathi ngesikhathi enza lokhu wayefuna izinkampani lapho ezothenga khona bese edayisela umasipala. Wathola ukuthi ayikho inkampani yomuntu wesifazane omnyama angathenga kuyo. Ezikhona wabona ukuthi azikwazi ukukhiqiza umthamo odingekayo uma zithola i-oda elikhulu.“Ngabona ithuba lokuthi ngivule inkampani ngisebenze nabantu besifazane sibe yinkampani ekhiqizela izinkampani izingubo zokusebenza nemifaniswano kanjalo nezingubo zokulala. Ngahambisa umbono wami kwaSAB bawubona uphusile bangixhasa,” kusho yena.Kule nkampani uthe kusebenza abesifazane kuphela bonke baneminyaka engaphansi kuka-35.Nyakenye ungenele umncintiswano wabantu abasha abanamabhizinisi enza kahle ohlelwa yiSAB, waphuma ku-top-21 ezweni lonke.INGAPHAKATHI lendawo ekhiqiza imifaniswano nezimpahla zokusebenza, Ikhethelo Clothing and Textile eseMlaza Isithombe: Sithunyelwe“Ibhizinisi lokukhiqiza impahla ngingene kulona ngo-2017. Nyakenye ngiqokwe ngaba ngomunye wosomabhizinisi abenza kahle ababili. Ukuqokwa kungenze ngabona ukuthi ngempela ngiwusomabhizinisi osenganyukela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemuva kwalokho ngivakashelwe ngongoti bokukhiqizwa kwezimpahla ezenziwe ngendwangu baseNerthelands bezobona indawo engisebenzela kuyo, baphinde bangicobelela ngolwazi lokukhulisa umkhiqizo wami,” kusho yena.Uthe bamsiza ngokuthi indawo yakhe ayihlele ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi akhiqize ngendlela eyiyo.Muva nje uthe usebenzisana nenye inkampani ekhiqiza ama-duvet, amashidi nezinye izinto zokulala zikanokusho.“Lezi zimpahla sizokwazi ukuzidayisa emazweni aphesheya. Amakhasimende athenga lezi zimpahla ngabantu abangenqeni ukukhipha imali futhi abangazithandi izinto ezifana nezabanye. Kubo sibala namahhotela aphambili,” kusho yena.

source: bacele ikhefu abe anc abasolwa emahlazweni ocansi
text: ZIZICELELE ikhefu izikhulu ze-ANC ezisolwa emacaleni ocansi  njengoba kusaqhubeka uphenyo lwamaphoyisa emuva kokuvulwa kwamacala.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC uMnuz Ace Magashule ngoLwesibili udalule ukuthi oMnuz Zizi Kodwa noMnuz Pule Mabe bacele ukushawa umoya. UMagashule uthe nakuba abasolwa bezibona bemsulwa kodwa bebengafuni ukuqhubeka nokusebenza bengaphansi kwefu elimnyama lokusolwa ngokunukubeza abesifazane. Ubekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba ekomkhulu lenhlangano eLuthuli House eGoli.Kuvela lokhu nje kade kuhleli umhlangano wesigungu sokusebenza kwenhlangano (NWC).FUNDA:UKodwa usola itulo ngelokudlwengulaUMabe ubesanda kukhishwa phambili emuva kophenyo olwenziwe yi-ANC kodwa ummangali wanganeliseka wavula icala emaphoyiseni. UKodwa ubhekene nezinsolo zokudlwengula owesifazane othushuke nalezi zinsolo waziyisa ehhovisi le-ANC wase elulekwa ngokuthi avule icala. UMagashule uncome abasolwa ngokuzicelela ukushenxa.''Uma sikhuluma ngomholi oqotho sisuke sisho abantu abanjena ke. Bazoqhubeka babe sesigungwini esiphezulu kodwa ngeke besayikhulumela i-ANC. Uqabane uDakota Legoete uzoqhubeka abambe izintambo akhulumele i-ANC,'' kuchaza uMagashule.

IZITOLO eziningi seziqalile ukuyikazela izinto ezikhala kahle, izipho ezigoqwe ngobunono, oswidi ababizayo abanezinhliziyo, imisiko nokuningi okuhehayo izithandani ezingazijabulisa ngakho kuleli sonto.Usuku lwakusasa olwaziwa njengolwabantu abathandanayo eNingizimu Afrika luza nezindleko eziningi. Lolu suku njengoba lufika kanye ngonyaka wonke umuntu usuke enenhloso yokujabulisa othandiweyo wakhe, abanye baze bangene ezikweletini. Kodwa ongoti bathi asikho isidingo sokuphoqa kulabo abavalekile ngoba ziningi izinto abangazenza emakhaya bajabule ngaphandle kokumosa imali.Indlela ondlala ngayo umbhede kumele yehluke kwejwayelekile. Ungoti wezobudlelwane, uJo Hammings, uthi kwabakhonze izimbali ungazivuvuzela embhedeni uzibhale inhliziyo, ubeka noswidi enizofunzana wona nesithandwa sakho. Iwayini, ijusi namanzi nakho ungakubeka eduze nombhede ukuze konke kube seduze nani ningalokhu niphuma ningena.Ungoti wezemfashini eThekwini uNksz Philile Mungwe weVallure uthi ukumesha nohlobo lwamashidi owandlala embhedeni kumele axoxe indaba ngalolu suku.Eminye imininingwane icashunwe kwi-www.dreams.co.uk.

source: izobuyela kwi ifp ikwazulu natal msimango
text: I-IFP ithi ukhetho lwangoMeyi 8 luzocacisa ukuthi ngubani umakhonya phakathi kweNkatha ne-ANC. Lokhu kuvele ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi kunomhlangano oyisipesheli wesiShayamthetho mayelana nokuba sihlakazwe kuleli hlandla eliphelayo leminyaka emihlanu ukuze amaqembu akwazi ukukhankasela ukhetho luka-2019.UMnuz Nhlanhla Msimango we-IFP utshele amalungu kaKhongolose ukuthi umbuso wabo ubaliwe njengoba kuza ukhetho.“Ngithi kini Mene, mene, tekel, upharsin. Ngithi uMbuso wenu Macingwane nawe Zikalala uphelile. Sizobuyisa okwethu. Ngemuva kokhetho siyiNkatha sizobe sihleli kulolo hlangothi siphethe isifundazwe, nina ningapha emabhentshini aphikisayo. Kulo nyaka kuzocaca ukuthi obani amadoda ebafaneni. Uqhude manikiniki kuyaphela ngani ngoba nehlulekile,” kusho uMsimango obehhewulwa i-ANC.UMnuz Sihle Zikalala we-ANC uthe kufana nokudlala okushiwo uMsimango ngoba i-ANC ibasebenzele abantu baKwaZulu-Natal ngakho abaziboni bebuyela emuva.“Sithathe lo hulumeni izinga lokuphasa kuka-matric liphansi kakhulu kodwa namhlanje sithola imiphumela engamaphesenti angu-76. Namhlanje abantu bakithi banemigwaqo nengqalasizinda ngenxa kaloKhongolose. Mhlonishwa uMsimango sithi siyohlangana okhethweni,” kusho uZikalala.Ubonge wonke amalungu esiShayamthetho ngokusebenzisana kahle.USotswebhu we-ANC, uNksz Nontembeko Boyce, uthe nakuba isiShayamthetho sihlakaziwe ngokwezigaba ezithile zomthetho kodwa imisebenzi izoqhubeka.“ISilo samabandla wonke sizoqhubeka sizovula isiShayamthetho ngoLwesibili bese kulandela uNdunankulu nenkulumo ezobe ichaza kabanzi ngesimo sesifundazwe. Ngisho amakomiti azoqhubeka nemisebenzi yomphakathi ,” kusho uNksz Boyce.

ABADILIZELWE imijondolo eCato Manor ngoba kuthiwa bakhe esizeni sesikole ngaphandle kwemvume bathi akukho okubambekayo okukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba abakhe kuwo ngowesikole ngoba awubiyiwe.Abahlali abaficwe yiphephandaba izolo behleli esigangeni, bethi badilizelwe imijondolo yabo ngoMgqibelo, bathi wunyaka wesibili behleli kule ndawo. Ngaphambi kokuthi bakhe baya ekhanseleni beyocela ukwakha labachitha labatshela ukuthi abaye ophikweni lwezindlu kumasipala.UMnuz Vusimuzi Mhlanga, okwabadilizelwe, uthe babengeke bayilandele imigomo abayitshelwa yikhansela ngoba abanayo imali yokugibela baye emahhovisi.“Ngesikhathi siya ekhanseleni sasivele sesiphelelwe yimisebenzi singasenayo imali yokukhokha emqashweni. Kubalwa amahhovisi angekho endaweni kuthiwa asiye kuwo, sizoya ngani? Sabona ukuthi into esingeke siyenze kungcono sakhe imijondolo ukuze babone ukuthi yini esiyifunayo,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi sekukaningi bedilizelwa imijondolo babuye bayivuse ngoba bengenayo indawo yokuhlala.“Kulokhu umasipala udilize imijondolo wathatha othayela bethu wahamba nabo, kwashishwa izimpahla zethu abanye bashiselwa nomazisi kodwa kulindeleke ukuthi sivote. Uthishanhloko uma sicela ukukhuluma naye usibizela amaphoyisa ekubeni indawo engayibiyile,” kusho yena.UNksz Xolo Miya uthe izingane zabo sezihlala zigade ‘omalume’ abadilizayo.“Zithi zidlala zibe zigadile ukuthi ayikho yini imoto yakwamasipala emayo bese ziyamemeza siphume ezindlini,” kusho yena.UMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe umasipala ukhathazekile ngokwanda kwezigameko zokudliwa komhlaba.“Siyakuqonda ukuthi isidingo sezindlu kumasipala sikhulu, sinohlelo lokwakhela abantu abahlala kulo masipala izindlu kodwa asikwazi ukumelana nomthamo wabadinga izindlu ngenxa yokuthi abantu bafudukela kuleli dolobha bezofuna imisebenzi,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi uma kukhona abaphula umthetho bakhe ngokungemthetho, imijondolo yabo izodilizwa.“Abadilizelwe imijondolo uma bebona ukuthi kukhona ukwephulwa komthetho kumele bayobika emaphoyiseni,” usho kanje.

PHEZU kokuba izinyunyana zothisha ziyamukela inkulumo kaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngendaba yokuthuthukisa imfundo ngokuthi kube nama-tablet kubona bonke abafundi kuleli kodwa ezinye izinto zithi zingagcina zingenzekanga.URamaphosa umemezele izinto eziningi uhulumeni ahlose ukuzenza kwezemfundo njengokuthi uhlelo lwama-tablet luqale ezikoleni ezisemakhaya nasemalokishini, kuguqulwe izikole eziningi zibe ngezamakhono kanjalo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kunezindlu zangasese kuzona zonke izikole.UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Allen Thompson, uthe noma bekwamukela konke okushiwo nguMengameli ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo ebibhekiswe esizweni ngeledlule kodwa okunye kwakho ngeke kwenzeke.Uthe kumele kuqeqeshwe othisha ngezobuchwepheshe njengoba kuzomele bafundise abafundi abaphethe ama-tablet.Uqhube wathi kunezikole ezingenawo ugesi namanzi, izindlu zangasese, unogada futhi kazibiyiwe.“Uma uletha ubuchwepheshe obunje udinga zonke lezi zinto. Izikole azinikiwe nemali ngumnyango, ezinye azinazo nezincwadi zokufunda. Angiyiphathi eyonogada abakhokhelwa ngumnyango yiphupho ezikoleni eziningi okusho ukuthi uma sebufakiwe lobu buchwepheshe buzokwebiwa. Ezinye zezikole azinazo izindlu ama-strongroom okugcina impahla ebalulekile, kwezinye izicabha nama-buglar guards akukho,” kusho uThompson.Uthe kungathatha isikhathi ukuthi lezi zinto zilungiswe kuzona zonke izikole.“Sifuna ungqongqoshe wezemfundo kuzwelomke abuyise uhlelo lokuthi othisha bathole ama-laptop. Lolu hlelo kwaxoxwa ngalo lwaze lwaya nasePhalamende lwagcina lungafinyelelanga ndawo.”Uthe izinto eziningi uMengameli abekhuluma ngazo zizogcina ezikoleni ezazingama-Model C ezinezinsiza.Okhulumela iSadtu, uNksz Nomusa Cembi, uthe bafuna othisha baqeqeshwe ngezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.Uthe bayakwamukela okushiwo nguRamaphsoa wathi kumele kusheshiswe indaba yezindlu zangasese.“Indaba yezindlu zangasese yinto okumele isheshiswe ngoba kunabafundi abafayo ngoba bephonseka kwingqalasizinda engekho esimeni. Abaqeqeshwe othisha ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinto ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.”Uthe badumele ukuthi akukho okushiwo ngendaba yekhomishini eyajutshwa ngowayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma eyayizobhekana namaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni iqale ngawothisha.“Akushiwo lutho ngale khomishini okunalokho kukhulunywa indaba yokuthi kuzodilizwa. Siyajabulangenkulumo kaMengameli kodwa ezinye zezinto kusekude ukuthi zenzeke.”URamaphosa umemezele nokuthi kuzoqalwa nezifundo zamakhono nezintsha okubalwa iTechnical Mathematics neTechnical Sciences, Maritime Sciences, Aviation Studies, Mining Sciences neQuaponics.

Mhleli: Ngibhala ngokukhulu ukuphoxeka ngeqembu engililandelayo nengilithandayo iKaizer Chiefs. Iphinde yaphoxa futhi kowomkhaya ngoMgqibelo. BAGWETSHWE odilikajele neminyaka engu-54 ababulali ababili abahlasela ehostela KwaMashu babulala abantu. NgoFebhuwari 7 nonyaka iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini igwebe ababulali, uSfiso Gumede (29) noSizwe Mthiyane (34) odilikajele ababili umuntu ngamunye neminyaka engu-54 ngaphezulu.Inkantolo ithe ibagixabeza ngeminyaka engu-30 ngecala lokuzama ukubulala, engu-15 ngecala lokubamba inkunzi, neminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye ngecala lokutholakala nezibhamu.Ngo-Okthoba 2018 abesilisa babehlezi beyiqulu endaweni yokucima ukoma emgwaqweni uXolo khona ehostela, kwafika amadoda amane azenza abathengayo. Atshelwa ukuthi utshwala sebuphelile, akhipha izibhamu afuna ngodli imali namafoni kubantu ababehlezi endaweni yokucima ukoma.Lawa madoda kuthiwa aphinda adubula abantu ababezihlalele.Kwashona uMnuz Bongikosi Biyela (29) noMnuz Sibonelo Mbanjwa (33) kulesi sigameko. Abanye abane balimala baphuthinyiswa esibhedlela. Amaphoyisa aKwaMashu abe esevula icala lokubulala, elokuzama ukubulala nelokubamba inkunzi. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwezibhamu yaveza ukuthi yizo ezasebenza kulesi sehlo.

ISIKHULU sikamasipala esidutshulwe sabulawa sihamba ngemoto yaso edolobheni eMnambithi, kuthiwa siyalele abasibhekele imfuyo yaso ukuthi bayifake kahle uphawu ukuze umndeni waso ungahlupheki uma kwenzeka sishona.UMnuz Simingaye Oscar Hlatshwayo (38) obeyi-Excutive Director oPhikweni loKwakhiwa kweNgqalasizinda kuMasipala i-Alfred Duma, kuthiwa bekungakapheli isikhathi eside eyalele omunye wabangani bakhe ukuthi enze isiqiniseko sokuthi imfuyo yakhe inophawu.Umfowabo, uMnuz Sizwe Hlatshwayo abehlala naye, uthe umfowabo ubengakukhonzile ukukhuluma, ubethula noma kukhona into emphethe kabi kodwa uzwe kuthiwa ubeke wayaleza ukuthi imfuyo yakhe ayiphawulwe kahle.“Umfowethu bekungumuntu ozithandela umsebenzi, uma kunento emphethe kabi ubethula nayo, ubeze akhulume uma kunomsebenzi okumele umenzele wona. Ubefuna into yenziwe ngendlela ayichaze ngayo ungashintshi nokuncane. Uma uke washintsha indlela akutshele yona benixabana,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi akukho umfowabo abeke wakusho okusondelene nokuthi kukhona abafuna ukumbulala.“Indlela okwenzeke ngayo sisola ukuthi yinto ebihleliwe futhi bekwaziwa ukuthi ekuseni edolobheni kuba nesiminyaminya, izimoto zihamba kancane, nebala bekunjalo, ababulali bamdubule ebanjwe yisiminyamaminya. Sithemba ukuthi amaphoyisa azoqhamuka nomkhondo ngoba okwamanje sisadidekile, akukho esikwaziyo,” kusho yena.UMNUZ Simingaye Oscar Hlatshwayo obeyi-Excutive Director oPhikweni loKwakhiwa kweNgqalasizinda kuMasipala i-Alfred DumaIMenenja yezokuXhumana kuMasipala i-Alfred Duma, uMnuz Siyabonga Maphalala, ithe uHlatshwayo ubeneminyaka ewu-15 esebenzela lo masipala. Waqala ukusebenza kuwo kusewuMnambithi.Uthe phakathi kweminye imisebenzi encomekayo ayenzele lo masipala, ukuhola uhlelo lokuhlanganiswa kwengqalasizinda, ngesikhathi kuhlanganiswa uMasipala uMnambithi ayewusebenzela neNdaka, kusungulwa i-Alfred Duma, ngo-2015.Umfowabo kamufi uthe uzofihlwa ngoMgqibelo.

UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Willies Mchunu uthi iyabakhuthaza imibono abayithola kubantu uma benza ucwaningo emphakathini, ngenhloso yokuthola ukuthi baphethe kanjani.Ethula inkulumo yakhe mayelana nesimo sesifundazwe, enkundleni yezemidlalo eRoyal Showgrounds eMgungundlovu, ngaphambi kokuthi axinwe ukugula, uMchunu uthe bathatha isinqumo sokuthi benze ucwaningo emphakathini, ukuze bafunde ukuthi ikuphi lapho bengenzi khona kahle.Uthe bakwenza lokhu ngoba bezibophezele ekutheni bashintshe impilo yabantu.“Siqale ukwenza lolu cwaningo ngo-2015. Siyajabula ukubika ukuthi manje sesiqede ucwaningo luka-2018 futhi siyisifundazwe sokuqala esibe nesibindi sathatha igxathu lokuthi siyekele umphakathi ukuba usihlole ukuthi sisebenza kanjani,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe okutholwe ucwaningo ukuthi u-39%, wabantu awugculisekile ngendlela abenza ngayo, wengeza ngokuthi * -61% ugculisekile. “Into abakhala ngayo kakhulu abantu abanxusa ukuthi isukumelwe, yindaba yokudala amathuba emisebenzi, ilandelwe indaba yezindlu, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhona nezemfundo ezisezingeni,” kusho uMchunu.Uvumile ukuthi bewuhulumeni basahluleka ukudala amathuba emisebenzi.“Yize umnotho wethu ukhula kusukela kuqale isigaba sale Khabhinethi ekhona kodwa lokhu kukhula kuphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nokuhanjiswa kwezidingo ngendlela umphakathi olindele ngayo nokudala amathuba emisebenzi,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe okwamanje bangu-2.635 million abantu abangasebenzi eKZN uma kuqhathaniswa nabangu-2.536, abebengasebenzi ngesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka odlule.UMchunu uthe kuyacaca ukuthi ukudala amathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esedlule akuzange kuhambe kahle. Uthe enye into evelile ocwaningweni abalwenza emphakathini wukuthi abantu bafuna ukuphepha lapho behlala khona.‘”Mayelana nobugebengu sibone bukhula kakhulu kulesi sikhathi esikuso futhi buphazamisa ezomnotho namabhizinisi, okukhathaza kakhulu ukuthi amacala okubulala aphezulu,’’ kusho uMchunu.Uthe bazishaya isifuba ngohlelo lwabo lwezempilo olwenza abantu baphile isikhathi eside.“Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi isikhathi esiphilwa ngabantu ngokujwayelekile sesisukile eminyakeni engu-56, saya ku-60, phakathi kuka-2015 no-2016.”Uthe babone nempumelelo ekulweni nengculuzi.

source: ungqongqoshe uzosiza ngezicathulo izingane ezihlwempu ezikoleni
text: UNGQONGQOSHE wezaMandla uJeff Radebe uzohambela isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal namhlanje, emkhankasweni wokusiza izingane zesikole eziswele izicathulo. Inhloso yomkhankaso ukuveza ukubaluleka kokufunda nokuthi izingane zesikole zikwazi ukuya esikoleni, ngaphandle kokucwaswa futhi zizibone zifana nezinye ngisho ngabe ziphuma emakhaya ahlwempu.Ngokwesitatimende esithunyelwe, ungqongqoshe uthi akumele izingane zingayi esikoleni ngenxa yokungabi nezicathulo ezifanele.Umkhankaso uzoqala eNdwedwe eJohn Makhathini Civic Centre ngo-9 ekuseni lapho azonikela khona ngezicathulo ezikoleni ezihlukene endaweni. Uzobe eseya konikezela ngezicathulo lapho akhula khona KwaMashu, ezikoleni okubalwa kuzo afunda kuzona iDukemini Primary School neSibonelo High School.Kulindeleke ukuthi izingane ezizohlomula emkhankasweni zibe ngaphezulu kuka 500.

USASHAQEKILE umphakathi waseNtshawini, eStanger, ngokubulawa kwabalisa ababili abaklajwe bashiswa ngamalungu omphakathi abebasola ngokuba yizigebengu ezingena emizini yabantu.Kuthiwa uMnuz Thulubheke Thokozani Mdlalose (29) noMnuz Bhekinkosi Mfundeni Msomi (35) bebephuma emsebenzini nozakwabo ababili ngoLwesithathu ebusuku ngesikhathi bevinjwa abantu abebebasola ngokuba yingxenye yezigebengu okuthiwa zihlalise abantu lubhojozi ngokubangenela ezindlini zibaphuce impahla kokunye zidlwengule nabesifazane.Laba bobabili batholakale eMelville izolo ekuseni beshisiwe. Phezu kwabo bekubekwe amathayi, utshani, amapulangwe noplastiki. Kukholakala ukuthi leli qulu libashayile labaklabha lase libahudulela epaki, iHlalanathi nokuyilapho beshiselwe khona.Ngesikhathi izintatheli zaleli phephandaba zifika epaki bekusashunqa intuthu kodwa izidumbu sezithathiwe. Uma bebuzwa abakhelene nepaki ngokwenzekile bebevele bathi abazi lutho futhi ababonanga lutho. Kuze kwaba ngabantu abebehlala esigcemeni obekuhlala kuso laba ababulewe ababhoboke ngokwenzekile.UNksz Thandazile Zulu (25) obehlala egcekeni noMdlalose okuthiwa ungowaseMlaza kodwa ubeqashe eNtshawini, uthe bangqongqozelwe abantu abasebenza naye ekuseni ngo-4 bebika ukuthi sebevinjwe umphakathi waseMelville.UNksz Zulu uthe Mdlalose noMsomi bebesebenza enkontilekeni ebifaka imithangala emgwaqweni. Uthe uzakwabo ubabikele ukuthi bebephantshelwe yisondo lemoto base behamba ngezinyawo benqamula eMelville ngesikhathi bevinjwa yiqulu labantu ebelingalawuleki.Elinye ilungu lomphakathi, uNksz Sinenhlanhla Xhakaza, lithe namanje basashaqekile ngokubulawa kwalaba njengoba libachaze njengabantu abebesebenza bengahluphi muntu. “Kubuhlungu ukubabona bebulawe ngesihluku esinje. Izandla nezinyawo zabo beziboshiwe, omunye eboshwe ngentambo, omunye ngocingo. Iminwe kaMfundeni beyiklajiwe ilenga, unyawo lukaThokozani nalo lulenga.” Uthe kuleya ndawo usukhona umkhuba wokuthi kubulawe abantu ngoba besolwa ngokwenza izenzo zobugebengu noma bengabanjwanga oqotsheni.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Vincent Shezi, lithe belisanda kuzwa ngalesi sigameko. Lithe umphakathi uhlushwa yizigebengu kanti sekuvamile ukuthi abantu balinyazwe, abanye babulawe ngoba besolwa ngobugebengu.“Noma sikuqonda ukuthi umphakathi uhleli lubhojozi ngenxa yobugebengu, siyakugxeka ukuthi abantu bazijezisele abantu. Ukubulawa kwabantu baze bashiswe kuwubulwane nobugebengu,” kusho uShezi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amabili okubulala emuva kokutholakala kwabalisa ababili bebulewe. Uthe kusolakala ukuthi laba balisa bashaywe ngamalungu omphakathi abashisa.
