text: OWAYENGUNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal, oyinhloko yezinhlelo zemikhankaso ye-ANC nelungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, uthe uMengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa unikwe umsebenzi wokuthi agxile ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwe ukuze kwakheke amathuba emisebenzi kukhule nezwe.UMchunu uthe lezi ngezinye zezinto okumele zilungiswe ngokushesha ezweni ukuze abantu baphume ebubheni.Ezinye zezinto athe uRamaphosa uyalelwe yinhlangano ukuthi agxile kuzona kakhulu, ukulwa nenkohlakalo, ukubhekana nendaba yobugebengu nokuqeda indlala.“Siyi-ANC sithe nazi izinto mengameli okufanele ugxile kuzona kakhulu kunakuqala, ezinye zazo zibalulekile njengemfundo nezempilo. Umnotho wethu ubungakhuli, ubukhula ngo-0 bani wamaphesenti kodwa manje sesinethemba ngoba usukhula ngo-1%. Liphezulu izinga lokungasebenzi ikakhulu entsheni, okuyinhlekelele,” kusho uMchunu.Ukusho lokhu ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku ngesikhathi kuvaleliswa obenguMengameli weNatu uMnuz Siphosethu Ngcobo obesehole le nyunyana iminyaka engu-18 eNatu Teacher Development Institute eMadadeni.Uthe isiqalile ukuthela izithelo imizamo yokulwa nenkohlakalo njengoba kukhona iKhomishini yeJaji Zondo ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.“Abantu bayamenyezwa laphaya. Uma ubiziwe yeka ukulokhu uya emaphepheni nakwabezindaba shona khona uyophendula kuyona. Asikwazi ukukusiza kumele ugeze igama lakho kuleya nkundla,” kusho uMchunu.Uthe kumele livalwe igebe elikhona phakathi kwabahluphekayo nabacebile.UMchunu osebenze kakhulu neNatu enguNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uthe le nyunyana yiyona ahlangana nayo isikhathi eside uma eqhathanisa nezinye izinyunyana.Uthe kunalabo abacabanga ukuthi othisha abanazwi ezintweni eziqhubeka ezweni wathi lokhu akulona iqiniso ngoba kumele babe nezwi.Muva nje kube nokungqubuzana kwemibono phakathi kukaMchunu nowayeyisikhulu sakwa-Eskom uMnuz Matshela Koko ngezindaba ezithinta le nkampani.UMchunu uthe kukhona abantu abasabukela phansi othisha ngokuthi bona akufanele babe nombono ngoba ngemuva kwenkulumo yakhe ekhuluma nelinye lamaphephandaba aseThohoyandou eLimpopo, waveza ukuthi kumele kugxekwe ombombayi bezimenenja ezimnyama ngezinkinga zakwa-Eskom.I-ANC yamgxeka ngalesi sitatimende kodwa yaphinde yaxolisa kuyena.“Kukhona abacabanga ukuthi othisha akumele babe nombono ngezinto ezithinta izwe. Othisha yibona bantu abakha isizwe, kumele kwesekwe yonke imizamo yokwakha leli lizwe.”UMchunu uthe ufunde lukhulu kuNgcobo nakuMengameli weNatu uMnuz Allen Thompson ngesikhathi engungqongqoshe.Unxuse uThompson ukuthi ahlale ekubantu, angazithwali njengoba esengumengameli.UThompson uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhankaso wokuqoqa lonke ulwazi lothisha bakwaGrade R ukuze bathole iziqu abanazo ukuze bakwazi ukuqashwa ngokugcwele.Uthe bazolwela nomabhalane ezikoleni ngoba ngabantu abahlale benganakwa.“Sizolwela nokuthi kuqashwe onogada, sifuna kuqiniswe ezokuphepha ezikoleni,” kusho uThompson.Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe yizikhulu ezehlukene okubalwa umkhandlu wothisha iSace, ezinye izinyunyana zothisha okubalwa iNaptosa, izikhulu zomnyango wezemfundo kuzwelonke nasesifundazweni.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga akakwazanga ukuphumelela ngoba bekushone umshana wakhe kodwa uthumele abalethe umyalezo wokuhalalisela uNgcobo ngokuhola inyunyana isikhathi eside.

source: abe anc bacikwa yimeya esaba otokoloshe emotweni
text: IYAVUTHA ikhokhasi yamakhansela e-ANC kuMasipala waseMtubatuba ikhala ngemeya athi ilaxaze imoto ngoba isaba ukuthi inotokoloshe, yathenga entsha ceke ngemali kamasipala.Amakhansela athi iMeya uMnz Velangenkosi Gumede iyeke imoto iJeep Cheerokee emnyama yaze yadayiswa ngoba isaba ukuthi uma ihamba ngayo ingase ibeke impilo yayo engcupheni ngoba icushwe ngotokoloshe.Amakhansela uma ekhuluma le ndaba kuvele kuthi awazisakaze phansi ngoba asola imeya ngokuchitha imali yomkhandlu entweni engenasidingo.Umthombo uthe le moto eyiJeep neshaya ngezinombolo ezithi Mtuba 1, yayihamba imeya eyakhishwa esikhundleni uMnuz Qhina Mkhwanazi.Yiyona leyo moto okuthiwa imeya ibingafuni nakuyithinta njengoba isihamba ngeToyota Fortuner entsha.Imithombo ithi ngendlela amakhansela e-ANC adinwe ngayo, acebe imeya kuNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube.Kuvele ukuthi uNkk Dube-Ncube ubehambele lo umasipala ngoLwesine ngenxa yokukhungathwa yizinkinga.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi kukhona uNkk Dube-Ncube kusukume elinye lamakhansela lamtshela ukuthi abayizwa le ndaba yemeya esaba otokoloshe.Isitatimende esikhishwe wumnyango siveza ukuthi uNkk Dube-Ncube unike imeya ithuba lokuphendula ngendaba yemoto enotokoloshe yavuma ukuthi yayiyeka imoto kodwa yayichitha eyotokoloshe. Ichaze yathi iyibone ingasaphephile ngoba isihambe yafika ku-110 000 km.Okhulumela ikhokhasi ye-ANC kulo masipala uMnuz Siyabonga Khumalo, uthe ziningi izinto ezingahambi kahle kumasipala futhi bazibikile zonke kungqongqoshe.Uthe udaba lwemoto alusalanga ngaphandle ngoba abahambisani nokuthengwa kwemoto entsha.“Le moto endala isesimeni esihle kabi, siyaxakeka uma kuthiwa ayisafuneki sekuthengwe entsha. Lokhu kukatokoloshe emotweni asikwazi kahle sakuzwa nje kuthiwa kuke kwashiwo yiyona imeya ngesikhathi ikhuluma udaba lwemoto,’’ kusho uKhumalo.Imenenja kamasipala uMnuz Jeconia Mngomezulu ukuqinisekisile ukuthi yashintshwa imoto yemeya ngoba yayindala kakhulu.“Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ayisekho iJeep eyayihamba imeya eyaphuma kodwa ngeke ngiyikhulume eyotokoloshe. Imeya ayikaze isho ukuthi yesaba otokoloshe emotweni kodwa siyishintshele ukuguga kwayo ngoba sifuna ebiza kahle ezokwazi ukusiza uma imeya yenza umsebenzi wayo,” kusho uMngomezulu.

KUSIZE amaphoyisa kucishe kusuka uthuli lwezichwe izolo phakathi kwenhlangano yezitshudeni iSasco ne-EFF Student Command (EFFSC) eDurban University of Technology ngesikhathi i-EFFSC iphazamisa isithangami seSasco nabezindaba.Usihlalo weSasco, uMqondisi Duma, bese kuphele cishe imizuzu eyishumi eqale ukukhuluma ngesikhathi kuqhamuka isigejana se-EFFSC sangena phakathi kwezintatheli sabuza ukuthi ukhulumelani ngesitshudeni esishonile uMlungisi Madonsela obeyilungu le-EFFSC ngoba abamazi.“Nikhulumelani ngoMlungisi, uyamazi? Yekani le nto eniyenzayo,” kusho esinye sezitshudeni ze-EFFSC sishaya amakhamera simphuca nephepha abefunda kulona.Kube sekungenelela amaphoyisa ahlukanisa isixuku kwahlakazekwa kanjalo.UDuma uqhubekile wakhuluma nezintatheli ezitshela ukuthi abanalo udlame bayahlonipha.Uthe sibi isehlakalo sokubulawa kwesitshudeni ngoba silwela imfundo.“Siyakhala ngendaba yokuqashwa kwenkampani yonogada ezimele ukuqapha izitshudeni. Sifuna inyuvesi ilungise ibathathe bonke abangakabhalisi ukuze babhalise,” kusho uDuma.Umengameli womkhandlu owengamele izitshudeni eDUT, uKhanyisani ‘Godlimpi’ Khambule, ugxeke inyuvesi emuva kokushona kukaMadonsela oshonele esibhedlela esizimele eThekwini.UKhambule uthe basemanzini ngenxa yokwenzeke izolo lapho omunye wonogada obeqashwe yinyuvesi edubule isitshudeni sashona.“Sifuna ukudlulisa umlayezo kubaphathi baseDUT, kuhulumeni nakwabomthetho wokuthi kusiphethe kabi okusehlele. Akusiphathi kahle ukuthi kudutshulwe ilungu le-EFF lashona ngenxa yesiteleka,” kusho uKhambule.Izitshudeni ze-EFF zimashe emgwaqweni odlula kulesi sikhungo izolo kanti amaphoyisa abelokhu eqaphe isimo.UKhambule uthe bavamile ukuteleka enyuvesi futhi kuvamise ukuthi badutshulwe ngezinhlamvu zenjoloba kodwa ngoLwesibili onogada badubule ngezinhlamvu zangempela.“Onogada balandela imiyalelo abayinikwa abaphathi benyuvesi ukuthi abadubule izitshudeni,” kusho yena.Emashini bekukhona namalungu emikhandlu ehlukene okubalwa iSadesmo ye-IFP neBLF.Abengamele izitshudeni enyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal ophikweni i-Edgewood, Westville, Howard kanjalo naseMangosuthu University of Technology bakuqinisekisile ukuthi namabhasi ezitshudeni awasebenzi.Okhulumela i-EFFSC eMUT, uMvuyisi Mavuthulana, uthe inyuvesi izovalwa kuze kufezwe izidingo zezitshudeni.“Sizobhekana ngendlela eyiyo nalesi senzo saseDUT ngoba uma sikhombisa ukwesaba singaphinda senzeke lesi sehlakalo futhi sizoqhubeka nokuphatha bethanda bengathandi,” kusho uMavuthulana.

LIKHULU isasasa ngombukiso omkhulu wamabhizinisi ozoba KwaZulu-Natal okokuqala ngenyanga ezayo.Kulindeleke ukuthi ihehe osomabhizinisi abaningi i-International Franchise and Entrepreneur Expo eyethulwa Ithala ngokuhlanganyela neFranchise Association of South Africa (Fasa). Kuzobe kuwunyaka ka-21 kwenziwa lo mbukiso ohlose ukunika ithuba osomabhizinisi abancane nemifelandowonye ukuhweba emabhizinisini eFranchising. Oyisikhulu esiphezulu se-Ithala Development Finance Corporation uNksz Pearl Bengu, uthe ukulethwa kwalo mbukiso KwaZulu-Natal kuyingxenye yemizamo yabo yokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane.“Sacela kwiFasa ukuletha lo mbukiso ukuze sivulele osomabhizinisi bethu amathuba. Lokhu kuyingxenye yokukhulisa nesikhwama sethu iFranchise Fund. Sifuna osomabhizinisi bangathengi nje kuphela amabhizinisi amaFranchise kodwa baguqule ngisho awabo abe yiwona,” echaza.Uthe lo mbukiso uhambisana nemigomo yabo kwezokuthuthukiswa komnotho nokwakha amathuba omsebenzi nokuletha abatshali zimali esifundazweni.UNkk Vera Valasis onguMqondisi oMkhulu kwaFasa, uthe sekuneminyaka engu-20 lo mbukiso wenziwa eGoli.“Ukulethwa kwalo mbukiso KwaZulu-Natal kukhombisa ukuthi uyasabalala. Siyajabula ukuthi osomabhizisi bazothola ithuba lokuhlangana nosondonzima kumaFranchise, bathole nokuchushiswa ngaleli bhizinisi.”Lo mbukiso uzudonsa izinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngoMashi 8 eDurban Exhibition Centre. Bangaphezu kuka-40 osomabhizinisi okulindeleke ukuthi babe yingxenye yalo mbukiso abasemikhakheni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuhle, ubuchwepheshe, ezokuvakasha neminye.Kulezi zinsuku ezimbili kuzoba nezikhulumi ezahlukene ukuchushisa osomabhizinisi abancane kulo mkhakha.Umkhakha weFranchising ubalwa neminye ekhulisa umnotho kuleli. Ngokombiko wangonyaka odlule weFasa kuvela ukuthi lo mkhakha ufaka * -15.7% emnothweni wakuleli. Kuthiwa angaphezu kuka-850 amaFranchise kuleli ezitolo ezingaphezu kuka-41 000. Ngemininingwane yokubhalisela ukungena kulo mbukiso kungenwa kwi-website ethi: www.ife.co.za kanti kubiza uR50 ukungena ngosuku embukisweni. Uma uthenga ithikithi emnyango uR100. Izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-16 zingena mahhala.Eminye imininingwane iyatholakala kwi-website ethi:www.ithala.co.za noma ku-031 907 8911.

KUBHEKWE ukuthi udaba lokudala amathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda nezinhlelo zokufukula intsha kube ngezinye zezinto eziseqhulwini uma uNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Willies Mchunu (osesithombeni), esethula inkulumo yakhe mayelana nesimo sesifundazwe enkundleni yezemidlalo eRoyal Show Grounds eMgungundlovu ngoLwesithathu.Namhlanje iSilo samaBandla uGoodwill Zwelithini kulindeleke ukuthi sivule isiShayamthetho ngokusemthethweni bese kuthi kusasa uMchunu athule inkulumo yakhe mayelana nesimo sesifundazwe.Ihhovisi likaMchunu likuqinisekisile ukuthi nguyena ozokwethula inkulumo yesimo sesifundazwe yize ekade engekho isikhathi esiningi kusukela kuqale unyaka ebanjelwe nguNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa koMnotho esifundazweni uMnuz Sihle Zikalala.Umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe ucabanga ukuthi udaba lokudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwentsha kwezomnotho ngezinye zezinto ezizoba seqhulwini enkulumweni kaMchunu.“Ngicabanga ukuthi le nkulumo kaMchunu sekungeyokugcina, angiboni eqhubeka njengondunankulu ngemuva kokhetho lukazwelonke,” kusho uKhumalo.

source: imibono unyazi sicela luthethelele abagcotshwa abamisiwe
text: MHLELI: Ngicela ukuthi ungidlulisele ukuphatheka kabi kwami ngesenzo esenzeka lapha ebandleni selokhu kwahlala ubaba uNyazi ebandleni. Okokuqala, ngizobeka kucace ukuthi ngokwenqubo yaleli bandla uma kuzongena imihlangano eyaye yenziwe kathathu onyakeni, okuyinhlangano kaJanuwari, Julayi no-Okthoba kumele kuthethelelwe bonke abebemisiwe ngenxa yokuphambana nomthetho webandla noma ngamacala athile abasuke bewenzile, bephula imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Kodwa lokhu sibona sekushaywa indiva nobaba sengathi uyehluleka ukuphuma nento ecacile njengomholi webandla. Abantu bayazenzela nje, akanendaba futhi uyehluleka ukumela iqiniso njengoba kunguye owokugcina okumele aphume nezwi eliwujuqu.Ngikhuluma nje kunabagcotshwa abayilokhu bamiswa. Manje sekungaphezulu kweminyaka eyisithupha udaba lwabo lungakhulumeki, yena ubaba uthulile nje akabashayi mkhuba noma sebekhalela ukuthi phela abaxolelwe, babuyele esontweni. Ngokwenqubo yebandla lokhu akwenzeki.Siyamangala-ke ngoba lokhu kuyaphambana nomthetho kanti nekomiti elimiselwe ukulungisa izindaba zebandla lizithulele nje. Manje angisazi ukuthi leli bandla libhekephi uma kunjalo. Uma yena engabathetheleli njengomnikazi wesonto kanti ngubani okumele abathethelele? Futhi uma yena engabazweli ngubani kanti ozobazwela ngoba uma bexabene, engabalamuli ngabe ulindele ukuthi kuze kuchitheke igazi yini lapha ebandleni? Yonke le mihlangano engiyibalile iyangena nje bamisiwe laba bantu, abasonti ndawo, abasazazi noma basengamaNazaretha noma sebeyini. Uma belahlwa benganakwa kanti yini lena engaka abayona lapha ebandleni edala bangiyitholi intethelelo?Uma bengahamba manje emhlabeni bengathethelelwe kuyothiwani? Sengisola ukuthi naye ubaba akalinakile ibandla ukuthi abantu bayezwana noma cha. Laba bagcotshwa ngingabala oMfundisi Khanyi, Mavuso, Ngema, Mchunu noMvangeli uMtshali. Angisazi kahle noma bamisiwe noma baxoshiwe yini ebandleni. Ngikhuluma nje lona omunye uMfundisi Richard Mchunu wake wazidela weza mathupha ethi uzozicelela intethelelo kuye ubaba uNyazi kepha wavinjwa ngamanye amalungu ebandla, amfaka induku phambi kwakhe ubaba. Ngelanga ashaywa ngalo kwakuyiSabatha kwakukhona ngisho iSilo Samabandla sivakashile, okungavumelekile-ke emthethweni kaNkulunkulu ukuba kwenzeke. Futhi lokhu kwakumele ubaba njengomholi aphume nezwi eliwujuqu ngaso leso sikhathi, ayilungise yena le ndaba yalaba bagcotshwa abathethelele babuyele esontweni nabo bazikhonzele. Kepha yena wathi laba bantu abaxabene bebodwa, abasale bayilungise le ndaba yokuxabana kwabo wasuka washiya kulenga kunjalo.Le nto eyenzekayo lapha ebandleni isiphethe kabi kakhulu ngoba ihlambalaza ibandla likaNkulunkulu wasekuPhakameni. Angikaze ngiyibone le nto ngoba kuyimanje kukhona abanye abagcotshwa abamisiwe futhi nabo okungezwakali kahle ukuthi benze sono sini.UThingolwenkosazana lwalungahambisani nokushaywa nokuxoshwa kwabantu esontweni noma ngabe benzeni. Lwaluze lusho luthi mina angixoshi muntu ngoba nobaba abazange baxoshe muntu. Kodwa manje lokhu sekuyinsakavukela nje ebandleni. Siyibandla siyamangala ukuthi sekuyisonto elinjani kanti leli uma selinjena. Ngiyafisa ukuthi nesigungu esiphezulu silusukumele ngokukhulu ukushesha lolu daba lwalaba bagcotshwa, babuyiselwe ebandleni nabo bakhonze.Le nto ibuhlungu ngoba laba bantu banezingane namakhosikazi abangazi lutho futhi angone lutho. Nabo bayathinteka abasasonti ndawo ngoba kumiswe oyise nabayeni babo. Ngicela isonto lingaphenduki kube yikwamachanca kwampunzi edla emini lingaphenduki libe yihlathi ekubeni kunomholi nesigungu esimiselwe ukulungisa lezi zindaba. Njengoba nje kuzoba nomhlangano lapha eGoli kuyo lenyanga bengicela babuyiswe laba bagcotshwa, kungadlalwa ngokukholwa kwabo ngoba bengenamkhulumeli.Ngifisa ukuthi kuphele lokhu kuxabana okukhona ngaphansi kobuholi boNyazi nalo alusukume lubonise ubuholi balo luqede le ngxabano ekhona esithathe iminyaka eminingi kangaka.Uma lwehluleka ukulamula le ngxabano ngifisa bamiswe nalaba abanye abagcotshwa abaxabene nalaba abemisiwe baze babuyele esontweni sebebuyisene ngoba basonta kanjani bona bexabene nabanye?Sekwaze kwaba khona omunye umuzi owakheka phezu kwenzondo khona lapha eGoli, okuyaye kuthi uma uNyazi luze kulona omunye umuzi abanye abavumelekile ukungena kuwo ngoba kuxatshenwe. Uma selulethe umhlangano kulona omunye futhi laba abanye abavumelekile ukungena kuwo.Ubaba uyawubuka nje lo msindo uyaqhubeka. Bengilokhu ngithi uzowunaka awulungise njengenhloko. Manje zidla amahlanga phambi kwakhe abantu bayazenzela nje. Iyakhathaza le nto ngoba isisontisa kabi uma sinyonkolozana kabi kangaka ngoba awukwazi ukukhuluma nalaba abanye ngoba uthathwa njengevukela mbuso kulaba abamise, abanye kushiwo lokhu nalokhu. “Wonke amaNazaretha mawabe munye njengebumba likasimende.” Ameni, ngiyabonga.OkhathazekileEGAUTENG

OWAYEYILUNGU lePhalamende, uNkk Vytjie Mentor, izolo ubuze kabanzi ngokwethembeka kwemininingwane yocingo eqoshiwe eyiswe kwiKhomishini ivela kuNkk Lakela Kaunda owayesebenza njengomsizi kaMnuz Jacob Zuma.UNkk Mentor ubethula ubufakazi osukwini lwesibili kwikhomishini lapho ekade ehlohlwa imibuzo. Ngonyaka odlule wabethula ubufakazi kodwa nakulo nyaka uphinde wabizwa ngoba bekukhona izinto obekumele azicacise.Ngonyaka odlule watshela ikhomishini ukuthi uNkk Kaunda wamshayela ucingo wamtshela ukuthi kumele ahlangane noZuma eGoli ukuze bakhulume ngezinto zikahulumeni.UNkk Mentor ngaleso sikhathi wayenguSihlalo wekomiti elibhekele ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi kahulumeni.Uthe ukufika kwakhe eGoli kwaholela ekutheni agcine eseya emzini wakwaGupta lapho athenjiswa khona umsebenzi wokuba nguNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni.UNkk Kaunda uphikile ukuthi washayela uNkk Mentor wakhipha nemininingwane eqoshiwe yocingo eqinisekisa ukuthi akaze amthinte.Ummeli kaNkk Kaunda, * -Adv Henry Cowley, utshele ikhomishini ukuthi akukaze kube khona ukuxhumana phakathi kwamumele noNkk Mentor.UNkk Mentor, izolo ophike nemininingwane yoMnyango wezaseKhaya neyakwa-SAA, nayizolo ubemile ekutheni waxhumana noNkk Kaunda wathi abagcinanga ngokuxhumana kodwa babethumelelana nemiyalezo.“Ngeke ngikhulume ngokwethembeka kwemininingwane ekhishwe nguNkk Kaunda kwiKhomishini, ivela kuyena hhayi kwaVodacom. Ngatshelwa ukuthi izinkampani zamaselula aziyigcini imininingwane ngaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu,” kusho uNkk Mentor.

source: imibono simanzonzo isimo ngokuwa kwenkampani eyenza ijuba
text: MHLELI: Ngicela Isolezwe ke lilandelele liphenye kabanzi ngenkampani endala kunazo zonke la kwelakithi likaMthaniya, ephisa utshwala besizulu namahewu, okuthiwa idilize inqwaba yabasebenzi ngenxa yokwehla kwezinga lokuthengwa komkhiqizo wayo, iJuba.Isimo sibi futhi simazonzo kuleya nkampani kangangokuthi sekuze kwavalwa nendawo yayo endala ekhiqiza lona iJuba namahewu aziwa ngokuthi uKhozi.Le nkampani izinze eKhangela, ingumakhelwane nesibhedlela esikhulu eThekwini iKing Edward. Kuyangidabukisa mina njengomuntu owake wasebenza khona esikhathini esiphambili ukubona le nkampani iwa sibhekile ngenxa nje yobudedengu beziphathimandla eziyiphethe.Ngiyethemba ukuthi Isolezwe lizokwazi ukulululandela lolu daba lwale nkampani, likwazi nokuthola umnyombo wokuthi kahlehle kwenzakani kuleya nkampani, ukuze amaqiniso ahlale obala.Ngicela ukuligodla igama lami Mhleli, ngenxa yokusaba ngokuphepha kwami.Okhathazekile

ISIKHULU sophiko lwezokuvakasha KwaZulu-Natal, iTourism KwaZulu-Natal, esisanda kuqokwa sizimisele ukuthuthukisa izindawo zokuvakasha ezisezindaweni ezisemakhayaUMnuz Nhlanhla Khumalo, onamasonto amabili eqokelwe ukuba yiGeneral Manager, uthe izindawo ezigudle ulwandle zidume ngokuheha izivakashi kodwa uyazi ukuthi izindawo ezinothe ngomlando namasiko amaZulu ziyaziheha izivakashi ezifisa ukubona futhi zifunde ngamasiko.“Njengamanje izindawo ezithuthukisiwe eziningi ziseduze namadolobha, ezisemakhaya zisasilele emuva ngenani lezivakashi ezihambelayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuthi azikathuthukiswa ngezinga elilingana nelasemadolobheni,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe emasonto amabili eqalile esikhundleni ubesabheka izinhlelo nemigomo elawula lolu phiko.“Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale izinhlelo ezintsha kumele ubheke imithetho nemigomo elawula isikhungo ukuze ubone ukuthi amasu owacabangayo ngeke yini ashayisane nemithetho elawula lesi sikhungo. Engikutholile ukuthi imigomo nezinhlelo ezikhona ziyavuma. Okwamanje angizukuqhamuka nezinhlelo eziningi ezintsha, ngizothuthukisa izinhlelo ebezivele zikhona, ngiqedele ebese ziqaliwe,” kusho uKhumalo.UKhumalo uneminyaka eyevile eshumini esebenza eMnyangweni wezeMvelo kuzwelonke. Uthe ngokubona kwakhe umsebenzi wezokuvakasha usondelene nemvelo.UKhumalo uneMasters kwiTourism Development, uke waba ngumqondisi wohlelo oluqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezokuvakasha ziyenziwa ezifundazweni ezigudle ulwandle, kulezi zinhlelo bekukhona izinhlelo zezokuvakasha ezihlanganisa nemvelo. Kulolu hlelo usebenze iminyaka eyisishagalombili.Uqhube wathi kunamathuba amaningi okukhula emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, wezemvelo kanjalo nasemkhakheni wamasiko nomlando.

UKHALA uyazithulisa owesilisa wasePort Shepstone owayevakashele umngani wakhe eThekwini, othi wabanjwa inkunzi waphucwa uR1 100 nguscabha etekisini yaseSouth Beach.UMnuz Christ Cele, uthe wayeyohlangana nomngani wakhe, wagibela itekisi ngo-5.30 ekuseni, esekhokha kuscabha owayeqoqa imali kwabanye abagibeli wabe esekhonjwa ngommese yilo sicabha, wathatha yonke imali yakhe.“Ngakhipha imali ngithi ngiyakhokha, umfana wayithatha imali kubo bonke abagibeli. Ube esesondela eduze kwami wakhipha ummese wathi angikhiphe yonke imali engiyiphethe. Wathatha uR1 100 obusekhukhwini lami. Bekunabagibeli kule tekisi, kuthe noma ngizama ukukhala ngangasizwa muntu, umshayeli naye wavele wayishaya yazula, wangamnaka. Kuthe uma ima itekisi umfana wehla, wabaleka. Obehlezi eduze kwami wazikhalela ngokuthi naye ubesaba ukuthi uzomphuca eyakhe imali uma engilekelela,” kusho uCele.Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi umshayeli akazange amlekelele, kunalokho waba nezaba wathi akamazi lo scabha, wathi ubehamba yedwa, engenamsizi.“Umshayeli waba umuntu ongayingeni indaba yami, wathi akagadi abagibeli yena. Ngasala dengwane ngingasenalutho, ngihlukumezekile ngalesi sigameko. Ngifuna ubulungiswa,” kusho uCele.UMnuz Vusi Msani, wososeshini baseSouth Beach, uthe babikelwe ngalesi sigameko.“Ngashayelwa ucingo umshayeli engitshela ukuthi kunomgibeli okhala ngokuthi ubanjwe inkunzi esetekisini waphucwa uR1 100, kunabagibeli phakathi. Ngathi abaye esiteshini samaphoyisa bavule icala, baveza ukuthi amaphoyisa anqabile ukulivula icala umshayeli ehamba yedwa, bafuna ophucwe imali. Umgibeli ubevele eseyile kolivula icala.“Sibe sesicela lo mgibeli ukuthi eze ekomitini lethu elibheka izikhalazo zabagibeli, elihlangana njalo ngoLwesine kodwa wangafika lo mgibeli. Besifuna ukuthola okwenzeka njengoba osicabha bengasekho nhlobo lapha eSouth Beach, bamiswa ngoNovemba 1 ngonyaka odlule,” kusho uMsani.Uthe lolu daba bazolulandela.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Thembeka Mbele, uthe baphenya icala lokubanjwa inkunzi komgibeli esetekisini.“Ngokophenyo esilwenzayo umgibeli ngoFebhuwari 16 nonyaka, ngo-5.30 ekuseni wabanjwa inkunzi egibele itekisi, umsolwa wayehlezi ngasemnyango. Wamkhomba ngommese, wathatha imali yakhe. Icala lokubanjwa inkunzi livulwe esiteshini saseDurban Central, uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka,” kusho uCol. Mbele.Imenenja ehhovisi leSantaco eKZN uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uthe bayezwelana nalo mgibeli, wanxusa ukuba abagibeli beqikelele uma begibele amatekisi ukuthi bayazigada izimpahla zabo ngoba abanye abasuke begibele nabo basuke bengaziwa.Uthe bazolulandelela lolu daba.

source: imibono umthethosisekelo waba yingcwaba lokugcina komnyama
text: ABAMHLOPHE bafika ezwenikazi i-Afrika bathola abamnyama benamasiko abo. Nakuba babaphuca okuningi kodwa kukhona abangabanga namandla okubaphuca khona. Kokunye abangakwazanga ukukuphuca khona abampisholo yilo isiko nesintu sabo. Bafaka inkolo ngenhloso yokumdunga umqondo umuntu omnyama. Kuyadabukisa ukuthi kuthe uma sekuphatha umuntu omnyama, waphuca umuntu wakubo isiko nesintu sakhe. Namhlanje sinobugcwelegcwele izwelonke uhulumeni wakha imali ngabo, namhlanje sinezingane ezihlala emigwaqweni ezijika zibe yizigebengu, ezigcina sezibizwa ngamaphara.Ngo-1996 kwaqhanyukwa noMthethosisekelo wezwe owanconywa kwathiwa muhle kunayo yonke emhlabeni. Lihle iqiniso, lokho kwaba yingcwaba lokugcina kumuntu omnyama. Umuntu omnyama kuqale lapho ukuthi kuthiwe akenze izinto eziphambene nesiko nesintu sakhe, okugcine kumngcwaba okokugcina.Uma ingane izalwa emandulo bekwaziwa ukuthi uma uyise nonina bengashadile leyo ngane ingumlanjwana, iyohlale ingeyakoninalume. Namhlanje uma ingane izalwa esibhedlela akubuzwa nakubuzwa kuvele kuthiwe ayibhalwe ngesibongo sikayise, lawo maphepha ayogcina eseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, nakhona ingane igxivizwe ngesibongo sikayise. Unina ngokungazi isiko njengalokhu selamuka nezinkolo avume kugcine isibongo esisebenzayo kungesikayise wengane. Uma makhathaleni ingane isinezinkinga, kugcina sekufanele kuhlehlelwe emuva ingane ilungise iphutha elenzeka ngesikhathi izalwa sekuthiwa ayihambe iyofuna izincwadi ezifungelwe kokunye kuthathwe igazi. Uma uyise wengane nonina sebexabana kuqala inkinga. Akubhekwa ukuthi iphutha leli elenzeka emuva esibhedlela, lilungiswe kalula ngoba kwaziwa ukuthi isiko nesintu kuthini.Namhlanje la maphara esikhala ngawo amaqanda azalwe nguMthethosisekelo wethu owakhiwe omnyama kubusa omnyama, amachwane achanyiselwa yilokhu kuhlupheka esikubona kubhebhetheka imihla namalanga enganeni yomuntu omnyama. Siqamba amanga sithi kunezinkumbi zezingane ezingayitholi imisebenzi ngoba sifuna ukwanelisa izifiso zepolitiki sibe sazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi akulula ukuthola umsebenzi kuphambene esibongweni. Uma ingane iphuma iyofuna umsebenzi iphuma naliphi ithongo? Lokhu ongqongqoshe abaphethe kowezaseKhaya bakwazi kahle kamhlophe, ezabo izingane ngeke bavume ukuthi zibizwe ngesibongo abaziyo ukuthi akusona. Kufana ncamashi nokuthi ezemindeni yabo ezakhona izingane bazifaka ezibhedlela ezingcono, nasezikoleni ezingcono bese bethi bahola umphakathi wona oyiswa ezikoleni nasezibhedlela abathi ezikahulumeni. Liphi iqiniso eliyophephisa lisindise liphinde liphilise umuntu omnyama oholwa omnyama na?Namhlanje sekuyinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba ukuthi yonke ingane ezalwayo uyise nonina abashadile, noma beshadile kodwa akuzange kwagcagcwa njengalokhu sekwalahleka isintu namasiko. Namhlanje sekuyinto enzima ukuthi uma uganwa ungaganwa umuntu ongenayo ingane. Iningi labesifazane linezingane, kanjalo nebesilisa.Ukuyeka imikhuba efana nokusoma nokuhlolwa kwabesimame nokufundiswa kwabafana entabeni yikhona okuchamisele le nkinga yokuthi wonke umuntu usethatha isinqumo sokuganwa enomuntu onengane yomunye. Kukabili-ke le ngane ayithole engakashadi owesimame uzohamba nayo uyoyibiza ngesibongo salapho eganele khona, kokunye uzwe bona abadala obathembile okuthi bazi isintu abazizalukazi namakhehla bethi hamba uyobiza isibongo sakini khona ungayohlupheka. Kulapho-ke kuqala khona izinkinga. Kulapho uqala khona ukuba nezinkinga zasemsamo usuhlangabezana nale nkinga yaseMnyangweni wezaseKhaya, sekuthiwa thola izincwadi ezifungelwe, kumbe kuthathwe igazi ukuthola ukuthi bayakuzala ngempela yini laba bantu ngoba uthi uzama ukuguqula isibongo kube ngesilungile.Abantu abaningi abaya kohlola ezangomeni namhlanje bazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi yisibongo esonakele. Uyozwa nohlolayo ethi thatha isibongo sikayihlo into engelona nakancane isiko, belekelelwa amanye amabandla akhona athi ancike esintwini kodwa ebe ekhuthaza into ephambene nesintu.Lithi-ke elami uma uhulumeni engakalungisi ezibhedlela lapho kuzalelwa khona izingane kanjalo nasemnyangweni, abantu bakithi abathi beyokulungisa batshelwe lokhu nalokhu, usekude umuntu omnyama ukukhulukeka nokuthi umnotho ube sezandleni zakhe.NANSI INDABANgeke ulahlwe abezizwe, uyolahla abakini.Bhedlindaba(033) 5691317/ 0797471911/ 0728972001.

MHLELI: Ngizwakalisa umuzwa wami ngengqungquthela ye-IFP KZN ebisoLundi ngempelasonto mhla ka-29 Juni. Ngiyilungu le-IFP ebeliyingxenye yengqungquthela futhi ebelinelungelo lokuvota.Ngizwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngenkulumo kaMnuz Xolani Dube ongumhlaziyi wezepolitiki, ayisho ohlelweni lwezindaba kuKhozi FM ngoJulayi 1. UDube uthe uMnuz AT Ntuli ukhonjiwe nekomiti akhethwe nalo. Lapho umhlaziyi ubekhomba ngenjumbane umholi wethu, uMntwana waKwaPhindangene ukuthi ukhombe uNtuli ukuthi abe ngusihlalo waseKZN.UNtuli uphakanyiswe amaziko ukuba angenele ukhetho. UMntwana uyilungu le-IFP elivela ezikweni, kuyilungelo lakhe ukuba nombono njengoba nomthethosisekelo weqembu lethu usho njalo. Ngiyazi uDube akawazi umthethosisekelo wethu. Kuyakhathaza okwenziwa uDube ukuthi njalo bahlasela uMntwana ngokuthi akahambisani nentando yeningi. UDube uze wabala nabaholi abaningi athi sebahamba eNkatheni ngenxa kaShenge. Ihlaya nje ubala ubaba uJiyane. UJiyane wazesulela eqenjini, izwe liyakwazi lokho.Usho kanjani ukuthi umuntu ukhonjiwe esikhundleni kodwa ewine ngamavoti? UNtuli uwine ngamavoti ehlula akababa uYengwa. Asicacise nokuthi zonke izikhundla, kukhethwe ngenqubo yentando yeningi, kwaba khona abaphakanyiswayo kepha bazihoxela bona, okuyilungelo labo nalokho. Uma uMntwana ephawula ukuthi njengelungu le-IFP uyakweseka ukuphakanyiswa kweMeya yaseNkandla, yikuphi la umthethosisekelo ungamvumeli ukuba abeke umbono wakhe? Uma lokho kusho ukukhomba ngentshebe, cha ukuhlaziya kukaDube kunomkhuhlane. Abahlaziyi abayeke ukulokhu behlasela uShenge, kade zingenzeki izingqungquthela begxeka uShenge, inkinga isemazikweni abengakulungele. Asikwamukele ukuthi bekuyingqungquthela yokukhetha le, vele imibono ibihlukene kodwa asingahlaseli umholi ngamampunge ngoba bekuvotwa ngohlelo lwevoti eliyimfihlo, kwabalwa zavuna uMphemba izibalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikucacise lokhu ngoba kuzosiza obengekho emhlanganweni alazi iqiniso. Siyazi abanye kuselukhuni ukwamukela imiphumela, bese bebeka izaba ngokuthi umholi wathi weseka uNtuli, baze bathi akulula ukumphonsela inselelo. Uma kungelula ukuphonsela umbono womholi inselelo pho bamphakamisa kanjani? Bakwazi kanjani ukucula izingoma ezeseka uYengwa emhlanganweni umholi aye kuwo baze bangunga izimonto ahamba ngazo?Ngifisa abahlaziyi banike iNkatha isikhathi sayo sokwenza izinto zayo, bese behlaziya ngeqiniso, bangachemi nabantu abangafuni ukwamukela imiphumela. Siyabonga kubaba uYengwa nekomiti lonke eliphumile kulokho abasenzele khona. Asinike uMphemba nekomiti elisha ithuba lokuyisa iNkatha phambili sibeseke egameni leqembu.Ngiyathokoza mhleli, ukungivumela ngisebenzise ilungelo njengomfundi waleli phephandaba lansuku zonke.Thokozani NtombelaENKANDLA

SIPHINDE safakelwa ezinye izigidi isikhwama okuhloswe ngaso ukusiza intsha enamabhizinisi KwaZulu-Natal, esethulwa ekuqaleni konyaka. Lesi sikhwama esibizwa ngeKZN Youth Fund sethulwa nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe uMnuz Sihle Zikalala ngoJanuwari. Ethula isabelozimali sehhovisi lakhe izolo, undunankulu umemezele ukuthi kuzokwengezwa uR50 million kulesi sikhwama.Ngesikhathi sethulwa ngoJanuwari, uZikalala waveza ukuthi wuR50 million obekelwe lesi sikhwama. Emuva kokwethulwa kwaso kwabuye kwaba nesidlo sasekuseni nabanye osomabhizinisi abanikele ngoR20 million, okwenze isikhwama saba uR70 million. Kumanje isikhwama sesinoR120 million.Ekhuluma eSishayamthetho sesifundazwe izolo uZikalala, uthe basabafuna abanye osomabhizinisi abazimele abazonikela kulesi sikhwama.“Siyazi ukuthi kunokuhlobana phakathi kosomabhizinisi nokudaleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.Lesi sikhwama esesinguR120 million sizosiza intsha engosomabhizinisi, ezovulela nabanye amathuba omsebenzi. Siyakujabulela ukuthi ibhange i-Absa selibeke eceleni uR70 million ozosiza intsha efuna ukuboleka imali noR500 million wamabhizinisi amancane,” kusho uZikalala.Uthe basazibophezele ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi esifundazweni nokudala amathuba omsebenzi. Uveze ukuthi kulindeleke ukuthi lesi sikhwama senyuke njengoba kusekhona izingxoxo nabanye osomabhizinisi abazimele. UZikalala uthe ithimba lokuqala lentsha elifake izicelo zokuhlomula kulesi sikhwama, lizokwethulwa ngenyanga ezayo.Ngesikhathi ethula isikhwama ngoJanuwari, undunankulu wagcizelela ukuthi sizohlomulisa kuphela amabhizinisi angeke aphele endleleni. Uthe kuzoxhaswa amabhizinisi azokwazi ukudala amathuba omsebenzi kwenye intsha, ikakhulukazi kwiFranchising nasezimbonini zokukhiqiza. Uveze nokuthi isikhwama senzelwe ukusiza intsha engalutholi uxhasho lokuqala amabhizinisi emabhange, ezosizwa nangokuqeqeshwa.

ABALANDELI beMeya yeTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede basabisa ngokuthatha izinyathelo uma ingabuyiselwa emsebenzini njengoba inikwe ikhefu ngemuva kwamacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti.Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede izolo bebebhikisha edolobheni bezwakalisa ilaka labo ngemuva kokuthi i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal yelule isikhathi ikhefu lakhe kuze kube yenza isimemezelo ekuqaleni kuka-Agasti.Abalandeli bagasele emahhovisi kamasipala eCity Hall bakhipha abasebenzi.NgoLwesithathu babe nomlindelo bekhulekela umholi wabo.Ngaphandle kwaseCity Hall kusuke esinamathambo amaphoyisa abeqaphe isimo ededela isibhaxu kubalandeli bemeya kubalwa nezintatheli.Amaphoyisa abonakale ebamba ngesidlozane intatheli ye-Independent Media, uMnuz Sihle Mavuso oze waboshwa kodwa wabuye wadedelwa.Bayisikhombisa abantu ababoshiwe kubalwa nabaholi bemashi.Kuthiwa bathathu abalimele ngemuva kokudutshulwa ngezinhlamvu zenjoloba.Ababhikishi basuke eCity Hall baya eGugu Dlamini Park maqede baphikelela emahhovisi e-ANC.EGugu Dlamini baphakelwe ukudla ukuthiba iphango. Emahhovisi e-ANC akekho okhulume nabo basuka khona baya esiteshini samaphoyisa beyophoqa ukuthi kudedelwe abaholi ababoshiwe.Abazange bangene esiteshini eDurban Central ngoba amaphoyisa abesebalinde ngaphandle abahlakaza ngokudubula emoyeni, efutha nesisi esikhalisa unyembezi.Omunye okhulumela abalandeli bemeya, uMnuz Sduduzo Magwaza, usabise ngokuthi sebezothatha izinyathelo zomthetho uma ingabuyiselwa emsebenzi.“Into esilethe lapha wukuthi sizophoqa ukuthi imeya ivunyelwe iqhubeke nomsebenzi wayo,” kusho uMagwaza.Uthe banezinyathelo eziningi abangazithatha ukulungisa lolu daba.“Sizoqhubeka nokufaka ingcindezi sixoxe nobuholi besifundazwe ngoba thina singabantu abawuqondayo umbutho, uma singanelisekile ngesikunikwa wubuholi besifundazwe sizodlulela ebuholini bukazwelonke nalapho uma singagciliseki sizophoqeleka ukuthi sisebenzise umthetho, ngoba siyakholelwa ekutheni isinqumo sesifundazwe asikho emthethweni,” kusho uMagwaza.Izolo isimo besishubile eThekwini njengoba kuphazamiseke nokuhamba kwezimoto ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umbhikisho.Ngaphandle kwasesiteshini iDurban Central abalandeli bakaGumede bacishe babambana ngezandla namaphoyisa ngemuva kokuthi edubule emoyeni, bewasola ngokusebenzisa izindlela zamaphoyisa obandlululo.Khona izolo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umbhikisho, kusabalale nemibiko ethi imenenja yoMkhandlu uMnuz Sipho Nzuza isisulile emsebenzini.UNzuza ungufakazi woMbuso ecaleni elithinta imeya. Okhulumela uMkhandlu weTheku uMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela uthe amanga aluhlaza ukuthi uNzuza usulile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Thembeka Mbele uthe bayisikhombisa abantu ababoshiwe mayelana namacala okudala uthuthuva emphakathini.Uthe kukhona nentatheli eboshiwe kodwa yabuye yadedelwa.“Kunecala lokushaya nokudicilela phansi isithunzi eliphenywayo elibekwe intatheli,” kusho uMbele.

KUSAME nse ukusebenza kwamatekisi erenki yaseMlaza, iMNR naseNgonyameni njengoba ososeshini bakulezi zindawo bengavumelananga emhlanganweni kulandela ukubulawa kwabashayeli abangaphansi kwasoseshini uMNR eMlaza. NgoLwesibili ntambama kubulawe abashayeli bamatekisi ababili kwizigameko ezehlukene. Umshayeli oyedwa udutshulwe ka-D kanti omunye udutshulwe kwa-M.Kuthiwa ukubulawa kwalaba bashayeli kulandela ukubangwa kwemizila phakathi kososeshini ababili iMNR Taxi neNgonyameni Taxi. Kuthiwa osomatekisi bakwaMNR banqabele amatekisi aseNgonyameni ukuthi asebenzise umgwaqo odlula eMlaza uma beya eThekwini nokusolwa ukuthi yikho okususe lolu thuthuva.Izolo ososeshini iMNR Taxi neNgonyameni Taxi babe nomhlangano obulawula yisifunda iNingizumu 2.UNobhala weNingizimu 2, uMnuz Mandla Malishe, uthe baphume bedangele kulo mhlangano njengoba kungabanga nokuzwana kulabo soseshini.“UMnyango wezokuThutha usungenelele kulolu daba njengoba uze wasiyalele ngokumele sikwenze ukuze sixazulule lolu daba, kodwa umhlangano awubanga nenqubekela phambili njengoba kugejane amazwi kulabo soseshini,” kusho uMalishe. Isolezwe latshelwa umthombo walo ukuthi usoseshini waseNgonyameni uneminyaka wacela ukuncikiswa owaMNR.“Ubudlelwana bube muncu ngoba usoseshini waseNgonyameni awuyinyusanga imali yokugibela kule nyanga, uMNR uyinyuse ngo50c kubagibeli abaya ngaphakathi eMlaza, kwabaya eThekwini inyuke ngo R1,” kusho umthombo. Umthombo uthe ukunganyuswa kwemali kwamatekisi aseNgonyameni kuthathwe ngendlela yokudla umsebenzi wakwaMNR kwabe sekukhishwa umyalelo wokuthi bengabe besaguduza emzileni ohamba uMNR, bahambe ngoMangosuthu Highway.Amatekisi awabonwa erenki yakuMNR emva kokudutshulwa kosomatekisi, kanti abagibeli bagibela amabhasi, abanye bagibela awakwa-E, F nakwa-G. UMnuz Sifiso Shangase, oyimenenja ehhovisi leSantaco KwaZulu-Natal, ucele labo soseshini ukuthi baxoxisane. “Njengoba siyimboni yamatekisi sikhona ukusiza umphakathi, ngakho uma lungaxazululwa lolu daba umphakathi uyahlukumezeka,” kusho uShangase.

KUBOSHWE owesilisa oneminyaka engu-49 obanjwe nemali okusolwa ukuthi ngeyomkokotelo elinganiselwa ku-R107 300 ngoLwesithathu eBotshabelo, eFree State.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uSergeant Martin Xuma uthe le ndoda iboshwe abeSelossha Tactical Response Team ngemuva kokutholwa kwale mali ifakwe ezicathulweni lapho kuhlala khona izingubo zokugqoka emzini wayo.Lo mlisa uyiswe esiteshini lapho ahlonywe khona ngemibuzo, amaphoyisa athola enye imali yomkokotelo amaphaketheni akhe."Ngemuva kokwenza uphenyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle komuzi wakhe, amaphoyisa athole enye imali ewumkokotelo engalinganiselwa ku-R105 900 ifakwe kuplastiki omnyama ifihlwe endlini yangasese," kusho uXuma.Uthe isiyonke imali eshaqwe amaphoyisa ihlanganise u-R107 300.Uthe le ndoda ibhekene necala lokuphatha imali engekho emthethweni kanti kulindeleke ukuthi ivele enkantolo yemantshi yaseBotshabelo maduze.UKhomishana wamaphoyisa eFree State uLieutenant General Moeketsi Sempe unxuse abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali amakhasimende athenga ngayo isemthethweni.

BAKHALA bayazithulisa abadayisi basemgwaqweni ePinetown emuva kokuthi umlilo okusolakala ukuthi uqalwe amaphara ushise impahla abayidayisayo yaba wumlotha ezintatha zayizolo.UNkk Philomena MaMthembu Hlophe ophethe indawo okugcinwa kuyo impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni u-Anderson phakathi kwerenke yaKwaNdengezi neyaseClermont, ePinetown uthe ushayelwe ngamaphoyisa amtshela ukuthi kuyasha ngabo-2 ezintatha zayizolo.“Ngishayelwe izicishamlilo safika kanye nazo la ePinetown. Zizamile ukucisha kodwa ngebhadi ayikho impahla esindile njengoba konke kushe kwaba wumlotha. Saqala ngabo-1980 ukudayisa ezitaladini zasePinetown kodwa siyaqala ukubhekana nesimo esinzima kanje. Kusolakala ukuthi umlilo uqalwe yilaba abahlala kujantshi wesitimela kusho ukuthi bebebasile wase umlilo ubhebhetheka ushisa impahla lapha,” kusho uNkk Hlophe.Ucele noma wubani ongaba nosizo ukuba alekelele abadayisi abashelwe yimpahla ikakhulukazi uMasipala weTheku esho nokuthi akukho lapho abadayisi bethatha khona.Abadayisa izinkukhu oNksz Magaret Hadebe (54), Nksz Borcas Phakathi (56), uNkk Thandi Mabaso (69) noMnuz Mzingelwa Gama (79) bebekhalela izinkukhu zabo ezishe ziphila zaba ngamalahle.“Awukwazi nokubona ukuthi bekuyinkukhu enjani, zife zaphela izinkukhu zethu . Sicela uMasipala weTheku usinxephezele ngoba siyarenta ukugcina impahla yethu lapha. Sikhokha uR40 ngesonto noR400 wephemithi yezinyanga eziyisithupha. Siziphilisa ngokudayisa izinkukhu asazi sizokwenzenjani ngoba silahlekelwe yimpahla kaR2 000 umuntu emunye,” kusho uNksz Hadebe.UMnuz Jackson Rooimes owenza izicathulo, azikhande aphinde adayise nezintsha, uthe ulahlekelwe yimpahla kaR80 000 ngoba ubesanda kuthenga impahla yenyanga futhi kunezicathulo zabantu ezibizayo abezozilungisa kodwa ezishile. Kuyimanje angazi ukuthi ngizothathani ngiyihlanganise nani ngoba abantu bazozifuna izicathulo zabo,” kusho uRooimes.Uthe unezingane ezine azondla ngokudayisa emgwaqweni njengoba eyokugcina ineminyaka emibili.Ucele uMasipala weTheku ukuthi ubanxephezele ngoba abanawo umshwalense wosomabhizinisi kwazise basebenzela ukuxosha ikati eziko.Uveze ukuthi ngesonto ubekhokha uR70 ukugcina impahla yakhe kule ndawo eshile bese eba nephemithi kaR139 yezinyanga ezintathu.UMnuz Craig Peters oyi-Acting Divisional Commander ePinetown Fire and Emergency Department, uthe abasebenzi ababheka amaCCTV kaMasipala weTheku babone umlilo otshanini obungakujantshi wesitimela kwathi izicishamlilo seziphuthuma khona zezwa umsindo wento eqhumayo, kwase kusha amalangabi.Uthe kushe amaveji, inyama, iziphuzo, izinkukhu, izingubo zokugqoka nokunye.Ikhansela lendawo uNkk Mel Brauteseth lithe lisola ukuthi amaphara yiwona aqale umlilo ngoba egodola kodwa ahluleka ukuwulawula njengoba ushise impahla yabahwebi basemgwaqweni.“Bekukhona izitofu zegesi eziwu-40, izinkukhu ezilinganiselwa ku-80 nempahla ehlukene. Yonke into ishe yaba amalahle, ” kusho uNkk Brauteseth.UCaptain Nqobile Gwala wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uthe ukhona umlilo oshise impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni, akekho olimele.UMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela okhulumela uMasipala weTheku uthe imbangela yomlilo ayaziwa kodwa kuthiwa uqale ngakujantshi wesitimela wagcina usushisa indawo egcina impahla yabadayisi basemgwaqweni.Uthe bangaphezu kuka 300 abadayisi akade bebeka impahla engabiza uR300 000 kuleya ndawo.“Kukhona ingqalasizinda yakwaMTN yentengo kaR17 million neyakwaVodacom esingakayitholi intengo yayo,umonakalo owenzekile kwingqalasizinda kamasipala ulinganisela kuR9 million,”kusho uMayisela.

OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma usazolinda uphenyo lweKhomishana kaJaji Raymond Zondo ngezinsongo zokubulawa abhekene nazo ngaphambi kokuba afake isicelo sokuba kwengezwe ezokuPhepha kuye.Lokhu kuvezwe umkhulumeli wakhe, uMnuz Vukile Mathabela emuva kokuba kube nezinhlangano eziphazamise ukuba kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane nomndeni wakhe uZuma.“UJaji uZondo ukucacisile kwikhomishini yakhe ukuthi lolu daba lwezinsongo zokubulawa ezibhekiswe kuZuma zizophenywa abaphenyi bekhomishini ukuze bathole ukuthi ziqhamukaphi.“Kuyothi uma sebesithulele umbiko bese uMengameli Zuma ethatha isinyathelo. Okwamanje lukhona uhlelo lwamaphoyisa ngokuphepha kukaZuma njengoba amaphoyisa ehlale emqaphile,” kuchaza uMathabela obexoxa neSolezwe. NgeSonto eledlule, inhlangano elwisana nezimpi zamatekisi KwaZulu-Natal okuwuBumbano lokuThula Forum, iphakamise ukuthi kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kuZuma. Ikusho lokhu esitatimendeni sayo emuva kokuba uZuma edalule kwiKhomishini kaZondo ukuthi kukhona abasongela ngokumbulala nomndeni wakhe.Usihlalo woBumbano lokuThula, uMnuz Andile Hlatshwayo, uthe babona kuyisikhathi sokuba uZuma avikelwe ngoba sekuyacaca ukuthi impilo yakhe isengozini.“Ngemuva kwezinkulumo ezethulwe uZuma kuKhomishini yokuLawulwa kombuso yiDlanzana ngoLwesibili, kusicacele thina njengoBumbano ukuthi uyakudinga ukuthola ezokuphepha ezengeziwe kulezi anazo. Yingakho sicela kuMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa ukuba alubukisise lolu daba ngoba angeke sibe nokuthula uma kubakhona okwehlela uZuma,” kusho uHlatshwayo.Kule khomishini uZuma uveze ukuthi kuye kwafona umuntu ongaziwa kumsizi wakhe obhekene nezindaba zakhe ku-ANC esabisa ngokuthi bazobulala uZuma nomndeni wakhe kanye nommeli wakhe okungu-Advocate Muzi Sikhakhane.Lezi zinsolo uZuma abeziveza bezilandela nezinye azidalule ngoMsombuluko zokuthi kwakunetulo elaphekwa izinhlaka ezithile lokuba asocongwe emcimbini kaKhuzani owawungoMashi eMoses Mabhida Stadium.Inhlangano eyeseka uZuma, okuyi-Radical Economic Transformation (RET) nayo inanele ikhwelo loBumbano yathi ifuna uZuma avikelwe kuphinde kuqiniswe ezokuphepha kwakhe ngoba ayisathembi lutho.UMnuz Nkosentsha Shezi we-RET, uthe bashaqekile ngezinsongo ezidalulwe uZuma kwiKhomishini kaZondo.“Okwamanje asikalibhaleli ihhovisi likaMengameli nelikaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa ukuze bahlinzeke uZuma ngezokuphepha ezengeziwe kodwa sifuna avikelwe manje nomndeni wakhe ngoba basengozini. Empeleni sekuyacaca ukuthi kade uZuma abasengozini kodwa inkinga ukuthi abafisa ukumsoconga bayehluleka ukuthola ithuba elikahle,” kusho uShezi. Uthe uZuma ungubaba we-Radical Economic Transformation abafisa avikelwe ngakho konke ukuze aphephe.Le nhlangano yiyo eqashe amabhasi abethwele abantu abebesuka KwaZulu-Natal beyokweseka uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngesikhathi evela okokuqala ngoMsombuluko kwiKhomishini kaZondo. Okhulumela uMengameli, uNkk Khusela Diko, ucele ukuba athunyelelwe umyalezo ngalolu daba kodwa ugcine engaphendulanga kwaze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela.

SEKUPHINDE kwangena esinye isikhalo ngengqungquthela ye-IFP Youth Brigade okuwuphiko lwentsha yeNkatha ebihleli oLundi ngempelasonto. Iziko Imbabazane elibuye lizibize ngoMtshezi, kuthiwa seliphumele obala lithi kuningi okungahambanga kahle ngengqungquthela ekhethe uMnuz Mthokozisi Nxumalo kwesikaSihalo wophiko.UNobhala walo uNksz Nobuhle Ngubane unqabile ukuphawula ngencwadi okuthiwa ithunyelwe esigungwini esiphezulu seqembu . Akafunanga ngisho ukukhuluma ngesikhalo okuthiwa basifakile uvele wavala ucingo.Umthombo opotshozele leli phephandaba, uthe abaningi bayesaba ukuphumela obala ngoba kuba sengathi bavukela iqembu.Umthombo uthi isigungu esiphezulu siyitholile incwadi evela kuleli ziko.“Awu kuyaziwa nje ukuthi izinto zihamba kanjani eqenjini abantu bakhalaza emakhoneni ngoba abaningi bayesaba. Uvele uthathwe njengomuntu ongahloniphi odicilela phansi iqembu uma uveza izikhalo,” kusho umthombo.Elinye ilungu elingathandanga ukuveza igama lalo lithi kufanele kukhethwe kabusha kulungiswe wonke amaphutha enzeka engqungqutheleni.“Kwakungena noma wubani lapha engqungqutheleni nezigqebhezana zokungena zakhwabaniswa. Wake wayibonaphi ingqungquthela eyenzelwa etendeni ngoba akhona amahholo oLundi. Baningi kakhulu abantu abangagculisekile ngendlela okuqhutshwa ngayo izingqungquthela ze-IFP,” kuchaza ilungu elikhathazekile.Lesi sikhalazo selama eduze esinye esavela ngosuku lokusongwa kwengqungquthela lapho indoda eyazethula ngoNgcobo isibongo, yasukuma yaphikisa imiphumela. Le ndoda ize yazibophezela ngokuthi izolulandela lolu daba kuze kube sekugcineni. Akuqali ukuthi kube nomsindo njengoba kuke kwabangwa imiphumela yokhetho lobuholi besifundazwe KwaZulu-Natal. Owayehola umkhankaso wezikhalo uMnuz Simphiwe Zungu wamiswa eqenjini emuva kwezinsukwana nje ephumele obala ngokungenami kwakhe.Okhulumela iqembu uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa ukuqinisekisile ukuthi incwadi ifikile futhi iyacutshungulwa indaba yayo kodwa wathi ngeke iphindwe ingqungquthela.“Sikholwa wukuthi kwahamba kahle konke engqungqutheleni yeqembu. Siyafuna futhi ukuxwayisa amalungu ethu agijima aye kwabezindaba ukuthi lokhu akufuneki. Wudaba lwangaphakathi lolu kufanele iqembu linikwe ithuba lilulungise,” kusho uHlengwa.

USEMISIWE enhlanganweni uNobhala we-IFP ezikweni Enkululekweni, Osizweni, ngemuva kokuphumela obala wakhalaza mayelana nemiphumela yengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi obusha baKwaZulu-Natal ebisoNdini ngempelasonto. Isinqumo sokumisa uMnuz Siphiwe Zungu sithathwe isiyingi sasoSizweni ngoMsombuluko.UPhini likaNobhala wesiyingi sasoSizweni, uNkk Noxolo Nzuza, uthe lesi sinqumo basithathe emhlanganweni ophuthumayo abawubizile ngoMsombuluko ngemuva kokuzwa uZungu ekhuluma emsakazweni mayelana nengqungquthela nokuyilapho ephinde wangakhuluma kahle ngoMengameli weqembu Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.“Ngingakuqinisekisa ukuthi yithina esithathe isinqumo sokumumisa uZungu kuze kuba kuphutholwa uhlelo lokuqondiswa kwakhe ubugwegwe ngemuva kokuthi ekhulume ngezindaba zenhlangano kwabezindaba. Isinqumo sokumumisa sisidlulisele kwisigungu esiphezulu,” kusho uNkk Nzuza.UNkk Nzuza akazange athande ukwenaba kakhulu ngalolu daba, wacela ukuthi kuthintwe umkhulumeli weqembu uMnuz Mkhuleko Hlengwa. Imizamo yokuthola uHlengwa ayizange iphumelele. Ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa kanti nomyalezo athunyelelwe wona kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela engawuphendulile.Isolezwe linayo ikhophi yencwadi ebhalwe isiyingi sasoSizweni eqinisekisa ukumiswa kukaZungu enhlanganweni.Ethintwa uZungu izolo, uthe ayikho incwadi asayitholile evela esiyingini sabo ekhuluma ngokumumisa enhlanganweni.UZungu uthe isiyingi sasoSizweni asinawo amandla okumumisa enhlanganweni.“Abantu abanamandla okungimisa isigungu esiphezulu kuphela. Into engenziwa isiyingi ukungibizela emhlanganweni sixoxe,” kusho uZungu.UNobala-jikelele we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe ngokulawulwa uMthethosisekelo isiyingi sinawo amandla okuthatha izinqumo bese sibikele izinhlaka eziphezulu.“Okwamanje akukho ebesisakutholile okuvela esiyingini sasoSizweni, mhlawumbe basenza izinhlelo zokusibikela. Uma isinqumo besithathe izolo (ngoMsombuluko) asilindele ukuthi namhlanje (ngoLwesibili) ngabe sekukhona esikutholile,” kusho uHlabisa.UZungu ube sezindabeni ngemuva kokuphumela obala wakhalaza ngemiphumela yengqungquthela yeqembu nokulapho ebhalele ubuholi obuphezulu beqembu kubalwa noButhelezi, wacela ukuthi kwenziwe impinda yengqungquthela.Le ncwadi uyibhale emuva kokuthi amalungu eqembu anganeme wona aqome ukuzifihla ngoba esaba ukuhlukunyezwa ekhalaze kwabezindaba nokuyilapho esole khona uButhelezi ngokukhomba ngentshebe uMnuz Thami Ntuli ogcine ekhethwe njengoSihlalo omusha weqembu equmba phansi imbangi yakhe uMnuz Mbangiseni Yengwa.

KUSOLWA imbawula ngokusha kwemijondolo yaseClare Estate, eThekwini, ngoMgqibelo, kwasala dengwane abahlali abaningi. Kushaye isikhathi sokuloba singakatholakali isibalo semijondolo eshe ngoMgqibelo ebusuku kodwa abahlali bathi ingaphezu kuka-50 eshile. Kusolwa abanye abahlali okuthiwa bebezifudumeza ngembawula ngokusha kwemijondolo. Izolo ekuseni abanye abahlali abashelwe yimijondolo bese beqalile ukuyivusa njengoba abanye belale komakhelwane.UMnuz Nhlonipho Kweqela, ongomunye wabashelwe umjondolo, uthe ngenhlanhla akekho obephakathi ngesikhathi kusha. Uveze ukuthi bekungo-9 ebusuku ngesikhathi etshelwa ukuthi kuyasha endlini yakhe.“Kusize ukuthi bengisemsebenzini nomuntu engihlala naye esavakashile. Ngifike sekushe yonke impahla, ngasala nezingubo ebengizigqokile. Sisola ukuthi umlilo udalwe yimbawula ngoba kuthiwa kunabafana abebeyibasile bezifudumeza,” kusho yena.UKweqela uthe ukhoseliswe omakhelwane abangashelwanga ukuze akwazi ukulala ebusuku ngoMgqibelo. Ngesikhathi eshayelwa yiphephandaba izolo uthe usazoyozama enye indawo azofihla kuyo ikhanda.UNksz Thabisa esingatholakala isibongo sakhe, uthe ushelwe yizimpahla kulesi sigameko. Uthe emuva kokusha kuhambe ngisho ugesi njengoba kushe nezintambo zawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe bazwile ngesigameko sokusha kwemijondolo kodwa alikho icala elivuliwe.

KUMISWE ukufunda esikoleni, Ukusa High, eHammarsdale izolo ngemuva kokubulawa konogada ababili okusolwa ukuthi bashaywe bafa begadile ebusuku bangoLwesithathu esikoleni.Isidumbu sikaMnuz Mncedisi Ntuli (29) okuthiwa bekuwusuku lwakhe lokuqala esebenza esikoleni nesikazakwabo uMnuz Thandazani (46) zitholakale kwelinye lamakilasi esikole izolo ekuseni, uzakwabo wesithathu obesaphila uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela elimele kanzima.Kusolwa ukuthi abahlaseli bebefuna ukhiye wegumbi elihlala ama-laptop nezinye izimpahla ezibalulekile zesikole, ongahlali konogada.Ngokuthola kwaleli phephandaba ngomthombo ongaphakathi esikoleni, unogada ongena ekuseni ufike kukhiyiwe esangweni, wama ngaphandle kwaze kwafika uthishanhloko.“Uthishanhloko uthe unogada makangene ngaphakathi ayobheka ukuthi akukho yini lapho belele khona. Unogada ujombe uthango wangena ngaphakathi wabuya esethi ozakwabo ubafice belele edamini legazi akazi noma kukhona yini kubo osaphila. Uthishanhloko umlandele wangena naye baphuma sebeyofuna abosizo oluphuthumayo,” kusho umthombo.Uyise kaMncedisi, uMnuz Thembinkosi Ntuli, uthe nguye obegqugquzela indodana yakhe ukuthi ingahlali ekhaya isalinde ukuthi kulungiswe okuthile emaphepheni ayo ayigunyaza ukuthi ibe ngunogada ogcwele.“Emasontweni amathathu edlule ungitshele ukuthi uqashwe yinkampani egada ezikoleni, ugada ePhezulu High, bengingazi ukuthi usegada la, eKusa High,” kusho uNtuli.UMfowabo kaThandazani, uMnuz Muntu Majola, uthe akazange asole lutho umfowabo engabuyi emsebenzini ekuseni izolo ngoba kuyenzeka aqale ezindaweni zakhe ngaphambi kokugoduka.“Kuneminyaka egada kulesi sikole akakaze ahlaselwa yize engaphathi lutho oluyisikhali sokuzivikela,” kusho uMajola.UMnuz Mondli Dlamini ongomunye wabanikazi benkampani yonogada iMI Trading ebiqashe labo nogada, uthe sibethuse kakhulu lesi sigameko sokubulawa kwabantu ebebezinikele ekuvikeleni impahla yomphakathi.“Lo msebenzi siwenza ngoba sinothando lomphakathi, akukho nzuzo esiyenzayo yingakho siqasha abantu abangenawo amaphepha ngoba abanamaphepha bazofuna ukukhokhelwa imali esingenayo. Onogada bethu basuke bengahlomile babekelwe ukuthi bafone uma bebona okusolisayo,” kusho uDlamini.Usihlalo wesigungu esilawula isikole, uMnuz Aaron Cele, uthe badumele ngalesi sehlakalo, bebezitshela ukuthi ukuba khona komuntu ogadile esikoleni kuzokwenza izigilamkhuba zisabe ukungena.Unobhala weSadtu kulesi sifundazwe uMnuz Bheki Shandu uthe bahlale belugcizelela udaba lokuphepha ezikoleni emnyangweni, wathi ukubulawa kwalabo nogada kuveze ukuthi kumele ukugada kubhekwe ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani.UNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, obezifikele kulesi sikoleni uthe uphoxeke kakhulu. Uthe kukhomba ukuthi kumele kubuyiswe amakomiti emigwaqo ngoba onogada kabanele ukuthi bagade izikole.“Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezifunda emalokishini nasemakhaya ngeke zithuthuke, ngoba uma kufakwe izinsiza zokuthuthukisa izikole izigebengu ziyangena. Uma kungathiwa onogada abahlome nakhona bazoba sengcupheni yokuhlaselwa kufunwa izibhamu,” kusho uMshengu.Izolo abafundi baphindiselwe emakhaya, uMshengu uthe kuzoze kufundwe ngoMsombuluko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLt Col Thulani Zwane, uthe amaphoyisa athole onogada (29) noneminyaka ewu-46 beshonile ekilasini eceleni kwabo kwatholakala i-crowbar.

source: imibono uma sewazi ngeke ubulale umuntu okubize ngongeyikho
text: NGITHI angisike elijikayo ngodaba olushicilelwe kulo leli iphephandaba ngeledlule lapho kube nesehlo esibuhlungu sokuphuma komphefumulo ngenxa yokuthi kukhona obethukuthele ngokubizwa ngeShangane ngumufi, wabe esembhokoda ngomkhonto washona.Ngaphambi kokungena engqikithini yodaba kuzomele nginike umlando (omfishane) wakuleli lizwe nomonakalo owenziwa nguMbuso wamaBhunu ekudaleni ukucwasana phakathi kwabampisholo bebodwa.Inqubo yokucwasana yakwazi ukuthola impande igxile kwabampisholo isizwa izinhlaka zokubusa ezazaziwa ngokuthi oHulumeni beZabelo nalabo okwakuthiwa ngoZimele Geqe. Lapha ngingabala oHulumeni waKwaZulu, Qwaqwa, Lebowa, KwaNdebele, Gazankulu, KwaNgwane ababengoZibuse bese kuba owaseTranskei, Ciskei, Venda naseBophuthatswana ababengoZimele Geqe.Mina nodadewethu ababili uNomonde, noNonceba nomfowethu osadlula emhlabeni uJabulani sizalwa ngumama onguMxhosa intombi yeHlubi yakwaXaba nobaba wethu uBaloyi esikhule sazi ukuthi ungumShangane.Abazali bethu bahlangana eMgungundlovu behlanganiswa umsebenzi bashada, kwazalwa thina. Sikhule elokishini eSobantu sihlala nabantu abangaMaZulu, safunda isiZulu saze saphothula isikole.Yize umama nobaba bebehlale bezikhuluma izilimi zabo isiXhosa nesiShangane/Tsonga uma kuvakashe izihlobo zethu kodwa alikho nelinye ilanga lapho sazibona khona ukuthi singamaShangane kuqala andube sibe ngaMaZulu.Abazali bethu basikhulise ngendlela yokuthi sizibone siyizakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kuqala andube sizibone imvelaphi yethu engicabanga ukuthi yikho okwenza singazizwa sicwasekile ekukhuleni kwethu.Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi njalo ngeSonto odadewethu babethi uma bebuye esontweni bagqoke imvunulo yesiShangane, ebizwa ngokuthi umtsheko noma iShibhelani, banconywe uma behamba ngaphakathi elokishini abantu bencoma ubaba ngokuziqhenya kwakhe ngemvelaphi yakhe.Ekukhuleni kwami ngifunda ngizazi ukuthi ubuzwe bami ngiliShangane. Ngitholile ukuthi lapha kwelikaMthaniya uma umuntu ekhuluma ulimi olungelona olwesiNguni kuvele kuthiwe uliShangane.Kuhambe kwahamba leli gama lokubiza umuntu ngeShangane lathatha isimo sokuba yindelelo nokuthuka engicabanga ukuthi yiyo imbangela edala intukuthelo kwabanye uma bebizwa ngalo ngenxa yokungazi. Kwabanye bethu, ukubizwa ngento oyiyona akusiyo into esiyithatha ngokuthi yindelelo futhi asiqwashi ngisho ukuqwasha ngoba sivele sibone ukuthi labo abasho njalo yingoba bengazi lutho.Abanye uthi ungabatshela ukuthi unguMshangane usuyobona bekubuza izinto eziyimikhuba abezwa kuthi zezinzwa ngamaShangane, ezinye ezingelona iqiniso.Kukaningi uma ngitshela abesifazane ukuthi empeleni ngiyiShangane, uyobona sebehlisa amehlo ngaphansi kwenkaba yakho uma nimile, behleka becabanga ukuthi kukhona okuhlukile abazokubona ngoba kunemfundiso esabalele ukuthi amadoda angamaShangane anobuntu obukhulu ngokuhlukile kunawezinye izizwe kanti akunjalo.Ngize ngincokole ngithi sengize ngiyingwevu ekhanda angikaze ngisibone isihlahla somvongothi futhi angikhumbuli ubaba etshala enisela ngamanzi muthi thizeni ekhaya ekukhuleni kwethu ukuze kukhulise izitho zethu nomfowethu ongasekho.Kamumva kuhambe kwaba khona ukuzinyeza kulabo phambilini ababengenankinga yokubizwa ngamaShangane, baqala bathi abawona amaShangane kepha bangamaTsonga.Lokhu kwangicacela ngisebenza ePitioli. Babethi amaShangane yilaba abadabuka eMozambique nengcosana ehlala eMpumalanga, ikakhululazi eBushbuckridge lapho uthola izibongo ezifana noSithole, Nxumalo, Ndlovu noMhlongo kepha uma uthi uyabathakazela ngoJobe, Gatsheni, Njomane, Mkhatshwa bavele bathi akuzona izithakazelo zabo.Ngicabanga ukuthi into ebalulekile ukuthi abantu bafundiseke futhi bakujwayele ukuvakasha baphume emingceleni yesifundazwe noma izigodi zalapho behlala khona ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinto abazizwayo ngabantu bezizwe ezithize azilona iqiniso futhi uma sewazi ngeke unengeke ugcine usukhipha umphefumulo ngoba nakhu uthi ubizwe ngento ongayithathi ukuthi umuntu, isilwanyana ngoba lokho kobe kukhombise izinga elikhulu lokungazi.Lapha KwaZulu kunezibongo eziningi zabantu imvelaphi yabo eyobuShangane ezinye zazo okungoMaluleka nomaMaluleke, Masinga, Makwakwa oMathebula njalo njalo.UMbulelo Baloyi usebenzela uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal kepha lokhu okubhalwe ngenhla akuhlangene nomnyango noma nesikhundla sakhe kuhulumeni

ABAHLAZIYI bezombusazwe babona lisengcupheni yokuphelelwa yisithunzi nokuthenjwa ihhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi, u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane, (osesithombeni) emuva kokuchithwa kwakhe yinkantolo ekutheni kumele kusheshiswe izinyathelo azithathela uNgqongqoshe wezamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan ngodaba oluthinta ukusungulwa kophiko lwabaphenyi abangekho emthethweni kwa-SARS.Izolo inkantolo enkulu eNorth Gauteng inqume ukuthi kumele kumiswe konke okuthinta ukuthathelwa izinyathelo kukaGordhan kuze kuphume isinqumo senkantolo. U-Advocate Mkhwebane wayalela noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi athathele uGordhan izinyathelo zokumqondisa ubugwegwe. Wayalela nePhalamende ukuthi lithathele izinyathelo uGordhan.Umhlaziyi uMnuz Thabani Khumalo uthe umphakathi ngeke usakwazi ukuthemba ihhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi uma belokhu benza imibiko ekhahlelwa yizinkantolo.“Lisengozini yokuphelelwa yisithunzi ihhovisi lakhe kanti libaluleke kakhulu futhi lenza umsebenzi obucayi. Ukwenzeka kwamaphutha kuzokwenza abantu bengalithembi, uhulumeni ungalithembi nezinkantolo imbala ngeke zisalinaka,” kusho uKhumalo.UMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, ongummeli nongoti ogxile kwezokusebenza komthethosisekelo, uthe: “Okwakhe wukuthi ethule akutholile bese ekucacisa ukuthi nabanye basengenza olwabo uphenyo hhayi ukuthi abathathelwe izinyathelo.”USolwazi Karthy Govender, ungoti wezomthethosisekelo oke wasebenza enyuvesi yakwaZulu-Nata nakwiHuman Rights Commission, uthe: “Okubalulekile wukuthi akumele abantu basatshiswe ngokuphakamisa ukuthi kumele kwenziwe njani ngoba lokho kungadala ezinye izinkinga.”I-IFP ithe ikhathazekile ngokusebenza kwehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi njengoba echithwe yinkantolo. IPhalamende lithe ngeke limthathele zinyathelo uGordhan.I-EFF ithe izosidlulisa lesi sinqumo senkantolo.Ngeledule inkantolo yomthethosisekelo ichithe u-Advocate Mkhwebane owayekade edlulise isinqumo mayelana nodaba lwemali eyabolekwa yibhange i-Absa kwibhange lombuso yanquma ukuthi akhokhe yena ezinye zezindleko zabameli.Khonamanjalo, ngoLwesibili inkantolo enkulu eNorth Gauteng ikuhlehlisile ukulalelwa kwesicelo sikaRamaphosa sokuphikisa umbiko kaMkhwebane othinta izigidi zamarandi azithola ngesikhathi ekhankasela ukuba ngumengameli we-ANC.

INDODA ehlobisa amawashi ngobuhlau ithole ithuba lokuthi iyokhangisa ngawo embukisweni eLondon.Umbhali wezincwadi, uMnuz Lunga Ntuli, wakwaDukuza, umenywe ukuyokhangisa ngamawashi elebula yakhe ebizwa ngeLN Watches. Umenywe kwi-Africa Fashion Week London (AFWL) ngo-Agasti 9-10. Kulo mbukiso waminyaka yonke kuhlangana abakhangisi bengqephu bamazwe ahlukene bezokhombisa ngethalente labo. Umbukiso usuvulele osomabhizinisi abaningi emkhakheni wemfashini ithuba lokukhula kulo mkhakha.Ukumenywa kukaNtuli kuqhamuke emuva kokuba abohlaka lwezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali esifundazweni bebone umsebenzi wakhe. Umsebenzi wakhe bawubona kwezinye zezimakethe ezikhangisa ngomsebenzi esifundazweni.“Ngijabule kakhulu ukuthola ithuba ngoba bekuvele kuyiphupho lami ukuthi umsebenzi wami ufinyelele nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuya kwi-AFWL kuzosiza nokuthi ngazi kabanzi ngomkhakha wemfashini. Umbono omkhulu wukukhulisa ilebula yami, ngingagcini ngamawashi kuphela,” kusho uNtuli.UNtuli, owaqala ilebula ngo-2016, uke wenza nezikhwama kodwa kazihambanga ngendlela abefisa ngayo. Nokho usebona kuyithuba lokuthi abuyele nakuzona njengoba ekholwa wukuthi kuningi azokuthola kulo mbukiso.Uthe icebo lamawashi laqala ngoba uyathanda ukuqhakambisa okwesintu. Usebenzisana nabanye abesifazane abenza umsebenzi wezandla, asebenza nabo. Uzimisele ukwakha ubudlelwano nezitolo zaseLondon, athe ziningi ezidayisa izimpahla zase-Afrika.UNtuli, osebhale izincwadi ezine zothando, uthe ubuhlalu buyindlela yokuxoxa ngezothando. Uthe ubone ukuthi bukhona ubudlelwano phakathi kwezindaba zothando abhala ngazo nobuhlalu ngoba vele nasemandulo bekusetshenziswa bona uma kushelwa.Umbukiso waseLondon wasungulwa nguNkk Ronke Ademiluyi waseNigeria kodwa ozalelwe e-England. Wasungulwa ngo-2011 ukukhombisa ithalente labantu base-Afrika kwezemfashini nokuvulela amathuba abasiki bengqephu nosomabhizinisi base-Afrika kwamanye amazwe.Uphiko lwezohwebo nokutshalwa kwezimali KwaZulu-Natal lwasungulwa ukusiza izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika nosomabhizinisi abancane ukuthi bazidayise kwamanye amazwe. Luphinde lukhuthaze nokuthuthukiswa komnotho wesifundazwe nokuvulela amathuba osomabhizinisi besifundazwe.

IMEYA kaMasipala waseKurhuleni uMnuz Mzwandile Masina, ishaya phansi ngonyawo ukuthi ngeke yehle esikhundleni emuva kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo yethenda yamathoyilethi.UMasina obekhuluma nesiteshi somsakazo iSAfm izolo, uyazichitha izinsolo zethenda kaR1.9bn. UMasina usola ukuthi kunetulo lokumsusa esikhundleni. Uthe kunemiyalezo esabalele ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuthiwa kumele asule. Uveze ukuthi akukho okungahambanga kahle ngesikhathi kukhishwa le thenda. Uthe kwayona ithenda yakhishwa engakangeni esikhundeni ngo-Agasti 2016.“UMasipala wethu ungomunye wabenza kahle kakhulu ngokusebenza nokuyisa intuthuko emphakathini. Angisatshiswa wukuthi abantu bathini futhi ngeke ngisuke esikhundleni. Alikho iphutha elenzekile kodwa kwalandelwa yonke imigomo ngokukhishwa kwethenda,” kuchaza uMasina.Uthe uMasipala wakhe usukhiphe amathoyilethi angu-39 000 kubahlali basemjondolo, okuyisibalo esinyuke kakhulu sisuka ku-9 000 ngo-2014.Ecacisa esitatimendeni asifundele abezindaba esithangamini sangoLwesithathu eGermiston Civic Centre, uMasina uthe wuR872 osetshenziswe kwithenda yamathoyitheli. Uthe phezu kwenkampani eyayiqashelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ngo-2014, baphinde baqasha abanye osonkontileka abangu-16.Kwenzeka lokhu nje kumiswe uMnuz Joe Mojapelo obeyisikhulu esiphezulu kulo Masipala. Uthe uMojapelo umiswe emuva kombiko weSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), esolwa ngenkohlakalo. UMasina uthe uMojapelo kumele avele phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe, aziphendulele kulezi zinsolo zenkohlakalo. Ephawula ngalezi zinsolo uMajapelo, uthe imeya inephutha ngokuthi kunombiko omsola ngenkohlakalo. Ekhuluma emsakazweni uMojapelo uthe unobufakazi bokuthi awukho umbiko oshiwo yimeya.“Bengivele ngazi ukuthi awukho lo mbiko kodwa bekufanele ngenze ucwaningo ukuqinisekisa. Ngaxoshwa ngoMeyi 2 ngaphambi kokhetho, nakho engingeke ngiphawule kakhulu ngakho ngoba angiyena usopolitiki. Ngaxhumana neSIU ukubuza ngombiko ngathola ukuthi awukho. Ngiwumuntu wenkonzo, izindaba ezifana nalezi zicekela phansi isithunzi sami emphakathi,” kusho uMojapelo. Akacacisanga ukuthi uzovela yini ekomitini lokuqondiswa ubugwegwe njengokusho kwemeya.

KUZOSHUBA ezinkampanini eziphula umthetho wokusebenza konogada njengoba iPrivate Security Industry Regulatory Authority (Psira) isimise inkampani edume ngokukhipha abakhe ezindaweni ezingafanele, iRed Ants Security Relocation and Eviction Services.IPsira imise ukusebenza kweRed Ants emuva kwezikhalo zokuthi inesihluku uma yenza umsebenzi wayo futhi ayibaphathi kahle abantu esuke izobakhipha.IRed Ants idume kakhulu eGauteng kwazise muva nje iyona ebikhipha abantu abebakhe imijondolo endaweni engafanele e-Alexandra.Isikhulu esiphezulu sePsira, uMnuz Manabela Chauke sithe iRed Ants inikezwe ithuba lokuthi iziphendulele ngaphambi kokuthi imiswe.Uthe inalo ilungelo lokuphikisa isinqumo sokumiswa kwayo.“Zonke izinkampani zonogada zizoqashwa ngeso lokhozi, ukuthi ziwenza ngokufanele yini umsebenzi wazo. Uma kunezikhalo sizoziphenya, sibamise okufanele bamiswe. Banalo ilungelo lokuphikisa izinqumo zethu kodwa umsebenzi sizowuqapha,” kusho uChauke.Khonamanjalo inhlangano elwela amalungelo abantu, i-AfriForum ithe ayihambisani nomthetho ohlongozwayo wokuthi izinkampani zonogada zingabi nezibhamu ezinkulu ezizishintshayo.UMnuz Marnus Kamfer, obhekele ezomthetho nokuphepha komphakathi kwi-AfriForum uthe akazi ukuthi uhulumeni ufuna onogada bazivikele kanjani uma kuthiwa bangaziphathi izibhamu ezizishintshayo.“Siphakamisa ukuthi uhulumeni ayibuyekeze le mithetho. Siyitshelile nePsira ukuthi asineme ngokuthi kuzoncishiswa izibhamu ezinkulu ezizishintshayo.Bekungafanele uhulumeni achibiyele imithetho ethinta ukusebenza kwalezi zibhamu ngaphandle kokuxoxa nezinkampani zonogada. Uthi sizozivikela kanjani ezigebengwini eziphatha izinhlokohlela zezibhamu?” kusho uKamfer.
