text: AMASOSHA oMkhonto weSizwe Military Veterans Association (MKMVA) eGauteng azoqhubeka nemashi yawo ebhekiswe ekomkhulu le-ANC iLuthuli House yize kunohlangothi loMkhonto weSizwe National Council olungahambisani nayo.Izolo okhulumela iMKMVA kuzwelonke uMnuz Carl Niehaus, uthe imashi eGauteng izoqhubeka njengoba behlelile yize iMK National Council idonse amalungu ayo ngendlebe yathi akangamasheli eLuthuli House namhlanje.“Siyakuqinisekisa ukuthi uNobhala weMKMVA eGauteng uSolly Matebesi usazisile ukuthi bazomashela eLuthuli House ngokuthula banxenxe umbutho ukuthi usebenzise iziphakamiso ezenziwa engqungqutheleni ka-54 ye-ANC ikakhulukazi lezo ezithinta amasosha oMkhonto weSizwe nosizi abhekene nalo,” kusho uNiehaus.Uthe ubuholi obuphezulu beMKMVA busebenza kanzima ukusiza ababengamasosha oMkhonto weSizwe.UNiehaus uthe banelungelo lokubeka imibono yabo nelokumasha ngokuthula njengoba bezokwenza namhlanje.“Kuwubuwula ukuthi kuthiwe imashi yeMKMVA ifana nokuthi amaqabane avukela umbuso we-ANC. Imashi ikhombisa ukuthi amasosha oMkhonto weSizwe afuna ukubeka izikhalo zawo nokuthi kusebenze iziphakamiso ezathathwa engqungqutheleni. Singabantu abanokuthula futhi sifuna ubumbano yingakho nemashi yethu izoba nokuthula,” kusho uNiehaus.

KUHLENGEZELE izinyembezi endodaneni kasomabhizinisi waseNewcastle obulawe ngoMeyi ngesikhathi kuvela osolwa ngokumbulala nomngani wakhe okuthiwa ubanjwe eGoli yithimba eliyisipesheli likaNgqongqoshe uBheki Cele.UMnuz Philani Thwala (37) ubevele enkantolo yeMantshi yaseNewcastle izolo ngecala lokubulala uMnuz Martin Sithole owayeyilungu le-ANC nomngani wakhe uMnuz Buthanani Shange owayenguthishomkhulu, eNewcastle.UThwala kuthiwa ubanjwe eGermiston, eGoli, ngoLwesihlanu emva kophenyo lwethimba eliphenya amacala epolitiki.Ngesikhathi evela enkantolo ubefakwe ozankosi ezandleni ehlanganiswe nowesilisa osolwa ngokuthi wamdayisela izinhlamvu okunguMnuz Peter Mazibuko (51) kodwa yena inkantolo enqume ukungamshushisi ngoba kuthiwa akekho ohlwini lwamacala obekumele abe senkantolo izolo.UMnuz Sizwe Sithole, oyindodana kaSithole, uthe uphatheke kabi kwavuka umunyu ebona uThwala kodwa kwabuye kwagezeka inhliziyo ngokuboshwa kwakhe ngokushesha.“Nakuba ubaba engeke esavuka kodwa okusijabulisayo wukuthi amaphoyisa kaCele ayawenza umsebenzi. Sinethemba lokuthi ukuboshwa kwakhe kuzoveza owayemthumile,” kusho uSithole.Ezokuphepha beziqinile njengoba amaphoyisa abengaphezulu kuka-15 abeqaphe isimo kanti nenkantolo ibigcwele phama.Umndeni wakwaShange nawo ubuphume ngobuningi. Indodana yakhe, uMnuz Smele Shange, ithe: “Ubaba siyazi ukuthi wayengahlangene nalokhu futhi babengafuni yena ngakho sibheke ukuba sibone umthetho usebenza nokuyinto esithemba ukuthi sizoyibona uma kuqhubeka icala. Umsolwa besiqala ukumbona asimazi,” kusho uShange.UMnuz Senzo Khumalo we-ANCYL uthe asebekujahile ukuba kudalulwe owayethume uThwala ngoba bayazi ukuthi akavelanga wazisukela wazobulala.Umshushisi, uBranden Van Staden uthe icala likaThwala libucayi ngakho asikho isidingo sokuba anikezwe ibheyili.UThwala ucele iMantshi, uMnuz Karmlesh Gurlaal ukuba imnikeze isikhashana esingangesonto ukuze azitholele ummeli ozimele okhokhelwayo. Icala lihlehliselwe uJulayi 15.UThwala ubhekene namacala amabili okubulala, elokutholakala nezinhlamvu nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nelokubopha itulo lokubulala.

KULELI sonto uMkhandlu weTheku udalule ukuthi usuzosebenzisa abasebenzi bawo ukuqoqa udoti elokishini eMlaza, ungabe usasebenzisa izinkontileka njengoba bekwenzeka.UTHOKOZANI NDLOVU uxoxe noMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela, okhulumela umkhandlu ukuzwa ukuthi bazokwazi yini ukumelana nomsebenzi obuwenziwa osonkontileka abaningi ngabasebenzi babo kuphela. Nokuthi kuzokwenzekani ngabakhala ngokuphucwa iqatha emlonyeni.NGABE kuyiqiniso ukuthi umkhandlu usuzosebenzisa abasebenzi bawo kuphela ukuqoqa udoti? Uma kunjalo, kuzokwenzeka kanjani ngoba kubukeka umsebenzi umningi ngaphezu kwabo? Nizolwenzanjani ngodaba lwaMadelangokubona athi ngeke kwenzeke lokho?KUYIQINISO ukuthi sesizosebenzisa abasebenzi bomkhandlu kuphela. Kuzokwenzeka ngokuthi abasebenzi banikwe amashifu amabili ukuze bakwazi ukwenza wonke umsebenzi.Ngasohlangothini lwaMadelangokubona, zikhona izinhlelo umkhandlu onazo ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza nawo.NGABE ninabasebenzi abanele emkhandlwini ukwenza wonke lo msebenzi?ASINABO abasebenzi abenele kodwa sinezinhlelo zokuthi silande abasebenzi bomkhandlu kweminye iminyango abazoqala ishifu yabo yesibili uma sebeqede umsebenzi abawenzayo. Kukhona abazoqala ngo-12 emini kuze kube * -5 ntambama.KUVELE ukuthi kunemali ebisikhokhelwe osonkontileka abangawenzanga umsebenzi wokuqoqa udoti. Ngabe kuzokwenzekani ngaleyo mali njengoba umkhandlu usuvele ubakhokhele?NJENGAMANJE sesiqale isabelomali esisha. Imali abebekhokhelwe yona eyomsebenzi abebevele sebewenzile.NGABE nizongenela enkingeni yabasebenzi abangaphansi kosonkontileka ebenisebenzisana nabo abakhala ngokuthi abayitholanga imiholo yabo yezinyanga ezimbili sebesebenzile?KUMANJE lolo daba lucutshungulwa imenenja yomkhandlu futhi luzoxazululeka maduze.NGABE nizosibheka isiphakamiso sabo sokuthi nabo bafuna ukuba ngabasebenzi bomkhandlu ngokugcwele?EZINYANGENI ezimbili ezizayo umkhandlu uzobe usuwazi ukuthi bangaki abanye abasebenzi abadingekayo okumele bengezwe. Kuzokhishwa izikhangiso zomsebenzi futhi kuzolandelwa umthetho wokuqashwa kwabasebenzi.UMA kungukuthi ninabo abasebenzi abangakwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi bangaphakathi, kungani nisebenzise osonkontileka ekuqaleni?ASINABO abasebenzi abenele kodwa ukusebenzisa osonkontileka kwaba yisinqumo esathathwa ngo-2000. Lolu hlelo lokusebenzisa osonkontileka belusebenza kahle kuze kube * -2018.NGOKUQONDA kwami, kunesabelomali sosonkontileka ebesibekwe eceleni yonke le minyaka, ngabe sekuzokwenzekani manje ngaso?LESO sabelomali sizosetshenziswa kwezinye izidingo zomkhandlu zangaphakathi, ngokunjalo nemisebenzi ezobe ikhangiswa kuzobe kusetshenziswa sona.UMA sewuphetha ngabe sikhona isiqiniseko sokuthi abasebenzi bomkhandlu abazoqhubeka nomsebenzi wosonkontileka bazophepha uma sebeqoqa udoti emalokishini?SIZOKWENZA isiqiniseko sokuthi bazohamba namaphoyisa omkhandlu naweSAPS ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabo.Yize kunjalo kodwa asiyiboni nenkinga enkulu ngoba udaba losonkontileka silubhekile nalo ngeke basale ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zomkhandlu.

UMHLAZIYI wepolitiki uMnuz Xolani Dube weXubera Institute for Research, uthe ukusebenzisana komholi we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema nalowo owayenguNgqongqoshe wezokuVakasha uMnuz Derek Hanekom nePhini likaNobhala Jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila ukuze bakhiphe lowo owayenguMengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma kwaba wukungathembeki kwezinga eliphezulu.UDube uthe ukuvela kwalezi zinsolo kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi iSACP ayithembekile kumbimbi lwayo ne-ANC futhi ikulolu mbimbi ukufeza izinhloso zayo.“Babengakheli i-ANC yodwa uzungu kodwa babakhela nomengameli wezwe uzungu, kusobala ukuthi abekho kulolu mbimbi ngoba bengabaholi abaqotho kodwa bafuna ukufeza izinhloso zabo. Ngeke uthi bafuna ukulekelela i-ANC, kuyakhathaza lokhu abakwenzayo,” kusho uDube.Uthe kuyacaca ukuthi oMapaila noHanekom babengasebenzi bodwa kodwa babeholwa ngothile.Wathi kuzokhathaza uma kuwukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wayelwazi lolu daba ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi akayibhekelele i-ANC kodwa ubhekelele okunye.ISACP imvikelile uMapaila ithi wayethunyiwe ukuba ayimele ezinhlelweni zokukhipha uZuma.“I-SACP yayiwuseka umkhankaso wokususa umholi owayengazibhekeleli izidingo zabantu futhi ayizisoli ngalokho. Kwakuwumkhankaso osobala owawucacisa ukuthi idinga umholi ozonakekela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Siyakugxeka ukuthathwa kwalo mkhankaso sengathi kwakuyinto efihliwe noma uzungu lokuhlasela abathile ngoba konke kwakusobala,” kusho uMnuz Alex Mashilo okhulumela iSACP.Khonamanjalo, owayengungqongqoshe uHanekom uvumile ukuthi wahlangana nabaholi be-EFF ngesikhathi befuna ukukhipha uZuma.UHanekom ubephendula ezinsolweni ezenziwe wuMholi we-EFF uMalema othe uHanekom wasebenzisana ne-EFF wase wayinika uhlu lwamalungu e-ANC ayezovota namaqembu aphikisayo ukuze kukhishwe uZuma esikhundleni.Yize ekuvumile ukuhlangana nabe-EFF uHanekom ukuchithile ukuthi wanikeza i-EFF uhlu lwamalungu asePhalamende ayezovota ne-EFF.Uthe akufihliwe ukuthi wake wahlangana namalungu e-EFF ngesikhathi i-ANC ifuna ukukhipha uZuma esikhundleni.“Ngaphuza ikhofi noMnuz Godrich Gardee (onguNobhala-jikelele we-EFF) kabili eMugg and Bean ose-Eastgate. Mhlawumbe sahlangana kathathu futhi. Angikaze ngimnike uhlu lwamagama abantu be-ANC,” kusho uHanekom ebhalela iSABC ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

OWAYENGU Khomishina  kwaSouth African Revenue Services (Sars) uMnuz  Tom Moyane usekuqinisekisile ukuthi irogue unit beyikhona futhi isebenza, ummeli wakhe uthe uzimisele ngokufakaza ngalokhu akushoyo.Ummeli kaMoyane uEric Mabuza uthe uma engase inkantolo uMoyane ukuthi avele azofakaza ngakwaziyo, lokho angakwenza ngaphandle kwenkinga kwazise akekho ongaphikisana nomyalelo wenkantolo.“Angabethula ubufakazi uma inkantolo imyalela ukuthi enze njalo,” kusho uMabuza ekhuluma ngoMoyana ngesikhathi ebuzwa i-Independent Media ukuthi angakwazi yini ukukufungela lokhu akushoyo.Kodwa ummeli akakwazanga ukuphendula umbuzo wokuthi uMoyane ucabangani  ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uPravin Gordhan.Ngesonto eledlule lo mlisa owaxoshwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoNovemba wonyaka odlule uyena owavula icala evulela i-unit.Uthe ezinye izinto ezathengwa zisebenziselwa ukumpimpa, amakhamera, imishini yokuqopha, ukujenywa kwama cellular, okwakwenziwela ukuphazamisa ezokuxhumana phakathi kwama phone nama cellular..“Ngavula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa eBrooklyn ngoMeyi 2015, nabasebenzi ababili bafika nabo bavuma ukuthi bazokuba ngofakazi bahulumeni," kuchaza isitatimende esithunyelwe uMoyane.Okhulumela amaHawks uCaptain Llyod Ramovha uthe izolo bebesematasa bebheka izivumelwano bazokwazi ukuqinisekisa konke ngoLwesibili.

KUBOSHWE amaphoyisa amane nonogada abasolwa ngokuthumba abantu ababili babatalabha emgwaqweni uNanda ngaseSpringfield ngoLwesithathu ebusuku.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe ngoLwesithathu ebusuku ligamenxe ihora leshumi abagilwa ababili abaneminyaka ewu-28 no-36 bebehamba emgwaqweni uNanda ngesikhathi bethunjwa ngamadoda amahlanu abehamba ngemoto. Kuthiwa amadoda akhombe abagilwa ngesibhamu abaphoqa ukuthi bangene ebhuthini yemoto.Isitatimende samaphoyisa siveza ukuthi abagilwa bathathwe bayiswa kwenye indawo egcina amaloli emgwaqweni uPeters lapho amadoda efike afuna uR50 000 ngodli. Abagilwa bashaywe kanzima uma bethi kabanayo imali. Omunye ube esededelwa kwathiwa akayofuna imali.Odedeliwe ube esethinta amaphoyisa aseGreenwood Park wakwazi nokukhomba abasolwa. Amaphoyisa kuthiwa awavimbile amadoda ukuthi abaleke.UCapt Gwala uthe amaphoyisa awavimbile amadoda ase ekhomba lapho egcine khona omunye umgilwa.Bobabili abagilwa kuthiwa bebeshaywe kanzima. Baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa kuthiwa luveze ukuthi amadoda amathathu angamaphoyisa nelilodwa lesifazane asebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa eNanda. Owesihlanu kusolwa ukuthi ungunogada.UCapt Gwala uthe amaphoyisa athole iselula yomunye umgilwa kubo. Imoto yamaphoyisa okuthiwa isetshenzisiwe kulobu bugebengu kuthiwa itholwe ipakwe esiteshini samaphoyisa kanti enye imoto ebisetshenziswa ithathiwe ukuze kuphenywe.Bonke abasolwa abahlanu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-19 no-29 bazovela enkantolo yeMantshi eThekwini ngecala lokuthumba, ukukhomba ngesibhamu, ukweba iselula, ukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza nokuzama ukuqola imali.Ngokwesitatimende samaphoyisa ukuboshwa kwamaphoyisa azibandakanya nobugebengu ecashe ngokuba abantu bomthetho kuzoba yisexwayiso nakwamanye. Amaphoyisa aseqale uhlelo lwangaphakathi lokuqondisa amaphoyisa ubugwegwe. Isitatimende sithi amaphoyisa angaxoshwa noma ukuqulwa kwecala kungakaphothulwa enkantolo.Amaphoyisa ancome amalungu omphakathi ngokuwabikela ngokungaziphathi kahle kwamaphoyisa ase enxusa abantu ukuthi bawabike ukuze abhekane nengalo yomthetho.

BAGODUKE bengadlile izolo abafundi besikole samabanga aphansi KwaMakhutha, abafike kugqekezwe kwebiwa nokudla kwabo.Kuphoqeleke ukuthi basheshe bagoduke abafundi baseHabiyane Primary njengoba izigebengu zithathe konke ukudla abaphekelwa kona, kwebiwa nesitofu. Isolezwe lifike kulesi sikole izolo omama abaphekayo bezipholele ekhishini. Endlini okuhlala kuyo ukudla bekukhona ama-butternut ambalwa okuthiwa yiwona asale ngesikhathi kwebiwa. Kusolwa ukuthi izigebengu zingene ngopotsho maqede zabhoboza uphahla ekhishini.UMnuz Lucky Mbhele ongumzali futhi ongunogada wesikole, uthe ngoMgqibelo wayezongena esikoleni ngezithuba zabo-7 ngesikhathi eficana nomunye wabasolwa.“Ngamfica ekilasini lakwaGrade 7, ngamkhiyela ngaphakathi ngayobiza amaphoyisa. Nguyena ogcine esitshela ukuthi izimpahla zidayiswe kuphi njengoba ethe isitofu sidayiswe ngoR400, kwebiwa nezigubhu zikagesi,” kuchaza uMbhele.UMbhele othe ugada emini kuphela, uthe kukaningi begqekezelwa ngoba isango alikhiywa futhi kunopotsho abaningi. Uthe sekwakhishwa ngisho izinsimbi zasemawindini nasezicabheni. Oyilungu lesigungu esilawula isikole, uNkk Thulisile Mthembu, uthe inselelo enkulu ukuthi abanaye unogada okhokhelwa umnyango. Uthe uMbhele akakwazi ukwenza kahle umsebenzi ngokugcwele ngoba uhlanganiselwa ngabazali imali, abuye angakhokheleki kahle.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uCaptain Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuboshwe umsolwa oneminyaka engu-30, ovele eNkantolo yeMantshi eMbumbulu izolo.Iphephandaba livakashele naseMasuku Primary eFolweni lapho kwadutshulwa khona uthisha emagcekeni esikole ngaphambi kokuvalwa kwezikole ngenyanga edlule. UMnuz Siboniso Nyawose wadutshulwa efika esikoleni ekuseni, uMnyango wezeMfundo wathembisa ukuqinisa ezokuphepha. Omunye uthisha ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe abazange baphazamiseke izolo yize besasaba. Uthe amaphoyisa afikile ukuzohlola isimo ekuseni. Esangweni bekukhona onogada ababili okuthiwa bashintshana nabanye ababili abangena ebusuku.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe abezindaba uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo eKZN uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu, uthe konke kuhambe kahle ngosuku lokuqala lokuvulwa kwezikole. Ungqongqoshe ugasele kungazelewe eMyezaneni High eMgungundlovu ukuyobheka ukuthi kuyafundwa ngosuku lokuqala. Lesi sikole kuke kwabikwa ngaso kuthiwa sinabafundi abasebenzisa izidakamizwa futhi abangakuhloniphi ukungena ngesikhathi. UMshengu uvakashele naseDabulamanzi Combined eMgungundlovu. Kuhlelwa ukuthi lesi sikole sigxile kwezolimo.

source: i ifp ibhekene ngeziqu ne da
text: I-IFP isibize umhlangano ophuthumayo ne-DA ukuze inqande ingozi yokulahlekelwa uMasipala wasebaQulusini nabanye KwaZulu-Natal njengoba bubamuncu ubudlelwane babo.Lokhu kulandela ukuthi umholi weDemocratic Alliance KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango ebhalelwe incwadi iFederal Executive (FedEx) okuyisigungu esiphezulu seqembu imfaka ingcindezi ukuba acacise ngekusasa abanalo ne-IFP njengoba beyisola ngokubadayisa eGauteng nangokwamukela isikhundla seScopa kuzwelonke nesekomiti likaNdunankulu eSishayamthetho saseGoli.USihlalo kazwelonke we-IFP, uMnuz Blessed Gwala uthe lo mhlangano owokuqinisa ubudlelwane abanabo.“Empeleni lo mhlangano okufanele uhlale kuleli sonto kuzoba owokuqinisa ubudlelwane esinabo ne-DA. Ngifisa nokuthi kucace ukuthi azikho izinkinga esinazo ne-DA njengoba senibeka kanjalo,” kusho uGwala.Ukusho lokhu nje amakhansela e-IFP eBaqulusini anovalo lokuthi uma sekuvotwa kukhethwa imeya entsha, ezovala isikhala sikaMnuz Jerry Sibiya kungenzeka i-DA ivote ne-ANC .Abanye bese bephakamise nokuthi kuqhubeke uMnuz Mncedisi Maphisa abambe kuze kufike u-2021.Nokho ubuholi be-IFP bona buhlela ukufaka uMnuz Mpiyakhe Hlatshwayo oke waba yimeya ye-IFP eDumbe ,waphinde waba eye-NFP eZululand.UGwala uthe izokhethwa imeya kodwa basalungisa amagama kwikhomishini ezimele yokhetho. Uthe uHlatshwayo uzofungiswa njengekhansela labo kungekudala.UMnuz Zwakele Mncwango we-DA uthe lo mhlangano awukwazi ukubakhona ngoba yena akekho kuleli sonto.“Ngaphandle kwalokho mina njengomholi we-DA angiyazi indaba yokuthi ayisekho imeya ebaQulusini. I-IFP ayikaze ingazise ngakho amakhansela ami angavota kanjani engenawo umyalelo azobe ewuthola kimi ekubeni nami ngingabikelwe lutho,” kusho uMncwango.Uthe angeke aphawule indaba ethinta ubudlelwane babo nencwadi ayibhalelwe iFedEx.

ABALANDELI beMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, bathi kabahambisani nokuthi umholi wabo aqhubeke nokuhlala ekhaya ibe ikhefu abenikwe lona lenyanga yi-ANC seliphelile.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli, izolo utshele abezindaba ukuthi uNkk Gumede, iMeya yaseNewcastle, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, nekhansela laseThekwini, uMnuz Mondli Mthembu, bazoqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya kuze kube bathatha isinqumo ngabo okulindeleke ukuthi basikhiphe esontweni lokuqala ku-Agasti.“Ubuholi besifundazwe bathatha isinqumo sokuthi iMeya yaseThekwini, eyaseNewcastle nekhansela uMthembu ukuba baye ekhefini lenyanga. Lesi sinqumo sisamile ngoba isinqumo ngekusasa labo besingakasithathi. Silindele ukuthi sisikhiphe esontweni lokuqala ku-Agasti emuva kokuthola umbiko esizobe siwunikwe yisigungu esibhekelele ukusebenza kwesifundazwe,” kusho uNtuli.Uthe balindele ukuthi amaqabane ahloniphe isinqumo esathathwa wubuholi besifundazwe ngokuthi angabuyeli emsebenzini.UNtuli uthe bakhathazekile ngokungabi khona kozinzo eMkhandlwini weTheku osekuholele ekutheni babe nemihlangano namagatsha enhlangano nemibutho yeqembu, okubalwa kuyo nowabesifazane.Okhulumela abalandeli baNkk Gumede, uMnuz Mzo Dube, uthe bona abakaze bahambisane nesinqumo sokuthi imeya inikwe ikhefu.“Esikushoyo manje wukuthi njengoba isikhathi sekhefu sesiphelile silindele ukuthi imeya ibuyele emsebenzini iqhubeke nomsebenzi wayo ngoba kwasekuqaleni kwaba yiphutha ukuba kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi inikwe ikhefu ngoba awukwazi ukuthatha isinqumo ngohlelo ongazi ukuthi luzophetha kanjani,” kusho uDube.Uthe isinqumo sekhefu lenyanga kwaba yisinqumo sepolitiki.“Isicelo sokuhlaba ikhefu sifakwa emsebenzini. Umasipala wuhlaka oluzimele ngakho kasiluqondi uhlelo lwakhona ukuthi luhamba kanjani uma kuphoqeka ukuthi uqhubeke nekhefu,” kusho uDube.Amanye amakhansela asondelene noNkk Gumede kodwa angagunyaziwe ukuthi akhulume nabezindaba acele ukuthi angadalulwa athe amagatsha awaneme ngokuthi imeya kusamele iqhubeke nokuhlala ekhaya.“Adiniwe amaqabane, asazi ngempela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani,” kusho ikhansela.Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede siye koshicilela izolo kulindeleke ukuthi babe nomkhuleko wokuzila.UDube uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhuleko wabo njengoba behlelile.Elinye ikhansela le-ANC lithe bekuhlelwe ukuthi kuphume amabhasi amabili kwi-zone ngayinye kuma-zone awu-17, eThekwini.Abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede bathe abakwamukeli ukuthi aqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya.UNkk Gumede ungaphandle ngebheyili kaR50 000, emuva kokuboshwa mayelana namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti eThekwini.

source: basola abathile kwi anc ngokugxambukela kwezetheku
text: ABAHOLI balabo abeseka iMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku, uNkk Zandile Gumede, basola abaholi abathile kwi-ANC ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zaseThekwini ngenhloso yokufeza izinhloso zabo zezombusazwe.Esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini izolo, okhulumela abeseka uNkk Gumede, uMnuz Mzomuhle Dube usole uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, uMnuz Mdumiseni Ntuli noNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele ngokufaka unyawo lwedada eThekwini.“UNtuli uyagxambukela eThekwini, lokho akusithusi ngoba vele umfowabo uMnuz Bheki Ntuli obenguNobhala eThekwini ukhona embangweni wezikhundla njengoba kuyiwa engqungqutheleni yesifunda, esinye isizathu esenza angabi qotho odabeni lwaseThekwini wukuthi uNkk Gumede wayehola ithimba laseThekwini elaliphikisana nokuthi akhethwe njengoNobhala wesifundazwe,” kusho uDube.Uthe kwabathusa futhi ukuthi ngesikhathi beboshiwe ngeledlule esiteshini samaphoyisa eDurban Central ngemuva kombhikisho, bezwa elinye iphoyisa lithi uthe uCele ufuna inombolo yecala.Omunye wabakhulumela abeseka uNkk Gumede, uMnuz Sduduzo Magwaza uthe uNobhala we-ANC esifundazweni, nomfowabo obenguNobhala waseThekwini baba nomhlangano nemenenja yoMkhandlu weTheku, uMnuz Sipho Nzuza kwathathwa isinqumo sokuthi kwelulwe inkontileka yezinkampani ezine ezithinteka ecaleni mayelana nethenda kadoti okuboshwe ngayo uNkk Gumede, kusetshenziswa isigaba somthetho uSection 36, lapho inkampani inikwa umsebenzi ngaphandle kokulandelwa kwemigudu yokukhishwa kwamathenda.Ukwelulwa kwethenda yokuqoqwa kukadoti kumenyezelwe emhlanganweni wamakhansela alawula umasipala ngoJuni 18, iMeya isinikwe ikhefu lenyanga.Omunye wabeseka imeya, uMnuz Ntando Khuzwayo, uthe: “Singabaholi thina emagatsheni nakuma-zone e-ANC konke lokhu esikwenzayo sikwenza ngoba singahambisani nendlela okusingathwe ngayo udaba lwemeya nekhansela uMondli Mthembu ngoba sikholwa wukuthi ubulungiswa abuzange benziwe, asikwenzi lokhu ngoba kuyiMeya singakwenza kunoma iliphi iqabane uma sibona ukuthi kudlalwa ngalo.”UDube uthe: “Sesibhalele ubuholi bukazwelonke ukuba bungenele, uma singaneme ngokungenela kwabo sizophoqeleka ukuthi siye enkantolo.”Okunye okuvelile wukuthi abeseka uNkk Gumede ngeledlule bavale amahhovisi esifunda eCommercial City ngoba bengahambisani nokuqokwa kwethimba lesikhashana okuthiwa kumele lilungiselele ingqungquthela.Okhulumela uCele, uNksz Reneilwe Serero, uthe uCele akahlangani nophenyo lwaphoyisa. UNtuli akatholakalanga.

UMVIKELI woMphakathi u-Advocate Busisiwe Mkhwebane uthe bazohlangana enkantolo noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngodaba lomnikelo awuthola enkampanini iBosasa njengoba elwenze ngendlela uphenyo lwakhe.Usho lokhu nje kulandela isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuthi uzoya enkantolo eyophikisana nombiko ka-Advocate Mkhwebane lapho ethe wakhohlisa iPhalamende ngodaba lwalo mnikelo kaR500 000 wokuxhasa umkhankaso wakhe wokuba nguMengameli we-ANC ngo-2017.“Nginabo bonke ubufakazi ngalolu daba sizoveza yonke into enkantolo. Udaba ngiludlulisele ophikweni lwezokushushisa ukuze kube yilona oluzophenya udaba lwalo mnikelo nokuthi kwabakhona ukushushumbiswa kwemali,” kusho u-Advocate Mkhwebane.Usole uRamaphosa ngokuthi washesha ukuphendula umbuzo weDA ngalolu daba ePhalamende engenalo ulwazi olugcwele.“Kwakumele alinde aze athole umbiko ogcwele, angasheshi aphendule. Kwakungewona umbuzo wokuqala kodwa kwakuwumbuzo olandelayo yingakho sasingekho isidingo sokuthi asheshe aphendule,” kusho u -Advocate Mkhwebane. Uthe uze waphenya udaba lwalo mnikelo ngoba kwafakwa isikhalazo yiDA.“Uma nabanye ababengenele umbango wokuhola i-ANC kuthiwa asibaphenye ngiyokwenza nalokho. URamaphosa ngimphenye ngoba kufakwe isikhalazo abanye asikaze sifakwe isikhalazo ngabo,” kusho uAdv Mkhwebane.Ukuchithile ukuthi ungumuntu kalowo owayenguMengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma ngoba nguyena owasayina incwadi yokumqasha.“UZuma waqoka uMengameli wamaJaji, owayenguMvikeli woMphakathi u-Advocate Thuli Madonsela waqokwa nguZuma ngakho ungathi bonke labo abantu baZuma? Mina ngaphakanyiswa iPhalamende emuva kokufakwa imibuzo nabanye ababegaqele lesi sikhundla kubuka wonke umuntu wakuleli,” kusho yena.Khonamanjalo, iDA ifuna iPhalamende lisheshise uhlelo lokukhipha esikhundleni u-Advocate Mkhwebane emuva kokuba iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo imchithile yathi waqamba amanga odabeni oluthinta uphenyo lweBhange loMbuso.Inkantolo enkulu yachitha isinqumo sakhe sokuthi ibhange i-Absa kumele libuyise uR1.1 billion kwibhange lombuso ngoba latakulwa leli bhange ngesikhathi sobandlululo.Lokhu kusho ukuthi angazithola esekhokha imali ecela kuR900 000 ephaketheni lakhe wezindleko zecala.Inkantolo ithole ukuthi akazange ahambise ngendlela uma enza uphenyo futhi waqamba amanga, wangalandela imigomo yehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi.

UMENGAMELI we-EFF uMnuz Julius Malema uthi bazolwa kuze kufike ekugcineni beseka uMvikeli woMphakathi * -Adv Busisiswe Mkhwebane njengoba esempini yomthetho noNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni uMnuz Pravin Gordhan.Ekhuluma nabalandeli beqembu lakhe ngaphandle kwaseNkantolo eNkulu yasePitoli izolo, ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo isigodlile isinqumo sayo odabeni luka-Adv Mkhwebane noGordhan, uMalema uthe uma inkantolo ephakeme ikhipha isinqumo esingahambisani nabo ngeke baze bangabaze ukuyisa lolu daba eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo.“Sizimisele ngisho ukukhokhela zonke izindleko zaleli cala, lokhu esikwenzayo akukho mayelana noMkhwebane kodwa sivikela isithunzi sehhovisi lakhe,” kusho uMalema.Uthe bazimisele ukulwa nohulumeni.“UGordhan kumele azi ukuthi asimsabi futhi ngeke aze asisabise,” kusho uMalema.UMalema uthe akekho noyedwa umuntu ongaya kwiKhomishini athi uMalema uthinteka kwinkohlakalo emabhizinisini kahulumeni. “Bangakusho lokho kuphela uma bekhuluma emgwaqweni,” kusho uMalema.Abantu abacabanga kancane bayasisola ngokuthi asizazi ukuthi sifunani ngoba phambilini besimgxeka uMvikeli woMphakathi.“Amacala awafani, odabeni lwakhe ne-Absa samtshela ukuthi uzimele kodwa kuleli sinaye,” kusho uMalema.Omunye wabameli ka-Adv Mkhwebane, * -Adv Thabani Masuku izolo ugxeke uGordhan ngokudelela ammele ngemuva kokukhipha umbiko wakhe mayelana nophiko lwezingede lwakwaSars.UMasuku uthe inkulumo kaGordhan ethi * -Adv Mkhwebane umqambimanga osabalalisa izindaba ezingekho, kuphambene nomsebenzi wakhe wokuvikela izinhlaka zikahulumeni ezaziwa ngokuthi ngamaChapter 9 Institutions.

source: imibono asingabi amadoda ngemikhaba nezimpandla kuphela bakwethu
text: MHLELI: Ngingathokoza uma ungangipha isiqeshana kwelakho kuyinyanga yamadoda nami ngiveze umbono wami noma ulwazi ngendoda ukuthi iyini.Okokuqala indoda iyanakekela inothando. Indoda yilo muntu ozobeka umndeni wakhe phambili, yilo muntu ozothanda umkakhe noma lo athandana naye nezingane. Indoda iyahlonipheka konke ekwenzayo emphakathini akuhlambalazi. Indoda ayigqoki izicathulo ishintshe amapheya angafani ekubeni izingane ekhaya zifunda zingenazicathulo kwezinye izicathulo zitshekile izimpahla zigugile, ifunwa imali yesondlo sezingane ngenkani, cha akuyona indoda leyo wumfana nje osakhula.Asingabi ngamadoda ngemikhaba, izimpandla nezintshebe kepha emindenini siyasatshwa ngoba siphenduka izilwane. Izwe lidunguzela kanjena nje yingoba sekukhona abantu abathi bangamadoda ngoba bangolizwi aliphikiswa yingakho kunje, yingakho sesikwazi ukulala nabantwana bethu, yingakho sesikwazi ukushaya abazali bethu sibabulale, sihlukumeza esithi siyabathanda. OWAYENGUMENGAMELI wakuleli uMnuz Jacob Zuma uthi ugqigqa izinkantolo nje futhi usevela kwikhomishini kaZondo yingenxa yetulo elidala lokuthi asuswe ebuholini kuhulumeni.UZuma udalule lokhu ngoMsombuluko ngesikhathi eqala ukufakaza kwikhomishi ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Ngesikhathi eqala ukufakaza uZuma, ummeli wakhe u-Adv Muzi Sikhakhane uqale wacacisa ngokubhalela kwakhe ikhomishini eyicela ukuthi imthumelele imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi avele. USikhakhane uveze ukuthi akukho kuhle ukuthi kule khomishini kunabantu asebebukwa njengamaqhawe abanye babukwa njengabasolwa ekubeni yasungulelwa ukuthi ithole iqiniso ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana.Eseqala ukufakaza uZuma uqale ngokundlalela umlando ngokuhlaselwa kwakhe athi kwaqala ngonyaka ka-1990 lapho athola khona umbiko wokuthi kunabahlela ukuthi lidicilelwe phansi igama lakhe ngaphambi kwengqungquthela ye-ANC. Uthe ngemuva kokwenza uphenyo lwakhe wathola ukuthi ababefuna ukumhlasela babehlongoza ukwenza lokhu ngoba ‘wayazi lukhulu’ uZuma ngohulumeni wobandlululo. Uthe lokhu kwakuhlelwa izinhlangano ezizimele, eyodwa yakuleli nenye yaphesheya.UZuma uthe lezi zinhlangano zabona ukuthi uyathandwa kwi-ANC, yabe sezihlela ukubhekana naye ngenye indlela. Uthi ngemuva kwenkomfa ye-ANC wasuswa njengenhloko yezobunhloli. Uthi ngenxa yendlela izinto ezenzeka ngayo esuswa kwenza babona ukuthi kunezimpimpi kwi-ANC.UZuma uthe nalabo abahlongoza ukuthi kube khona le khomishini basaqhubeka nemizamo yokulwa nesithunzi sakhe. UZuma uthe ngo-2005 wasuswa njengephini likaMengameli we-ANC ngoba wayesolwa ecaleni lokuthengwa kwezikhali (arms deal). Uthe bonke abanye amagama abo ayevela abakaze baphenywe futhi abakaze basuswe ezikhundleni zabo kwi-ANC. Ngaleso sikhathi uZuma wayephenywa ama-Scorpions.UZuma uthi ngesikhathi eqala ukwaziswa ngalolu daba watshelwa ukuthi alikho icala abekwa lona, uSchabir Schaik nje owafaka igama lakhe kwisitatimende sakhe kodwa kuphelela lapho. Ngemuva kwesonto uZuma uthi waziswa ukuthi empeleni akhona amacala azobekwa wona kodwa anganyamalala uma angase ahoxe esikhundleni sokuba yiPhini likaMengameli.UZuma uthi wathenjiswa uR20 million, kwathiwa akahambe eyohlala eNkandla uzonakekelwa futhi anyamalale namacala ayesolwa ngawo. Uthi kwamuxaka lokhu ngoba wayekade aziswe ukuthi alikho icala azobekwa lona ngokuthengwa kwezikhali.Ngo-2005 uZuma wasuswa njengePhini likaMengali Thabo Mbheki. Uthe uZuma wakwamukela lokhu.Ngemuva kwenkomfa yango-2007, uZuma wabekwa njengomholi omusha we-ANC athi kwenzeka ngaphezu kwetulo lokuthi aboshwe. UZuma uthe ngemuva kwalokho kwabekwa uSchabir Shaik icala eyedwa ukuze uma etholwa enecala, kubekwe yena icala kwazise babesolwa bobabili ngenkohlakalo odabeni lokuthengwa kwezikhali. Ngemuva kwesinqumo sejaji esathola uSchabir Shaik enecala, kwaba nemibiko yokuthi iJaji lathi kunomkhonyovu ohlanganisa uShaik noZuma. UZuma uthe indlela lokhu okwakushiwo ngayo osopolitiki nabamaphephandaba, kwaze kwenza iJaji laphumela obala lasho ukuthi alikaze likusho lokho.UZuma uthi konke lokhu kubeka ngokusobala ukuthi kunezihlangano ezicashile ezilwa nesithunzi sakhe emphakathini futhi ezimufuna engekho ebuholini kuhulumeni ngoba zisabela ukuthi angase aphumele obala ngezimfihlo azaziyo.“Nizokhumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi ngakha umuzi wami eNkandla, kwaba nomsindo ngenkohlakalo. Nizokhumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi kubikwa abezindaba babesho isamba semali eyasetshenziswa kwakhiwa umuzi wami. Kwaphenya iminyango emibili kahulumeni emzini wami, yangathola lutho. Kweza ngisho owayenguMvikeli Womphakathi, wangathola lutho,” kusho uZuma.UZuma uphinde walwa nokubizwa kwale khomishini ngekhomishini ephenya ngokulawulwa kombuso yidlanzana. Uthe leli temu liyihaba ngoba akuzona zonke izinhlaka zombuso ezibhekene nenkohlakalo.

ILUNGU leDA esiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal uNksz Mbali Ntuli liphakamisa ukuthi ahlolisiswe amaloli ukuthi asesimeni sokuba semgwaqweni emuva kokusinda engozini yemoto ngempelasonto.UNksz Ntuli usinde ngokulambisa ngesikhathi imoto yakhe ishayiswa yiloli kuN3 ngaseMariannhill Toll Plaza yona yabe isishayisa ezinye izimoto kubalwa eyamaphoyisa neyelungu lePhalamende le-ANC uMnuz Enoch Mthethwa.Abashayeli bezimoto ezintathu ezishayiswe ekaNksz Ntuli kubikwa ukuthi basesibhedlela namanje lapho belashwa khona emva kwengozi.Engxoxweni neSolezwe izolo, uNksz Ntuli uthe usakhungathekile namanje emva kwengozi.“Ngibonga uMdali ngokuthi ngisindile. Leli loli lingene ngemuva emotweni yami layiphusha yabe isiyaphenduka yashayisa ezinye izimoto zabantu kubalwa neyelungu lePhalamende likazwelonke. Iloli liphinde lashayisa nangasesicabheni sami ngesikhathi imoto iphenduka,” kuchaza uNksz Ntuli.Uthe leli loli elimshayisile belihamba emzileni ohamba izimoto ezigijimayo.“Kwakona ukuthi leli loli belihamba emzileni wezimoto ezigijimayo, akukho emthethweni yingakho nje ligcine selenza ingozi ecishe yabulala inqwaba yabantu,” kusho uNksz Ntuli.Uthe uyafisa ukuthi amaloli ahlolisiswe kahle ukuthi asesimeni esikahle ngaphambi kokuthi angene emgwaqweni.“Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele kwenziwe uphenyo olunzulu ngale ngozi ngoba kuyaqapheleka ukuthi izingozi eziningi ikakhulukazi kuN3 zidalwa ngamaloli asuke ephelelwe ngamabhuleki,” kusho uNksz Ntuli.Uthe amaphoyisa ayithathile iloli emuva kwesigameko.UMthethwa we-ANC naye imoto yakhe elimele kulengozi uthe empeleni bayisikhombisa abantu abathintekayo kulesi sehlakalo.“Umshayeli weloli uvumile endaweni yesehlakalo ukuthi iloli lakhe liphelelwe ngamabhuleki,” kusho uMthethwa.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLt Clonel Thulani Zwane, uthe kuvulwe icala lokushayela budedengu esiteshini samaphoyisa eHillcrest emva kwengozi eyenzeke kuN3, ngoLwesihlanu.

OKLEBE bathi bayazi ngezinsolo zokuphulwa kwemibandela yebheyili yiMeya yoMkhandlu weTheku uNkk Zandile Gumede emisiwe emsebenzini emva kokuboshwa mayelana namacala enkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa athinta ithenda yezigidi yokuqoqwa kukadoti eThekwini.Okhulumela oKlebe, uBrigadier Hangwani Mulaudzi izolo uthe zikhona izikhalo abazitholile mayelana nokuthi uNkk Gumede uphule eminye yemibandela yakhe yebheyili.“Siyazi ngezikhalo zokuthi iMeya yaseThekwini iphule eminye imibandela yebheyili, ithimba labaphenyi noPhiko lwezokuShushisa kumele baxhumane babikele iMantshi ngalezi zinsolo bese kuba iyona enqumayo ukuthi kuzokwenzekani,” kusho uMaluadzi.Omunye wemibandela yebheyili kaNkk Gumede owawubukeka umnqinda amandla, ilowo owawuthi kumele ame ukuqhuba izinhlelo zikamasipala.UNkk Gumede unikwe ikhefu lezinsuku ezingu-30 yi-ANC ngemuva kokuboshwa mayelana nethenda yokuqoqwa kukadoti.Izolo uNkk Gumede bekulindeleke ukuthi abuyele emsebenzini njengoba ikhefu anikwe lona lenyanga seliphelile.I-ANC izolo bekulindeleke ukuthi yenze isimemezelo mayelana nekusasa lakhe kodwa lize lashona ilanga singekho isimemezelo esenziwayo.Ethintwe uMkhulumeli we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nomagugu Simelane-Zulu ophinde abe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo esifundazweni, akazange atholakale, ucingo lwakhe lubanjwe ngumkhulumeli wakhe uNkk Thando Nkosi othe bazokwaziswa abezindaba uma sekukhona isinqumo esithathiwe.I-ANC kulindeleke ukuthi imemezele ngekusasa likaNkk Gumede namhlanje.Izolo i-ANC ibibambe umhlangano lapho kade ibhunga khona ngalolu daba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abalandeli bakaNkk Gumede bahlela ukuthi namhlanje babambe umlindelo bese kuthi kusasa ngoLwesine bayamthatha bamyisa eCity Hall.Okhulumela uMkhandlu weTheku, uMnuz Msawakhe Mayisela, uthe ngeke bakwazi ukuphawula mayelana nodaba lweMeya wacela ukuthi kuthintwe i-ANC esifundazweni.“Siyabanxusa abezindaba ukuthi banikeze ubuholi be-ANC esifundazweni isikhathi sokuthi busebenze lolu daba kodwa mina engingakusho ngasohlangothini lukamasipala, umsebenzi uyaqhubeka siholwa yimenenja yomkhandlu uMnuz Sipho Nzuza nePhini leMeya uNkk Fawzia Peer okuyilo eliyiNhloko yezepolitiki okwamanje,” kusho uMayisela.Uthe bona babheke kakhulu ekutheni umsebenzi wokuhanjiswa kwezidingo kubantu uyaqhubeka, abanendaba kakhulu nokuthi kuqhubekani kwezepolitiki.“Umsebenzi wethu siyawazi futhi akukho okuzosivimba ukuthi siqhubeke nawo,” kusho uMayisela.

KUBOSHWE izisebenzi zoMnyango wezaseKhaya ezingu-17 kanjalo nabanye abangezona izisebenzi zalo mnyango abangu-12 ngamacala athinta inkohlakalo.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe walo Mnyango uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi ephendula umbuzo kaNksz Liezl Linda van der Merwe we-IFP obuze ukuthi iziphi izinyathelo ezenziwayo emnyangweni ukuqeda inkohlakalo ethinta ukukhishwa kwezinto ngomgunyathi emnyangweni okubeka engcupheni ezokuphepha kwezwe.UMotsoaledi uthe bathula umkhankaso iBvisa Masina, elwisana nenkohlakalo. “Sisebenzisana nezinhlaka zokuphepha ukulwa nenkohlakalo emnyangweni. Onyakeni wezimali odlule sibophe abasebenzi abangu-17 kanjalo nabangebona abasebenzi abangu-12 ngenxa yalo mkhankaso.”Uthe bamatasa bafundisa izisebenzi zomnyango mayelana nenkohlakalo kanjalo nomthelela omubi wayo. “Sifuna ukuthi abasebenzi bethu baziphathe ngendlela yingakho uphiko lomnyango olulwa nenkohlakalo luzama ukunqanda izehlakalo zenkohlakalo. Siyaphenya ngazo zonke izinsolo ezibikwayo zenkohlakalo.”Uthe uma kutholakala ukuthi kunobuqiniso ezinsolweni zenkohlakalo udaba baludlulisela kwiLabour Relations ukuze labo abathintekayo baqondiswe ubugwegwe.“Kube sekubikelwa izimenenja ngezindlela ezisetshenzisiwe kwenziwa le nkohlakalo bese kulungiswa lapho kuxega khona. Kube sekuvalwa lelo gebe elikhona ukuze kungaphinde kwenzeke into efanayo.”Uthe kulo nyaka wezimali bazogxila kakhulu odabeni oluthinta ukungena ezweni kanjalo nezithinta amaPassports.“Kuzobhekwa kabanzi lezo zisebenzi ezisebenza lezi zindawo kubhekwe nokuthi zikhokhelwa ngendlela. Sizobheka nokuthi izindawo okukhishwa kuzona izimvume ziyahambisana nayo yonke imigomo ebekiwe.”Kuvela lokhu nje kuhlale kunokukhala kubantu abasuke beshadiswe nabantu bokufika ngokungemthetho.Lo mkhuba kusuke kusolakale ukuthi wenziwe ngabantu abasebenza ngaphakathi emnyangweni.

SEKUZOPHELA ukuhamba amabanga amade beyotheza izinkuni abantu baseNquthu esigodini sakwaQwabe kulandela ukwethulwa kohlelo lukagesi olwethulwe ngoLwesibili.Lolu hlelo lokufakelwa kwemizi engu-461 ugesi olubiza uR5 million lwethulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo ezobuCiko namaSiko, KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Hlengiwe Mavimbela obemele uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka.Lolu hlelo lwethulwe ku-ward 2 kwaQwabe.IPhini leMeya yaseNquthu, uNksz Nothile Zungu, lithe bese kuyiminyaka umphakathi ukhahlanyezwa izigameko zokwebiwa kwemfuyo.“Obekubuhlungu ukuthi indawo yakwaQwabe ibisifana nesiqhingi ngoba kuyiyo yodwa ebingenawo ugesi njengoba zonke izigodi eyakhelene nazo okuyiseSandlwana, KwaNyezi, eNgxibongo nakoHlazakazi sekunogesi. Okunye esifisa kucace ukuthi abantu bakwaQwabe abakaze bathi abawufuni ugesi ngoba bethi uzoxhopha izinkomo. Yinkolelo leyo ebifafazwa abantu abangenalo iqiniso ngomphakathi wakule ndawo,” kusho uNksz Zungu.UNksz Mavimbela uthe impilo yabantu bakwaQwabe ayisophinde ifane ngoba sebezoyeka ukuvuka ekuseni ngovivi beyotheza izinkuni, bashiye izingane zilele ngenxa yokuthi manje sebezofakelwa ugesi emzini yabo.“Kade sihamba lapha sikhuluma nomphakathi ngesikhathi kuza ukhetho. Ngakho izikhalo nosizi lwale ndawo sikuqonda kahle kakhulu njengohulumeni oholwa uKhongolose neniwukhethe kulezi zinyanga ezimbili ezedlule. UNdunankulu ubaba uSihle Zikalala ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo yesifundazwe uzibophezele njengohulumeni ukuthi sizobeka eqhulwini uhlelo lokuhanjiswa kwezidingo zabantu. Namhlanje silapha sihambisana nesikhondlakhondla senkampani kagesi okungu-Eskom, sizothi luyaqala luyashikisha ufudu. Ukufakwa kukagesi kule ndawo kuzokwenza nezinhlelo zamanzi ezenziwayo zisheshe,” kusho uNksz Mavimbela.Uthe bayazi ukuthi udaba lwamanzi lube wuhlupho kakhulu kulo mphakathi ngenxa yezigebengu ebezitshontsha ama-generator aphehla amanzi.Uthe usonkontileka ozofaka ugesi uzoqala kuleli sonto.UNkk Phetheni Mbokazi oyilungu lo mphakathi uthe kubajabulise kakhulu ukuthi ngemuva kweminyaka sebezoba nogesi. Uthe besebefile ukutheza izinkuni kude namadaka ezinkomo abebebasa ngawo.

SIZOVULWA ngelizayo isikole iSahlumbe High, eWeenen osekuphele inyanga sivaliwe ngenxa yezimpi zezigodi zabafundi ezikapakele esikoleni.Kuthiwa nezidakamizwa zidliwa udede esikoleni kukhalwa nangokushoda kwamakilasi.Izolo uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo uMnuz Kwazi Mshengu ube nomhlangano nomphakathi wakule ndawo kubalwa nenkosi uMthembu lapho kuvunyelwene khona ngokuthi kumele sivulwe isikole.Okhulumela uMshengu, uMnuz Kwazi Mthethwa, uthe kuvunyelwene nomphakathi nazo zonke ezinye izinhlaka ukuthi lesi sikole kumele sivulwe uma sekuvulwa izikole ngoLwesibili oluzayo.Uthe bekungokwesibili bebuyela kulesi sikole enyangeni eyodwa.“Ungqongqoshe uzimisele ngokuthi kulungiswe isimo sesikole yingakho ebuyele kaningi kusona ezama ukuthi kutholakale isixazululo. Ziningi izinto ebezinomthelela wokuthi kuphazamiseke isikole njengokuthi izimpi zezigodi zikapakele esikoleni, kube nokukhala kubazali ngendaba yezinguquko ngohlelo lwezemfundo kanjalo namagumbi angomahamba nendlwana okufundela okusho ukuthi ayashoda ngakho kudinga ukuthi sakhiwe isikole,” kusho uMthethwa.Uthe kuvunyelwene ngokuthi kubanjiswane wathi nendaba yengqalasizinda izolungiswa.UMshengu unxuse umphakathi ukuthi izikole uziphathise okwamagugu ngoba yilapho kwakhiwa khona abantu abazoba wutho ngomuso.Uthe kube nesikhalo ngokuthi isikole asilawuleki kahle ngoba abafundi baningi.“Bese sisezinhlelweni zokuthi sakhe esinye isikole eSahlumbe ukuze sikwazi ukuthatha omunye umthamo wabafundi bafundele khona. Kube nesikhalo ngendaba yezidakamizwa okuthiwa ziba nomthelela ekutheni baxabane balwe.”Uthe kube nesikhalo ngokusebenza kothisha njengoba abazali bethi abazange abafundi bawathole amaripoti kuvalwa izikole.Kumele kwenziwe umsebenzi, uthisha kumele afundise cishe amahora ayisikhombisa ngosuku. Ngesonto elizayo ngoLwesihlanu bonke abafundi kumele bagoduke bephethe amaripoti abo ukuze abazali babone ukuthi basebenze kanjani,” kusho uMshengu.Uthe impahla yesikole icekeleke phansi ngenxa yokulwa kwabafundi.“Besibize nobuholi bezigodi ezehlukene ukuze sibambisane sonke kubuyiselwe ukufunda esimeni esifanele. Sizosebenzisana namaphoyisa ukuze kuseshwe noma yinini ukuze abafundi bangaphathi izikhali,” kusho uMshengu.

UKHIHLE isililo unina wowayengumdlali weBafana Bafana ngesikhathi ebona uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa obezokhalisa umndeni ngokushona kukamyeni wakhe izolo.UNkk Ntombifuthi Meyiwa ongunina kaSenzo Meyiwa, ukhale ebona uMnuz Bheki Cele obezobhonga emswaneni ngokushona kukaMnuz Sam Meyiwa. UCele ubezovela okokuqala emndenini emuva kokushona kukaMeyiwa entathakusa yangoMsombuluko, oshone nesilonda ngenxa yokungaboshwa kwababulali bendodana yakhe.UCele ofike emuva kwamahora amathathu kunobekulindelekile, ucele ukubhunga nomndeni ngaphakathi endlini.Esekhuluma nabezindaba uthe unqume ukuzohlanganisa amehlo ngoba ubevele exhumana nomndeni ngisho uMeyiwa esaphila. Uchithe izinsolo zokuthi akukho okwenzekayo ngecala lokubulawa kukaSenzo, athe sekusungulwe ithimba eliyisipesheli eliphenyayo.“Akulona iqiniso ukuthi akwenziwa lutho ngecala ekubeni selufike ngisho kuMengameli. Ubaba kaSenzo waziyela kuMengameli eyocela ukuthi amtholele ukuthi ngubani owambulala. Nami ngakhuluma naye ngonyaka odlule kunemidlalo kaSenzo, wakhuluma konke okusenhliziyweni yakhe. Ngamtshela ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke ukuthi bagcine bengatholakalanga ababulali futhi namanje ngisakugcizelela lokho.”Uthe usuku nosuku bayakhuluma noNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa uMnuz Ronald Lamola ngaleli cala futhi unethemba lokuthi ikhona inqubekela phambili. ULamola bekumele avele naye izolo kwaMeyiwa kodwa wabuye wabanjwa uhambo.UCele ugcizelele ukuthi ngeke esalokhu esho isikhathi okuzoboshwa ngalo abasolwa njengaphambilini. Uthe angakuqinisekisa ukuthi ngelinye ilanga kukhona oyojeza.Uphikile ukuthi amaphoyisa asehlulekile kuleli cala njengoba ethe akhona namanye amacala okuphela iminyaka engaphezu kweyisihlanu kusaphenywa.Uthe ngenxa yobucayi becala okunye ngeke bakwazi ukukudalula futhi abantu kumele baqonde ukuthi akayena umphenyi.Okhulumela umndeni, uMnuz Siyabonga Meyiwa, uthe bayakwamukela okushiwo ungqongqoshe futhi bayethemba ukuthi ngelinye ilanga bayolithola iqiniso.UMeyiwa uzongcwatshwa ngoMgqibelo emathuneni aseStella Wood emuva kwenkonzo ezoba sehholo kwa-M, eMlaza.

Ngokusho kukaNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uDkt. Joe Phaahla, mhla zingama-25 kuMbasa iNingizimu Afrika yaqopha ukukhula kwezigameko ezintsha ze-COVID-19 ngama-137%, uma kuqhathaniswa nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ezedlule, okuholwa kakhulu ngamazinga aphezulu
okusuleleka ezifundazweni zase-Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natali kanye naseNtshonalanga Kapa.
“I-COVID-19 isalokhu iyingozi futhi ngeke sikwazi ukuyekela zonke izindlela zokuyivikela, kusho uNgqongqoshe uPhaahla.
“Siyaphinda futhi sinxusa bonke labo abangakagomi ukuthi beze bezogoma.
Sisalokhu singaphansi kwama-50% wabantu abadala asebethole okungenani umjovo owodwa kanti lokho akukuhle neze.

Sinxusa intsha esikhulile ukuthi isondele. Ukuqina kwamasotsha omzimba ngokwemvelo kuyafadalala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi akufani nokugoma, ngeke ukubekele isikhathi. Sinxusa bonke labo abafanelekile ukuthola umjovo wokuvuselela ukuthi basebenzise leli

UMnyango Wezempilo eNtshonalanga Kapa uthi imininingwane yalapha kuleli lizwe neyasemhlabeni jikelele iqinisekisa ukuthi ukugomela i-COVID-19 kusalokhu kuyisona sikhali esihamba phambili ekulweni negciwane. Lokhu kusiza kakhulu kubantu abanamasotsha
Ukuze inqotshwe, kufanele siyiqede ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kugoma abantu abaningi futhi siqhubeke nokuthola imijovo yokuvuselela, kusho umnyango.
Yize izigameko ze-COVID-19 zikhula futhi izwe lilindele ukuthi maduze lingene ehlandleni lesihlanu, akukaziwa ukuthi lizoba libi kangakanani.

“Okungakaqinisekiswa yilokho esikutshelwa ngososayensi bethu ukuthi umxhantela wegciwane omusha uzofika ngomxha ntela omusha oteketiswa ngelikaPi, ozofuna ukusabalala ngesivinini futhi wehlule namasotsha omzimba aqinile. Kodwa kulesi sigaba,
osekuqinisekisiwe ukuthi yikhona okudlangile yimixhantela yegciwane iOmicron ebizwa nge-B.4 ne-B.5, kusho uPhaahla.
Ungasiza ukugwema ukusulelana nge-COVID-19 ngokuqinisekisa:
Ukuthi awushiywa isikhathi ekuthatheni imigomo yakho ye-COVID-19 kanye nemijovo yokuvuselela.
Ukuthi izindawo zangaphakathi zingenisa umoya ngokwanele.
Ukuthi ugqoka isifonyo uma ungaphakathi kwesakhiwo kanye nasezindaweni ezigcwele abantu.
Ukuthi uyazi kumele wenzeni uma unezimpawu ezifana nezomkhuhlane.

Siphila ezweni lapho bonke abantu bevumelekile ukwe nza amasiko nemikhuba yabo ngokukhululeka. Izwe lapho noma ngubani anga bhikisha ngokukhululeka ngokweseka ezenhlalo, eze politiki nanoma yini enye imbangela noma ikuphi.
Ukusebenza komthethosi sekelo wethu kuphezu kohu lumeni ophendulayo, lapho aBaphathi bephendula ku bantu nalapho iPhalamende limele abantu.
Ilizwe lapho umthetho usebenza ngokulinganayo kunoma isiphi isakhamuzi.
Manje sesinohulumeni wa bantu, osebenzela abantu, futhi ngabantu.
Ngesikhathi umbuso wo bandlululo wawuqholosha sakunqoba ngomthethosi sekelo obandlulula ngoko -buhlanga emhlabeni jikelele eminyakeni engama-60 eya dlula, ulahle ukuzethemba nokubekezelela.

Encwadini engaphendu lwanga eyayiya ku-Verwoerd ngenyanga phambi koku menyezelwa kweriphabhu likhi, u-Nelson Mandela waqinisekisa ukuchithwa kwenhlangano yenkululeko yiriphabhulikhi yabamhlo phe eyaphoqelelwa nge nkani.

Ukuhlanganyela neqembu lamazwe e-BRICS ngowezi 2010 kwaba yingqophamla ndo ekufuneni kwethu ukwenza ngcono intuthuko kazwelonke eseqhulwini ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile neminotho eba lulekile esavela yase-Brazil, e-Russia, e-India nase-China.Uma

ungabhekisisa, ama zwe e-BRICS aqukethe mhla wumbe ama-41% enanibantu lomhlaba futhi anama-24% e-GDP yomhlaba wonke kanye nengxenye ye-16% yohwebo lomhlaba. Sesihlo mule inzuzo yobulungu baleli qembu lamazwe, ika khulukazi ekusebenzisaneni kwezomnotho.

Ukuhwebelana namazwe amabili sekukhulile, ika khulukazi i-China ne-India, ngokuthengiswa kwempahla ephuma kuleli lizwe kanye nokulethwa kwempahla ekhi qizwe kula mazwe osekuqine kakhulu. Amazwe eqembu i-BRICS ayaqhubeka nokuba ngumthombo obalulekile
wotshalomali oluqonde ngqo lwezangaphandle ezinda weni ezingumongo ezifana nezimayini, ezezimoto, ezokuthutha, ezamandla ezihlanzekile, ezemisebenzi yezezimali kanye nezolwazi lobuchwepheshe i-IT.

Ukubuyekezwa kwango wezi-2018 kobulungu bethu be-BRICS ngongoti benka mpani iDeloitte kwabalula ukuthi ababambisene neBRICS “batshala izimali ezweni ngokungaphezu kokuphindwe kathathu uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka eyisikhombisa ngaphambi kowezi-2011”. Lolu

tshalo mali kanye nemiklamo ibuye yaholela ekusungulweni kwe misebenzi ebonakalayo.Selokhu kwasungulwa ibhange iNew Development Bank , ihhovisi lalo lesi funda eliseGoli, iNingizimu Afrika isibe ngabahlomuli bokwesekwa ngezezimali ngokwemisebenzi ngemikla
mo yezokuthutha, ezamandla ezihlanzekile, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, ingqalasizinda yamanzi kanye nokunci shiswa kwegesi engcolisa umoya.

Selokhu kwabheduka ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 , iNingizimu Afrika isiya mukele izigidigidi ezi-R28 zo xhasomali oluvela kwibhange i-New Development Bank ngaphansi koHlelo Lwema limboleko Yezimo Eziphuthu mayo zeCOVID-19 ukulwa nobhubhane kanye nokwe seka
Kuphinde kwaba noku sebenzisana okukhulu noza kwethu be-BRICS ekutho leni izinsiza zokuzivikela kanye nokusebenzisana ekufinyeleleni kwimigomo nokusatshalaliswa kwayo.

Kamuva nje besibambe iqhaza kwiNgqungquthela ye-BRICS ye-13, lapho amazwe e-BRICS avuma ukuqinisa ukusebenzisana ukulwa neCOVID-19 kanye nokunxenxa ukwesekwa kwezepolitiki nezinsiza zezezimali ezidingekayo ukubhekana nokulungela ubhubhane olungabheduka

kuzobaluleka ikakhulukazi ekuvuseleleni umnotho womhlaba jikelele, lapho ukuthuthuka okunga lingani kusho ukuthi amanye amazwe azovuka masinya, ngesikhathi amanye esalela emuva.

lapho etshala futhi ekhulisa khona izitshalo kanye nezinkukhu azithumela ezitolo ezinkulu eziningi. Ipulazi lakhe libuye libe nabafundi abangama-20 abaqhuba izifundo zolimo ukuze libaqeqeshe. U-Dkt Zulu washiya phansi umsebenzi wakhe kuMnyango Wezolimo

abesifazane abaningi ngokusemandleni ukuthi bangene kwezolimo, oku ngumkhakha akholelwa ukuthi ungakwazi uku thuthukisa futhi usungule nemisebenzi.“Ngisebenze iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, ngisebenza nezikhulu ezikhulisa umkhakha wezolimo, futhi sasiza

wasebenza ezifundazweni eziyisithupha, esiza abesifazane kanye nabantu abasha ukuthi baqhube imisebenzi yabo yezolimo.

Ukufuya izinkukhu zokuthengisaNgowezi-2017, u-Dkt Zulu wabona ukuthi ukuqeqesha kwakhe kuyize uma imiphumela ingabonakali, ngakho-ke wabe esethenga ipulazi ukuze ezosebenza ngolwazi lwakhe.Namuhla, usengumlimi wezinkukhu zenyama ezingaphezu kwezi-7 500.

nezindleko ze-Gautrain, Metrobus, A Re Yeng, Rea Vaya, Metrorail, amabhasi e-Gautrain, amabhasi e-Johannesburg City Sightseeing, amabhasi kama sipala waseTshwane kanye namatekisi.

Ekhuluma ngesikhathi kwe thulwa lolu hlelo-kusebenza emahhovisi abasunguli balo e-Midrand, u-MEC wezoku Thutha e-Gauteng u-Ismail Vadi uthe umnyango uyasibona isidingo sezobuchwepheshe no hlelo oluphusile kwezokuthutha oluzobamba iqhaza ekuthuthu kisweni

“UHulumeni Wesifunda zwe sase-Gauteng unikele ngesikhathi, imizamo nezi nsiza ukuthuthukisa lolu hlelo lwezokuthutha olusiza umpha kathi ukwazi ukuxhumana kalula nezinhlobo zokuthu thwa komphakathi ezahlukene esifundazweni.”Sesiqalile ukubona amandla

ezobuchwepheshe eguqula isimo sezinsizakalo zokuthu thwa komphakathi. Akukho ukungabaza ukuthi ushintsho lwezobuchwepheshe emhlabe ni jikelele seluqalise uguquko olukhulukazi emkhakheni we zokuthutha, futhi nathi kumele siguquke ukuze sihambisane nalezi

U-Vadi uqinisekisile ukuthi isifundazwe sizoqhubeka noku sebenzisa ezobuchwepheshe besimanjemanje, ucwaningo nentuthuko ukuthuthukisa isifundazwe esisebenzisa ezobu chwepheshe esizophucula futhi senze kube lula ukufinyelela kwezokuthutha.

Uma ‘seludawunilodiwe’ lolu hlelo-kusebenza, luzobasiza abalusebenzisayo ukuhlela uhambo lwabo ngokuthi bakhethe uhlobo lwezoku thutha abaludingayo, izikhathi zokuhamba nokunye, njengo kuqoka uhambo olufushane nolusheshayo futhi olungambi eqolo.
Umfundi waseGoli u-Glen Dlamini uthe lolu hlelo-kuse benza luzoletha isisombululo kubagibeli abayizinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane.

Luwuhlelo oluhle kakhulu oluqaliswe nguhulumeni futhi akungabazeki nakancane uku thi luzosiguqula isimo sezinto, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha njengami abagibela izithuthi zomphakathi nsuku zonke besuka eSoweto belibangise eNyuvesi yaseGoli e-Auckland

Park.”“Okungenani manje sengiya kwazi ukuhlela uhambo lwami kangcono, ngokwemali engi -nayo, futhi ngenze nesilinganiso sezikhathi zokuhamba ngize ngifike lapho ngiphokophele khona.”“Ngicabanga ukuthi lolu wu hlelo-kusebenza olumangazayo impela futhi
njengomuntu ongeyena owokudabuka ku lesi sifundazwe, luzongisiza kakhulu uma kufanele ngiha mbe ngezithuthi zomphakathi,” kusho uKhanyo Malunga, ngesikhathi ekhuluma no Vuk’uzenzele e-Blairgowrie.
“Uma ngize lapha ngizokwe nza inhlolokhono, ngizokwazi ukuhlela kangcono futhi ngazi nendlela yami kanye nokuthi ngiyaphi,” kwengeza yena.
Lolu hlelo-kusebenza lutho lakala kumadivayisi e-Android nama-iPhone, ezitolo ezihluka hlukene zezinhle lo-kusebenza zokuxhumana .

Sasungula uhlelo loku siza abantu ngomse benzi ngonyaka odlule ukuze kudalwe inqwaba yamathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esifishane kakhulu. Lokhu kwakubiza izindlela ezintsha nezinga masu amasha okusebenza ukuze kuqaliswe izinhlelo ngesivinini nangobungako

Inqubo yokuqashwa kwabantu abaningi abanga sebenzi isebenzise izinkundla zobuchwepheshe ukufinyelela kubo bonke ababambiqhaza abafanele kile obekungafinyeleleka kubo. Isibonelo, abalimi abalimela ukuziphilisa bakwazi ukufaka isicelo soxhaso nge-USSD futhi
bathola amavawusha athunyelwa komakhalekhukhwini babo.

Selokhu uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo wavulela ukufakwa kwezi celo zesigaba esilandelayo sakamuva sokuqashwa kwabasizi basezikoleni, bangaphezu kwezi-940 000 abantu abasha abafake izi celo enkundleni yokufaka izicelo zomsebenzi ese tshenziswa mahhala
ebizwa ngokuthi i-SAYouth.mobi, eyingxenye yohlelo lukazwelonke lwePathway Management Network.
Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obusha ekuhlinzekeni ngamathuba omsebenzi kwenze uhlelo lokuqasha abasebenzi lwaba lula, lwashesha futhi lwaba ngoluvuleleke kakhulu.
UHlelo Loxhaso Lweze misebenzi LukaMongameli luqalise futhi lwalawula ukusebenzisana kwemi-khakha kahulumeni.
Izinhlelo zesigaba sokuqala zaqaliswa yiminyango kazwelonke eyi-11. Imise benzi yayo yaqondaniswa nokugwema ukuphindaphinda nokusaphaza futhi kwathuthukisa ukufunda kuleso sipiliyoni sabanye.
Uhlelo loxhaso oluqo-ndene namathuba omsebenzi luphinde lwaveza ukubaluleka koku bambisana komphakathi.
Uhulumeni, amabhizi nisi, ezemisebenzi kanye nezinhlangano zompha kathi bahlanganyele ukuze babandakanye labo abangasebenzi kwezomnotho.

Zingaphezu kwesigamu sesigidi izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika esezihlomulile esigabeni sokuqala, kube kusane zinye izinhlelo eziningana ezisaqhubeka. Ababambiqhaza banikwe ithuba lokuhola ukuze bakwazi ukuziphilisa, bafunda amakhono amasha futhi
bathuthukisa abavele sebenawo, nokusebenzisa isipiliyoni sabo ukudlulela komunye umsebenzi noma ukuzidalela amathuba omsebenzi.

Isibonelo, ababambiqhaza abaningi abaqashwa wuMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nengqa lasizinda esigabeni sokuqala sezinhlelo ba kwazi ukuthola imisebenzi emkhakheni wezemise benzi ozimele ekupheleni kukaNdasa 2021.
Iningi lalabo ababa sohlelweni lokuqala lokuba ngabasizi basezikoleni, nabo, bathola imisebenzi, sebehlome ngesipili yoni, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namareferensi.

Izinhlelo ezaqaliswa ngoHlelo Lwezemisebenzi LukaMongameli ziphi-nde zasiza imiphakathi kabanzi. Kugxilwe kakhulu ekudalweni kwamathuba omsebenzi emikhakheni enomthelela emphakathini ngokuqondile njenge zemfundo, ukutholakala kokudla, ukunakekelwa
kwengqalasizinda yo mphakathi kanye nokuvi kelwa kwezemvelo.
Ngohlelo Lwezemise benzi LukaMongameli kuqashwe abantu abasha ukuze kusekelwe futhi kusizwe othisha basezikoleni zethu. Abanye baqashwa ukuze bakhe amabhuloho emiphakathini yasemakhaya.

Kwasizwa inqwaba yeziNkulisa ukuze zikwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza nokuvulwa. Abalimi abalimela ukudayisela ukuziphilisa baxhaswa ukuze bandise imikhiqizo yabo, futhi kwavuselelwa futhi kwalungiswa imifula namaxhaphozi.

Njengengxenye yesi gaba sesibili, sisungula Isikhwama Sokuqasha Umphakathi esizosekela umsebenzi oholwa yizi-nhlangano zomphakathi ezinomsebenzi omuhle ovamile emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo enje ngezolimo zasema dolobheni, ubuciko bomphakathi, ukuthuthu kiswa
kwezindawo zokuhlala ezingahlelekile ngokugcwele kanye noku phepha komphakathi.
Njengoba kunokusilela emuva okukhulu kwezomnotho okudalwe wubhubhane lweSifo seGciwane le-Corona, ukuqashwa komphakathi kuhlinzeke ngoxhaso olubalulekile lokudalwa kwamathuba omsebenzi.
Lokhu kungukuqaliswa kokuzibophezela kwethu kokuthi uhulumeni kumele ubambe iqhaza ekuxhaseni ukuqashwa kwabantu ngenkathi imakethe yeza basebenzi isavuselelwa.

Ngohlelo Lwezemise benzi LukaMongameli sifake abantu abasha abaningi emisebenzini ngendlela engakaze ibonwe esikhathini esifishane. Balinganiselwa kuma-84% ababambi-qhaza bakusigaba sokuqala ababengabantu abasha abangaphansi kweminyaka engama-35, futhi
izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu kubo zazinga bantu besimame.

Esigabeni sesibili sili-ndele ukuthi lesi sibalo sibesikhulu kuna lokhu, njengoba uxhaso luzocishe lufinyelele kusigidigidi esisodwa samarandi lwesiNgenelelo soHlelo LukaMonga meli Lokuqasha Abantu Abasha.Njengengxenye yalokhu kungenelela, abantu abasha
abaningi bazoqashwa kuMisebenzi Yentsha Kazwelonke evuselelwe.
Abantu abasha bazothola ukuqeqeshelwa amakhono ezobuchwepheshe futhi amabhizinisi abantu abasha azothola uxhaso lokuwakhulisa nokuqasha.

Kuyinkinga enkulu ukungabibikho kwemisebenzi ezweni lethu. Angeke sikwazi ukuba nokunye ukubambezeleka oku-ngapheli kokubhekana nale nkinga ngenxa yezithiyo zeminyango kahulumeni, izinqubo zokuqasha esezaphelelwa isikhathi, ukungabibikho kwabasebenzi

ukuthi abantu abasha ba-yakhuthazwa ukuthi banqande ukwesuleleka, kubandakanyaukushintsha indlela yokuzi-phatha, ukufinyelela kuma-khondomu kanye nokuhlala ngokuhlolela leli gciwane. Ku-fanele siqinisekise ukuthi noma ngubani osehaqwe yileli gciwane

uyakwazi ukuﬁ nyelela ekwela-shweni kanye nasekunakeke-lweni.Kufanele ukuthi sisebenze ngokuzikhandla ekunqandeni i-HIV phakathi kwabantu abahamba phambili ekwesule-lekeni, okubandakanya aba-dayisa ngomzimba, abesilisa abazibandakanya ocansini na-banye

besilisa, kanye nabantu abazijova ngezidakamizwa. Kumele siqede ukucwaswa kanye nobandlululo olubhe-kiswe kulaba bantu. Singeze neze sazinika ithemba lokuthi singaqeda i-HIV uma sisaziba izidingo, ukukhathazeka kanye namalungelo engxenye yenani-bantu

lakithi.INingizimu Afrika kufanele ukuthi ikhuphule amasokisi ezinyathelweni zayo zokuthi kusokwe abesilisa abasha ukuze kuncishiswe ubungozi bokuthi bathole i-HIV . Ukuso-kwa okungaphephile akumele neze kugcine kunika abesilisa abasha izinkinga zempilo

zangunaphakade, futhi akukho na-munye okufanele ukuthi abulawe ukusokwa. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abesilisa abasebasha ba-sokwa ngendlela ephephile. Sigqugquzelwa yimiphu-mela yocwaningo lwakamuva olumayelana nezindlela zoku-vikelwa kweSandulela ngculazi

ipre-exposure prophylaxis( i-PrEP). Alufani nemishanguzo yokwelapha yona enikwa aba-ntu asebevele behaqwe yi-HIV , i-PrEP ihlanganisa phakathiukusetshenziswa njalo kwezidakamizwa zemishanguzo ngabantu abangakahaqwa yi-HIV ukuze kunqandwe ukwesule-leka.

Ucwaningo, olwenziwe ngososayensi bethimba leHIV Prevention Trials Network, luthole ukuthi ukuthola imijovo esebenza isikhathi eside kanye emva kwamaviki ayisishiyaga-lombili yayingcono kakhulu ukwedlula amaphilisi asetshe-nziselwa ukunqanda i-HIV . Le

miphumela inamandla kakhulu ekuqiniseni amandla ethu oku-bhekana nalo mqedazwe.Uma sifuna ukuqeda ngempu-melelo i-AIDS njengensongo ye-sihlava sezempilo yomphakathi eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo, kufanele ukuthi sihlanganise le ntuthuko yokwelapha ngo-kwenza

izinguquko ezibalule-kile ekuziphatheni. Kufanele futhi ukuthi sibhekane nomnotho kanye nezimo zenhlalo noku-yizona ezinesandla emazingeni aphezulu okwesuleleka.Omunye wemisebenzi yethu obaluleke kakhulu ukunika amandla amantombazane asethombile kanye

nabesifazane abasha, ngemfundo, ngomnotho kanye nangenhlalo. Kufanele ukuthi bakwazi ukuthathaizinqumo ngazo zonke izindlela ngempilo yabo, kubandakanya ububili babo kanye nendlela yokuziphatha ehambiselana nezocansi.Ekugcineni, sizophumelela ekuqedeni

i-AIDS ngokuni-ka abantu abasha amandla, abesifazane kanye nabanye abantu abasengcupheni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukunikwa ama-ndla ngokukwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi, iseluleko kanye no-kusekela. Lokhu kubandakanya ukukwazi ukufinyelela kwi-mfundo kanye
namathubaomnotho, ikakhulukazi abe-sifazane abasebasha. Lokhu kunikwa amandla kuphinde kuchaze ukuthi wonke umuntu kumele akwazi ukufinyelela ekuhlolweni, ukwelashwa kanye nezinye izinsiza zezempilo.

Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika basuka kude, babekezele kakhulu futhi benze inqubekelaphambili ebonakalayo ekulweni ne-HIV , i-AIDS kanye neSifo sofuba. Masiphinde siqinise amandla okusombulula kanye nezenzo zethu zokubhekana futhi sinqobe i-AIDS unomphela.

Ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa isimo senhlekelele kazwelonke emavikini ayisithupha adlule, iNingizimu Afrika yayinezi-gameko ezingama-61 kuphela eziqinisekisiwe zabasuleleke ngegciwane lecorona . Nga-phandle kokubuka inani eliphansi, umbono wongoti kanye

nesikubone kwamanye amazwe aphesheya kubonise ukuthi ukusuleleka kusazokhuphuka ngendlela eyisimanga. Ngabe sengithi kuzodingeka kutha-thwe izinyathelo ezinkulu futhi eziphuthumayo. Lezo zinyathelo – okubanda-kanya ukuvalwa kwezwe jikelele nokuvalwa

kwemingcele – okubonise ukuthi kuyasebenza ngempela ukubambezela uku-bhebhetheka kwesifo. Lokhu kuyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika bayilandele imiyalelo yokuvalwa kwezwe, ukuqhelelana nabanye abantu kanye nokugqoka izifonyo

zo-buso. Ngiyanibonga kakhulu ngalokhu nangakho konke ukuzinikela esenikwenzile.Kulesi sigaba sokudlondlobala kobhubhane, amanye amazwe abe nenani labasulelekile eliphe-zulu ukwedlula thina. Njenga-manje – okungusuku lwama-46 selokhu sabika isigameko

se-100 segciwane lecorona – sesinezi-gameko eziqinisekisiwe eziyizi-6 783. Izwe lase-Italy, elinenani labantu elifanayo nelethu, libe nezigameko ezingaphezu kwe-zi-140 000 kanye neMelika ibe nezigameko eziqinisekisiwe ezilinganiselwa ezi-700 000

esikhathini sezinsuku ezinga-ma-46.Kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi ubungozi sebudlulile. Asikafiki esihlokweni sokusuleleka eNi-ngizimu Afrika. Lonke ucwani-ngo lwesayensi lubonisa ukuthi izinga lokusuleleka lisazoqhu-beka likhuphuke ngesivinini esikhulu

ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezizayo.Noma kunjalo, isivinini eli-bhebhetheka ngaso igciwane nenani labantu abasulelekayo lizolawulwa ukuthi thina senza-ni manje. Yingakho ukuxegiswa kokuvalwa kwezwe kudinga kwenziwe kancane kancane nangokucophelela. Kungalesi

sizathu ukuthi imithethonqubo eminingi kumele ihlale ikhona futhi kungani kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi abantu bayila-ndele. Ngiyazi ukuthi kunzima kanjani lokhu futhi ngiyakuqo-nda ukukhathazeka abantu ba-kithi abaningi abanako ngokuthi le mithethonqubo

igxambukela futhi ibeka imikhawulo ku-malungelo abo. Inhlosongqangi yethu ngukugcina impilo.Ukuqhelelana nabantu noku-hlanzeka kuseyizona zikhali zethu ezihamba phambi-li kulo mzabalazo. Ilokhu okulawula imithethonqubo esiyibekile esigabeni sesine

sokubhekana negciwane. Ukucabangela kwethu kususe-lwa ebufakazini obuqanda ikha-nda, ulwazi lwesayensi no-mnotho kanye nokusebenza okuhamba phambili kwamazwe ngamazwe. Ngesahlulelo sowe-1995 seNkantolo Yomthethosise-kelo eyakhipha emthethweni isigwebo

sentambo, u-Justice Arthur Chaskalson wabhala wathi: “Amalungelo empilo nesithunzi yiwona abaluleke kakhulu kuwowonke amalu-ngelo omuntu futhi angumtho-mbo wawo wonke amalungelo omuntu. Ngokuzinikela kwethu emphakathini owakhiwe ngo-kwamukela amalungelo

abantu sidingeka ukuba siwaqhaka-mbise la malungelo amabili okudlula wonke amanye.”Le mithethonqubo esiyibekile ibekelwe phezu kwalokho ku-zinikelela empilweni nesithu-nzi, futhi ezithethelela – kulezi zimo ezibucayi – imikhawulo yesikhashana kwamanye

amalu-ngelo, njengokuba nelungelo lokuya lapho uthanda khona nokuba nanoma ubani ofuna ukuba naye.Ekwenzeni lokhu, iNingizimu Afrika ayifani namanye amazwe.Inani labantu emhlabeni elili-nganiselwa koyedwa kwabahlanu livalelwe ngenxa yesifo noma

lisekuvalweni kwezwe, ngaleli nani elikhula ngesivi-nini ngenxa yokukhula kwenani labasulelekayo. Lokhu kubanda-kanya amazwe anenani labantu elikhulu kunelethu, njenge-India enabantu abayisigidigidi esi-1.5. Inqwaba yamazwe isibeke izikhathi zokubuya

ekhaya njengalesi esisibekile lana. Imikhawulo ekuhambeni ibekiwe emazweni amaningi. EUK kanye nakunhlokodolobha yaseFrance , e-Paris , ukuzivocavoca ngaphandle kunemikhawulo yamahora athile ebangeni eli-thile ukusuka ekhaya lomuntu.Izindlela zokugcina

nokugwe-ma ezifanayo nezethu zibekiwe emazweni amaningi. Isibo-nelo, ukudayiswa kotshwala ngesikhathi sokuvalwa kwezwe kunemikhawulo ethile noma ku-misiwe ezindaweni eziningi ngohulumeni bendawo, kubanda-kanya i-Mexico , i-Hong Kong kanye neGreenland ,

ngenyanga edlule eyabeka ukuvalwa uku-dayiswa kotshwala ngesikhathi sokuvalwa kwezwe ukunciphisa ukusuleleka kodwa futhi ‘no-kwehlisa udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.’Sekube nemibono eminingi yomphakathi ngesinqumo sika-hulumeni sokwelula

ukuvinje-lwa kokudayiswa kwemikhiqizo yogwayi esigabeni sesine. Isi-nqumo esifana nalesi kulindele-kile ukuthi silethe impikiswano, kodwa akukuhle ukucabanga ukuthi kunoNgqongqoshe noma uMongameli owenza noma osho noma yini afuna ukuyisho ngalo-lu

daba.Mhla zingama-23 kuMbasa, ngamemezela ukuthi ukudayiswa kogwayi kuzovumeleka esigabeni sesine. Lokhu kwa-kususelwa embonweni wo-Mkhandlu Kazwelonke Obhekene Negciwane Lecorona (NCCC), futhi okwakuqukethwe ohlakeni olwalungakaphasiswa olwaluchicilelelwe

ukubonisana.Emva kokucabangisisa oku-nzulu nokuxoxisana, i-NCCC yabuye yabuyekeza isinqumo sayo egwayini. Yingakho ke, imithethonqubo eyavunyelwa yiKhabhinethi neyamenyezelwa nguNgqongqoshe uNkosazana Dlamini-Zuma mhla zingama-29 kuMbasa yelula ukuvalwa

ko-gwayi.Lesi kwaba yisinqumo esathathwa ndawonye nezitatimende ezethulwa emphakathini yimi-na noNgqongqoshe zethulwa simele, sigunyazwe, yithimba engiliholayo.Wonke umthethonqubo esi-wubekile ucatshangisiswe kanzulu. Ngesikhathi senza lokho kube khona

ukubonisana nongoti bezokwelapha, izifunda ezehlukene kanye nezimboni ezehlukene. Besiholwa izi-nhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nalokho amanye amazwe asedlule kukhona.Iqiniso ukuthi sizwa amanzi ngobhoko. Kusekuningi kakhu-lu okumayelana nalolu bhu-bhane

lwegciwane okungazi-wa. Kungcono ukuphambukela ohlangothini lokucophelela kunokuthi kusasa silahlekelwe ngokwahlulelwa. Ngesikhathi kusenokwehluka kwemibono kwezinye zezi-nqumo esizithathile – kwesinye isikhathi lokhu kunombono owehlukanisa abantu –

uhu-lumeni wenza yonke imizamo ukukwenza ngendlela ezokwe-nza ngcono amalungelo empilo nesithunzi sabobonke abantu bakithi.Ekulaleleni abantu bakithi nokukhathazeka kwabo ngalesi sikhathi kube ngeye yezinto ezehlukile esinazo zokuthi uhu-lumeni ululawule

kanjani lolu bhubhane. Siyaqhubeka uku-lalela ukukhathazeka kwabantu bakithi futhi sizimisele ukwenza izinguquko ezizohambisana nokukhathazeka kwabantu ngezingqinamba abahlangabe-zana nazo nesidingo sokuphe-phisa izimpilo.Kulesi sikhathi esinzima, ama-ndla

ethu sonke kumele siwa-bhekise ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ezempilo nempilo kuyagcinwa, ukuthi ukuthuthwa kokudla, amanzi, usizo lwezempilo, ukuphepha komphakathi no-kwesekwa komphakathi aku-phazamiseki. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo ezi-ngajwayelekile,

njengohulu-meni, njengomunye nomunye nanjengomphakathi ngesinye isikhathi amaphutha sizowe-nza. Uma lokho kwenzeka, sizowalungisa. Kodwa kumele siqhubekele phambili, singa-ngenwa itwetwe noma singa-lahlekelwa ukuzimisela.Isimo esizithola sikuso sidinga
isibindi nokubekezela. Sidinga ukufiselana okuhle noku-thembana phakathi kwakho, isakhamuzi, kanye nohulumeni, naphakathi komunye nomunye.
Umthetho Obhekelele U dlame Lwasekhaya uzi vikela ngokugcwele izisulu zodlame lwasekhaya.

Ukuhlukumeza kwe nzeka ngezindlela ezahlu kene futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu besifazane bazi izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlukumeza ukuze ba zivikele. Udlame lwasekhaya lwe nzeka uma umuntu ehle lwa yilokhu:Ukushaywa: Isibonelo, uma ushaywa noma
Ukuhlukunyezwa ngoko cansi: Uma isisulu sidlwe ngulwa noma siphoqwa ukuthi senze noma sibukele okuphathelene nocansi okwe hlisa isithunzi.
Ukuhlukumeza ngoko mphefumulo, ngamazwi kanye nangokomqondo: Lokhu kwenzeka uma umu ntu ehlale ethukwa, ejivazwa noma ebizwa ngamagama ajivazayo.
Ukuhlukumeza ngokupha thelene nomnotho: Lokhu kungenzeka uma isisulu sivi njelwa ukuthi sithole iholo.
Ukwesabisa: Isibonelo sokwesabisa yilapho isisu lu sithola imilayezo noma ama-SMS asesabisayo futhi ethusayo.
Ukukhathazwa: Kungaba isibonelo ngokuthi uhlale ushayelwa ucingo noma uma uhlale ugadiwe futhi lokhu kukwenza ukuthi wesabe.
Ukulandelwa: Kwenzeka uma umhlukumezi ehlala ekulandela noma ephoqa ukukhuluma nawe ungafuni.
Ukulinyazwa kwempahla: Isibonelo, uma ohlukumezayo elimaza impahla yakho ngamabomu ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.
Noma eyiphi enye indlela yokuziphatha ngokulawula noma ngokuhlukumeza e ngabangela ukulimaza ngokuphathelene noku phepha, impilo noma uku phila kahle kungukuhlu kumeza.

Umuntu okuhlukumezayo kungaba yinoma ubani ono budlelwane noma ohlobene naye ngokwegazi, oshade naye noma umuntu okukhu lisile ongakuzali/ingane oyi khulisile ungayizali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa oshade naye, umlingani ohlala naye ko dwa ongashadile naye, umza
li okukhulisayo ongakuzali noma ingane oyikhulisayo ongayizali, ohlala naye endli ni noma ilungu lomndeni.
Kungaba futhi umuntu owa wuthandana naye noma owawethembisene naye u mshado.
Lokhu kungukwenza ngcono ngama-25% onyakeni owedlule kanye nokunyuka ngama-15% onyakeni owedlule ngaphambi kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19.
Esikhathini esifanayo, ihhovisi lakwa-SARS liphinde lakhokha inani eliphezulu kakhulu lokubuyisela intela selokhu lasungulwa eminyakeni engama-25 eyadlula.
I-ejensi enekhono lokuqoqa intela ingummongo wokwakha umbuso okhonayo.

Ukuqoqwa kwentela kuqhuba ukuthuthukiswa kwesizwe sethu. Imali eqoqwe ngu-SARS ikhokhela izidingonqangi kanye nengqalasizinda. Ngemali engango-R17.8 trillion eqoqwe ngu-SARS selokhu asungulwa ngowe1997, sikwazile ukwakha izingqalasizinda zomphakathi
eziningi ezifana nemitholampilo, izikole nezibhedlela, salungisa futhi sakha imigwaqo emisha, saphinde seseka umphakathi obuthakathaka ngezibonelelo zikahulumeni kanye nezinye izinyathelo.
Uma uhlelo-kusebenza lokuqoqwa kwentela kanye nemithetho eseka lokho isebenza kahle, ingaxaki futhi isebenza ngokulinganayo, ikhuthaza ukuthotshelwa kokukhokhwa kwentela.
Ukugcina uzinzo kanye nokwethembeka kwa-SARS bekungokunye okuseqhulwini uma ngikhethwa njengoMongameli ngowezi-2018.

Njengezinye izikhungo eziningi, u-SARS naye ushayeke kakhulu ngumthelela omubi wokuqhwagwa kwamandla ombuso, ukugxambukela kwezepolitiki, ukungaphathi ngomthetho kanye nezinye izinto ezikhinyabeza ukusebenza kahle kwakhe.
Lokhu kube nomphumela hhayi nje kuphela wokudicilela phansi ukulunga kwabakhokhintela, kodwa nokulahleka kokuzithemba njengebhizinisi emnyangweni.

Ngowezi-2018, ngaqoka ikhomishana ezophenya ngokuphathwa nokwenganyelwa kwentela kwa-SARS usihlalo wayo kwakunguJaji osewathatha umhlalaphansi u-Robert Nugent. Ikhomishana yethula umbiko wayo wokugcina ekupheleni kwawo lowo nyaka.
Eminyakeni emine eyalandela, u-SARS useqalise cishe zonke izincomo eziyi16 kanye nezinye izincomo ezingama-27 ukugcina uzinzo kulo mnyango.

U-SARS useqhube iqhingasu lokushintsha indlela yokusebenza ukuthi azibeke phambili ekusebenzeni kahle nokwethula izinsiza ngendlela ehamba phambili. Usehlanganise uhlelo lokugqugquzela ukuziphatha kahle nokuthobela imithetho yentela.

Amanani aphezulu amanje empahla, aholela ekunyukeni kwentela yezinkampani, abe nesandla ekuqoqweni kwakamuva kwentela eyeqile. Okuphinde kwadlala indima izinyathelo u-SARS azithathile ukwenza ngcono ubuchwepheshe bokuthumela ulwazi nezinye
izingqalasizinda, indlela yokusebenza yesimanje, ukuqasha abasebenzi abanekhono, kanye nokulwa nokubalekela ukukhokhwa kwentela kanye nobuge-bengu.
Esinye sezincomo zeKhomishana ka-Nugent kwakungukuthi u-SARS aphinde asungule ithimba elizoqapha liphinde liphenye ukuhweba okungekho emthethweni.

UPhiko Lomnotho Ongekho Emthethweni olwasungulwa ngowezi-2018 seluphumelele izikhathi eziningi ekuqedeni ukuhweba komnotho okungekho emthethweni, kubandakanya nokugxila ekungalandelini umthetho wentela yempahla ephuma kwamanye amazwe.

Ukuqoqwa kwentela ezinkampanini ezisohlwini lwe-JSE, abahlala kumazwe amaningi kanye nalabo bantu abagwilike kakhulu manje sekusebenza kahle kakhulu kulawulwa uPhiko Lwamabhizinisi Amakhulu, olwaphinde lwethulwa ngowezi-2020.
Umphumela woshintsho lwaka-SARS ludale ukuba ngcono ekuthotshelweni kwentela yomuntu ngamunye, intela yenkampani kanye neNtela Ngobungakomholo.

U-SARS uveza obala labo ababalekela ukukhokha intela, abazuza ezenzweni zobugebengu, kanye nalabo ababandakanyeka kwizenzo zenkohlakalo. Wakheke kahle kakhulu ngokuthi 'umqoqintela' ungomunye wamathuluzi asebenza kahle kakhulu ukuqeda inkohlakalo.

Ezigamekweni lapho indlela yokuphila yomuntu ayihambelani nalokho akuveza obala, u-SARS ubenza ucwaningo lwendlela yoku-phila. Onyakeni owedlule, u-SARS uphothule ucwaningo lwezindlela zokuphila okuholele ekuqoqweni kwezinye izigidi ezingamaR474.

Njengoba siphokophelele phambili nemizamo yokuqinisa amandla ombuso nokwakha kabusha izikhungo ebeziqedwe amandla ukuqhwagwa kwamandla ombuso, kuningi okusafanele sikufunde kulokho okuzuzwe ngu-SARS esikhathini esifushane.
Uma izikhungo zikahulumeni zilawulwa kahle futhi ngempumelelo, uma zibonisa ukuthembeka nokuba neqiniso ekusebenzeni kwazo, lokhu kufaka isandla ekwenyuseni ukuthembeka kuhulumeni.
Ukuzithemba kumabhizinisi nakubatshalizimali nakho kuba ngcono, kugqugquzeleka utshalomali olukhulu kanye nokukhula komnotho.

Ubuholi kanye nabasebenzi bakwa-SARS kufanele bethulelwe isigqoko ngomsebenzi wabo. Kufanele sibonge abakhokhintela abathembekile baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphandle kokusebenzisana nabo, lemali etholakele kamuva ngabe akwenzekanga.
Ukuthi u-SARS ukhulise umthamo wentela ngokubhalisa kwabantu abasha abayizigidi ezi-1.8 onyakeni owedlule kungenye yempumelelo enhle kakhulu.

Singaphinde sakhe iNingizimu Afrika kuphela uma siqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nale sibopho sethu sonke, futhi uma siqinisa umsebenzi osuqalile wokuqinisekisa ukuthi le ntela isetshenziswa ngobuhlakani nangendlela elungile.

Umbiko wokugcina woPhiko Olukhethekile Kwezokuphenywa Kwamacala (i-SIU) ophenyweni lwawo ngezinsolo ezihlobene nanoma ikuphi ukusetshenziswa budedengu kwezimali ze-COVID-19, kuzo zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni nakumkhakha ozimele usanda kugunyazwa
nguMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi ukhishelwe umphakathi.
Umbiko uyisinyathelo esibaluleke kakhulu ekulweni nenkohlakalo nokuphatha budedengu kwimikhakha kahulumeni nozimele, ubeke kanjalo uMongameli.
NgoNtulikazi ngowezi-2020, uMongameli u-Ramaphosa wagunyaza uphenyo lwe-SIU.
Ngaleso sikhathi, waqinisekisa ukuthi uma i-SIU ithola ubufakazi bokuthi ubugebengu benzekile, izobophezeleka ukuthi idlulisele ubufakazi kuPhiko Lwezokushushisa Kuzwelonke (i-NPA).
I-SIU yaphinde yagunyazwa ukuvula kokuthethwa kwamacala ukuze kuzobuyiswa konke okulahlekele umbuso.
I-SIU yaphenya izinkontileka eziyizi-5 467 ezazihlonyuliswe abahlinzeki-nsiza abayizi-3 066, ezazilinani eliyizigidigidi eziyi-R14.3.
Uphenyo lwezinkontileka eziyizi-4 549 seluphothuliwe, eziyizi-2 803 zazo zatholakala ukuthi azihanjiswanga ngendlela. Lokhu kwenza ama-62% ophenyo oseluphothuliwe.

“Lolu phenyo beluqondiswe ngqo kubantu nezikhungo ebezizitshela ukuthi zingaxhaphaza umzuzu wobuthakathaka besizwe ukuzicebisa bona nalabo abahlangene nabo ukuxhaphaza izinsiza zomphakathi,” kusho uMongameli.

Wengeze ngokuthi akwamukelekile ukuthi izinkontileka eziningi kangaka okufanele zisindise izimpilo futhi zivikele indlela yokuziphilisa yabantu zaphathwa ngendlela engeyiyo, ngokungalandeli umthetho noma ngokukhwabanisa.
“Lolu phenyo lubonisa ukuzimisela ukusiphula isihlava senkohlakalo kanye nokubhekana nababhebhezeli bayo,” kusho uMongameli u-Ramaphosa.
Umbiko wokugcina ucacisa ngezindaba i-SIU ezidluli-sele ku-NPA, iminyango nezinkampani kumkhakha kahulumeni namanye amaqembu.
I-NPA izophothula inqubo yokuthi izigilamkhuba zibhekane nomthetho kanye nokubhekana nobuntekenteke obutholwe uphenyo lwe-SIU, kuchaza uMongameli.
Selokhu kwaqala uphenyo, i-SIU, isebenzisana namanye ama-ejensi, isiyenze le nqubekela-phambili elandelayo:

Amacala angama-45, enani elihlanganisiwe lezigidigidi ezi-R2.1, adluliselwe kwiNkantolo Ekhethekile Yamacala Enkohlalo, Ukukhwabanisa kanye Nokusetshenziswa kwemali ngokungekho emthethweni i-Special Tribunal on Corruption, Fraud and Illicit Money Flows.

Inkantolo ekhethekile inegunya elisemthethweni ukubuyisa izimali zikahulumeni ezebiwe kwenziwa inkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezimali ngokungekho emthethweni, futhi ithathele ababhebhezeli balokho izinyathelo zomthetho;
Amacala angama-224 adluliselwe ukuthi izi phathimandla zeminyango noma zezinkampani zikahulumeni zithathelwe izinyathelo zokuqondiswa izigwegwe;
Amacala angama-386 adlu liselwe kwi-NPA, futhi amathathu adluliselwe ukuthi uMongameli atha-the isinyathelo ngawo;
Amacala angama-330 adlu liselwe ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zomthetho, okubandakanya ukuvi njelwa ukusebenza (ungabe usakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi nohulumeni).
Ngokombiko, isamba sezigidi ezingama-R551.5 (inani lemali kanye nempahla) kumele sibuyiswe, kanti izigidi ezingama-R34.2 sezibuyisiwe kuze kube manje.
Uphenyo luvimbe ukulahlekelwa izigidi ezingama-R114.2, futhi lwa bekela eceleni izinkontileka zenani lezigidi ezingamaR170.4.
I-SIU ilindele ukuthi la macala aphothulwe phakathi kukaNdasa noMbasa wezi-2022, ngaphambi kokuhanjiswa kombiko owengeziwe kuMongameli ekupheleni kukaNhlangulana.
Umbiko awufaki phakathi imininingwane yophenyo olusaqhubeka lwezinsolo ezitholwe i-SIU emva ko mnqamulajuqu owawubekelwe umbiko wokugcina.
Lokhu kubandakanya uphenyo lwabahlinzeki nsiza abangama-476, abeyaniswa nezinkontileka ezingama-964, zenani elingaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-R961.6.
Imiphumela yalolu phenyo, ihhovisi likaMongameli lithe, izofakwa kumbiko wangoNhlangulana.
UMongameli wethulele isigqoko i-SIU ngomsebenzi ewenze ezinyangeni eziyi-18 ezedlule, kanye nezingede nabanye ofakazi abalethe imininingwane kubaphenyi.
